vocabBank.zh: 我们已经有了一支像样的团队了。

vocabBank.en: What did you learn first, back then?
vocabBank.zh: 你当初最先学的是什么？

vocabBank.en: That's exactly where I started too.
vocabBank.zh: 我当初也正是从这儿开始的。

vocabBank.en: By tomorrow, we'll have had a whole night to prepare.
vocabBank.zh: 到明天，我们会有一整晚的时间来准备。

vocabBank.en: It is, and I wish I felt more ready.
vocabBank.zh: 是的，我真希望自己感觉更有准备一点。

vocabBank.en: If I were you, I'd say the same thing.
vocabBank.zh: 如果我是你，我也会这么说。

vocabBank.en: That's all I ever wanted too.
vocabBank.zh: 这也是我一直以来想要的。

vocabBank.en: Yes it is, welcome! Please, sit anywhere.
So many more than expected, in a good way.
vocabBank.zh: 比预期多了这么多，是好事。

vocabBank.en: Let's begin, everyone repeat after me.
vocabBank.zh: 我们开始吧，大家跟我念。

vocabBank.en: You had already been through so much.
I'm honored it's felt that way.
vocabBank.zh: 很荣幸这堂课能给你这种感觉。

vocabBank.en: They did, a long time ago.
vocabBank.zh: 确实有过，很久以前的事了。

vocabBank.en: I understand, I felt that way too.
If I were starting again, I'd do exactly that.
vocabBank.zh: 如果我重新开始，我也会正好这么做。

vocabBank.en: One person at a time, that's how it works.
vocabBank.zh: 一次一个人，事情就是这样成的。

vocabBank.en: You did it! I'm so proud of you.
vocabBank.zh: 你做到了！我真为你骄傲。

vocabBank.en: We've improved more than we realize, it's true.
vocabBank.zh: 确实，我们的进步比自己意识到的要多。

vocabBank.en: You've kept that a secret this whole time?
I wish you'd told me too, but I understand.
vocabBank.zh: 我也希望你早点告诉我，但我理解。

vocabBank.en: You'll be an amazing teacher, Sam.
vocabBank.zh: 你会成为一名很棒的老师的，Sam。

vocabBank.en: None of us would be here without that.
vocabBank.zh: 没有那件事，我们谁都不会在这儿。

vocabBank.en: A little of both, and I love that.
vocabBank.zh: 两者兼备，我很喜欢这样。

vocabBank.en: Welcome, Sam — we're so glad you're here.
Oh wow, who told you about us?
vocabBank.zh: 哦哇，是谁跟你说起我们的？

vocabBank.en: Word travels fast around here, I guess.
vocabBank.zh: 看来这儿的消息传得挺快的。

vocabBank.en: If you'd like to come, we'd be happy to talk.
vocabBank.zh: 如果你想来，我们很乐意聊聊。

vocabBank.en: She said that to me too, once.
She told the truth — it really was just that.
vocabBank.zh: 她说的是实话——它原本确实只是那样。

vocabBank.en: Sure, I can tell you the whole story.
vocabBank.zh: 当然，我可以把整个故事都跟你说说。

vocabBank.en: She mentioned that to me too, actually.
vocabBank.zh: 其实她也跟我提过这事。

vocabBank.en: Some of it, yes — but not all of it.
vocabBank.zh: 可以写一部分——但不是全部。

vocabBank.en: Some things are better left untold.
vocabBank.zh: 有些事最好还是别说出来。

vocabBank.en: I wish I had chosen my words more carefully too.
vocabBank.zh: 我也希望自己当时能更谨慎地选择措辞。

vocabBank.en: It really does deserve to be told.
Let's trust her, she seemed thoughtful.
vocabBank.zh: 我们相信她吧，她看起来挺细心的。

vocabBank.en: She's already sent it? Let's read it now.
vocabBank.zh: 她已经发过来了？我们现在就读吧。

vocabBank.en: That title gives me chills, honestly.
vocabBank.zh: 说实话，这个标题让我起了鸡皮疙瘩。

vocabBank.en: If it's published, that's more than okay with me.
vocabBank.zh: 如果发表了，我完全没问题。

vocabBank.en: She wrote exactly what it felt like.
vocabBank.zh: 她写出了那种感觉本身。

vocabBank.en: More moving than any of us expected, really.
vocabBank.zh: 确实比我们所有人预期的都更感人。

vocabBank.en: We had nothing, and it still felt like enough.
vocabBank.zh: 我们一无所有，但那已经足够了。

vocabBank.en: It'll stay with all of us, I think.
vocabBank.zh: 我觉得它会留在我们所有人心里。

vocabBank.en: Send it exactly as it is, I agree.
vocabBank.zh: 我同意，就这样原样发出去吧。

vocabBank.en: The front page? I can't believe it.
People are reaching out from everywhere.
vocabBank.zh: 各地的人都在联系我们。

vocabBank.en: That offer means more than they know.
vocabBank.zh: 这份心意比他们想的还要珍贵。

vocabBank.en: They said that? That's exactly the point.
vocabBank.zh: 他们这么说？这正是关键所在。

vocabBank.en: Bigger than we ever imagined, truly.
vocabBank.zh: 确实比我们想的要大得多。

vocabBank.en: And now it's changing lives already.
vocabBank.zh: 而现在它已经在改变生活了。

vocabBank.en: I wish she could see it too, more than anything.
vocabBank.zh: 我也非常希望她能看到这一切。

vocabBank.en: In a way, she really has, hasn't she?
vocabBank.zh: 从某种意义上，她确实已经看到了，对吧？

vocabBank.en: Higher than we planned — how much higher?
We hadn't planned for this at all, had we?
vocabBank.zh: 我们完全没料到这一点，是吧？

vocabBank.en: It's better that we talk about it now.
How much time do we actually have?
vocabBank.zh: 我们实际上还有多少时间？

vocabBank.en: If that's true, we'd better act now.
vocabBank.zh: 如果是真的，那我们最好现在就行动。

vocabBank.en: We definitely didn't come this far for nothing.
vocabBank.zh: 我们肯定不是白走了这么远的路。

vocabBank.en: Although money is tight, that matters more.
vocabBank.zh: 尽管手头紧张，但这一点更重要。

vocabBank.en: Despite the money trouble, that's still true.
vocabBank.zh: 尽管有资金问题，这一点依然成立。

vocabBank.en: What can we actually try first?
vocabBank.zh: 我们实际上可以先试试什么呢？

vocabBank.en: If we asked them, some would surely help.
vocabBank.zh: 如果我们求助，肯定会有人愿意帮忙。

vocabBank.en: We could, and I think we should.
vocabBank.zh: 我们可以，而且我觉得应该这么做。

vocabBank.en: Let's do both, why choose just one?
vocabBank.zh: 两个都做吧，何必只选一个呢？

vocabBank.en: Whoever left that, they believed in us.
vocabBank.zh: 不管是谁留下的，他们都相信我们。

vocabBank.en: She said that? That means everything.
vocabBank.zh: 她这么说？这对我们意义重大。

vocabBank.en: Although it's not enough, it's a real start.
vocabBank.zh: 尽管还不够，但这是个真正的开始。

vocabBank.en: Stories from the students would move everyone.
vocabBank.zh: 学员们的故事一定会打动所有人。

vocabBank.en: Sure, I can have one ready by tomorrow.
vocabBank.zh: 没问题，我明天就能弄好一张。

vocabBank.en: By then, we'll have finished everything.
vocabBank.zh: 到那时，我们会把一切都准备好的。

vocabBank.en: Sure, a big circle it is.
They've already made signs? That's so sweet.
vocabBank.zh: 他们已经做好标牌了？真是太贴心了。

vocabBank.en: Nobody needs to be asked twice, it seems.
vocabBank.zh: 看来根本不用问第二遍。

vocabBank.en: I haven't either, and I love it.

vocabBank.en: She's about to speak — let's listen closely.
vocabBank.zh: 她要开始讲了——我们仔细听吧。

vocabBank.en: Despite the fear, we made it through.
vocabBank.zh: 尽管害怕，我们还是挺过来了。

vocabBank.en: However hard, we're never really alone.
vocabBank.zh: 无论多难，我们其实从不孤单。

vocabBank.en: We're going to be more than okay.
vocabBank.zh: 我们会不只是没事，会很好。

vocabBank.en: We're growing, and it feels incredible.
vocabBank.zh: 我们在成长，这感觉太棒了。

vocabBank.zh: 我也希望自己没等那么久。

vocabBank.zh: 尽管还没结束，但我们已经准备好一起面对了。

vocabBank.zh: 如果拿到了，我们会再请一位老师。

vocabBank.en: If it were bigger, we could help twice as many.
vocabBank.zh: 如果更大一点，我们能帮到两倍的人。
说实话，听到这个我很高兴。

vocabBank.zh: 这确实是个值得担心的问题。

vocabBank.en: If we took it carefully, I think it still would.
vocabBank.zh: 如果我们谨慎处理，我想它依然会是。

vocabBank.en: Although you're unsure, that's a fair place to start.
vocabBank.zh: 尽管你还不确定，但这是个不错的开始。

vocabBank.en: Let's lay it all out, no surprises.
vocabBank.zh: 我们把一切都列清楚，别留惊喜。

vocabBank.en: We'll manage that, it's not too much.
vocabBank.zh: 这个我们能应付，不算太多。

vocabBank.en: Three years guaranteed sounds worth it.

vocabBank.en: If we expanded, that would be incredible.
vocabBank.zh: 如果真扩张了，那会太棒了。

vocabBank.en: If we grew too fast, we'd have to be careful.
vocabBank.zh: 如果扩张太快，我们就得格外小心。

vocabBank.en: It's always been the right plan, too.
vocabBank.zh: 而且这一直都是正确的计划。

vocabBank.en: More than we can give alone, that's true.
vocabBank.zh: 确实比我们单独能给的要多。

vocabBank.en: Maybe growing up means carrying it further.
vocabBank.zh: 也许成长意味着把它带得更远。

vocabBank.en: Your opinion matters a lot here.
vocabBank.zh: 你的意见在这儿很重要。

vocabBank.en: If it helps just one more, that's enough reason.
vocabBank.zh: 如果能多帮一个人，理由就够了。

vocabBank.en: What I think is, let's take the risk together.
vocabBank.zh: 我的想法是，我们一起冒这个险吧。

vocabBank.en: We're all leaning toward yes, I think.
vocabBank.zh: 我觉得我们都倾向于同意。

vocabBank.en: If we accept it, we go in together.
vocabBank.zh: 如果接受，我们就一起进去。

vocabBank.en: Let's call her first thing tomorrow.
vocabBank.zh: 我们明天一早就打给她。

vocabBank.en: Thank you, we won't let it go to waste.
vocabBank.zh: 谢谢，我们不会辜负这份支持的。

vocabBank.en: If we need anything, we'll be sure to ask.
vocabBank.zh: 如果需要什么，我们一定会去问的。

vocabBank.en: A real partnership means more than money.
vocabBank.zh: 真正的合作意味着比金钱更多的东西。

vocabBank.en: If you'd told me, I wouldn't have believed it either.
vocabBank.zh: 就算你当时告诉我，我也不会相信的。

vocabBank.en: Although it's scary, it's beautiful too.

vocabBank.zh: 敬接下来的一切，我们一起面对。

vocabBank.en: A landlord who rents old shops sounds promising.
vocabBank.zh: 一个专租老店面的房东听起来挺有希望的。

vocabBank.en: A neighborhood that needs it is exactly where we belong.
vocabBank.zh: 一个需要它的街区，正是我们该去的地方。

vocabBank.en: Let's go take a look together.
Yes, we're the ones who called yesterday.
vocabBank.zh: 是的，我们就是昨天打电话的人。

vocabBank.en: The light really is beautiful, isn't it?
Of course, I can explain it all.
vocabBank.zh: 当然可以，我可以都跟您说说。

vocabBank.zh: 对，一个任何人都受欢迎的地方。

vocabBank.zh: 谢谢，我们会好好爱护这里的。

vocabBank.zh: 我们已经找到了一个完美的地方。

If you're willing, we trust you completely.
vocabBank.zh: 如果你愿意，我们完全信任你。

vocabBank.en: The guy who never spoke up is long gone now.
vocabBank.zh: 那个从不发言的人早就不在了。

vocabBank.zh: 你才是真正配得上这一切的人。

vocabBank.zh: 你不会的。我们已经相信你了。

vocabBank.zh: 这面墙是大家会第一眼看到的地方。

vocabBank.zh: 没问题，我们一起搬进去吧。

vocabBank.en: Yes, this is the place that was in the paper.
vocabBank.zh: 对，这就是报纸上写的那个地方。

vocabBank.en: Whoever told you, please thank them for us.
vocabBank.zh: 不管是谁告诉你的，请替我们谢谢她。

vocabBank.en: Although they're apart, the spirit is the same.
vocabBank.zh: 尽管相隔两地，但精神是一样的。

vocabBank.zh: 你们给我写了信？我都说不出话了。

vocabBank.en: All of us who watched you are so proud.

vocabBank.en: This one will always be close to me.
vocabBank.zh: 这一封会一直被我珍藏在身边。

vocabBank.en: We're so glad you'll be teaching us.

vocabBank.en: A building that's seen beginnings deserves one more.
vocabBank.zh: 一栋见证过开始的楼，值得再多迎来一个。

vocabBank.en: Let's begin — hello, how are you?
vocabBank.zh: 我们开始吧——你好，你好吗？

vocabBank.en: I'm glad you came across it.
vocabBank.zh: 很高兴你偶然读到了它。

vocabBank.en: We'd love for you to look into it.
vocabBank.zh: 我们很乐意让您调查一下。

vocabBank.en: If they agree, I'm comfortable with it.
vocabBank.zh: 如果他们同意，我没问题。

vocabBank.en: Let's bring it up gently, no pressure.
vocabBank.zh: 我们委婉地提一下吧，不给压力。

vocabBank.en: People who feel that way should be respected.
vocabBank.zh: 有这种感受的人应该被尊重。

vocabBank.en: We'd be honored to include your story.
vocabBank.zh: 能收录你的故事，我们感到很荣幸。

vocabBank.en: You've figured it out beautifully now.
vocabBank.zh: 你现在已经想得很清楚了。

vocabBank.en: If it helps one, it's already worth it.
vocabBank.zh: 如果能帮到一个人，就已经值得了。

vocabBank.en: We'll try to carry on as usual.
vocabBank.zh: 我们会尽量照常进行的。

vocabBank.en: The room where it all began, still standing.
vocabBank.zh: 一切开始的那间屋子，依然屹立在这儿。

vocabBank.en: Nervous, but going well — I'll take that.
vocabBank.zh: 紧张归紧张，但进展不错——我能接受。

vocabBank.en: Of course, I can tell you everything.
vocabBank.zh: 当然，我可以把一切都告诉你们。

vocabBank.en: It was taken at the very beginning, then.

vocabBank.zh: 如果当年我是您，我也会有一样的感受。

vocabBank.en: What was it like? Overwhelming, honestly.
vocabBank.zh: 什么感觉？说实话，是一种难以承受的震撼。

vocabBank.en: You've handled it with so much grace.
vocabBank.zh: 你处理得非常从容优雅。

vocabBank.en: I look forward to that too, truly.
I deal with it by staying calm myself.
vocabBank.zh: 我通过让自己保持冷静来应对。

vocabBank.en: I run into them all the time, actually.
Those moments are why any of this matters.
vocabBank.zh: 正是这些时刻让这一切都有了意义。

vocabBank.en: We're excited to see where it's headed.
vocabBank.zh: 我们很期待看看它的方向。

vocabBank.en: Although it's short, it says everything.
vocabBank.zh: 尽管很短，但说尽了一切。

vocabBank.en: The shot that made you cry made me cry too.
vocabBank.zh: 让你哭的那个镜头也让我哭了。

vocabBank.en: We've come further than I ever imagined.
vocabBank.zh: 我们走的路比我想象的要远得多。

vocabBank.en: Whoever sees it will feel less alone.

vocabBank.en: If they want it, let's send it in.

vocabBank.en: If it were shown wider, that would be the real win.
vocabBank.zh: 如果能被更多人看到，那才是真正的胜利。

vocabBank.en: Let's send it and see what unfolds.
vocabBank.zh: 投过去吧，看看接下来会怎样。

vocabBank.en: I've been thinking about that too, actually.
vocabBank.zh: 其实我也一直在想这件事。

vocabBank.en: Long or not, I'm ready to start.
vocabBank.zh: 不管多长，我都准备好开始了。

vocabBank.en: If that's true, I'll start this week.
vocabBank.zh: 如果真是这样，我这周就开始。

vocabBank.en: A checklist helps, at least I know where to start.

vocabBank.en: I'll gather all of that this week.
vocabBank.zh: 我这周就把这些都准备好。

vocabBank.en: I haven't taken one yet, but I will.

vocabBank.en: Thicker than expected, but it's all there.
vocabBank.zh: 确实比想的厚，但都齐了。

vocabBank.en: Yes, I do. It's under my name.
vocabBank.zh: 有的。是在我名下预约的。

vocabBank.en: Straightforward is exactly what I hoped for.

vocabBank.en: Got it, starting with my personal details.

我会把每个日期都仔细核对一遍。

vocabBank.zh: 没问题，我已经准备好了。

vocabBank.en: I can talk about both for hours.
vocabBank.zh: 这两个我能聊上好几个小时。

vocabBank.en: If they ask, I'll tell them the whole story.
vocabBank.zh: 如果他们问，我会把整个故事告诉他们。

vocabBank.en: Honest is the only way I know how.
vocabBank.zh: 诚实是我唯一会的方式。

vocabBank.en: Yes, I can tell you exactly why.

vocabBank.en: A place where I found everything that matters.
vocabBank.zh: 一个我找到了所有重要事物的地方。

vocabBank.en: A real ceremony? I wasn't expecting that.
vocabBank.zh: 还有正式的仪式？我倒是没想到。

vocabBank.en: Of course you can, I'd want nobody else.
vocabBank.zh: 当然可以，我谁都不想少。

vocabBank.en: More than home. It's everything I hoped for.
vocabBank.zh: 不只是家。这是我曾希望的一切。

vocabBank.en: I've been thinking about proposing to Emma.
vocabBank.zh: 我一直在想向Emma求婚这件事。

vocabBank.en: I've never been more sure of anything.
vocabBank.zh: 我从没这么确定过任何事。
正是，准备好迎接永远了。

vocabBank.en: How did you know? I'm asking for a reason.
vocabBank.zh: 您是怎么知道的？我这么问是有原因的。

vocabBank.en: Certainty over timing — that makes sense.
vocabBank.zh: 确定感比时机更重要——这说得通。

vocabBank.en: A way that feels like me — I know exactly what that is.
vocabBank.zh: 像我自己的风格——我很清楚那是什么。

vocabBank.en: Yes, I'm looking for the perfect one.
vocabBank.zh: 是的，我在找最完美的那一枚。

vocabBank.en: I do, actually — I checked secretly.
vocabBank.zh: 我知道，其实我偷偷查过了。

vocabBank.en: Made locally? That makes it even more perfect.
vocabBank.zh: 本地做的？那就更完美了。

vocabBank.en: I'm thinking of doing it at the bookstore.
The place where it started is the place to finish it.
vocabBank.zh: 开始的地方，也该是这一步发生的地方。

vocabBank.en: If I do it there, it'll mean everything to both of us.
vocabBank.zh: 如果在那儿求婚，对我们俩都会意义非凡。
其实一切都不只是好而已。

vocabBank.en: You'll understand in just a moment.
Something good is going on, I promise.
vocabBank.zh: 是件好事在发生，我保证。

vocabBank.en: You changed mine too, from the very first day.
vocabBank.zh: 你也改变了我的人生，从第一天起就是。

vocabBank.en: It is. Will you marry me?
You just made me the happiest person alive.
vocabBank.zh: 你刚刚让我成了这世上最幸福的人。

vocabBank.en: Look at it forever, it's yours now.
vocabBank.zh: 尽情看吧，它现在是你的了。

vocabBank.en: They're going to lose their minds, honestly.
vocabBank.zh: 说实话，他们一定会激动疯的。

vocabBank.en: The best night of both our lives.
vocabBank.zh: 是我们两个人这辈子最好的一晚。

vocabBank.en: The biggest one it's ever seen, I agree.
vocabBank.zh: 有史以来最大的一场，我同意。

vocabBank.en: Your happiness means the world to us.
vocabBank.zh: 您的祝福对我们意义重大。

vocabBank.en: We'll figure it all out together.
vocabBank.zh: 我们会一起把这些都搞定的。

vocabBank.en: If we kept it small, I'd love that even more.
vocabBank.zh: 如果办小一点，我会更喜欢。

vocabBank.en: People who matter is all we ever needed.
vocabBank.zh: 重要的人，就是我们一直需要的全部。

vocabBank.en: What a perfect date that would be.
The same us, but so much further along.
vocabBank.zh: 还是我们俩，但已经走了这么远。

vocabBank.en: A lifetime together, worth every year of waiting.
vocabBank.zh: 相守一生，这么多年的等待都值了。

vocabBank.en: The bouquets arrived just in time.
Sure, I'll have them set up in minutes.
vocabBank.zh: 没问题，我几分钟就能摆好。
两者都有，差不多各占一半。

vocabBank.en: Three generations? I'm honored to wear it.
vocabBank.zh: 三代人？我很荣幸能戴上它。
说实话，我才是幸运的那个。

vocabBank.en: I've never been more ready for anything.
vocabBank.zh: 我从没为任何事这么准备好过。

vocabBank.en: We're honored to be witnesses to it.
vocabBank.zh: 能作为见证人，我们感到很荣幸。

vocabBank.en: She asked us to sit, so let's sit.
vocabBank.zh: 她请我们坐下，那我们就坐吧。

vocabBank.en: I'm choosing you too, for the rest of my life.
vocabBank.zh: 我也在选择你，用我余生的每一天。

vocabBank.en: If a decade couldn't stop us, nothing can.
vocabBank.zh: 如果十年都拦不住我们，那什么都拦不住了。

vocabBank.en: We're officially married. I can hardly believe it.
vocabBank.zh: 我们正式结婚了。我简直不敢相信。

vocabBank.en: I've been waiting all day for this.
vocabBank.zh: 我等这一刻等了一整天了。

vocabBank.en: The whole street heard it, and I loved that.
vocabBank.zh: 整条街都听到了，我很喜欢这样。
我们现在好好庆祝一下吧。

vocabBank.en: We've all been waiting to hear them.
To the couple who taught us so much, cheers.
vocabBank.zh: 敬这对教会我们良多的新人，干杯。

vocabBank.en: To love that waited, and was worth it.
You may have every dance tonight.
vocabBank.zh: 今晚每一支舞都归你了。

vocabBank.en: So am I. We'll be terrible together.
vocabBank.zh: 我也是。我们就一起烂到底吧。

vocabBank.en: It's even better than I imagined.
Long is perfect. I'll read every word.
vocabBank.zh: 长才好呢。每个字我都会读。

vocabBank.en: A letter answered after ten long years.
vocabBank.zh: 一封等了十年才得到回音的信。

vocabBank.en: Thank you for being part of this day.
vocabBank.zh: 谢谢你们成为这一天的一部分。

vocabBank.en: They're waiting for us? That's so sweet.
vocabBank.zh: 他们在等我们？真是太贴心了。

vocabBank.en: More ready than I've ever been, Mrs. Wife.
vocabBank.zh: 从没这么准备好过，老婆太太。

vocabBank.en: It feels like the beginning of everything.
Forever looks like this, exactly like this.
vocabBank.zh: 永远就是这样子，正是这样。

vocabBank.en: The best trade either of us ever made.
vocabBank.zh: 这是我们俩这辈子做过最好的交易。

vocabBank.en: Where do you feel like going?
If we booked today, let's do it right now.
vocabBank.zh: 如果今天订划算，那我们现在就订吧。

vocabBank.en: No layovers sounds perfect to me.
vocabBank.zh: 不用转机对我来说太完美了。

vocabBank.en: It might, so let's weigh it now.
vocabBank.zh: 有可能，那我们现在就称一下吧。
它们已经在我的随身行李里了。

vocabBank.en: A window seat, if that's available.
Thirty minutes, got it. We'll be there early.
vocabBank.zh: 三十分钟，明白了。我们会早点到的。

vocabBank.en: No, I don't have anything like that.
Thank you so much, you too.
Pasta sounds good to me, thanks.
We're really doing this, aren't we?
vocabBank.zh: 我们真的在做这件事了，对吧？

vocabBank.en: What do you feel like watching?
We'll be staying for about ten days.
vocabBank.zh: 我们大概会待十天左右。

vocabBank.en: Thank you, we're so excited to be here.
vocabBank.zh: 谢谢，能来这儿我们太激动了。

vocabBank.en: Yes, it's under my wife's name.
vocabBank.zh: 有的，是在我妻子名下订的。

vocabBank.en: You've upgraded it? That's so kind of you.
vocabBank.zh: 您升级了？您真是太好了。

vocabBank.en: Good to know, thank you for explaining.
How much is the exchange rate today?
That's fine, small fees don't bother me.
vocabBank.zh: 没关系，小额手续费我不介意。

vocabBank.en: I asked for that, and you delivered perfectly.
vocabBank.zh: 我确实是这么要求的，您办得太好了。

vocabBank.en: Older than that? I can hardly imagine it.
vocabBank.zh: 比那还老？我简直难以想象。
我们就一起彻底迷路吧。

vocabBank.en: I wish it never had to end either.
vocabBank.zh: 我也希望它永远不用结束。

vocabBank.en: Ready, and grateful for this whole trip.
vocabBank.zh: 准备好了，而且对这趟旅行满怀感激。

vocabBank.en: We've made memories that'll last forever.
vocabBank.zh: 我们攒下的回忆会永远留在心里。

vocabBank.en: Home is whoever's beside you, exactly.
vocabBank.zh: 家就是在你身边的那个人，正是如此。

vocabBank.en: He raised it again? That's the third time.
vocabBank.zh: 又涨了？这已经是第三次了。

vocabBank.en: If we saved carefully, I think we could.
vocabBank.zh: 如果省着点存，我觉得可以。

vocabBank.en: Somewhere quiet, close to the bookstore.
vocabBank.zh: 安静一点的地方，离书店近。

vocabBank.en: We've set a firm budget already.
vocabBank.zh: 我们已经定好了明确的预算。

vocabBank.en: You've already found some? Let's see them.
vocabBank.zh: 已经找到了？我们看看吧。
说实话，有个后院挺不错的。
最近才翻修的？那更好了。

vocabBank.en: What we think is, we love it already.
vocabBank.zh: 我们的想法是，我们已经很喜欢了。

vocabBank.en: Minor issues we can live with, then.
vocabBank.zh: 那小问题我们可以接受。

vocabBank.en: Older, so let's budget for a new one.
vocabBank.zh: 比较老，那我们就把换新的算进预算吧。

vocabBank.en: Nothing should stop us — let's move forward.
vocabBank.zh: 没什么能阻止我们——我们继续推进吧。

vocabBank.en: That'll work in our favor, I believe.
vocabBank.zh: 我相信这会对我们有利。

vocabBank.en: We can put down twenty percent.
vocabBank.zh: 我们能付百分之二十的首付。

vocabBank.en: We've been approved? That's incredible news.
vocabBank.zh: 批准了？这真是太棒的消息了。

vocabBank.en: If that helps, we'll offer a bit more.
vocabBank.zh: 如果这样有用，我们就多加一点。

vocabBank.en: A buyer who wants it too? Let's move fast.
vocabBank.zh: 也有买家想要？那我们得快点行动了。

vocabBank.en: It was accepted? We actually did it!
vocabBank.zh: 被接受了？我们真的做到了！

vocabBank.en: Of course, we'll take our time reading.
After this? My hand is shaking already.
vocabBank.zh: 这个签完就行？我的手已经在抖了。
我们终于一起成了房主。

vocabBank.en: I've been waiting to ask you that myself.
It's about to become everything to us.
vocabBank.zh: 它马上就要成为我们的一切了。
是真的，而且完全是我们的了。

vocabBank.en: Do we really want to lift furniture ourselves?
vocabBank.zh: 我们真的想自己搬家具吗？

vocabBank.en: If we hired movers, that'd be worth the cost.
vocabBank.zh: 如果请搬家公司，这钱花得值。

vocabBank.en: Let's book them right now, before they fill up.
vocabBank.zh: 我们现在就订，免得约满了。

vocabBank.en: The kitchen's done? That's the important part.
vocabBank.zh: 厨房弄好了？那是最重要的部分。

vocabBank.en: Where else but right by the front door?
vocabBank.zh: 还能挂哪儿，就挂在门口旁边吧。

vocabBank.en: It already feels like home to me too.
vocabBank.zh: 对我来说也已经有家的感觉了。

vocabBank.en: You've seemed a bit different, now that you mention it.
vocabBank.zh: 你这么一说，我确实感觉你最近不太一样。

vocabBank.en: Let's go get one right now.
vocabBank.zh: 我们现在就去买一个吧。

vocabBank.en: It said three minutes, so let's time it.
vocabBank.zh: 上面说三分钟，那我们计时吧。

vocabBank.en: Of course I can. Here goes.
It says two lines. We're having a baby.
vocabBank.zh: 两条线。我们要有孩子了。

vocabBank.en: Same here, in equal, overwhelming amounts.
vocabBank.zh: 我也是，两种感觉都汹涌得压倒一切。

vocabBank.en: If it goes smoothly, spring can't come soon enough.
vocabBank.zh: 如果顺利的话，真希望春天快点到。

vocabBank.en: Soon, but let's enjoy just knowing for now.
vocabBank.zh: 快了，但先让我们俩单独享受这个消息吧。

vocabBank.en: April? That's sooner than I imagined.
That tiny sound just changed my whole life.
vocabBank.zh: 这个小小的声音，彻底改变了我的人生。

vocabBank.en: If you could, that would mean so much.
vocabBank.zh: 如果你能，那真是太好了。

vocabBank.en: Although it's rough, we're taking it day by day.
vocabBank.zh: 尽管很难熬，我们就一天一天地扛过去。

vocabBank.en: We do. A very big something.
vocabBank.zh: 确实有。一件很重要的事。

vocabBank.en: A baby! This calls for a celebration.
A new generation, right here with us.
vocabBank.zh: 新的一代人，就在我们身边。

vocabBank.en: If we did, it would carry so much meaning.
vocabBank.zh: 如果这样做，会承载太多意义了。

vocabBank.en: A name that's already part of us — perfect.
vocabBank.zh: 一个已经属于我们的名字——太完美了。

vocabBank.en: Whatever we have, that name will fit somehow.
vocabBank.zh: 不管生的是什么，这个名字总会有办法用上。

vocabBank.en: Sure, I've watched a few videos on it.
vocabBank.zh: 没问题，我看过几个教程视频了。

vocabBank.en: What about a soft, neutral yellow?
vocabBank.zh: 用一种柔和的中性黄色怎么样？

vocabBank.en: It'll hold everything that matters, soon enough.
vocabBank.zh: 很快，它就会装下所有重要的一切。

vocabBank.en: You've all chipped in? I'm overwhelmed.
vocabBank.zh: 大家都凑了钱？我太感动了。

vocabBank.en: This baby is loved before even arriving.
vocabBank.zh: 这个宝宝还没出生就已经被这么多人爱着了。

vocabBank.en: She'll grow up with so many people loving her.
vocabBank.zh: 她会在这么多人的爱中长大。

vocabBank.en: I'm coming, don't let her stop.
We'll be three, and I can't wait.
vocabBank.zh: 我们会变成三个人，我等不及了。

vocabBank.en: It moves fast, and I love every second of it.
vocabBank.zh: 确实很快，而我热爱其中的每一秒。

vocabBank.en: Neither of us has, but maybe it's time.
vocabBank.zh: 确实都没有，但也许是时候了。

vocabBank.en: We'll definitely need one before too long.
vocabBank.zh: 我们肯定很快就会需要一辆车。

vocabBank.en: Let's sign up together, right now.
vocabBank.zh: 我们现在就一起报名吧。

vocabBank.en: A natural? I'm relieved to hear that.
vocabBank.zh: 有天赋？听到这话我松了口气。

vocabBank.en: I'll aim for a hundred, just to be safe.
vocabBank.zh: 我争取拿满分，稳妥一点。

vocabBank.en: I've studied it more than any other chapter.
vocabBank.zh: 这一章我看得比其他都仔细。

vocabBank.en: I passed? I can finally breathe again.
vocabBank.zh: 通过了？我终于能松口气了。

vocabBank.en: I did? This might be the best day ever.
vocabBank.zh: 真的吗？这可能是最好的一天了。
二手的，如果还可靠的话。

vocabBank.en: Safety ratings matter most to us right now.
vocabBank.zh: 现在安全评级对我们来说最重要。

vocabBank.en: Yes, let's take it around the block.
vocabBank.zh: 好的，我们绕街区开一圈吧。

vocabBank.en: It feels smoother than I expected.
Plenty of space — that settles it for me.
vocabBank.zh: 空间足够——这一点让我定下心来了。

vocabBank.en: I think this is exactly the one.
We'd like to finance it monthly.
If that's true, let's put down more.
vocabBank.zh: 如果是这样，那我们多付一些首付吧。

vocabBank.en: Full coverage, better safe than sorry.
vocabBank.zh: 全险吧，安全总比后悔好。

vocabBank.en: Since it's low, that's a relief to hear.
vocabBank.zh: 既然费率低，那真是让人松了口气。

vocabBank.en: Fully insured, and finally free to drive.
vocabBank.zh: 全额投保了，终于能开车走了。

vocabBank.en: We're really driving, and it feels amazing.
vocabBank.zh: 我们真的在开车，感觉太棒了。

vocabBank.en: Let's take the longest way possible.
vocabBank.zh: 我们就走最远的那条路吧。

vocabBank.en: This car will carry our whole family soon.
vocabBank.zh: 很快，这辆车就会载着我们一家人。

vocabBank.en: Let me figure it out with you.
There it is, it's clicked into place.
Ready for all three of us, at last.
vocabBank.zh: 终于为我们三个人准备好了。
怎么都看不够/难以置信
让每个人都感到宾至如归
让我们发挥出最好水平
远远落后于（此处指线后）
更有嚼劲的（chewy 比较级）

scenes.title: Toronto Pearson Airport
scenes.subtitle: 多伦多皮尔逊机场 · 入境检查

npcLine.en: Hello! Passport, please.
npcLine.zh: 你好！请出示护照。

choices.text: Here you are.
choices.zh: 给你

choices.text: Nice to meet you.

n1.hintOnWrong: 递东西给别人时说「给你」→ Here you are.

npcLine.en: What's the purpose of your visit?
npcLine.zh: 你此行的目的是？

choices.text: I'm here to meet someone.
choices.zh: 我是来见一个人的

choices.text: Goodbye.

n2.hintOnWrong: 说明来意 → I'm here to meet someone.

npcLine.en: Interesting! Welcome to Toronto.
npcLine.zh: 有意思！欢迎来到多伦多。

choices.text: Thank you!
choices.zh: 谢谢

choices.text: Sorry.

n3.hintOnWrong: 表达感谢 → Thank you!

npcLine.en: Hop in! Where to?
npcLine.zh: 上车吧！去哪儿？

choices.text: This address, please.
choices.zh: 这个地址，麻烦了

choices.text: I am fine, thanks.

n1.hintOnWrong: 出示地址说明目的地 → This address, please.

npcLine.en: Huh, that's an old street. Haven't heard that name in years.
npcLine.zh: 咦，这条老街，好多年没人提起了。

choices.text: Really? Do you know it well?
choices.zh: 真的吗？你熟悉那里吗

choices.text: I don't know.

n2.hintOnWrong: 追问 → Really? Do you know it well?

npcLine.en: We're here!
npcLine.zh: 到了！

choices.text: Perfect, this is it.
choices.zh: 太好了，就是这里

choices.text: Where are we?

n3.hintOnWrong: 确认到达 → Perfect, this is it.

scenes.title: Maple Street Hostel
scenes.subtitle: 枫叶街旅馆 · 竟是明信片上的地址

npcLine.en: Welcome! Do you have a reservation?
npcLine.zh: 欢迎！请问有预订吗？

choices.text: Yes, under Zhang.
choices.zh: 有，姓张

choices.text: No, thank you.

n1.hintOnWrong: 确认预订 → Yes, under [name].

npcLine.en: Actually — someone left this here for you, years ago.
npcLine.zh: 对了——很多年前，有人在这儿给你留了这个。

choices.text: For me? Can I see it?
choices.zh: 给我的？我能看看吗

choices.text: I have no money.

npcLine.en: Here you go. It's a note from a woman named Emma.
npcLine.zh: 给你，一位叫 Emma 的女士留的字条。

choices.text: Thank you so much!
choices.zh: 太谢谢了

choices.text: Goodbye.

n3.hintOnWrong: 表达感谢 → Thank you so much!

scenes.title: Kensington Market Café
scenes.subtitle: 肯辛顿市场咖啡馆 · 打听线索

npcLine.en: Morning! What can I get for you?
npcLine.zh: 早上好！想点些什么？

choices.text: A coffee and a croissant, please.
choices.zh: 请给我一杯咖啡和一个牛角包

choices.text: I'm not hungry.

n1.hintOnWrong: 点单说「请给我...」→ ..., please.

npcLine.en: Wait — is that Emma's note? I know her!
npcLine.zh: 等等——那是 Emma 的字条？我认识她！

choices.text: You know her? Where is she?
choices.zh: 你认识她？她在哪儿

choices.text: I don't know.

n2.hintOnWrong: 追问下落 → You know her? Where is she?

npcLine.en: She said... watch the sunset from the CN Tower.
npcLine.zh: 她说过……去 CN 塔看日落。

choices.text: Thank you, I'm on my way!
choices.zh: 谢谢，我这就出发！

choices.text: Is it free?

n3.hintOnWrong: 道谢并表明行动（陈述句）→ Thank you, I'm on my way!

scenes.title: Racing to the CN Tower
scenes.subtitle: 街头问路 · 赶往 CN 塔

npcLine.en: Yes? Can I help you?
npcLine.zh: 什么事？需要帮忙吗？

choices.text: Excuse me, where is the CN Tower?
choices.zh: 打扰一下，请问CN塔怎么走

choices.text: I like pizza.

n1.hintOnWrong: 开口问路 → Excuse me, where is the CN Tower?

npcLine.en: Go straight, then turn left.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示当下的决定 → I'll grab that one.

npcLine.en: Here you go! Anything else?
npcLine.zh: 给你！还需要别的吗？

choices.text: No, that's all. Thank you!
choices.zh: 不用了，就这些。谢谢！

choices.text: Give me everything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌收尾 → No, that's all. Thank you!

transition.en: Saturday evening, you arrive at Mrs. Ho's door.
transition.zh: 周六傍晚，你到了Ho太太家门口。

scenes.title: Arriving for Dinner
scenes.subtitle: Ho太太家 · 感恩节晚餐

npcLine.en: You made it! Are you hungry?
npcLine.zh: 你来啦！饿了吗？

choices.text: Yes, very! Thanks for having me.
choices.zh: 嗯，很饿！谢谢你邀请我。

choices.text: No, not really.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简短肯定回答＋礼貌语 → Yes, very! Thanks for having me.

npcLine.en: This is my son, David. He's visiting for the holiday.
npcLine.zh: 这是我儿子David。他回来过节。

choices.text: Nice to meet you, David.
choices.zh: 很高兴认识你，David。

choices.text: I don't know you.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌问候（陈述句）→ Nice to meet you, David.

npcLine.en: Come in, come in. Dinner's almost ready.
npcLine.zh: 快进来快进来。饭马上就好了。

choices.text: Smells amazing, thank you.
choices.zh: 闻起来太香了，谢谢。

choices.text: I'm not hungry.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌称赞 → Smells amazing, thank you.

scenes.title: At the Table
scenes.subtitle: 餐桌上 · 感恩节话题

npcLine.en: So, do you like Toronto so far?
npcLine.zh: 所以，你喜欢多伦多吗，目前为止？

choices.text: I love it. Everyone is so kind.
choices.zh: 很喜欢。这里的人都很友善。

choices.text: Not really, sorry.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回答并说明理由 → I love it. Everyone is so kind.

npcLine.en: In Canada, we celebrate Thanksgiving in October, not November.
npcLine.zh: 在加拿大，我们感恩节是十月过，不是十一月。

choices.text: Oh, interesting! I love learning new things.
choices.zh: 哦，有意思！我喜欢学新东西。

choices.text: I don't care.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Oh, interesting! I love learning new things.

npcLine.en: It's closer to harvest time here. Anyway — eat, eat!
npcLine.zh: 因为这里收获季更早一些。好啦——吃吧吃吧！

choices.text: Let's eat before it gets cold.
choices.zh: 我们趁热吃吧。

choices.text: I'll eat later.

n3.hintOnWrong: 提议一起行动 → Let's eat before it gets cold.

transition.en: After dinner, David steps out to take a call.
transition.zh: 晚饭后，David出去接了个电话。

scenes.title: A Story, Almost Told
scenes.subtitle: 客厅 · 欲言又止的往事

npcLine.en: Now... about that photo. That house belongs to someone I once knew.
npcLine.zh: 现在……说说那张照片吧。那栋房子是我曾经认识的一个人的。

choices.text: Who is that?
choices.zh: 那是谁呢？

choices.text: I don't want to know.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问是谁 → Who is that?

npcLine.en: That's... a long story. Maybe too long for tonight.
npcLine.zh: 这个……说来话长。今晚可能讲不完。

choices.text: That's okay. Can we talk again soon?
choices.zh: 没关系。我们能改天再聊吗？

choices.text: Forget it, then.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 提议下次再聊 → Can we talk again soon?

npcLine.en: Of course, dear. Come by anytime.
npcLine.zh: 当然可以，亲爱的。随时过来找我。

choices.text: I will. Thank you, Mrs. Ho.
choices.zh: 我会的。谢谢你，Ho太太。

choices.text: Maybe not.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 承诺以后会做 → I will. Thank you, Mrs. Ho.

transition.en: Walking home, your mind is racing.
transition.zh: 走回家的路上，你思绪万千。

npcLine.en: You're back! How was dinner?
npcLine.zh: 你回来啦！晚饭怎么样？

choices.text: It's wonderful, and a little mysterious.
choices.zh: 很棒，而且有点神秘。

choices.text: It's boring.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单评价（陈述句）→ It's wonderful, and a little mysterious.

npcLine.en: Mysterious? What do you mean?
npcLine.zh: 神秘？什么意思？

choices.text: She knows the house in the photo.
choices.zh: 她认识照片里那栋房子。

choices.text: I don't want to talk.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述新发现（陈述句）→ She knows the house in the photo.

npcLine.en: Wow. What's the plan now?
npcLine.zh: 哇。那现在打算怎么办？

choices.text: I'll visit her again soon.
choices.zh: 我会尽快再去找她。

choices.text: Nothing, I guess.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll visit her again soon.

transition.en: A few days later, walking past Ten Letters Bookstore...
transition.zh: 几天后，你路过「十封信」书店……

scenes.title: Help Wanted
scenes.subtitle: 书店门口 · 看到招聘启事

npcLine.en: Oh! Are you looking at my hiring sign?
npcLine.zh: 哦！你在看我的招聘启事吗？

choices.text: Yes, are you hiring?
choices.zh: 是啊，你们在招人吗？

choices.text: No, just walking.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 Yes/No 问句确认 → Yes, are you hiring?

npcLine.en: I am! Do you have any work experience?
npcLine.zh: 在招！你有工作经验吗？

choices.text: Yes, I do. Can I tell you about it?
choices.zh: 有的。我可以跟你说说吗？

choices.text: No, never worked.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答＋用 can 请求 → Can I tell you about it?

npcLine.en: Of course! Come in, let's talk.
npcLine.zh: 当然可以！进来，我们聊聊。

choices.text: Sounds great, let's go in.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们进去吧。

choices.text: No, thanks.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Sounds great, let's go in.

scenes.title: The Interview
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 聊聊过去的工作经历

npcLine.en: So, tell me — what did you do before?
npcLine.zh: 那，说说看——你以前是做什么的？

choices.text: I worked at a small café.
choices.zh: 我以前在一家小咖啡馆工作过。

choices.text: I don't remember.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用一般过去时讲过去做过的事 → I worked at a small café.

npcLine.en: Nice! What did you do there?
npcLine.zh: 不错！你在那儿做什么？

choices.text: I made coffee and helped customers.
choices.zh: 我做咖啡，还帮顾客服务。

choices.text: I did nothing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 继续用过去时描述工作内容 → I made coffee and helped customers.

npcLine.en: That sounds perfect for a bookstore too.
npcLine.zh: 这经验在书店也很合适。

choices.text: I hope so! I love books.
choices.zh: 希望如此！我很喜欢书。

choices.text: Maybe not.

n3.hintOnWrong: 表达希望（陈述句）→ I hope so! I love books.

scenes.title: A Few More Questions
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 为什么想来这儿

npcLine.en: Why did you leave that job?
npcLine.zh: 你为什么离开那份工作？

choices.text: I moved to Toronto, so I left.
choices.zh: 我搬到多伦多了，所以就离职了。

choices.text: I don't know.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时+连接词 so 说明原因 → I moved to Toronto, so I left.

npcLine.en: That makes sense. Why do you want to work here?
npcLine.zh: 有道理。你为什么想来这儿工作？

choices.text: Because I really love this bookstore.
choices.zh: 因为我真的很喜欢这家书店。

choices.text: I need money.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 because 说明原因（固定搭配）→ Because I really love this bookstore.

npcLine.en: That's a great reason. Can you start this week?
npcLine.zh: 这个理由真好。你这周能开始吗？

choices.text: Yes, I can start anytime.
choices.zh: 可以，我随时都能开始。

choices.text: Not for a month.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回答可行性 → Yes, I can start anytime.

npcLine.en: Great! Welcome to the team.
npcLine.zh: 太好了！欢迎加入。

choices.text: Thank you! I'm so excited.
choices.zh: 谢谢！我太激动了。

choices.text: Whatever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 表达兴奋（陈述句）→ Thank you! I'm so excited.

npcLine.en: We'll figure out the schedule together.
npcLine.zh: 我们一起来定排班吧。

choices.text: Sounds good, let's plan it now.
choices.zh: 好呀，我们现在就定吧。

choices.text: Later, maybe.

n2.hintOnWrong: 提议一起行动 → Sounds good, let's plan it now.

npcLine.en: Perfect. See you soon, coworker.
npcLine.zh: 太好了。回见啦，同事。

choices.text: See you soon! Thanks again.
choices.zh: 回见！再次谢谢你。

choices.text: Bye forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌道别 → See you soon! Thanks again.

scenes.title: Setting the Schedule
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 约定上班时间

npcLine.en: Can you work weekends?
npcLine.zh: 你周末能上班吗？

choices.text: Yes, I can work Saturdays.
choices.zh: 可以，我周六能上班。

choices.text: No, never.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回答 → Yes, I can work Saturdays.

npcLine.en: Great, and what about weekday mornings?
npcLine.zh: 很好，那平日早上呢？

choices.text: Mornings work well for me.
choices.zh: 早上对我来说没问题。

choices.text: I hate mornings.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单陈述可行性 → Mornings work well for me.

npcLine.en: Perfect. I'll write it down.
npcLine.zh: 太好了。我这就写下来。

choices.text: I'll be here bright and early.
choices.zh: 我会早早地过来的。

choices.text: Maybe I'll come.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示承诺 → I'll be here bright and early.

transition.en: Monday morning, your first shift begins.
transition.zh: 周一早上，你的第一次上班开始了。

scenes.title: First Shift
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 第一天上班

npcLine.en: Ready? Let's start with the shelves.
npcLine.zh: 准备好了吗？我们从书架开始吧。

choices.text: Ready! Let's do this.
choices.zh: 准备好了！开始吧。

choices.text: Not really.

n1.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Ready! Let's do this.

npcLine.en: Can you sort these by author's last name?
npcLine.zh: 你能按作者姓氏给这些排序吗？

choices.text: Sure, I can do that easily.
choices.zh: 没问题，这个我很容易就能做到。

choices.text: That's too hard.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表示能力 → Sure, I can do that easily.

npcLine.en: You're a natural at this!
npcLine.zh: 你干这个很有天赋！

choices.text: Thanks, that's because I love organizing.
choices.zh: 谢谢，那是因为我喜欢整理东西。

choices.text: It's boring.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 because 说明原因（固定搭配）→ Thanks, that's because I love organizing.

scenes.title: An Old Ledger
scenes.subtitle: 储藏室 · Emma提到旧账本

npcLine.en: This storage room came with old boxes from the last owner.
npcLine.zh: 这间储藏室带着上一任房东留下的旧箱子。

choices.text: Really? What's inside them?
choices.zh: 真的吗？里面有什么？

choices.text: I don't want to look.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问细节 → What's inside them?

npcLine.en: Old ledgers, mostly. Want to take a look?
npcLine.zh: 大多是旧账本。想看看吗？

choices.text: Sure, can I open this one?
choices.zh: 好呀，我能打开这本看看吗？

choices.text: No, boring.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 请求许可 → Can I open this one?

npcLine.en: Go ahead. It's from years ago.
npcLine.zh: 打开吧。这是好多年前的了。

choices.text: Okay, I'll take a quick look.
choices.zh: 好的，我快速看一看。

choices.text: I'll skip it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示马上要做 → I'll take a quick look.

scenes.title: A Familiar Name
scenes.subtitle: 旧账本 · 发现一个熟悉的姓氏

npcLine.en: Find anything interesting?
npcLine.zh: 找到什么有意思的东西了吗？

choices.text: Wait, this name looks familiar.
choices.zh: 等等，这个名字看着眼熟。

choices.text: Nothing much.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述发现（陈述句）→ Wait, this name looks familiar.

npcLine.en: Which name? Let me see.
npcLine.zh: 哪个名字？我看看。

choices.text: It says 'Ho' right here.
choices.zh: 这里写着'Ho'。

choices.text: I can't read it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 指出具体内容（陈述句）→ It says 'Ho' right here.

npcLine.en: Ho... like your neighbor?
npcLine.zh: Ho……跟你邻居同姓？

choices.text: Maybe! Why is her name in here?
choices.zh: 有可能！她的名字为什么会在这里？

choices.text: Just a coincidence.

n3.hintOnWrong: 追问原因 → Why is her name in here?

scenes.title: A Growing Mystery
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 谜团越来越大

npcLine.en: I don't know. This ledger is from before I bought the shop.
npcLine.zh: 我不知道。这本账本是我买下这家店之前的。

choices.text: So someone else owned it first.
choices.zh: 所以是别人先拥有的。

choices.text: That's not possible.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时描述推断 → So someone else owned it first.

npcLine.en: Exactly. Maybe Mrs. Ho remembers something.
npcLine.zh: 没错。也许Ho太太记得点什么。

choices.text: I'll ask her tomorrow.
choices.zh: 我明天去问问她。

choices.text: Forget about it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll ask her tomorrow.

npcLine.en: Good idea. Keep me posted!
npcLine.zh: 好主意。有消息跟我说一声！

choices.text: I will, I promise.
choices.zh: 我会的，我保证。

choices.text: Maybe, maybe not.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 承诺 → I will, I promise.

transition.en: At the end of your shift, you head home.
transition.zh: 下班后，你走回家。

scenes.title: Telling Sam
scenes.subtitle: 公寓 · 告诉Sam这个发现

npcLine.en: You got a job? That's great!
npcLine.zh: 你找到工作啦？太好了！

choices.text: I did! I worked my first shift today.
choices.zh: 找到啦！我今天上了第一个班。

choices.text: Not really.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时说明今天做了什么 → I worked my first shift today.

npcLine.en: Cool! Anything exciting happen?
npcLine.zh: 酷！有什么有意思的事发生吗？

choices.text: Yes, I found an old name in a ledger.
choices.zh: 有，我在一本旧账本里发现了一个名字。

choices.text: No, nothing at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用过去时讲述今天发生的事 → I found an old name in a ledger.

npcLine.en: Whose name?
npcLine.zh: 谁的名字？

choices.text: Mrs. Ho's. I'll ask her about it tomorrow.
choices.zh: Ho太太的。我明天去问问她。

choices.text: I'd rather not say.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句+will承诺后续行动 → Mrs. Ho's. I'll ask her about it tomorrow.

transition.en: The next day, you knock on Mrs. Ho's door.
transition.zh: 第二天，你敲响了Ho太太家的门。

scenes.title: A Promise Kept
scenes.subtitle: Ho太太家门口 · 问起那个名字

npcLine.en: Oh, hello! Did you come about the photo?
npcLine.zh: 哦，你好！你是为了照片来的吗？

choices.text: Yes. I found the name 'Ho' in an old ledger.
choices.zh: 是的。我在一本旧账本里发现了'Ho'这个名字。

choices.text: No, just visiting.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时讲述你发现的事 → I found the name 'Ho' in an old ledger.

npcLine.en: My name? Where did you see that?
npcLine.zh: 我的名字？你在哪儿看到的？

choices.text: At the bookstore where I work now.
choices.zh: 在我现在工作的书店里。

choices.text: I don't remember where.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单说明地点（陈述句）→ At the bookstore where I work now.

npcLine.en: Let's look into it together, at the library. I need time to think first.
npcLine.zh: 我们一起去图书馆查查吧。我需要先想一想。

choices.text: Okay, I'll wait until you're ready.
choices.zh: 好的，我会等你准备好。

choices.text: I can't wait.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示愿意等待 → I'll wait until you're ready.

transition.en: A few days later, you wake up with a sore throat.
transition.zh: 几天后，你一觉醒来喉咙很痛。

npcLine.en: You look tired. Are you okay?
npcLine.zh: 你看起来很累。你还好吗？

choices.text: Not really, my throat hurts.
choices.zh: 不太好，我喉咙疼。

choices.text: I'm perfect.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述身体状况（陈述句）→ Not really, my throat hurts.

npcLine.en: You should see a doctor.
npcLine.zh: 你应该去看医生。

choices.text: You're right, I'll go today.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我今天就去。

choices.text: I'm fine, really.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll go today.

npcLine.en: There's a clinic near the subway station.
npcLine.zh: 地铁站附近有一家诊所。

choices.text: Thanks, I'll head there now.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我现在就过去。

choices.text: I don't need it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌感谢并说明行动 → Thanks, I'll head there now.

npcLine.en: Hi, do you have an appointment?
npcLine.zh: 你好，你预约了吗？

choices.text: No, I don't. Can I be seen today?
choices.zh: 没有。今天能看诊吗？

choices.text: Yes, obviously.

n1.hintOnWrong: 否定回答＋用 can 请求 → Can I be seen today?

npcLine.en: Sure. What's the problem today?
npcLine.zh: 可以。今天哪里不舒服？

choices.text: My throat really hurts.
choices.zh: 我喉咙很痛。

choices.text: Nothing, really.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述症状（陈述句）→ My throat really hurts.

npcLine.en: Okay, please take a seat and wait.
npcLine.zh: 好的，请坐着等一下。

choices.text: Thank you, I'll wait right here.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我就在这儿等。

choices.text: How long will it take?

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应＋will → Thank you, I'll wait right here.

npcLine.en: So, when did the pain start?
npcLine.zh: 那，疼痛是什么时候开始的？

choices.text: It started two days ago.
choices.zh: 两天前开始的。

choices.text: I don't know when.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回答何时发生 → It started two days ago.

npcLine.en: I see. How are you feeling otherwise?
npcLine.zh: 明白了。其他方面感觉怎么样？

choices.text: A bit tired, but okay.
choices.zh: 有点累，但还好。

choices.text: Terrible, obviously.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单描述感受（陈述句）→ A bit tired, but okay.

npcLine.en: Let's take a quick look at your throat.
npcLine.zh: 我们快速看一下你的喉咙。

choices.text: Okay, let's do that.
choices.zh: 好的，来吧。

choices.text: No, I'm scared.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Okay, let's do that.

npcLine.en: It's just a small infection. Nothing serious.
npcLine.zh: 只是个小感染，不严重。

choices.text: That's a relief to hear.
choices.zh: 听到这个我就放心了。

choices.text: That's terrible news.

n1.hintOnWrong: 表达如释重负（陈述句）→ That's a relief to hear.

npcLine.en: Can you take this medicine twice a day?
npcLine.zh: 你能一天吃两次这个药吗？

choices.text: Yes, I can do that easily.
choices.zh: 可以，这个我很容易做到。

choices.text: I hate medicine.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 确认能做到 → Yes, I can do that easily.

npcLine.en: Good. Feel better soon!
npcLine.zh: 好的。祝你早日康复！

choices.text: Thank you so much, doctor.
choices.zh: 太谢谢你了，医生。

choices.text: Whatever, bye.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌道谢 → Thank you so much, doctor.

transition.en: The weeks pass, and December brings the first snow.
transition.zh: 几周过去，十二月带来了第一场雪。

scenes.title: Getting Ready for Christmas
scenes.subtitle: 公寓 · 商量圣诞节怎么过

npcLine.en: Christmas is next week. Do you have plans?
npcLine.zh: 下周就是圣诞节了。你有安排吗？

choices.text: Not yet. Do you have any ideas?
choices.zh: 还没有。你有什么想法吗？

choices.text: I don't celebrate.

choices.text: That's such a hard choice to make.
choices.zh: 这真是个艰难的抉择。

choices.text: That's not fair at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单共情（陈述句）→ That's such a hard choice to make.

npcLine.en: It was. But we promised each other something before we left.
npcLine.zh: 确实是。但我们离开之前，彼此许下了一个承诺。

choices.text: What did you promise?
choices.zh: 你们承诺了什么？

choices.text: I don't need details.

n2.hintOnWrong: 追问细节 → What did you promise?

npcLine.zh: 我们承诺有一天要一起回去，一家人一起。

choices.text: That's a promise worth keeping.
choices.zh: 这是个值得坚守的承诺。

choices.text: Promises don't always work out.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That's a promise worth keeping.

scenes.title: An Old Name
scenes.subtitle: 客厅 · 一个新的线索

npcLine.en: One neighbor helped us more than anyone. A young woman who ran a small shop nearby.
npcLine.zh: 有一位邻居帮了我们特别多。是一个在附近开小店的年轻女人。

choices.text: Do you remember her name?
choices.zh: 您还记得她的名字吗？

choices.text: That's not important now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问细节（do-question式）→ Do you remember her name?

npcLine.en: It's been so long... but I think her shop sold books.
npcLine.zh: 太久了……但我记得她的店是卖书的。

choices.text: Emma's shop sells books too.
choices.zh: Emma的店也是卖书的。

choices.text: That's probably not related.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述关联（陈述句）→ Emma's shop sells books too.

npcLine.en: Wait — could it be the same shop? Ten Letters?
npcLine.zh: 等等——会不会就是同一家店？十封信？

choices.text: I'll ask Emma about it tomorrow.
choices.zh: 我明天去问问Emma。

choices.text: It's probably just a coincidence.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll ask Emma about it tomorrow.

scenes.title: Why It Matters
scenes.subtitle: 客厅 · Uncle Lok的心里话

npcLine.en: This all matters because my sister carried this story alone for years.
npcLine.zh: 这一切之所以重要，是因为我妹妹多年来一直独自承担着这段往事。

choices.text: She doesn't have to carry it alone anymore.
choices.zh: 她不用再独自承担了。

choices.text: That sounds dramatic.

n1.hintOnWrong: 温暖回应（陈述句）→ She doesn't have to carry it alone anymore.

npcLine.en: Thank you for saying that.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你这么说。

choices.text: Thank you for trusting me with it.
choices.zh: 谢谢您愿意信任我，跟我说这些。

choices.text: It's really no problem.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应感激 → Thank you for trusting me with it.

npcLine.en: Let's go visit that house together soon, all three of us.
npcLine.zh: 我们三个尽快一起去看看那栋房子吧。

choices.text: I'd love that. Let's plan it.
choices.zh: 我很愿意。我们来定个计划吧。

choices.text: Maybe some other time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → I'd love that. Let's plan it.

npcLine.en: It was wonderful to finally meet you.
npcLine.zh: 终于见到你了，真是太好了。

choices.text: The pleasure was all mine.
choices.zh: 这份荣幸都是我的。

choices.text: You too, I guess.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应（固定表达）→ The pleasure was all mine.

npcLine.en: Come back anytime, both of you.

choices.zh: 我们会的，我保证。

choices.text: Maybe, we'll see.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 承诺 → We will, I promise.

npcLine.en: Safe travels home.
npcLine.zh: 回家路上小心。

choices.text: Thank you, take care!
choices.zh: 谢谢您，您也保重！

choices.text: Bye, see you never.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌道别 → Thank you, take care!

transition.en: On the bus ride home, neither of you says much at first.
transition.zh: 回家的公交车上，一开始你们俩都没怎么说话。

scenes.title: Processing Together
scenes.subtitle: 公交车上 · 一起消化这段往事

npcLine.en: That was a lot to hear today.
npcLine.zh: 今天听到的这些真不少。

choices.text: It was, but I'm glad I heard it.
choices.zh: 确实，但我很高兴我听到了这些。

choices.text: It was kind of boring.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单感想（陈述句）→ It was, but I'm glad I heard it.

npcLine.en: Thank you for helping me find this.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你帮我找到了这些。

choices.text: We found it together.
choices.zh: 是我们一起找到的。

choices.text: It was mostly luck.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应（陈述句）→ We found it together.

npcLine.en: Let's visit the house next weekend, like he said.
npcLine.zh: 我们下周末就去看看那栋房子吧，像他说的那样。

choices.text: Yes, let's make a plan.
choices.zh: 好，我们来定个计划。

choices.text: Let's wait a little longer.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Yes, let's make a plan.

transition.en: That evening, you can't wait to tell Emma and Sam.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，你迫不及待想告诉Emma和Sam。

scenes.title: Sharing the News
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 告诉Emma这个新线索

npcLine.en: You look like you have a story to tell.
npcLine.zh: 你看起来有故事要讲啊。

choices.zh: 是的。一个大故事。

choices.text: Not really, never mind.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单陈述（陈述句）→ I do. A big one.

npcLine.zh: 帮过Ho太太一家的那家店，会不会正好是卖书的？

choices.text: Yes, it did. Maybe it was this one.
choices.zh: 是的，没错。也许就是这家店。

choices.text: No, it sold shoes.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用过去时确认（陈述句）→ Yes, it did. Maybe it was this one.

npcLine.en: That would explain a lot. Let's find out together.
npcLine.zh: 那就能解释很多事了。我们一起查清楚吧。

choices.text: Let's start tomorrow.
choices.zh: 我们明天就开始吧。

choices.text: Let's forget about it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's start tomorrow.

transition.en: A quiet Tuesday morning at the bookstore.
transition.zh: 周二早上，书店里很安静。

scenes.title: A Slow Morning
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 慢悠悠的早晨

npcLine.en: It's a slow morning. Have you ever worked somewhere this quiet?
npcLine.zh: 今天早上很清闲。你以前有在这么安静的地方工作过吗？

choices.text: I've never worked somewhere this quiet.
choices.zh: 我从来没在这么安静的地方工作过。

choices.text: I like loud places.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时（never）回应经历 → I've never worked somewhere this quiet.

npcLine.en: Have you read any of these books yet?
npcLine.zh: 这些书你已经读过哪些了吗？

choices.text: I've already read three of them.
choices.zh: 我已经读过其中三本了。

choices.text: I don't like reading.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时（already）→ I've already read three of them.

npcLine.en: Impressive! What's your favorite so far?
npcLine.zh: 厉害！目前为止你最喜欢哪本？

choices.text: This one is my favorite so far.
choices.zh: 目前这本是我的最爱。

choices.text: I don't have a favorite.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ This one is my favorite so far.

scenes.title: Morning News
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 聊聊今天的新闻

npcLine.zh: 你今天早上看新闻了吗？

choices.zh: 没有，我还没看呢。

choices.text: Yes, it's always boring.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时（yet）→ No, I haven't checked it yet.

npcLine.zh: 市中心要开一家新咖啡馆了。

choices.zh: 听起来很棒。

choices.text: I don't care about cafés.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That sounds exciting.

choices.text: No, and I never will.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时（tried it twice）→ Yes, I've tried it twice.

scenes.title: The Morning Rush
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 突然忙起来了

npcLine.zh: 哇，一下子来了好多顾客！

choices.zh: 我去帮门口那几位。

choices.text: I'll just watch.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示马上要做 → I'll help the ones by the door.

npcLine.zh: 我去补货的时候，你能顾一下收银台吗？

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表示能力 → Sure, I can handle it.

choices.text: I never eat lunch.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时反问 → Not yet, have you?

scenes.title: A Customer's Question

scenes.title: Closing Up

scenes.title: Walking Together
scenes.subtitle: 街上 · 和Emma一起走一段

npcLine.zh: 你找到照片里那栋房子了吗？

scenes.title: How Was Work?
scenes.subtitle: 公寓 · Sam问起今天工作

npcLine.zh: 今天工作怎么样？

choices.text: Busy, but a good kind of busy.
choices.zh: 很忙，但是那种令人满足的忙。

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单描述（陈述句）→ Busy, but a good kind of busy.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时（already）→ Yes, I've already told her everything.

choices.zh: 饿坏了，闻起来太香了。

choices.text: Not hungry at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ Starving, this smells amazing.

npcLine.en: Have you ever cooked a full meal by yourself?
npcLine.zh: 你自己一个人做过一整顿饭吗？

choices.text: I've cooked a few simple meals.
choices.zh: 我做过几顿简单的饭。

choices.text: I've never cooked in my life.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时（cooked a few）→ I've cooked a few simple meals.

npcLine.zh: 哦，这房子？我们家已经在这儿住了十年了。

npcLine.en: By the way, Lunar New Year is next week. Will you join us?
npcLine.zh: 对了，下周就是春节了。你愿意来我们家过节吗？

choices.text: I'd love to join you.
choices.zh: 我很乐意加入你们。

choices.text: I've never heard of it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌接受邀请 → I'd love to join you.

npcLine.en: Wonderful! It's the biggest celebration of the year for us.
npcLine.zh: 太好了！这对我们来说是一年中最盛大的节日。

choices.text: I can't wait to see it.
choices.zh: 我等不及想看看了。

choices.text: That sounds too big for me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 表达期待（陈述句）→ I can't wait to see it.

transition.en: The next week, you help decorate for the festival.
transition.zh: 第二周，你帮忙一起布置节日装饰。

scenes.title: Preparing for the Festival
scenes.subtitle: Ho太太家 · 布置春节装饰

npcLine.en: We need red decorations. Which one is bigger?
npcLine.zh: 我们需要红色装饰。哪一个更大？

choices.text: This one is bigger than that one.
choices.zh: 这个比那个大。

choices.text: They look the same size.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → This one is bigger than that one.

npcLine.en: Good choice. Can you help me hang it?
npcLine.zh: 选得好。你能帮我挂上去吗？

choices.text: Sure, I can reach higher than you.
choices.zh: 没问题，我够得比你高。

choices.text: I'm not tall enough either.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can + 比较级 → Sure, I can reach higher than you.

npcLine.en: Perfect. This is the best decoration we've had in years.
npcLine.zh: 太好了。这是我们这些年里最好的装饰了。

choices.text: I'm glad I could help.
choices.zh: 很高兴我能帮上忙。

choices.text: I didn't do much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ I'm glad I could help.

transition.en: New Year's Eve, the whole family gathers around the table.
transition.zh: 除夕夜，一家人围坐在桌前。

scenes.title: Reunion Dinner
scenes.subtitle: Ho太太家 · 除夕团圆饭

npcLine.en: Everyone's here. Let's eat before it gets cold.
npcLine.zh: 大家都到齐了。我们趁热吃吧。

choices.text: This table has more food than I've ever seen.
choices.zh: 这桌菜比我见过的都多。

choices.text: There's not much food.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → This table has more food than I've ever seen.

npcLine.en: Try this dish. It's my mother's recipe.
npcLine.zh: 尝尝这道菜。是我妈妈的食谱。

choices.text: This is the best dish I've had all year.
choices.zh: 这是我今年吃过最好吃的菜。

choices.text: It's a bit too salty.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用最高级 → This is the best dish I've had all year.

npcLine.en: I'm so happy you're here with us tonight.
npcLine.zh: 今晚你能在这儿，我真的很开心。

choices.text: I'm happy to be here too.
choices.zh: 我也很开心能在这儿。

choices.text: I should probably go soon.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ I'm happy to be here too.

scenes.title: New Traditions
scenes.subtitle: 餐桌上 · 聊聊过节的不同

npcLine.en: Have you ever celebrated Lunar New Year before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前庆祝过春节吗？

choices.text: I've never celebrated Lunar New Year before.
choices.zh: 我以前从没庆祝过春节。

choices.text: I celebrate it every year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时（never）→ I've never celebrated Lunar New Year before.

npcLine.en: It's very different from other holidays, isn't it?
npcLine.zh: 跟其他节日很不一样，对吧？

choices.text: It feels warmer than any holiday I know.
choices.zh: 感觉比我知道的任何节日都要温暖。

choices.text: It feels exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → It feels warmer than any holiday I know.

npcLine.en: That's the nicest thing you could say.
npcLine.zh: 这是你能说出的最贴心的话了。

choices.text: I mean it, thank you for having me.
choices.zh: 我是真心的，谢谢你们邀请我。

choices.text: I was just being polite.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → I mean it, thank you for having me.

npcLine.en: Here — a red envelope for you.
npcLine.zh: 给你——一个红包。

choices.text: Oh, thank you so much.
choices.zh: 哦，太谢谢您了。

choices.text: I don't need money.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌感谢 → Oh, thank you so much.

npcLine.en: It's for good luck, not for spending right away.
npcLine.zh: 这是图个好运，不是让你马上花掉的。

choices.text: I'll keep it somewhere special.
choices.zh: 我会把它放在一个特别的地方。

choices.text: I'll spend it tonight.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll keep it somewhere special.

npcLine.en: You've brought us good luck too, you know.
npcLine.zh: 其实你也给我们带来了好运，你知道吗。

choices.text: I've never felt so welcome anywhere.
choices.zh: 我从没在哪里感到如此受欢迎。

choices.text: I feel a little out of place.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've never felt so welcome anywhere.

scenes.title: Fireworks
scenes.subtitle: 院子里 · 烟花与家人

npcLine.en: Come outside — the fireworks are starting!
npcLine.zh: 出来吧——烟花要开始了！

choices.text: I'm coming, don't start without me!
choices.zh: 我来了，别没我就开始！

choices.text: I'll stay inside.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → I'm coming, don't start without me!

npcLine.en: Look at that one — it's brighter than the last!
npcLine.zh: 看那个——比上一个还亮！

choices.text: That's the brightest one yet.
choices.zh: 这是目前为止最亮的一个。

choices.text: It's not that bright.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用最高级 → That's the brightest one yet.

npcLine.en: This has been a perfect night.
npcLine.zh: 今晚真是完美的一晚。

choices.text: It really has been perfect.
choices.zh: 确实是完美的一晚。

choices.text: It's been okay, I guess.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时附和 → It really has been perfect.

transition.en: Later, when the fireworks fade, Mrs. Ho finds you alone.
transition.zh: 后来，烟花渐渐散去，Ho太太找到独自一人的你。

scenes.title: A Quiet Moment
scenes.subtitle: 阳台上 · 深夜的对话

npcLine.en: I read a few of those letters tonight.
npcLine.zh: 我今晚读了几封那些信。

choices.text: What did they say?
choices.zh: 信里写了什么？

choices.text: I don't want to know yet.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问细节（wh-question）→ What did they say?

npcLine.en: One of them was addressed to someone named Emma.
npcLine.zh: 其中一封是写给一个叫Emma的人的。

choices.text: Wait, our Emma? That can't be a coincidence.
choices.zh: 等等，我们认识的那个Emma？这不可能是巧合。

choices.text: That's probably a different Emma.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述惊讶（陈述句）→ Wait, our Emma? That can't be a coincidence.

npcLine.en: I think it's time we showed her these letters.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得是时候把这些信给她看看了。

choices.text: I'll bring her here tomorrow.
choices.zh: 我明天带她过来。

choices.text: Let's wait a bit longer.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll bring her here tomorrow.

transition.en: That weekend, Sam invites you to watch a hockey game.
transition.zh: 那个周末，Sam邀请你一起看冰球比赛。

npcLine.en: Hockey is Canada's favorite sport. Have you ever watched a game?
npcLine.zh: 冰球是加拿大人最喜欢的运动。你看过比赛吗？

choices.text: I've never watched hockey before.
choices.zh: 我以前从没看过冰球。

choices.text: I watch it every single day.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've never watched hockey before.

npcLine.en: If our team scores, everyone here will go crazy.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们的队进球了，这儿的人都会疯掉的。

choices.text: If they score, I'll cheer too.
choices.zh: 如果他们进球，我也会一起欢呼。

choices.text: I probably won't notice.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If they score, I'll cheer too.

npcLine.en: The game is about to start. Grab a seat!
npcLine.zh: 比赛快开始了。快找个位置坐下！

choices.text: I'm sitting right here, ready to watch.
choices.zh: 我就坐这儿，准备看比赛了。

choices.text: I'll stand in the back.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → I'm sitting right here, ready to watch.

npcLine.en: If we win this period, we'll be in first place.
npcLine.zh: 如果这一节我们赢了，我们就会排名第一。

choices.text: If we win, we'll celebrate all night.
choices.zh: 如果我们赢了，我们会庆祝一整晚。

choices.text: We'll probably lose anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If we win, we'll celebrate all night.

npcLine.en: GOAL! Did you see that shot?
npcLine.zh: 进球啦！你看到那一射了吗？

choices.text: I saw it! That was amazing!
choices.zh: 我看到了！太精彩了！

choices.text: I missed it, sorry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → I saw it! That was amazing!

npcLine.en: This is officially the best game I've been to.
npcLine.zh: 这正式成为我看过最精彩的比赛了。

choices.text: Best one I've seen too.
choices.zh: 也是我看过最好的一场。

choices.text: I've seen better games.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用最高级 → Best one I've seen too.

transition.en: During a break in the game, you check your phone.
transition.zh: 比赛中场休息时，你看了看手机。

scenes.title: A Message from Mrs. Ho
scenes.subtitle: 酒吧 · Ho太太发来消息

npcLine.en: "I found something important in the letters. Can you bring Emma tomorrow?"
npcLine.zh: 「我在信里发现了很重要的东西。你明天能带Emma一起来吗？」

choices.text: Yes, I can bring her tomorrow.
choices.zh: 好的，我明天可以带她来。

choices.text: No, she's too busy.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Yes, I can bring her tomorrow.

npcLine.en: Sam, sorry — I have to make a quick call.
npcLine.zh: Sam，抱歉——我得赶紧打个电话。

choices.text: No worries, go ahead.
choices.zh: 没事，你去吧。

choices.text: Can't it wait?

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应（陈述句）→ No worries, go ahead.

npcLine.en: Emma, are you free tomorrow morning?
npcLine.zh: Emma，你明天早上有空吗？

choices.text: I'm free. Is everything okay?
choices.zh: 我有空。一切都还好吗？

choices.text: I'm busy all day, sorry.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应＋关心（陈述句）→ I'm free. Is everything okay?

scenes.title: Explaining Everything
scenes.subtitle: 电话里 · 跟Emma解释这一切

npcLine.en: Wait, slow down. Mrs. Ho's family knew someone from a bookshop?
npcLine.zh: 等等，慢点说。Ho太太一家认识一个书店的人？

choices.text: Yes, someone who helped them a lot.
choices.zh: 是的，一个帮了他们很多忙的人。

choices.text: No, I made that part up.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时确认 → Yes, someone who helped them a lot.

npcLine.en: And one of the letters has my name on it?
npcLine.zh: 而且其中一封信上写着我的名字？

choices.text: It's had your name on it this whole time.
choices.zh: 这封信从一开始就写着你的名字。

choices.text: It's just a different Emma.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → It's had your name on it this whole time.

npcLine.en: If that's true, this changes everything.
npcLine.zh: 如果这是真的，这会改变一切。

choices.text: If it's true, we'll find out tomorrow.
choices.zh: 如果是真的，我们明天就能知道了。

choices.text: It's probably not true.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If it's true, we'll find out tomorrow.

scenes.title: Back to the Game
scenes.subtitle: 酒吧 · 回到比赛现场

npcLine.en: Everything okay? You look distracted.
npcLine.zh: 一切还好吗？你看起来有点心不在焉。

choices.text: I'm okay, just a lot on my mind.
choices.zh: 我没事，就是想的事有点多。

choices.text: Nothing, I'm totally fine.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单陈述（陈述句）→ I'm okay, just a lot on my mind.

npcLine.en: Want to talk about it, or just watch the game?
npcLine.zh: 想聊聊，还是就先看比赛？

choices.text: Let's just watch for now.
choices.zh: 我们先看比赛吧。

choices.text: I need to leave right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单提议 → Let's just watch for now.

npcLine.en: Fair enough. If they win tonight, drinks are on me.
npcLine.zh: 行吧。如果他们今晚赢了，这轮我请客。

choices.text: If they win, I'm holding you to that.
choices.zh: 如果他们赢了，我可要记住你这句话。

choices.text: I don't think they'll win.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If they win, I'm holding you to that.

transition.en: The next morning, you meet Emma outside Mrs. Ho's building.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，你和Emma在Ho太太家楼下碰头。

scenes.title: Morning Nerves
scenes.subtitle: 楼下 · 见面前的紧张

npcLine.en: I've never been this nervous before.
npcLine.zh: 我从没这么紧张过。

choices.text: It's okay, I've got your hand.
choices.zh: 没事的，我牵着你的手呢。

choices.text: You should calm down.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时回应 → It's okay, I've got your hand.

npcLine.en: If this is really about my family, I need to know everything.
npcLine.zh: 如果这真的跟我家有关，我需要知道一切。

choices.text: If it's about your family, we'll learn it together.
choices.zh: 如果跟你家有关，我们会一起了解清楚。

choices.text: If it's your family, that's your problem.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If it's about your family, we'll learn it together.

npcLine.en: Okay. Let's go up.
npcLine.zh: 好。我们上去吧。

choices.text: Let's go up together.
choices.zh: 我们一起上去吧。

choices.text: You should go up first.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's go up together.

scenes.title: Three Together
scenes.subtitle: Ho太太家 · 三人一起看信

npcLine.en: Emma, thank you for coming. Please, sit.
npcLine.zh: Emma，谢谢你能来。请坐。

choices.text: Thank you for having me.
choices.zh: 谢谢您邀请我。

choices.text: I almost didn't come.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you for having me.

npcLine.en: This letter has your family name on it. Do you recognize it?
npcLine.zh: 这封信上写着你的姓氏。你认得出来吗？

choices.text: Yes, that's my grandmother's handwriting.
choices.zh: 是的，这是我祖母的笔迹。

choices.text: No, I've never seen it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that's my grandmother's handwriting.

npcLine.en: Your grandmother? Then it really was her shop.
npcLine.zh: 你祖母？那当年真的是她的店。

choices.text: It really was, all along.
choices.zh: 确实是，一直都是。

choices.text: That seems unlikely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去时确认（陈述句）→ It really was, all along.

scenes.title: Emma's Reaction
scenes.subtitle: 客厅 · Emma消化这个消息

npcLine.en: My grandmother never told me she helped a family like yours.
npcLine.zh: 我祖母从没跟我说过她帮过像你们这样的一家人。

choices.text: Maybe she's never told anyone.
choices.zh: 也许她从没跟任何人说过。

choices.text: Maybe she just forgot about it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → Maybe she's never told anyone.

npcLine.en: If she were still here, I'd love to hear the whole story.
npcLine.zh: 如果她还在，我真想听听完整的故事。

choices.text: Maybe these letters can tell us more.
choices.zh: 也许这些信能告诉我们更多。

choices.text: We'll never really know now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述可能性（陈述句）→ Maybe these letters can tell us more.

npcLine.en: There's one more letter I haven't opened yet.
npcLine.zh: 还有一封信我还没拆开。

choices.text: Let's open it together, right now.
choices.zh: 我们现在就一起打开吧。

choices.text: Let's save it for later.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's open it together, right now.

scenes.title: The Unopened Letter
scenes.subtitle: 客厅 · 那封还没拆开的信

npcLine.en: If we open it, there's no going back.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们打开它，就没有回头路了。

choices.text: If we don't open it, we'll always wonder.
choices.zh: 如果我们不打开，我们会一直好奇下去。

choices.text: If we open it, nothing will change.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If we don't open it, we'll always wonder.

npcLine.en: Emma, would you like to be the one to open it?
npcLine.zh: Emma，你愿意由你来打开它吗？

choices.text: Yes, I think I can do this.
choices.zh: 好，我觉得我能做到。

choices.text: No, someone else should do it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表达能力 → Yes, I think I can do this.

npcLine.en: Take your time. We're right here with you.
npcLine.zh: 慢慢来。我们就在这儿陪着你。

choices.text: Thank you, both of you.
choices.zh: 谢谢你们俩。

choices.text: I'd rather do this alone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单感谢（陈述句）→ Thank you, both of you.

scenes.title: One Step Closer
scenes.subtitle: 客厅 · 离真相更近了一步

npcLine.en: It's addressed to my grandmother, from someone named Lily.
npcLine.zh: 这封信是写给我祖母的，寄信人叫Lily。

choices.text: Lily — that name sounds familiar.
choices.zh: Lily——这个名字听着有点耳熟。

choices.text: I've never heard that name.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单反应（陈述句）→ Lily — that name sounds familiar.

npcLine.en: Lily... that was my mother's name.
npcLine.zh: Lily……那是我母亲的名字。

choices.text: Your mother wrote this letter?
choices.zh: 这封信是你妈妈写的？

choices.text: That must be a different Lily.

n2.hintOnWrong: 确认信息（陈述句/问句）→ Your mother wrote this letter?

npcLine.en: If this is what I think it is, our families have known each other for decades.
npcLine.zh: 如果我想的没错，我们两家已经认识了好几十年了。

choices.text: If that's true, that's incredible.
choices.zh: 如果是真的，这太不可思议了。

choices.text: If that's true, I don't care.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If that's true, that's incredible.

npcLine.en: There are more pages here. Should we keep reading?
npcLine.zh: 这儿还有更多信纸。我们要不要继续读？

choices.text: Yes, let's keep reading together.
choices.zh: 好，我们一起继续读吧。

choices.text: Let's stop for today.

n1.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Yes, let's keep reading together.

npcLine.en: This next part was written in 1984.
npcLine.zh: 接下来这部分是1984年写的。

choices.text: It was written right when everything changed.
choices.zh: 正是一切发生变化的时候写的。

choices.text: It was written just for fun.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → It was written right when everything changed.

npcLine.en: 1984 — that's when Hong Kong's future was decided.
npcLine.zh: 1984年——那是香港的未来被决定的一年。

choices.text: That's when so much was decided for so many families.
choices.zh: 那是为无数家庭决定命运的一年。

choices.text: That doesn't sound important.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → That's when so much was decided for so many families.

npcLine.en: My parents were scared about what would happen after 1997.
npcLine.zh: 我父母很担心1997年之后会发生什么。

choices.text: So many decisions were made so quickly.
choices.zh: 那么多决定都被匆忙做出来了。

choices.text: That doesn't sound so bad.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → So many decisions were made so quickly.

npcLine.en: So many people left. It changed the whole neighborhood.
npcLine.zh: 很多人都离开了。整个社区都变了样。

choices.text: That's heartbreaking to imagine.
choices.zh: 想想都让人心碎。

choices.text: That sounds exaggerated.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单共情（陈述句）→ That's heartbreaking to imagine.

npcLine.en: But we made a choice, and here we are.
npcLine.zh: 但我们做了选择，也就有了今天的我们。

choices.text: And it brought us all together.
choices.zh: 而这一切把我们都联系在了一起。

choices.text: And it was all for nothing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → And it brought us all together.

npcLine.en: The trip here was long and quiet. Nobody spoke much.
npcLine.zh: 来这儿的旅程又长又安静。谁都没怎么说话。

choices.text: That sounds like such a hard trip.
choices.zh: 听起来是段特别艰难的旅程。

choices.text: That sounds like an easy trip.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单共情（陈述句）→ That sounds like such a hard trip.

npcLine.en: Everything we owned was packed into two suitcases.
npcLine.zh: 我们所有的家当都装进了两只行李箱里。

choices.text: Two suitcases for a whole life.
choices.zh: 两只箱子装下了整个人生。

choices.text: That doesn't seem like much.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单感叹（陈述句）→ Two suitcases for a whole life.

npcLine.en: But we were welcomed here, eventually.

choices.zh: 如果我们想要，那就得抓紧行动了。

choices.text: If we want it, there's no rush at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If we want it, we'd better act fast.

transition.en: That evening, everyone gathers at the bookshop to talk.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，大家聚在书店商量这件事。

npcLine.en: Okay, everyone. Are we really doing this?
npcLine.zh: 好了，大家。我们真的要做这件事吗？

choices.text: I think we really are.
choices.zh: 我觉得我们真的要做。

choices.text: I think we should wait years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ I think we really are.

npcLine.en: I've already spoken to a few old friends. They want to help.
npcLine.zh: 我已经跟几个老朋友说过了。他们都愿意帮忙。

choices.text: You've already started, wow.
choices.zh: 你已经开始张罗了，真厉害。

choices.text: You've already given up, then?

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → You've already started, wow.

npcLine.en: Let's put this to a vote. All in favor?
npcLine.zh: 我们来投个票吧。赞成的举手？

choices.text: Let's vote — I'm in favor.
choices.zh: 我们投票吧——我赞成。

choices.text: Let's not decide today.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's vote — I'm in favor.

npcLine.en: First, we need a budget. How much can we raise?
npcLine.zh: 首先，我们需要一个预算。我们能筹到多少钱？

choices.text: How much do we actually need?
choices.zh: 我们实际上需要多少呢？

choices.text: I don't want to talk numbers.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问细节 → How much do we actually need?

npcLine.en: If we all contribute a little, it could work.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们大家都出一点力，应该行得通。

choices.text: If everyone helps, it'll definitely work.
choices.zh: 如果大家都帮忙，肯定能行。

choices.text: If everyone helps, it still won't work.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If everyone helps, it'll definitely work.

npcLine.en: We had talked about this for years, but we'd never really tried.
npcLine.zh: 我们已经谈论这件事好多年了，但从没真正尝试过。

choices.text: We'd talked about it for years, but this feels different.
choices.zh: 我们已经聊了好多年，但这次感觉不一样。

choices.text: We've never mentioned this before.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时 → We'd talked about it for years, but this feels different.

transition.en: The next morning, you and Emma visit the bank together.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，你和Emma一起去了银行。

scenes.title: Visiting the Bank
scenes.subtitle: 银行 · 申请一笔贷款

npcLine.en: So, you'd like a loan for a community project?
npcLine.zh: 所以，你们想为一个社区项目申请贷款？

choices.text: Yes, exactly. It means a lot to us.
choices.zh: 是的，没错。这对我们意义重大。

choices.text: No, it's just for fun.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单确认（陈述句）→ Yes, exactly. It means a lot to us.

npcLine.en: Can you tell me more about the project?
npcLine.zh: 能跟我多说说这个项目吗？

choices.text: Of course, I can explain everything.
choices.zh: 当然可以，我可以把一切都说清楚。

choices.text: I can't really explain it well.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Of course, I can explain everything.

npcLine.en: This is one of the best proposals I've seen this year.
npcLine.zh: 这是我今年看过最好的提案之一。

choices.text: That means so much, thank you.
choices.zh: 这对我们意义重大，谢谢您。

choices.text: I doubt that's really true.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单感谢（陈述句）→ That means so much, thank you.

transition.en: With the loan approved, it's time to inspect the house.
transition.zh: 贷款批下来了，是时候去检查一下这栋房子了。

scenes.title: The Inspection
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · 检查房屋状况

npcLine.en: By the time we arrived, the roof had already started leaking.
npcLine.zh: 我们到的时候，屋顶已经开始漏水了。

choices.text: It had already gotten worse than we thought.
choices.zh: 情况已经比我们想的更糟了。

choices.text: It had already been fully repaired.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时 → It had already gotten worse than we thought.

npcLine.en: The good news is, the foundation is solid.
npcLine.zh: 好消息是，地基很牢固。

choices.text: That's a relief, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，这真让人松了口气。

choices.text: That's not good news at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That's a relief, honestly.

npcLine.en: It'll take work, but it can definitely be saved.
npcLine.zh: 会花点功夫，但绝对能修好。

choices.text: As long as it can be saved, I'm happy.
choices.zh: 只要能修好，我就开心了。

choices.text: It probably can't be saved at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → As long as it can be saved, I'm happy.

transition.en: By the weekend, the renovation has already begun.
transition.zh: 到了周末，翻修工作已经开始了。

npcLine.en: Everyone had shown up before I even got here.
npcLine.zh: 我还没到，大家就都已经到了。

choices.text: Everyone had already started without you.
choices.zh: 大家没等你就已经开始了。

choices.text: Nobody had shown up at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时 → Everyone had already started without you.

npcLine.en: Can you help carry these boards?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮忙搬一下这些木板吗？

choices.text: Sure, hand them over.
choices.zh: 没问题，递给我吧。

choices.text: I can't lift anything today.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Sure, hand them over.

npcLine.en: This place already feels warmer than before.
npcLine.zh: 这地方已经比之前暖多了。

choices.text: It really does feel warmer already.
choices.zh: 确实已经暖多了。

choices.text: It still feels cold to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → It really does feel warmer already.

transition.en: While you're painting a wall, someone knocks on the open door.
transition.zh: 你正在刷墙的时候，有人敲了敲敞开的门。

scenes.title: An Unexpected Visitor
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · 一位不速之客

npcLine.en: Sorry — is this place open? I just moved here and I saw the lights on.
npcLine.zh: 不好意思——这里是开放的吗？我刚搬来，看到这儿亮着灯。

choices.text: Come in, please. When did you move here?
choices.zh: 请进。你什么时候搬来的？

choices.text: Sorry, we're closed to visitors.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时追问 → Come in, please. When did you move here?

npcLine.en: Just last week. We haven't met anyone here yet.
npcLine.zh: 上周刚到。我们在这儿还没认识什么人呢。

choices.text: Well, you've met someone now.
choices.zh: 那现在你们认识了。

choices.text: You'll probably never meet anyone.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → Well, you've met someone now.

npcLine.en: What is this place going to be, exactly?
npcLine.zh: 这地方具体会变成什么呢？

choices.text: A place for people just like you.
choices.zh: 一个专为像你这样的人准备的地方。

choices.text: I honestly have no idea.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回答（陈述句）→ A place for people just like you.

scenes.title: Helping the Newcomers
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · 帮助新来的家庭

npcLine.en: Honestly, we haven't found our way around the city yet.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，我们对这座城市还不太熟。

choices.text: We hadn't either, once.
choices.zh: 我们也曾经不熟。

choices.text: That's not our problem, sorry.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时呼应 → We hadn't either, once.

npcLine.en: Could you show us where to buy groceries nearby?
npcLine.zh: 你能带我们看看附近哪儿能买菜吗？

choices.text: Of course, I can show you right now.
choices.zh: 当然，我现在就可以带你们去。

choices.text: I can't leave right now, sorry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Of course, I can show you right now.

npcLine.en: You're being so kind. We really appreciate it.
npcLine.zh: 你人真好。我们真的很感激。

choices.text: It's exactly what someone once did for us.
choices.zh: 这正是曾经有人为我们做过的事。

choices.text: It's really no big deal, forget it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ It's exactly what someone once did for us.

transition.en: That night, the group discusses what to call this new place.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，大家讨论该给这个新地方取什么名字。

scenes.title: The Name of the Place
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · 该取什么名字

npcLine.en: What should we call it?
npcLine.zh: 我们该叫它什么呢？

choices.text: What does everyone think?
choices.zh: 大家都是怎么想的？

choices.text: I don't think it needs a name.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问意见 → What does everyone think?

npcLine.en: It was Lily's kindness that started all of this.
npcLine.zh: 是Lily的善意开启了这一切。

choices.text: Then it should carry her name somehow.
choices.zh: 那它应该以某种方式带上她的名字。

choices.text: Then it shouldn't be named after anyone.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单表达意见（陈述句）→ Then it should carry her name somehow.

npcLine.en: Lily's House. Simple, and true.
npcLine.zh: 「Lily之家」。简单，而且贴切。

choices.text: Lily's House — I love it.
choices.zh: 「Lily之家」——我很喜欢。

choices.text: Lily's House sounds a bit plain.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Lily's House — I love it.

transition.en: A month later, the doors of Lily's House open for the first time.
transition.zh: 一个月后，「Lily之家」第一次敞开了大门。

npcLine.en: It's not finished yet, but it's ready enough to open.
npcLine.zh: 还没完全弄好，但已经够开放了。

choices.text: It's ready enough, and that's what matters.
choices.zh: 已经够好了，这才是最重要的。

choices.text: It should have been finished by now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ It's ready enough, and that's what matters.

npcLine.en: Look — the new family from down the street is here.
npcLine.zh: 你看——街那头那户新家庭来了。

choices.text: Let's welcome them properly.
choices.zh: 我们好好欢迎他们吧。

choices.text: Let's pretend we don't see them.

n2.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's welcome them properly.

npcLine.en: A decade ago, someone had already started this story without knowing it.
npcLine.zh: 十年前，有人在不知情的情况下，就已经开启了这个故事。

choices.text: And we're the ones finishing it.
choices.zh: 而我们是把它继续写下去的人。

choices.text: And it means nothing to us now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ And we're the ones finishing it.

transition.en: A week after opening, Lily's House already feels alive.
transition.zh: 开放一周后，「Lily之家」已经充满了生气。

npcLine.en: A few of us were talking. What if this place had English classes?
npcLine.zh: 我们几个之前在聊。要是这里能有英语课呢？

choices.text: If we had classes, I'd love to help.
choices.zh: 如果开课，我很乐意帮忙。

choices.text: If we had classes, I'd rather not.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If we had classes, I'd love to help.

npcLine.en: You've already learned so much this year yourself.
npcLine.zh: 你自己今年已经学了这么多了。

choices.text: I've learned enough to pass it on now.
choices.zh: 我学得已经够多了，现在可以传下去了。

choices.text: I've forgotten most of it already.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've learned enough to pass it on now.

npcLine.en: Let's ask around and see who else wants to teach.
npcLine.zh: 我们问问看还有谁想来教课。

choices.text: Good idea, let's ask everyone tonight.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们今晚就去问问大家。

choices.text: Let's just decide it's you and me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Good idea, let's ask everyone tonight.

npcLine.en: I'd love to teach a class, if you'll have me.
npcLine.zh: 如果你们不嫌弃，我很想教一堂课。

choices.text: If you're in, we'd be so lucky.
choices.zh: 如果你加入，那我们真是太幸运了。

choices.text: If you're in, that's a bit much.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If you're in, we'd be so lucky.

npcLine.en: I could probably help too, if it's just simple conversation.
npcLine.zh: 如果只是简单对话，我大概也能帮上忙。

choices.text: Simple conversation is exactly what's needed.
choices.zh: 简单对话正是需要的。

choices.text: Simple conversation isn't really teaching.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Simple conversation is exactly what's needed.

npcLine.en: Look at that — we already have three teachers.
npcLine.zh: 你看——我们已经有三位老师了。

choices.text: We've already got a real team.
choices.zh: 我们已经有了一支像样的团队了。

choices.text: We've barely started, really.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → We've already got a real team.

npcLine.en: What should the first lesson be about?
npcLine.zh: 第一课应该讲点什么？

choices.text: What did you learn first, back then?
choices.zh: 你当初最先学的是什么？

choices.text: It doesn't matter what we teach.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问过去经历（wh-question）→ What did you learn first, back then?

npcLine.en: Simple greetings. That's where everyone starts.
npcLine.zh: 简单的问候语。每个人都是从这儿开始的。

choices.text: That's exactly where I started too.
choices.zh: 我当初也正是从这儿开始的。

choices.text: That seems too easy for anyone.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That's exactly where I started too.

npcLine.en: By the time class starts tomorrow, we should have everything ready.
npcLine.zh: 明天上课之前，我们应该把一切都准备好。

choices.text: By tomorrow, we'll have had a whole night to prepare.
choices.zh: 到明天，我们会有一整晚的时间来准备。

choices.text: By tomorrow, nothing will be ready.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时 → By tomorrow, we'll have had a whole night to prepare.

transition.en: The next evening, you pace nervously before the first class.
transition.zh: 第二天傍晚，第一堂课开始前，你紧张地来回踱步。

scenes.title: Nervous Before Teaching
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 上课前的紧张

npcLine.en: You seem nervous. First time teaching?
npcLine.zh: 你看起来很紧张。第一次教课？

choices.text: It is, and I wish I felt more ready.
choices.zh: 是的，我真希望自己感觉更有准备一点。

choices.text: It is, but I feel completely calm.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气（wish）→ It is, and I wish I felt more ready.

npcLine.en: If I were you, I'd just remember your own first day here.
npcLine.zh: 如果我是你，我就会想想自己刚到这儿的第一天。

choices.text: If I were you, I'd say the same thing.
choices.zh: 如果我是你，我也会这么说。

choices.text: If I were you, I wouldn't bother.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气（If I were...）→ If I were you, I'd say the same thing.

npcLine.en: You'll do fine. Everyone in that room just wants to be understood.
npcLine.zh: 你会做得很好的。那间屋子里的每个人，都只是想被理解。
