choices.text: That's all I ever wanted too.
choices.zh: 这也是我一直以来想要的。

choices.text: That's easy for you to say.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That's all I ever wanted too.

npcLine.en: Hello! Is this the English class?
npcLine.zh: 你好！这是英语课的教室吗？

choices.text: Yes it is, welcome! Please, sit anywhere.
choices.zh: 是的，欢迎！请随便坐。

choices.text: Yes, but we're already full.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌欢迎（陈述句）→ Yes it is, welcome! Please, sit anywhere.

npcLine.en: More people have come than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 来的人比我预期的要多。

choices.text: So many more than expected, in a good way.
choices.zh: 比预期多了这么多，是好事。

choices.text: Fewer than I hoped, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → So many more than expected, in a good way.

npcLine.en: Okay, everyone. Let's begin with 'Hello, how are you?'
npcLine.zh: 好了，各位。我们从「你好，你好吗？」开始吧。

choices.text: Let's begin, everyone repeat after me.
choices.zh: 我们开始吧，大家跟我念。

choices.text: Let's skip the basics entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's begin, everyone repeat after me.

transition.en: After class, one student lingers to talk.
transition.zh: 下课后，一位学员留下来聊了聊。

scenes.title: A Student's Story
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 一位学员的故事

npcLine.en: By the time we moved here, we had already lost almost everything once.
npcLine.zh: 我们搬来这儿的时候，其实已经失去过几乎所有东西一次了。

choices.text: You had already been through so much.
choices.zh: 你们已经经历了太多。

choices.text: You hadn't lost anything, really.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时 → You had already been through so much.

npcLine.en: This class is the first thing that's felt like starting over.
npcLine.zh: 这堂课是第一件让我感觉像是重新开始的事。

choices.text: I'm honored it's felt that way.
choices.zh: 很荣幸这堂课能给你这种感觉。

choices.text: It's really not that big of a deal.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ I'm honored it's felt that way.

npcLine.en: Someone did this for your friend's family too, didn't they?
npcLine.zh: 曾经也有人为你朋友一家做过这样的事，对吧？

choices.text: They did, a long time ago.
choices.zh: 确实有过，很久以前的事了。

choices.text: No, that never really happened.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去时确认 → They did, a long time ago.

scenes.title: If I Were You
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 给学员的建议

npcLine.en: I'm scared to speak English outside this room.
npcLine.zh: 我在这间教室外面很害怕开口说英语。

choices.text: I understand, I felt that way too.
choices.zh: 我理解，我也曾经那样。

choices.text: You shouldn't feel scared at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单共情（陈述句）→ I understand, I felt that way too.

npcLine.en: If I were you, I'd practice with just one shopkeeper at first.
npcLine.zh: 如果我是你，我会先只找一位店主练习。

choices.text: If I were starting again, I'd do exactly that.
choices.zh: 如果我重新开始，我也会正好这么做。

choices.text: If I were you, I'd give up entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气 → If I were starting again, I'd do exactly that.

npcLine.en: One shopkeeper. Then one neighbor. Then a whole city.
npcLine.zh: 先一位店主。然后一位邻居。然后是一整座城市。

choices.text: One person at a time, that's how it works.
choices.zh: 一次一个人，事情就是这样成的。

choices.text: That sounds like it'll take forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ One person at a time, that's how it works.

transition.en: A few weeks pass, and small victories start to add up.
transition.zh: 几周过去了，一个个小小的胜利开始累积起来。

scenes.title: Small Victories
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 一个个小小的进步

npcLine.en: I ordered my coffee in English today, all by myself.
npcLine.zh: 我今天自己一个人用英语点了咖啡。

choices.text: You did it! I'm so proud of you.
choices.zh: 你做到了！我真为你骄傲。

choices.text: That's not really a big deal.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时庆祝＋陈述句 → You did it! I'm so proud of you.

npcLine.en: Every one of you has improved more than you probably notice.
npcLine.zh: 你们每个人的进步，都比自己意识到的要多。

choices.text: We've improved more than we realize, it's true.
choices.zh: 确实，我们的进步比自己意识到的要多。

choices.text: I don't think anyone has improved much.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → We've improved more than we realize, it's true.

npcLine.en: This calls for a celebration, don't you think?
npcLine.zh: 这值得庆祝一下吧，你说呢？

choices.text: It absolutely calls for one.
choices.zh: 绝对值得庆祝。

choices.text: I don't think it's necessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单赞同（陈述句）→ It absolutely calls for one.

transition.en: That night, Sam asks to speak with you privately.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，Sam说想单独跟你聊聊。

npcLine.en: I've been taking night classes. I never told you.
npcLine.zh: 我一直在上夜校。我从没跟你说过。

choices.text: You've kept that a secret this whole time?
choices.zh: 你这么久一直瞒着我？

choices.text: You've never done anything like that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → You've kept that a secret this whole time?

npcLine.en: I wish I had told you sooner, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，我真希望自己早点告诉你。

choices.text: I wish you'd told me too, but I understand.
choices.zh: 我也希望你早点告诉我，但我理解。

choices.text: I wish you had never told me at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气 → I wish you'd told me too, but I understand.

npcLine.en: I want to become a real teacher someday. Maybe even here.
npcLine.zh: 我想有一天成为一名真正的老师。也许就在这儿。

choices.text: You'll be an amazing teacher, Sam.
choices.zh: 你会成为一名很棒的老师的，Sam。

choices.text: You'll probably change your mind.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示看好未来 → You'll be an amazing teacher, Sam.

transition.en: The next class, Sam stands at the front for the first time.
transition.zh: 下一堂课，Sam第一次站到了讲台前。

npcLine.en: If I hadn't come to this city, none of this would have happened.
npcLine.zh: 如果我当初没来这座城市，这一切都不会发生。

choices.text: None of us would be here without that.
choices.zh: 没有那件事，我们谁都不会在这儿。

choices.text: It would have happened anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ None of us would be here without that.

npcLine.en: A teacher, a student — tonight, we're all a little of both.
npcLine.zh: 老师、学生——今晚，我们都有点两者兼备。

choices.text: A little of both, and I love that.
choices.zh: 两者兼备，我很喜欢这样。

choices.text: I'd rather just pick one role.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ A little of both, and I love that.

npcLine.en: Class, please welcome our newest teacher, Sam.
npcLine.zh: 同学们，请欢迎我们最新的老师，Sam。

choices.text: Welcome, Sam — we're so glad you're here.
choices.zh: 欢迎，Sam——很高兴你在这儿。

choices.text: Welcome, Sam, I guess this is fine.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌欢迎（固定短语）→ Welcome, Sam — we're so glad you're here.

transition.en: One afternoon, the phone at Lily's House rings.
transition.zh: 一天下午，Lily之家的电话响了。

scenes.title: A Reporter Calls
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 一通意外的电话

npcLine.en: Hi, I'm a reporter with the local paper. I heard about this place.
npcLine.zh: 你好，我是本地报社的记者。我听说了这个地方。

choices.text: Oh wow, who told you about us?
choices.zh: 哦哇，是谁跟你说起我们的？

choices.text: We don't want any visitors.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时追问 → Oh wow, who told you about us?

npcLine.en: A student of yours mentioned it to a friend of mine.
npcLine.zh: 你们的一位学员跟我一个朋友提起过。

choices.text: Word travels fast around here, I guess.
choices.zh: 看来这儿的消息传得挺快的。

choices.text: That's not possible, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Word travels fast around here, I guess.

npcLine.en: Would it be okay if I came by this week to talk?
npcLine.zh: 这周我过去聊聊，方便吗？

choices.text: If you'd like to come, we'd be happy to talk.
choices.zh: 如果你想来，我们很乐意聊聊。

choices.text: If you come, we won't have time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If you'd like to come, we'd be happy to talk.

npcLine.en: One of your students told me she'd never felt so welcome anywhere.
npcLine.zh: 你们的一位学员告诉我，她从没在哪里感到如此受欢迎。

choices.text: She said that to me too, once.
choices.zh: 她也曾这样跟我说过。

choices.text: She never said anything like that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语 → She said that to me too, once.

npcLine.en: Mrs. Ho told me this place used to be just a house with a story.
npcLine.zh: Ho太太告诉我，这地方以前只是一栋有故事的房子。

choices.text: She told the truth — it really was just that.
choices.zh: 她说的是实话——它原本确实只是那样。

choices.text: She didn't tell you the truth, actually.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语回应 → She told the truth — it really was just that.

npcLine.en: Can you tell me how this all started?
npcLine.zh: 你能跟我讲讲这一切是怎么开始的吗？

choices.text: Sure, I can tell you the whole story.
choices.zh: 当然，我可以把整个故事都跟你说说。

choices.text: I can't really explain it simply.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Sure, I can tell you the whole story.

scenes.title: Questions About the Past
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 问起过去的事

npcLine.en: Emma mentioned that her grandmother had helped families here decades ago.
npcLine.zh: Emma提到，她祖母几十年前曾在这儿帮助过很多家庭。

choices.text: She mentioned that to me too, actually.
choices.zh: 其实她也跟我提过这事。

choices.text: She never mentioned anything like that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语 → She mentioned that to me too, actually.

npcLine.en: Is it okay if I include some of the family history?
npcLine.zh: 我可以把一部分家族历史写进去吗？

choices.text: Some of it, yes — but not all of it.
choices.zh: 可以写一部分——但不是全部。

choices.text: No, none of it should be shared.

n2.hintOnWrong: 有保留地同意 → Some of it, yes — but not all of it.

npcLine.en: I understand. Some things are meant to stay private.
npcLine.zh: 我理解。有些事情本就该保持私密。

choices.text: Some things are better left untold.
choices.zh: 有些事最好还是别说出来。

choices.text: Nothing here should stay private.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → Some things are better left untold.

transition.en: After the reporter leaves, Emma looks thoughtful.
transition.zh: 记者离开后，Emma看起来若有所思。

scenes.title: Careful with Words
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 该说到什么程度

npcLine.en: I wish I'd said less about my grandmother.
npcLine.zh: 我真希望自己少说点关于我祖母的事。

choices.text: I wish I had chosen my words more carefully too.
choices.zh: 我也希望自己当时能更谨慎地选择措辞。

choices.text: I wish you had said even more, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气 → I wish I had chosen my words more carefully too.

npcLine.en: But maybe her story deserves to be told.
npcLine.zh: 但也许她的故事值得被讲出来。

choices.text: It really does deserve to be told.
choices.zh: 确实值得被讲出来。

choices.text: It should probably stay hidden forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → It really does deserve to be told.

npcLine.en: Let's trust the reporter to be careful with it.
npcLine.zh: 我们就相信这位记者会谨慎处理吧。

choices.text: Let's trust her, she seemed thoughtful.
choices.zh: 我们相信她吧，她看起来挺细心的。

choices.text: Let's call and take it all back.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's trust her, she seemed thoughtful.

transition.en: A few days later, the reporter sends a draft to read.
transition.zh: 几天后，记者发来了一份草稿让大家看看。

npcLine.en: She's already sent the draft. Should we read it together?
npcLine.zh: 她已经把草稿发过来了。我们要不要一起读？

choices.text: She's already sent it? Let's read it now.
choices.zh: 她已经发过来了？我们现在就读吧。

choices.text: She hasn't sent anything yet.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → She's already sent it? Let's read it now.

npcLine.en: The title is 'A House That Remembers.'
npcLine.zh: 标题是《一栋会记得的房子》。

choices.text: That title gives me chills, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，这个标题让我起了鸡皮疙瘩。

choices.text: That title doesn't mean anything.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That title gives me chills, honestly.

npcLine.en: If this gets published, more people will know our story.
npcLine.zh: 如果这篇发表了，会有更多人知道我们的故事。

choices.text: If it's published, that's more than okay with me.
choices.zh: 如果发表了，我完全没问题。

choices.text: If it's published, I'll ask her to stop.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If it's published, that's more than okay with me.

scenes.title: Reading the Draft
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 一起读草稿

npcLine.en: She wrote that a decade apart became a lifetime together.
npcLine.zh: 她写道，分开了十年，最终成了一辈子的相守。

choices.text: She wrote exactly what it felt like.
choices.zh: 她写出了那种感觉本身。

choices.text: She wrote something completely wrong.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语呼应 → She wrote exactly what it felt like.

npcLine.en: This part about Lily... it's more moving than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 关于Lily的这部分……比我预期的更感人。

choices.text: More moving than any of us expected, really.
choices.zh: 确实比我们所有人预期的都更感人。

choices.text: Less moving than I hoped, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → More moving than any of us expected, really.

npcLine.en: I think it's ready. What does everyone think?
npcLine.zh: 我觉得可以了。大家觉得呢？

choices.text: I think it's ready too.
choices.zh: 我也觉得可以了。

choices.text: I think it needs a lot more work.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ I think it's ready too.

scenes.title: A Line That Mattered
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 一句戳中人心的话

npcLine.en: One line says, 'They had nothing, and they built everything.'
npcLine.zh: 有一句写着，「他们一无所有，却建起了一切。」

choices.text: We had nothing, and it still felt like enough.
choices.zh: 我们一无所有，但那已经足够了。

choices.text: We had everything back then, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时呼应 → We had nothing, and it still felt like enough.

npcLine.en: That line is going to stay with me for a long time.
npcLine.zh: 这句话会在我心里留很久。

choices.text: It'll stay with all of us, I think.
choices.zh: 我觉得它会留在我们所有人心里。

choices.text: It'll probably be forgotten by tomorrow.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示未来的持续 → It'll stay with all of us, I think.

npcLine.en: Print it. Send it in exactly as it is.
npcLine.zh: 发表吧。就这样原样发出去。

choices.text: Send it exactly as it is, I agree.
choices.zh: 我同意，就这样原样发出去吧。

choices.text: Let's change everything about it first.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ Send it exactly as it is, I agree.

transition.en: Sunday morning, the article appears in print.
transition.zh: 周日早上，这篇报道刊登了出来。

npcLine.en: It's here! Look, we're on the front page.
npcLine.zh: 登出来啦！你看，我们上头版了。

choices.text: The front page? I can't believe it.
choices.zh: 头版？我简直不敢相信。

choices.text: The front page doesn't matter much.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单感叹（陈述句）→ The front page? I can't believe it.

npcLine.en: My phone hasn't stopped ringing all morning.
npcLine.zh: 我的手机一上午都没停过。

choices.text: Mine hasn't stopped either.
choices.zh: 我的也没停过。

choices.text: Mine has been completely silent.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → Mine hasn't stopped either.

npcLine.en: People are asking how they can help.
npcLine.zh: 有人在问怎么才能帮上忙。

choices.text: People are reaching out from everywhere.
choices.zh: 各地的人都在联系我们。

choices.text: Nobody is really asking anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → People are reaching out from everywhere.

npcLine.en: A local business offered to donate desks and chairs.
npcLine.zh: 一家本地商户提出想捐些桌椅。

choices.text: That offer means more than they know.
choices.zh: 这份心意比他们想的还要珍贵。

choices.text: That offer doesn't help us at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That offer means more than they know.

npcLine.en: Someone said they'd never thought about newcomers this way before.
npcLine.zh: 有人说，他们以前从没这样想过新移民的处境。

choices.text: They said that? That's exactly the point.
choices.zh: 他们这么说？这正是关键所在。

choices.text: They said that, but it doesn't matter.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语回应 → They said that? That's exactly the point.

npcLine.en: This is bigger than any of us imagined.
npcLine.zh: 这比我们所有人想象的都要大得多。

choices.text: Bigger than we ever imagined, truly.
choices.zh: 确实比我们想的要大得多。

choices.text: Smaller than I expected, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → Bigger than we ever imagined, truly.

npcLine.en: A month ago, this was just an idea over dinner.
npcLine.zh: 一个月前，这还只是饭桌上的一个想法。

choices.text: And now it's changing lives already.
choices.zh: 而现在它已经在改变生活了。

choices.text: And now it's still just an idea.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单陈述（陈述句）→ And now it's changing lives already.

npcLine.en: I wish Lily could see what her one small shop became.
npcLine.zh: 我真希望Lily能看到她当年那家小店变成了什么样子。

choices.text: I wish she could see it too, more than anything.
choices.zh: 我也非常希望她能看到这一切。

choices.text: I wish she had never opened it at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气 → I wish she could see it too, more than anything.

npcLine.en: Maybe, in a way, she already has.
npcLine.zh: 或许，从某种意义上说，她已经看到了。

choices.text: In a way, she really has, hasn't she?
choices.zh: 从某种意义上，她确实已经看到了，对吧？

choices.text: In no way has she seen any of it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → In a way, she really has, hasn't she?

transition.en: Two months in, Emma looks over the numbers with a worried face.
transition.zh: 两个月过去，Emma皱着眉看着账目。

scenes.title: The Funding Gap
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 发现资金缺口

npcLine.en: The heating bill was higher than we budgeted for.
npcLine.zh: 取暖费比我们预算的要高。

choices.text: Higher than we planned — how much higher?
choices.zh: 比计划的高——高多少？

choices.text: Higher than we planned doesn't matter.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用比较级追问 → Higher than we planned — how much higher?

npcLine.en: By next month, we'll have spent more than we brought in.
npcLine.zh: 到下个月，我们花的会比筹到的还多。

choices.text: We hadn't planned for this at all, had we?
choices.zh: 我们完全没料到这一点，是吧？

choices.text: We had planned for exactly this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时 → We hadn't planned for this at all, had we?

npcLine.en: I didn't want to worry anyone, but we need to talk about it.
npcLine.zh: 我不想让大家担心，但我们得谈谈这件事。

choices.text: It's better that we talk about it now.
choices.zh: 现在谈这个反而更好。

choices.text: It's better if we ignore it for now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ It's better that we talk about it now.

transition.en: That evening, everyone meets to face the problem together.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，大家聚在一起面对这个问题。

scenes.title: Hard Conversations
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 难以启齿的话题

npcLine.en: How bad is it, really?
npcLine.zh: 情况到底有多糟？

choices.text: How much time do we actually have?
choices.zh: 我们实际上还有多少时间？

choices.text: How is that even possible?

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问细节 → How much time do we actually have?

npcLine.en: If nothing changes, we'll have to close by spring.
npcLine.zh: 如果情况不改变，我们春天前就得关门了。

choices.text: If that's true, we'd better act now.
choices.zh: 如果是真的，那我们最好现在就行动。

choices.text: If that's true, there's nothing to do.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If that's true, we'd better act now.

npcLine.en: We didn't come this far to give up now.
npcLine.zh: 我们不是走了这么远才要现在放弃的。

choices.text: We definitely didn't come this far for nothing.
choices.zh: 我们肯定不是白走了这么远的路。

choices.text: Maybe it's time to give up, though.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去时坚定表态 → We definitely didn't come this far for nothing.

scenes.title: Although We Struggle
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 尽管困难重重

npcLine.en: Although we're short on money, we're not short on people who care.
npcLine.zh: 尽管我们缺钱，但我们不缺关心这件事的人。

choices.text: Although money is tight, that matters more.
choices.zh: 尽管手头紧张，但这一点更重要。

choices.text: Although money is tight, nothing else matters.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although money is tight, that matters more.

npcLine.en: Despite everything, this place has already changed lives.
npcLine.zh: 尽管有这么多困难，这个地方已经改变了很多人的生活。

choices.text: Despite the money trouble, that's still true.
choices.zh: 尽管有资金问题，这一点依然成立。

choices.text: Despite the money trouble, none of that matters.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Despite the money trouble, that's still true.

npcLine.en: So, what do we do about it?
npcLine.zh: 那，我们该怎么办呢？

choices.text: What can we actually try first?
choices.zh: 我们实际上可以先试试什么呢？

choices.text: What we do doesn't matter now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 追问下一步 → What can we actually try first?

npcLine.en: What if we asked the newspaper's readers directly?
npcLine.zh: 要是我们直接向报纸的读者求助呢？

choices.text: If we asked them, some would surely help.
choices.zh: 如果我们求助，肯定会有人愿意帮忙。

choices.text: If we asked them, nobody would care.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If we asked them, some would surely help.

npcLine.en: Or we could throw a fundraiser, right here at the house.
npcLine.zh: 或者我们可以在这栋房子里办一场募捐活动。

choices.text: We could, and I think we should.
choices.zh: 我们可以，而且我觉得应该这么做。

choices.text: We couldn't organize that in time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can/could 回应 → We could, and I think we should.

npcLine.en: Let's do both — the article and the event.
npcLine.zh: 我们两个都做——报道和活动都要。

choices.text: Let's do both, why choose just one?
choices.zh: 两个都做吧，何必只选一个呢？

choices.text: Let's just pick the easier one.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's do both, why choose just one?

transition.en: Word gets out, and the response is immediate.
transition.zh: 消息传开了，回应来得很快。

npcLine.en: Someone dropped off an envelope. It just says 'For Lily's House.'
npcLine.zh: 有人送来了一个信封。上面只写着「给Lily之家」。

choices.text: Whoever left that, they believed in us.
choices.zh: 不管是谁留下的，他们都相信我们。

choices.text: Whoever left that probably made a mistake.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Whoever left that, they believed in us.

npcLine.en: One of your old students said she'd never forget what this place gave her.
npcLine.zh: 你以前的一位学员说，她永远不会忘记这个地方给她的一切。

choices.text: She said that? That means everything.
choices.zh: 她这么说？这对我们意义重大。

choices.text: She said that, but it changes nothing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语回应 → She said that? That means everything.

npcLine.en: It's not enough to fix everything, but it's a real start.
npcLine.zh: 这还不够解决所有问题，但已经是个真正的开始了。

choices.text: Although it's not enough, it's a real start.
choices.zh: 尽管还不够，但这是个真正的开始。

choices.text: Although it's not enough, it means nothing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although it's not enough, it's a real start.

scenes.title: Planning the Fundraiser
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 筹划募捐活动

npcLine.en: We should have music, food, and stories from the students.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该有音乐、食物，还有学员们的故事分享。

choices.text: Stories from the students would move everyone.
choices.zh: 学员们的故事一定会打动所有人。

choices.text: Stories from the students seem unnecessary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ Stories from the students would move everyone.

npcLine.en: Can you design a poster for it?
npcLine.zh: 你能设计一张海报吗？

choices.text: Sure, I can have one ready by tomorrow.
choices.zh: 没问题，我明天就能弄好一张。

choices.text: I can't design anything, sorry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Sure, I can have one ready by tomorrow.

npcLine.en: By the time the night comes, everything needs to be ready.
npcLine.zh: 到活动那晚，一切都得准备就绪。

choices.text: By then, we'll have finished everything.
choices.zh: 到那时，我们会把一切都准备好的。

choices.text: By then, nothing will be finished.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时/将来完成时表达 → By then, we'll have finished everything.

scenes.title: Getting Everything Ready
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 紧锣密鼓地准备

npcLine.en: Can you set up the chairs in a big circle?
npcLine.zh: 你能把椅子摆成一个大圈吗？

choices.text: Sure, a big circle it is.
choices.zh: 没问题，就摆成大圈。

choices.text: I can't move that many chairs alone.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Sure, a big circle it is.

npcLine.en: The students have already made signs for the door.
npcLine.zh: 学员们已经做好了门口的标牌。

choices.text: They've already made signs? That's so sweet.
choices.zh: 他们已经做好标牌了？真是太贴心了。

choices.text: They haven't made anything at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → They've already made signs? That's so sweet.

npcLine.en: Everyone's pitching in without being asked.
npcLine.zh: 大家都不用问就主动来帮忙了。

choices.text: Nobody needs to be asked twice, it seems.
choices.zh: 看来根本不用问第二遍。

choices.text: Everyone needs to be asked repeatedly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → Nobody needs to be asked twice, it seems.

transition.en: Saturday night, Lily's House fills with music and voices.
transition.zh: 周六晚上，Lily之家充满了音乐和人声。

npcLine.en: I've never seen this many people in one room.
npcLine.zh: 我从没见过这么多人挤在一间屋子里。

choices.text: I haven't either, and I love it.
choices.zh: 我也没见过，我很喜欢这样。

choices.text: I've seen way more than this, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I haven't either, and I love it.

npcLine.en: One student is about to tell her story to everyone.
npcLine.zh: 有一位学员马上就要向大家讲述她的故事了。

choices.text: She's about to speak — let's listen closely.
choices.zh: 她要开始讲了——我们仔细听吧。

choices.text: She's not ready to speak at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → She's about to speak — let's listen closely.

npcLine.en: By the end of the night, we'd raised more than double our goal.
npcLine.zh: 到当晚结束时，我们已经筹到了超过目标两倍的钱。

choices.text: We'd raised double? I can hardly believe it.
choices.zh: 已经筹到两倍了？我简直不敢相信。

choices.text: We'd raised nothing at all, sadly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去完成时 → We'd raised double? I can hardly believe it.

npcLine.en: Despite how scared we were a week ago, look at us now.
npcLine.zh: 尽管一周前我们那么害怕，你看看我们现在。

choices.text: Despite the fear, we made it through.
choices.zh: 尽管害怕，我们还是挺过来了。

choices.text: Despite the fear, nothing has changed.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Despite the fear, we made it through.

npcLine.en: However hard it gets, this community shows up.
npcLine.zh: 无论有多难，这个社区都会挺身而出。

choices.text: However hard, we're never really alone.
choices.zh: 无论多难，我们其实从不孤单。

choices.text: However hard, we're always on our own.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → However hard, we're never really alone.

npcLine.en: I think we're going to be okay.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得我们会没事的。

choices.text: We're going to be more than okay.
choices.zh: 我们会不只是没事，会很好。

choices.text: We're going to close soon, probably.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will/going to 表示预测 → We're going to be more than okay.

transition.en: The next morning, the numbers finally make sense again.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，账目终于又能对得上了。

scenes.title: We Made It
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 危机过去了

npcLine.en: We're not just surviving anymore. We're actually growing.
npcLine.zh: 我们不再只是勉强维持了。我们真的在成长。

choices.text: We're growing, and it feels incredible.
choices.zh: 我们在成长，这感觉太棒了。

choices.text: We're barely surviving, still.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → We're growing, and it feels incredible.

npcLine.en: I wish I hadn't been so scared to ask for help.
npcLine.zh: 我真希望自己当初没那么害怕开口求助。

choices.text: I wish I hadn't waited so long either.
choices.zh: 我也希望自己没等那么久。

choices.text: I wish we had never asked at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气 → I wish I hadn't waited so long either.

npcLine.en: Although the hard part isn't over, I feel ready for it now.
npcLine.zh: 尽管困难的部分还没过去，但我现在觉得自己已经准备好了。

choices.text: Although it's not over, we're ready together.
choices.zh: 尽管还没结束，但我们已经准备好一起面对了。

choices.text: Although it's not over, I'd rather quit now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although it's not over, we're ready together.

transition.en: A woman in a city hall badge knocks on the door.
transition.zh: 一位戴着市政厅工作证的女士敲了敲门。

npcLine.en: Hi, I read the article. I work with the city's community programs.
npcLine.zh: 你好，我看了那篇报道。我在市政府的社区项目部门工作。

choices.text: Oh, welcome! What brings you here?
choices.zh: 哦，欢迎！是什么风把您吹来了？

choices.text: We're not interested, sorry.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌欢迎（陈述句）→ Oh, welcome! What brings you here?

npcLine.en: The city has a small grant program for places exactly like this.
npcLine.zh: 市政府有一个小额补助项目，正适合这样的地方。

choices.text: A grant program? Tell me more.
choices.zh: 补助项目？跟我多说说。

choices.text: We don't need any grants.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ A grant program? Tell me more.

npcLine.en: Would you be open to hearing about it?
npcLine.zh: 您愿意听我讲讲吗？

choices.text: If you have time, we'd love to hear it.
choices.zh: 如果您有时间，我们很乐意听听。

choices.text: If you have time, we'd rather not.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If you have time, we'd love to hear it.

scenes.title: If the City Helped
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 假设性的讨论

npcLine.en: If you had this funding, what would you do with it?
npcLine.zh: 如果你们拿到这笔资助，会用来做什么？

choices.text: If we had it, we'd hire a second teacher.
choices.zh: 如果拿到了，我们会再请一位老师。

choices.text: If we had it, we wouldn't change anything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句（second conditional）→ If we had it, we'd hire a second teacher.

npcLine.en: If the space were bigger, could you help more families?
npcLine.zh: 如果这个地方更大一些，你们能帮到更多家庭吗？

choices.text: If it were bigger, we could help twice as many.
choices.zh: 如果更大一点，我们能帮到两倍的人。

choices.text: If it were bigger, it wouldn't matter much.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If it were bigger, we could help twice as many.

npcLine.en: That's exactly the kind of thinking this grant is for.
npcLine.zh: 这正是这笔补助想要支持的想法。

choices.text: That's good to hear, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，听到这个我很高兴。

choices.text: That doesn't really convince me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That's good to hear, honestly.

transition.en: After the visitor leaves, the room grows quiet.
transition.zh: 客人离开后，屋子里安静了下来。

npcLine.en: I wonder what strings would be attached to city money.
npcLine.zh: 我在想市政府的钱会不会附带什么条件。

choices.text: That's a fair thing to wonder about.
choices.zh: 这确实是个值得担心的问题。

choices.text: That's not worth thinking about at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That's a fair thing to wonder about.

npcLine.en: If we took the money, would we still feel like it's ours?
npcLine.zh: 如果我们拿了这笔钱，这地方还会像是属于我们的吗？

choices.text: If we took it carefully, I think it still would.
choices.zh: 如果我们谨慎处理，我想它依然会是。

choices.text: If we took it, it wouldn't be ours anymore.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If we took it carefully, I think it still would.

npcLine.en: Although I'm not sure yet, I'm at least willing to talk about it.
npcLine.zh: 尽管我还没想清楚，但我至少愿意谈谈这件事。

choices.text: Although you're unsure, that's a fair place to start.
choices.zh: 尽管你还不确定，但这是个不错的开始。

choices.text: Although you're unsure, let's just say no.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although you're unsure, that's a fair place to start.

npcLine.en: Let's lay out everything the grant would require of us.
npcLine.zh: 我们把这笔补助会要求我们做的事都列出来吧。

choices.text: Let's lay it all out, no surprises.
choices.zh: 我们把一切都列清楚，别留惊喜。

choices.text: Let's just sign it without reading.

n1.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's lay it all out, no surprises.

npcLine.en: We'd need to report our numbers every three months.
npcLine.zh: 我们得每三个月上报一次数据。

choices.text: We'll manage that, it's not too much.
choices.zh: 这个我们能应付，不算太多。

choices.text: We'll never manage something like that.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示能应对 → We'll manage that, it's not too much.

npcLine.en: In exchange, we'd get funding that's been guaranteed for three years.
npcLine.zh: 作为交换，我们会得到一笔保证发放三年的资助。

choices.text: Three years guaranteed sounds worth it.
choices.zh: 保证三年，这听起来很值得。

choices.text: Three years guaranteed sounds too risky.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Three years guaranteed sounds worth it.

scenes.title: Imagining More
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 想象更大的可能

npcLine.en: If we expanded, we could open a second location someday.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们扩张，或许有一天能开第二个地点。

choices.text: If we expanded, that would be incredible.
choices.zh: 如果真扩张了，那会太棒了。

choices.text: If we expanded, it would ruin everything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If we expanded, that would be incredible.

npcLine.en: But if we grew too fast, we might lose what makes this place special.
npcLine.zh: 但如果我们扩张得太快，可能会失去这地方特别的地方。

choices.text: If we grew too fast, we'd have to be careful.
choices.zh: 如果扩张太快，我们就得格外小心。

choices.text: If we grew too fast, nobody would notice.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If we grew too fast, we'd have to be careful.

npcLine.en: Slow and steady. That's always been the plan.
npcLine.zh: 慢慢来，稳稳走。这一直都是我们的计划。

choices.text: It's always been the right plan, too.
choices.zh: 而且这一直都是正确的计划。

choices.text: It's never really been much of a plan.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → It's always been the right plan, too.

npcLine.en: Part of me wishes things could just stay small and simple.
npcLine.zh: 我心里有一部分希望一切能保持小而简单。

choices.text: I wish that too, some days.
choices.zh: 有些日子我也希望这样。

choices.text: I never wish for that, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气 → I wish that too, some days.

npcLine.en: But more families need help than this one small house can give.
npcLine.zh: 但需要帮助的家庭，比这一栋小房子能给的要多得多。

choices.text: More than we can give alone, that's true.
choices.zh: 确实比我们单独能给的要多。

choices.text: Fewer than you think, probably.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → More than we can give alone, that's true.

npcLine.en: Maybe growing up doesn't mean losing what we started with.
npcLine.zh: 也许成长并不意味着失去我们最初拥有的东西。

choices.text: Maybe growing up means carrying it further.
choices.zh: 也许成长意味着把它带得更远。

choices.text: Maybe growing up always means losing something.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Maybe growing up means carrying it further.

npcLine.en: As a student here, I think the grant sounds like a good thing.
npcLine.zh: 作为这里的一位学员，我觉得这笔补助听起来是件好事。

choices.text: Your opinion matters a lot here.
choices.zh: 你的意见在这儿很重要。

choices.text: Your opinion doesn't really count here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Your opinion matters a lot here.

npcLine.en: If it helps even one more family like mine, it's worth it.
npcLine.zh: 如果它能多帮到一个像我这样的家庭，就值得了。

choices.text: If it helps just one more, that's enough reason.
choices.zh: 如果能多帮一个人，理由就够了。

choices.text: If it helps one more, it's still not worth it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If it helps just one more, that's enough reason.

npcLine.en: Sam, as our newest teacher, what do you think?
npcLine.zh: Sam，作为我们最新的老师，你怎么想？

choices.text: What I think is, let's take the risk together.
choices.zh: 我的想法是，我们一起冒这个险吧。

choices.text: What I think doesn't really matter here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ What I think is, let's take the risk together.

npcLine.en: It sounds like we're all leaning the same way.
npcLine.zh: 听起来我们的想法都差不多。

choices.text: We're all leaning toward yes, I think.
choices.zh: 我觉得我们都倾向于同意。

choices.text: We're all leaning toward no, clearly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → We're all leaning toward yes, I think.

npcLine.en: If we accept it, we do it together, with our eyes open.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们接受，就要一起做，而且要清楚地知道自己在做什么。

choices.text: If we accept it, we go in together.
choices.zh: 如果接受，我们就一起进去。

choices.text: If we accept it, that's someone else's job.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If we accept it, we go in together.

npcLine.en: Then it's decided. Let's call her back tomorrow.
npcLine.zh: 那就这么定了。我们明天回电话给她。

choices.text: Let's call her first thing tomorrow.
choices.zh: 我们明天一早就打给她。

choices.text: Let's wait another month to decide.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's call her first thing tomorrow.

transition.en: A week later, the paperwork is signed.
transition.zh: 一周后，文件签好了。

npcLine.en: Congratulations. The city is proud to support this place.
npcLine.zh: 恭喜。市政府很自豪能支持这个地方。

choices.text: Thank you, we won't let it go to waste.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们不会辜负这份支持的。

choices.text: Thank you, we probably won't use it well.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应（陈述句）→ Thank you, we won't let it go to waste.

npcLine.en: If you ever need anything else, my door is open.
npcLine.zh: 如果你们以后还需要什么，我随时欢迎。

choices.text: If we need anything, we'll be sure to ask.
choices.zh: 如果需要什么，我们一定会去问的。

choices.text: If we need anything, we'll figure it out alone.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If we need anything, we'll be sure to ask.

npcLine.en: This is bigger than a grant. This is a real partnership.
npcLine.zh: 这不只是一笔补助。这是一次真正的合作。

choices.text: A real partnership means more than money.
choices.zh: 真正的合作意味着比金钱更多的东西。

choices.text: A grant is really all it is, though.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → A real partnership means more than money.

scenes.title: Reflection on Growth
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 关于成长的感想

npcLine.en: A year ago, I would never have imagined any of this.
npcLine.zh: 一年前，我根本无法想象会有今天这一切。

choices.text: If you'd told me, I wouldn't have believed it either.
choices.zh: 就算你当时告诉我，我也不会相信的。

choices.text: If you'd told me, I would have believed it instantly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If you'd told me, I wouldn't have believed it either.

npcLine.en: Growth is scary. But it's also kind of beautiful.
npcLine.zh: 成长很吓人。但也有它美好的一面。

choices.text: Although it's scary, it's beautiful too.
choices.zh: 尽管吓人，但也很美好。

choices.text: Although it's scary, that's all it is.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although it's scary, it's beautiful too.

npcLine.en: Here's to whatever comes next.
npcLine.zh: 敬接下来的一切。

choices.text: To whatever comes next, together.
choices.zh: 敬接下来的一切，我们一起面对。

choices.text: To whatever comes next, I guess.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ To whatever comes next, together.

transition.en: With the grant secured, talk turns to expansion.
transition.zh: 拿到资助后，话题转向了扩张。

scenes.title: Scouting a Second Spot
scenes.subtitle: 东区 · 物色第二个地点

npcLine.en: There's a landlord who rents out old shops near the east side.
npcLine.zh: 东区那边有个房东，专门出租一些老店面。

choices.text: A landlord who rents old shops sounds promising.
choices.zh: 一个专租老店面的房东听起来挺有希望的。

choices.text: A landlord who rents old shops sounds risky.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → A landlord who rents old shops sounds promising.

npcLine.en: The east side is a neighborhood that really needs this.
npcLine.zh: 东区正是一个真正需要这种地方的街区。

choices.text: A neighborhood that needs it is exactly where we belong.
choices.zh: 一个需要它的街区，正是我们该去的地方。

choices.text: A neighborhood that needs it isn't our concern.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → A neighborhood that needs it is exactly where we belong.

npcLine.en: Should we go take a look this weekend?
npcLine.zh: 我们这周末要不要去看看？

choices.text: Let's go take a look together.
choices.zh: 我们一起去看看吧。

choices.text: Let's not bother looking yet.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's go take a look together.

npcLine.en: You're the ones who called about the old bakery space?
npcLine.zh: 你们就是打电话问那间旧面包店铺面的人？

choices.text: Yes, we're the ones who called yesterday.
choices.zh: 是的，我们就是昨天打电话的人。

choices.text: No, that must be someone else.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → Yes, we're the ones who called yesterday.

npcLine.en: It's small, but the light in here is beautiful.
npcLine.zh: 地方不大，但这儿的采光很漂亮。

choices.text: The light really is beautiful, isn't it?
choices.zh: 光线确实很漂亮，对吧？

choices.text: The light doesn't matter much to us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ The light really is beautiful, isn't it?

npcLine.en: Can I ask what you'd use this space for?
npcLine.zh: 我能问问你们打算怎么用这块地方吗？

choices.text: Of course, I can explain it all.
choices.zh: 当然可以，我可以都跟您说说。

choices.text: I can't really say right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Of course, I can explain it all.

scenes.title: Explaining the Vision
scenes.subtitle: 东区 · 说明这里的用途

npcLine.en: So it's a place where people learn English for free?
npcLine.zh: 所以这是一个人们可以免费学英语的地方？

choices.text: Yes, a place where anyone is welcome.
choices.zh: 对，一个任何人都受欢迎的地方。

choices.text: No, a place where nobody is welcome.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → Yes, a place where anyone is welcome.

npcLine.en: My own parents were immigrants. This would have meant a lot to them.
npcLine.zh: 我父母当年也是移民。这样的地方对他们来说会意义重大。

choices.text: If they were here now, they'd understand completely.
choices.zh: 如果他们现在在这儿，一定会完全理解的。

choices.text: If they were here now, they wouldn't care at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If they were here now, they'd understand completely.

npcLine.en: I'll give you a fair price. Consider it done.
npcLine.zh: 我给你们一个公道的价格。就这么定了。

choices.text: Thank you, we'll take great care of it.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们会好好爱护这里的。

choices.text: Thank you, we'll probably neglect it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示承诺 → Thank you, we'll take great care of it.

transition.en: You rush back to share the news.
transition.zh: 你急忙赶回去分享这个消息。

npcLine.en: We found a place? Already?
npcLine.zh: 找到地方了？这么快？

choices.text: We've already found the perfect place.
choices.zh: 我们已经找到了一个完美的地方。

choices.text: We haven't found anything at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → We've already found the perfect place.

npcLine.en: Who's going to run the second location day to day?
npcLine.zh: 第二个地点日常谁来管呢？

choices.text: Who wants to take that on?
choices.zh: 谁愿意接下这个任务？

choices.text: Who cares who runs it?

n2.hintOnWrong: 追问细节 → Who wants to take that on?

npcLine.en: I'd like to try, if everyone trusts me with it.
npcLine.zh: 如果大家信得过我，我想试试。

choices.text: If you're willing, we trust you completely.
choices.zh: 如果你愿意，我们完全信任你。

choices.text: If you're willing, we'll think about it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If you're willing, we trust you completely.

npcLine.en: A year ago, I was the guy who never spoke up in class.
npcLine.zh: 一年前，我还是那个课堂上从不主动发言的人。

choices.text: The guy who never spoke up is long gone now.
choices.zh: 那个从不发言的人早就不在了。

choices.text: The guy who never spoke up is still here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → The guy who never spoke up is long gone now.

npcLine.en: Now I'm the one who's running a whole location.
npcLine.zh: 现在我是负责整个分点的人了。

choices.text: You're the one who's earned this, truly.
choices.zh: 你才是真正配得上这一切的人。

choices.text: You're the one who's rushing into this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → You're the one who's earned this, truly.

npcLine.en: I won't let you all down. I promise.
npcLine.zh: 我不会让大家失望的。我保证。

choices.text: You won't. We already believe in you.
choices.zh: 你不会的。我们已经相信你了。

choices.text: You probably will, but that's okay.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示信心 → You won't. We already believe in you.

transition.en: The next weeks are full of paint, sawdust, and laughter.
transition.zh: 接下来几周充满了油漆味、木屑和笑声。

npcLine.en: This is the wall where we should hang the welcome sign.
npcLine.zh: 这面墙就是该挂欢迎标牌的地方。

choices.text: This is the wall where everyone will see it first.
choices.zh: 这面墙是大家会第一眼看到的地方。

choices.text: This is the wall where nobody will look.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → This is the wall where everyone will see it first.

npcLine.en: Can you help me carry this bookshelf inside?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我把这个书架搬进去吗？

choices.text: Sure, let's carry it in together.
choices.zh: 没问题，我们一起搬进去吧。

choices.text: I can't lift anything heavy today.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Sure, let's carry it in together.

npcLine.en: It's starting to look like somewhere people would want to be.
npcLine.zh: 它开始看起来像是个人们会想来的地方了。

choices.text: If I were new here, I'd want to be here too.
choices.zh: 如果我是新来的，我也会想来这儿。

choices.text: If I were new here, I'd rather stay away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If I were new here, I'd want to be here too.

npcLine.en: Is this the place that was in the newspaper?
npcLine.zh: 这是不是报纸上写的那个地方？

choices.text: Yes, this is the place that was in the paper.
choices.zh: 对，这就是报纸上写的那个地方。

choices.text: No, you're thinking of somewhere else.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → Yes, this is the place that was in the paper.

npcLine.en: My neighbor is the woman who told me about it.
npcLine.zh: 我邻居就是跟我说起这地方的那个人。

choices.text: Whoever told you, please thank them for us.
choices.zh: 不管是谁告诉你的，请替我们谢谢她。

choices.text: Whoever told you was probably mistaken.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句回应 → Whoever told you, please thank them for us.

npcLine.en: When does the first class start here?
npcLine.zh: 这儿的第一堂课什么时候开始？

choices.text: It starts this Saturday morning.
choices.zh: 这周六早上就开始。

choices.text: It doesn't have a start date yet.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回答（陈述句）→ It starts this Saturday morning.

scenes.title: Two Houses, One Story
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 两个地点，一个故事

npcLine.en: It's strange to think we're in two places at once now.
npcLine.zh: 想到我们现在同时在两个地方，感觉挺奇妙的。

choices.text: Strange, but wonderful too.
choices.zh: 奇妙，但也很美好。

choices.text: Strange, and honestly a bit much.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Strange, but wonderful too.

npcLine.en: Although they're different buildings, they feel like the same home.
npcLine.zh: 尽管是不同的建筑，但感觉像是同一个家。

choices.text: Although they're apart, the spirit is the same.
choices.zh: 尽管相隔两地，但精神是一样的。

choices.text: Although they're apart, nothing connects them.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although they're apart, the spirit is the same.

npcLine.en: Two houses, one story. I like the sound of that.
npcLine.zh: 两栋房子，一个故事。我喜欢这个说法。

choices.text: One story that keeps growing.
choices.zh: 一个不断成长的故事。

choices.text: One story that's already finished.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ One story that keeps growing.

npcLine.en: We wrote you a letter, for your first day running things alone.
npcLine.zh: 我们给你写了封信，庆祝你第一天独自挑大梁。

choices.text: You wrote me a letter? I'm speechless.
choices.zh: 你们给我写了信？我都说不出话了。

choices.text: You wrote me a letter, and I lost it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → You wrote me a letter? I'm speechless.

npcLine.en: It's from all of us who've watched you grow.
npcLine.zh: 这是所有看着你成长的人写给你的。

choices.text: All of us who watched you are so proud.
choices.zh: 所有看着你成长的人都为你骄傲。

choices.text: All of us who watched you feel nothing special.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → All of us who watched you are so proud.

npcLine.en: Keep it somewhere close. Ten Letters started with just one.
npcLine.zh: 把它放在身边吧。「十封信」当年也是从一封开始的。

choices.text: This one will always be close to me.
choices.zh: 这一封会一直被我珍藏在身边。

choices.text: This one probably won't matter much later.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ This one will always be close to me.

transition.en: On opening day, the little bakery-turned-classroom fills up fast.
transition.zh: 开放当天，这间由面包店改造的教室很快就坐满了。

npcLine.en: Welcome, everyone. My name is Sam, and I'll be your teacher.
npcLine.zh: 欢迎大家。我叫Sam，我会是大家的老师。

choices.text: We're so glad you'll be teaching us.
choices.zh: 我们很高兴能由你来教我们。

choices.text: We didn't know who'd be teaching us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 will 回应 → We're so glad you'll be teaching us.

npcLine.en: This building is one that has seen a lot of new beginnings.
npcLine.zh: 这栋楼见证过很多新的开始。

choices.text: A building that's seen beginnings deserves one more.
choices.zh: 一栋见证过开始的楼，值得再多迎来一个。

choices.text: A building that's seen beginnings means nothing special.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → A building that's seen beginnings deserves one more.

npcLine.en: Let's begin, everyone. Hello, how are you?
npcLine.zh: 我们开始吧，各位。你好，你好吗？

choices.text: Let's begin — hello, how are you?
choices.zh: 我们开始吧——你好，你好吗？

choices.text: Let's wait a little longer to start.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's begin — hello, how are you?

transition.en: A woman with a camera bag introduces herself at the door.
transition.zh: 一位背着相机包的女士在门口自我介绍。

scenes.title: A Filmmaker Visits
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 纪录片导演来访

npcLine.en: I came across your story in the newspaper. It stuck with me.
npcLine.zh: 我在报纸上偶然读到了你们的故事。一直记在心里。

choices.text: I'm glad you came across it.
choices.zh: 很高兴你偶然读到了它。

choices.text: I'm sorry you came across it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（come across）→ I'm glad you came across it.

npcLine.en: I'd like to look into making a short documentary.
npcLine.zh: 我想调查一下，拍一部短纪录片。

choices.text: We'd love for you to look into it.
choices.zh: 我们很乐意让您调查一下。

choices.text: Please don't look into anything here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（look into）→ We'd love for you to look into it.

npcLine.en: Would everyone be comfortable being filmed?
npcLine.zh: 大家愿意被拍摄吗？

choices.text: If they agree, I'm comfortable with it.
choices.zh: 如果他们同意，我没问题。

choices.text: If they agree, I'll still say no.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If they agree, I'm comfortable with it.

scenes.title: Asking Around
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 征求大家的意见

npcLine.en: Should we bring this up at the next class?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要在下堂课上提一下这事？

choices.text: Let's bring it up gently, no pressure.
choices.zh: 我们委婉地提一下吧，不给压力。

choices.text: Let's bring it up and demand answers.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（bring up）→ Let's bring it up gently, no pressure.

npcLine.en: Some people who've dealt with hard pasts might not want cameras.
npcLine.zh: 有些经历过艰难过去的人可能不想面对镜头。

choices.text: People who feel that way should be respected.
choices.zh: 有这种感受的人应该被尊重。

choices.text: People who feel that way should just film anyway.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → People who feel that way should be respected.

npcLine.en: Nobody should feel pressured to take part.
npcLine.zh: 谁都不该被逼着参与。

choices.text: Nobody should be pressured, agreed.
choices.zh: 谁都不该被逼，同意。

choices.text: Everyone should be pressured a little.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → Nobody should be pressured, agreed.

scenes.title: Volunteering a Story
scenes.subtitle: Lily之家 · 有人主动愿意讲述

npcLine.en: I'd like to be part of it, actually. I want people to know.
npcLine.zh: 其实我想参与。我希望大家能知道。

choices.text: We'd be honored to include your story.
choices.zh: 能收录你的故事，我们感到很荣幸。

choices.text: We'd rather not include your story.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ We'd be honored to include your story.

npcLine.en: It took me years to figure out how to talk about it.
npcLine.zh: 我花了好几年才想明白该怎么讲这件事。

choices.text: You've figured it out beautifully now.
choices.zh: 你现在已经想得很清楚了。

choices.text: You still haven't figured anything out.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（figure out）→ You've figured it out beautifully now.

npcLine.en: If it helps even one person, it's worth telling.
npcLine.zh: 如果能帮到哪怕一个人，讲出来就值得。

choices.text: If it helps one, it's already worth it.
choices.zh: 如果能帮到一个人，就已经值得了。

choices.text: If it helps one, that's still not enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If it helps one, it's already worth it.

transition.en: The following week, cameras arrive at Lily's House.
transition.zh: 第二周，摄影机来到了Lily之家。

npcLine.en: Just carry on like we're not here. Act natural.
npcLine.zh: 就当我们不存在，照常进行就好。放自然点。

choices.text: We'll try to carry on as usual.
choices.zh: 我们会尽量照常进行的。

choices.text: We'll try to stop everything instead.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（carry on）→ We'll try to carry on as usual.

npcLine.en: This is the room where the first class happened.
npcLine.zh: 这就是第一堂课发生的那间屋子。

choices.text: The room where it all began, still standing.
choices.zh: 一切开始的那间屋子，依然屹立在这儿。

choices.text: The room where it all began, torn down now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → The room where it all began, still standing.

npcLine.en: Everyone's a little nervous, but it's going well so far.
npcLine.zh: 大家都有点紧张，但目前进展还不错。

choices.text: Nervous, but going well — I'll take that.
choices.zh: 紧张归紧张，但进展不错——我能接受。

choices.text: Nervous, and going terribly, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Nervous, but going well — I'll take that.

npcLine.en: Can you tell us about the house in the old photo?
npcLine.zh: 您能跟我们说说那张老照片里的房子吗？

choices.text: Of course, I can tell you everything.
choices.zh: 当然，我可以把一切都告诉你们。

choices.text: I can't talk about that on camera.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Of course, I can tell you everything.

npcLine.en: That photo was taken the year we arrived here.
npcLine.zh: 那张照片是我们刚到这儿那年拍的。

choices.text: It was taken at the very beginning, then.
choices.zh: 那就是最初拍下的了。

choices.text: It was taken much more recently, actually.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → It was taken at the very beginning, then.

npcLine.en: If I'd known then what I know now, I'd have worried less.
npcLine.zh: 如果当年就知道现在知道的这些，我会少担心很多。

choices.text: If I were you back then, I'd have felt the same.
choices.zh: 如果当年我是您，我也会有一样的感受。

choices.text: If I were you back then, I'd feel nothing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If I were you back then, I'd have felt the same.

npcLine.en: What was it like to learn your grandmother's story?
npcLine.zh: 了解到你祖母的故事时，是什么感觉？

choices.text: What was it like? Overwhelming, honestly.
choices.zh: 什么感觉？说实话，是一种难以承受的震撼。

choices.text: What was it like? I didn't feel anything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回答（陈述句）→ What was it like? Overwhelming, honestly.

npcLine.en: I've had to sit with a lot of feelings I didn't expect.
npcLine.zh: 我不得不去消化很多没预料到的情绪。

choices.text: You've handled it with so much grace.
choices.zh: 你处理得非常从容优雅。

choices.text: You've barely dealt with any of it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → You've handled it with so much grace.

npcLine.en: I look forward to whoever finds this film someday.
npcLine.zh: 我很期待将来某一天有人看到这部影片。

choices.text: I look forward to that too, truly.
choices.zh: 我也真心期待那一天。

choices.text: I don't look forward to that at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（look forward to）→ I look forward to that too, truly.

transition.en: The crew travels to the east side to film Sam's classroom.
transition.zh: 摄制组去了东区拍摄Sam的教室。

npcLine.en: How do you deal with a full room of nervous new students?
npcLine.zh: 面对满屋子紧张的新学员，你是怎么应对的？

choices.text: I deal with it by staying calm myself.
choices.zh: 我通过让自己保持冷静来应对。

choices.text: I deal with it by ignoring them completely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（deal with）→ I deal with it by staying calm myself.

npcLine.en: Do you ever run into your old students around town?
npcLine.zh: 你会在城里偶遇以前的学员吗？

choices.text: I run into them all the time, actually.
choices.zh: 其实我经常遇到他们。

choices.text: I never run into anyone I know.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（run into）→ I run into them all the time, actually.

npcLine.en: That's the moment I remember why I started this.
npcLine.zh: 那就是让我想起自己为什么开始做这件事的时刻。

choices.text: Those moments are why any of this matters.
choices.zh: 正是这些时刻让这一切都有了意义。

choices.text: Those moments don't really change anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Those moments are why any of this matters.

transition.en: A month later, the filmmaker returns with a rough cut.
transition.zh: 一个月后，导演带着初剪回来了。

npcLine.en: It's not finished, but I wanted you to see where it's headed.
npcLine.zh: 还没做完，但我想让大家先看看方向对不对。

choices.text: We're excited to see where it's headed.
choices.zh: 我们很期待看看它的方向。

choices.text: We'd rather not see it unfinished.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ We're excited to see where it's headed.

npcLine.en: I called it 'Ten Letters, One Home.'
npcLine.zh: 我给它取名叫《十封信，一个家》。

choices.text: That title fits perfectly.
choices.zh: 这个标题太贴切了。

choices.text: That title doesn't fit at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That title fits perfectly.

npcLine.en: Although it's only twelve minutes, it says everything.
npcLine.zh: 尽管只有十二分钟，但它说尽了一切。

choices.text: Although it's short, it says everything.
choices.zh: 尽管很短，但说尽了一切。

choices.text: Although it's short, it says nothing at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although it's short, it says everything.

npcLine.en: There's a shot of the old letters that made me cry.
npcLine.zh: 有一个拍那些旧信的镜头，让我哭了。

choices.text: The shot that made you cry made me cry too.
choices.zh: 让你哭的那个镜头也让我哭了。

choices.text: The shot that made you cry felt boring to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → The shot that made you cry made me cry too.

npcLine.en: Watching it back, I finally see how far we've come.
npcLine.zh: 回看这一切，我终于看清我们走了多远。

choices.text: We've come further than I ever imagined.
choices.zh: 我们走的路比我想象的要远得多。

choices.text: We've barely moved at all, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → We've come further than I ever imagined.

npcLine.en: Whoever sees this film will know they're not alone either.
npcLine.zh: 无论谁看到这部片子，都会明白自己也不是孤单一人。

choices.text: Whoever sees it will feel less alone.
choices.zh: 无论谁看到它，都会感觉不那么孤单。

choices.text: Whoever sees it will feel even more alone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → Whoever sees it will feel less alone.

scenes.title: Sharing It Wider
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 让更多人看到

npcLine.en: A film festival wants to show it. Should we send it in?
npcLine.zh: 有个电影节想放映它。我们要不要投过去？

choices.text: If they want it, let's send it in.
choices.zh: 如果他们想要，那就投过去吧。

choices.text: If they want it, let's hold it back.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If they want it, let's send it in.

npcLine.en: If it were shown wider, more houses like ours could start.
npcLine.zh: 如果能被更多人看到，或许会有更多像我们这样的地方开起来。

choices.text: If it were shown wider, that would be the real win.
choices.zh: 如果能被更多人看到，那才是真正的胜利。

choices.text: If it were shown wider, nothing would really change.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If it were shown wider, that would be the real win.

npcLine.en: Let's send it in and see what happens next.
npcLine.zh: 我们投过去吧，看看接下来会发生什么。

choices.text: Let's send it and see what unfolds.
choices.zh: 投过去吧，看看接下来会怎样。

choices.text: Let's not send anything at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's send it and see what unfolds.

transition.en: One evening, a letter about your immigration status arrives.
transition.zh: 一天晚上，一封关于你移民身份的信寄到了。

scenes.title: A Big Decision
scenes.subtitle: 公寓 · 一个重要的决定

npcLine.en: You've been here long enough to apply for permanent residency now.
npcLine.zh: 你在这儿住的时间已经够长，现在可以申请永久居民身份了。

choices.text: I've been thinking about that too, actually.
choices.zh: 其实我也一直在想这件事。

choices.text: I've never once thought about it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've been thinking about that too, actually.

npcLine.en: It's a long process, but it's worth doing properly.
npcLine.zh: 这个过程挺长的，但值得好好走一遍。

choices.text: Long or not, I'm ready to start.
choices.zh: 不管多长，我都准备好开始了。

choices.text: If it's long, I'd rather skip it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ Long or not, I'm ready to start.

npcLine.en: If you apply now, you could have your status by next year.
npcLine.zh: 如果你现在申请，明年就可能拿到身份了。

choices.text: If that's true, I'll start this week.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我这周就开始。

choices.text: If that's true, I'll wait another year.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If that's true, I'll start this week.

scenes.title: Researching the Process
scenes.subtitle: 图书馆 · 查询申请流程

npcLine.en: There's a whole checklist of eligibility requirements online.
npcLine.zh: 网上有一整份资格要求清单。

choices.text: A checklist helps, at least I know where to start.
choices.zh: 有清单就好办了，至少我知道从哪儿开始。

choices.text: A checklist just makes it more confusing.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ A checklist helps, at least I know where to start.

npcLine.en: You'll need proof of residence, income, and language ability.
npcLine.zh: 你需要居住证明、收入证明，还有语言能力证明。

choices.text: I'll gather all of that this week.
choices.zh: 我这周就把这些都准备好。

choices.text: I'll never manage to find all that.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll gather all of that this week.

npcLine.en: Have you already passed a language test before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前已经通过语言考试了吗？

choices.text: I haven't taken one yet, but I will.
choices.zh: 我还没考过，但我会去考的。

choices.text: I've taken it and failed every time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I haven't taken one yet, but I will.

scenes.title: Gathering Documents
scenes.subtitle: 公寓 · 收集申请材料

npcLine.en: Can you find your old lease agreements from the past few years?
npcLine.zh: 你能找到过去几年的租房合同吗？

choices.text: I can dig those out tonight.
choices.zh: 我今晚就能把这些找出来。

choices.text: I can't find any of my old papers.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → I can dig those out tonight.

npcLine.en: Don't forget your bank statements and pay stubs, too.
npcLine.zh: 别忘了银行流水和工资单也要。

choices.text: Right, I'll print those out tomorrow.
choices.zh: 对，我明天就把这些打印出来。

choices.text: Right, I'll ignore those completely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Right, I'll print those out tomorrow.

npcLine.en: This folder is getting thicker than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个文件夹比我想的要厚多了。

choices.text: Thicker than expected, but it's all there.
choices.zh: 确实比想的厚，但都齐了。

choices.text: Thinner than expected, we're missing things.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → Thicker than expected, but it's all there.

transition.en: A week later, you visit an immigration consultant's office.
transition.zh: 一周后，你去了一家移民顾问事务所。

scenes.title: The Immigration Office
scenes.subtitle: 移民顾问事务所 · 咨询

npcLine.en: Welcome. Do you have an appointment today?
npcLine.zh: 欢迎光临。您今天有预约吗？

choices.text: Yes, I do. It's under my name.
choices.zh: 有的。是在我名下预约的。

choices.text: No, I just walked in randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答（do-question）→ Yes, I do. It's under my name.

npcLine.en: Have a seat. The consultant will review your file shortly.
npcLine.zh: 请坐。顾问很快就会审核您的材料。

choices.text: Thank you, I'll wait patiently.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我会耐心等的。

choices.text: Thank you, I'll come back later.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示等待 → Thank you, I'll wait patiently.

npcLine.en: Your file is in order. This looks straightforward.
npcLine.zh: 您的材料没问题。这个申请看起来很顺利。

choices.text: Straightforward is exactly what I hoped for.
choices.zh: 顺利正是我希望听到的。

choices.text: Straightforward sounds too good to be true.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Straightforward is exactly what I hoped for.

scenes.title: The Application Form
scenes.subtitle: 移民顾问事务所 · 填写申请表

npcLine.en: Fill in your personal details on this section first.
npcLine.zh: 先在这一部分填写您的个人信息。

choices.text: Got it, starting with my personal details.
choices.zh: 明白了，先从个人信息开始。

choices.text: I'd rather skip this section entirely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Got it, starting with my personal details.

npcLine.en: Make sure every date matches the documents you brought.
npcLine.zh: 确保每个日期都跟您带来的文件对得上。

choices.text: I'll double-check every single date.
choices.zh: 我会把每个日期都仔细核对一遍。

choices.text: I'll just guess the dates roughly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll double-check every single date.

npcLine.en: There's also a small application fee to pay today.
npcLine.zh: 今天还需要缴纳一笔申请费。

choices.text: No problem, I came prepared for that.
choices.zh: 没问题，我已经准备好了。

choices.text: No problem, I'll pay it never.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ No problem, I came prepared for that.

transition.en: Two months later, a letter invites you to an interview.
transition.zh: 两个月后，一封信邀请你去参加面谈。

npcLine.en: They might ask about your work history and community ties.
npcLine.zh: 他们可能会问你的工作经历和社区联系。

choices.text: I can talk about both for hours.
choices.zh: 这两个我能聊上好几个小时。

choices.text: I can't remember any of my history.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → I can talk about both for hours.

npcLine.en: If they ask why you want to stay, what will you say?
npcLine.zh: 如果他们问你为什么想留下，你会怎么说？

choices.text: If they ask, I'll tell them the whole story.
choices.zh: 如果他们问，我会把整个故事告诉他们。

choices.text: If they ask, I won't know what to say.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If they ask, I'll tell them the whole story.

npcLine.en: Just be honest. That's always the best answer.
npcLine.zh: 诚实就好。这永远是最好的回答。

choices.text: Honest is the only way I know how.
choices.zh: 诚实是我唯一会的方式。

choices.text: Honest sounds risky to me, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Honest is the only way I know how.

npcLine.en: Can you tell me why you'd like to stay in Canada?
npcLine.zh: 您能说说为什么想留在加拿大吗？

choices.text: Yes, I can tell you exactly why.
choices.zh: 可以，我可以准确地告诉您原因。

choices.text: I can't really explain my reasons.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Yes, I can tell you exactly why.

npcLine.en: This place is where I found my community, my work, and my home.
npcLine.zh: 这里是我找到社区、工作和家的地方。

choices.text: A place where I found everything that matters.
choices.zh: 一个我找到了所有重要事物的地方。

choices.text: A place where I found nothing worth keeping.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → A place where I found everything that matters.

npcLine.en: That's a genuine answer. Thank you for your time today.
npcLine.zh: 这是个真诚的回答。谢谢您今天抽空前来。

choices.text: Thank you for hearing me out.
choices.zh: 谢谢您听我说完。

choices.text: Thank you, whatever happens next.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you for hearing me out.

npcLine.en: Any news yet on the application?
npcLine.zh: 申请那边有消息了吗？

choices.text: Nothing yet, but I'm trying to be patient.
choices.zh: 还没有，但我在努力保持耐心。

choices.text: Nothing yet, and I've given up hope.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Nothing yet, but I'm trying to be patient.

npcLine.en: It usually takes a few months to process, I've read.
npcLine.zh: 我看资料说通常要处理几个月。

choices.text: I've read the same thing, so I'm prepared to wait.
choices.zh: 我也看到过同样的说法，所以我做好了等待的准备。

choices.text: I've never read anything about the timeline.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've read the same thing, so I'm prepared to wait.

npcLine.en: Although waiting is hard, you've done everything right.
npcLine.zh: 尽管等待很煎熬，但你该做的都做对了。

choices.text: Although it's hard, I know I did my best.
choices.zh: 尽管很煎熬，但我知道自己尽力了。

choices.text: Although it's hard, I probably did it wrong.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although it's hard, I know I did my best.

transition.en: One ordinary afternoon, an email changes everything.
transition.zh: 一个普通的下午，一封邮件改变了一切。

scenes.title: The Approval
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 好消息到了

npcLine.en: Your phone just buzzed like crazy. What is it?
npcLine.zh: 你手机刚才疯狂震动。是什么？

choices.text: It's the email I've been waiting for.
choices.zh: 是我一直在等的那封邮件。

choices.text: It's nothing, just an old reminder.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时说明 → It's the email I've been waiting for.

npcLine.en: Well? Don't leave me hanging, what does it say?
npcLine.zh: 怎么样？别吊我胃口，上面写了什么？

choices.text: It says I've been approved!
choices.zh: 上面写着我被批准了！

choices.text: It says the application was denied.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（approve）回应 → It says I've been approved!

npcLine.en: You did it! I'm so unbelievably happy for you.
npcLine.zh: 你做到了！我为你高兴得难以置信。

choices.text: We did it. This was never just me.
choices.zh: 是我们做到的。这从来都不只是我一个人的事。

choices.text: I did it entirely alone, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → We did it. This was never just me.

npcLine.en: There's a small ceremony next month to receive your card.
npcLine.zh: 下个月有一个小仪式来领取你的身份卡。

choices.text: A real ceremony? I wasn't expecting that.
choices.zh: 还有正式的仪式？我倒是没想到。

choices.text: A real ceremony sounds unnecessary to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ A real ceremony? I wasn't expecting that.

npcLine.en: Can we all come and watch you take this step?
npcLine.zh: 我们大家都能来看你走完这一步吗？

choices.text: Of course you can, I'd want nobody else.
choices.zh: 当然可以，我谁都不想少。

choices.text: I'd rather nobody came at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Of course you can, I'd want nobody else.

npcLine.en: A decade apart, and now this is officially home.
npcLine.zh: 分开了十年，而现在，这里正式成了家。

choices.text: More than home. It's everything I hoped for.
choices.zh: 不只是家。这是我曾希望的一切。

choices.text: Less than home, if I'm honest.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → More than home. It's everything I hoped for.

transition.en: That night, you can't stop thinking about the future.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，你满脑子都是未来的事。

npcLine.en: You've been staring at your phone for an hour. What's up?
npcLine.zh: 你盯着手机看了一个小时了。怎么了？

choices.text: I've been thinking about proposing to Emma.
choices.zh: 我一直在想向Emma求婚这件事。

choices.text: I've been thinking about nothing at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've been thinking about proposing to Emma.

npcLine.en: Proposing? That's huge! Are you sure?
npcLine.zh: 求婚？这可是大事！你确定吗？

choices.text: I've never been more sure of anything.
choices.zh: 我从没这么确定过任何事。

choices.text: I'm not sure about it at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ I've never been more sure of anything.

npcLine.en: A decade apart, and now you're ready for forever.
npcLine.zh: 分开了十年，现在你准备好迎接永远了。

choices.text: Ready for forever, exactly.
choices.zh: 正是，准备好迎接永远了。

choices.text: Not ready for forever, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Ready for forever, exactly.

npcLine.en: How did you know it was the right time to propose, back then?
npcLine.zh: 您当年是怎么知道求婚的时机到了的？

choices.text: How did you know? I'm asking for a reason.
choices.zh: 您是怎么知道的？我这么问是有原因的。

choices.text: I don't need to know how you knew.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时追问 → How did you know? I'm asking for a reason.

npcLine.en: You'll know. It's less about timing and more about certainty.
npcLine.zh: 你会知道的。这与其说是时机，不如说是确定感。

choices.text: Certainty over timing — that makes sense.
choices.zh: 确定感比时机更重要——这说得通。

choices.text: Timing over certainty — I disagree completely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → Certainty over timing — that makes sense.

npcLine.en: Whatever you choose, do it in a way that feels like you.
npcLine.zh: 不管你选什么方式，都要让它像你自己的风格。

choices.text: A way that feels like me — I know exactly what that is.
choices.zh: 像我自己的风格——我很清楚那是什么。

choices.text: A way that feels like me sounds too hard to plan.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → A way that feels like me — I know exactly what that is.

transition.en: The next day, you visit a small jewelry shop.
transition.zh: 第二天，你去了一家小珠宝店。

npcLine.en: Are you looking for an engagement ring today?
npcLine.zh: 您今天是来看订婚戒指的吗？

choices.text: Yes, I'm looking for the perfect one.
choices.zh: 是的，我在找最完美的那一枚。

choices.text: No, I'm just browsing forever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → Yes, I'm looking for the perfect one.

npcLine.en: Do you know her ring size, or should we guess?
npcLine.zh: 您知道她的戒指尺寸吗，还是我们得猜？

choices.text: I do, actually — I checked secretly.
choices.zh: 我知道，其实我偷偷查过了。

choices.text: I don't, and I've never thought about it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I do, actually — I checked secretly.

npcLine.en: This one was made by a local designer. It suits a simple, honest style.
npcLine.zh: 这一枚是本地设计师做的。适合简约、真诚的风格。

choices.text: Made locally? That makes it even more perfect.
choices.zh: 本地做的？那就更完美了。

choices.text: Made locally? That doesn't matter to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → Made locally? That makes it even more perfect.

scenes.title: Choosing the Moment
scenes.subtitle: 书店门口 · 挑选求婚地点

npcLine.en: Where are you thinking of doing it?
npcLine.zh: 你打算在哪儿求婚？

choices.text: I'm thinking of doing it at the bookstore.
choices.zh: 我打算在书店求婚。

choices.text: I'm thinking of doing it at a random bus stop.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → I'm thinking of doing it at the bookstore.

npcLine.en: That's where you two really started, isn't it?
npcLine.zh: 那不就是你们俩真正开始的地方吗？

choices.text: The place where it started is the place to finish it.
choices.zh: 开始的地方，也该是这一步发生的地方。

choices.text: The place where it started doesn't feel right anymore.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → The place where it started is the place to finish it.

npcLine.en: If you do it there, among the letters, it'll mean everything.
npcLine.zh: 如果你在那儿求婚，在那些信件中间，会意义非凡。

choices.text: If I do it there, it'll mean everything to both of us.
choices.zh: 如果在那儿求婚，对我们俩都会意义非凡。

choices.text: If I do it there, it'll mean nothing special.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If I do it there, it'll mean everything to both of us.

transition.en: Saturday evening, you wait for Emma to close up the shop.
transition.zh: 周六傍晚，你等着Emma关店。

scenes.title: Nervous Again
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 又一次紧张

npcLine.en: You're acting strange tonight. Is everything okay?
npcLine.zh: 你今晚有点奇怪。一切都还好吗？

choices.text: Everything's more than okay, actually.
choices.zh: 其实一切都不只是好而已。

choices.text: Everything's terrible, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Everything's more than okay, actually.

npcLine.en: Why are your hands shaking?
npcLine.zh: 你的手怎么在抖？

choices.text: You'll understand in just a moment.
choices.zh: 你马上就会明白的。

choices.text: My hands never shake, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ You'll understand in just a moment.

npcLine.en: You're worrying me a little. What's going on?
npcLine.zh: 你让我有点担心了。到底怎么了？

choices.text: Something good is going on, I promise.
choices.zh: 是件好事在发生，我保证。

choices.text: Nothing is going on, forget I said anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → Something good is going on, I promise.

npcLine.en: Ten years ago, a letter changed my life. So did you.
npcLine.zh: 十年前，一封信改变了我的人生。你也是。

choices.text: You changed mine too, from the very first day.
choices.zh: 你也改变了我的人生，从第一天起就是。

choices.text: You didn't really change anything for me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → You changed mine too, from the very first day.

npcLine.en: What are you doing? Wait — is that a ring?
npcLine.zh: 你在干嘛？等等——那是戒指吗？

choices.text: It is. Will you marry me?
choices.zh: 是的。你愿意嫁给我吗？

choices.text: It's nothing, don't worry about it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单确认＋核心问句 → It is. Will you marry me?

npcLine.en: Yes. Yes, a thousand times yes!
npcLine.zh: 愿意。愿意，愿意一千次！

choices.text: You just made me the happiest person alive.
choices.zh: 你刚刚让我成了这世上最幸福的人。

choices.text: I'll take that as a maybe, then.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ You just made me the happiest person alive.

scenes.title: She Said Yes
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 沉浸在幸福里

npcLine.en: I can't stop looking at this ring.
npcLine.zh: 我一直忍不住看这枚戒指。

choices.text: Look at it forever, it's yours now.
choices.zh: 尽情看吧，它现在是你的了。

choices.text: Stop looking at it, it's not real.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（look at）→ Look at it forever, it's yours now.

npcLine.en: We should call everyone. They're going to be so excited.
npcLine.zh: 我们该打电话告诉大家。他们一定会特别激动。

choices.text: They're going to lose their minds, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，他们一定会激动疯的。

choices.text: They're going to be completely unbothered.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will/going to 表示预测 → They're going to lose their minds, honestly.

npcLine.en: This is the best night of my entire life.
npcLine.zh: 这是我这辈子最好的一晚。

choices.text: The best night of both our lives.
choices.zh: 是我们两个人这辈子最好的一晚。

choices.text: One of many good nights, I suppose.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用最高级 → The best night of both our lives.

transition.en: Word spreads fast through Lily's House.
transition.zh: 消息在Lily之家很快就传开了。

npcLine.en: I heard the news! When did this happen?
npcLine.zh: 我听说了！这是什么时候的事？

choices.text: It happened just last night.
choices.zh: 就是昨晚发生的事。

choices.text: It happened years ago, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → It happened just last night.

npcLine.en: This calls for the biggest celebration this house has ever seen.
npcLine.zh: 这值得办一场这栋房子有史以来最大的庆祝会。

choices.text: The biggest one it's ever seen, I agree.
choices.zh: 有史以来最大的一场，我同意。

choices.text: A small quiet one would be enough.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → The biggest one it's ever seen, I agree.

npcLine.en: I'm so happy for you both, more than words can say.
npcLine.zh: 我为你们俩感到无比开心，多到言语难以表达。

choices.text: Your happiness means the world to us.
choices.zh: 您的祝福对我们意义重大。

choices.text: Your happiness doesn't really matter to us.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Your happiness means the world to us.

scenes.title: Wedding Planning Begins
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 开始筹备婚礼

npcLine.en: We'll need a venue, a caterer, and a guest list, for a start.
npcLine.zh: 首先我们得先定场地、餐饮，还有宾客名单。

choices.text: We'll figure it all out together.
choices.zh: 我们会一起把这些都搞定的。

choices.text: We'll never figure any of this out.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → We'll figure it all out together.

npcLine.en: If we kept it small, it would feel more like us.
npcLine.zh: 如果办得小一点，会更像我们的风格。

choices.text: If we kept it small, I'd love that even more.
choices.zh: 如果办小一点，我会更喜欢。

choices.text: If we kept it small, I'd feel disappointed.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If we kept it small, I'd love that even more.

npcLine.en: A small wedding, full of people who actually matter.
npcLine.zh: 一场小小的婚礼，宾客都是真正重要的人。

choices.text: People who matter is all we ever needed.
choices.zh: 重要的人，就是我们一直需要的全部。

choices.text: People who matter aren't that important, really.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → People who matter is all we ever needed.

npcLine.en: What if we got married exactly ten years after we reunited?
npcLine.zh: 要是我们在重逢十周年的那天结婚呢？

choices.text: What a perfect date that would be.
choices.zh: 那真是个完美的日子。

choices.text: What a strange date to pick.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单感叹（陈述句）→ What a perfect date that would be.

npcLine.en: The same airport, the same city, the same us.
npcLine.zh: 同一个机场，同一座城市，还是我们俩。

choices.text: The same us, but so much further along.
choices.zh: 还是我们俩，但已经走了这么远。

choices.text: The same us, but honestly nothing has changed.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ The same us, but so much further along.

npcLine.en: Ten years apart, and now a lifetime together.
npcLine.zh: 分开十年，如今是相守一生。

choices.text: A lifetime together, worth every year of waiting.
choices.zh: 相守一生，这么多年的等待都值了。

choices.text: A lifetime together, though the wait feels wasted.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ A lifetime together, worth every year of waiting.

transition.en: The morning of the wedding, everyone rushes to help.
transition.zh: 婚礼当天早上，大家都赶来帮忙。

scenes.title: Wedding Morning
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 婚礼当天早晨

npcLine.en: The florist just dropped off the bouquets.
npcLine.zh: 花商刚把花束送到了。

choices.text: The bouquets arrived just in time.
choices.zh: 花束正好及时送到了。

choices.text: The bouquets never arrived at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → The bouquets arrived just in time.

npcLine.en: Can you help set up the chairs before the guests arrive?
npcLine.zh: 客人到之前，你能帮忙摆好椅子吗？

choices.text: Sure, I'll have them set up in minutes.
choices.zh: 没问题，我几分钟就能摆好。

choices.text: I can't move chairs in this suit.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Sure, I'll have them set up in minutes.

npcLine.en: Nervous, or just excited?
npcLine.zh: 是紧张，还是纯粹兴奋？

choices.text: Both, in about equal measure.
choices.zh: 两者都有，差不多各占一半。

choices.text: Neither, I feel completely numb.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Both, in about equal measure.

npcLine.en: This tie has been in our family for three generations.
npcLine.zh: 这条领带已经在我们家传了三代人了。

choices.text: Three generations? I'm honored to wear it.
choices.zh: 三代人？我很荣幸能戴上它。

choices.text: Three generations sounds like too much pressure.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → Three generations? I'm honored to wear it.

npcLine.en: You look sharp. She's a lucky woman.
npcLine.zh: 你看起来真精神。她真是个幸运的女人。

choices.text: I'm the lucky one, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我才是幸运的那个。

choices.text: Luck has nothing to do with it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ I'm the lucky one, honestly.

npcLine.en: It's almost time. Are you ready to walk out there?
npcLine.zh: 快到时间了。你准备好走出去了吗？

choices.text: I've never been more ready for anything.
choices.zh: 我从没为任何事这么准备好过。

choices.text: I don't think I'll ever be ready.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ I've never been more ready for anything.

transition.en: The small garden behind the bookstore fills with familiar faces.
transition.zh: 书店后面的小花园里挤满了熟悉的面孔。

scenes.title: The Ceremony Begins
scenes.subtitle: 书店后花园 · 仪式开始

npcLine.en: We are gathered here today to witness this union.
npcLine.zh: 我们今天齐聚在这里，见证这段结合。

choices.text: We're honored to be witnesses to it.
choices.zh: 能作为见证人，我们感到很荣幸。

choices.text: We'd rather not be witnesses to this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ We're honored to be witnesses to it.

npcLine.en: The officiant asked everyone to please take their seats.
npcLine.zh: 司仪请大家就座。

choices.text: She asked us to sit, so let's sit.
choices.zh: 她请我们坐下，那我们就坐吧。

choices.text: She asked us to sit, but I'll stand.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语回应 → She asked us to sit, so let's sit.

npcLine.en: Here comes the bride.
npcLine.zh: 新娘来了。

choices.text: There she is. She's breathtaking.
choices.zh: 她来了。美得令人屏息。

choices.text: There she is. Right on schedule.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单感叹（陈述句）→ There she is. She's breathtaking.

npcLine.en: I promise to choose you, again and again, every single day.
npcLine.zh: 我承诺，我会一次又一次地选择你，每一天都是。

choices.text: I'm choosing you too, for the rest of my life.
choices.zh: 我也在选择你，用我余生的每一天。

choices.text: I'm choosing this suit, mostly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → I'm choosing you too, for the rest of my life.

npcLine.en: If ten years couldn't keep us apart, nothing ever will.
npcLine.zh: 如果十年都没能让我们分开，那以后也不会有什么能做到了。

choices.text: If a decade couldn't stop us, nothing can.
choices.zh: 如果十年都拦不住我们，那什么都拦不住了。

choices.text: If a decade couldn't stop us, something eventually will.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If a decade couldn't stop us, nothing can.

npcLine.en: By the power vested in me, I now pronounce you married.
npcLine.zh: 以我被赋予的权力，我现在宣布你们结为夫妻。

choices.text: We're officially married. I can hardly believe it.
choices.zh: 我们正式结婚了。我简直不敢相信。

choices.text: We're officially married, and it feels ordinary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单感叹（陈述句）→ We're officially married. I can hardly believe it.

npcLine.en: You may now kiss the bride.
npcLine.zh: 你现在可以亲吻新娘了。

choices.text: I've been waiting all day for this.
choices.zh: 我等这一刻等了一整天了。

choices.text: I'd rather wait a little longer, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ I've been waiting all day for this.

npcLine.en: Everyone cheered so loudly the whole street could hear it.
npcLine.zh: 大家欢呼得那么响，整条街都能听到。

choices.text: The whole street heard it, and I loved that.
choices.zh: 整条街都听到了，我很喜欢这样。

choices.text: The whole street heard it, which embarrassed me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → The whole street heard it, and I loved that.

npcLine.en: Congratulations, Mr. and Mrs.! Let's head to the reception.
npcLine.zh: 恭喜二位！我们去婚宴现场吧。

choices.text: Let's go celebrate properly now.
choices.zh: 我们现在好好庆祝一下吧。

choices.text: Let's skip the reception entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's go celebrate properly now.

transition.en: Inside, tables are set with candles and name cards.
transition.zh: 屋里，桌子上摆着蜡烛和座位卡。

npcLine.en: As the best man, I've prepared a few words.
npcLine.zh: 作为伴郎，我准备了几句话。

choices.text: We've all been waiting to hear them.
choices.zh: 我们都一直等着听呢。

choices.text: We've all been dreading this moment.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → We've all been waiting to hear them.

npcLine.en: To the couple who taught us all what waiting is worth.
npcLine.zh: 敬这对教会我们等待的意义的新人。

choices.text: To the couple who taught us so much, cheers.
choices.zh: 敬这对教会我们良多的新人，干杯。

choices.text: To the couple who taught us nothing, cheers.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → To the couple who taught us so much, cheers.

npcLine.en: Raise your glasses, everyone. To love that waited ten years!
npcLine.zh: 大家举杯吧。敬等待了十年的爱情！

choices.text: To love that waited, and was worth it.
choices.zh: 敬这份等待的爱，值得！

choices.text: To love that waited far too long.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ To love that waited, and was worth it.

npcLine.en: May I have this dance?
npcLine.zh: 可以请你跳这支舞吗？

choices.text: You may have every dance tonight.
choices.zh: 今晚每一支舞都归你了。

choices.text: I'd rather sit this one out.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ You may have every dance tonight.

npcLine.en: I'm terrible at dancing, just so you know.
npcLine.zh: 我跳舞很烂，先跟你说一声。

choices.text: So am I. We'll be terrible together.
choices.zh: 我也是。我们就一起烂到底吧。

choices.text: I'm actually a professional dancer.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ So am I. We'll be terrible together.

npcLine.en: This is exactly how I imagined this moment.
npcLine.zh: 这正是我想象中的这一刻。

choices.text: It's even better than I imagined.
choices.zh: 比我想象的还要好。

choices.text: It's nothing like I imagined, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ It's even better than I imagined.

scenes.title: The Guest Book
