scenes.subtitle: 婚宴 · 签到本上的祝福

npcLine.en: I wrote something in your guest book. It's a bit long.
npcLine.zh: 我在你们的签到本上写了些话。有点长。

choices.text: Long is perfect. I'll read every word.
choices.zh: 长才好呢。每个字我都会读。

choices.text: Long is unnecessary, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Long is perfect. I'll read every word.

npcLine.en: This whole day feels like a letter finally being answered.
npcLine.zh: 今天这一整天，感觉像是一封信终于得到了回音。

choices.text: A letter answered after ten long years.
choices.zh: 一封等了十年才得到回音的信。

choices.text: A letter that was never really answered.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → A letter answered after ten long years.

npcLine.en: Thank you for letting all of us be part of your story.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你们让我们都成为了你们故事的一部分。

choices.text: Thank you for being part of this day.
choices.zh: 谢谢你们成为这一天的一部分。

choices.text: Thank you, but it was never about you.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Thank you for being part of this day.

transition.en: As the night winds down, guests gather at the door with sparklers.
transition.zh: 夜色渐深，宾客们拿着仙女棒聚在门口。

npcLine.en: Everyone's lined up outside, waiting to see you two off.
npcLine.zh: 大家都在外面排好队，等着送你们俩离开。

choices.text: They're waiting for us? That's so sweet.
choices.zh: 他们在等我们？真是太贴心了。

choices.text: They're waiting for us? Tell them to leave.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ They're waiting for us? That's so sweet.

npcLine.en: Don't forget to catch the bouquet before you go.
npcLine.zh: 走之前别忘了接住花束。

choices.text: I won't forget, I promise.
choices.zh: 我不会忘的，我保证。

choices.text: I'd rather skip that tradition.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ I won't forget, I promise.

npcLine.en: Ready to start our life together, Mr. Husband?
npcLine.zh: 准备好开始我们的共同生活了吗，老公先生？

choices.text: More ready than I've ever been, Mrs. Wife.
choices.zh: 从没这么准备好过，老婆太太。

choices.text: Not ready at all, if I'm honest.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ More ready than I've ever been, Mrs. Wife.

transition.en: The morning after, you wake up as a married man.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，你以已婚人士的身份醒来。

scenes.title: The Next Morning
scenes.subtitle: 公寓 · 婚礼后的清晨

npcLine.en: Good morning, husband. How does it feel?
npcLine.zh: 早安，老公。感觉怎么样？

choices.text: It feels like the beginning of everything.
choices.zh: 感觉像是一切的开始。

choices.text: It feels exactly like yesterday, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回答（陈述句）→ It feels like the beginning of everything.

npcLine.en: So, what does forever look like from here?
npcLine.zh: 那，从这里开始，永远会是什么样子？

choices.text: Forever looks like this, exactly like this.
choices.zh: 永远就是这样子，正是这样。

choices.text: Forever looks uncertain, I have to admit.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回答（陈述句）→ Forever looks like this, exactly like this.

npcLine.en: A decade apart, a lifetime together. Not a bad trade.
npcLine.zh: 分开十年，相守一生。这笔交易不亏。

choices.text: The best trade either of us ever made.
choices.zh: 这是我们俩这辈子做过最好的交易。

choices.text: A trade I'm still not sure was worth it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ The best trade either of us ever made.

transition.en: A week after the wedding, you sit down to plan a honeymoon.
transition.zh: 婚礼后一周，你们坐下来计划蜜月旅行。

scenes.title: Booking the Trip
scenes.subtitle: 书店里 · 订蜜月行程

npcLine.en: Where should we go for our honeymoon?
npcLine.zh: 我们蜜月去哪儿好呢？

choices.text: Where do you feel like going?
choices.zh: 你想去哪儿？

choices.text: Where we go doesn't matter to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问对方想法（wh-question）→ Where do you feel like going?

npcLine.en: If we booked flights today, we could save quite a bit.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们今天订机票，能省不少钱。

choices.text: If we booked today, let's do it right now.
choices.zh: 如果今天订划算，那我们现在就订吧。

choices.text: If we booked today, we'd probably regret it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If we booked today, let's do it right now.

npcLine.en: This airline has a direct flight with no layovers.
npcLine.zh: 这家航空公司有直飞航班，不用转机。

choices.text: No layovers sounds perfect to me.
choices.zh: 不用转机对我来说太完美了。

choices.text: No layovers sounds boring, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ No layovers sounds perfect to me.

npcLine.en: Have you checked the airline's baggage allowance?
npcLine.zh: 你查过航空公司的行李额度了吗？

choices.text: I've already checked it twice.
choices.zh: 我已经查过两遍了。

choices.text: I've never once checked it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've already checked it twice.

npcLine.en: Your suitcase looks like it might go over the weight limit.
npcLine.zh: 你的行李箱看起来可能会超重。

choices.text: It might, so let's weigh it now.
choices.zh: 有可能，那我们现在就称一下吧。

choices.text: It might, but I don't really care.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ It might, so let's weigh it now.

npcLine.en: Don't forget your passport and boarding pass.
npcLine.zh: 别忘了护照和登机牌。

choices.text: They're already in my carry-on.
choices.zh: 它们已经在我的随身行李里了。

choices.text: I forgot both of those completely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ They're already in my carry-on.

transition.en: At the airport, you approach the check-in counter.
transition.zh: 在机场，你们走向值机柜台。

npcLine.en: Can I see your passports and booking confirmation, please?
npcLine.zh: 可以看一下您的护照和订票确认单吗？

choices.text: Of course, here they are.
choices.zh: 当然，给您。

choices.text: We don't have any of that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, here they are.

npcLine.en: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
npcLine.zh: 您想要靠窗还是靠过道的座位？

choices.text: A window seat, if that's available.
choices.zh: 靠窗的，如果还有的话。

choices.text: Neither, I'd like to stand the whole flight.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回答 → A window seat, if that's available.

npcLine.en: Your gate closes thirty minutes before departure.
npcLine.zh: 登机口在起飞前三十分钟关闭。

choices.text: Thirty minutes, got it. We'll be there early.
choices.zh: 三十分钟，明白了。我们会早点到的。

choices.text: Thirty minutes seems like plenty of time to wander.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Thirty minutes, got it. We'll be there early.

npcLine.en: Please remove your shoes and place your bag on the belt.
npcLine.zh: 请脱鞋，把包放到传送带上。

choices.text: Sure, one moment please.
choices.zh: 好的，请稍等。

choices.text: I'd rather keep my shoes on.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌配合 → Sure, one moment please.

npcLine.en: Do you have any liquids over 100 milliliters?
npcLine.zh: 您有超过100毫升的液体吗？

choices.text: No, I don't have anything like that.
choices.zh: 没有，我没带这类东西。

choices.text: Yes, I have several full bottles.

n2.hintOnWrong: 否定回答 → No, I don't have anything like that.

npcLine.en: All clear. Enjoy your trip!
npcLine.zh: 都没问题。祝您旅途愉快！

choices.text: Thank you so much, you too.
choices.zh: 太谢谢您了，您也是。

choices.text: Finally, that took forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you so much, you too.

transition.en: Once the plane levels off, you both relax for the first time all day.
transition.zh: 飞机平飞后，你们俩这一天第一次真正放松下来。

npcLine.en: Would you like chicken or pasta for your meal?
npcLine.zh: 您的正餐想要鸡肉还是意面？

choices.text: Pasta sounds good to me, thanks.
choices.zh: 意面听起来不错，谢谢。

choices.text: Neither, I'll just skip the meal.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回答 → Pasta sounds good to me, thanks.

npcLine.en: I can't believe we're actually on our way.
npcLine.zh: 我简直不敢相信我们真的在路上了。

choices.text: We're really doing this, aren't we?
choices.zh: 我们真的在做这件事了，对吧？

choices.text: We're not really going anywhere, are we?

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → We're really doing this, aren't we?

npcLine.en: Ten hours until we land. What should we watch?
npcLine.zh: 还有十小时才降落。我们看点什么？

choices.text: What do you feel like watching?
choices.zh: 你想看什么？

choices.text: What we watch is a waste of time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 追问对方意见 → What do you feel like watching?

transition.en: After landing, you clear customs in an unfamiliar country.
transition.zh: 落地后，你们在一个陌生的国家过了海关。

npcLine.en: What is the purpose of your visit?
npcLine.zh: 您此行的目的是什么？

choices.text: We're here on our honeymoon.
choices.zh: 我们是来度蜜月的。

choices.text: We're not sure, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单说明（陈述句）→ We're here on our honeymoon.

npcLine.en: Congratulations! How long will you be staying?
npcLine.zh: 恭喜！您打算待多久？

choices.text: We'll be staying for about ten days.
choices.zh: 我们大概会待十天左右。

choices.text: We'll never leave, probably.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 回答 → We'll be staying for about ten days.

npcLine.en: Welcome, and enjoy your stay.
npcLine.zh: 欢迎光临，祝您旅途愉快。

choices.text: Thank you, we're so excited to be here.
choices.zh: 谢谢，能来这儿我们太激动了。

choices.text: Thank you, though we'd rather be home.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you, we're so excited to be here.

npcLine.en: Welcome! Do you have a reservation with us?
npcLine.zh: 欢迎光临！您有在我们这儿预订吗？

choices.text: Yes, it's under my wife's name.
choices.zh: 有的，是在我妻子名下订的。

choices.text: No, we just walked in randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it's under my wife's name.

npcLine.en: We've upgraded your room for your honeymoon. Congratulations.
npcLine.zh: 我们把您的房间升级了，祝贺新婚。

choices.text: You've upgraded it? That's so kind of you.
choices.zh: 您升级了？您真是太好了。

choices.text: You've made a mistake, probably.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → You've upgraded it? That's so kind of you.

npcLine.en: Breakfast is served until ten, and checkout is at noon.
npcLine.zh: 早餐供应到十点，退房时间是中午十二点。

choices.text: Good to know, thank you for explaining.
choices.zh: 知道了，谢谢您的说明。

choices.text: That schedule doesn't work for us at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Good to know, thank you for explaining.

scenes.title: Exchanging Currency
scenes.subtitle: 货币兑换处 · 换外币

npcLine.en: How much would you like to exchange today?
npcLine.zh: 您今天想换多少钱？

choices.text: How much is the exchange rate today?
choices.zh: 今天的汇率是多少？

choices.text: How much money doesn't concern me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 追问汇率 → How much is the exchange rate today?

npcLine.en: There's a small commission fee on every exchange.
npcLine.zh: 每笔兑换都有一点手续费。

choices.text: That's fine, small fees don't bother me.
choices.zh: 没关系，小额手续费我不介意。

choices.text: That's outrageous, I refuse to pay it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That's fine, small fees don't bother me.

npcLine.en: Here's your cash, all in smaller bills as you asked.
npcLine.zh: 这是您的现金，都按您说的换成了小面额。

choices.text: I asked for that, and you delivered perfectly.
choices.zh: 我确实是这么要求的，您办得太好了。

choices.text: I never asked for smaller bills at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语呼应 → I asked for that, and you delivered perfectly.

transition.en: That evening, you wander through the old town together.
transition.zh: 那天傍晚，你们俩一起漫步在老城区。

npcLine.en: This street is older than both our countries combined.
npcLine.zh: 这条街比我们两个国家加起来的历史都要长。

choices.text: Older than that? I can hardly imagine it.
choices.zh: 比那还老？我简直难以想象。

choices.text: Newer than that, probably, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → Older than that? I can hardly imagine it.

npcLine.en: Should we get lost on purpose for a while?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要故意迷路一会儿？

choices.text: Let's get completely lost together.
choices.zh: 我们就一起彻底迷路吧。

choices.text: Let's follow the map exactly, please.

n2.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's get completely lost together.

npcLine.en: I never want this trip to end.
npcLine.zh: 我真希望这趟旅行永远不要结束。

choices.text: I wish it never had to end either.
choices.zh: 我也希望它永远不用结束。

choices.text: I wish it would end sooner, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用虚拟语气 → I wish it never had to end either.

transition.en: Ten days later, you board the flight back to Toronto.
transition.zh: 十天后，你们登上了返回多伦多的航班。

npcLine.en: Ready to go back to real life?
npcLine.zh: 准备好回到真实生活了吗？

choices.text: Ready, and grateful for this whole trip.
choices.zh: 准备好了，而且对这趟旅行满怀感激。

choices.text: Not ready at all, let's just stay here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ Ready, and grateful for this whole trip.

npcLine.en: We've made a decade's worth of memories in just ten days.
npcLine.zh: 我们十天里攒下了够一辈子回味的回忆。

choices.text: We've made memories that'll last forever.
choices.zh: 我们攒下的回忆会永远留在心里。

choices.text: We've made memories nobody will care about.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → We've made memories that'll last forever.

npcLine.en: Home isn't a place. It's whoever's sitting next to me.
npcLine.zh: 家不是一个地方。家是坐在我身边的人。

choices.text: Home is whoever's beside you, exactly.
choices.zh: 家就是在你身边的那个人，正是如此。

choices.text: Home is definitely just a place, though.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → Home is whoever's beside you, exactly.

transition.en: Married life settles in, and a new question arises.
transition.zh: 婚后的生活渐渐安定下来，一个新的问题出现了。

npcLine.en: Our landlord just raised the rent again.
npcLine.zh: 房东又涨房租了。

choices.text: He raised it again? That's the third time.
choices.zh: 又涨了？这已经是第三次了。

choices.text: He raised it, and I don't mind at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用过去时回应 → He raised it again? That's the third time.

npcLine.en: Maybe it's time we thought about buying our own place.
npcLine.zh: 也许是时候考虑买自己的房子了。

choices.text: Maybe it really is time.
choices.zh: 也许真是时候了。

choices.text: Maybe it's never going to be time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ Maybe it really is time.

npcLine.en: If we saved carefully, we could afford a small place.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们省着点存钱，能负担得起一个小地方。

choices.text: If we saved carefully, I think we could.
choices.zh: 如果省着点存，我觉得可以。

choices.text: If we saved carefully, it still wouldn't be enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If we saved carefully, I think we could.

scenes.title: Meeting a Realtor
scenes.subtitle: 房产中介 · 见经纪人

npcLine.en: What kind of neighborhood are you looking for?
npcLine.zh: 您想找什么样的社区？

choices.text: Somewhere quiet, close to the bookstore.
choices.zh: 安静一点的地方，离书店近。

choices.text: Somewhere doesn't matter, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回答（陈述句）→ Somewhere quiet, close to the bookstore.

npcLine.en: What's your budget range, roughly speaking?
npcLine.zh: 大致来说，您的预算范围是多少？

choices.text: We've set a firm budget already.
choices.zh: 我们已经定好了明确的预算。

choices.text: We haven't thought about money at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ We've set a firm budget already.

npcLine.en: I've found a few listings that might fit what you need.
npcLine.zh: 我找到了几套可能符合你们需求的房源。

choices.text: You've already found some? Let's see them.
choices.zh: 已经找到了？我们看看吧。

choices.text: You've found nothing useful, probably.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → You've already found some? Let's see them.

npcLine.en: This house has three bedrooms and a small backyard.
npcLine.zh: 这栋房子有三间卧室和一个小后院。

choices.text: A backyard sounds nice, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，有个后院挺不错的。

choices.text: A backyard sounds like too much work.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ A backyard sounds nice, honestly.

npcLine.en: The kitchen was renovated just two years ago.
npcLine.zh: 厨房两年前刚翻修过。

choices.text: Recently renovated? Even better.
choices.zh: 最近才翻修的？那更好了。

choices.text: Recently renovated? That worries me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Recently renovated? Even better.

npcLine.en: What do you two think so far?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩目前觉得怎么样？

choices.text: What we think is, we love it already.
choices.zh: 我们的想法是，我们已经很喜欢了。

choices.text: What we think doesn't matter yet.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ What we think is, we love it already.

transition.en: Before making an offer, you hire an inspector.
transition.zh: 在出价之前，你们请了一位验房师。

scenes.title: The Home Inspection
scenes.subtitle: 验房 · 检查房屋状况

npcLine.en: Overall, the structure is solid, with a few minor issues.
npcLine.zh: 整体来说，结构很牢固，有几个小问题。

choices.text: Minor issues we can live with, then.
choices.zh: 那小问题我们可以接受。

choices.text: Minor issues that will ruin everything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Minor issues we can live with, then.

npcLine.en: The furnace is older and might need replacing soon.
npcLine.zh: 暖炉比较老了，可能很快就得换。

choices.text: Older, so let's budget for a new one.
choices.zh: 比较老，那我们就把换新的算进预算吧。

choices.text: Older, but I'll just ignore that completely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用比较级 → Older, so let's budget for a new one.

npcLine.en: Nothing here should stop you from making an offer.
npcLine.zh: 这里没什么问题会阻止你们出价的。

choices.text: Nothing should stop us — let's move forward.
choices.zh: 没什么能阻止我们——我们继续推进吧。

choices.text: Something should probably stop us, actually.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → Nothing should stop us — let's move forward.

npcLine.en: Your interest rate will depend on your credit history.
npcLine.zh: 您的利率会取决于您的信用记录。

choices.text: That'll work in our favor, I believe.
choices.zh: 我相信这会对我们有利。

choices.text: That'll work against us, definitely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 will 回应 → That'll work in our favor, I believe.

npcLine.en: How much of a down payment can you provide?
npcLine.zh: 您能付多少首付？

choices.text: We can put down twenty percent.
choices.zh: 我们能付百分之二十的首付。

choices.text: We can't provide any down payment.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ We can put down twenty percent.

npcLine.en: You've been approved for the mortgage amount you requested.
npcLine.zh: 您申请的贷款金额已经批准了。

choices.text: We've been approved? That's incredible news.
choices.zh: 批准了？这真是太棒的消息了。

choices.text: We've been rejected again, probably.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → We've been approved? That's incredible news.

scenes.title: Making an Offer
scenes.subtitle: 房产中介 · 提交报价

npcLine.en: If you offer slightly above asking, you'll likely win the bid.
npcLine.zh: 如果报价略高于要价，你们很可能会赢得竞价。

choices.text: If that helps, we'll offer a bit more.
choices.zh: 如果这样有用，我们就多加一点。

choices.text: If that helps, we'll offer far less instead.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If that helps, we'll offer a bit more.

npcLine.en: There's another buyer who's also very interested.
npcLine.zh: 还有另一位买家也很感兴趣。

choices.text: A buyer who wants it too? Let's move fast.
choices.zh: 也有买家想要？那我们得快点行动了。

choices.text: A buyer who wants it too doesn't concern us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → A buyer who wants it too? Let's move fast.

npcLine.en: Congratulations, your offer was accepted!
npcLine.zh: 恭喜，你们的报价被接受了！

choices.text: It was accepted? We actually did it!
choices.zh: 被接受了？我们真的做到了！

choices.text: It was rejected again, unfortunately.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用被动语态 → It was accepted? We actually did it!

scenes.title: Signing the Papers
scenes.subtitle: 律师事务所 · 签署文件

npcLine.en: Please review these closing documents before you sign.
npcLine.zh: 请在签字前先审阅这些成交文件。

choices.text: Of course, we'll take our time reading.
choices.zh: 当然，我们会仔细阅读。

choices.text: We'd rather sign without reading.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, we'll take our time reading.

npcLine.en: The keys will officially be yours after this signature.
npcLine.zh: 这个签名之后，钥匙就正式归你们了。

choices.text: After this? My hand is shaking already.
choices.zh: 这个签完就行？我的手已经在抖了。

choices.text: After this? I feel completely unmoved.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ After this? My hand is shaking already.

npcLine.en: It's official. Welcome to homeownership.
npcLine.zh: 正式生效了。欢迎成为房主。

choices.text: Homeowners, at last, together.
choices.zh: 我们终于一起成了房主。

choices.text: Homeowners, though it doesn't feel real yet.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Homeowners, at last, together.

transition.en: That afternoon, you stand outside your very own front door.
transition.zh: 那天下午，你们站在了属于自己的家门前。

scenes.title: Getting the Keys
scenes.subtitle: 新家门口 · 拿到钥匙

npcLine.en: Do you want to carry me over the threshold?
npcLine.zh: 你要不要把我抱过门槛？

choices.text: I've been waiting to ask you that myself.
choices.zh: 我正想问你这句话呢。

choices.text: I'd rather you walk in on your own.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've been waiting to ask you that myself.

npcLine.en: This empty living room is about to become our whole life.
npcLine.zh: 这间空荡荡的客厅马上就要变成我们的整个生活了。

choices.text: It's about to become everything to us.
choices.zh: 它马上就要成为我们的一切了。

choices.text: It's about to stay empty forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在进行时 → It's about to become everything to us.

npcLine.en: Our first house. I can hardly believe it's real.
npcLine.zh: 我们的第一套房子。我简直不敢相信这是真的。

choices.text: Real, and completely ours.
choices.zh: 是真的，而且完全是我们的了。

choices.text: Real, though it still feels borrowed.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Real, and completely ours.

npcLine.en: Should we hire movers, or do this ourselves?
npcLine.zh: 我们要请搬家公司，还是自己来？

choices.text: Do we really want to lift furniture ourselves?
choices.zh: 我们真的想自己搬家具吗？

choices.text: Do we own any furniture worth moving?

n1.hintOnWrong: 反问对方（do-question）→ Do we really want to lift furniture ourselves?

npcLine.en: If we hired movers, we'd save our backs at least.
npcLine.zh: 如果请搬家公司，至少能保住我们的腰。

choices.text: If we hired movers, that'd be worth the cost.
choices.zh: 如果请搬家公司，这钱花得值。

choices.text: If we hired movers, it'd be a total waste.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If we hired movers, that'd be worth the cost.

npcLine.en: Let's book a moving company for next Saturday.
npcLine.zh: 我们订个下周六的搬家公司吧。

choices.text: Let's book them right now, before they fill up.
choices.zh: 我们现在就订，免得约满了。

choices.text: Let's wait until the very last minute.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's book them right now, before they fill up.

transition.en: By evening, boxes fill every room of the new house.
transition.zh: 到了傍晚，新房子的每个房间都堆满了箱子。

npcLine.en: I've unpacked the kitchen, but the rest can wait.
npcLine.zh: 我已经把厨房收拾好了，剩下的可以慢慢来。

choices.text: The kitchen's done? That's the important part.
choices.zh: 厨房弄好了？那是最重要的部分。

choices.text: The kitchen's done, but who cares about that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → The kitchen's done? That's the important part.

npcLine.en: Where should we hang the picture from our wedding?
npcLine.zh: 我们婚礼那张照片该挂哪儿？

choices.text: Where else but right by the front door?
choices.zh: 还能挂哪儿，就挂在门口旁边吧。

choices.text: Where we hang it doesn't matter to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ Where else but right by the front door?

npcLine.en: This messy, half-unpacked house already feels like home.
npcLine.zh: 这个乱糟糟、还没收拾完的家，已经有家的感觉了。

choices.text: It already feels like home to me too.
choices.zh: 对我来说也已经有家的感觉了。

choices.text: It still feels like someone else's place.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ It already feels like home to me too.

transition.en: Months into homeownership, Emma seems unusually quiet one morning.
transition.zh: 住进新家几个月后，一天早上Emma显得格外安静。

scenes.title: A Strange Feeling
scenes.subtitle: 新家 · 一种奇怪的感觉

npcLine.en: I've been feeling a little off lately.
npcLine.zh: 我最近感觉有点不对劲。

choices.text: You've seemed a bit different, now that you mention it.
choices.zh: 你这么一说，我确实感觉你最近不太一样。

choices.text: You've seemed perfectly normal to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → You've seemed a bit different, now that you mention it.

npcLine.en: Should we pick up a pregnancy test, just to check?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要买个验孕棒，查一下？

choices.text: Let's go get one right now.
choices.zh: 我们现在就去买一个吧。

choices.text: Let's not worry about it at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's go get one right now.

npcLine.en: My hands are shaking just thinking about it.
npcLine.zh: 光是想到这个，我的手就在抖了。

choices.text: Mine are shaking too, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我的手也在抖。

choices.text: Mine feel completely steady, weirdly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Mine are shaking too, honestly.

npcLine.en: The instructions say to wait exactly three minutes.
npcLine.zh: 说明书上说要精确等三分钟。

choices.text: It said three minutes, so let's time it.
choices.zh: 上面说三分钟，那我们计时吧。

choices.text: It said three minutes, but let's just guess.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用间接引语回应 → It said three minutes, so let's time it.

npcLine.en: I can't look. Can you check it for me?
npcLine.zh: 我不敢看。你能帮我看一下吗？

choices.text: Of course I can. Here goes.
choices.zh: 当然可以。我来看了。

choices.text: I can't look either, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Of course I can. Here goes.

npcLine.en: Well? What does it say?
npcLine.zh: 怎么样？上面显示什么？

choices.text: It says two lines. We're having a baby.
choices.zh: 两条线。我们要有孩子了。

choices.text: It says one line. Better luck next time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ It says two lines. We're having a baby.

scenes.title: Processing the News
scenes.subtitle: 客厅 · 消化这个消息

npcLine.en: I'm terrified and thrilled at exactly the same time.
npcLine.zh: 我又害怕又激动，两种感觉同时出现。

choices.text: Same here, in equal, overwhelming amounts.
choices.zh: 我也是，两种感觉都汹涌得压倒一切。

choices.text: I feel nothing at all, weirdly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Same here, in equal, overwhelming amounts.

npcLine.en: If everything goes smoothly, we'll be parents by next spring.
npcLine.zh: 如果一切顺利，明年春天我们就是父母了。

choices.text: If it goes smoothly, spring can't come soon enough.
choices.zh: 如果顺利的话，真希望春天快点到。

choices.text: If it goes smoothly, I'd rather it took longer.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If it goes smoothly, spring can't come soon enough.

npcLine.en: We should probably tell everyone soon.
npcLine.zh: 我们大概应该尽快告诉大家。

choices.text: Soon, but let's enjoy just knowing for now.
choices.zh: 快了，但先让我们俩单独享受这个消息吧。

choices.text: Soon, though I'd rather never tell anyone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Soon, but let's enjoy just knowing for now.

transition.en: A few weeks later, you sit in a doctor's waiting room.
transition.zh: 几周后，你们坐在医生的候诊室里。

scenes.title: The First Appointment
scenes.subtitle: 妇产科 · 第一次产检

npcLine.en: Based on your dates, we estimate the due date in April.
npcLine.zh: 根据您的日期推算，预产期在四月。

choices.text: April? That's sooner than I imagined.
choices.zh: 四月？比我想的要快。

choices.text: April? That's much later than expected.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ April? That's sooner than I imagined.

npcLine.en: Would you like to hear the heartbeat?
npcLine.zh: 你们想听听胎心吗？

choices.text: Yes, more than anything.
choices.zh: 想，比任何事都想。

choices.text: No, we'd rather not know yet.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回答 → Yes, more than anything.

npcLine.en: That fast little sound is your baby's heartbeat.
npcLine.zh: 这个跳得快快的小声音，就是你们宝宝的心跳。

choices.text: That tiny sound just changed my whole life.
choices.zh: 这个小小的声音，彻底改变了我的人生。

choices.text: That tiny sound doesn't feel real yet.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ That tiny sound just changed my whole life.

npcLine.en: How's Emma doing this morning?
npcLine.zh: Emma今天早上怎么样？

choices.text: She's not feeling great, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，她感觉不太好。

choices.text: She's feeling perfectly fine, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ She's not feeling great, honestly.

npcLine.en: If crackers help, I can bring some over.
npcLine.zh: 如果饼干管用，我可以送一些过去。

choices.text: If you could, that would mean so much.
choices.zh: 如果你能，那真是太好了。

choices.text: If you could, please don't bother.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If you could, that would mean so much.

npcLine.en: Although it's rough right now, it won't last forever.
npcLine.zh: 尽管现在很难熬，但不会一直这样。

choices.text: Although it's rough, we're taking it day by day.
choices.zh: 尽管很难熬，我们就一天一天地扛过去。

choices.text: Although it's rough, nothing seems to help at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用让步连接词 → Although it's rough, we're taking it day by day.

transition.en: At Lily's House, you gather everyone for an announcement.
transition.zh: 在Lily之家，你们把大家聚起来宣布消息。

npcLine.en: You two look like you have something to say.
npcLine.zh: 你们俩看起来有话要说啊。

choices.text: We do. A very big something.
choices.zh: 确实有。一件很重要的事。

choices.text: We don't, actually. Never mind.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ We do. A very big something.

npcLine.en: We're expecting a baby in April.
npcLine.zh: 我们四月份要迎来一个宝宝了。

choices.text: A baby! This calls for a celebration.
choices.zh: 宝宝！这值得庆祝一下。

choices.text: A baby? That's unfortunate timing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单感叹（陈述句）→ A baby! This calls for a celebration.

npcLine.en: This house is about to have a whole new generation in it.
npcLine.zh: 这栋房子马上就要迎来新的一代人了。

choices.text: A new generation, right here with us.
choices.zh: 新的一代人，就在我们身边。

choices.text: A new generation, far away from here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ A new generation, right here with us.

npcLine.en: What if we named her after my grandmother?
npcLine.zh: 要是给她取名叫我祖母的名字呢？

choices.text: If we did, it would carry so much meaning.
choices.zh: 如果这样做，会承载太多意义了。

choices.text: If we did, it wouldn't mean anything special.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用更复杂的条件句 → If we did, it would carry so much meaning.

npcLine.en: Lily. It's a name that's already part of our story.
npcLine.zh: Lily。这是个已经属于我们故事的名字了。

choices.text: A name that's already part of us — perfect.
choices.zh: 一个已经属于我们的名字——太完美了。

choices.text: A name that's already part of us feels wrong.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用定语从句 → A name that's already part of us — perfect.

npcLine.en: We don't even know if it's a girl yet, and I already love that name.
npcLine.zh: 我们还不知道是不是女孩，但我已经爱上了这个名字。

choices.text: Whatever we have, that name will fit somehow.
choices.zh: 不管生的是什么，这个名字总会有办法用上。

choices.text: Whatever we have, we should pick something else.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Whatever we have, that name will fit somehow.

npcLine.en: Can you help me assemble this crib this weekend?
npcLine.zh: 这周末你能帮我组装这个婴儿床吗？

choices.text: Sure, I've watched a few videos on it.
choices.zh: 没问题，我看过几个教程视频了。

choices.text: I can't put furniture together at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 回应 → Sure, I've watched a few videos on it.

npcLine.en: What color should we paint the walls?
npcLine.zh: 墙壁我们该刷什么颜色？

choices.text: What about a soft, neutral yellow?
choices.zh: 用一种柔和的中性黄色怎么样？

choices.text: What we paint the walls doesn't matter.

n2.hintOnWrong: 提议（wh-question式）→ What about a soft, neutral yellow?

npcLine.en: This tiny room is going to hold our whole world soon.
npcLine.zh: 这间小小的房间很快就要装下我们的整个世界了。

choices.text: It'll hold everything that matters, soon enough.
choices.zh: 很快，它就会装下所有重要的一切。

choices.text: It'll probably stay empty for a while yet.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示未来 → It'll hold everything that matters, soon enough.

transition.en: Friends fill the backyard with balloons and gifts.
transition.zh: 朋友们把后院装点满了气球和礼物。

npcLine.en: We've all chipped in to get you the stroller you wanted.
npcLine.zh: 我们大家凑钱给你买了你想要的婴儿车。

choices.text: You've all chipped in? I'm overwhelmed.
choices.zh: 大家都凑了钱？我太感动了。

choices.text: You've all wasted your money, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → You've all chipped in? I'm overwhelmed.

npcLine.en: Everyone wanted to be part of welcoming this baby.
npcLine.zh: 大家都想参与迎接这个宝宝。

choices.text: This baby is loved before even arriving.
choices.zh: 这个宝宝还没出生就已经被这么多人爱着了。

choices.text: This baby will grow up without much love.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ This baby is loved before even arriving.

npcLine.en: This whole community is going to be her family too.
npcLine.zh: 这整个社区也将会是她的家人。

choices.text: She'll grow up with so many people loving her.
choices.zh: 她会在这么多人的爱中长大。

choices.text: She'll grow up not knowing any of you.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示预测 → She'll grow up with so many people loving her.

scenes.title: Waiting for April
scenes.subtitle: 新家 · 等待四月的到来

npcLine.en: I can feel her kicking right now. Come feel this.
npcLine.zh: 我现在能感觉到她在踢了。快来摸摸看。

choices.text: I'm coming, don't let her stop.
choices.zh: 我来了，让她别停。

choices.text: I'm staying right here, thanks.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ I'm coming, don't let her stop.

npcLine.en: In just a few more months, we won't be two anymore.
npcLine.zh: 再过几个月，我们就不再只是两个人了。

choices.text: We'll be three, and I can't wait.
choices.zh: 我们会变成三个人，我等不及了。

choices.text: We'll stay two forever, probably.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示未来 → We'll be three, and I can't wait.

npcLine.en: A decade apart, a wedding, a house, and now this. Life moves fast.
npcLine.zh: 分开十年、一场婚礼、一栋房子，现在又是这个。生活变化真快。

choices.text: It moves fast, and I love every second of it.
choices.zh: 确实很快，而我热爱其中的每一秒。

choices.text: It moves fast, and it scares me a little.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ It moves fast, and I love every second of it.

transition.en: With a baby on the way, the subject of a car comes up.
transition.zh: 随着宝宝即将出生，买车这件事被提上了日程。

npcLine.en: Neither of us has ever gotten a driver's license.
npcLine.zh: 我们俩谁都从没考过驾照。

choices.text: Neither of us has, but maybe it's time.
choices.zh: 确实都没有，但也许是时候了。

choices.text: Neither of us needs one, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → Neither of us has, but maybe it's time.

npcLine.en: With a stroller and diaper bags, we'll need a car eventually.
npcLine.zh: 带着婴儿车和尿布包，我们迟早会需要一辆车。

choices.text: We'll definitely need one before too long.
choices.zh: 我们肯定很快就会需要一辆车。

choices.text: We'll never really need a car, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示未来 → We'll definitely need one before too long.

npcLine.en: Let's sign up for driving lessons this week.
npcLine.zh: 我们这周就报名驾驶课吧。

choices.text: Let's sign up together, right now.
choices.zh: 我们现在就一起报名吧。

choices.text: Let's put it off for another year.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's sign up together, right now.

npcLine.en: Adjust your mirrors before you even start the engine.
npcLine.zh: 发动引擎之前先调好后视镜。

choices.text: Mirrors first, got it.
choices.zh: 先调后视镜，明白了。

choices.text: I'll skip the mirrors this time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Mirrors first, got it.

npcLine.en: Now, slowly ease off the brake and onto the gas.
npcLine.zh: 现在，慢慢松开刹车，轻踩油门。

choices.text: Slowly, okay. Here we go.
choices.zh: 慢慢来，好的。开始了。

choices.text: Slowly is boring, let's go fast.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Slowly, okay. Here we go.

npcLine.en: Not bad for a first try. You're a natural.
npcLine.zh: 第一次开成这样不错。你很有天赋。

choices.text: A natural? I'm relieved to hear that.
choices.zh: 有天赋？听到这话我松了口气。

choices.text: A natural? I nearly hit that cone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ A natural? I'm relieved to hear that.

npcLine.en: You'll need to score at least eighty percent to pass.
npcLine.zh: 您需要至少达到百分之八十才能通过。

choices.text: I'll aim for a hundred, just to be safe.
choices.zh: 我争取拿满分，稳妥一点。

choices.text: I'll aim for the lowest possible score.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示打算 → I'll aim for a hundred, just to be safe.

npcLine.en: Have you studied the road sign chapter closely?
npcLine.zh: 您仔细看过交通标志那一章吗？

choices.text: I've studied it more than any other chapter.
choices.zh: 这一章我看得比其他都仔细。

choices.text: I've never opened that chapter at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → I've studied it more than any other chapter.

npcLine.en: You scored ninety-five. Congratulations, you passed.
npcLine.zh: 您得了九十五分。恭喜，通过了。

choices.text: I passed? I can finally breathe again.
choices.zh: 通过了？我终于能松口气了。

choices.text: I passed, but I don't really care.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ I passed? I can finally breathe again.

transition.en: Weeks of practice later, it's finally time for the road test.
transition.zh: 经过几周练习，终于到了路考的日子。

npcLine.en: Please signal before you change lanes.
npcLine.zh: 变道前请打转向灯。

choices.text: Of course, signaling now.
choices.zh: 好的，正在打灯。

choices.text: I'd rather not signal, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌配合 → Of course, signaling now.

npcLine.en: Come to a complete stop at the sign ahead.
npcLine.zh: 在前面的停车标志前完全停稳。

choices.text: Stopping completely, right here.
choices.zh: 完全停下，就在这儿。

choices.text: I'll just roll through it a little.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Stopping completely, right here.

npcLine.en: That's the test complete. You passed with flying colors.
npcLine.zh: 测试完成了。您通过得非常出色。

choices.text: I did? This might be the best day ever.
choices.zh: 真的吗？这可能是最好的一天了。

choices.text: I did, but the whole test felt shaky.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ I did? This might be the best day ever.

npcLine.en: Are you looking for something new or used?
npcLine.zh: 您是想要新车还是二手车？

choices.text: Used, if it's still reliable.
choices.zh: 二手的，如果还可靠的话。

choices.text: New, and money doesn't matter.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回答 → Used, if it's still reliable.

npcLine.en: This model has great safety ratings for families.
npcLine.zh: 这款车对家庭来说安全评级很高。

choices.text: Safety ratings matter most to us right now.
choices.zh: 现在安全评级对我们来说最重要。

choices.text: Safety ratings don't concern us at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Safety ratings matter most to us right now.

npcLine.en: Would you like to take it for a test drive?
npcLine.zh: 您想试驾一下吗？

choices.text: Yes, let's take it around the block.
choices.zh: 好的，我们绕街区开一圈吧。

choices.text: No, I'll just buy it blindly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回答＋提议 → Yes, let's take it around the block.

npcLine.en: How does the steering feel to you?
npcLine.zh: 转向手感怎么样？

choices.text: It feels smoother than I expected.
choices.zh: 比我预期的要顺滑。

choices.text: It feels the same as every other car.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回答（陈述句）→ It feels smoother than I expected.

npcLine.en: There's plenty of trunk space for a stroller back there.
npcLine.zh: 后备箱空间足够放一辆婴儿车。

choices.text: Plenty of space — that settles it for me.
choices.zh: 空间足够——这一点让我定下心来了。

choices.text: Plenty of space we'll never actually use.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Plenty of space — that settles it for me.

npcLine.en: So, what do you think? Is this the one?
npcLine.zh: 那，你怎么想？就是这辆了吗？

choices.text: I think this is exactly the one.
choices.zh: 我觉得就是这辆了。

choices.text: I think we should keep looking elsewhere.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单表态（陈述句）→ I think this is exactly the one.

npcLine.en: Would you like to pay in full or finance monthly?
npcLine.zh: 您想一次付清，还是按月分期？

choices.text: We'd like to finance it monthly.
choices.zh: 我们想按月分期。

choices.text: We'd like to skip payment entirely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回答 → We'd like to finance it monthly.

npcLine.en: If you put more down now, your payments will be lower later.
npcLine.zh: 如果您现在多付一些首付，以后每月还款会更低。

choices.text: If that's true, let's put down more.
choices.zh: 如果是这样，那我们多付一些首付吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's put down nothing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用条件句 → If that's true, let's put down more.

npcLine.en: Sign here, and the car is officially yours.
npcLine.zh: 在这儿签字，这辆车就正式是您的了。

choices.text: Signing right now, no hesitation.
choices.zh: 现在就签，毫不犹豫。

choices.text: I need another week to think it over.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Signing right now, no hesitation.

npcLine.en: Would you like basic coverage or full coverage?
npcLine.zh: 您想要基础险还是全险？

choices.text: Full coverage, better safe than sorry.
choices.zh: 全险吧，安全总比后悔好。

choices.text: No coverage at all, we'll take our chances.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回答 → Full coverage, better safe than sorry.

npcLine.en: Since neither of you has had a ticket, your rate is quite low.
npcLine.zh: 由于你们俩都没有违章记录，费率相当低。

choices.text: Since it's low, that's a relief to hear.
choices.zh: 既然费率低，那真是让人松了口气。

choices.text: Since it's low, something must be wrong.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Since it's low, that's a relief to hear.

npcLine.en: You're fully insured and ready to drive off the lot.
npcLine.zh: 您已经全额投保，可以把车开走了。

choices.text: Fully insured, and finally free to drive.
choices.zh: 全额投保了，终于能开车走了。

choices.text: Fully insured, though I'm still nervous to drive.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Fully insured, and finally free to drive.

transition.en: You pull out of the lot in your very own car.
transition.zh: 你们开着自己的车，驶离了停车场。

scenes.title: The First Drive Home
scenes.subtitle: 车里 · 第一次自己开车回家

npcLine.en: I still can't believe we're actually driving right now.
npcLine.zh: 我到现在还是不敢相信我们真的在开车了。

choices.text: We're really driving, and it feels amazing.
choices.zh: 我们真的在开车，感觉太棒了。

choices.text: We're not really driving anywhere important.

n1.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ We're really driving, and it feels amazing.

npcLine.en: Should we take the long way home, just to enjoy it?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要绕远路回家，就为了多享受一下？

choices.text: Let's take the longest way possible.
choices.zh: 我们就走最远的那条路吧。

choices.text: Let's take the shortest route, please.

n2.hintOnWrong: 接受提议 → Let's take the longest way possible.

npcLine.en: Next stop: bringing our baby home in this very car.
npcLine.zh: 下一站：坐着这辆车把我们的宝宝接回家。

choices.text: This car will carry our whole family soon.
choices.zh: 很快，这辆车就会载着我们一家人。

choices.text: This car will probably sit unused for years.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 will 表示未来 → This car will carry our whole family soon.

scenes.title: Installing the Car Seat
scenes.subtitle: 车里 · 安装儿童安全座椅

npcLine.en: Can you help me figure out these straps?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我弄清楚这些安全带怎么用吗？

choices.text: Let me figure it out with you.
choices.zh: 我跟你一起弄清楚。

choices.text: I've never figured anything like that out.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用短语动词（figure out）→ Let me figure it out with you.

npcLine.en: This seat is supposed to click when it's secure.
npcLine.zh: 这个座椅装稳固之后应该会发出咔哒声。

choices.text: There it is, it's clicked into place.
choices.zh: 好了，咔哒一声装好了。

choices.text: There's no click at all, something's wrong.

n2.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ There it is, it's clicked into place.

npcLine.en: This car is finally, truly ready for our family.
npcLine.zh: 这辆车终于真正为我们一家人准备好了。

choices.text: Ready for all three of us, at last.
choices.zh: 终于为我们三个人准备好了。

choices.text: Ready for nobody, if I'm honest.

n3.hintOnWrong: 简单回应（陈述句）→ Ready for all three of us, at last.

transition.en: Before the baby arrives, they decide to get in shape together.
transition.zh: 在宝宝出生前，两人决定一起锻炼身体。

npcLine.en: Are you looking to sign up for a membership today?
npcLine.zh: 你们今天是想办理会员吗？

choices.text: Yes, we'd like to join together.
choices.zh: 是的，我们想一起加入。

choices.text: No, we've already joined elsewhere.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, we'd like to join together.

npcLine.en: We offer monthly plans and annual plans.
npcLine.zh: 我们有月付和年付两种方案。

choices.text: The annual plan sounds like a better deal.
choices.zh: 年付方案听起来更划算。

choices.text: Neither plan sounds worth it to us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句表达偏好 → The annual plan sounds like a better deal.

npcLine.en: Have you worked out at a gym before?
npcLine.zh: 你们以前在健身房锻炼过吗？

choices.text: We've never really worked out before.
choices.zh: 我们以前几乎没怎么锻炼过。

choices.text: We're working out here right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用现在完成时 → We've never really worked out before.

transition.en: A staff member introduces them to a personal trainer.
transition.zh: 一位工作人员把他们介绍给一名私人教练。

npcLine.en: What are your fitness goals?
npcLine.zh: 你们的健身目标是什么？

choices.text: We just want to build some healthy habits.
choices.zh: 我们只是想养成一些健康的习惯。

choices.text: We don't really have any goals.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答目标 → We just want to build some healthy habits.

npcLine.en: Can you do ten push-ups in a row?
npcLine.zh: 你能连续做十个俯卧撑吗？

choices.text: I can probably do a few, not ten.
choices.zh: 我大概能做几个，十个不行。

choices.text: I can't move my arms at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can probably do a few, not ten.

npcLine.en: I'll design a program based on your level.
npcLine.zh: 我会根据你们的水平设计一套训练计划。

choices.text: That would be really helpful, thank you.
choices.zh: 那真的会很有帮助，谢谢你。

choices.text: We'd rather just guess on our own.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That would be really helpful, thank you.

transition.en: The trainer runs a quick assessment to set a baseline.
transition.zh: 教练做了一次简单的体测来确定基础水平。

npcLine.en: Let's check your grip strength and your flexibility first.
npcLine.zh: 我们先测一下你的握力和柔韧性。

choices.text: Sounds good, let's get started.
choices.zh: 好的，我们开始吧。

choices.text: Let's skip all of that testing.

n1.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Sounds good, let's get started.

npcLine.en: Your flexibility is better than most beginners.
npcLine.zh: 你的柔韧性比大多数新手都要好。

choices.text: That's nice to hear, I do stretch often.
choices.zh: 听到这个真好，我确实经常拉伸。

choices.text: That's surprising, I never stretch at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's nice to hear, I do stretch often.

npcLine.en: If you train consistently, you'll see results within weeks.
npcLine.zh: 如果坚持训练，几周内就能看到效果。

choices.text: If that's true, I'm definitely staying consistent.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我一定会坚持下去。

choices.text: If that's true, I'll probably quit anyway.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, I'm definitely staying consistent.

transition.en: The trainer walks them through the equipment floor.
transition.zh: 教练带着他们熟悉器械区。

npcLine.en: This machine works your legs and your core.
npcLine.zh: 这台器械能锻炼你的腿部和核心肌群。

choices.text: I could definitely use stronger legs.
choices.zh: 我确实需要更强壮的腿。

choices.text: My legs are already the strongest part of me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I could definitely use stronger legs.

npcLine.en: Are you adjusting the seat before you start?
npcLine.zh: 开始前你要调整一下座椅吗？

choices.text: Yes, I'm adjusting it right now.
choices.zh: 是的，我正在调整。

choices.text: Yes, I adjusted it years ago.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → Yes, I'm adjusting it right now.

npcLine.en: Please keep your back straight during this exercise.
npcLine.zh: 做这个动作时请保持背部挺直。

choices.text: Of course, I'll keep it straight.
choices.zh: 当然，我会保持挺直的。

choices.text: Sorry, straight backs aren't really my thing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, I'll keep it straight.

transition.en: They decide to try a group fitness class together.
transition.zh: 他们决定一起试试团体健身课。

npcLine.en: Have you ever taken a spin class before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前上过动感单车课吗？

choices.text: I've taken one, but it was ages ago.
choices.zh: 上过一次，但那是很久以前了。

choices.text: I'm taking one at this exact moment.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've taken one, but it was ages ago.

npcLine.en: This class is more intense than yoga.
npcLine.zh: 这堂课比瑜伽课强度更大。

choices.text: That's fine, I like a challenge.
choices.zh: 没关系，我喜欢挑战。

choices.text: That's fine, I hate any kind of effort.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's fine, I like a challenge.

npcLine.en: Remember to drink water and pace yourself.
npcLine.zh: 记得多喝水，控制好自己的节奏。

choices.text: I will, and I'll take breaks if I need to.
choices.zh: 我会的，需要的话我也会休息一下。

choices.text: I will, but breaks are a waste of time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → I will, and I'll take breaks if I need to.

transition.en: A few weeks in, they check how far they've come.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们查看自己的进步情况。

npcLine.en: You've gotten noticeably stronger since your first week.
npcLine.zh: 从第一周到现在，你明显变强了。

choices.text: I've definitely felt the difference lately.
choices.zh: 我最近确实感觉到了变化。

choices.text: I've felt exactly the same the whole time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've definitely felt the difference lately.

npcLine.en: How many times a week are you training?
npcLine.zh: 你现在一周训练几次？

choices.text: I'm training about four times a week.
choices.zh: 我现在大概一周训练四次。

choices.text: Training isn't something I do at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答频率 → I'm training about four times a week.

npcLine.en: Your resting heart rate has dropped quite a bit.
npcLine.zh: 你的静息心率已经降低了不少。

choices.text: That's a great sign, I'm relieved to hear it.
choices.zh: 这是个好迹象，听到这个我松了口气。

choices.text: That's a bad sign, I'm worried about it now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → That's a great sign, I'm relieved to hear it.

transition.en: A minor injury interrupts their routine.
transition.zh: 一次轻微受伤打断了他们的训练计划。

npcLine.en: What happened to your shoulder?
npcLine.zh: 你的肩膀怎么了？

choices.text: I strained it lifting too much weight.
choices.zh: 我举太重的重量拉伤了它。

choices.text: Nothing happened, my shoulder is perfectly fine.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → I strained it lifting too much weight.

npcLine.en: If you rest it properly, it should heal fast.
npcLine.zh: 如果好好休息，应该很快就能痊愈。

choices.text: If that's true, I'll rest it this whole week.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我这一整周都会休息。

choices.text: If that's true, I'll ignore it completely.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, I'll rest it this whole week.

npcLine.en: Try lighter exercises until the pain is gone.
npcLine.zh: 在疼痛消失之前先做一些强度较轻的运动。

choices.text: Okay, and I'll ask the trainer for options.
choices.zh: 好的，我也会向教练咨询一下选择。

choices.text: Okay, but lighter exercises sound pointless to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → Okay, and I'll ask the trainer for options.

transition.en: The trainer helps them modify the routine around the injury.
transition.zh: 教练帮他们围绕伤情调整了训练计划。

npcLine.en: We should focus on your lower body for now.
npcLine.zh: 我们现在应该先专注练下半身。

choices.text: That makes sense, my legs need work anyway.
choices.zh: 有道理，反正我的腿也需要加强。

choices.text: That makes no sense, my legs are useless.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That makes sense, my legs need work anyway.

npcLine.en: Do these squats feel okay on your shoulder?
npcLine.zh: 做这些深蹲你的肩膀感觉还好吗？

choices.text: Yes, my shoulder feels totally fine here.
choices.zh: 是的，我的肩膀在这个动作里完全没问题。

choices.text: No, I've never done a squat in my life.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, my shoulder feels totally fine here.

npcLine.en: We'll add the shoulder work back in gradually.
npcLine.zh: 我们会逐渐把肩膀训练加回来。

choices.text: That sounds like a smart, careful approach.
choices.zh: 这听起来是个明智又谨慎的做法。

choices.text: That sounds way too slow for me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That sounds like a smart, careful approach.

transition.en: Months later, they hit a milestone they're proud of.
transition.zh: 几个月后，他们达成了一个值得骄傲的里程碑。

npcLine.en: You've hit your goal weight for the squat.
npcLine.zh: 你的深蹲已经达到目标重量了。

choices.text: I can't believe I've actually done it.
choices.zh: 我真不敢相信自己真的做到了。

choices.text: I've never once tried the squat before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I can't believe I've actually done it.

npcLine.en: How does it feel to reach this goal?
npcLine.zh: 达成这个目标感觉怎么样？

choices.text: It feels amazing, all the work paid off.
choices.zh: 感觉太棒了，所有的努力都值得了。

choices.text: It doesn't feel like anything at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → It feels amazing, all the work paid off.

npcLine.en: Congratulations, that's genuinely impressive progress.
npcLine.zh: 恭喜你，这真的是了不起的进步。

choices.text: Thank you, I couldn't have done it without your help.
choices.zh: 谢谢你，没有你的帮助我做不到这些。

choices.text: Thank you, though I did all of it myself.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you, I couldn't have done it without your help.

transition.en: With the baby due soon, they talk about keeping the habit alive.
transition.zh: 宝宝快出生了，他们聊起该如何保持这个习惯。

npcLine.en: Once the baby comes, how will we keep exercising?
npcLine.zh: 宝宝出生以后，我们要怎么继续锻炼？

choices.text: We'll probably take turns watching the baby.
choices.zh: 我们大概会轮流照看宝宝。

choices.text: We'll probably just stop exercising forever.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答计划 → We'll probably take turns watching the baby.

npcLine.en: The gym has a daycare room for members.
npcLine.zh: 健身房给会员提供了一间托儿室。

choices.text: That's perfect, that solves our whole problem.
choices.zh: 太完美了，这解决了我们所有的问题。

choices.text: That's useless, we would never use that room.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's perfect, that solves our whole problem.

npcLine.en: Let's keep this up together, no matter what.
npcLine.zh: 不管怎样，我们一起坚持下去吧。

choices.text: Let's keep this up together, always.
choices.zh: 我们一起坚持下去，永远如此。

choices.text: Let's just give this up right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's keep this up together, always.

transition.en: The nursery they painted and set up themselves last month has hit a snag — the paint is already peeling, and pulling back the carpet to check reveals water damage underneath. They call in a contractor to fix it properly.
transition.zh: 他们上个月自己刷漆布置的婴儿房出了点问题——油漆已经开始掉皮，掀开地毯检查时还发现底下有水损。他们决定请一位专业的承包商来彻底处理。

npcLine.en: What kind of renovation are you planning?
npcLine.zh: 你们打算做什么样的装修？

choices.text: We're turning this room into a nursery.
choices.zh: 我们要把这个房间改成婴儿房。

choices.text: We're not planning any renovation at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答计划 → We're turning this room into a nursery.

npcLine.en: Do you have a budget in mind?
npcLine.zh: 你们心里有预算数字吗？

choices.text: Yes, we're hoping to stay under five thousand.
choices.zh: 有的，我们希望控制在五千以内。

choices.text: No, money doesn't matter to us at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, we're hoping to stay under five thousand.

npcLine.en: I'll put together an estimate by Friday.
npcLine.zh: 我会在周五之前给你们一份报价。

choices.text: That works great, we'll wait to hear from you.
choices.zh: 那太好了，我们等你的消息。

choices.text: That's too slow, we needed it yesterday.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That works great, we'll wait to hear from you.

transition.en: They visit a hardware store to pick paint colors.
transition.zh: 他们去五金店挑选油漆颜色。

npcLine.en: Are you looking for a bright color or something neutral?
npcLine.zh: 你们想要鲜艳的颜色还是中性色？

choices.text: Something neutral would be safer for now.
choices.zh: 现在选中性色会更保险一些。

choices.text: Something neutral sounds much too boring.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句表达偏好 → Something neutral would be safer for now.

npcLine.en: This paint is more durable than the cheaper brand.
npcLine.zh: 这种油漆比便宜的牌子更耐用。

choices.text: Durable is worth the extra cost to us.
choices.zh: 耐用对我们来说值这个额外花费。

choices.text: Durable doesn't matter, we'll repaint every year.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Durable is worth the extra cost to us.

npcLine.en: How many gallons do you think you'll need?
npcLine.zh: 你们觉得需要买几加仑？

choices.text: I think two gallons should cover it.
choices.zh: 我觉得两加仑应该够用了。

choices.text: I think paint is something we don't need.

n3.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → I think two gallons should cover it.

transition.en: Work begins by tearing out the old carpet.
transition.zh: 工程从撕掉旧地毯开始。

npcLine.en: This carpet has been here since the house was built.
npcLine.zh: 这块地毯从这房子建成就一直在这儿了。

choices.text: It's definitely been here far too long.
choices.zh: 它在这儿的时间确实太久了。

choices.text: It's never actually been here before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → It's definitely been here far too long.

npcLine.en: Watch out for nails as you pull it up.
npcLine.zh: 拉起地毯的时候要小心钉子。

choices.text: Thanks for the warning, I'll wear gloves.
choices.zh: 谢谢提醒，我会戴上手套的。

choices.text: Thanks, but gloves seem unnecessary here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Thanks for the warning, I'll wear gloves.

npcLine.en: Once the carpet is gone, we'll check the subfloor.
npcLine.zh: 地毯拆掉之后，我们会检查一下底层地板。

choices.text: Sounds good, and let me know what you find.
choices.zh: 好的，如果发现什么问题告诉我一声。

choices.text: Sounds good, but I don't want to know.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → Sounds good, and let me know what you find.

transition.en: The subfloor reveals an unexpected problem.
transition.zh: 底层地板暴露出一个意外的问题。

npcLine.en: There's some water damage on this section of the floor.
npcLine.zh: 地板这一部分有一些水损。

choices.text: That's concerning, how bad is the damage?
choices.zh: 这挺让人担心的，损坏有多严重？

choices.text: That's fine, water damage never matters.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's concerning, how bad is the damage?

npcLine.en: If we replace this section now, it won't spread.
npcLine.zh: 如果现在就更换这一部分，问题就不会扩散。

choices.text: If that's the fix, let's do it right away.
choices.zh: 如果这样能解决，那我们马上就做。

choices.text: If that's the fix, let's just ignore it.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's the fix, let's do it right away.

npcLine.en: This will add a bit to the original estimate.
npcLine.zh: 这会比原来的报价多花一点钱。

choices.text: That's understandable, we'd rather fix it properly.
choices.zh: 这可以理解，我们更希望把它彻底修好。

choices.text: That's unacceptable, we won't pay a cent more.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's understandable, we'd rather fix it properly.

transition.en: New laminate flooring goes in over a few days.
transition.zh: 新的复合地板花了几天时间铺设完成。

npcLine.en: Are you happy with how the flooring looks so far?
npcLine.zh: 目前地板的样子你们满意吗？

choices.text: Yes, it's coming together beautifully.
choices.zh: 是的，效果非常好。

choices.text: No, we haven't looked at it once.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it's coming together beautifully.

npcLine.en: This laminate is easier to clean than carpet.
npcLine.zh: 这种复合地板比地毯更容易清洁。

choices.text: Easier to clean matters a lot with a baby coming.
choices.zh: 宝宝快出生了，好清洁真的很重要。

choices.text: Easier to clean doesn't matter to us at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Easier to clean matters a lot with a baby coming.

npcLine.en: Give it twenty-four hours before moving furniture on it.
npcLine.zh: 在上面放家具之前请等二十四小时。

choices.text: Got it, we'll wait a full day before that.
choices.zh: 明白了，我们会等满一整天再放。

choices.text: Got it, though waiting sounds pointless to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Got it, we'll wait a full day before that.

transition.en: The couple spends a Saturday painting the room themselves.
transition.zh: 夫妻俩花了一个周六自己粉刷房间。

npcLine.en: Have you ever painted a room before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前刷过房间吗？

choices.text: I've painted one room, years ago.
choices.zh: 我几年前刷过一个房间。

choices.text: I'm painting a room right this second.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've painted one room, years ago.

npcLine.en: Are you taping the edges before we start?
npcLine.zh: 开始之前你要贴一下边缘的胶带吗？

choices.text: Yes, I'm taping them right now.
choices.zh: 是的，我正在贴胶带。

choices.text: Yes, I taped them last summer.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → Yes, I'm taping them right now.

npcLine.en: Let's do two coats to make sure it's even.
npcLine.zh: 我们刷两层，确保颜色均匀。

choices.text: Sounds smart, two coats it is.
choices.zh: 听起来很明智，那就刷两层吧。

choices.text: Let's just do one coat and hope for the best.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Sounds smart, two coats it is.

transition.en: With the new flooring finally down, they move the crib back into the room and put it back together.
transition.zh: 新地板终于铺好了，他们把婴儿床搬回房间，重新组装起来。

npcLine.en: Can you find the instruction manual in the box?
npcLine.zh: 你能在箱子里找到说明书吗？

choices.text: I can see it right here on top.
choices.zh: 我能看到它就在最上面。

choices.text: I can't find any manual anywhere.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can see it right here on top.

npcLine.en: This piece is heavier than it looks.
npcLine.zh: 这块板子比看起来要重。

choices.text: You're right, let's lift it together.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我们一起抬吧。

choices.text: You're wrong, it feels perfectly light.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → You're right, let's lift it together.

npcLine.en: Make sure every screw is tightened before we test it.
npcLine.zh: 测试之前要确保每颗螺丝都拧紧了。

choices.text: Will do, and I'll double-check each one.
choices.zh: 会的，我也会再检查一遍每一颗。

choices.text: Will do, but checking screws is a waste of time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → Will do, and I'll double-check each one.

transition.en: They add blackout curtains for better sleep.
transition.zh: 他们装上遮光窗帘，方便宝宝睡觉。

npcLine.en: Why did you choose blackout curtains for this room?
npcLine.zh: 你们为什么给这间房选了遮光窗帘？

choices.text: We chose them so the baby can nap during the day.
choices.zh: 我们选它是为了让宝宝白天也能睡着。

choices.text: We chose them because color didn't matter.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → We chose them so the baby can nap during the day.

npcLine.en: Could you hold the rod steady while I hang this?
npcLine.zh: 我挂窗帘的时候你能扶稳窗帘杆吗？

choices.text: Sure, I've got it steady for you.
choices.zh: 好的，我给你扶稳了。

choices.text: Sorry, holding things isn't really my job.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Sure, I've got it steady for you.

npcLine.en: These curtains block almost all of the light.
npcLine.zh: 这些窗帘几乎能挡住所有的光线。

choices.text: Perfect, that's exactly what we wanted.
choices.zh: 太好了，这正是我们想要的。

choices.text: Perfect, though we wanted more light in here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Perfect, that's exactly what we wanted.

transition.en: The contractor does a final walkthrough with them.
transition.zh: 承包商和他们一起做最后的验收。

npcLine.en: Have you noticed any issues since the paint dried?
npcLine.zh: 油漆干了之后你们有发现什么问题吗？

choices.text: We haven't noticed anything wrong at all.
choices.zh: 我们完全没发现什么问题。

choices.text: We've noticed problems in every single corner.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We haven't noticed anything wrong at all.

npcLine.en: This room turned out even better than we planned.
npcLine.zh: 这间房间的效果比我们计划的还要好。

choices.text: It really did, thank you for the great work.
choices.zh: 确实如此，谢谢你的出色工作。

choices.text: It really didn't, we're quite disappointed honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, thank you for the great work.

npcLine.en: Thank you both for trusting me with this project.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你们俩把这个项目交给我。

choices.text: Thank you, we couldn't be happier with the result.
choices.zh: 谢谢你，我们对结果非常满意。

choices.text: Thank you, though we're not happy at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you, we couldn't be happier with the result.

transition.en: They stand in the finished nursery for the first time.
transition.zh: 他们第一次站在装修完成的婴儿房里。

npcLine.en: Can you believe this room is actually finished?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信这间房间真的完工了吗？

choices.text: I can barely believe how much has changed.
choices.zh: 我几乎不敢相信变化有这么大。

choices.text: I can't tell that anything has changed here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/程度 → I can barely believe how much has changed.

npcLine.en: It's finally starting to feel real, isn't it?
npcLine.zh: 这终于开始感觉真实了，不是吗？

choices.text: It really is, we're actually parents soon.
choices.zh: 确实是这样，我们很快就要当父母了。

choices.text: It really isn't, nothing feels different at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, we're actually parents soon.

npcLine.en: Let's take a picture before we fill it with toys.
npcLine.zh: 在这里堆满玩具之前，我们拍张照片吧。

choices.text: Let's take a picture right now.
choices.zh: 我们现在就拍张照片吧。

choices.text: Let's skip the picture, it doesn't matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's take a picture right now.

transition.en: On a quiet weekend, they visit an animal shelter.
transition.zh: 一个安静的周末，他们去了一家动物收容所。

npcLine.en: Are you hoping to adopt a puppy or an older dog?
npcLine.zh: 你们是想领养幼犬还是成年犬？

choices.text: An older dog might actually suit us better.
choices.zh: 成年犬可能其实更适合我们。

choices.text: A puppy would be way too calm for us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句表达偏好 → An older dog might actually suit us better.

npcLine.en: Have you had a dog before?
npcLine.zh: 你们以前养过狗吗？

choices.text: We've never had one, but we've read a lot.
choices.zh: 我们从没养过，但看了很多资料。

choices.text: We're having one at this exact moment.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've never had one, but we've read a lot.

npcLine.en: This dog is calmer than most of the others here.
npcLine.zh: 这只狗比这里的大多数狗都要安静。

choices.text: Calmer sounds perfect with a baby on the way.
choices.zh: 宝宝快出生了，安静一点正合适。

choices.text: Calmer sounds boring, we want an energetic one.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Calmer sounds perfect with a baby on the way.

transition.en: A volunteer brings the dog out to meet them.
transition.zh: 一位志愿者把这只狗带出来见他们。

npcLine.en: What's his name and how old is he?
npcLine.zh: 他叫什么名字，多大了？

choices.text: His name is Biscuit, and he's about four.
choices.zh: 他叫比斯吉，大概四岁。

choices.text: His name doesn't matter to us at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答信息 → His name is Biscuit, and he's about four.

npcLine.en: Can you sit down here so he gets used to you?
npcLine.zh: 你能坐在这里让他熟悉一下你吗？

choices.text: I can definitely sit here for a while.
choices.zh: 我完全可以在这儿坐一会儿。

choices.text: I can't sit still for even a minute.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can definitely sit here for a while.

npcLine.en: He's sniffing your hand, that's a good sign.
npcLine.zh: 他在闻你的手，这是个好迹象。

choices.text: He's warming up to me already.
choices.zh: 他已经开始对我有好感了。

choices.text: He's ignoring me completely right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → He's warming up to me already.

transition.en: A staff member asks a few questions before approving the adoption.
transition.zh: 一位工作人员在批准领养前问了几个问题。

npcLine.en: Do you have a fenced yard at home?
npcLine.zh: 你们家里有围栏院子吗？

choices.text: Yes, we have a small fenced yard.
choices.zh: 是的，我们有一个小的围栏院子。

choices.text: No, we live inside an active volcano.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, we have a small fenced yard.

npcLine.en: If he has anxiety, will you commit to training?
npcLine.zh: 如果他有焦虑情绪，你们会坚持训练吗？

choices.text: If that happens, we'll absolutely commit to training.
choices.zh: 如果真是那样，我们一定会坚持训练。

choices.text: If that happens, we'll just give up on him.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that happens, we'll absolutely commit to training.

npcLine.en: We'll follow up with a home visit next week.
npcLine.zh: 我们下周会安排一次家访跟进。

choices.text: That's fine, we'll be ready for the visit.
choices.zh: 没问题，我们会为家访做好准备。

choices.text: That's odd, a visit seems unnecessary to us.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's fine, we'll be ready for the visit.

transition.en: Before bringing him home, they take him for a vet checkup.
transition.zh: 带他回家前，他们先带他去做兽医体检。

npcLine.en: Has he had all of his vaccinations?
npcLine.zh: 他所有的疫苗都打过了吗？

choices.text: He's had most, but he's due for one more.
choices.zh: 大部分都打了，但还差一针。

choices.text: He's having a vaccination this very second.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → He's had most, but he's due for one more.

npcLine.en: His weight is actually pretty healthy for his size.
npcLine.zh: 以他的体型来说，他的体重其实挺健康的。

choices.text: That's great news, I was a little worried.
choices.zh: 这真是个好消息，我之前还有点担心。

choices.text: That's bad news, we expected him to be thinner.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's great news, I was a little worried.

npcLine.en: Please bring him back if he seems off in any way.
npcLine.zh: 如果他有任何不对劲的地方，请带他回来。

choices.text: Of course, we'll keep a close eye on him.
choices.zh: 当然，我们会密切留意他的状态。

choices.text: Of course, though we probably won't notice anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, we'll keep a close eye on him.

transition.en: The dog's first night in the new house is a little rough.
transition.zh: 这只狗在新家的第一晚有点不顺利。

npcLine.en: He's whining and pacing by the door.
npcLine.zh: 他在门边呜咽着来回走动。

choices.text: He's probably just nervous in a new place.
choices.zh: 他可能只是在陌生的地方感到紧张。

choices.text: He's clearly enjoying every second of this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → He's probably just nervous in a new place.

npcLine.en: Should we let him sleep in our room tonight?
npcLine.zh: 我们今晚要不要让他睡在我们房间？

choices.text: Yes, just for tonight, that should help.
choices.zh: 好，就今晚，这样应该会有帮助。

choices.text: No, he should sleep outside in the yard.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, just for tonight, that should help.

npcLine.en: If we stay calm, he'll settle down eventually.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们保持冷静，他最终会安定下来。

choices.text: If that's true, let's just be patient.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，那我们就耐心一点吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's give up right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, let's just be patient.

transition.en: They sign the dog up for a basic obedience class.
transition.zh: 他们给他报了一个基础服从训练课程。

npcLine.en: Does he know any commands already?
npcLine.zh: 他已经会一些指令了吗？

choices.text: Yes, he already knows sit and stay.
choices.zh: 会的，他已经会坐下和等待了。

choices.text: No, he doesn't understand a single word.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, he already knows sit and stay.

npcLine.en: Consistency matters more than the exact commands you use.
npcLine.zh: 一致性比你用的具体指令更重要。

choices.text: That makes sense, we'll try to stay consistent.
choices.zh: 有道理，我们会尽量保持一致。

choices.text: That makes no sense, exact words matter most.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, we'll try to stay consistent.

npcLine.en: Great job today, and keep practicing at home.
npcLine.zh: 今天表现很好，回家继续练习。

choices.text: Thanks, and we'll practice every single day.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们会每天都练习的。

choices.text: Thanks, but practicing at home sounds tiring.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → Thanks, and we'll practice every single day.

transition.en: They come home to find a chewed-up shoe.
transition.zh: 他们回家发现一只鞋被咬烂了。

npcLine.en: What happened to your shoe?
npcLine.zh: 你的鞋子怎么了？

choices.text: He chewed it up while we were out.
choices.zh: 我们出门的时候他把它咬烂了。

choices.text: Nothing happened, my shoe is perfectly fine.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → He chewed it up while we were out.

npcLine.en: We should buy him some proper chew toys.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该给他买一些正经的咬胶玩具。

choices.text: Good idea, let's get some this weekend.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们这周末就去买。

choices.text: Bad idea, he doesn't need any toys.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, let's get some this weekend.

npcLine.en: Try not to be too upset, it's a common phase.
npcLine.zh: 别太生气了，这是很常见的一个阶段。

choices.text: You're right, and it's just an old shoe anyway.
choices.zh: 你说得对，反正也只是一只旧鞋子。

choices.text: You're right, but I'm still furious about it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → You're right, and it's just an old shoe anyway.

transition.en: With both a baby and a dog coming, they baby-proof and dog-proof the house together.
transition.zh: 宝宝和狗都快到位了，他们一起把家里做了防护。

npcLine.en: We already baby-proofed the outlets last month.
npcLine.zh: 我们上个月已经给插座做了婴儿防护。

choices.text: Good, now let's dog-proof the low cabinets too.
choices.zh: 很好，我们再把低处的柜子也做好狗狗防护。

choices.text: Good, the low cabinets don't need any changes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时陈述 → Good, now let's dog-proof the low cabinets too.

npcLine.en: Can you move the trash can somewhere he can't reach?
npcLine.zh: 你能把垃圾桶挪到他够不到的地方吗？

choices.text: I can move it under the sink right now.
choices.zh: 我现在就能把它挪到水槽下面。

choices.text: I can't be bothered to move anything today.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can move it under the sink right now.

npcLine.en: This house is getting ready for two new family members.
npcLine.zh: 这个家正在为两位新家庭成员做准备。

choices.text: It really is, and we couldn't be more excited.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们非常激动。

choices.text: It really isn't, nothing has changed here at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → It really is, and we couldn't be more excited.

transition.en: They let the dog sniff around the finished nursery.
transition.zh: 他们让狗在装修好的婴儿房里到处闻一闻。

scenes.title: Introducing the Dog to the Crib
scenes.subtitle: 婴儿房 · 提前适应

npcLine.en: Let him sniff the crib so he gets curious, not scared.
npcLine.zh: 让他闻闻婴儿床，这样他会好奇而不是害怕。

choices.text: Let's do that slowly, one step at a time.
choices.zh: 我们慢慢来，一步一步地进行。

choices.text: Let's just keep him out of this room forever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that slowly, one step at a time.

npcLine.en: He seems calm and pretty curious about the room.
npcLine.zh: 他看起来很平静，对这个房间也挺好奇的。

choices.text: That's reassuring, I was worried he'd be anxious.
choices.zh: 这让我安心多了，我之前担心他会焦虑。

choices.text: That's concerning, calm dogs worry me the most.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, I was worried he'd be anxious.

npcLine.en: We'll keep practicing this every few days before the baby comes.
npcLine.zh: 在宝宝出生前，我们会每隔几天就这样练习一次。

choices.text: That sounds like a really solid plan.
choices.zh: 这听起来是个非常靠谱的计划。

choices.text: That sounds like way too much effort.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That sounds like a really solid plan.

transition.en: The couple looks around at the nursery, the dog, and each other.
transition.zh: 夫妻俩看看婴儿房，看看狗，又看看彼此。

npcLine.en: We've come such a long way since we met, haven't we?
npcLine.zh: 从我们相遇到现在，我们已经走了很长的路，不是吗？

choices.text: We really have, and I wouldn't change a thing.
choices.zh: 确实是这样，我什么都不想改变。

choices.text: We really haven't, everything feels exactly the same.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, and I wouldn't change a thing.

npcLine.en: How does it feel knowing our family is about to grow?
npcLine.zh: 想到我们的家庭即将壮大，你感觉如何？

choices.text: It feels overwhelming in the best possible way.
choices.zh: 感觉难以置信，但是是最美好的那种。

choices.text: It doesn't feel like anything special to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → It feels overwhelming in the best possible way.

npcLine.en: Let's promise to figure it all out together, no matter what.
npcLine.zh: 我们约定好，不管发生什么都要一起面对。

choices.text: Let's promise that, together, always.
choices.zh: 我们约定好，永远在一起面对。

choices.text: Let's not make any promises right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's promise that, together, always.

transition.en: Spring arrives, and with it, tax season.
transition.zh: 春天到了，报税季也随之而来。

npcLine.en: Are we filing jointly this year, since we're married now?
npcLine.zh: 既然我们结婚了，今年是不是要联合报税？

choices.text: Yes, filing jointly should save us money.
choices.zh: 是的，联合报税应该能帮我们省钱。

choices.text: No, married couples can't file taxes together.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, filing jointly should save us money.

npcLine.en: Have you gathered your income slips yet?
npcLine.zh: 你收集好收入单据了吗？

choices.text: I've gathered most, but a few are missing.
choices.zh: 大部分都收集好了，但有几张还没找到。

choices.text: I'm gathering them at this exact moment.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've gathered most, but a few are missing.

npcLine.en: We should probably hire an accountant this year.
npcLine.zh: 今年我们大概应该请个会计师。

choices.text: That's a good idea, our situation's more complicated now.
choices.zh: 这是个好主意，我们的情况现在更复杂了。

choices.text: That's unnecessary, taxes are always simple for us.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's a good idea, our situation's more complicated now.

transition.en: They sit down with an accountant for the first time.
transition.zh: 他们第一次和一位会计师坐下来谈。

scenes.title: Meeting the Accountant
scenes.subtitle: 会计事务所 · 首次咨询

npcLine.en: Did you buy a house or have a child last year?
npcLine.zh: 你们去年买房了或者有孩子了吗？

choices.text: No, but we're expecting a baby this year.
choices.zh: 没有，不过我们今年会迎来一个宝宝。

choices.text: No, and nothing has changed in years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答但补充信息 → No, but we're expecting a baby this year.

npcLine.en: This deduction could lower what you owe significantly.
npcLine.zh: 这项抵扣能大幅降低你们要缴的税。

choices.text: If it helps that much, let's definitely claim it.
choices.zh: 如果能有这么大帮助，那我们一定要申报它。

choices.text: If it helps that much, let's skip it anyway.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If it helps that much, let's definitely claim it.

npcLine.en: I'll have everything ready for you by next week.
npcLine.zh: 下周之前我会把一切都准备好给你们。

choices.text: Perfect, we really appreciate your help with this.
choices.zh: 太好了，非常感谢你在这方面的帮助。

choices.text: Perfect, though we don't actually need any help.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Perfect, we really appreciate your help with this.

transition.en: That weekend, they sort through a shoebox of receipts.
transition.zh: 那个周末，他们整理了一鞋盒的收据。

npcLine.en: Why do we have so many receipts from last spring?
npcLine.zh: 为什么我们有这么多去年春天的收据？

choices.text: We probably saved them for the renovation deductions.
choices.zh: 我们大概是为了装修抵扣才留下的。

choices.text: We probably saved them for no reason at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → We probably saved them for the renovation deductions.

npcLine.en: This pile is more organized than that one over there.
npcLine.zh: 这一堆比那边那一堆整理得更好。

choices.text: Let's use this pile as our system, then.
choices.zh: 那我们就用这一堆的方式来整理吧。

choices.text: Let's ignore that and mix them all together.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's use this pile as our system, then.

npcLine.en: Can you scan these while I make some coffee?
npcLine.zh: 我去泡咖啡的时候你能把这些扫描一下吗？

choices.text: I can start scanning them right now.
choices.zh: 我现在就能开始扫描。

choices.text: I can't scan anything, the scanner is broken.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can start scanning them right now.

transition.en: They discuss whether working from home counts for a deduction.
transition.zh: 他们讨论在家办公是否能算作一项抵扣。

scenes.title: The Work-From-Home Deduction
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 居家办公抵扣

npcLine.en: How many days a week do you work from home?
npcLine.zh: 你一周有几天在家办公？

choices.text: I work from home about three days a week.
choices.zh: 我一周大概有三天在家办公。

choices.text: Working from home isn't something I do.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答频率 → I work from home about three days a week.

npcLine.en: Have you kept track of your home office expenses?
npcLine.zh: 你有记录居家办公的开销吗？

choices.text: I've kept a rough record on my phone.
choices.zh: 我在手机上大概记了一下。

choices.text: I've never once thought about tracking that.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've kept a rough record on my phone.

npcLine.en: This could add up to a nice deduction.
npcLine.zh: 这累积起来可能是一笔不错的抵扣。

choices.text: That's great, every bit helps this year.
choices.zh: 太好了，今年每一点都有帮助。

choices.text: That's pointless, small amounts never matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's great, every bit helps this year.

transition.en: The accountant reviews the draft return with them.
transition.zh: 会计师和他们一起审核报税草稿。

scenes.title: Double-Checking the Numbers
scenes.subtitle: 会计事务所 · 核对数字

npcLine.en: Does this total match what you expected?
npcLine.zh: 这个总数和你预期的一致吗？

choices.text: Yes, it's actually pretty close to what I expected.
choices.zh: 是的，和我预期的其实挺接近的。

choices.text: No, taxes are something I never think about.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it's actually pretty close to what I expected.

npcLine.en: This number is higher than I originally estimated.
npcLine.zh: 这个数字比我最初估算的要高。

choices.text: Higher is fine, as long as it's accurate.
choices.zh: 只要准确，高一点也没关系。

choices.text: Higher is unacceptable, please just make it lower.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Higher is fine, as long as it's accurate.

npcLine.en: If everything checks out, I'll submit it tomorrow.
npcLine.zh: 如果一切都没问题，我明天就提交。

choices.text: If it all looks right, please go ahead.
choices.zh: 如果一切都没问题，那就请提交吧。

choices.text: If it all looks right, let's wait another month.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If it all looks right, please go ahead.

transition.en: With everything confirmed, they submit the joint tax return.
transition.zh: 一切确认无误后，他们提交了联合报税表。

scenes.title: Submitting the Return
scenes.subtitle: 会计事务所 · 提交报税

npcLine.en: I'm submitting it online right now.
npcLine.zh: 我现在正在网上提交。

choices.text: Great, let me know once it goes through.
choices.zh: 太好了，提交成功了告诉我一声。

choices.text: Great, though I don't care when it's done.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → Great, let me know once it goes through.

npcLine.en: It's submitted, and you should get a confirmation email.
npcLine.zh: 已经提交了，你们应该会收到一封确认邮件。

choices.text: Great, and thank you for handling everything so well.
choices.zh: 太好了，也谢谢你把一切都处理得这么好。

choices.text: Great, but I doubt we'll get any email.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → Great, and thank you for handling everything so well.

npcLine.en: How long does it usually take to hear back?
npcLine.zh: 通常要多久才能收到回复？

choices.text: It usually takes a few weeks, I believe.
choices.zh: 我记得通常要几周时间。

choices.text: It usually takes about ten seconds total.

n3.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时长 → It usually takes a few weeks, I believe.

transition.en: A few weeks later, a notice arrives about their refund.
transition.zh: 几周后，一封关于退税的通知到了。

npcLine.en: We've been approved for a refund!
npcLine.zh: 我们的退税已经获批了！

choices.text: I've been hoping for good news all week.
choices.zh: 我这一整周都盼着有好消息。

choices.text: I've never once hoped for anything like this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've been hoping for good news all week.

npcLine.en: This refund is bigger than we expected.
npcLine.zh: 这笔退税比我们预期的要多。

choices.text: Bigger is always a pleasant surprise.
choices.zh: 多一点总是个惊喜。

choices.text: Bigger sounds suspicious, something must be wrong.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Bigger is always a pleasant surprise.

npcLine.en: What should we do with the extra money?
npcLine.zh: 我们要怎么用这笔多出来的钱？

choices.text: Let's put it toward the baby's savings.
choices.zh: 我们把它存进宝宝的储蓄里吧。

choices.text: It doesn't matter, money isn't important to us.

n3.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Let's put it toward the baby's savings.

transition.en: They talk about staying organized for next tax season.
transition.zh: 他们聊起如何为明年的报税季提前做好准备。

npcLine.en: Should we keep a folder for receipts all year round?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要一年到头都留一个文件夹放收据？

choices.text: Yes, that would save us a lot of stress.
choices.zh: 好，那样能省掉我们不少压力。

choices.text: No, a shoebox works better for us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that would save us a lot of stress.

npcLine.en: If we track expenses monthly, next year will be easier.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们每月记录开销，明年就会更轻松。

choices.text: If that's true, let's start doing that now.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我们现在就开始吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's wait until next spring.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, let's start doing that now.

npcLine.en: We'll keep the same accountant for next year too.
npcLine.zh: 明年我们也会继续找同一位会计师。

choices.text: Good call, she made this whole process easy.
choices.zh: 这个决定不错，她让整个过程都很轻松。

choices.text: Bad call, we should find someone new instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Good call, she made this whole process easy.

transition.en: They sit down to decide exactly how to use the refund.
transition.zh: 他们坐下来商量退税该怎么用。

npcLine.en: How much should we put toward the baby fund?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该拿出多少放进宝宝基金？

choices.text: Let's put about half of it toward that.
choices.zh: 我们把大约一半放进去吧。

choices.text: None of it, the baby fund doesn't need anything.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Let's put about half of it toward that.

npcLine.en: We should save the rest for emergencies.
npcLine.zh: 剩下的我们应该留着应急用。

choices.text: That's smart, we could use a bigger cushion.
choices.zh: 这很明智，我们确实需要更多的应急储备。

choices.text: That's silly, emergencies never actually happen.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's smart, we could use a bigger cushion.

npcLine.en: This year has honestly gone better than we imagined.
npcLine.zh: 老实说，今年比我们想象的顺利多了。

choices.text: It really has, and I'm grateful for that.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我对此心存感激。

choices.text: It really hasn't, this year's been a disaster.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really has, and I'm grateful for that.

transition.en: That evening, they relax now that tax season is finally over.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，报税季终于结束，他们放松下来。

npcLine.en: I'm just glad tax season is finally behind us.
npcLine.zh: 我真高兴报税季终于过去了。

choices.text: Me too, that felt like a real accomplishment.
choices.zh: 我也是，感觉像完成了一件大事。

choices.text: Me too, though nothing was actually finished.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Me too, that felt like a real accomplishment.

npcLine.en: We've handled a lot together this past year.
