npcLine.zh: 过去这一年我们一起处理了很多事情。

choices.text: We really have, and we make a good team.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们真是很棒的搭档。

choices.text: We really haven't, we've done nothing together.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, and we make a good team.

npcLine.en: Let's just relax tonight and not think about anything else.
npcLine.zh: 我们今晚就好好放松，什么都别想了。

choices.text: Let's relax tonight, we've earned it.
choices.zh: 我们今晚好好放松吧，这是我们应得的。

choices.text: Let's start planning next year's taxes instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's relax tonight, we've earned it.

transition.en: At the office job he took on the side last year to help save for the baby, his manager calls him in for an annual review.
transition.zh: 去年为了多攒点钱迎接宝宝，他还兼了一份公司的工作——今天经理叫他进去做年度绩效评估。

npcLine.en: Your work this year has been outstanding.
npcLine.zh: 你今年的工作表现非常出色。

choices.text: Thank you, I've really enjoyed the challenges.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我真的很享受这些挑战。

choices.text: Thank you, I've never enjoyed any of this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → Thank you, I've really enjoyed the challenges.

npcLine.en: How do you feel about taking on more responsibility?
npcLine.zh: 你对承担更多责任有什么想法？

choices.text: I feel ready to take that step now.
choices.zh: 我觉得自己已经准备好迈出这一步了。

choices.text: I feel like responsibility isn't for me.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → I feel ready to take that step now.

npcLine.en: We'd like to consider you for a promotion.
npcLine.zh: 我们想考虑给你升职。

choices.text: That would mean a great deal to me.
choices.zh: 这对我来说意义重大。

choices.text: That would mean nothing to me at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That would mean a great deal to me.

transition.en: He calls his wife on his lunch break to share the news.
transition.zh: 午休时他打电话给妻子分享这个消息。

npcLine.en: You'll never guess what happened at work today.
npcLine.zh: 你绝对猜不到今天公司发生了什么事。

choices.text: I won't guess, just tell me right now.
choices.zh: 我不猜了，快告诉我吧。

choices.text: I already know exactly what happened.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时表达 → I won't guess, just tell me right now.

npcLine.en: They're considering me for a promotion!
npcLine.zh: 他们在考虑给我升职！

choices.text: That's amazing, I'm so proud of you!
choices.zh: 太棒了，我为你感到骄傲！

choices.text: That's boring, I don't really care.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → That's amazing, I'm so proud of you!

npcLine.en: This couldn't have come at a better time.
npcLine.zh: 这个消息来得真是太是时候了。

choices.text: It really couldn't, with the baby coming soon.
choices.zh: 确实太是时候了，宝宝也快出生了。

choices.text: It really could, the timing feels terrible.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really couldn't, with the baby coming soon.

transition.en: A short panel interview is scheduled to confirm the promotion.
transition.zh: 公司安排了一场简短的面试来确认这次晋升。

npcLine.en: Why do you think you're ready for this role?
npcLine.zh: 你为什么认为自己已经准备好胜任这个职位？

choices.text: I've built strong relationships across every team.
choices.zh: 我在各个团队之间都建立了牢固的关系。

choices.text: I've never actually worked with any teams.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答理由 → I've built strong relationships across every team.

npcLine.en: Can you describe a time you solved a difficult problem?
npcLine.zh: 你能描述一次你解决难题的经历吗？

choices.text: I can think of a project from last spring.
choices.zh: 我能想到去年春天的一个项目。

choices.text: I can't remember solving any problems ever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can think of a project from last spring.

npcLine.en: That answer was clearer than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个回答比我预期的更清晰。

choices.text: Thank you, I prepared quite a bit for this.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我为这个准备了不少。

choices.text: Thank you, though I didn't prepare at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thank you, I prepared quite a bit for this.

transition.en: A week later, the manager brings him a formal offer.
transition.zh: 一周后，经理带来了一份正式的晋升方案。

npcLine.en: The role comes with a fifteen percent raise.
npcLine.zh: 这个新职位会加薪百分之十五。

choices.text: That's a generous raise, thank you so much.
choices.zh: 这加薪很慷慨，非常感谢。

choices.text: That's an insulting raise, I expected more.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's a generous raise, thank you so much.

npcLine.en: Do you have any questions about the new title?
npcLine.zh: 关于新的职位头衔你有什么问题吗？

choices.text: Yes, I'm curious about the reporting structure.
choices.zh: 有的，我想了解一下汇报结构。

choices.text: No, titles have never mattered to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, I'm curious about the reporting structure.

npcLine.en: If you accept, you'll start the new role in June.
npcLine.zh: 如果你接受，六月就会开始新职位的工作。

choices.text: If that's the timeline, I happily accept.
choices.zh: 如果是这个时间安排，我很乐意接受。

choices.text: If that's the timeline, I'll have to decline.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's the timeline, I happily accept.

transition.en: He decides to ask for a bit more before signing.
transition.zh: 在签字前，他决定再多争取一些条件。

npcLine.en: Is there anything else you'd like to discuss?
npcLine.zh: 还有什么你想讨论的吗？

choices.text: Yes, could we talk about extra vacation days?
choices.zh: 有的，我们能聊聊额外的假期吗？

choices.text: No, everything sounds perfect exactly as is.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答提要求 → Yes, could we talk about extra vacation days?

npcLine.en: We could offer you an extra week off.
npcLine.zh: 我们可以给你多一周的假期。

choices.text: If that's possible, that would be wonderful.
choices.zh: 如果可以的话，那就太好了。

choices.text: If that's possible, I'd rather have less time off.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's possible, that would be wonderful.

npcLine.en: Let's finalize everything by the end of the week.
npcLine.zh: 我们本周结束前把一切都定下来吧。

choices.text: Sounds great, let's finalize it then.
choices.zh: 好的，那我们就那时定下来吧。

choices.text: Let's just leave everything undecided for now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Sounds great, let's finalize it then.

transition.en: He shares the news with his current teammates.
transition.zh: 他把这个消息告诉了现在的团队成员。

npcLine.en: We heard you're moving to a new role.
npcLine.zh: 我们听说你要调到一个新职位了。

choices.text: I heard right, it's official as of today.
choices.zh: 你们听到的没错，今天正式确定了。

choices.text: You heard wrong, nothing has changed for me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → I heard right, it's official as of today.

npcLine.en: This team is going to miss you a lot.
npcLine.zh: 这个团队会很想念你的。

choices.text: I'll miss you all too, more than you know.
choices.zh: 我也会很想念你们，比你们想象的还要多。

choices.text: I won't miss any of you, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → I'll miss you all too, more than you know.

npcLine.en: Thank you all for everything over these years.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你们这些年来的一切。

choices.text: Thank you, it's been an honor working together.
choices.zh: 谢谢，和大家一起共事是我的荣幸。

choices.text: Thank you, though this team taught me nothing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you, it's been an honor working together.

transition.en: Before the transition, he documents his ongoing projects.
transition.zh: 在交接之前，他把手头的项目都记录了下来。

npcLine.en: Have you written up notes for each project?
npcLine.zh: 你有没有给每个项目写好交接笔记？

choices.text: I've written detailed notes for most of them.
choices.zh: 我给大部分项目都写了详细的笔记。

choices.text: I've never written a single note in my life.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've written detailed notes for most of them.

npcLine.en: Who's taking over your client accounts?
npcLine.zh: 谁来接手你的客户账户？

choices.text: A colleague from another team is taking them.
choices.zh: 另一个团队的同事会接手它们。

choices.text: Nobody, those accounts will just disappear.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答人选 → A colleague from another team is taking them.

npcLine.en: Please make sure the handoff meeting is well documented.
npcLine.zh: 请确保交接会议有详细的记录。

choices.text: Of course, I'll take detailed notes myself.
choices.zh: 当然，我自己会做详细的记录。

choices.text: Sorry, documenting meetings isn't really my thing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, I'll take detailed notes myself.

transition.en: His first day in the new role begins with a team introduction.
transition.zh: 新职位的第一天从团队介绍开始。

scenes.title: The First Day in the New Role
scenes.subtitle: 公司 · 新职位第一天

npcLine.en: Welcome aboard, we're excited to have you leading us.
npcLine.zh: 欢迎加入，我们很期待由你来带领我们。

choices.text: Thank you, I'm excited to work with all of you.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我也很期待和大家一起共事。

choices.text: Thank you, though I'd rather not lead anyone.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Thank you, I'm excited to work with all of you.

npcLine.en: What changes are you hoping to make first?
npcLine.zh: 你希望首先做出什么改变？

choices.text: I'd like to understand the team before changing anything.
choices.zh: 我想先了解团队，再考虑做出改变。

choices.text: I'd like to change absolutely everything today.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答计划 → I'd like to understand the team before changing anything.

npcLine.en: This new chapter feels a little scary, doesn't it?
npcLine.zh: 这个新篇章感觉有点吓人，不是吗？

choices.text: It does, but I'm ready for the challenge.
choices.zh: 确实是，但我已经准备好迎接这个挑战了。

choices.text: It doesn't, nothing about this feels new at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It does, but I'm ready for the challenge.

transition.en: That night, the couple celebrates the promotion at home.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，夫妻俩在家庆祝这次晋升。

npcLine.en: I'm so proud of everything you've accomplished.
npcLine.zh: 我为你所取得的一切感到骄傲。

choices.text: I couldn't have done it without your support.
choices.zh: 没有你的支持我做不到这些。

choices.text: I've accomplished absolutely nothing this whole time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I couldn't have done it without your support.

npcLine.en: How does the new title feel so far?
npcLine.zh: 到目前为止，这个新头衔感觉怎么样？

choices.text: It feels surreal, honestly, in the best way.
choices.zh: 说实话，感觉有点不真实，但是是最好的那种。

choices.text: It doesn't feel any different at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → It feels surreal, honestly, in the best way.

npcLine.en: Let's toast to this new chapter of our lives.
npcLine.zh: 我们为人生的这个新篇章干杯吧。

choices.text: Let's toast to us, and to everything ahead.
choices.zh: 我们为彼此干杯，也为前方的一切干杯。

choices.text: Let's skip the toast, it feels unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's toast to us, and to everything ahead.

transition.en: With the promotion settled, they talk about balancing work and the baby.
transition.zh: 晋升尘埃落定后，他们聊起如何平衡工作和宝宝。

npcLine.en: Are you worried the new role will take too much time?
npcLine.zh: 你担心新职位会占用太多时间吗？

choices.text: A little, but I'll set clear boundaries.
choices.zh: 有一点，但我会设定清晰的边界。

choices.text: Not at all, work is the only thing that matters.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → A little, but I'll set clear boundaries.

npcLine.en: If we plan carefully, we can manage both.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们做好规划，两边都能兼顾。

choices.text: If that's true, let's plan it out together.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我们一起来规划吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's not bother planning at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, let's plan it out together.

npcLine.en: No matter what, our family comes first.
npcLine.zh: 无论如何，我们的家庭永远是第一位的。

choices.text: Always, no matter what happens at work.
choices.zh: 永远如此，无论工作上发生什么。

choices.text: Not always, work will always come first.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Always, no matter what happens at work.

transition.en: Before the baby comes, they sign up to volunteer at a food bank.
transition.zh: 在宝宝出生前，他们报名去一家食物银行做志愿者。

npcLine.en: Have you volunteered anywhere before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前在别的地方做过志愿者吗？

choices.text: I've volunteered a little, back in university.
choices.zh: 我在大学的时候做过一点志愿者工作。

choices.text: I'm volunteering here for the very first time ever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've volunteered a little, back in university.

npcLine.en: What days are you both available to help?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩哪几天有空来帮忙？

choices.text: We're free on Saturday mornings, mostly.
choices.zh: 我们大部分时候周六早上有空。

choices.text: We're never free on any day of the week.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时间 → We're free on Saturday mornings, mostly.

npcLine.en: We'll send you an orientation schedule by email.
npcLine.zh: 我们会通过邮件把入职培训安排发给你们。

choices.text: Perfect, we'll keep an eye on our inbox.
choices.zh: 好的，我们会留意邮箱的。

choices.text: Perfect, though we never check our email.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Perfect, we'll keep an eye on our inbox.

transition.en: A coordinator walks new volunteers through the basics.
transition.zh: 一位协调员给新志愿者讲解基本流程。

scenes.title: The Orientation
scenes.subtitle: 食物银行 · 入职培训

npcLine.en: Please wash your hands before handling any food.
npcLine.zh: 接触食物前请先洗手。

choices.text: Of course, I'll wash them right now.
choices.zh: 当然，我现在就去洗。

choices.text: Sorry, washing hands seems unnecessary here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, I'll wash them right now.

npcLine.en: This shift usually serves about two hundred families.
npcLine.zh: 这一班通常会服务大约两百个家庭。

choices.text: That's a lot of families, I'm glad we're here.
choices.zh: 这可真不少家庭，还好我们来了。

choices.text: That's too many families, we should probably leave.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's a lot of families, I'm glad we're here.

npcLine.en: Let's start you off sorting canned goods.
npcLine.zh: 我们先安排你们做罐头食品的分类。

choices.text: Sounds good, show us where to start.
choices.zh: 好的，告诉我们从哪儿开始。

choices.text: Let's skip sorting, it sounds too boring.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Sounds good, show us where to start.

transition.en: They spend the morning sorting boxes of donated food.
transition.zh: 他们花了一上午分拣捐赠的食物箱。

scenes.title: Sorting Donations
scenes.subtitle: 食物银行 · 分拣捐赠

npcLine.en: Are you checking the expiration dates as you go?
npcLine.zh: 你分拣的时候有没有检查保质期？

choices.text: Yes, I'm checking every single date.
choices.zh: 是的，我在检查每一个日期。

choices.text: Yes, I checked one date last week.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → Yes, I'm checking every single date.

npcLine.en: This box is heavier than the last one.
npcLine.zh: 这箱比上一箱要重。

choices.text: It is, let's carry it together this time.
choices.zh: 确实是，这次我们一起抬吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this box feels lighter than air.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's carry it together this time.

npcLine.en: Where should the expired items go?
npcLine.zh: 过期的物品应该放哪儿？

choices.text: They should go in the discard bin over there.
choices.zh: 应该放到那边的废弃箱里。

choices.text: They should go straight back on the shelf.

n3.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答位置 → They should go in the discard bin over there.

transition.en: After sorting, they help pack boxes for families.
transition.zh: 分拣完之后，他们帮忙给各个家庭打包食物箱。

scenes.title: Packing Food Boxes
scenes.subtitle: 食物银行 · 打包食物箱

npcLine.en: Each box needs one protein, two vegetables, and a grain.
npcLine.zh: 每箱需要一份蛋白质、两份蔬菜和一份谷物。

choices.text: Got it, I'll follow that pattern for each one.
choices.zh: 明白了，我每一箱都会按这个搭配来。

choices.text: Got it, though I'll just add whatever I want.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Got it, I'll follow that pattern for each one.

npcLine.en: Can you double-check this box before it goes out?
npcLine.zh: 这箱出去之前你能再检查一遍吗？

choices.text: I can check it right now, no problem.
choices.zh: 我现在就能检查，没问题。

choices.text: I can't check anything, I'm far too busy.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can check it right now, no problem.

npcLine.en: We've packed almost fifty boxes already.
npcLine.zh: 我们已经打包了差不多五十箱了。

choices.text: That's incredible, we're moving faster than I thought.
choices.zh: 太厉害了，我们的速度比我想的还快。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we're moving way too slowly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → That's incredible, we're moving faster than I thought.

transition.en: A family arrives to pick up their food box.
transition.zh: 一个家庭前来领取食物箱。

scenes.title: Meeting a Family
scenes.subtitle: 食物银行 · 遇见一个家庭

npcLine.en: Thank you so much, this really helps us this month.
npcLine.zh: 太感谢了，这个月真的帮了我们大忙。

choices.text: Of course, we're happy to help however we can.
choices.zh: 不客气，我们很乐意尽力帮忙。

choices.text: Of course, though helping wasn't really our plan.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, we're happy to help however we can.

npcLine.en: Do you have kids of your own?
npcLine.zh: 你们自己有孩子吗？

choices.text: Not yet, but we're expecting one soon.
choices.zh: 还没有，不过我们很快就要有一个了。

choices.text: No, and we never plan to have any.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答但补充信息 → Not yet, but we're expecting one soon.

npcLine.en: Congratulations, and good luck with everything ahead.
npcLine.zh: 恭喜你们，也祝你们前方一切顺利。

choices.text: Thank you so much, that means a lot.
choices.zh: 非常感谢，这对我们意义重大。

choices.text: Thank you, though luck doesn't matter to us.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you so much, that means a lot.

transition.en: In the afternoon, they help serve a hot meal service.
transition.zh: 下午，他们帮忙提供热食服务。

scenes.title: Serving a Hot Meal
scenes.subtitle: 食物银行 · 热食服务

npcLine.en: Could you serve the soup while I hand out bread?
npcLine.zh: 我发面包的时候你能盛汤吗？

choices.text: Sure, I'll take care of the soup.
choices.zh: 好的，汤我来负责。

choices.text: Sorry, serving soup isn't something I want to do.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Sure, I'll take care of the soup.

npcLine.en: This line is longer than it was an hour ago.
npcLine.zh: 这条队伍比一小时前更长了。

choices.text: It is, let's pick up the pace a bit.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们加快点速度吧。

choices.text: It isn't, the line looks shorter to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's pick up the pace a bit.

npcLine.en: Everyone's been so patient waiting in this line.
npcLine.zh: 大家在队伍里等待都非常有耐心。

choices.text: They really have, it's touching to see.
choices.zh: 确实如此，看着挺让人感动的。

choices.text: They really haven't, everyone seems furious.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → They really have, it's touching to see.

transition.en: By the end of the shift, they're exhausted but glad they came.
transition.zh: 轮班结束时，他们又累又高兴自己来了。

scenes.title: A Tired but Good Day
scenes.subtitle: 食物银行 · 疲惫又满足

npcLine.en: How are you feeling after a full day of this?
npcLine.zh: 忙了一整天，你现在感觉怎么样？

choices.text: I'm exhausted, but it was worth every minute.
choices.zh: 我很累，但每一分钟都值得。

choices.text: I'm not tired at all, this was way too easy.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → I'm exhausted, but it was worth every minute.

npcLine.en: We made a real difference for a lot of families today.
npcLine.zh: 今天我们真的为很多家庭带来了改变。

choices.text: We really did, and it felt amazing.
choices.zh: 确实如此，感觉很棒。

choices.text: We really didn't, nothing we did mattered.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We really did, and it felt amazing.

npcLine.en: Although it was tiring, I'd do it again tomorrow.
npcLine.zh: 虽然很累，但明天我还会愿意再来一次。

choices.text: Although it was tiring, I feel the same way.
choices.zh: 虽然很累，但我也有同样的感受。

choices.text: Although it was tiring, I never want to return.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Although it was tiring, I feel the same way.

transition.en: In the car home, they talk about volunteering regularly.
transition.zh: 回家的车上，他们聊起要不要定期去做志愿者。

npcLine.en: Should we come back and do this once a month?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要每个月都回来做一次？

choices.text: Yes, let's commit to once a month.
choices.zh: 好，我们就定每月一次吧。

choices.text: No, once was already more than enough.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's commit to once a month.

npcLine.en: If we bring the baby someday, they'll grow up seeing this.
npcLine.zh: 如果以后带着宝宝一起来，他们从小就能看到这些。

choices.text: If that's true, that means even more to me.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，那对我来说意义更大了。

choices.text: If that's true, I'd rather keep the baby home.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, that means even more to me.

npcLine.en: This is going to become a real family tradition.
npcLine.zh: 这会成为我们家真正的传统。

choices.text: I love that idea, I really do.
choices.zh: 我很喜欢这个主意，真的很喜欢。

choices.text: I hate that idea, traditions feel pointless to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → I love that idea, I really do.

transition.en: That evening, they reflect on the day over dinner.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们在晚餐时聊起这一天的感受。

npcLine.en: What surprised you most about today?
npcLine.zh: 今天最让你意外的是什么？

choices.text: How grateful everyone was, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，是大家的感激之情。

choices.text: Nothing surprised me about today at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → How grateful everyone was, honestly.

npcLine.en: It made me think about how lucky we are.
npcLine.zh: 这让我意识到我们有多幸运。

choices.text: It made me feel exactly the same way.
choices.zh: 我也有一模一样的感受。

choices.text: It made me feel nothing at all, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It made me feel exactly the same way.

npcLine.en: I want our child to grow up with this kind of heart.
npcLine.zh: 我希望我们的孩子长大后也拥有这样一颗心。

choices.text: So do I, more than almost anything else.
choices.zh: 我也是，这比几乎任何事都更重要。

choices.text: I don't, other things matter far more to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → So do I, more than almost anything else.

transition.en: A month later, they return for their second shift, now more confident.
transition.zh: 一个月后，他们回来参加第二次轮班，比之前更自信了。

scenes.title: The Second Visit
scenes.subtitle: 食物银行 · 第二次到访

npcLine.en: Welcome back, you two already know the routine.
npcLine.zh: 欢迎回来，你们俩已经熟悉流程了。

choices.text: We do, and it feels good to be back.
choices.zh: 确实是，能回来感觉很好。

choices.text: We don't, we've forgotten everything already.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We do, and it feels good to be back.

npcLine.en: You two are much faster than you were last time.
npcLine.zh: 你们俩比上次快多了。

choices.text: Practice really does make a difference.
choices.zh: 练习确实会带来不同。

choices.text: We're actually much slower than last time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Practice really does make a difference.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy life gets, this is worth the time.
npcLine.zh: 无论生活有多忙，这件事都值得花时间。

choices.text: No matter how busy we get, we'll always make time.
choices.zh: 无论多忙，我们都会一直抽出时间来。

choices.text: No matter how busy we get, this won't matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy we get, we'll always make time.

transition.en: A severe winter storm warning is issued for the city.
transition.zh: 市里发布了一条严重暴风雪预警。

npcLine.en: They're calling for thirty centimeters of snow tonight.
npcLine.zh: 他们预报今晚会下三十厘米的雪。

choices.text: That's a lot of snow, we should prepare.
choices.zh: 这雪量可不少，我们应该做好准备。

choices.text: That's barely any snow, we can ignore it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's a lot of snow, we should prepare.

npcLine.en: Have you checked if we have enough candles?
npcLine.zh: 你检查过我们蜡烛够不够了吗？

choices.text: I've checked, and we have plenty.
choices.zh: 我检查过了，我们蜡烛很充足。

choices.text: I'm checking that at this exact moment.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've checked, and we have plenty.

npcLine.en: We should charge our phones before the power goes out.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该在停电之前把手机充满电。

choices.text: Good thinking, I'll plug mine in now.
choices.zh: 想得周到，我现在就去充。

choices.text: Bad thinking, our phones are already full.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good thinking, I'll plug mine in now.

transition.en: They make a quick trip to the store before it closes early.
transition.zh: 他们赶在商店提前关门前去买了点东西。

scenes.title: Stocking Up
scenes.subtitle: 超市 · 采购应急物资

npcLine.en: What do we still need to buy before we leave?
npcLine.zh: 我们走之前还需要买什么？

choices.text: We still need bottled water and batteries.
choices.zh: 我们还需要瓶装水和电池。

choices.text: We don't need to buy anything at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答清单 → We still need bottled water and batteries.

npcLine.en: This line is much longer than usual today.
npcLine.zh: 今天这条队伍比平时长多了。

choices.text: It is, everyone's preparing for the storm.
choices.zh: 确实是，大家都在为暴风雪做准备。

choices.text: It isn't, this line looks shorter than usual.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, everyone's preparing for the storm.

npcLine.en: Let's grab some extra blankets while we're here.
npcLine.zh: 我们既然在这儿，就多拿几条毯子吧。

choices.text: Good call, let's grab a few more.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们再多拿几条吧。

choices.text: Let's skip the blankets, we have enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good call, let's grab a few more.

transition.en: That night, the lights suddenly flicker and go dark.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，灯突然闪了一下就熄灭了。

npcLine.en: The power just went out across the whole street.
npcLine.zh: 整条街刚刚都停电了。

choices.text: It really did, let's light the candles.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们点上蜡烛吧。

choices.text: It really didn't, everything looks fine to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It really did, let's light the candles.

npcLine.en: Are you feeling okay in the dark and cold?
npcLine.zh: 在黑暗和寒冷中你还好吗？

choices.text: Yes, I'm doing fine, just a bit cold.
choices.zh: 还好，就是有点冷。

choices.text: No, darkness has never bothered me at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, I'm doing fine, just a bit cold.

npcLine.en: If the power stays off, we'll use the fireplace.
npcLine.zh: 如果电一直没来，我们就用壁炉取暖。

choices.text: If it stays off, that sounds like a good plan.
choices.zh: 如果一直没电，这个计划听起来不错。

choices.text: If it stays off, let's just sit in the cold.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If it stays off, that sounds like a good plan.

transition.en: The fireplace crackles, but they light a few candles too, just for the cozy glow.
transition.zh: 壁炉噼啪作响，但他们还是点了几支蜡烛，就为了那份温馨的暖光。

scenes.title: Waiting It Out
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 等待风暴过去

npcLine.en: This feels a bit like camping indoors, doesn't it?
npcLine.zh: 这感觉有点像在室内露营，不是吗？

choices.text: It really does, it's kind of cozy.
choices.zh: 确实是，感觉还挺温馨的。

choices.text: It doesn't feel like anything special.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, it's kind of cozy.

npcLine.en: How long do you think the storm will last?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得这场暴风雪会持续多久？

choices.text: I think it'll last through most of the night.
choices.zh: 我觉得它会持续大半个晚上。

choices.text: I think it already ended an hour ago.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答预测 → I think it'll last through most of the night.

npcLine.en: Let's tell stories by candlelight until we're tired.
npcLine.zh: 我们就着烛光讲故事，讲到困了为止。

choices.text: I love that idea, let's start now.
choices.zh: 我很喜欢这个主意，我们现在就开始吧。

choices.text: Let's just sit in silence instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → I love that idea, let's start now.

transition.en: By morning, the storm has passed and the power is back.
transition.zh: 到了早上，暴风雪已经过去，电也来了。

npcLine.en: The power's finally back on, and the sun is out.
npcLine.zh: 电终于来了，太阳也出来了。

choices.text: Finally, I really missed having lights.
choices.zh: 终于啊，我真的很想念有灯光的日子。

choices.text: Finally, though I preferred it without power.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Finally, I really missed having lights.

npcLine.en: Look how much snow piled up outside.
npcLine.zh: 看看外面堆了多少雪。

choices.text: Wow, that's way more than I expected.
choices.zh: 哇，比我预想的多多了。

choices.text: Wow, that's much less than I expected.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Wow, that's way more than I expected.

npcLine.en: We're going to need to shovel the whole driveway.
npcLine.zh: 我们得把整条车道都铲一遍雪。

choices.text: We are, let's grab the shovels and start.
choices.zh: 确实需要，我们拿铲子开始吧。

choices.text: We're not, the snow can just melt on its own.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → We are, let's grab the shovels and start.

transition.en: They bundle up and start shoveling the driveway together.
transition.zh: 他们裹得严严实实，一起开始铲车道上的雪。

npcLine.en: Are you doing okay with the heavy lifting?
npcLine.zh: 搬这些重活你还好吗？

choices.text: Yes, I'm managing, but let's take breaks.
choices.zh: 还好，不过我们中途休息一下吧。

choices.text: No, heavy lifting has never bothered me once.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, I'm managing, but let's take breaks.

npcLine.en: This side of the driveway is icier than the other.
npcLine.zh: 车道这一边比另一边更结冰。

choices.text: It is, let's put down some salt here first.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们先在这边撒点盐吧。

choices.text: It isn't, both sides look exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's put down some salt here first.

npcLine.en: Careful, you shouldn't lift too much with the baby coming.
npcLine.zh: 小心点，宝宝快出生了，你不该抬太重的东西。

choices.text: You're right, and I'll let you handle the heavy parts.
choices.zh: 你说得对，重的部分就让你来吧。

choices.text: You're right, but I'll keep lifting anyway.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → You're right, and I'll let you handle the heavy parts.

transition.en: They walk over to check on an elderly neighbor.
transition.zh: 他们走过去看看一位年长的邻居。

npcLine.en: We wanted to make sure you got through the storm okay.
npcLine.zh: 我们想确认一下您暴风雪期间没事。

choices.text: That's so kind, thank you for checking on me.
choices.zh: 你们真是太好了，谢谢来看我。

choices.text: That's unnecessary, I never needed any help.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时表达关心的回应 → That's so kind, thank you for checking on me.

npcLine.en: Do you need any help shoveling your walkway?
npcLine.zh: 您需要帮忙铲一下人行道上的雪吗？

choices.text: Yes, please, that would be a huge help.
choices.zh: 好的，麻烦你们了，这真的帮了大忙。

choices.text: No, I actually enjoy the extra exercise alone.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, please, that would be a huge help.

npcLine.en: You two are wonderful neighbors, truly.
npcLine.zh: 你们俩真是很棒的邻居。

choices.text: Thank you, we're happy to help anytime.
choices.zh: 谢谢您，我们随时都乐意帮忙。

choices.text: Thank you, though helping isn't really our thing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you, we're happy to help anytime.

transition.en: On the walk back, one of them slips on a patch of ice.
transition.zh: 回家的路上，其中一人在一块冰上滑了一下。

npcLine.en: Are you okay? That looked like a bad fall.
npcLine.zh: 你没事吧？那一下看起来摔得挺重。

choices.text: I'm okay, just a little shaken up.
choices.zh: 我没事，就是有点被吓到了。

choices.text: I'm not okay, call an ambulance right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I'm okay, just a little shaken up.

npcLine.en: We should be extra careful walking on ice like this.
npcLine.zh: 在这种冰面上走路我们应该格外小心。

choices.text: You're right, let's walk more slowly from here.
choices.zh: 你说得对，接下来我们走慢一点吧。

choices.text: You're wrong, walking fast is always safer.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → You're right, let's walk more slowly from here.

npcLine.en: With the baby coming, we really can't take chances.
npcLine.zh: 宝宝快出生了，我们真的不能冒险。

choices.text: You're right, we can't be careless anymore.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我们不能再粗心大意了。

choices.text: You're wrong, we can take all the risks we want.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/许可 → You're right, we can't be careless anymore.

transition.en: Back home, they warm up with hot cocoa.
transition.zh: 回到家后，他们喝着热可可暖和身子。

npcLine.en: Nothing beats hot cocoa after a day like that.
npcLine.zh: 经历了这样的一天，没有什么比热可可更好了。

choices.text: Absolutely nothing, this is exactly what we needed.
choices.zh: 绝对没有，这正是我们需要的。

choices.text: Actually, cold water would be better right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Absolutely nothing, this is exactly what we needed.

npcLine.en: This whole day turned into quite an adventure.
npcLine.zh: 这一整天变成了一场不小的冒险。

choices.text: It really did, one we won't forget soon.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这一天我们不会很快忘记。

choices.text: It really didn't, today felt completely ordinary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really did, one we won't forget soon.

npcLine.en: Even in the storm, I felt safe with you.
npcLine.zh: 即使在暴风雪里，和你在一起我也感到安心。

choices.text: Even in the storm, I felt exactly the same.
choices.zh: 即使在暴风雪里，我的感受也完全一样。

choices.text: Even in the storm, I felt scared the whole time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even in the storm, I felt exactly the same.

transition.en: That night, they sit together, grateful the storm brought them closer.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们坐在一起，感激这场暴风雪让彼此更亲近。

scenes.title: Grateful for the Quiet
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 感激这份安静

npcLine.en: Days like today remind me what really matters.
npcLine.zh: 像今天这样的日子让我想起什么才是真正重要的。

choices.text: They remind me of that too, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我也有同样的感受。

choices.text: They remind me of nothing important at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They remind me of that too, honestly.

npcLine.en: How are you feeling about everything coming next?
npcLine.zh: 对接下来即将到来的一切，你感觉怎么样？

choices.text: I feel ready, especially after a day like this.
choices.zh: 我感觉自己准备好了，尤其是经历了今天这样的一天。

choices.text: I feel completely unprepared for anything at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → I feel ready, especially after a day like this.

npcLine.en: Let's remember today, no matter what happens next.
npcLine.zh: 不管接下来发生什么，我们都要记住今天。

choices.text: Let's remember today, always.
choices.zh: 我们要永远记住今天。

choices.text: Let's just forget about today completely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's remember today, always.

transition.en: They plan a dinner party to bring both families together.
transition.zh: 他们计划办一场家宴，把两家人聚到一起。

npcLine.en: What should we cook for both of our families?
npcLine.zh: 我们该给两家人做什么菜？

choices.text: Let's make something that mixes both traditions.
choices.zh: 我们做一道融合两边传统的菜吧。

choices.text: It doesn't matter, food isn't important tonight.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Let's make something that mixes both traditions.

npcLine.en: Does anyone have food allergies we should know about?
npcLine.zh: 有没有谁对食物过敏，我们需要知道？

choices.text: Yes, my mother can't have shellfish.
choices.zh: 有的，我妈妈不能吃贝类海鲜。

choices.text: No, allergies have never existed in either family.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, my mother can't have shellfish.

npcLine.en: This dish takes longer to make than the others.
npcLine.zh: 这道菜做起来比其他的要花更长时间。

choices.text: Then let's start on that one first.
choices.zh: 那我们就先做那道菜吧。

choices.text: Then let's just skip that dish entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Then let's start on that one first.

transition.en: They head to the market to gather ingredients.
transition.zh: 他们去市场采购食材。

npcLine.en: Can you find fresh ginger and green onions?
npcLine.zh: 你能找到新鲜的姜和葱吗？

choices.text: I can find those in the produce section.
choices.zh: 我能在蔬果区找到那些。

choices.text: I can't find ginger anywhere in this whole store.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can find those in the produce section.

npcLine.en: This cut of meat looks fresher than that one.
npcLine.zh: 这块肉看起来比那块更新鲜。

choices.text: You're right, let's get this one instead.
choices.zh: 你说得对，那我们就买这块吧。

choices.text: You're wrong, they look exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → You're right, let's get this one instead.

npcLine.en: We're going to need a bigger cart at this rate.
npcLine.zh: 照这个速度我们得换个更大的购物车了。

choices.text: Ha, you're probably right about that.
choices.zh: 哈哈，你说的大概没错。

choices.text: Ha, this cart is already way too big.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → Ha, you're probably right about that.

transition.en: The night before, they set the table for a big gathering.
transition.zh: 前一晚，他们为这场聚会摆好了桌子。

npcLine.en: How many place settings do we need in total?
npcLine.zh: 我们总共需要摆多少套餐具？

choices.text: We need twelve settings, counting both families.
choices.zh: 算上两家人，我们需要十二套。

choices.text: We need zero settings, everyone will stand.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → We need twelve settings, counting both families.

npcLine.en: Should the kids sit at their own small table?
npcLine.zh: 孩子们要不要坐在他们自己的小桌子？

choices.text: Yes, that'll be easier for everyone.
choices.zh: 好，这样对大家来说都更方便。

choices.text: No, the kids should stand the entire meal.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that'll be easier for everyone.

npcLine.en: Let's add some candles to make it feel special.
npcLine.zh: 我们加几支蜡烛，让气氛更特别一点。

choices.text: Great idea, I'll grab some from the drawer.
choices.zh: 好主意，我去抽屉里拿几支。

choices.text: Let's skip the candles, they're unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Great idea, I'll grab some from the drawer.

transition.en: Both families arrive within minutes of each other.
transition.zh: 两家人几乎前后脚地到了。

npcLine.en: Welcome, come in, come in, make yourselves at home.
npcLine.zh: 欢迎欢迎，快进来，不要拘束。

choices.text: Thank you for having us, everything smells wonderful.
choices.zh: 谢谢邀请我们，一切都闻起来太香了。

choices.text: Thank you, though we'd rather stand by the door.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you for having us, everything smells wonderful.

npcLine.en: Can I take your coats for you?
npcLine.zh: 我能帮你们把外套拿去挂起来吗？

choices.text: Yes, thank you, that's very kind of you.
choices.zh: 好的，谢谢你，你真是太贴心了。

choices.text: No, I'd rather wear my coat all evening.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Yes, thank you, that's very kind of you.

npcLine.en: This house looks even nicer than the last time.
npcLine.zh: 这房子比上次看起来还要漂亮。

choices.text: Thank you, we've done some renovations lately.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们最近做了一些装修。

choices.text: Thank you, though nothing here has changed at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thank you, we've done some renovations lately.

transition.en: They bring the food out and everyone gathers around the table.
transition.zh: 他们把菜端上桌，大家都围坐了过来。

npcLine.en: This smells absolutely incredible, who made it?
npcLine.zh: 这闻起来简直太香了，是谁做的？

choices.text: We made it together, actually, all afternoon.
choices.zh: 其实是我们俩一起做的，做了一下午。

choices.text: Nobody made it, it appeared from nowhere.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答信息 → We made it together, actually, all afternoon.

npcLine.en: Please, help yourselves before it gets cold.
npcLine.zh: 大家请自便，趁热吃吧。

choices.text: Thank you, everything looks absolutely delicious.
choices.zh: 谢谢，看起来一切都太好吃了。

choices.text: Thank you, but I'd rather wait until it's cold.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Thank you, everything looks absolutely delicious.

npcLine.en: This is better than the version we had at the restaurant.
npcLine.zh: 这个比我们在餐厅吃的那道还要好吃。

choices.text: That means a lot, thank you so much.
choices.zh: 这话对我们意义重大，非常感谢。

choices.text: That's rude, the restaurant version was clearly better.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That means a lot, thank you so much.

transition.en: Conversation flows easily as the meal continues.
transition.zh: 用餐间，谈话气氛轻松愉快。

npcLine.en: Have you two picked out a name for the baby yet?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩给宝宝想好名字了吗？

choices.text: We've narrowed it down to a couple of names.
choices.zh: 我们已经把范围缩小到几个名字了。

choices.text: We've never once thought about a name.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've narrowed it down to a couple of names.

npcLine.en: If it's a boy, what name are you considering?
npcLine.zh: 如果是男孩，你们在考虑什么名字？

choices.text: If it's a boy, we're leaning toward a family name.
choices.zh: 如果是男孩，我们倾向于用一个家族名字。

choices.text: If it's a boy, we haven't thought about it.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If it's a boy, we're leaning toward a family name.

npcLine.en: This baby is going to be so loved.
npcLine.zh: 这个宝宝会被这么多人疼爱。

choices.text: That's exactly why tonight means so much.
choices.zh: 这正是今晚意义如此重大的原因。

choices.text: That's why we're not excited about this at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's exactly why tonight means so much.

transition.en: Before dessert, someone raises a glass for a toast.
transition.zh: 上甜点之前，有人举杯要祝酒。

npcLine.en: I'd like to say a few words, if that's alright.
npcLine.zh: 如果可以的话，我想说几句话。

choices.text: Of course, please, go right ahead.
choices.zh: 当然可以，请说吧。

choices.text: Sorry, we'd rather not hear any speeches.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, please, go right ahead.

npcLine.en: To two families becoming one, and to the baby on the way.
npcLine.zh: 敬两个家庭合而为一，也敬即将到来的宝宝。

choices.text: To family, and to everything ahead of us.
choices.zh: 敬家人，也敬我们前方的一切。

choices.text: To nothing in particular, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应祝酒词 → To family, and to everything ahead of us.

npcLine.en: Cheers, and thank you all for being here tonight.
npcLine.zh: 干杯，也谢谢大家今晚能来。

choices.text: Cheers, we're so grateful to have you all.
choices.zh: 干杯，我们非常感激大家的到来。

choices.text: Cheers, though we didn't really want anyone here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Cheers, we're so grateful to have you all.

transition.en: Dessert brings out old family stories and a lot of laughter.
transition.zh: 甜点端上来后，大家聊起老家事，笑声不断。

npcLine.en: Tell them the story about your first date.
npcLine.zh: 跟他们讲讲你们第一次约会的故事吧。

choices.text: Oh no, that story is a little embarrassing.
choices.zh: 哦不，那个故事有点尴尬。

choices.text: Oh no, we've never actually been on a date.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Oh no, that story is a little embarrassing.

npcLine.en: This dessert is even sweeter than I remembered.
npcLine.zh: 这个甜点比我记忆中的还要甜。

choices.text: It really is, I might need a second slice.
choices.zh: 确实是，我可能得再来一块。

choices.text: It really isn't, this dessert has no flavor.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I might need a second slice.

npcLine.en: Nights like this remind me how lucky we are.
npcLine.zh: 像今晚这样的夜晚让我意识到我们有多幸运。

choices.text: They really do, I feel the exact same way.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我也有一模一样的感受。

choices.text: They don't, tonight felt pretty ordinary to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They really do, I feel the exact same way.

transition.en: As the evening winds down, guests begin to say their goodbyes.
transition.zh: 夜色渐深，客人们开始一一道别。

npcLine.en: Thank you so much for tonight, it was wonderful.
npcLine.zh: 非常感谢今晚，一切都太棒了。

choices.text: Thank you for coming, it meant everything to us.
choices.zh: 谢谢你们能来，这对我们意义非凡。

choices.text: Thank you, though we didn't enjoy it much.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you for coming, it meant everything to us.

npcLine.en: Let's do this again soon, before the baby comes.
npcLine.zh: 我们要在宝宝出生前再聚一次。

choices.text: Absolutely, let's plan another one next month.
choices.zh: 当然，我们下个月再安排一次吧。

choices.text: Let's not, once was more than enough.

n2.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Absolutely, let's plan another one next month.

npcLine.en: Drive safe, and text us when you get home.
npcLine.zh: 开车小心，到家了发个消息给我们。

choices.text: We will, thank you for worrying about us.
choices.zh: 我们会的，谢谢你们为我们担心。

choices.text: We won't, texting after driving feels pointless.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → We will, thank you for worrying about us.

transition.en: Once everyone has left, the couple cleans up side by side.
transition.zh: 客人都走了以后，夫妻俩并肩收拾屋子。

npcLine.en: Tonight went even better than I hoped it would.
npcLine.zh: 今晚比我期望的还要顺利。

choices.text: It really did, I'm so glad we did this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很高兴我们办了这场聚会。

choices.text: It really didn't, tonight was a total disaster.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, I'm so glad we did this.

npcLine.en: Can you dry while I wash these dishes?
npcLine.zh: 我洗碗的时候你能擦干吗？

choices.text: I can dry, just hand them over.
choices.zh: 我能擦干，递给我就行。

choices.text: I can't help with dishes tonight, I'm too tired.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can dry, just hand them over.

npcLine.en: No matter how tired we are, tonight was worth it.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们现在多累，今晚都是值得的。

choices.text: No matter how tired, I'd do it again tomorrow.
choices.zh: 不管多累，明天我还愿意再办一次。

choices.text: No matter how tired, I regret every part of it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how tired, I'd do it again tomorrow.

transition.en: Looking over the monthly bills, they notice the phone plan is expensive.
transition.zh: 翻看每月账单时，他们发现手机套餐太贵了。

npcLine.en: This bill is higher than it was last year.
npcLine.zh: 这份账单比去年要高。

choices.text: It is, we should look into other plans.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们应该看看其他套餐。

choices.text: It isn't, this bill looks lower than ever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we should look into other plans.

npcLine.en: Have we ever actually compared other providers?
npcLine.zh: 我们真的比较过其他运营商吗？

choices.text: We've never really compared them, honestly.
choices.zh: 老实说，我们从来没真正比较过。

choices.text: We're comparing them at this exact second.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've never really compared them, honestly.

npcLine.en: We should probably switch before the baby comes.
npcLine.zh: 我们大概应该在宝宝出生前换掉。

choices.text: Good idea, every dollar helps right now.
choices.zh: 好主意，现在每一块钱都有用。

choices.text: Bad idea, switching plans sounds like a hassle.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, every dollar helps right now.

transition.en: He calls the current provider to ask about better deals.
transition.zh: 他打电话给目前的运营商询问更好的方案。

npcLine.en: How can I help you today?
npcLine.zh: 今天有什么可以帮您的？

choices.text: I'd like to ask about lowering my monthly bill.
choices.zh: 我想问问怎样能降低我的月账单。

choices.text: I don't need any help at all today.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答需求 → I'd like to ask about lowering my monthly bill.

npcLine.en: Are you currently under contract with us?
npcLine.zh: 您目前和我们有合约吗？

choices.text: No, my contract actually ended last month.
choices.zh: 没有，我的合约实际上上个月就结束了。

choices.text: Yes, I signed a lifetime contract at birth.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → No, my contract actually ended last month.

npcLine.en: I can offer you a discount if you upgrade today.
npcLine.zh: 如果您今天升级套餐，我可以给您一个折扣。

choices.text: If that saves money, I'm definitely interested.
choices.zh: 如果能省钱，我一定感兴趣。

choices.text: If that saves money, I'd rather not bother.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that saves money, I'm definitely interested.

transition.en: That evening, they compare a few plans side by side.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们把几个套餐放在一起比较。

npcLine.en: This plan has more data than the one we have now.
npcLine.zh: 这个套餐的流量比我们现在的多。

choices.text: More data would actually be really useful.
choices.zh: 更多流量其实会很有用。

choices.text: More data would just go to waste anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → More data would actually be really useful.

npcLine.en: Which provider has the best coverage in our area?
npcLine.zh: 哪家运营商在我们这个地区信号覆盖最好？

choices.text: This one seems to have the best reviews.
choices.zh: 这一家看起来评价最好。

choices.text: Coverage doesn't matter to us at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答比较 → This one seems to have the best reviews.

npcLine.en: Bundling internet and phone together saves even more.
npcLine.zh: 把网络和手机套餐捆绑在一起能省更多钱。

choices.text: Let's bundle them, then, that sounds smart.
choices.zh: 那我们就捆绑吧，这听起来很明智。

choices.text: Let's keep them separate, bundling sounds risky.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Let's bundle them, then, that sounds smart.

transition.en: Before switching, they carefully read the contract terms.
transition.zh: 在换套餐前，他们仔细阅读了合约条款。

scenes.title: Reading the Fine Print
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 阅读合约细则

npcLine.en: Are there any cancellation fees if we leave early?
npcLine.zh: 如果我们提前离开会有取消费用吗？

choices.text: Yes, there's a fee if you cancel within a year.
choices.zh: 有的，如果一年内取消会有费用。

choices.text: No, cancellation is always completely free.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, there's a fee if you cancel within a year.

npcLine.en: This clause is more confusing than the rest of the contract.
npcLine.zh: 这一条比合约的其他部分更让人困惑。

choices.text: It is, let's ask the agent to explain it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们让客服解释一下吧。

choices.text: It isn't, every clause here is perfectly clear.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's ask the agent to explain it.

npcLine.en: If you sign today, the price is locked for two years.
npcLine.zh: 如果你今天签约，价格会锁定两年。

choices.text: If that's guaranteed, I'm ready to sign.
choices.zh: 如果这是保证的，那我准备好签字了。

choices.text: If that's guaranteed, I'd rather not sign anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's guaranteed, I'm ready to sign.

transition.en: They call to officially switch to the new provider.
transition.zh: 他们打电话正式转到新的运营商。

npcLine.en: Would you like to keep your current phone numbers?
npcLine.zh: 您想保留目前的手机号码吗？

choices.text: Yes, keeping our numbers is really important.
choices.zh: 是的，保留我们的号码非常重要。

choices.text: No, we'd love to get brand new numbers.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Yes, keeping our numbers is really important.

npcLine.en: The transfer will take about two business days.
npcLine.zh: 转移大约需要两个工作日。

choices.text: That's fine, two days works for us.
choices.zh: 没问题，两天对我们来说可以接受。

choices.text: That's too long, we need it done instantly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's fine, two days works for us.

npcLine.en: You'll receive a confirmation text once it's complete.
npcLine.zh: 完成后您会收到一条确认短信。

choices.text: Great, we'll keep an eye out for that.
choices.zh: 好的，我们会留意的。

choices.text: Great, though we never read our texts.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Great, we'll keep an eye out for that.

transition.en: A technician comes to install the new internet router.
transition.zh: 一位技术人员上门安装新的网络路由器。

npcLine.en: Where would you like the router placed?
npcLine.zh: 您想把路由器放在哪里？

choices.text: Somewhere central would give us the best signal.
choices.zh: 放在中间位置信号应该会最好。

choices.text: It doesn't matter, signal isn't important to us.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Somewhere central would give us the best signal.

npcLine.en: This new connection is much faster than your old one.
npcLine.zh: 这个新网络比你们之前的快多了。

choices.text: That's a huge improvement, thank you.
choices.zh: 这真是个巨大的提升，谢谢你。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we expected it to be slower.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's a huge improvement, thank you.

npcLine.en: Please restart your devices to connect to the new network.
npcLine.zh: 请重启您的设备以连接新网络。

choices.text: Sure, I'll restart everything right now.
choices.zh: 好的，我现在就重启所有设备。

choices.text: Sorry, restarting devices sounds too complicated.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Sure, I'll restart everything right now.

transition.en: A month later, the first bill under the new plan arrives.
transition.zh: 一个月后，新套餐的第一张账单到了。

npcLine.en: Look, this bill is way lower than the old one.
npcLine.zh: 看，这张账单比之前的低多了。

choices.text: It really is, I'm so glad we switched.
choices.zh: 确实如此，很高兴我们换了。

choices.text: It really isn't, this bill looks higher to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I'm so glad we switched.

npcLine.en: We've saved almost forty dollars a month already.
npcLine.zh: 我们每月已经省了差不多四十块钱。

choices.text: That's incredible, that adds up fast.
choices.zh: 太厉害了，这样积累起来很快。

choices.text: That's disappointing, forty dollars means nothing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → That's incredible, that adds up fast.

npcLine.en: That savings could go straight into the baby fund.
npcLine.zh: 这笔省下的钱可以直接存进宝宝基金。

choices.text: Let's do exactly that, starting this month.
choices.zh: 那我们就这么做吧，从这个月开始。

choices.text: Let's spend it on something else instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Let's do exactly that, starting this month.

transition.en: A week later, the internet suddenly stops working.
transition.zh: 一周后，网络突然中断了。

npcLine.en: Is your internet working right now?
npcLine.zh: 你的网络现在能用吗？

choices.text: No, it stopped working about an hour ago.
choices.zh: 不能，大概一小时前就断了。

choices.text: Yes, it's working perfectly, no issues at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → No, it stopped working about an hour ago.

npcLine.en: There's an outage in your area right now.
npcLine.zh: 您所在的区域目前正在停机维护。

choices.text: That explains it, thanks for letting us know.
choices.zh: 这就说得通了，谢谢你告诉我们。

choices.text: That's impossible, everything else works fine here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That explains it, thanks for letting us know.

npcLine.en: We'll have it restored within the hour.
npcLine.zh: 我们会在一小时内恢复网络。

choices.text: Thank you, we'll just wait it out then.
choices.zh: 谢谢，那我们就耐心等一下。

choices.text: Thank you, though an hour feels far too long.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Thank you, we'll just wait it out then.

transition.en: Months later, they revisit the plan to see if they need less.
transition.zh: 几个月后，他们重新审视套餐，看是否需要精简。

scenes.title: Downgrading Later
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 重新调整套餐

npcLine.en: Have we actually been using all this data?
npcLine.zh: 我们真的用完了这么多流量吗？

choices.text: We haven't used nearly that much, actually.
choices.zh: 其实我们根本没用那么多。

choices.text: We've used every bit of it every month.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We haven't used nearly that much, actually.

npcLine.en: A smaller plan would honestly work just fine now.
npcLine.zh: 现在其实一个更小的套餐就够用了。

choices.text: Let's downgrade and save a bit more.
choices.zh: 那我们就降级，多省一点钱吧。

choices.text: Let's upgrade even more, just in case.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's downgrade and save a bit more.

npcLine.en: It's nice being on top of our expenses like this.
npcLine.zh: 像这样掌控好开支感觉真不错。

choices.text: It really is, this feels responsible of us.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这样感觉我们很负责任。

choices.text: It really isn't, tracking expenses feels pointless.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, this feels responsible of us.

transition.en: With the household bills in order, they feel more ready for the baby.
transition.zh: 家里的账单都理顺了，他们对迎接宝宝感到更有底气。

npcLine.en: We've handled so many little things this year.
npcLine.zh: 今年我们处理了这么多小事。

choices.text: We really have, piece by piece it all adds up.
choices.zh: 确实如此，一点一点地积累起来。

choices.text: We really haven't, nothing has changed all year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, piece by piece it all adds up.

npcLine.en: How do you feel about all of this coming together?
npcLine.zh: 看到这一切都逐渐就绪，你感觉怎么样？

choices.text: I feel calm, which surprises me a little.
choices.zh: 我感觉很平静，这让我自己都有点意外。

choices.text: I feel nothing about any of this at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → I feel calm, which surprises me a little.

npcLine.en: No matter what comes next, we've got this.
npcLine.zh: 无论接下来发生什么，我们都能应付。

choices.text: No matter what happens, we've got each other.
choices.zh: 无论发生什么，我们都拥有彼此。

choices.text: No matter what happens, we're on our own.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what happens, we've got each other.

transition.en: Before the baby arrives, they plan one last road trip together.
transition.zh: 在宝宝出生前，他们计划最后一次两人自驾游。

npcLine.en: A friend offered us her cottage by the lake.
npcLine.zh: 一个朋友把她湖边的度假屋借给我们了。

choices.text: That's so generous, we should say yes.
choices.zh: 她真是太大方了，我们应该答应。

choices.text: That's odd, we should probably say no.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时陈述回应 → That's so generous, we should say yes.

npcLine.en: How long is the drive up there?
npcLine.zh: 开车到那里要多久？

choices.text: It's about three hours, give or take.
choices.zh: 大概三个小时左右。

choices.text: It's not a drive, it's a five-minute walk.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时长 → It's about three hours, give or take.

npcLine.en: We'll need to pack for warm days and cool nights.
npcLine.zh: 我们需要准备白天暖和、晚上凉爽的衣物。

choices.text: Good point, I'll pack layers for both.
choices.zh: 有道理，我会为两种情况都准备好衣物。

choices.text: Good point, though I'll just pack nothing warm.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Good point, I'll pack layers for both.

transition.en: Early Saturday morning, they load the car and head out.
transition.zh: 周六一大早，他们装好车出发了。

npcLine.en: Did you remember to pack the cooler?
npcLine.zh: 你记得带保温箱了吗？

choices.text: Yes, it's already in the trunk.
choices.zh: 是的，已经放在后备箱了。

choices.text: No, coolers have never mattered to us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it's already in the trunk.

npcLine.en: This route looks more scenic than the highway.
npcLine.zh: 这条路线看起来比高速公路更有风景。

choices.text: Let's take this route, then, we're in no rush.
choices.zh: 那我们走这条路吧，反正也不赶时间。

choices.text: Let's take the highway, scenery doesn't matter.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's take this route, then, we're in no rush.

npcLine.en: I'm so ready to just relax for a few days.
npcLine.zh: 我真的很想好好放松几天了。

choices.text: Same here, this trip couldn't come at a better time.
choices.zh: 我也是，这趟旅行来得正是时候。

choices.text: Same here, though I'd rather keep working instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → Same here, this trip couldn't come at a better time.

transition.en: They pull into the driveway of a cozy lakeside cottage.
transition.zh: 他们把车开进了一间温馨湖边小屋的车道。

npcLine.en: This view is even better than the photos showed.
npcLine.zh: 这景色比照片上看到的还要美。

choices.text: It really is, I can't stop staring at it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我怎么看都看不够。

choices.text: It really isn't, the photos looked much nicer.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I can't stop staring at it.

npcLine.en: Can you help me unload the car?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我把车上的东西卸下来吗？

choices.text: I can grab these bags right now.
choices.zh: 我现在就能把这些包拿下来。

choices.text: I can't lift anything, I'm too tired to move.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can grab these bags right now.

npcLine.en: Let's pick a bedroom before we unpack.
npcLine.zh: 我们收拾行李前先选一间卧室吧。

choices.text: Sounds good, let's check them both out.
choices.zh: 好的，我们两间都去看看吧。

choices.text: Let's just sleep in the car instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Sounds good, let's check them both out.

transition.en: That afternoon, they borrow kayaks and head onto the lake.
transition.zh: 那天下午，他们借了皮划艇下湖去了。

npcLine.en: Have you ever been kayaking before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前划过皮划艇吗？

choices.text: I've tried it once, years ago.
choices.zh: 我几年前试过一次。

choices.text: I'm kayaking right at this very second.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've tried it once, years ago.

npcLine.en: This lake is calmer than I expected today.
npcLine.zh: 今天这个湖比我预想的要平静。

choices.text: It really is, perfect conditions for us.
choices.zh: 确实如此，条件对我们来说太完美了。

choices.text: It really isn't, the waves are terrifying.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, perfect conditions for us.

npcLine.en: Are you paddling toward that little island?
npcLine.zh: 你是要划向那个小岛吗？

choices.text: Yes, I'm heading straight for it now.
choices.zh: 是的，我现在正朝那儿划去。

choices.text: Yes, I paddled there last summer already.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → Yes, I'm heading straight for it now.

transition.en: They spend the rest of the afternoon lounging on the dock.
transition.zh: 剩下的下午他们都在码头上悠闲地度过。

npcLine.en: This might be the most relaxed I've felt in months.
npcLine.zh: 这可能是我几个月来感觉最放松的一次。

choices.text: I've felt the exact same way all day.
choices.zh: 我一整天都有一模一样的感受。

choices.text: I've never once felt relaxed in my life.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've felt the exact same way all day.

npcLine.en: Once the baby comes, quiet afternoons like this will be rare.
npcLine.zh: 宝宝出生后，这样安静的午后会变得很少见。

choices.text: That's exactly why we should enjoy this moment.
choices.zh: 这正是我们要好好珍惜这一刻的原因。

choices.text: That's why we shouldn't have come here at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → That's exactly why we should enjoy this moment.

npcLine.en: Let's just stay here and do absolutely nothing.
npcLine.zh: 我们就待在这儿，什么都不做吧。

choices.text: Deal, let's do nothing for the rest of the day.
choices.zh: 成交，今天剩下的时间我们就什么都不做。

choices.text: Let's go find something productive to do instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Deal, let's do nothing for the rest of the day.

transition.en: As evening falls, they cook dinner over an open fire.
transition.zh: 夜幕降临，他们在篝火上做晚饭。

npcLine.en: Can you turn the skewers while I set the table?
npcLine.zh: 我摆桌子的时候你能翻一下烤串吗？

choices.text: I can turn them, no problem at all.
choices.zh: 我能翻，没问题。

choices.text: I can't cook anything, fire scares me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can turn them, no problem at all.

npcLine.en: Everything tastes better cooked over a real fire.
npcLine.zh: 用真正的篝火做的东西吃起来更香。

choices.text: It really does, there's something special about it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这样做出来的东西有种特别的味道。

choices.text: It doesn't, this tastes exactly like at home.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, there's something special about it.

npcLine.en: Watch out, that pan is hotter than it looks.
npcLine.zh: 小心点，那个平底锅比看起来要烫。

choices.text: Thanks for the warning, I'll be careful.
choices.zh: 谢谢提醒，我会小心的。

choices.text: Thanks, though I'll just grab it with my hands.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thanks for the warning, I'll be careful.

transition.en: After dinner, they lie back and look up at the stars.
transition.zh: 晚饭后，他们躺下来仰望星空。

npcLine.en: You can see so many more stars out here.
npcLine.zh: 在这儿能看到多得多的星星。

choices.text: You can, the city never lets us see this.
choices.zh: 确实能，在城市里我们从没能看到过这些。

choices.text: You can't, this sky looks exactly like home.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → You can, the city never lets us see this.

npcLine.en: What do you think our lives will look like in a year?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得一年后我们的生活会是什么样子？

choices.text: Busier, but happier, I think.
choices.zh: 我觉得会更忙，但也更幸福。

choices.text: Exactly the same as it is right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答预测 → Busier, but happier, I think.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy things get, let's find nights like this.
npcLine.zh: 不管以后有多忙，我们都要找出这样的夜晚。

choices.text: No matter how busy, we'll always make time for this.
choices.zh: 不管多忙，我们都会为这样的时刻抽出时间。

choices.text: No matter how busy, nights like this won't matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy, we'll always make time for this.

transition.en: The next morning brings unexpected rain against the windows.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，窗外下起了意料之外的雨。

scenes.title: A Rainy Morning
scenes.subtitle: 度假屋 · 下雨的清晨

npcLine.en: If it keeps raining, what should we do instead?
npcLine.zh: 如果一直下雨，我们应该做点什么呢？

choices.text: If it does, let's just play cards inside.
choices.zh: 如果一直下，我们就在屋里打牌吧。

choices.text: If it does, let's paddle out into the storm.

n1.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If it does, let's just play cards inside.

npcLine.en: This is actually kind of nice, listening to the rain.
npcLine.zh: 其实听雨声也挺不错的。

choices.text: It really is, it feels calm and peaceful.
choices.zh: 确实是，感觉很平静安宁。

choices.text: It really isn't, rain always ruins everything.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, it feels calm and peaceful.

npcLine.en: Even the rainy days here feel special somehow.
npcLine.zh: 就连这里下雨的日子都有种特别的感觉。

choices.text: Even the rain, I have to admit, feels nice.
choices.zh: 即使是下雨，我也不得不承认感觉很好。

choices.text: Even the rain proves this trip was a mistake.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even the rain, I have to admit, feels nice.

transition.en: On the final day, they pack the car and tidy the cottage.
transition.zh: 最后一天，他们收拾车子，整理好度假屋。

npcLine.en: Have we left everything the way we found it?
npcLine.zh: 我们有把一切都恢复成原来的样子吗？

choices.text: I've double-checked, and everything looks good.
choices.zh: 我又检查了一遍，一切都没问题。

choices.text: I've never once checked anything in this cottage.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've double-checked, and everything looks good.

npcLine.en: This trip went by faster than I wanted it to.
npcLine.zh: 这趟旅行过得比我希望的要快。

choices.text: It really did, I already miss it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我已经开始想念了。

choices.text: It really didn't, this trip felt endless.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, I already miss it.

npcLine.en: We'll definitely come back here someday.
npcLine.zh: 我们以后一定会再回来的。

choices.text: We will, maybe with a little one next time.
choices.zh: 一定会的，也许下次会带着小宝宝一起来。

choices.text: We won't, once was more than enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → We will, maybe with a little one next time.

transition.en: On the drive home, they reflect quietly on the last few days.
transition.zh: 回家的路上，他们静静地回味这几天。

npcLine.en: I think we really needed this trip.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得我们真的很需要这趟旅行。

choices.text: We did, more than I even realized.
choices.zh: 确实需要，比我意识到的还要需要。

choices.text: We didn't, this trip felt like a waste.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We did, more than I even realized.

npcLine.en: How do you feel about everything that's coming next?
npcLine.zh: 对于接下来即将到来的一切，你感觉怎么样？

choices.text: I feel calm, and honestly, really excited.
choices.zh: 我感觉很平静，说实话，也非常期待。

choices.text: I feel nothing at all about any of it.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → I feel calm, and honestly, really excited.

npcLine.en: Whatever happens next, we're doing this together.
npcLine.zh: 不管接下来发生什么，我们都会一起面对。

choices.text: Whatever happens, together, always.
choices.zh: 不管发生什么，我们都一起面对，永远如此。

choices.text: Whatever happens, we'll probably face it apart.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Whatever happens, together, always.

transition.en: A wedding invitation from an old friend arrives in the mail.
transition.zh: 一位老朋友的婚礼请柬寄到了。

npcLine.en: Should we RSVP for both of us, even this pregnant?
npcLine.zh: 都这么大肚子了，我们还要回复两人都参加吗？

choices.text: Yes, I really don't want to miss this.
choices.zh: 是的，我真的不想错过这场婚礼。

choices.text: No, weddings have never mattered to us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, I really don't want to miss this.

npcLine.en: The wedding is only three weeks before your due date.
npcLine.zh: 婚礼距离你的预产期只有三周。

choices.text: That's cutting it close, but it should be fine.
choices.zh: 这时间是有点紧，但应该没问题。

choices.text: That's way too risky, we should skip it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's cutting it close, but it should be fine.

npcLine.en: We'll check with the doctor before we confirm.
npcLine.zh: 我们确认之前先问问医生。

choices.text: Good idea, better safe than sorry.
choices.zh: 好主意，安全第一。

choices.text: Bad idea, the doctor never needs to know.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Good idea, better safe than sorry.

transition.en: They browse the couple's online gift registry.
transition.zh: 他们浏览新人的线上礼物登记清单。

npcLine.en: What's still left on their registry?
npcLine.zh: 他们的登记清单上还剩什么没被认领？

choices.text: A few kitchen items and some bedding.
choices.zh: 还有一些厨房用品和床上用品。

choices.text: Nothing at all, everything's already taken.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答清单 → A few kitchen items and some bedding.

npcLine.en: This set is nicer than the one we almost bought.
npcLine.zh: 这一套比我们差点买的那套更漂亮。

choices.text: It is, let's go with this one instead.
choices.zh: 确实是，那我们就选这一套吧。

choices.text: It isn't, let's stick with the other one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's go with this one instead.

npcLine.en: Should we add a card with a personal note?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要附一张写了寄语的卡片？

choices.text: Yes, a personal note would mean a lot.
choices.zh: 好，一句寄语会很有意义。

choices.text: No, cards are a complete waste of paper.

n3.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, a personal note would mean a lot.

transition.en: Finding an outfit that fits her growing belly proves tricky.
transition.zh: 找一件能穿得下渐渐隆起的肚子的衣服有点棘手。

npcLine.en: Have you found anything that actually fits yet?
npcLine.zh: 你有找到真正合身的衣服了吗？

choices.text: I've found one dress that fits perfectly.
choices.zh: 我找到了一件很合身的裙子。

choices.text: I've never once tried anything on today.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've found one dress that fits perfectly.

npcLine.en: This color suits you more than the other options.
npcLine.zh: 这个颜色比其他选择更适合你。

choices.text: You're right, I'll take this one.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我就要这件了。

choices.text: You're wrong, the other colors suit me better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → You're right, I'll take this one.

npcLine.en: You look absolutely beautiful in that.
npcLine.zh: 你穿这件真的美极了。

choices.text: Thank you, that means a lot right now.
choices.zh: 谢谢，这句话现在对我意义重大。

choices.text: Thank you, though I don't believe you at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Thank you, that means a lot right now.

transition.en: They take their seats as the wedding ceremony begins.
transition.zh: 婚礼仪式开始，他们落座就位。

npcLine.en: Doesn't the bride look absolutely stunning?
npcLine.zh: 新娘是不是美得让人惊艳？

choices.text: She really does, I'm getting a little emotional.
choices.zh: 确实是，我都有点感动了。

choices.text: She doesn't, this dress looks quite plain.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → She really does, I'm getting a little emotional.

npcLine.en: How long have those two been together?
npcLine.zh: 他们俩在一起多久了？

choices.text: They've been together for almost eight years.
choices.zh: 他们在一起差不多八年了。

choices.text: They've never actually been together at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → They've been together for almost eight years.

npcLine.en: Weddings always remind me of our own, don't they?
npcLine.zh: 婚礼总是让我想起我们自己的婚礼，是不是？

choices.text: They do, every single time.
choices.zh: 确实是，每次都会想起。

choices.text: They don't, our wedding feels like a blur.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They do, every single time.

transition.en: After the ceremony, guests move to the reception hall.
transition.zh: 仪式结束后，宾客们移步到宴会厅。

npcLine.en: Which table are we assigned to?
npcLine.zh: 我们被安排在哪一桌？

choices.text: We're at table seven, near the dance floor.
choices.zh: 我们在七号桌，靠近舞池。

choices.text: We're not assigned to any table at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答信息 → We're at table seven, near the dance floor.

npcLine.en: Are you comfortable, or should we get you a softer chair?
npcLine.zh: 你坐着舒服吗，还是要换个更软的椅子？

choices.text: A softer chair would actually be great, thanks.
choices.zh: 更软一点的椅子确实会更好，谢谢。

choices.text: A softer chair sounds completely unnecessary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → A softer chair would actually be great, thanks.

npcLine.en: The best man is about to give his speech.
npcLine.zh: 伴郎马上要致辞了。

choices.text: Let's listen closely, I love a good speech.
choices.zh: 我们仔细听吧，我很喜欢听精彩的致辞。

choices.text: Let's ignore it, speeches are always boring.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Let's listen closely, I love a good speech.

transition.en: The best man raises his glass for the toast.
transition.zh: 伴郎举起酒杯开始祝酒。

npcLine.en: I've known the groom since we were kids.
npcLine.zh: 我从小就认识新郎了。

choices.text: That's such a sweet way to start a toast.
choices.zh: 用这种方式开场祝酒真是太温馨了。

choices.text: That's odd, why mention childhood at a wedding?

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → That's such a sweet way to start a toast.

npcLine.en: If you'd told me back then he'd marry his best friend, I wouldn't have believed you.
npcLine.zh: 如果那时候有人告诉我他会娶自己最好的朋友，我肯定不会相信。

choices.text: That line got a laugh from the whole room.
choices.zh: 那句话逗笑了全场的人。

choices.text: That line felt completely inappropriate for a wedding.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应条件句 → That line got a laugh from the whole room.

npcLine.en: To the happy couple, may your love only grow.
npcLine.zh: 敬这对新人，愿你们的爱与日俱增。

choices.text: To the happy couple, cheers to that.
choices.zh: 敬这对新人，为此干杯。

choices.text: To the happy couple, though the speech ran long.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应祝酒 → To the happy couple, cheers to that.

transition.en: Between courses, they catch up with friends they haven't seen in years.
transition.zh: 上菜间隙，他们和多年未见的朋友叙旧。

npcLine.en: I can't believe how long it's been since we last talked!
npcLine.zh: 真不敢相信我们已经这么久没聊了！

choices.text: I know, it's been far too long.
choices.zh: 是啊，实在是太久了。

choices.text: I know, we just talked yesterday, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → I know, it's been far too long.

npcLine.en: You look even more radiant than I remember.
npcLine.zh: 你比我记忆中的样子还要神采奕奕。

choices.text: Aw, thank you, pregnancy agrees with me I guess.
choices.zh: 哎呀，谢谢，看来我挺适合怀孕的。

choices.text: Aw, thank you, though I feel exhausted every day.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Aw, thank you, pregnancy agrees with me I guess.

npcLine.en: We should get all our old friends together again soon.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该尽快把老朋友们再聚一次。

choices.text: Absolutely, let's plan something after the baby comes.
choices.zh: 当然，我们等宝宝出生后就安排一次吧。

choices.text: Absolutely not, reunions are always awkward.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Absolutely, let's plan something after the baby comes.

transition.en: The newlyweds step onto the floor for their first dance.
transition.zh: 新人走上舞池跳起了第一支舞。

npcLine.en: Do you remember our first dance at our own wedding?
npcLine.zh: 你还记得我们自己婚礼上的第一支舞吗？

choices.text: I remember every single second of it.
choices.zh: 我记得每一秒钟。

choices.text: I don't remember anything about that day.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I remember every single second of it.

npcLine.en: This song is even more beautiful live than on the radio.
npcLine.zh: 这首歌现场听起来比在广播里更好听。

choices.text: It really is, live music just hits different.
choices.zh: 确实如此，现场音乐就是不一样。

choices.text: It really isn't, the radio version sounds better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, live music just hits different.

npcLine.en: I wish I could dance with you right now.
npcLine.zh: 我真希望现在能和你跳一支舞。

choices.text: If I weren't this pregnant, I'd be right there.
choices.zh: 如果我没这么大肚子，我早就上去了。

choices.text: If I weren't this pregnant, I still wouldn't dance.

n3.hintOnWrong: 虚拟语气 → If I weren't this pregnant, I'd be right there.

transition.en: As the night goes on, they decide to leave a little early.
transition.zh: 夜色渐深，他们决定提前一点离开。

npcLine.en: Are you getting tired? We can leave whenever you want.
npcLine.zh: 你累了吗？我们随时可以走。

choices.text: A little, but tonight was worth every minute.
choices.zh: 有点累，但今晚的每一分钟都值得。

choices.text: No, I could stay here all night long.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → A little, but tonight was worth every minute.

npcLine.en: We should say our goodbyes before we slip out.
npcLine.zh: 我们该在悄悄离场前先道个别。

choices.text: Good idea, let's find the couple first.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们先找到新人。

choices.text: Bad idea, let's just sneak out unnoticed.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, let's find the couple first.

npcLine.en: Thank you both for celebrating with us tonight.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你们俩今晚来陪我们庆祝。

choices.text: Thank you for having us, congratulations again.
choices.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我们，再次恭喜。

choices.text: Thank you, though we're honestly ready to leave.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you for having us, congratulations again.

transition.en: On the drive home, they quietly reflect on the evening.
transition.zh: 回家的路上，他们静静回味这一晚。

npcLine.en: Tonight made me think a lot about our own marriage.
npcLine.zh: 今晚让我想了很多关于我们自己婚姻的事。

choices.text: Me too, and I'm grateful for every year of it.
choices.zh: 我也是，我很感激这些年的每一年。

choices.text: Me too, I mostly thought about the food.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Me too, and I'm grateful for every year of it.

npcLine.en: In a few weeks, we'll be starting our own new chapter.
npcLine.zh: 再过几周，我们就要开启自己的新篇章了。

choices.text: We will, and I couldn't be more ready.
choices.zh: 确实是，我已经准备好了。

choices.text: We won't, nothing about our life will change.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → We will, and I couldn't be more ready.

npcLine.en: Even after everything, I'd choose this life with you again.
npcLine.zh: 即使经历了这一切，我还是会再次选择和你一起过这样的生活。

choices.text: Even after everything, I'd choose you every time.
choices.zh: 即使经历了这一切，我每次都会选择你。

choices.text: Even after everything, I'd choose something simpler.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even after everything, I'd choose you every time.

transition.en: Late one night, she wakes up with a strange tightening feeling.
transition.zh: 深夜，她突然感到一阵奇怪的紧绷感醒了过来。

npcLine.en: I think I'm having contractions.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得我在宫缩了。

choices.text: Okay, I'm timing them starting right now.
choices.zh: 好，我现在就开始给它们计时。

choices.text: Okay, I'm going back to sleep now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → Okay, I'm timing them starting right now.

npcLine.en: How far apart are they so far?
npcLine.zh: 目前两次之间间隔多久？

choices.text: About eight minutes apart, I think.
choices.zh: 我觉得大概间隔八分钟。

choices.text: They aren't apart at all, they're constant.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答频率 → About eight minutes apart, I think.

npcLine.en: If they get closer together, we should head to the hospital.
npcLine.zh: 如果间隔越来越短，我们就该去医院了。

choices.text: If that happens, let's grab the hospital bag.
choices.zh: 如果真是那样，我们就拿上待产包吧。

choices.text: If that happens, let's just wait a few more days.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that happens, let's grab the hospital bag.

transition.en: They call the on-call doctor for guidance.
transition.zh: 他们打电话给值班医生寻求指导。

scenes.title: Calling the Doctor
scenes.subtitle: 电话 · 联系值班医生

npcLine.en: How often are the contractions coming now?
npcLine.zh: 现在宫缩多久来一次？

choices.text: They're coming about every five minutes.
choices.zh: 大概每五分钟一次。

choices.text: They aren't coming at all right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答频率 → They're coming about every five minutes.

npcLine.en: It's time to come in, don't wait any longer.
npcLine.zh: 该来医院了，别再等了。

choices.text: Okay, we're leaving for the hospital right now.
choices.zh: 好的，我们现在就出发去医院。

choices.text: Okay, we'll head there sometime tomorrow.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Okay, we're leaving for the hospital right now.

npcLine.en: Drive safely, and try to stay calm.
npcLine.zh: 开车小心，尽量保持冷静。

choices.text: We will, thank you for your help.
choices.zh: 我们会的，谢谢你的帮助。

choices.text: We won't, calm feels impossible right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → We will, thank you for your help.

transition.en: They rush to the car in the middle of the night.
transition.zh: 深夜里他们冲向车子。

npcLine.en: Are you okay? Just breathe through it.
npcLine.zh: 你还好吗？跟着呼吸就好。

choices.text: I'm okay, just drive a little faster please.
choices.zh: 我没事，麻烦开快一点。

choices.text: I'm okay, there's no need to hurry at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I'm okay, just drive a little faster please.

npcLine.en: This traffic is worse than I expected at this hour.
npcLine.zh: 这个点的交通比我预想的还要糟糕。

choices.text: It is, let's take the side street instead.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们走小路吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this traffic looks perfectly light.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's take the side street instead.

npcLine.en: We're almost there, just a few more minutes.
npcLine.zh: 我们快到了，再坚持几分钟。

choices.text: Good, I don't think I can wait much longer.
choices.zh: 太好了，我觉得我撑不了太久了。

choices.text: Good, though I could wait for hours if needed.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good, I don't think I can wait much longer.

transition.en: They rush through the doors of the emergency entrance.
transition.zh: 他们冲进了急诊入口的大门。

npcLine.en: How far along are you, and how frequent are the contractions?
npcLine.zh: 您现在孕几周，宫缩频率如何？

choices.text: Thirty-nine weeks, and about four minutes apart.
choices.zh: 三十九周了，大概每四分钟一次。

choices.text: I have no idea how far along I am.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答信息 → Thirty-nine weeks, and about four minutes apart.

npcLine.en: Please have a seat, a nurse will call you shortly.
npcLine.zh: 请坐一下，护士很快会叫您的名字。

choices.text: Thank you, we'll wait right over there.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们就在那边等着。

choices.text: Thank you, but waiting isn't an option right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Thank you, we'll wait right over there.

npcLine.en: We're getting a wheelchair for you right away.
npcLine.zh: 我们马上给您准备轮椅。

choices.text: Thank you, that would help a lot right now.
choices.zh: 谢谢，现在这真的很有帮助。

choices.text: Thank you, though I'd rather just walk instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Thank you, that would help a lot right now.

transition.en: A nurse leads them to a delivery room and helps her settle in.
transition.zh: 一位护士带他们到产房，帮她安顿好。

scenes.title: Getting Settled in the Delivery Room
scenes.subtitle: 产房 · 安顿下来

npcLine.en: I'm going to check how dilated you are now.
npcLine.zh: 我现在要检查一下您的宫口开了多少。

choices.text: Okay, I'll try to relax while you check.
choices.zh: 好的，检查的时候我会尽量放松。

choices.text: Okay, though I'd rather you skip that entirely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → Okay, I'll try to relax while you check.

npcLine.en: You're already more dilated than most people at this stage.
npcLine.zh: 您现在开的口比这个阶段大多数人都要大。

choices.text: That's good news, isn't it?
choices.zh: 这是好消息吧？

choices.text: That's bad news, something must be wrong.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's good news, isn't it?

npcLine.en: Can you squeeze my hand during the next one?
npcLine.zh: 下一次宫缩的时候你能握着我的手吗？

choices.text: I can, I'm right here with you.
choices.zh: 我能，我一直在你身边。

choices.text: I can't, I need to step outside for air.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, I'm right here with you.

transition.en: As labor intensifies, the midwife coaches her through each contraction.
transition.zh: 随着产程加剧，助产士指导她度过每一次宫缩。

npcLine.en: Breathe in slowly, and let it out just as slowly.
npcLine.zh: 慢慢吸气，再同样慢慢地呼出来。

choices.text: Okay, I'm trying my best to focus.
choices.zh: 好，我在尽力集中精神。

choices.text: Okay, though breathing feels impossible right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'm trying my best to focus.

npcLine.en: You're doing better than you think you are.
npcLine.zh: 你做得比你自己想象的要好。

choices.text: Thank you, that really helps to hear.
choices.zh: 谢谢，听到这个真的很有帮助。

choices.text: Thank you, though I feel like I'm failing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thank you, that really helps to hear.

npcLine.en: I'm right here, and I'm not going anywhere.
npcLine.zh: 我就在这里，哪儿也不去。

choices.text: I know, and that means everything to me.
choices.zh: 我知道，这对我意义非凡。

choices.text: I know, though I wish you'd leave right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I know, and that means everything to me.

transition.en: The midwife signals that it's time to push.
transition.zh: 助产士示意该开始用力了。

npcLine.en: On the next contraction, I need you to push hard.
npcLine.zh: 下一次宫缩时，我需要您用力。

choices.text: Okay, I'm ready, tell me when.
choices.zh: 好的，我准备好了，告诉我什么时候。

choices.text: Sorry, pushing isn't something I want to do.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'm ready, tell me when.

npcLine.en: You can do this, you're almost there.
npcLine.zh: 你能做到的，就快成功了。

choices.text: I can do this, I know I can.
choices.zh: 我能做到的，我知道我可以。

choices.text: I can't do this, I want to stop now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can do this, I know I can.

npcLine.en: One more big push, and your baby will be here.
npcLine.zh: 再用一次力，宝宝就要出生了。

choices.text: Okay, this is it, here we go.
choices.zh: 好，就是现在了，开始吧。

choices.text: Okay, though I'd rather wait a bit longer.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → Okay, this is it, here we go.

transition.en: A tiny cry fills the room as the baby is born.
transition.zh: 一声细小的啼哭充满了整个房间，宝宝出生了。

npcLine.en: Congratulations, it's a healthy baby.
npcLine.zh: 恭喜，是个健康的宝宝。

choices.text: I can't believe this is really happening.
choices.zh: 我真不敢相信这真的发生了。

choices.text: I already knew this would happen exactly like this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I can't believe this is really happening.

npcLine.en: Would you like to hold your baby now?
npcLine.zh: 您现在想抱抱宝宝吗？

choices.text: Yes, please, I've been waiting for this moment.
choices.zh: 好的，请给我，我一直在等这一刻。

choices.text: No, not yet, I'd rather wait a while.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Yes, please, I've been waiting for this moment.

npcLine.en: This is the most amazing moment of my entire life.
npcLine.zh: 这是我这辈子最美妙的时刻。

choices.text: It really is, for me too.
choices.zh: 确实如此，对我来说也是。

choices.text: It really isn't, I've had better moments.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, for me too.
