transition.en: In the quiet hour after birth, the new family holds each other close.
transition.zh: 分娩后安静的第一个小时，这个新家庭紧紧地拥抱在一起。

npcLine.en: How are you feeling right now, honestly?
npcLine.zh: 老实说，你现在感觉怎么样？

choices.text: Exhausted, but happier than I've ever been.
choices.zh: 很累，但比以往任何时候都幸福。

choices.text: I feel exactly the same as before.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → Exhausted, but happier than I've ever been.

npcLine.en: Look at those tiny fingers and toes.
npcLine.zh: 看看这些小小的手指和脚趾。

choices.text: They're so tiny, I can't get over it.
choices.zh: 太小了，我怎么看都看不够。

choices.text: They look completely normal, nothing special at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They're so tiny, I can't get over it.

npcLine.en: Everything we've been through led us to this moment.
npcLine.zh: 我们经历的一切都指向了这一刻。

choices.text: It has, and it was all worth it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，一切都值得。

choices.text: It hasn't, none of it led anywhere.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → It has, and it was all worth it.

transition.en: As the sun rises, they finally settle on a name: Lily — after the woman whose kindness started it all.
transition.zh: 太阳升起时，他们终于确定了名字：Lily——纪念那位善良开启了这一切的女士。

npcLine.en: Are we finally deciding on the name?
npcLine.zh: 我们终于要定下名字了吗？

choices.text: Yes, I think we both already know it.
choices.zh: 是的，我觉得我们俩其实早就知道了。

choices.text: No, we'll just pick something random later.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, I think we both already know it.

npcLine.en: This name suits them perfectly, doesn't it?
npcLine.zh: 这个名字非常适合他们，不是吗？

choices.text: It really does, it feels just right.
choices.zh: 确实如此，感觉恰到好处。

choices.text: It really doesn't, let's think of something else.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, it feels just right.

npcLine.en: Welcome to the world, we've been waiting for you.
npcLine.zh: 欢迎来到这个世界，我们一直在等你。

choices.text: We've been waiting so long, and here you are.
choices.zh: 我们等了这么久，你终于来了。

choices.text: We've never once waited for you at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've been waiting so long, and here you are.

transition.en: Two days later, they carry the baby through their own front door.
transition.zh: 两天后，他们把宝宝抱进了自己家门。

npcLine.en: This house feels completely different now, doesn't it?
npcLine.zh: 这个家现在感觉完全不一样了，不是吗？

choices.text: It really does, in the best possible way.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且是最好的那种不一样。

choices.text: It doesn't feel any different at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, in the best possible way.

npcLine.en: Can you set up the bassinet in our room?
npcLine.zh: 你能把婴儿床摆在我们房间吗？

choices.text: I can set it up right now.
choices.zh: 我现在就能摆好。

choices.text: I can't, we don't own a bassinet.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can set it up right now.

npcLine.en: Our dog seems curious but calm about the baby.
npcLine.zh: 我们家狗对宝宝好像既好奇又平静。

choices.text: That's reassuring, all that training paid off.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，之前的训练真的有用了。

choices.text: That's concerning, we should send the dog away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, all that training paid off.

transition.en: A nurse's instructions on swaddling come in handy that first night.
transition.zh: 第一晚，护士教的襁褓包法派上了用场。

npcLine.en: Can you remember how the nurse folded the blanket?
npcLine.zh: 你还记得护士是怎么折毯子的吗？

choices.text: I can remember most of it, I think.
choices.zh: 我大概能记得大部分。

choices.text: I can't remember anything she showed us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can remember most of it, I think.

npcLine.en: This swaddle is tighter than the last attempt.
npcLine.zh: 这次包的襁褓比上次更紧了。

choices.text: It is, and it seems to be working.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且看起来很有效。

choices.text: It isn't, this one is actually looser.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, and it seems to be working.

npcLine.en: Look, they're finally settling down.
npcLine.zh: 看，他们终于安静下来了。

choices.text: They're finally calming down, thank goodness.
choices.zh: 他们终于平静下来了，谢天谢地。

choices.text: They're getting more upset by the second.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → They're finally calming down, thank goodness.

transition.en: At 3 a.m., the baby wakes up hungry again.
transition.zh: 凌晨三点，宝宝又饿醒了。

npcLine.en: Is it your turn or mine this time?
npcLine.zh: 这次轮到你还是我？

choices.text: It's my turn, go back to sleep.
choices.zh: 轮到我了，你继续睡吧。

choices.text: It's nobody's turn, let's ignore the crying.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答归属 → It's my turn, go back to sleep.

npcLine.en: How many hours of sleep did you get last night?
npcLine.zh: 你昨晚睡了几个小时？

choices.text: I probably got about three hours, total.
choices.zh: 我大概总共睡了三个小时。

choices.text: I got a full eight hours, easily.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时长 → I probably got about three hours, total.

npcLine.en: We've both become experts at surviving on little sleep.
npcLine.zh: 我们俩都成了靠少量睡眠撑下去的专家了。

choices.text: We really have, though I could use more coffee.
choices.zh: 确实如此，不过我需要更多咖啡。

choices.text: We really haven't, sleep has never been an issue.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, though I could use more coffee.

transition.en: They take the baby for the first pediatrician checkup.
transition.zh: 他们带宝宝去做第一次儿科体检。

scenes.title: The First Pediatrician Visit
scenes.subtitle: 儿科诊所 · 首次体检

npcLine.en: How has feeding been going so far?
npcLine.zh: 目前喂养情况怎么样？

choices.text: It's been going smoothly, actually.
choices.zh: 其实进行得很顺利。

choices.text: It's never once gone well at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → It's been going smoothly, actually.

npcLine.en: Their weight is right on track for this age.
npcLine.zh: 他们这个年龄段的体重完全符合标准。

choices.text: That's such a relief to hear.
choices.zh: 听到这个真的松了一口气。

choices.text: That's concerning, we expected more weight gain.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's such a relief to hear.

npcLine.en: Do you have any questions before you go?
npcLine.zh: 离开前你们有什么问题吗？

choices.text: Yes, actually, when should we expect a smile?
choices.zh: 有的，宝宝大概什么时候会笑？

choices.text: No, we understand everything perfectly already.

n3.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, actually, when should we expect a smile?

transition.en: By the end of the first week, exhaustion sets in.
transition.zh: 第一周快结束时，疲惫感袭来。

npcLine.en: I feel more tired than I've ever felt in my life.
npcLine.zh: 我感觉比这辈子任何时候都累。

choices.text: Me too, but somehow it's worth it.
choices.zh: 我也是，但不知怎么地这一切都值得。

choices.text: Me too, and I regret every part of this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Me too, but somehow it's worth it.

npcLine.en: Should we take turns napping this afternoon?
npcLine.zh: 今天下午我们要不要轮流小睡一下？

choices.text: Yes, let's split the afternoon in half.
choices.zh: 好，我们把下午分成两半吧。

choices.text: No, naps are a complete waste of time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's split the afternoon in half.

npcLine.en: Even on the hardest days, I wouldn't trade this for anything.
npcLine.zh: 即使是最难熬的日子，我也不会用这一切换任何东西。

choices.text: Even on the hardest days, I feel the same way.
choices.zh: 即使是最难熬的日子，我也有同样的感受。

choices.text: Even on the hardest days, I'd trade this in a second.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even on the hardest days, I feel the same way.

transition.en: Grandparents stop by to meet the baby for the first time.
transition.zh: 祖父母第一次来看宝宝。

npcLine.en: Oh, they have your nose, don't they?
npcLine.zh: 哦，他们的鼻子长得像你，是不是？

choices.text: Everyone keeps saying that, actually.
choices.zh: 其实大家都这么说。

choices.text: Nobody has ever said that before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Everyone keeps saying that, actually.

npcLine.en: Would you like us to bring dinner over this week?
npcLine.zh: 这周要不要我们给你们送饭过来？

choices.text: That would be an enormous help, thank you.
choices.zh: 那真的会帮上大忙，谢谢你们。

choices.text: That would be completely unnecessary, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That would be an enormous help, thank you.

npcLine.en: Let us know if you need anything at all.
npcLine.zh: 有什么需要就告诉我们。

choices.text: We will, and thank you for everything.
choices.zh: 我们会的，谢谢你们的一切。

choices.text: We will, but we probably won't need help.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用连接词 → We will, and thank you for everything.

transition.en: That evening, they attempt the baby's first bath at home.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们尝试给宝宝在家洗第一次澡。

npcLine.en: Can you check the water temperature first?
npcLine.zh: 你能先检查一下水温吗？

choices.text: I can check it right now with my wrist.
choices.zh: 我现在就用手腕试一下水温。

choices.text: I can't check temperature, I don't know how.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can check it right now with my wrist.

npcLine.en: They seem calmer in the water than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 他们在水里看起来比我预想的更平静。

choices.text: They really are, this is going better than I thought.
choices.zh: 确实是，这比我想的顺利多了。

choices.text: They really aren't, this is a total disaster.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, this is going better than I thought.

npcLine.en: Please hand me the towel when we're done.
npcLine.zh: 洗完之后请把毛巾递给我。

choices.text: Sure, I've got it ready right here.
choices.zh: 好的，我已经准备好了。

choices.text: Sorry, I forgot to get a towel at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Sure, I've got it ready right here.

transition.en: By the second week, a rough routine starts to form.
transition.zh: 到了第二周，一个大致的作息节奏开始形成。

npcLine.en: I think we're finally getting the hang of this.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得我们终于开始摸到门道了。

choices.text: We really are, it feels less chaotic now.
choices.zh: 确实如此，现在感觉没那么混乱了。

choices.text: We're not, everything still feels impossible.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → We really are, it feels less chaotic now.

npcLine.en: This week has been easier than last week, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，这周比上周轻松多了。

choices.text: It has, we're finally settling into this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们终于开始适应了。

choices.text: It hasn't, every single week feels the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It has, we're finally settling into this.

npcLine.en: We should probably write down what's working for us.
npcLine.zh: 我们大概应该把有效的方法记下来。

choices.text: Good idea, future us will thank us.
choices.zh: 好主意，以后的我们会感谢现在的自己。

choices.text: Bad idea, we'll never need to remember this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, future us will thank us.

transition.en: One rare quiet morning, the baby sleeps a little longer.
transition.zh: 一个难得安静的早晨，宝宝多睡了一会儿。

npcLine.en: Can you believe we actually get to drink hot coffee?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信我们居然能喝到热咖啡吗？

choices.text: I can't believe it, this feels like luxury.
choices.zh: 我不敢相信，这感觉像奢侈品一样。

choices.text: I can believe it, this happens every single day.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/惊讶 → I can't believe it, this feels like luxury.

npcLine.en: Moments like this remind me how far we've come.
npcLine.zh: 像这样的时刻让我意识到我们已经走了多远。

choices.text: They really do, more than you know.
choices.zh: 确实如此，比你想的还要多。

choices.text: They remind me of nothing in particular.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → They remind me of that too, honestly.

npcLine.en: No matter how hard it gets, this is the best thing we've ever done.
npcLine.zh: 不管有多难，这都是我们做过的最棒的事。

choices.text: No matter how hard, I agree completely.
choices.zh: 不管有多难，我完全同意。

choices.text: No matter how hard, I'm starting to have doubts.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how hard, I agree completely.

transition.en: The baby turns one month old, and they pause to celebrate quietly.
transition.zh: 宝宝满月了，他们安静地庆祝了一下。

npcLine.en: I can't believe a whole month has already passed.
npcLine.zh: 我真不敢相信整整一个月已经过去了。

choices.text: I know, it's gone by so fast.
choices.zh: 我知道，过得真快。

choices.text: I know, this month felt like forever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → I know, it's gone by so fast.

npcLine.en: How do you feel looking back on this first month?
npcLine.zh: 回顾这第一个月，你有什么感受？

choices.text: Exhausted, proud, and completely in love.
choices.zh: 疲惫、骄傲，还有满满的爱。

choices.text: I don't feel anything looking back at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → Exhausted, proud, and completely in love.

npcLine.en: Here's to many more months just like this one.
npcLine.zh: 敬未来更多像这样的月份。

choices.text: To many more, together, always.
choices.zh: 敬更多这样的时光，我们一起，永远如此。

choices.text: To fewer months like this one, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应祝酒 → To many more, together, always.

transition.en: With a baby now, they start thinking seriously about retirement.
transition.zh: 有了宝宝之后，他们开始认真考虑退休的事。

npcLine.en: Have we ever actually set up a retirement account?
npcLine.zh: 我们真的设立过退休账户吗？

choices.text: We've never really gotten around to it.
choices.zh: 我们其实一直没顾得上。

choices.text: We're setting one up at this exact moment.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've never really gotten around to it.

npcLine.en: It's probably time we took this more seriously.
npcLine.zh: 我们大概该更认真对待这件事了。

choices.text: You're right, especially with a family now.
choices.zh: 你说得对，尤其是现在有了家庭。

choices.text: You're wrong, retirement is decades away anyway.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → You're right, especially with a family now.

npcLine.en: We should book a meeting with a financial advisor.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该约一位理财顾问见面。

choices.text: Good idea, let's book something this week.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们这周就约一下吧。

choices.text: Bad idea, advisors just want our money.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, let's book something this week.

transition.en: They sit down with a financial advisor for the first time.
transition.zh: 他们第一次和理财顾问坐下来谈。

scenes.title: Meeting the Advisor
scenes.subtitle: 理财公司 · 首次咨询

npcLine.en: What age are you hoping to retire by?
npcLine.zh: 你们希望多大年纪退休？

choices.text: We're hoping for somewhere around sixty-five.
choices.zh: 我们希望大概在六十五岁左右。

choices.text: We're hoping to work forever, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答目标 → We're hoping for somewhere around sixty-five.

npcLine.en: The earlier you start saving, the more it grows.
npcLine.zh: 越早开始存钱，增长的空间就越大。

choices.text: That makes sense, let's start right away then.
choices.zh: 有道理，那我们现在就开始吧。

choices.text: That makes no sense, timing never matters.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, let's start right away then.

npcLine.en: I'll put together a plan based on your goals.
npcLine.zh: 我会根据你们的目标制定一份方案。

choices.text: Thank you, we really appreciate the help.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们真的很感激你的帮助。

choices.text: Thank you, though we don't need any plan.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Thank you, we really appreciate the help.

transition.en: The advisor explains different ways to invest their savings.
transition.zh: 顾问讲解了几种不同的投资方式。

scenes.title: Understanding Investment Options
scenes.subtitle: 理财公司 · 了解投资选项

npcLine.en: Are you comfortable with some risk, or would you rather play it safe?
npcLine.zh: 你们能接受一定的风险，还是更愿意求稳？

choices.text: A little risk is fine, we have time on our side.
choices.zh: 一点风险没关系，我们还有时间。

choices.text: No risk at all, we'd rather keep it under the mattress.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → A little risk is fine, we have time on our side.

npcLine.en: This fund has performed better than the market average.
npcLine.zh: 这只基金的表现比市场平均水平更好。

choices.text: That's encouraging, tell us more about it.
choices.zh: 这让人挺有信心的，多跟我们说说吧。

choices.text: That's suspicious, numbers like that seem fake.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's encouraging, tell us more about it.

npcLine.en: If you diversify, you'll reduce your overall risk.
npcLine.zh: 如果你们分散投资，整体风险就会降低。

choices.text: If that's true, let's diversify as much as we can.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我们就尽量分散投资吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's put it all in one place.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, let's diversify as much as we can.

transition.en: They decide how much to set aside each month.
transition.zh: 他们商量每个月要存多少钱。

scenes.title: Setting a Monthly Contribution
scenes.subtitle: 理财公司 · 设定月度存款

npcLine.en: How much can you comfortably contribute each month?
npcLine.zh: 你们每个月能轻松存多少？

choices.text: We can probably manage about three hundred.
choices.zh: 我们大概能存三百块左右。

choices.text: We can't contribute anything at all right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → We can probably manage about three hundred.

npcLine.en: Even a small amount adds up significantly over time.
npcLine.zh: 即使是小额存款，长期下来也会积累很多。

choices.text: Even a small amount, then, is worth doing.
choices.zh: 那么即使是小额，也值得去做。

choices.text: Even a small amount feels pointless to us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even a small amount, then, is worth doing.

npcLine.en: We'll set up automatic transfers so you never miss a month.
npcLine.zh: 我们会设置自动转账，这样你们就不会漏掉哪个月。

choices.text: That's smart, automation makes it effortless.
choices.zh: 这很明智，自动化让事情变得毫不费力。

choices.text: That's risky, we'd rather do it manually.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's smart, automation makes it effortless.

transition.en: Six months later, they check in on how the account is growing.
transition.zh: 六个月后，他们查看账户的增长情况。

scenes.title: A Check-In Six Months Later
scenes.subtitle: 理财公司 · 半年后回访

npcLine.en: How has the account performed so far?
npcLine.zh: 目前账户的表现怎么样？

choices.text: It's grown more than we expected, actually.
choices.zh: 其实增长比我们预期的要多。

choices.text: It's never once grown at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → It's grown more than we expected, actually.

npcLine.en: Your balance is higher than it was last quarter.
npcLine.zh: 你们的余额比上一季度更高了。

choices.text: That's great to hear, all the saving paid off.
choices.zh: 太好了，之前所有的储蓄都有了回报。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we expected far more growth.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's great to hear, all the saving paid off.

npcLine.en: Would you like to increase your monthly contribution?
npcLine.zh: 你们要不要增加每月的存款额？

choices.text: Yes, let's bump it up a little.
choices.zh: 好的，我们稍微提高一点吧。

choices.text: No, let's actually lower it instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Yes, let's bump it up a little.

transition.en: Over dinner, they explain their new plan to curious grandparents.
transition.zh: 晚饭时，他们向好奇的祖父母解释了新的规划。

scenes.title: Talking About the Future with Family
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 与家人分享

npcLine.en: Why did you two decide to start this now?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩为什么决定现在开始做这件事？

choices.text: We wanted to be responsible for our family's future.
choices.zh: 我们想为家庭的未来负起责任。

choices.text: We decided because someone told us to.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答理由 → We wanted to be responsible for our family's future.

npcLine.en: I wish we'd started this early like you two did.
npcLine.zh: 我真希望我们也能像你们俩一样早点开始。

choices.text: It's never too late to start, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，任何时候开始都不算晚。

choices.text: You're right, it's far too late for you now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应虚拟语气 → It's never too late to start, honestly.

npcLine.en: We're proud of how responsible you two have become.
npcLine.zh: 我们为你们俩变得这么负责任而感到骄傲。

choices.text: Thank you, that really means a lot to us.
choices.zh: 谢谢，这对我们来说意义重大。

choices.text: Thank you, though we haven't really changed at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → Thank you, that really means a lot to us.

transition.en: A rocky month in the market causes a bit of worry.
transition.zh: 市场经历了一个动荡的月份，引发了一些担忧。

scenes.title: A Market Dip
scenes.subtitle: 理财公司 · 市场波动

npcLine.en: Should we be worried about this drop in the market?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该为这次市场下跌感到担心吗？

choices.text: Not really, this is normal over time.
choices.zh: 其实不用，长期来看这很正常。

choices.text: Yes, let's pull all our money out right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Not really, this is normal over time.

npcLine.en: The market has always recovered from dips like this.
npcLine.zh: 市场以前每次这样下跌之后都会恢复。

choices.text: That's reassuring, let's just stay the course.
choices.zh: 这挺让人安心的，我们就继续保持原计划吧。

choices.text: That's not reassuring, let's panic and sell everything.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → That's reassuring, let's just stay the course.

npcLine.en: Even during dips, staying consistent matters most.
npcLine.zh: 即使在市场下跌期间，保持一致性才是最重要的。

choices.text: Even during dips, we'll keep contributing steadily.
choices.zh: 即使市场下跌，我们也会持续稳定地投入。

choices.text: Even during dips, we'll probably just quit.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even during dips, we'll keep contributing steadily.

transition.en: While they're at it, they decide to start saving for the baby too.
transition.zh: 既然都在做规划，他们也决定开始为宝宝存钱。

scenes.title: Setting Up a College Fund
scenes.subtitle: 理财公司 · 设立教育基金

npcLine.en: Have you considered opening an education fund too?
npcLine.zh: 你们有考虑也开一个教育基金吗？

choices.text: We've actually been thinking about that too.
choices.zh: 我们其实也一直在考虑这件事。

choices.text: We've never once thought about that at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've actually been thinking about that too.

npcLine.en: This account grows tax-free, which helps a lot.
npcLine.zh: 这个账户享受免税增长，这帮助很大。

choices.text: That's a huge advantage, let's set it up.
choices.zh: 这是个巨大的优势，我们就开一个吧。

choices.text: That's not important, taxes don't matter to us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's a huge advantage, let's set it up.

npcLine.en: This way, both generations are covered.
npcLine.zh: 这样一来，两代人都有了保障。

choices.text: That feels really good to say out loud.
choices.zh: 说出这句话的感觉真的很好。

choices.text: That feels like an unnecessary amount of planning.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That feels really good to say out loud.

transition.en: That night, they imagine what retirement might actually look like.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们想象退休后的生活会是什么样子。

scenes.title: Imagining Retirement
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 想象退休生活

npcLine.en: What do you picture us doing when we retire?
npcLine.zh: 你想象我们退休后会做什么？

choices.text: Traveling together, probably, with plenty of free time.
choices.zh: 大概会一起旅行，有很多自由时间。

choices.text: Nothing, retirement feels impossible to imagine.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答想象 → Traveling together, probably, with plenty of free time.

npcLine.en: If we plan well now, that future feels within reach.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们现在规划得好，那样的未来是触手可及的。

choices.text: If we keep this up, I really believe it.
choices.zh: 如果我们坚持下去，我真的相信能做到。

choices.text: If we keep this up, it still feels impossible.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If we keep this up, I really believe it.

npcLine.en: No matter how far off it seems, it's worth planning for.
npcLine.zh: 不管感觉多遥远，都值得为它做规划。

choices.text: No matter how far off, future us will thank us.
choices.zh: 不管多遥远，未来的我们会感谢现在的自己。

choices.text: No matter how far off, it's not worth thinking about.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how far off, future us will thank us.

transition.en: A year later, they sit down for their first annual review.
transition.zh: 一年后，他们进行了第一次年度财务回顾。

scenes.title: The Annual Review
scenes.subtitle: 理财公司 · 年度回顾

npcLine.en: This has been a strong first year for your savings.
npcLine.zh: 对你们的储蓄来说，这是坚实的第一年。

choices.text: It's been better than we ever imagined.
choices.zh: 这比我们想象的还要好。

choices.text: It's been a complete disappointment, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → It's been better than we ever imagined.

npcLine.en: How does it feel seeing real progress like this?
npcLine.zh: 看到这样真实的进步，你感觉怎么样？

choices.text: It feels incredibly motivating, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，感觉特别有动力。

choices.text: It doesn't feel like anything to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → It feels incredibly motivating, honestly.

npcLine.en: Here's to many more years of building this future together.
npcLine.zh: 敬未来更多年一起打造这个未来。

choices.text: To many more years, together, always.
choices.zh: 敬更多年，我们一起，永远如此。

choices.text: To fewer years of this, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应祝酒 → To many more years, together, always.

transition.en: One evening, Emma receives a call with sad news about her grandmother.
transition.zh: 一天晚上，Emma接到一通电话，得知祖母去世的消息。

npcLine.en: My grandmother passed away this morning.
npcLine.zh: 我祖母今天早上去世了。

choices.text: I'm so sorry, I'm right here with you.
choices.zh: 我很难过，我就在你身边。

choices.text: That's fine, these things happen sometimes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时表达慰问 → I'm so sorry, I'm right here with you.

npcLine.en: I don't really know what I need right now.
npcLine.zh: 我现在真的不知道自己需要什么。

choices.text: That's okay, you don't need to know right now.
choices.zh: 没关系，你现在不需要知道。

choices.text: That's odd, you should figure it out quickly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's okay, you don't need to know right now.

npcLine.en: Can you just hold me for a while?
npcLine.zh: 你能就这样抱着我一会儿吗？

choices.text: Of course, I can hold you as long as you need.
choices.zh: 当然可以，你需要多久我就抱多久。

choices.text: I can't right now, I have things to do.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → Of course, I can hold you as long as you need.

transition.en: The next day, they help Emma's family with funeral arrangements.
transition.zh: 第二天，他们帮忙Emma的家人处理葬礼安排。

npcLine.en: Have you decided on a date for the service yet?
npcLine.zh: 你们定好追悼仪式的日期了吗？

choices.text: We've settled on this coming Saturday.
choices.zh: 我们定在这个周六了。

choices.text: We've never once discussed the date.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've settled on this coming Saturday.

npcLine.en: Can you help me call some of the relatives?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我打电话通知一些亲戚吗？

choices.text: Of course, I can start calling right now.
choices.zh: 当然可以，我现在就开始打。

choices.text: Sorry, calling people isn't something I want to do.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → Of course, I can start calling right now.

npcLine.en: Thank you for handling all of this with me.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你和我一起处理这一切。

choices.text: Of course, we're in this together.
choices.zh: 当然了，我们要一起面对。

choices.text: Of course, though this isn't really my responsibility.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, we're in this together.

transition.en: The morning of the service, they get ready quietly together.
transition.zh: 追悼仪式当天早上，他们安静地一起准备。

npcLine.en: Do you think this is appropriate for today?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得今天穿这个合适吗？

choices.text: Yes, that looks perfectly appropriate to me.
choices.zh: 是的，在我看来这很合适。

choices.text: No, that looks far too bright for today.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that looks perfectly appropriate to me.

npcLine.en: I keep thinking about the last time we visited her.
npcLine.zh: 我一直在想我们上次去看她的情景。

choices.text: I'm thinking about that too, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我也一直在想那次。

choices.text: I'm not thinking about anything at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I'm thinking about that too, honestly.

npcLine.en: Whatever happens today, I'll stay close to you.
npcLine.zh: 不管今天发生什么，我都会陪在你身边。

choices.text: Whatever happens, thank you for being here.
choices.zh: 不管发生什么，谢谢你在我身边。

choices.text: Whatever happens, I'd rather you kept your distance.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Whatever happens, thank you for being here.

transition.en: Family and friends gather quietly at the funeral home.
transition.zh: 亲友们安静地聚集在殡仪馆。

npcLine.en: So many people came to pay their respects.
npcLine.zh: 有这么多人来表达哀悼。

choices.text: That says a lot about the life she lived.
choices.zh: 这说明了她过去的人生有多么充实。

choices.text: That seems unnecessary, honestly, for a small service.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That says a lot about the life she lived.

npcLine.en: I'm so sorry for your loss.
npcLine.zh: 请节哀，我为你的失去感到难过。

choices.text: Thank you, that means a lot to us.
choices.zh: 谢谢你，这对我们意义重大。

choices.text: Thank you, though we're actually doing just fine.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应慰问 → Thank you, that means a lot to us.

npcLine.en: Please, let us know if you need anything at all.
npcLine.zh: 有什么需要请一定告诉我们。

choices.text: Thank you, just having you here helps.
choices.zh: 谢谢，你能来就已经帮了很大忙。

choices.text: Thank you, though we don't need anything from anyone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Thank you, just having you here helps.

transition.en: Emma's father steps up to share a eulogy for his mother.
transition.zh: Emma的父亲上台为他的母亲致悼词。

npcLine.en: My mother taught me more than she ever knew.
npcLine.zh: 我母亲教给我的，比她自己意识到的还要多。

choices.text: What a beautiful way to remember her.
choices.zh: 这真是一种美好的怀念方式。

choices.text: That's a strange thing to say at a funeral.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → What a beautiful way to remember her.

npcLine.en: She always believed family came before everything else.
npcLine.zh: 她一直相信家庭比其他一切都重要。

choices.text: You could feel that in everything she did.
choices.zh: 在她所做的每一件事里都能感受到这一点。

choices.text: That's surprising, she never seemed to care much.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → You could feel that in everything she did.

npcLine.en: Even now, I feel her presence in this room.
npcLine.zh: 即使是现在，我也能感受到她在这个房间里的存在。

choices.text: Even now, I feel it too, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，即使是现在，我也有同样的感受。

choices.text: Even now, I don't feel anything at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even now, I feel it too, honestly.

transition.en: Afterward, family members quietly share favorite memories of her.
transition.zh: 仪式过后，家人们静静地分享着关于她的美好回忆。

npcLine.en: Do you remember how she always made too much food?
npcLine.zh: 你还记得她总是做太多菜吗？

choices.text: I remember, and it was always delicious.
choices.zh: 我记得，而且每次都很好吃。

choices.text: I don't remember her cooking at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I remember, and it was always delicious.

npcLine.en: She had a way of making everyone feel welcome.
npcLine.zh: 她总有办法让每个人都感到宾至如归。

choices.text: She really did, I felt that from the first day.
choices.zh: 确实是这样，我从第一天起就感受到了。

choices.text: She really didn't, I always felt out of place.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → She really did, I felt that from the first day.

npcLine.en: I wish our baby could have met her.
npcLine.zh: 我真希望我们的宝宝能见到她。

choices.text: If they had, she would have loved this baby so much.
choices.zh: 如果见到了，她一定会非常爱这个宝宝。

choices.text: If they had, it wouldn't have made any difference.

n3.hintOnWrong: 虚拟语气 → If they had, she would have loved this baby so much.

transition.en: Emma quietly steps outside, and he follows to be with her.
transition.zh: Emma悄悄走出去，他跟了出去陪着她。

scenes.title: Supporting Each Other
scenes.subtitle: 殡仪馆外 · 互相支持

npcLine.en: I just needed a moment to breathe.
npcLine.zh: 我只是需要一点时间喘口气。

choices.text: That's completely understandable, take all the time you need.
choices.zh: 这完全可以理解，你需要多久都可以。

choices.text: That's strange, you should be inside with everyone.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's completely understandable, take all the time you need.

npcLine.en: Thank you for not leaving my side today.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你今天一直没有离开我身边。

choices.text: Always, I'll never leave your side.
choices.zh: 永远如此，我永远不会离开你身边。

choices.text: You're welcome, though it wasn't really a big deal.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Always, I'll never leave your side.

npcLine.en: I love you, and I'm grateful we're facing this together.
npcLine.zh: 我爱你，也很感激我们能一起面对这些。

choices.text: I love you too, more than words can say.
choices.zh: 我也爱你，这份爱难以用言语表达。

choices.text: I love you too, though today feels distant somehow.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I love you too, more than words can say.

transition.en: They introduce the baby to relatives Emma hasn't seen in years.
transition.zh: 他们把宝宝介绍给Emma多年未见的亲戚们。

npcLine.en: Is this the baby we've all been hearing about?
npcLine.zh: 这就是我们一直听说的那个宝宝吗？

choices.text: It is, we're so glad you get to meet them.
choices.zh: 没错，很高兴你能见到他们。

choices.text: It isn't, this baby belongs to someone else.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → It is, we're so glad you get to meet them.

npcLine.en: Your great-grandmother would have adored this little one.
npcLine.zh: 你的曾祖母一定会非常疼爱这个小家伙。

choices.text: I believe she would have, without a doubt.
choices.zh: 我相信她一定会，毫无疑问。

choices.text: I doubt it, she never liked babies much.

n2.hintOnWrong: 虚拟语气回应 → I believe she would have, without a doubt.

npcLine.en: It's good to see this family staying close, even now.
npcLine.zh: 看到这个家族即使在这种时候依然团结在一起，真好。

choices.text: Even now, family is what matters most.
choices.zh: 即使是现在，家人才是最重要的。

choices.text: Even now, we're mostly just going through the motions.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even now, family is what matters most.

transition.en: That evening, they drive home quietly, holding hands at every red light.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们静静地开车回家，每次遇到红灯都会牵着手。

npcLine.en: Today was harder than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 今天比我预想的要难熬。

choices.text: It was, but you got through it.
choices.zh: 确实是，但你熬过来了。

choices.text: It really wasn't, today felt easy to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It was, but you got through it.

npcLine.en: How are you feeling now that it's over?
npcLine.zh: 现在一切都结束了，你感觉怎么样？

choices.text: Sad, but also strangely at peace.
choices.zh: 很难过，但也有种奇怪的平静感。

choices.text: I don't feel anything about it at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → Sad, but also strangely at peace.

npcLine.en: She's gone, but everything she gave us stays with us.
npcLine.zh: 她走了，但她给予我们的一切都会一直陪伴着我们。

choices.text: It really does, forever, in the way we love.
choices.zh: 确实如此，它会一直存在，藏在我们爱人的方式里。

choices.text: It really doesn't, memories tend to fade quickly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, forever, in the way we love.

transition.en: A few weeks later, they visit the cemetery together, quietly at peace.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们一起去墓地探望，心中已渐渐平静。

npcLine.en: I brought some flowers from her favorite garden.
npcLine.zh: 我带来了一些她最喜欢的花园里的花。

choices.text: That's such a lovely thing to do.
choices.zh: 这真是件很美好的事。

choices.text: That's strange, flowers don't really mean anything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's such a lovely thing to do.

npcLine.en: We've healed more than I thought we would by now.
npcLine.zh: 到现在为止，我们的疗愈比我预想的要好。

choices.text: We really have, one day at a time.
choices.zh: 确实如此，一天天慢慢来的。

choices.text: We really haven't, nothing has gotten any easier.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, one day at a time.

npcLine.en: No matter how much time passes, we'll always remember her.
npcLine.zh: 不管过去多少时间，我们都会一直记得她。

choices.text: No matter how much time, we'll carry her with us.
choices.zh: 不管过去多少时间，我们都会带着她一同前行。

choices.text: No matter how much time, we'll probably forget eventually.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how much time, we'll carry her with us.

transition.en: Inspired by her grandmother, Emma considers turning her baking hobby into a business.
transition.zh: 受祖母的启发，Emma考虑把烘焙爱好变成一门生意。

npcLine.en: I've been thinking about selling my baking online.
npcLine.zh: 我一直在考虑把我做的烘焙拿去网上卖。

choices.text: I think that's a wonderful idea, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我觉得这是个很棒的主意。

choices.text: I think that's a complete waste of time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → I think that's a wonderful idea, honestly.

npcLine.en: Do you really think people would pay for this?
npcLine.zh: 你真觉得会有人愿意花钱买吗？

choices.text: Yes, everyone who's tried it loves it.
choices.zh: 会的，每个尝过的人都喜欢。

choices.text: No, nobody would ever pay for baked goods.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, everyone who's tried it loves it.

npcLine.en: Let's look into what it takes to start.
npcLine.zh: 我们来研究一下开始需要做什么吧。

choices.text: Let's do that this weekend.
choices.zh: 我们这个周末就开始研究吧。

choices.text: Let's just forget about the whole idea.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that this weekend.

transition.en: They sit down together to sketch out a simple business plan.
transition.zh: 他们坐下来一起草拟一份简单的商业计划。

scenes.title: Writing a Business Plan
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 撰写商业计划

npcLine.en: What should we call the business?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该给这门生意起什么名字？

choices.text: Something warm, like Grandma's Kitchen.
choices.zh: 起个温暖点的名字，比如“奶奶的厨房”。

choices.text: It doesn't need a name at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Something warm, like Grandma's Kitchen.

npcLine.en: This name feels more personal than the other options.
npcLine.zh: 这个名字比其他几个选项更有个人色彩。

choices.text: It does, and it honors her memory too.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且也是对她的一种纪念。

choices.text: It doesn't, all the names sound the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, and it honors her memory too.

npcLine.en: We'll need to figure out pricing next.
npcLine.zh: 接下来我们需要研究定价问题。

choices.text: Right, let's compare prices at local bakeries.
choices.zh: 对，我们来比较一下本地烘焙店的价格吧。

choices.text: Right, though pricing shouldn't matter at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's compare prices at local bakeries.

transition.en: They visit a government office to register the business.
transition.zh: 他们去了一趟政府机构办理营业登记。

scenes.title: Registering the Business
scenes.subtitle: 政府机构 · 注册营业

npcLine.en: Do you have a business name already picked out?
npcLine.zh: 你已经选好营业名称了吗？

choices.text: Yes, it's called Grandma's Kitchen.
choices.zh: 选好了，叫“奶奶的厨房”。

choices.text: No, names have never mattered to us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it's called Grandma's Kitchen.

npcLine.en: You'll also need a food handling permit.
npcLine.zh: 你们还需要一份食品处理许可证。

choices.text: Got it, where do we apply for that?
choices.zh: 明白了，我们在哪儿申请呢？

choices.text: Got it, though permits sound unnecessary to us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → Got it, where do we apply for that?

npcLine.en: This should take about two weeks to process.
npcLine.zh: 这大概需要两周时间才能处理完。

choices.text: That's fine, we can use the time to prepare.
choices.zh: 没问题，我们可以利用这段时间准备。

choices.text: That's unacceptable, we need it done today.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's fine, we can use the time to prepare.

transition.en: They calculate ingredient costs to figure out fair prices.
transition.zh: 他们计算食材成本，以确定合理的定价。

npcLine.en: How much do the ingredients cost for one batch?
npcLine.zh: 一批的食材成本是多少？

choices.text: About fifteen dollars for a dozen cupcakes.
choices.zh: 大概十五块钱能做一打杯子蛋糕。

choices.text: Ingredients cost nothing, they're always free.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答成本 → About fifteen dollars for a dozen cupcakes.

npcLine.en: Our prices should be fair, but not too low.
npcLine.zh: 我们的定价应该公道，但也不能太低。

choices.text: Agreed, we still need to make a profit.
choices.zh: 同意，我们还是需要赚取利润的。

choices.text: Agreed, let's just give everything away for free.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, we still need to make a profit.

npcLine.en: This price feels more reasonable than what we first considered.
npcLine.zh: 这个价格比我们最初想的更合理一些。

choices.text: It does, let's go with this number.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们就用这个数字吧。

choices.text: It doesn't, let's double the price instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's go with this number.

transition.en: A tech-savvy friend helps them put together a simple online shop.
transition.zh: 一位懂技术的朋友帮他们搭建了一个简单的网店。

npcLine.en: Can you upload photos of your best cupcakes?
npcLine.zh: 你能上传你做的最好看的杯子蛋糕照片吗？

choices.text: I can upload a few right now.
choices.zh: 我现在就能上传几张。

choices.text: I can't, I've never actually taken any photos.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can upload a few right now.

npcLine.en: This photo looks better than the others.
npcLine.zh: 这张照片比其他几张更好看。

choices.text: It does, let's put it on the homepage.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们把它放到主页上吧。

choices.text: It doesn't, let's use a blurry one instead.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's put it on the homepage.

npcLine.en: Once this goes live, orders could start coming in fast.
npcLine.zh: 一旦上线，订单可能很快就会涌进来。

choices.text: If they do, we'll figure it out together.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我们就一起想办法应对。

choices.text: If they do, we'll just ignore them all.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If they do, we'll figure it out together.

transition.en: A notification chimes: their very first online order has arrived.
transition.zh: 一声提示音响起：他们的第一份网络订单来了。

npcLine.en: We just got our very first order!
npcLine.zh: 我们刚收到了第一笔订单！

choices.text: I can't believe this is actually happening.
choices.zh: 我不敢相信这真的发生了。

choices.text: I already knew this would happen eventually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → I can't believe this is actually happening.

npcLine.en: What did they order, and when do they need it?
npcLine.zh: 他们订了什么，什么时候需要？

choices.text: Two dozen cookies, ready by Friday.
choices.zh: 两打饼干，周五之前要好。

choices.text: Nothing was ordered, this must be a mistake.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答信息 → Two dozen cookies, ready by Friday.

npcLine.en: Let's make sure this first order is absolutely perfect.
npcLine.zh: 我们要确保这第一笔订单做得完美无缺。

choices.text: Agreed, let's put everything we have into it.
choices.zh: 同意，我们要全力以赴。

choices.text: Let's just do the bare minimum this time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Agreed, let's put everything we have into it.

transition.en: The night before delivery, they bake late into the evening.
transition.zh: 交货前一晚，他们烘焙到深夜。

npcLine.en: Are you doing okay staying up this late?
npcLine.zh: 熬到这么晚你还好吗？

choices.text: Yes, the excitement is keeping me awake.
choices.zh: 我还好，兴奋感让我一直清醒着。

choices.text: No, I fell asleep an hour ago.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, the excitement is keeping me awake.

npcLine.en: This batch smells even better than the test batch.
npcLine.zh: 这一批闻起来比试做的那批还要香。

choices.text: It really does, I think we nailed it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我觉得我们做成了。

choices.text: It really doesn't, something's clearly gone wrong.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I think we nailed it.

npcLine.en: Can you help me box these up carefully?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我小心地把这些装盒吗？

choices.text: I can, I'll be extra careful with them.
choices.zh: 我能，我会格外小心的。

choices.text: I can't, boxing things sounds too complicated.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, I'll be extra careful with them.

transition.en: They personally deliver the first order to a delighted customer.
transition.zh: 他们亲自把第一笔订单送到了一位喜出望外的顾客手中。

scenes.title: The First Delivery
scenes.subtitle: 顾客家门口 · 首次交货

npcLine.en: These look even better than the photos online.
npcLine.zh: 这些实物比网上的照片看起来还要好。

choices.text: Thank you so much, we hope you love them.
choices.zh: 太感谢了，希望您会喜欢。

choices.text: Thank you, though the photos were much nicer.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thank you so much, we hope you love them.

npcLine.en: How long have you two been baking together?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩一起烘焙多久了？

choices.text: We've actually just started this business.
choices.zh: 我们其实刚开始做这门生意不久。

choices.text: We've never once baked anything together.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've actually just started this business.

npcLine.en: I'll definitely be ordering from you again.
npcLine.zh: 我一定还会再向你们下单的。

choices.text: That means so much, thank you for the support.
choices.zh: 这对我们意义重大，谢谢您的支持。

choices.text: That's fine, though we'd rather not have repeat customers.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That means so much, thank you for the support.

transition.en: Balancing the new business with parenthood proves tricky some days.
transition.zh: 有些日子里，兼顾新生意和育儿并不容易。

scenes.title: Juggling Work and Baking
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 兼顾工作与育儿

npcLine.en: Are you feeling overwhelmed with everything lately?
npcLine.zh: 最近这些事让你觉得应接不暇吗？

choices.text: A little, but I'm managing okay.
choices.zh: 有一点，但我还应付得来。

choices.text: Not at all, everything feels effortless.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → A little, but I'm managing okay.

npcLine.en: We should probably set a limit on weekly orders.
npcLine.zh: 我们大概应该给每周的订单量设个上限。

choices.text: Good idea, that would keep things manageable.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样能让一切都保持可控。

choices.text: Bad idea, let's take every order that comes in.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, that would keep things manageable.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy it gets, our family still comes first.
npcLine.zh: 不管多忙，我们的家庭永远是第一位的。

choices.text: No matter how busy, that will never change.
choices.zh: 不管多忙，这一点永远不会改变。

choices.text: No matter how busy, the business matters more.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy, that will never change.

transition.en: One month in, they look back at what Grandma's Kitchen has become.
transition.zh: 开业一个月后，他们回顾“奶奶的厨房”走过的这段路。

npcLine.en: We've already filled over thirty orders this month.
npcLine.zh: 我们这个月已经完成了三十多份订单。

choices.text: That's incredible, we should be proud.
choices.zh: 太厉害了，我们应该为此感到骄傲。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we expected way more.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → That's incredible, we should be proud.

npcLine.en: How does it feel building something of our own?
npcLine.zh: 打造属于我们自己的东西，感觉怎么样？

choices.text: It feels incredibly fulfilling, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，感觉特别有成就感。

choices.text: It doesn't feel like anything special.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → It feels incredibly fulfilling, honestly.

npcLine.en: Somewhere, I think your grandmother is proud of this.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得，你祖母在某个地方一定为此感到骄傲。

choices.text: I like to think so too, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我也愿意这样相信。

choices.text: I doubt it, she never cared about business.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I like to think so too, honestly.

transition.en: After everything this year, they realize it's time to make a will.
transition.zh: 经历了今年这一切后，他们意识到该立遗嘱了。

scenes.title: A Difficult Conversation
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 一次艰难的对话

npcLine.en: We really should have a will, especially now.
npcLine.zh: 我们真的应该立一份遗嘱，尤其是现在。

choices.text: You're right, it's overdue at this point.
choices.zh: 你说得对，这事早就该做了。

choices.text: You're wrong, wills are only for old people.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → You're right, it's overdue at this point.

npcLine.en: It's not an easy topic, but it matters a lot.
npcLine.zh: 这不是个轻松的话题，但它非常重要。

choices.text: It does, especially with a child depending on us.
choices.zh: 确实如此，尤其是我们的孩子还要靠我们。

choices.text: It doesn't, this topic never really matters.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It does, especially with a child depending on us.

npcLine.en: Let's book a meeting with an estate lawyer.
npcLine.zh: 我们来约一位遗产律师谈谈吧。

choices.text: Let's do that sometime this week.
choices.zh: 我们这周就找时间约吧。

choices.text: Let's just put this off forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that sometime this week.

transition.en: They sit down with an estate lawyer for the first time.
transition.zh: 他们第一次和一位遗产律师坐下来谈。

scenes.title: Meeting the Lawyer
scenes.subtitle: 律师事务所 · 首次咨询

npcLine.en: Do you have any assets we should know about?
npcLine.zh: 你们有什么资产是我们应该知道的吗？

choices.text: Yes, our house and a small business.
choices.zh: 有的，我们的房子和一门小生意。

choices.text: No, we own absolutely nothing at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, our house and a small business.

npcLine.en: Have you thought about who would raise your child?
npcLine.zh: 你们考虑过谁来抚养你们的孩子吗？

choices.text: We've actually talked about that quite a bit.
choices.zh: 我们其实已经聊过不少这个话题了。

choices.text: We've never once considered that question.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've actually talked about that quite a bit.

npcLine.en: This is one of the most important decisions in a will.
npcLine.zh: 这是遗嘱中最重要的决定之一。

choices.text: We understand, and we've already decided.
choices.zh: 我们理解，而且我们已经决定好了。

choices.text: We understand, though we'd rather skip that part.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We understand, and we've already decided.

transition.en: They discuss who should raise their child if anything ever happened.
transition.zh: 他们讨论万一发生不测，谁来抚养他们的孩子。

npcLine.en: Who do you trust most to raise our child?
npcLine.zh: 你最信任谁来抚养我们的孩子？

choices.text: Honestly, I trust my sister the most.
choices.zh: 说实话，我最信任我姐姐。

choices.text: I don't trust anyone with that at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答理由 → Honestly, I trust my sister the most.

npcLine.en: She's more patient than anyone else in our family.
npcLine.zh: 她比我们家里其他任何人都更有耐心。

choices.text: She really is, and she loves kids too.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而且她也很喜欢小孩。

choices.text: She really isn't, she has no patience at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → She really is, and she loves kids too.

npcLine.en: If we chose her, would you feel completely at peace?
npcLine.zh: 如果我们选她，你会感到完全放心吗？

choices.text: If we chose her, I'd feel totally at peace.
choices.zh: 如果选她，我会觉得完全放心。

choices.text: If we chose her, I'd still feel worried.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If we chose her, I'd feel totally at peace.

transition.en: The lawyer walks them through how to divide their assets.
transition.zh: 律师引导他们了解如何分配资产。

scenes.title: Dividing Assets
scenes.subtitle: 律师事务所 · 分配资产

npcLine.en: Should everything go to your child eventually?
npcLine.zh: 所有东西最终都应该留给你们的孩子吗？

choices.text: Yes, with some set aside for family too.
choices.zh: 是的，也会留一些给家人。

choices.text: No, our child shouldn't inherit anything at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, with some set aside for family too.

npcLine.en: What about the business, if something happened to both of you?
npcLine.zh: 如果你们俩都出了意外，生意该怎么处理？

choices.text: We'd want it passed to a trusted family member.
choices.zh: 我们希望把它交给一位信得过的家人。

choices.text: The business doesn't matter to us at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答安排 → We'd want it passed to a trusted family member.

npcLine.en: This plan is clearer than what most couples come in with.
npcLine.zh: 这个方案比大多数来这儿的夫妻都要清晰。

choices.text: Thank you, we tried to think it through carefully.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们尽量把它考虑周全了。

choices.text: Thank you, though we barely thought about it at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thank you, we tried to think it through carefully.

transition.en: They add a few personal wishes beyond just the legal details.
transition.zh: 除了法律细节，他们还加入了一些个人心愿。

scenes.title: Writing Personal Wishes
scenes.subtitle: 律师事务所 · 写下心愿

npcLine.en: Do you want to include a letter for your child?
npcLine.zh: 你们想为孩子附上一封信吗？

choices.text: Yes, I've actually already started writing one.
choices.zh: 想的，我其实已经开始写了。

choices.text: No, letters seem completely unnecessary to us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, I've actually already started writing one.

npcLine.en: What would you want them to know most?
npcLine.zh: 你最想让他们知道什么？

choices.text: That they were loved more than they could ever know.
choices.zh: 他们被爱着，爱到超乎他们的想象。

choices.text: I don't want them to know anything at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答想法 → That they were loved more than they could ever know.

npcLine.en: Writing this down makes it feel more real, doesn't it?
npcLine.zh: 把这些写下来让一切感觉更真实了，不是吗？

choices.text: It does, in a heavy but important way.
choices.zh: 确实如此，是一种沉重但重要的真实感。

choices.text: It doesn't, this still feels distant to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It does, in a heavy but important way.

transition.en: After weeks of planning, it's finally time to sign the paperwork.
transition.zh: 经过几周的筹划，终于到了签署文件的时候。

scenes.title: Signing the Documents
scenes.subtitle: 律师事务所 · 签署文件

npcLine.en: Please sign here, and initial each page after that.
npcLine.zh: 请在这里签名，之后每一页都要签姓名首字母。

choices.text: Of course, just show me where to start.
choices.zh: 好的，告诉我从哪儿开始就行。

choices.text: Sorry, signing documents isn't something I do.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, just show me where to start.

npcLine.en: This feels heavier than I expected it to feel.
npcLine.zh: 这种感觉比我预想的要沉重。

choices.text: It does, but it's also a relief in a way.
choices.zh: 确实如此，但某种程度上也是一种解脱。

choices.text: It doesn't, this feels completely meaningless.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, but it's also a relief in a way.

npcLine.en: Congratulations, your affairs are now officially in order.
npcLine.zh: 恭喜你们，你们的事务现在正式安排妥当了。

choices.text: Thank you, that's a huge weight off our shoulders.
choices.zh: 谢谢，这真的让我们卸下了一块大石头。

choices.text: Thank you, though it doesn't change anything for us.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Thank you, that's a huge weight off our shoulders.

transition.en: They call Emma's sister to share the news and ask her officially.
transition.zh: 他们打电话给Emma的姐姐，正式告诉她这个决定。

npcLine.en: We'd like to ask you something important.
npcLine.zh: 我们想问你一件重要的事。

choices.text: Of course, anything, I'm listening.
choices.zh: 当然，什么都可以，我在听。

choices.text: Actually, I'd rather not hear it right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Of course, anything, I'm listening.

npcLine.en: We'd be honored if you'd be our child's guardian.
npcLine.zh: 如果你愿意做我们孩子的监护人，我们会非常荣幸。

choices.text: If you're asking, of course I'll say yes.
choices.zh: 如果是你们问，我当然会答应。

choices.text: If you're asking, I'll have to say no.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If you're asking, of course I'll say yes.

npcLine.en: Thank you, that means more to us than you know.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你，这对我们的意义超乎你的想象。

choices.text: Of course, I love that child already.
choices.zh: 当然了，我已经爱上这个孩子了。

choices.text: Of course, though I hope it never comes to that.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, I love that child already.

transition.en: That evening, they decide where to safely keep the paperwork.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们商量该把文件安全地存放在哪里。

scenes.title: Storing the Documents Safely
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 妥善保存文件

npcLine.en: Where should we keep the original copies?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该把原件放在哪里？

choices.text: Somewhere fireproof, like a safety deposit box.
choices.zh: 找个防火的地方，比如保险箱。

choices.text: It doesn't matter, we can just leave them anywhere.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Somewhere fireproof, like a safety deposit box.

npcLine.en: Your sister should know exactly where to find them.
npcLine.zh: 你姐姐应该确切知道去哪儿找到这些文件。

choices.text: You're right, I'll tell her the location today.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我今天就告诉她地点。

choices.text: You're wrong, she doesn't need to know anything.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → You're right, I'll tell her the location today.

npcLine.en: We should review this again every few years.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该每隔几年就再检查一次。

choices.text: Agreed, things change, and this should too.
choices.zh: 同意，情况会变化，这份文件也应该随之更新。

choices.text: Agreed, though we'll probably just forget about it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, things change, and this should too.

transition.en: That night, an unexpected calm settles over them.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，一种意想不到的平静笼罩了他们。

npcLine.en: I feel more at ease than I have in weeks.
npcLine.zh: 我感觉比这几周以来任何时候都更轻松。

choices.text: I feel that too, it's a strange kind of relief.
choices.zh: 我也有同感，这是一种奇怪的解脱感。

choices.text: I don't feel any different, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → I feel that too, it's a strange kind of relief.

npcLine.en: We've protected our family, no matter what happens.
npcLine.zh: 无论发生什么，我们都保护好了我们的家人。

choices.text: No matter what happens, that's what matters most.
choices.zh: 不管发生什么，这才是最重要的。

choices.text: No matter what happens, nothing feels protected.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what happens, that's what matters most.

npcLine.en: Facing this together made it so much easier.
npcLine.zh: 一起面对这件事让一切轻松了许多。

choices.text: It really did, I couldn't have done it alone.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我一个人根本做不到。

choices.text: It really didn't, this was harder together.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, I couldn't have done it alone.

transition.en: With this behind them, they turn their attention back to everyday life.
transition.zh: 把这件事放下之后，他们把注意力重新放回日常生活。

npcLine.en: This year taught us so much about what really matters.
npcLine.zh: 这一年教会了我们许多关于什么才真正重要的道理。

choices.text: It really did, more than any year before it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，比之前任何一年都要多。

choices.text: It really didn't, this year taught us nothing.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It really did, more than any year before it.

npcLine.en: How do you feel about everything still ahead of us?
npcLine.zh: 对于前方仍未到来的一切，你感觉怎么样？

choices.text: Hopeful, and grateful for everything we've built.
choices.zh: 充满希望，也感激我们一路建立的一切。

choices.text: I feel nothing about the future at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → Hopeful, and grateful for everything we've built.

npcLine.en: Whatever comes next, we'll face it the way we always have — together.
npcLine.zh: 无论接下来发生什么，我们都会像一直以来那样一起面对。

choices.text: Whatever comes next, together, always.
choices.zh: 无论接下来发生什么，我们都在一起，永远如此。

choices.text: Whatever comes next, we'll probably face it apart.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Whatever comes next, together, always.

transition.en: Emma's cousin is graduating from university, and they plan to attend.
transition.zh: Emma的表弟即将大学毕业，他们打算去参加。

npcLine.en: What time does the ceremony actually start?
npcLine.zh: 典礼具体几点开始？

choices.text: It starts at ten, but doors open earlier.
choices.zh: 十点开始，但门会更早开放。

choices.text: It doesn't have a start time at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时间 → It starts at ten, but doors open earlier.

npcLine.en: Should we bring flowers, or is that too much?
npcLine.zh: 我们要带花吗，还是这样有点太隆重了？

choices.text: Flowers would be a really sweet gesture.
choices.zh: 带花会是个很温馨的举动。

choices.text: Flowers seem completely unnecessary for this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Flowers would be a really sweet gesture.

npcLine.en: We'll need to leave early to find good parking.
npcLine.zh: 我们得早点出发才能找到好的停车位。

choices.text: Good thinking, let's leave in twenty minutes.
choices.zh: 想得周到，我们二十分钟后出发吧。

choices.text: Good thinking, though parking never matters much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Good thinking, let's leave in twenty minutes.

transition.en: They arrive at the large auditorium filled with proud families.
transition.zh: 他们抵达了挤满自豪家属的大礼堂。

npcLine.en: This place is more crowded than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这地方比我预想的还要拥挤。

choices.text: It is, let's find seats quickly.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们赶紧找座位吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this place looks nearly empty.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's find seats quickly.

npcLine.en: Can you see the stage from back here?
npcLine.zh: 从后面这里你能看到舞台吗？

choices.text: I can see it fine, actually.
choices.zh: 其实我能看得很清楚。

choices.text: I can't see anything from back here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can see it fine, actually.

npcLine.en: Let's save a seat for your aunt and uncle.
npcLine.zh: 我们留个座位给你的姑姑姑父吧。

choices.text: Good call, I'll put my bag on that seat.
choices.zh: 好主意，我把包放在那个座位上。

choices.text: Let's not, they can find their own seats.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good call, I'll put my bag on that seat.

transition.en: Graduates in caps and gowns file in to applause.
transition.zh: 身穿学位服的毕业生们在掌声中鱼贯而入。

npcLine.en: There he is, can you spot him in the crowd?
npcLine.zh: 他在那儿，你能在人群中认出他吗？

choices.text: I can spot him, he's waving right now.
choices.zh: 我能看到他，他正在挥手呢。

choices.text: I can't spot him anywhere in this crowd.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can spot him, he's waving right now.

npcLine.en: He looks so much older than I remember.
npcLine.zh: 他看起来比我记忆中老成多了。

choices.text: He really does, time flies, doesn't it?
choices.zh: 确实是，时间过得真快，不是吗？

choices.text: He really doesn't, he looks exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → He really does, time flies, doesn't it?

npcLine.en: I'm getting emotional just watching this.
npcLine.zh: 光是看着这一幕我就开始感动了。

choices.text: Same here, I wasn't expecting to tear up.
choices.zh: 我也是，没想到自己会想哭。

choices.text: I'm not feeling anything at all, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → Same here, I wasn't expecting to tear up.

transition.en: A guest speaker takes the stage to address the graduating class.
transition.zh: 一位嘉宾演讲人走上舞台，向毕业班致辞。

npcLine.en: Failure taught me more than success ever did.
npcLine.zh: 失败教会我的，比成功教会我的还要多。

choices.text: That's such a powerful thing to say.
choices.zh: 这句话说得真是有力量。

choices.text: That's a strange thing to say to graduates.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's such a powerful thing to say.

npcLine.en: If you follow your curiosity, it will never fail you.
npcLine.zh: 如果你追随自己的好奇心，它永远不会辜负你。

choices.text: If that's true, I should follow mine more often.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我应该更常追随自己的好奇心。

choices.text: If that's true, curiosity still seems pointless.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, I should follow mine more often.

npcLine.en: This speech is definitely making me reflect on my own life.
npcLine.zh: 这场演讲确实让我反思起自己的人生。

choices.text: Mine too, it's more relatable than I thought.
choices.zh: 我也是，这演讲比我想的更能引起共鸣。

choices.text: Not mine, this speech feels totally irrelevant.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → Mine too, it's more relatable than I thought.

transition.en: Names are called one by one as graduates cross the stage.
transition.zh: 毕业生们依次被点名走上舞台。

npcLine.en: They're getting close to his name now.
npcLine.zh: 现在快念到他的名字了。

choices.text: I'm ready with the camera, just in case.
choices.zh: 我已经拿好相机了，以防万一。

choices.text: I'm not ready, and I don't have a camera.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I'm ready with the camera, just in case.

npcLine.en: There he goes, walking across the stage!
npcLine.zh: 他上台了，正走过舞台！

choices.text: Look at him go, he's beaming with pride.
choices.zh: 看看他，满脸都是骄傲的笑容。

choices.text: He's barely moving, this is taking forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → Look at him go, he's beaming with pride.

npcLine.en: He's officially got his diploma now.
npcLine.zh: 他现在正式拿到学位证书了。

choices.text: He finally did it, after all those years.
choices.zh: 经过这些年的努力，他终于做到了。

choices.text: That diploma doesn't really mean anything, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → He finally did it, after all those years.

transition.en: The whole family cheers loudly as his name echoes through the hall.
transition.zh: 他的名字在礼堂里回响，全家人大声欢呼。

npcLine.en: We're being louder than everyone else, aren't we?
npcLine.zh: 我们是不是比其他人都更大声？

choices.text: Definitely, but he deserves every bit of it.
choices.zh: 绝对是，但这都是他应得的。

choices.text: No, actually we're the quietest ones here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Definitely, but he deserves every bit of it.

npcLine.en: Did you see him smile when he heard us cheering?
npcLine.zh: 你看到他听到我们欢呼时笑了吗？

choices.text: I did, his whole face lit up.
choices.zh: 看到了，他整张脸都亮了起来。

choices.text: I didn't see anything, my eyes were closed.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I did, his whole face lit up.

npcLine.en: Moments like this make all the noise worth it.
npcLine.zh: 像这样的时刻让所有的喧闹都值得。

choices.text: They really do, no regrets at all.
choices.zh: 确实如此，一点都不后悔。

choices.text: They don't, we probably embarrassed him.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They really do, no regrets at all.

transition.en: Outside, everyone gathers for photos in caps and gowns.
transition.zh: 典礼结束后，大家聚在外面穿着学位服拍照。

npcLine.en: Can you toss your cap in the air for this one?
npcLine.zh: 这张照片你能把帽子抛向空中吗？

choices.text: I can definitely do that, on three.
choices.zh: 我完全可以，数到三就抛。

choices.text: I can't, I might lose the cap somewhere.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can definitely do that, on three.

npcLine.en: This photo turned out better than the last one.
npcLine.zh: 这张照片比上一张拍得更好。

choices.text: It did, let's use this one for the frame.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们就用这张来装框吧。

choices.text: It didn't, let's delete this one immediately.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It did, let's use this one for the frame.

npcLine.en: Let's get one more with the whole family together.
npcLine.zh: 我们再拍一张全家福吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, everyone squeeze in close.
choices.zh: 好，大家都靠近一点吧。

choices.text: Let's skip that one, we have enough already.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, everyone squeeze in close.

transition.en: The family celebrates over lunch at a nearby restaurant.
transition.zh: 全家人在附近一家餐厅共进午餐庆祝。

npcLine.en: I'd like to say a few words about my nephew.
npcLine.zh: 我想说几句关于我侄子的话。

choices.text: Of course, please, we'd love to hear it.
choices.zh: 当然，请说吧，我们很想听。

choices.text: Sorry, we'd rather skip the speeches today.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, please, we'd love to hear it.

npcLine.en: He's worked harder than anyone I know for this.
npcLine.zh: 为了这一切，他比我认识的任何人都努力。

choices.text: He truly has, and it clearly paid off.
choices.zh: 他确实做到了，而且显然值得了。

choices.text: He hasn't, honestly, this was pretty easy for him.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → He truly has, and it clearly paid off.

npcLine.en: To many more milestones ahead for this whole family.
npcLine.zh: 敬这个大家庭未来更多的里程碑。

choices.text: To many more, cheers to all of us.
choices.zh: 敬更多的里程碑，为我们所有人干杯。

choices.text: To fewer milestones, honestly, life feels busy enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应祝酒 → To many more, cheers to all of us.

transition.en: Over dessert, the graduate shares his plans for the future.
transition.zh: 吃甜点时，这位毕业生分享了他对未来的计划。

npcLine.en: What are your plans now that you've graduated?
npcLine.zh: 毕业之后你有什么打算？

choices.text: I've actually just accepted a job offer.
choices.zh: 我其实刚接受了一份工作邀约。

choices.text: I have absolutely no plans of any kind.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答计划 → I've actually just accepted a job offer.

npcLine.en: That's such exciting news, congratulations again.
npcLine.zh: 这真是个令人兴奋的消息，再次恭喜你。

choices.text: Thank you, I still can't quite believe it.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我到现在还有点不敢相信。

choices.text: Thank you, though I already knew this would happen.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Thank you, I still can't quite believe it.

npcLine.en: We're so proud of the person you've become.
npcLine.zh: 我们为你成为这样的人感到骄傲。

choices.text: That means everything, thank you all so much.
choices.zh: 这句话对我意义非凡，非常感谢大家。

choices.text: That's a strange thing to say, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → That means everything, thank you all so much.

transition.en: Driving home, they talk about how quickly time passes.
transition.zh: 开车回家的路上，他们聊起时间过得有多快。

npcLine.en: It feels like just yesterday he was a kid.
npcLine.zh: 感觉他还是个孩子的日子就在昨天。

choices.text: It really does, time moves so fast.
choices.zh: 确实如此，时间过得太快了。

choices.text: It doesn't, he's always seemed grown up.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, time moves so fast.

npcLine.en: Someday, we'll be watching our own child walk across a stage like that.
npcLine.zh: 有一天，我们也会看着自己的孩子这样走过舞台。

choices.text: We will, and I already can't wait for that day.
choices.zh: 会的，我已经等不及那一天了。

choices.text: We won't, that day feels impossibly far away.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → We will, and I already can't wait for that day.

npcLine.en: No matter how far off that day is, moments like today make me hopeful.
npcLine.zh: 不管那天有多遥远，像今天这样的时刻让我充满希望。

choices.text: No matter how far off, I feel that hope too.
choices.zh: 不管有多遥远，我也感受到了这份希望。

choices.text: No matter how far off, I try not to think about it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how far off, I feel that hope too.

transition.en: A flyer at the community center catches their eye.
transition.zh: 社区中心的一张传单引起了他们的注意。

scenes.title: Spotting the Flyer
scenes.subtitle: 社区中心 · 发现传单

npcLine.en: Look, they're starting a volleyball league.
npcLine.zh: 看，他们要办一个排球联赛。

choices.text: We're definitely signing up for this.
choices.zh: 我们一定要报名参加这个。

choices.text: We're never doing anything like this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → We're definitely signing up for this.

npcLine.en: Do you think we're good enough to join?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得我们水平够加入吗？

choices.text: It says all skill levels are welcome.
choices.zh: 上面写着欢迎各种水平的人加入。

choices.text: No, this league sounds far too advanced.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答（补充信息） → It says all skill levels are welcome.

npcLine.en: We'll need to find a few more teammates first.
npcLine.zh: 我们得先再找几个队友。

choices.text: True, let's ask some friends tonight.
choices.zh: 没错，我们今晚就问问朋友吧。

choices.text: True, though we'd rather play completely alone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → True, let's ask some friends tonight.

transition.en: They text a few friends to see who wants to join.
transition.zh: 他们给几个朋友发消息，看谁想加入。

npcLine.en: How many players do we actually need on a team?
npcLine.zh: 一支队伍实际需要多少名球员？

choices.text: We need at least six players total.
choices.zh: 我们总共至少需要六名球员。

choices.text: We don't need any players at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → We need at least six players total.

npcLine.en: Have you heard back from anyone yet?
npcLine.zh: 有人回复你了吗？

choices.text: I've heard back from three people already.
choices.zh: 我已经收到三个人的回复了。

choices.text: I've never once texted anyone about this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've heard back from three people already.

npcLine.en: What should we name our team?
npcLine.zh: 我们的队伍要叫什么名字？

choices.text: Something fun, like the Bump Setters.
choices.zh: 起个有趣点的名字，比如“垫传高手”。

choices.text: It doesn't need a name, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Something fun, like the Bump Setters.

transition.en: They fill out the registration form at the community center.
transition.zh: 他们在社区中心填写了报名表。

scenes.title: Registering the Team
scenes.subtitle: 社区中心 · 报名注册

npcLine.en: Do you already have a team name picked out?
npcLine.zh: 你们已经选好队名了吗？

choices.text: Yes, we're calling ourselves the Bump Setters.
choices.zh: 选好了，我们叫“垫传高手”。

choices.text: No, names have never mattered to us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, we're calling ourselves the Bump Setters.

npcLine.en: The season runs for eight weeks, starting in June.
npcLine.zh: 赛季从六月开始，持续八周。

choices.text: That timeline works perfectly for us.
choices.zh: 这个时间安排对我们来说正合适。

choices.text: That timeline sounds completely unmanageable.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That timeline works perfectly for us.

npcLine.en: Games are played on Tuesday evenings.
npcLine.zh: 比赛安排在周二晚上。

choices.text: Tuesdays work great for our schedule.
choices.zh: 周二对我们的日程来说非常合适。

choices.text: Tuesdays are terrible, we're always busy then.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Tuesdays work great for our schedule.

transition.en: The team gets together for their first practice session.
transition.zh: 队伍第一次一起训练。

npcLine.en: Can you set the ball for me on this one?
npcLine.zh: 这一球你能给我传一下吗？

choices.text: I can, get ready to spike it.
choices.zh: 可以，准备好扣球吧。

choices.text: I can't, setting the ball isn't my thing.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, get ready to spike it.

npcLine.en: You're better at serving than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 你的发球比我预想的要好。

choices.text: Thanks, I've been practicing at home actually.
choices.zh: 谢谢，其实我一直在家练习。

choices.text: Thanks, though I've never played before this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thanks, I've been practicing at home actually.

npcLine.en: Let's run through a few more drills before we stop.
npcLine.zh: 结束前我们再多练几个球吧。

choices.text: Sounds good, let's keep going a little longer.
choices.zh: 好的，我们再多练一会儿。

choices.text: Let's just stop now, we've done enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Sounds good, let's keep going a little longer.

transition.en: On opening night, nerves build up before the first whistle.
transition.zh: 开幕夜，第一声哨响之前，紧张情绪逐渐累积。

scenes.title: Opening Night Jitters
scenes.subtitle: 体育馆 · 开幕夜的紧张

npcLine.en: Are you nervous about our first real game?
npcLine.zh: 对我们的第一场正式比赛你紧张吗？

choices.text: A little, but mostly I'm excited.
choices.zh: 有一点，但主要还是兴奋。

choices.text: No, nothing about tonight matters to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → A little, but mostly I'm excited.

npcLine.en: This other team looks more experienced than us.
npcLine.zh: 对方那支队伍看起来比我们更有经验。

choices.text: Maybe, but let's just do our best anyway.
choices.zh: 也许吧，但我们尽力就好。

choices.text: Maybe, so let's just forfeit right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Maybe, but let's just do our best anyway.

npcLine.en: Whatever the score is tonight, let's have fun out there.
npcLine.zh: 不管今晚比分如何，我们都要在场上玩得开心。

choices.text: Whatever happens, having fun is the whole point.
choices.zh: 不管结果如何，玩得开心才是重点。

choices.text: Whatever happens, winning is the only thing that matters.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Whatever happens, having fun is the whole point.

transition.en: The first set comes down to the wire.
transition.zh: 第一局比赛打到了最后关头。

scenes.title: A Close First Set
scenes.subtitle: 体育馆 · 焦灼的第一局

npcLine.en: This set is closer than I thought it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这一局比我想的要焦灼多了。

choices.text: It really is, every point matters now.
choices.zh: 确实如此，现在每一分都很重要。

choices.text: It really isn't, we're way ahead already.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, every point matters now.

npcLine.en: Can you cover the back line on the next serve?
npcLine.zh: 下一个发球你能守住后场吗？

choices.text: I can, I'll stay right there.
choices.zh: 可以，我会守在那儿的。

choices.text: I can't, the back line scares me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, I'll stay right there.

npcLine.en: We just won that set by two points!
npcLine.zh: 我们刚以两分优势赢下了那一局！

choices.text: We did it, that felt incredible!
choices.zh: 我们做到了，感觉太棒了！

choices.text: We didn't, we clearly lost that set.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did it, that felt incredible!

transition.en: A few weeks later, the team loses a game badly.
transition.zh: 几周后，队伍输掉了一场比分惨烈的比赛。

scenes.title: A Tough Loss
scenes.subtitle: 体育馆 · 惨痛的失利

npcLine.en: That was a much harder loss than usual.
npcLine.zh: 这次输球比平常要难受多了。

choices.text: It was, but we'll bounce back.
choices.zh: 确实是，但我们会振作起来的。

choices.text: It wasn't, losing never bothers us at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It was, but we'll bounce back.

npcLine.en: Even after a loss like this, I still love this team.
npcLine.zh: 即使输了这样的比赛，我依然喜欢这支队伍。

choices.text: Even after this, so do I, completely.
choices.zh: 即使经历了这些，我也完全一样喜欢。

choices.text: Even after this, I want to quit right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even after this, so do I, completely.

npcLine.en: Let's watch some film and figure out what went wrong.
npcLine.zh: 我们看看录像，找出问题出在哪里吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's do that this weekend.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们这周末就看吧。

choices.text: Let's just forget this game ever happened.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's do that this weekend.

transition.en: After a game, the team grabs pizza together to unwind.
transition.zh: 比赛结束后，队伍一起去吃披萨放松一下。

npcLine.en: This team has become closer than I ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 这支队伍变得比我预想的还要亲密。

choices.text: It really has, I'm grateful for all of you.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很感激你们所有人。

choices.text: It really hasn't, we're all still strangers.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really has, I'm grateful for all of you.

npcLine.en: How did you two even get into volleyball?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩到底是怎么开始接触排球的？

choices.text: We just saw a flyer and decided to try it.
choices.zh: 我们就是看到一张传单，决定试试看。

choices.text: Volleyball is something we've never actually played.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答经历 → We just saw a flyer and decided to try it.

npcLine.en: This might be the best decision we made all year.
npcLine.zh: 这可能是我们今年做过的最棒的决定。

choices.text: It honestly might be, up there with a few others.
choices.zh: 说实话，确实可能是，也算是这一年里的亮点之一。

choices.text: It definitely isn't, this was a mistake.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It honestly might be, up there with a few others.

transition.en: The final match of the season arrives — the championship game.
transition.zh: 赛季的最后一场比赛来了——冠军赛。

npcLine.en: We've made it further than we ever imagined.
npcLine.zh: 我们走到的这一步比我们想象的还要远。

choices.text: We really have, no matter what happens tonight.
choices.zh: 确实如此，不管今晚结果如何。

choices.text: We really haven't, we barely made progress.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, no matter what happens tonight.

npcLine.en: Whatever happens, I'm proud of how far we've come.
npcLine.zh: 无论结果如何，我为我们走过的路感到骄傲。

choices.text: Whatever happens, this season has been amazing.
choices.zh: 无论结果如何，这个赛季都很棒。

choices.text: Whatever happens, none of this was worth it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Whatever happens, this season has been amazing.

npcLine.en: Let's go out there and give it everything we've got.
npcLine.zh: 我们上场吧，全力以赴。

choices.text: Let's do it, together, one last time.
choices.zh: 我们一起，最后再拼一次。

choices.text: Let's just take it easy this time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do it, together, one last time.

transition.en: The final whistle blows, and the season comes to a close.
transition.zh: 最后一声哨响，赛季画上了句号。

npcLine.en: However this ended, I'm just glad we did this.
npcLine.zh: 不管结果怎样，我很高兴我们参加了这次比赛。

choices.text: However it ended, this was worth every second.
choices.zh: 不管结果怎样，这一切都值得每一秒钟。

choices.text: However it ended, this whole season was pointless.

n1.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → However it ended, this was worth every second.

npcLine.en: How do you feel now that the season is finally over?
npcLine.zh: 赛季终于结束了，你感觉怎么样？

choices.text: A little sad, but really grateful for it all.
choices.zh: 有点伤感，但对这一切非常感激。

choices.text: I don't feel anything about it, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → A little sad, but really grateful for it all.

npcLine.en: We should definitely sign up again next season.
npcLine.zh: 我们下个赛季一定要再报名参加。

choices.text: Absolutely, count us in for next season too.
choices.zh: 当然，下个赛季也算上我们。

choices.text: Absolutely not, once was more than enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Absolutely, count us in for next season too.

transition.en: They apply for a small plot at the community garden.
transition.zh: 他们申请了社区花园的一小块地。

scenes.title: Applying for a Plot
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 申请地块

npcLine.en: Have you ever grown anything before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前种过什么东西吗？

choices.text: I've grown a few herbs on our balcony.
choices.zh: 我在阳台上种过一些香草。

choices.text: I'm growing something at this exact moment.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've grown a few herbs on our balcony.

npcLine.en: There's currently a short waiting list for plots.
npcLine.zh: 目前地块有一个不长的等候名单。

choices.text: That's fine, we're happy to wait a bit.
choices.zh: 没关系，我们不介意等一段时间。

choices.text: That's unacceptable, we need one today.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's fine, we're happy to wait a bit.

npcLine.en: We'll call you as soon as a plot opens up.
npcLine.zh: 有地块空出来我们会马上打电话给你们。

choices.text: Perfect, we'll keep our phone nearby.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们会把手机放在身边留意。

choices.text: Perfect, though we probably won't answer.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Perfect, we'll keep our phone nearby.

transition.en: A spot opens up, and they visit their new plot for the first time.
transition.zh: 有地块空出来了，他们第一次去看自己的新地块。

scenes.title: The First Visit
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 首次到访

npcLine.en: This plot gets more sunlight than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这块地的日照比我预想的要多。

choices.text: It does, this should be perfect for tomatoes.
choices.zh: 确实是，这应该很适合种西红柿。

choices.text: It doesn't, this plot looks completely shaded.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, this should be perfect for tomatoes.

npcLine.en: What should we plant first?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该先种什么？

choices.text: Something easy, like lettuce or radishes.
choices.zh: 种点简单的，比如生菜或者萝卜。

choices.text: Nothing at all, planting sounds too difficult.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Something easy, like lettuce or radishes.

npcLine.en: Let's bring the baby along next time to see it.
npcLine.zh: 下次我们带宝宝一起来看看吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, they'll love the dirt.
choices.zh: 好啊，他们肯定会喜欢泥土的。

choices.text: Let's leave them at home, gardens are boring.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, they'll love the dirt.

transition.en: They spend a Saturday preparing the soil before planting.
transition.zh: 种植前，他们花了一个周六准备土壤。

scenes.title: Preparing the Soil
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 整理土壤

npcLine.en: Can you help me turn over this soil?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我把这块土翻一下吗？

choices.text: I can, hand me the other shovel.
choices.zh: 可以，把另一把铲子给我。

choices.text: I can't, digging isn't something I enjoy.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, hand me the other shovel.

npcLine.en: This soil looks richer than what we had last year.
npcLine.zh: 这块土看起来比我们去年那块要肥沃。

choices.text: It does, that should help everything grow.
choices.zh: 确实是，这应该对作物生长有帮助。

choices.text: It doesn't, this soil looks completely dead.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, that should help everything grow.

npcLine.en: We should add some compost before we plant anything.
npcLine.zh: 在种任何东西之前我们应该先加点堆肥。

choices.text: Good call, I'll grab some from the shed.
choices.zh: 好主意，我去棚子里拿一些。

choices.text: Bad call, compost never actually helps anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good call, I'll grab some from the shed.

transition.en: With soil ready, they finally plant their first seeds.
transition.zh: 土壤准备好后，他们终于种下了第一批种子。

npcLine.en: How deep should we plant these seeds?
npcLine.zh: 这些种子应该种多深？

choices.text: About an inch deep, according to the packet.
choices.zh: 按照种子包上写的，大概一英寸深。

choices.text: Depth doesn't matter for seeds at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答方法 → About an inch deep, according to the packet.

npcLine.en: Are you spacing them out evenly?
npcLine.zh: 你有把它们均匀地隔开吗？

choices.text: Yes, I'm measuring the distance carefully.
choices.zh: 是的，我在仔细测量间距。

choices.text: Yes, I spaced them out last winter.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 → Yes, I'm measuring the distance carefully.

npcLine.en: Let's water everything well before we go.
npcLine.zh: 走之前我们把一切都浇透吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's give it a good soak.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们好好浇一遍吧。

choices.text: Let's skip watering, the rain will handle it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's give it a good soak.

transition.en: A couple of weeks later, tiny green sprouts appear.
transition.zh: 几周后，一些嫩绿的小芽冒了出来。

scenes.title: The First Sprouts
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 第一批嫩芽

npcLine.en: Look, something's actually growing!
npcLine.zh: 看，真的有东西长出来了！

choices.text: It's really happening, I can't believe it.
choices.zh: 真的发生了，我简直不敢相信。

choices.text: It's not growing at all, this plot is dead.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → It's really happening, I can't believe it.

npcLine.en: These sprouts look healthier than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这些嫩芽看起来比我预想的更健康。

choices.text: They really do, we must be doing something right.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们一定是做对了什么。

choices.text: They really don't, they look completely wilted.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really do, we must be doing something right.

npcLine.en: The baby seems fascinated by the little leaves.
npcLine.zh: 宝宝好像被这些小叶子迷住了。

choices.text: They really are, look at that little face.
choices.zh: 确实是，看看那张小脸。

choices.text: They aren't interested at all, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They really are, look at that little face.

transition.en: A few weeks in, unwanted insects start showing up.
transition.zh: 几周后，一些不速之客——害虫开始出现。

scenes.title: Battling Pests
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 对付虫害
