npcLine.en: Something's been eating our lettuce leaves.
npcLine.zh: 有什么东西一直在吃我们的生菜叶子。

choices.text: I've noticed that too, we need a solution.
choices.zh: 我也注意到了，我们需要想个办法。

choices.text: I've never once noticed anything wrong here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've noticed that too, we need a solution.

npcLine.en: This natural spray is safer than chemical pesticides.
npcLine.zh: 这种天然喷剂比化学杀虫剂更安全。

choices.text: Safer sounds good, especially with the baby around.
choices.zh: 更安全听起来不错，尤其是家里有宝宝。

choices.text: Safer doesn't matter, let's use the strongest one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Safer sounds good, especially with the baby around.

npcLine.en: If we spray it every few days, it should help.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们每隔几天喷一次，应该会有帮助。

choices.text: If it helps, let's start doing that today.
choices.zh: 如果有效，我们今天就开始吧。

choices.text: If it helps, let's just wait a few more weeks.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If it helps, let's start doing that today.

transition.en: They chat with neighbors tending their own plots nearby.
transition.zh: 他们和在附近打理自己地块的邻居们聊了起来。

scenes.title: Meeting Fellow Gardeners
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 结识园友

npcLine.en: How long have you been gardening here?
npcLine.zh: 你在这儿种地多久了？

choices.text: I've been coming here for about five years.
choices.zh: 我在这儿差不多有五年了。

choices.text: I've never actually gardened here before today.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've been coming here for about five years.

npcLine.en: Your tomatoes look far more impressive than ours.
npcLine.zh: 你的西红柿看起来比我们的漂亮多了。

choices.text: Thank you, I'd be happy to share some tips.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我很乐意分享一些经验。

choices.text: Thank you, though yours look terrible, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thank you, I'd be happy to share some tips.

npcLine.en: We should organize a shared harvest dinner sometime.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该找时间办一顿丰收共享晚餐。

choices.text: That sounds wonderful, let's plan one soon.
choices.zh: 这听起来太棒了，我们尽快计划一下吧。

choices.text: That sounds unnecessary, let's just keep to ourselves.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That sounds wonderful, let's plan one soon.

transition.en: A sudden summer storm threatens to flatten their young plants.
transition.zh: 一场突如其来的夏季暴雨威胁着他们的幼苗。

scenes.title: A Summer Storm
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 夏季暴雨

npcLine.en: Should we go cover the plants before the storm hits?
npcLine.zh: 暴雨来之前我们要不要去给植物盖上防护？

choices.text: Yes, let's hurry before it starts raining.
choices.zh: 好，我们趁还没下雨赶紧去吧。

choices.text: No, the plants can handle anything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's hurry before it starts raining.

npcLine.en: This wind is stronger than the forecast predicted.
npcLine.zh: 这风比天气预报预测的要强。

choices.text: It is, let's finish up and get inside.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们赶紧弄完然后进去吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this wind feels perfectly calm.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's finish up and get inside.

npcLine.en: Even if we lose a few plants, most should survive.
npcLine.zh: 即使我们失去几株植物，大部分应该都能挺过去。

choices.text: Even if we do, we can always replant.
choices.zh: 即使真丢了几株，我们也可以重新种。

choices.text: Even if we do, the whole garden is ruined.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even if we do, we can always replant.

transition.en: Finally, it's time to pick their very first vegetables.
transition.zh: 终于到了采摘第一批蔬菜的时候了。

scenes.title: The First Harvest
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 首次丰收

npcLine.en: Can you believe we actually grew these ourselves?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信这些真的是我们自己种出来的吗？

choices.text: I can't believe it, I'm honestly so proud.
choices.zh: 我不敢相信，说实话我特别骄傲。

choices.text: I can believe it, this feels totally ordinary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/惊讶 → I can't believe it, I'm honestly so proud.

npcLine.en: These tomatoes taste even better than store-bought ones.
npcLine.zh: 这些西红柿吃起来比超市买的还要好吃。

choices.text: They really do, homegrown just tastes different.
choices.zh: 确实如此，自己种的味道就是不一样。

choices.text: They really don't, store-bought is always better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really do, homegrown just tastes different.

npcLine.en: Let's cook something tonight using only what we grew.
npcLine.zh: 今晚我们做点菜，只用我们自己种的东西吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, a full garden-to-table meal.
choices.zh: 好啊，来一顿完全的“从地到桌”大餐。

choices.text: Let's just order takeout instead tonight.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, a full garden-to-table meal.

transition.en: With more vegetables than they can eat, they share the extra with neighbors.
transition.zh: 蔬菜多得吃不完，他们把多出来的分享给了邻居。

npcLine.en: We grew way more than we could ever eat.
npcLine.zh: 我们种的比我们能吃完的多太多了。

choices.text: That's a good problem to have, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，这是个幸福的烦恼。

choices.text: That's a shame, we should have planted less.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's a good problem to have, honestly.

npcLine.en: We brought you some fresh vegetables from our garden.
npcLine.zh: 我们从自家花园带了些新鲜蔬菜给你们。

choices.text: That's so thoughtful, thank you so much.
choices.zh: 你们真是太贴心了，非常感谢。

choices.text: That's unnecessary, we don't eat vegetables.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去时表达感谢的回应 → That's so thoughtful, thank you so much.

npcLine.en: Growing food to share feels more meaningful than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 种菜分享给别人，比我预想的更有意义。

choices.text: It really does, I love this whole experience.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很享受整个过程。

choices.text: It really doesn't, sharing feels pointless to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I love this whole experience.

transition.en: As the season winds down, they start planning for next year.
transition.zh: 随着这个赛季接近尾声，他们开始计划明年的种植。

scenes.title: Planning Next Season
scenes.subtitle: 社区花园 · 规划来年

npcLine.en: What should we grow differently next year?
npcLine.zh: 明年我们应该有什么不同的种植方式？

choices.text: Maybe fewer tomatoes and more herbs.
choices.zh: 也许少种点西红柿，多种点香草。

choices.text: Nothing, next year we should stop gardening.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Maybe fewer tomatoes and more herbs.

npcLine.en: We've learned so much more than we expected this year.
npcLine.zh: 今年我们学到的比预想的多多了。

choices.text: We really have, and I loved every part of it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很享受这一切。

choices.text: We really haven't, we learned nothing at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, and I loved every part of it.

npcLine.en: No matter what we grow next year, I'm excited to do this again.
npcLine.zh: 不管明年种什么，我都很期待再来一次。

choices.text: No matter what, count me in every single year.
choices.zh: 不管怎样，每一年都算上我。

choices.text: No matter what, once was more than enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what, count me in every single year.

transition.en: After a break-in nearby, they consider a home security system.
transition.zh: 附近发生入室盗窃后，他们考虑安装家庭安防系统。

npcLine.en: Did you hear about the break-in two streets over?
npcLine.zh: 你听说两条街外那起入室盗窃了吗？

choices.text: Yes, that's actually what worried me too.
choices.zh: 听说了，其实这也让我担心。

choices.text: No, and I don't want to know either.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that's actually what worried me too.

npcLine.en: We should look into a security system.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该研究一下安防系统。

choices.text: Agreed, especially with the baby home now.
choices.zh: 同意，尤其是现在宝宝也在家了。

choices.text: Disagreed, security systems seem excessive.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, especially with the baby home now.

npcLine.en: Let's compare a few different companies.
npcLine.zh: 我们比较几家不同的公司吧。

choices.text: Let's start looking tonight.
choices.zh: 我们今晚就开始看吧。

choices.text: Let's just pick whichever one is cheapest.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's start looking tonight.

transition.en: A technician visits to walk them through options.
transition.zh: 一位技术人员上门为他们介绍方案。

npcLine.en: How many entry points does your home have?
npcLine.zh: 您家有多少个出入口？

choices.text: We have a front door, back door, and a garage.
choices.zh: 我们有前门、后门，还有一个车库。

choices.text: Our home doesn't have any entry points.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答信息 → We have a front door, back door, and a garage.

npcLine.en: This camera has better night vision than the basic model.
npcLine.zh: 这款摄像头的夜视效果比基础款更好。

choices.text: Better night vision sounds worth the upgrade.
choices.zh: 更好的夜视功能听起来值得升级。

choices.text: Night vision doesn't matter to us at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Better night vision sounds worth the upgrade.

npcLine.en: We'll install everything within a single afternoon.
npcLine.zh: 我们会在一个下午之内安装完所有设备。

choices.text: That's fast, when can we schedule it?
choices.zh: 这速度挺快的，我们什么时候能预约？

choices.text: That's too fast, we'd rather wait months.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's fast, when can we schedule it?

transition.en: The technician returns to install cameras and sensors.
transition.zh: 技术人员回来安装摄像头和传感器。

npcLine.en: Can you show me where the control panel goes?
npcLine.zh: 你能告诉我控制面板放哪儿吗？

choices.text: I can show you, right this way.
choices.zh: 我能告诉你，这边请。

choices.text: I can't, I don't know where anything goes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can show you, right this way.

npcLine.en: This sensor detects motion more accurately than older models.
npcLine.zh: 这个传感器检测动作比旧款更精准。

choices.text: More accurate sounds like a real improvement.
choices.zh: 更精准听起来确实是个提升。

choices.text: Accuracy doesn't really matter for this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → More accurate sounds like a real improvement.

npcLine.en: Please avoid touching the panel until setup is finished.
npcLine.zh: 在设置完成前请不要触碰面板。

choices.text: Of course, we'll stay out of the way.
choices.zh: 当然，我们不会打扰的。

choices.text: Sorry, I already pressed a few buttons.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, we'll stay out of the way.

transition.en: The technician shows them how to use the companion app.
transition.zh: 技术人员教他们如何使用配套应用。

scenes.title: Learning the App
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 学习使用应用

npcLine.en: Have you downloaded the app on your phones yet?
npcLine.zh: 你们的手机上下载这个应用了吗？

choices.text: We've just downloaded it, actually.
choices.zh: 我们其实刚下载好。

choices.text: We've never once used an app before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've just downloaded it, actually.

npcLine.en: This interface is simpler than most other systems.
npcLine.zh: 这个界面比大多数其他系统更简单。

choices.text: Simpler is exactly what we were hoping for.
choices.zh: 更简单正是我们希望的。

choices.text: Simpler feels boring, we wanted more features.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Simpler is exactly what we were hoping for.

npcLine.en: You'll get a notification whenever motion is detected.
npcLine.zh: 只要检测到动作，你们就会收到通知。

choices.text: Good, that will give us real peace of mind.
choices.zh: 很好，这会给我们真正的安心感。

choices.text: Good, though we'd rather not know anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Good, that will give us real peace of mind.

transition.en: That first night, the alarm suddenly goes off.
transition.zh: 第一晚，警报突然响了起来。

npcLine.en: What just triggered the alarm?
npcLine.zh: 刚才是什么触发了警报？

choices.text: It was probably just the cat walking by.
choices.zh: 大概只是猫走过去了。

choices.text: Nothing triggered it, we're just imagining things.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → It was probably just the cat walking by.

npcLine.en: We should adjust the sensitivity so this doesn't happen again.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该调整灵敏度，避免再发生这种情况。

choices.text: Good idea, let's lower it a bit tomorrow.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们明天把它调低一点。

choices.text: Bad idea, higher sensitivity is always better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, let's lower it a bit tomorrow.

npcLine.en: That definitely woke the whole house up.
npcLine.zh: 这肯定把全家人都吵醒了。

choices.text: It really did, let's go check on the baby.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们去看看宝宝吧。

choices.text: It really didn't, nobody woke up at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It really did, let's go check on the baby.

transition.en: A few weeks later, they add a video doorbell to the front porch.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们在前门廊加装了视频门铃。

scenes.title: Adding a Video Doorbell
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 安装视频门铃

npcLine.en: Can you see who's at the door from your phone?
npcLine.zh: 你能从手机上看到门口是谁吗？

choices.text: I can see clearly, even at night.
choices.zh: 我能看得很清楚，即使晚上也一样。

choices.text: I can't see anything on the screen.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can see clearly, even at night.

npcLine.en: This doorbell records more clearly than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个门铃录像的清晰度比我预想的要高。

choices.text: It really does, the picture is impressively sharp.
choices.zh: 确实如此，画面清晰得让人印象深刻。

choices.text: It really doesn't, the video looks blurry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, the picture is impressively sharp.

npcLine.en: Now we can answer the door even when we're not home.
npcLine.zh: 现在即使我们不在家也能应门了。

choices.text: We can, that's such a useful feature.
choices.zh: 确实可以，这个功能真的很实用。

choices.text: We can't, this doorbell doesn't do that.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → We can, that's such a useful feature.

transition.en: They also upgrade the front door to a smart lock.
transition.zh: 他们还把前门升级成了智能锁。

npcLine.en: How does this lock work exactly?
npcLine.zh: 这个锁具体是怎么工作的？

choices.text: You just enter a code or use the app.
choices.zh: 只需要输入密码或者用应用就行。

choices.text: It doesn't actually work at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答方法 → You just enter a code or use the app.

npcLine.en: This is more convenient than fumbling for keys.
npcLine.zh: 这比在包里摸钥匙方便多了。

choices.text: It really is, especially with a baby in my arms.
choices.zh: 确实如此，尤其是我怀里还抱着宝宝的时候。

choices.text: It really isn't, keys were always easier.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, especially with a baby in my arms.

npcLine.en: We can give the babysitter a temporary code too.
npcLine.zh: 我们也可以给保姆一个临时密码。

choices.text: We can, that solves a real problem for us.
choices.zh: 确实可以，这解决了我们的一个实际问题。

choices.text: We can't, temporary codes don't exist for this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → We can, that solves a real problem for us.

transition.en: They run a full test of the system before trusting it completely.
transition.zh: 在完全信任之前，他们对系统做了一次全面测试。

npcLine.en: Should we test every sensor in the house today?
npcLine.zh: 我们今天要测试家里每一个传感器吗？

choices.text: Yes, let's be thorough about this.
choices.zh: 好的，我们仔细一点测试吧。

choices.text: No, one test should cover everything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's be thorough about this.

npcLine.en: Every sensor responded faster than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 每个传感器的响应速度都比我预想的要快。

choices.text: That's reassuring, I feel much safer now.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，我现在感觉安全多了。

choices.text: That's concerning, fast responses seem suspicious.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's reassuring, I feel much safer now.

npcLine.en: I finally feel like our home is truly protected.
npcLine.zh: 我终于感觉我们的家真正得到了保护。

choices.text: I feel that too, and it's a huge relief.
choices.zh: 我也有同样的感受，这真是一种巨大的解脱。

choices.text: I don't feel that way at all, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I feel that too, and it's a huge relief.

transition.en: Weeks later, they get a real alert while out running errands.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们在外出办事时收到一条真实的警报。

npcLine.en: My phone just showed motion at the back door.
npcLine.zh: 我的手机刚显示后门有动静。

choices.text: Let's check the camera footage right now.
choices.zh: 我们马上看一下摄像头画面吧。

choices.text: Let's just ignore it, it's probably nothing.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → Let's check the camera footage right now.

npcLine.en: It was just the delivery driver dropping off a package.
npcLine.zh: 只是送货员放了一个包裹而已。

choices.text: What a relief, I was worried for a second.
choices.zh: 真是松了口气，我刚才紧张了一下。

choices.text: That's terrifying, we should call the police.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → What a relief, I was worried for a second.

npcLine.en: This system is proving useful more than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这套系统比我预想的更加实用。

choices.text: It really is, this was money well spent.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这笔钱花得很值。

choices.text: It really isn't, this alert was a total waste.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, this was money well spent.

transition.en: That night, they reflect on how much calmer they feel now.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们感慨自己现在感觉安心多了。

npcLine.en: I sleep so much better knowing the system is on.
npcLine.zh: 知道系统开着，我睡得踏实多了。

choices.text: Same here, it's such a relief every night.
choices.zh: 我也是，每晚都感觉安心不少。

choices.text: I actually sleep worse because of it, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Same here, it's such a relief every night.

npcLine.en: Even with everything else going on, this feels like one less worry.
npcLine.zh: 即使还有很多其他事情，这至少少了一个担忧。

choices.text: Even with everything else, I agree completely.
choices.zh: 即使还有很多其他事情，我也完全同意。

choices.text: Even with everything else, this feels like more worry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even with everything else, I agree completely.

npcLine.en: Protecting this family will always be worth the investment.
npcLine.zh: 保护这个家永远值得这份投入。

choices.text: It always will, no matter the cost.
choices.zh: 永远都值得，无论花多少钱。

choices.text: It won't, we probably overspent on this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → It always will, no matter the cost.

transition.en: They realize it's been years since either of them saw a doctor.
transition.zh: 他们意识到已经好几年没看过医生了。

npcLine.en: When was the last time you had a checkup?
npcLine.zh: 你上次体检是什么时候？

choices.text: Honestly, it's probably been three years.
choices.zh: 说实话，大概已经三年了。

choices.text: I just had one earlier this morning.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时间 → Honestly, it's probably been three years.

npcLine.en: We should really find a family doctor.
npcLine.zh: 我们真的应该找一位家庭医生了。

choices.text: You're right, let's start looking today.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我们今天就开始找吧。

choices.text: You're wrong, doctors are only for emergencies.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → You're right, let's start looking today.

npcLine.en: Let's ask around for recommendations first.
npcLine.zh: 我们先问问身边人有没有推荐吧。

choices.text: Good idea, I'll ask my coworkers.
choices.zh: 好主意，我去问问我的同事。

choices.text: Let's just pick a random name from a list.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, I'll ask my coworkers.

transition.en: They call a clinic to book their first appointment.
transition.zh: 他们打电话给一家诊所预约第一次就诊。

npcLine.en: Is this your first time visiting our clinic?
npcLine.zh: 这是您第一次来我们诊所吗？

choices.text: Yes, this is actually our very first visit.
choices.zh: 是的，这其实是我们第一次来。

choices.text: No, we've been coming here for decades.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, this is actually our very first visit.

npcLine.en: We have an opening this Thursday afternoon.
npcLine.zh: 我们这周四下午有一个空档。

choices.text: Thursday afternoon works perfectly for us.
choices.zh: 周四下午对我们来说非常合适。

choices.text: Thursday afternoon is completely impossible.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Thursday afternoon works perfectly for us.

npcLine.en: Please bring your health card and any medications you take.
npcLine.zh: 请带上您的医保卡和您正在服用的药物。

choices.text: Of course, we'll have everything ready.
choices.zh: 当然，我们会准备好一切的。

choices.text: Sorry, bringing anything sounds too complicated.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, we'll have everything ready.

transition.en: They fill out paperwork in a quiet waiting room.
transition.zh: 他们在安静的候诊室里填写文件。

npcLine.en: Have you filled out the medical history form yet?
npcLine.zh: 你把病史表填好了吗？

choices.text: I've finished most of it already.
choices.zh: 我大部分都已经填完了。

choices.text: I've never once seen this form before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've finished most of it already.

npcLine.en: This waiting room feels calmer than most clinics.
npcLine.zh: 这个候诊室感觉比大多数诊所都更安静。

choices.text: It does, that's a good sign, honestly.
choices.zh: 确实是，说实话这是个好兆头。

choices.text: It doesn't, this place feels chaotic.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, that's a good sign, honestly.

npcLine.en: The doctor will call you in shortly.
npcLine.zh: 医生很快就会叫你们进去。

choices.text: Thank you, we'll just wait right here.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们就在这儿等着。

choices.text: Thank you, though we can't wait at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Thank you, we'll just wait right here.

transition.en: A nurse takes basic measurements before the doctor arrives.
transition.zh: 在医生到来之前，护士先做了一些基础测量。

npcLine.en: I'm going to check your blood pressure now.
npcLine.zh: 我现在要给您量一下血压。

choices.text: Okay, I'll try to relax my arm.
choices.zh: 好的，我会尽量放松手臂。

choices.text: Okay, though I'd rather you skip that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → Okay, I'll try to relax my arm.

npcLine.en: Your blood pressure is a bit higher than average.
npcLine.zh: 您的血压比平均值稍微高一点。

choices.text: Should I be worried about that number?
choices.zh: 我应该为这个数字感到担心吗？

choices.text: Numbers like that never worry me at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Should I be worried about that number?

npcLine.en: Can you step on the scale for me next?
npcLine.zh: 接下来您能站到体重秤上吗？

choices.text: I can, just give me a second.
choices.zh: 可以，稍等我一下。

choices.text: I can't, I'd rather not know my weight.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, just give me a second.

transition.en: The doctor comes in and reviews their history together.
transition.zh: 医生走进来，和他们一起回顾病史。

npcLine.en: Does anything run in your family that I should know about?
npcLine.zh: 您的家族有什么疾病史是我需要知道的吗？

choices.text: Yes, high blood pressure runs on my father's side.
choices.zh: 有的，高血压在我父亲那边有家族史。

choices.text: No, nothing has ever happened in our family.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, high blood pressure runs on my father's side.

npcLine.en: How often do you exercise in a typical week?
npcLine.zh: 您通常一周锻炼几次？

choices.text: Maybe two or three times, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，大概两三次吧。

choices.text: Exercise isn't something I've ever tried.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答频率 → Maybe two or three times, honestly.

npcLine.en: Let's run a few blood tests just to be thorough.
npcLine.zh: 为了保险起见，我们做几项血液检测吧。

choices.text: Sounds reasonable, let's go ahead with that.
choices.zh: 听起来很合理，那就做吧。

choices.text: Let's skip that, tests feel unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Sounds reasonable, let's go ahead with that.

transition.en: A lab technician draws blood samples for testing.
transition.zh: 一位化验人员抽取了血液样本用于检测。

npcLine.en: Are you okay with needles, generally?
npcLine.zh: 您一般对打针没问题吧？

choices.text: Yes, needles have never really bothered me.
choices.zh: 没问题，打针从来没让我太在意。

choices.text: No, needles have always terrified me completely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, needles have never really bothered me.

npcLine.en: This will just feel like a small pinch.
npcLine.zh: 这只会有轻微的刺痛感。

choices.text: Okay, I'm ready whenever you are.
choices.zh: 好的，你准备好就开始吧。

choices.text: Okay, though I'd rather wait a few more minutes.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → Okay, I'm ready whenever you are.

npcLine.en: Results should be ready within a week.
npcLine.zh: 结果大概一周内就能出来。

choices.text: Great, we'll wait to hear back then.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们等消息。

choices.text: Great, though a week feels far too long.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Great, we'll wait to hear back then.

transition.en: A week later, they nervously wait for a call about the results.
transition.zh: 一周后，他们紧张地等着关于结果的电话。

npcLine.en: Have you heard anything from the clinic yet?
npcLine.zh: 诊所那边有消息了吗？

choices.text: I haven't heard anything yet, actually.
choices.zh: 其实还没有任何消息。

choices.text: I've heard everything already, twice.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I haven't heard anything yet, actually.

npcLine.en: I'm a little more nervous than I expected to be.
npcLine.zh: 我比预想的要紧张一些。

choices.text: I feel that too, but I'm sure it's fine.
choices.zh: 我也有同感，但我相信没事的。

choices.text: I don't feel nervous at all, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → I feel that too, but I'm sure it's fine.

npcLine.en: Whatever the results say, we'll handle it together.
npcLine.zh: 不管结果如何，我们都会一起面对。

choices.text: Whatever they say, together, always.
choices.zh: 不管结果如何，我们都在一起，永远如此。

choices.text: Whatever they say, I'd rather face it alone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Whatever they say, together, always.

transition.en: The clinic calls with the results a few days later.
transition.zh: 几天后，诊所打来电话告知结果。

npcLine.en: Your results came back mostly normal.
npcLine.zh: 您的检测结果大部分正常。

choices.text: That's such good news to hear.
choices.zh: 听到这个真是个好消息。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we hoped for something exciting.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's such a relief to hear.

npcLine.en: Your cholesterol is slightly higher than we'd like.
npcLine.zh: 您的胆固醇比我们希望的稍高一些。

choices.text: Okay, what should we do about that?
choices.zh: 好的，我们应该怎么处理呢？

choices.text: That's fine, cholesterol doesn't matter to us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Okay, what should we do about that?

npcLine.en: If you adjust your diet, it should improve over time.
npcLine.zh: 如果调整饮食，情况应该会逐渐好转。

choices.text: If that helps, we'll start making changes today.
choices.zh: 如果有帮助，我们今天就开始做出改变。

choices.text: If that helps, we'll just ignore it for now.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that helps, we'll start making changes today.

transition.en: They start making small changes to their diet and routine.
transition.zh: 他们开始在饮食和作息上做一些小调整。

npcLine.en: Should we start cooking with less oil?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要开始少放点油做饭？

choices.text: Yes, let's start with that this week.
choices.zh: 好，我们这周就开始吧。

choices.text: No, oil has never really mattered much.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's start with that this week.

npcLine.en: This meal tastes lighter than what we usually make.
npcLine.zh: 这顿饭吃起来比我们平常做的清淡一些。

choices.text: It does, and it's actually really tasty too.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且其实也很好吃。

choices.text: It doesn't, this tastes exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, and it's actually really tasty too.

npcLine.en: Small changes now will matter a lot down the road.
npcLine.zh: 现在的小改变以后会有很大意义。

choices.text: They will, and future us will thank us.
choices.zh: 确实会的，未来的我们会感谢现在的自己。

choices.text: They won't, small changes never matter at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → They will, and future us will thank us.

transition.en: Months later, a follow-up visit shows real progress.
transition.zh: 几个月后，一次复诊显示出了真实的进步。

npcLine.en: Your numbers have improved quite a bit since last time.
npcLine.zh: 您的各项数值比上次改善了不少。

choices.text: That's wonderful news, all that effort paid off.
choices.zh: 这真是好消息，所有的努力都值得了。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we expected way more change.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → That's wonderful news, all that effort paid off.

npcLine.en: How does it feel seeing your hard work pay off like this?
npcLine.zh: 看到自己的努力有了回报，你感觉怎么样？

choices.text: It feels really motivating, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，感觉特别有动力。

choices.text: It doesn't feel like anything to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → It feels really motivating, honestly.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy life gets, our health should always come first.
npcLine.zh: 不管生活多忙，我们的健康永远都应该放在第一位。

choices.text: No matter how busy, health comes first for us.
choices.zh: 不管多忙，健康对我们来说永远是第一位的。

choices.text: No matter how busy, other things matter more.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy, that will never change.

transition.en: With the baby turning one soon, they start planning a party.
transition.zh: 宝宝快满一岁了，他们开始筹备派对。

npcLine.en: Should we do a theme, or keep it simple?
npcLine.zh: 我们要定个主题，还是保持简单？

choices.text: Let's do a theme, something fun and colorful.
choices.zh: 定个主题吧，有趣又多彩的那种。

choices.text: No theme at all, themes are overrated.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Let's do a theme, something fun and colorful.

npcLine.en: How many people should we invite?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该邀请多少人？

choices.text: Just close family and a few friends.
choices.zh: 就近亲和几个朋友吧。

choices.text: Nobody, first birthdays don't need guests.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Just close family and a few friends.

npcLine.en: We'll need to book the space soon.
npcLine.zh: 我们得尽快预订场地了。

choices.text: Right, let's call the community hall today.
choices.zh: 对，我们今天就打电话给社区礼堂吧。

choices.text: Right, though the space doesn't matter much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's call the community hall today.

transition.en: They browse decorations to settle on a theme.
transition.zh: 他们浏览装饰品来确定一个主题。

npcLine.en: This jungle theme looks more fun than the space one.
npcLine.zh: 这个丛林主题看起来比太空主题更有趣。

choices.text: It does, let's go with the jungle theme.
choices.zh: 确实是，那我们就选丛林主题吧。

choices.text: It doesn't, the space theme looks way better.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's go with the jungle theme.

npcLine.en: Should we match the invitations to the theme too?
npcLine.zh: 请柬要不要也配合主题？

choices.text: Yes, that would tie everything together nicely.
choices.zh: 好，这样能让一切都更协调统一。

choices.text: No, invitations should always be plain.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that would tie everything together nicely.

npcLine.en: Let's order the decorations online today.
npcLine.zh: 我们今天就在网上订装饰品吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's order them right now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们现在就下单吧。

choices.text: Let's wait a few more weeks to order.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's order them right now.

transition.en: They design and send out invitations to friends and family.
transition.zh: 他们设计并发出了给亲友的请柬。

npcLine.en: Have you finished the guest list yet?
npcLine.zh: 宾客名单你列好了吗？

choices.text: I've finished it, we have twenty guests total.
choices.zh: 列好了，我们总共有二十位客人。

choices.text: I've never once made a guest list.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've finished it, we have twenty guests total.

npcLine.en: This design looks cuter than the last one we tried.
npcLine.zh: 这个设计比我们之前试的那个更可爱。

choices.text: It does, let's use this one for sure.
choices.zh: 确实是，那我们就用这个吧。

choices.text: It doesn't, let's go back to the old one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's use this one for sure.

npcLine.en: Please RSVP by the end of next week.
npcLine.zh: 请在下周末之前回复是否出席。

choices.text: Of course, we'll add that to the card.
choices.zh: 当然，我们会把这个加到卡片上。

choices.text: Sorry, deadlines feel unnecessary for a party.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, we'll add that to the card.

transition.en: The night before, they decorate the community hall together.
transition.zh: 前一晚，他们一起布置社区礼堂。

scenes.title: Decorating the Space
scenes.subtitle: 社区礼堂 · 布置现场

npcLine.en: Can you help me blow up these balloons?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我吹这些气球吗？

choices.text: I can, hand me the pump.
choices.zh: 可以，把打气筒给我。

choices.text: I can't, balloons always make me dizzy.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, hand me the pump.

npcLine.en: This banner looks bigger than I remembered ordering.
npcLine.zh: 这条横幅比我记忆中订的要大。

choices.text: It does, but bigger works fine for this space.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过对这个场地来说大一点也没关系。

choices.text: It doesn't, this banner looks tiny to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, but bigger works fine for this space.

npcLine.en: Let's hang the streamers along this whole wall.
npcLine.zh: 我们把彩带挂满这整面墙吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it'll look amazing.
choices.zh: 好，这样会很好看。

choices.text: Let's just leave that wall completely bare.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it'll look amazing.

transition.en: They pick up a custom cake from a local bakery.
transition.zh: 他们从本地烘焙店取了一个定制蛋糕。

npcLine.en: This cake turned out better than the photo we sent.
npcLine.zh: 这个蛋糕做出来比我们发的照片还要好看。

choices.text: It really did, this exceeded every expectation.
choices.zh: 确实是，这超出了我们所有的预期。

choices.text: It really didn't, this looks nothing like it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, this exceeded every expectation.

npcLine.en: Is there also a small smash cake for the baby?
npcLine.zh: 有给宝宝准备的小份专用蛋糕吗？

choices.text: Yes, it's right here in this small box.
choices.zh: 有的，就在这个小盒子里。

choices.text: No, babies don't need their own cake.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it's right here in this small box.

npcLine.en: Please keep it in the fridge until the party starts.
npcLine.zh: 请把它放在冰箱里直到派对开始。

choices.text: Of course, we'll take good care of it.
choices.zh: 当然，我们会好好保管的。

choices.text: Sorry, we're planning to leave it in the car.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, we'll take good care of it.

transition.en: On the big day, guests begin arriving at the hall.
transition.zh: 派对当天，客人们陆续到达礼堂。

scenes.title: Guests Start Arriving
scenes.subtitle: 社区礼堂 · 客人到场

npcLine.en: This place looks even better than I imagined!
npcLine.zh: 这地方看起来比我想象的还要漂亮！

choices.text: Thank you, we worked hard on the decorations.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们在装饰上花了不少心思。

choices.text: Thank you, though we barely decorated at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thank you, we worked hard on the decorations.

npcLine.en: Where should we put this gift?
npcLine.zh: 这份礼物应该放哪儿？

choices.text: You can put it on the gift table over there.
choices.zh: 您可以放在那边的礼物桌上。

choices.text: Gifts aren't allowed at this party.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答位置 → You can put it on the gift table over there.

npcLine.en: Thank you so much for coming, we're so glad you're here.
npcLine.zh: 非常感谢你能来，我们很高兴你在这儿。

choices.text: Thank you for inviting us, we wouldn't miss it.
choices.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我们，我们绝对不会错过的。

choices.text: Thank you, though we almost didn't come.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you for inviting us, we wouldn't miss it.

transition.en: The party fills with games, music, and laughter.
transition.zh: 派对上充满了游戏、音乐和欢笑。

scenes.title: Games and Laughter
scenes.subtitle: 社区礼堂 · 游戏时光

npcLine.en: This party is even more fun than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这场派对比我预想的还要有趣。

choices.text: It really is, everyone seems to be enjoying it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，大家看起来都很开心。

choices.text: It really isn't, everyone looks bored.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, everyone seems to be enjoying it.

npcLine.en: The kids are laughing more than the adults right now.
npcLine.zh: 现在孩子们比大人笑得还开心。

choices.text: They are, and that's exactly the point.
choices.zh: 确实是，这正是我们想要的效果。

choices.text: They aren't, the adults are having more fun.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, and that's exactly the point.

npcLine.en: Let's take some photos before things get too messy.
npcLine.zh: 趁场面还没太乱，我们拍些照片吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's grab everyone together now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们现在就把大家聚一起吧。

choices.text: Let's skip the photos, they never matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's grab everyone together now.

transition.en: It's time for the baby to dig into the smash cake.
transition.zh: 到了宝宝抓吃专用蛋糕的时刻。

scenes.title: The Smash Cake Moment
scenes.subtitle: 社区礼堂 · 抓蛋糕时刻

npcLine.en: Are you ready for this to get messy?
npcLine.zh: 你准备好接受这场混乱了吗？

choices.text: I am, I've got the camera ready.
choices.zh: 准备好了，相机也拿好了。

choices.text: I'm not, let's skip this part entirely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I am, I've got the camera ready.

npcLine.en: They're getting more cake on their face than in their mouth!
npcLine.zh: 他们脸上沾的蛋糕比嘴里吃到的还多！

choices.text: That's exactly how it's supposed to go!
choices.zh: 这正是它该有的样子！

choices.text: That seems like a total waste of cake.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's exactly how it's supposed to go!

npcLine.en: This is a memory we'll treasure forever.
npcLine.zh: 这将是我们永远珍藏的回忆。

choices.text: It really will, I already love this photo.
choices.zh: 确实会的，我已经很喜欢这张照片了。

choices.text: It won't, we'll probably forget this by tomorrow.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → It really will, I already love this photo.

transition.en: As guests leave, they say a heartfelt thank-you to each one.
transition.zh: 客人离场时，他们向每一位真诚道谢。

scenes.title: Saying Thank You
scenes.subtitle: 社区礼堂 · 感谢客人

npcLine.en: Thank you for making today so wonderful.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你让今天变得这么美好。

choices.text: Of course, thank you for celebrating with us.
choices.zh: 不客气，谢谢你和我们一起庆祝。

choices.text: Of course, though today wasn't really special.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, thank you for celebrating with us.

npcLine.en: I can't believe our baby is already one year old.
npcLine.zh: 我真不敢相信我们的宝宝已经一岁了。

choices.text: Neither can I, this whole year flew by.
choices.zh: 我也不敢相信，这一年过得太快了。

choices.text: I can believe it, this year felt endless.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Neither can I, this whole year flew by.

npcLine.en: Here's to many more birthdays just like this one.
npcLine.zh: 敬未来更多像这样的生日。

choices.text: To many more birthdays, side by side.
choices.zh: 敬更多的生日，我们并肩前行。

choices.text: To fewer birthdays like this, honestly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应祝酒 → To many more, together, always.

transition.en: That night, they look back on the baby's first year of life.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们回顾宝宝这一年的成长。

npcLine.en: This year has changed us more than any other.
npcLine.zh: 这一年比其他任何一年都更让我们发生了改变。

choices.text: It really has, and I wouldn't trade it for anything.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我不会用它换任何东西。

choices.text: It really hasn't, nothing has changed at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really has, and I wouldn't trade it for anything.

npcLine.en: How do you feel looking back on everything we've been through?
npcLine.zh: 回顾我们经历的一切，你有什么感受？

choices.text: Grateful, exhausted, and completely fulfilled.
choices.zh: 感激、疲惫，又充满成就感。

choices.text: I don't feel anything looking back, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → Grateful, exhausted, and completely fulfilled.

npcLine.en: Whatever the next year brings, we're ready for it, together.
npcLine.zh: 无论下一年带来什么，我们都已经准备好了，一起面对。

choices.text: Whatever comes next, hand in hand.
choices.zh: 无论接下来发生什么，我们都手牵着手。

choices.text: Whatever comes next, we'll probably face it apart.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Whatever comes next, together, always.

transition.en: With a toddler and a growing business, the house feels too small.
transition.zh: 带着蹒跚学步的孩子和不断扩大的生意，房子渐渐显得太小了。

npcLine.en: This house feels smaller every single month.
npcLine.zh: 这房子感觉每个月都变得更小了。

choices.text: It really does, we're bursting at the seams.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们已经快住不下了。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this house feels huge.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, we're bursting at the seams.

npcLine.en: Should we start looking at bigger places?
npcLine.zh: 我们要开始看更大的房子了吗？

choices.text: Yes, let's start browsing listings tonight.
choices.zh: 好，我们今晚就开始看房源吧。

choices.text: No, we'll just live in a smaller space forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's start browsing listings tonight.

npcLine.en: We'll need to talk to a real estate agent soon.
npcLine.zh: 我们很快就得找一位房产中介聊聊了。

choices.text: True, let's get a recommendation from a friend.
choices.zh: 没错，我们找朋友推荐一个吧。

choices.text: True, though agents seem completely unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → True, let's get a recommendation from a friend.

transition.en: They meet a real estate agent to talk through what they need.
transition.zh: 他们和一位房产中介见面，聊聊自己的需求。

scenes.title: Meeting the Agent
scenes.subtitle: 房产中介 · 首次咨询

npcLine.en: What's your budget for the new place?
npcLine.zh: 你们买新房子的预算是多少？

choices.text: We're hoping to stay under six hundred thousand.
choices.zh: 我们希望控制在六十万以内。

choices.text: Budget doesn't matter to us at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答预算 → We're hoping to stay under six hundred thousand.

npcLine.en: How many bedrooms are you looking for?
npcLine.zh: 你们想要几间卧室？

choices.text: At least three, plus a home office.
choices.zh: 至少三间，再加一个家庭办公室。

choices.text: We don't need any bedrooms at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答需求 → At least three, plus a home office.

npcLine.en: I'll send you a few listings that match.
npcLine.zh: 我会给你们发几套符合条件的房源。

choices.text: Great, we'll take a look tonight.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们今晚就看看。

choices.text: Great, though we probably won't check them.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Great, we'll take a look tonight.

transition.en: They tour their first potential house with the agent.
transition.zh: 他们和中介一起去看了第一套潜在的房子。

scenes.title: The First Showing
scenes.subtitle: 房屋现场 · 首次看房

npcLine.en: This kitchen is bigger than the one we have now.
npcLine.zh: 这个厨房比我们现在的要大。

choices.text: It really is, I love how open it feels.
choices.zh: 确实是，我很喜欢这种开阔的感觉。

choices.text: It really isn't, our current kitchen is bigger.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I love how open it feels.

npcLine.en: Can you picture our family living here?
npcLine.zh: 你能想象我们一家人住在这里吗？

choices.text: I actually can, quite easily.
choices.zh: 其实我可以，还挺容易想象的。

choices.text: I can't picture that at all, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I actually can, quite easily.

npcLine.en: Let's check out the backyard before we leave.
npcLine.zh: 走之前我们去看看后院吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's go take a look now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们现在就去看看吧。

choices.text: Let's skip the backyard, it doesn't matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's go take a look now.

transition.en: After several showings, they narrow it down to two houses.
transition.zh: 看了几套房子后，他们把范围缩小到了两套。

scenes.title: Comparing Two Houses
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 比较两套房子

npcLine.en: Which house has the better school district?
npcLine.zh: 哪套房子的学区更好？

choices.text: The second one has a much better district.
choices.zh: 第二套的学区好得多。

choices.text: Neither house is near any school district.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答比较 → The second one has a much better district.

npcLine.en: The first house is closer to your bakery kitchen.
npcLine.zh: 第一套离你的烘焙厨房更近。

choices.text: That's true, and that matters a lot to me.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这对我来说很重要。

choices.text: That's true, though distance doesn't matter.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's true, and that matters a lot to me.

npcLine.en: This is such a hard decision to make.
npcLine.zh: 这真是一个很难做的决定。

choices.text: It really is, let's sleep on it tonight.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们今晚先好好想想吧。

choices.text: It really isn't, let's just flip a coin.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, let's sleep on it tonight.

transition.en: After deciding, they prepare to make an offer on the house.
transition.zh: 做出决定后，他们准备对这套房子出价。

scenes.title: Making an Offer
scenes.subtitle: 房产中介 · 准备出价

npcLine.en: How much would you like to offer?
npcLine.zh: 你们想出价多少？

choices.text: We'd like to offer the full asking price.
choices.zh: 我们想按全价出价。

choices.text: We'd like to offer absolutely nothing.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答金额 → We'd like to offer the full asking price.

npcLine.en: There's another offer that came in higher than yours.
npcLine.zh: 有另一份出价比你们的高。

choices.text: If that's true, we might raise our offer.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我们可能会提高出价。

choices.text: If that's true, let's just walk away entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → If that's true, we might raise our offer.

npcLine.en: We'll hear back from the sellers by tomorrow.
npcLine.zh: 明天之前我们会收到卖家的回复。

choices.text: Okay, we'll try not to think about it too much.
choices.zh: 好的，我们尽量不去多想。

choices.text: Okay, though we won't be thinking about anything else.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Okay, we'll try not to think about it too much.

transition.en: That night, they wait anxiously for news about their offer.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们焦虑地等待出价的消息。

npcLine.en: I keep checking my phone every five minutes.
npcLine.zh: 我每隔五分钟就要看一次手机。

choices.text: I'm doing the exact same thing, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我也在做一模一样的事。

choices.text: I'm not checking anything at all right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I'm doing the exact same thing, honestly.

npcLine.en: Whatever happens, we'll find the right house eventually.
npcLine.zh: 不管结果如何，我们最终都会找到合适的房子。

choices.text: Whatever happens, that thought helps a lot.
choices.zh: 不管结果如何，这个想法真的很有帮助。

choices.text: Whatever happens, I can't stop worrying.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Whatever happens, that thought helps a lot.

npcLine.en: Let's just distract ourselves until we hear something.
npcLine.zh: 在收到消息之前，我们分散一下注意力吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's watch something together.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们一起看点什么吧。

choices.text: Let's just stare at the phone instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's watch something together.

transition.en: The next morning, the agent calls with exciting news.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，中介打来电话，带来了令人兴奋的消息。

npcLine.en: Congratulations, your offer was accepted!
npcLine.zh: 恭喜，你们的出价被接受了！

choices.text: I'm honestly speechless right now.
choices.zh: 我现在真的说不出话来。

choices.text: I already knew this would happen anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → I can't believe this is actually happening.

npcLine.en: You'll need to schedule a home inspection next.
npcLine.zh: 接下来你们需要预约一次房屋检查。

choices.text: Right, we'll call an inspector this week.
choices.zh: 对，我们这周就联系检查员。

choices.text: Right, though inspections seem unnecessary now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, we'll call an inspector this week.

npcLine.en: This is finally, actually happening for our family.
npcLine.zh: 这终于——真的要为我们一家发生了。

choices.text: It really is, I'm overwhelmed with joy.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我满心都是喜悦。

choices.text: It really isn't, nothing feels different yet.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, I'm overwhelmed with joy.

transition.en: An inspector walks through the house checking for issues.
transition.zh: 一位检查员在房子里检查有没有问题。

npcLine.en: The roof looks newer than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这屋顶看起来比我预想的要新。

choices.text: That's a relief, roofs are expensive to replace.
choices.zh: 这让人松了口气，换屋顶很贵的。

choices.text: That's odd, roofs never really matter.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's a relief, roofs are expensive to replace.

npcLine.en: There's a small issue with the basement plumbing.
npcLine.zh: 地下室的管道有一个小问题。

choices.text: Okay, how serious of an issue is it?
choices.zh: 好的，这问题严重吗？

choices.text: Okay, plumbing issues never matter at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Okay, how serious of an issue is it?

npcLine.en: Overall, this house is in better shape than most I inspect.
npcLine.zh: 总的来说，这房子的状况比我检查过的大多数房子都要好。

choices.text: That's great to hear, thank you for checking.
choices.zh: 听到这个真好，谢谢你的检查。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we hoped for a perfect score.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's great to hear, thank you for checking.

transition.en: Weeks later, they sign the final paperwork at closing.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们在交易结束时签署了最后的文件。

scenes.title: Closing Day
scenes.subtitle: 律师事务所 · 完成交易

npcLine.en: Please sign at the bottom of each page.
npcLine.zh: 请在每一页底部签名。

choices.text: Of course, just point me to the first one.
choices.zh: 好的，告诉我第一页在哪儿就行。

choices.text: Sorry, I'd rather not sign anything today.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, just point me to the first one.

npcLine.en: Congratulations, the house is officially yours.
npcLine.zh: 恭喜，这房子正式属于你们了。

choices.text: I'm so overwhelmed, thank you so much.
choices.zh: 我百感交集，非常感谢。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we don't actually want it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I'm so overwhelmed, thank you so much.

npcLine.en: Here are your keys, welcome to your new home.
npcLine.zh: 这是你们的钥匙，欢迎来到你们的新家。

choices.text: Thank you, I can't wait to start this chapter.
choices.zh: 谢谢你，我等不及要开始这个新篇章了。

choices.text: Thank you, though we're honestly a bit nervous.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Thank you, I can't wait to start this chapter.

transition.en: Movers help them carry boxes into the new, bigger house.
transition.zh: 搬家工人帮忙把箱子搬进了这个更大的新家。

npcLine.en: This new place already feels more like home than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个新家已经比我预想的更有家的感觉了。

choices.text: It really does, and we've barely unpacked.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而且我们才刚开始拆箱。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this place still feels foreign.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, and we've barely unpacked.

npcLine.en: Where should we put the crib first?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该先把婴儿床放哪儿？

choices.text: Let's set it up in the room by ours.
choices.zh: 我们把它摆在我们旁边的房间吧。

choices.text: The crib doesn't need a room at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Let's set it up in the room by ours.

npcLine.en: This house is going to hold so many new memories.
npcLine.zh: 这座房子将会承载许多新的回忆。

choices.text: It really is, and I can't wait for all of them.
choices.zh: 确实会的，我已经迫不及待了。

choices.text: It won't, memories only happen in the old house.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → It really is, and I can't wait for all of them.

transition.en: The car starts making a strange noise on the way to work.
transition.zh: 上班路上，车子开始发出奇怪的声音。

npcLine.en: Do you hear that clicking sound too?
npcLine.zh: 你也听到那个咔哒声了吗？

choices.text: Yes, it's been going on for a few minutes.
choices.zh: 是的，已经响了好几分钟了。

choices.text: No, the car sounds completely silent to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it's been going on for a few minutes.

npcLine.en: This sound is worse than it was yesterday.
npcLine.zh: 这个声音比昨天更严重了。

choices.text: It is, we should get it checked soon.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们应该尽快检查一下。

choices.text: It isn't, this sound has always been there.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we should get it checked soon.

npcLine.en: Let's book a mechanic appointment this week.
npcLine.zh: 我们这周预约一下机械师吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's call them this afternoon.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们今天下午就打电话吧。

choices.text: Let's just ignore it and hope it goes away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's call them this afternoon.

transition.en: At the shop, they try to describe the noise to the mechanic.
transition.zh: 在修车厂，他们试着向机械师描述这个声音。

npcLine.en: When does the noise happen, mostly?
npcLine.zh: 这个声音大部分是什么时候出现的？

choices.text: Mostly when I turn the steering wheel.
choices.zh: 大部分是我转方向盘的时候。

choices.text: It never happens at any particular time.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时机 → Mostly when I turn the steering wheel.

npcLine.en: Can you describe what the sound is like?
npcLine.zh: 你能描述一下这个声音是什么样的吗？

choices.text: I can, it's a sharp clicking sound.
choices.zh: 可以，是一种尖锐的咔哒声。

choices.text: I can't describe sounds, that's impossible for me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's a sharp clicking sound.

npcLine.en: I'll take it for a quick test drive to hear it.
npcLine.zh: 我会开去简单试驾一下，听听这个声音。

choices.text: Sounds good, let us know what you find.
choices.zh: 好的，有发现告诉我们一声。

choices.text: Sounds unnecessary, just guess what it is.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Sounds good, let us know what you find.

transition.en: The mechanic returns with news about what's causing the noise.
transition.zh: 机械师回来告知了造成噪音的原因。

npcLine.en: It looks like a worn-out wheel bearing.
npcLine.zh: 看起来是轮毂轴承磨损了。

choices.text: Okay, how serious is that problem exactly?
choices.zh: 好的，这个问题具体有多严重？

choices.text: Okay, wheel bearings never matter much.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Okay, how serious is that problem exactly?

npcLine.en: This part is more expensive to fix than a simple oil change.
npcLine.zh: 修这个零件比换机油要贵得多。

choices.text: That makes sense, safety parts usually cost more.
choices.zh: 有道理，安全部件通常更贵一些。

choices.text: That's odd, all repairs should cost the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, safety parts usually cost more.

npcLine.en: If we don't fix it now, it could get worse.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们现在不修，情况可能会恶化。

choices.text: If that's true, let's fix it today.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我们今天就修吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's wait a few more months.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, let's fix it today.

transition.en: The mechanic hands them a written repair quote.
transition.zh: 机械师给了他们一份书面维修报价。

npcLine.en: How much will the repair cost in total?
npcLine.zh: 总共维修要花多少钱？

choices.text: About four hundred dollars, including labor.
choices.zh: 大概四百块，包括人工费。

choices.text: The repair costs absolutely nothing at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答金额 → About four hundred dollars, including labor.

npcLine.en: This quote is actually lower than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个报价其实比我预想的要低。

choices.text: That's a relief, let's go ahead with it.
choices.zh: 这让人松了口气，我们就修吧。

choices.text: That's suspicious, prices this low seem fake.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's a relief, let's go ahead with it.

npcLine.en: Would you like us to check anything else while it's here?
npcLine.zh: 趁车在这儿，您想让我们检查点别的吗？

choices.text: Sure, could you check the brakes too?
choices.zh: 好的，能麻烦也检查一下刹车吗？

choices.text: No, one problem at a time is plenty.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Sure, could you check the brakes too?

transition.en: They wait at the shop while the repair is completed.
transition.zh: 他们在修车厂等待维修完成。

npcLine.en: How long is this repair usually going to take?
npcLine.zh: 这次维修通常需要多长时间？

choices.text: Probably about two hours, they said.
choices.zh: 他们说大概两个小时左右。

choices.text: It takes zero time, cars fix themselves.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时长 → Probably about two hours, they said.

npcLine.en: This waiting area is nicer than most shops I've been to.
npcLine.zh: 这个等候区比我去过的大多数修车厂都要好。

choices.text: It really is, at least there's free coffee.
choices.zh: 确实是，至少还有免费咖啡。

choices.text: It really isn't, this place feels awful.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, at least there's free coffee.

npcLine.en: Let's grab a coffee while we wait.
npcLine.zh: 我们等的时候去拿杯咖啡吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's go check the machine.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们去看看那台咖啡机吧。

choices.text: Let's just sit here and stare at the wall.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's go check the machine.

transition.en: The mechanic returns to let them know the car is ready.
transition.zh: 机械师回来告诉他们车已经修好了。

npcLine.en: Your car is all set, and the noise is gone.
npcLine.zh: 您的车已经修好了，那个噪音也没有了。

choices.text: That's fantastic, thank you for fixing it.
choices.zh: 太好了，谢谢您把它修好。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we wanted the noise to stay.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's fantastic, thank you for fixing it.

npcLine.en: We also topped off your fluids while it was here.
npcLine.zh: 趁车在这儿，我们也把各种液体加满了。

choices.text: Thank you, we really appreciate the extra care.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们很感激你们这份额外的用心。

choices.text: Thank you, though we didn't ask for that.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去时表达感谢的回应 → Thank you, we really appreciate the extra care.

npcLine.en: This car should run more smoothly now.
npcLine.zh: 现在这车应该开起来更顺畅了。

choices.text: That's great, let's take it for a test drive.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们去试驾一下吧。

choices.text: That's fine, smoothness never really matters.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's great, let's take it for a test drive.

transition.en: They decide to stay on top of maintenance from now on.
transition.zh: 他们决定从此以后好好跟上保养的节奏。

scenes.title: Setting Up Maintenance Reminders
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 设置保养提醒

npcLine.en: How often should we get an oil change?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该多久换一次机油？

choices.text: Every six months, or every eight thousand kilometers.
choices.zh: 每六个月，或者每行驶八千公里。

choices.text: Oil changes are something we never need.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答频率 → Every six months, or every eight thousand kilometers.

npcLine.en: We should set a reminder on our phones.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该在手机上设个提醒。

choices.text: Good idea, I'll set it up right now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我现在就设置。

choices.text: Bad idea, we'll just remember on our own.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, I'll set it up right now.

npcLine.en: Staying ahead of problems saves money in the long run.
npcLine.zh: 提前预防问题从长远来看能省钱。

choices.text: That's true, prevention beats repair every time.
choices.zh: 确实如此，预防永远胜过维修。

choices.text: That's not true, waiting always costs less.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's true, prevention beats repair every time.

transition.en: Weeks later, they discover a flat tire in the driveway.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们在车道上发现一个轮胎瘪了。

npcLine.en: Do you know how to change a tire?
npcLine.zh: 你知道怎么换轮胎吗？

choices.text: Yes, I actually learned years ago.
choices.zh: 知道，其实我很多年前就学过。

choices.text: No, and I've never even tried before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, I actually learned years ago.

npcLine.en: This spare tire looks smaller than the others.
npcLine.zh: 这个备用轮胎看起来比其他轮胎小。

choices.text: It is, but it should get us to a shop.
choices.zh: 确实是，但应该能撑到我们到修车厂。

choices.text: It isn't, all four tires look identical.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but it should get us to a shop.

npcLine.en: Can you hand me the wrench from the trunk?
npcLine.zh: 你能把后备箱里的扳手递给我吗？

choices.text: I can, one second, I'll grab it.
choices.zh: 可以，等一下，我去拿。

choices.text: I can't, I have no idea where that is.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, one second, I'll grab it.

transition.en: After the flat, they decide it's finally time for new tires.
transition.zh: 瘪胎事件之后，他们决定终于该换新轮胎了。

scenes.title: Buying New Tires
scenes.subtitle: 轮胎店 · 购买新轮胎

npcLine.en: These tires are rated for more kilometers than your old ones.
npcLine.zh: 这些轮胎的额定里程比你们的旧轮胎更长。

choices.text: That sounds great, let's go with that brand.
choices.zh: 听起来不错，我们就选这个牌子吧。

choices.text: That doesn't sound great, kilometers never matter.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That sounds great, let's go with that brand.

npcLine.en: Do you want all four tires replaced today?
npcLine.zh: 您今天要换全部四个轮胎吗？

choices.text: Yes, let's do all four while we're here.
choices.zh: 好的，既然来了就都换了吧。

choices.text: No, we only need one tire replaced.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's do all four while we're here.

npcLine.en: This car will handle so much better on new tires.
npcLine.zh: 换了新轮胎，这车的操控会好很多。

choices.text: I can already tell the difference, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我已经能感觉到不同了。

choices.text: I can't tell any difference at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → I can already tell the difference, honestly.

transition.en: That evening, they reflect on finally taking care of the car properly.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们感慨终于好好照顾了这辆车。

npcLine.en: This car has been more reliable than I expected lately.
npcLine.zh: 最近这车比我预想的更可靠了。

choices.text: It really has, staying on top of it paid off.
choices.zh: 确实如此，及时保养真的有回报。

choices.text: It really hasn't, this car breaks down constantly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really has, staying on top of it paid off.

npcLine.en: We've learned so much about basic car care this year.
npcLine.zh: 今年我们学到了很多基本的汽车保养知识。

choices.text: We really have, and it's saved us money too.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而且也帮我们省了钱。

choices.text: We really haven't, we've learned nothing at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, and it's saved us money too.

npcLine.en: Taking care of the little things really does matter.
npcLine.zh: 照顾好这些小事确实很重要。

choices.text: It really does, in more ways than one.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而且体现在很多方面。

choices.text: It doesn't, small things never really matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, in more ways than one.

transition.en: On a whim, they decide to finally learn an instrument together.
transition.zh: 一时兴起，他们决定终于一起学一门乐器。

npcLine.en: I've always wanted to learn guitar, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，我一直都想学吉他。

choices.text: I've wanted that too, let's finally do it.
choices.zh: 我也一直想学，我们终于做这件事吧。

choices.text: I've never once thought about learning that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've wanted that too, let's finally do it.

npcLine.en: Do you think we're too old to start now?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得我们现在开始学是不是太老了？

choices.text: No, plenty of people start later than us.
choices.zh: 不会，很多人开始学的时候比我们还晚呢。

choices.text: Yes, learning anything new is pointless now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 否定回答（补充理由） → No, plenty of people start later than us.

npcLine.en: Let's find a teacher and get started.
npcLine.zh: 我们找个老师开始学吧。

choices.text: Let's search for lessons this weekend.
choices.zh: 我们这周末就去找课程吧。

choices.text: Let's just watch videos instead of lessons.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's search for lessons this weekend.

transition.en: They visit a music shop to buy their first guitars.
transition.zh: 他们去了一家乐器店买第一把吉他。

npcLine.en: Which guitar feels more comfortable in your hands?
npcLine.zh: 哪把吉他握在手里感觉更舒服？

choices.text: This smaller one feels much more comfortable.
choices.zh: 这把小一点的感觉舒服多了。

choices.text: Comfort doesn't matter, let's just pick randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → This smaller one feels much more comfortable.

npcLine.en: Do you want steel strings or nylon strings?
npcLine.zh: 您想要钢弦还是尼龙弦？

choices.text: I think nylon sounds gentler for beginners.
choices.zh: 我觉得尼龙弦对初学者来说声音更柔和。

choices.text: Strings don't matter, all guitars sound the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答（补充信息） → I think nylon sounds gentler for beginners.

npcLine.en: We'll also need a tuner and some picks.
npcLine.zh: 我们还需要一个调音器和几个拨片。

choices.text: Right, let's grab those before we leave.
choices.zh: 对，我们走之前把那些也带上吧。

choices.text: Right, though we probably won't need those.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's grab those before we leave.

transition.en: Their teacher walks them through the very basics.
transition.zh: 他们的老师带他们了解最基础的知识。

scenes.title: The First Lesson
scenes.subtitle: 音乐教室 · 第一堂课

npcLine.en: Can you press down on these three strings for me?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我按住这三根弦吗？

choices.text: I can, though my fingers hurt already.
choices.zh: 可以，不过我的手指已经有点疼了。

choices.text: I can't, my fingers don't bend that way.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, though my fingers hurt already.

npcLine.en: This chord is easier than the one you just tried.
npcLine.zh: 这个和弦比你刚才试的那个更简单。

choices.text: That's a relief, my fingers needed a break.
choices.zh: 这让人松了口气，我的手指也需要休息一下。

choices.text: That's disappointing, I wanted something harder.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's a relief, my fingers needed a break.

npcLine.en: Practice this chord every day, even for five minutes.
npcLine.zh: 每天都练习这个和弦，哪怕只有五分钟。

choices.text: I will, I'll set a reminder for it.
choices.zh: 我会的，我会为此设个提醒。

choices.text: I won't, five minutes seems too short to bother.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → I will, I'll set a reminder for it.

transition.en: That week, they practice chords in the living room every evening.
transition.zh: 那一周，他们每晚都在客厅练习和弦。

npcLine.en: Are you getting the hang of that chord change?
npcLine.zh: 那个和弦切换你开始上手了吗？

choices.text: I'm getting there, slowly but surely.
choices.zh: 我在慢慢进步，虽然速度不快但很稳。

choices.text: I'm giving up on this entirely, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I'm getting there, slowly but surely.

npcLine.en: You've actually gotten better than me at this one.
npcLine.zh: 这个和弦你其实已经比我弹得好了。

choices.text: Maybe, but you're way ahead on the other chords.
choices.zh: 也许吧，但其他和弦你领先多了。

choices.text: That's impossible, I've never once practiced.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Maybe, but you're way ahead on the other chords.

npcLine.en: Let's try playing something together tonight.
npcLine.zh: 我们今晚试着一起弹点什么吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, even if it sounds terrible.
choices.zh: 好，就算听起来很糟糕也没关系。

choices.text: Let's not, playing together sounds embarrassing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, even if it sounds terrible.

transition.en: The teacher introduces them to reading guitar tabs.
transition.zh: 老师教他们如何看吉他谱。

npcLine.en: Do these numbers tell you which fret to press?
npcLine.zh: 这些数字是告诉你要按哪个品格吗？

choices.text: Yes, each number matches a specific fret.
choices.zh: 是的，每个数字对应一个具体的品格。

choices.text: No, the numbers mean absolutely nothing.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, each number matches a specific fret.

npcLine.en: This is more confusing than sheet music, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，这比五线谱还让人困惑。

choices.text: It is at first, but it gets easier.
choices.zh: 一开始确实是，但会越来越容易。

choices.text: It isn't, this makes perfect sense already.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is at first, but it gets easier.

npcLine.en: Once it clicks, you'll never forget how to read it.
npcLine.zh: 一旦你想通了，就再也不会忘记怎么看谱了。

choices.text: If that's true, I just need to keep practicing.
choices.zh: 如果真是这样，我只需要继续练习就好。

choices.text: If that's true, I'll give up right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's true, I just need to keep practicing.

transition.en: A tricky chord change leaves them both frustrated one evening.
transition.zh: 一个棘手的和弦切换让两人在一个晚上都感到很沮丧。

npcLine.en: I've been stuck on this same chord for days.
npcLine.zh: 这个和弦我已经卡了好几天了。

choices.text: I've been stuck too, we can figure it out together.
choices.zh: 我也一直卡在这儿，我们一起想办法吧。

choices.text: I've never once had trouble with this chord.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've been stuck too, we can figure it out together.

npcLine.en: Even though this is frustrating, we shouldn't give up.
npcLine.zh: 尽管这令人沮丧，我们也不应该放弃。

choices.text: Even though it's hard, I don't want to quit either.
choices.zh: 尽管很难，我也不想放弃。

choices.text: Even though it's hard, I'm ready to give up.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even though it's hard, I don't want to quit either.

npcLine.en: Let's take a short break and come back to it tomorrow.
npcLine.zh: 我们先休息一下，明天再回来练这个吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's clear our heads for a bit.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们先放空一下脑子。

choices.text: Let's just keep grinding until it's perfect.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's clear our heads for a bit.

transition.en: After weeks of practice, they play through their first full song.
transition.zh: 练习了好几周后，他们第一次完整弹完一首歌。

scenes.title: The First Full Song
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 第一首完整曲子

npcLine.en: We actually got through the whole song that time!
npcLine.zh: 这次我们真的完整弹完了整首歌！

choices.text: We did it, I'm honestly a little emotional.
choices.zh: 我们做到了，说实话我有点感动。

choices.text: We didn't, that was a complete disaster.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did it, I'm honestly a little emotional.

npcLine.en: That sounded so much better than last week.
npcLine.zh: 这次听起来比上周好多了。

choices.text: It really did, all that practice paid off.
choices.zh: 确实如此，所有的练习都有了回报。

choices.text: It really didn't, last week sounded better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, all that practice paid off.

npcLine.en: Let's record this and send it to our teacher.
npcLine.zh: 我们录下来发给老师吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, they'll be so proud.
choices.zh: 好啊，老师一定会很骄傲的。

choices.text: Let's not, recordings always sound embarrassing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, they'll be so proud.

transition.en: Their teacher invites them to a small student recital.
transition.zh: 老师邀请他们参加一场小型学员汇报演出。

scenes.title: The Recital
scenes.subtitle: 音乐教室 · 汇报演出

npcLine.en: Are you nervous about playing in front of people?
npcLine.zh: 在别人面前弹奏你紧张吗？

choices.text: A little, but I've prepared as much as I can.
choices.zh: 有一点，但我已经尽力准备了。

choices.text: No, performing has never bothered me at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → A little, but I've prepared as much as I can.

npcLine.en: There are much younger students performing tonight too.
npcLine.zh: 今晚还有年纪小得多的学生也要表演。

choices.text: That's inspiring, age really doesn't matter here.
choices.zh: 这挺鼓舞人心的，年龄在这儿真的不重要。

choices.text: That's embarrassing, we shouldn't be here at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's inspiring, age really doesn't matter here.

npcLine.en: You're up next, are you ready?
npcLine.zh: 下一个轮到你们了，准备好了吗？

choices.text: We're ready, let's just have fun with it.
choices.zh: 准备好了，我们就享受这个过程吧。

choices.text: We're not ready, let's leave right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We're ready, let's just have fun with it.

transition.en: They step onto a small stage to play their song together.
transition.zh: 他们走上小舞台，一起弹奏他们的曲子。

npcLine.en: My hands are shaking more than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 我的手抖得比我预想的要厉害。

choices.text: Mine too, but let's just start playing.
choices.zh: 我也是，但我们就开始弹吧。

choices.text: Mine aren't shaking at all, I feel calm.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Mine too, but let's just start playing.

npcLine.en: We made it through without a single mistake!
npcLine.zh: 我们一个错误都没犯地完整弹完了！

choices.text: We actually did it, I can't believe it.
choices.zh: 我们真的做到了，我简直不敢相信。

choices.text: We didn't, that performance was a disaster.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We actually did it, I can't believe it.

npcLine.en: The applause afterward felt more rewarding than I imagined.
npcLine.zh: 演出后的掌声比我想象的更让人有成就感。

choices.text: It really did, this was worth every hard practice.
choices.zh: 确实如此，之前每一次辛苦的练习都值得了。

choices.text: It really didn't, the applause felt awkward.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, this was worth every hard practice.

transition.en: On the drive home, they're already excited about learning more.
transition.zh: 回家的路上，他们已经迫不及待想学更多了。

npcLine.en: What song should we learn next?
npcLine.zh: 我们下一首要学什么歌？

choices.text: Something a bit more challenging, maybe.
choices.zh: 也许可以学点更有挑战性的。

choices.text: Nothing, we should probably stop learning now.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Something a bit more challenging, maybe.

npcLine.en: We've come further than I ever thought we would.
npcLine.zh: 我们进步的程度超出了我曾经的想象。

choices.text: We really have, and it's just the beginning.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而且这只是个开始。

choices.text: We really haven't, we've barely improved at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, and it's just the beginning.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy life gets, let's keep making music together.
npcLine.zh: 不管生活多忙，我们都要继续一起弹奏音乐。

choices.text: No matter how busy, this is worth the time.
choices.zh: 不管多忙，这都值得花时间。

choices.text: No matter how busy, we'll probably quit soon.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy, this is worth the time.

transition.en: While planning a trip, they check their passport expiration dates.
transition.zh: 在计划旅行时，他们查看了自己护照的到期日期。

npcLine.en: My passport actually expires in three months.
npcLine.zh: 我的护照其实三个月后就到期了。

choices.text: We should renew it before we book anything.
choices.zh: 我们在订任何票之前应该先续签。

choices.text: That's fine, expiration dates never matter much.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We should renew it before we book anything.

npcLine.en: Does our baby even have a passport yet?
npcLine.zh: 我们的宝宝有护照了吗？

choices.text: No, we've never actually applied for one.
choices.zh: 还没有，我们从没申请过。

choices.text: Yes, babies are born with passports already.

n2.hintOnWrong: 否定回答（补充理由） → No, we've never actually applied for one.

npcLine.en: Let's handle all three passports at once.
npcLine.zh: 我们一次性把三本护照都办了吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's book an appointment today.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们今天就预约吧。

choices.text: Let's just deal with one at a time, slowly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's book an appointment today.

transition.en: They gather the paperwork needed for all three applications.
transition.zh: 他们收集三份申请所需的文件。

npcLine.en: Have you found the baby's birth certificate yet?
npcLine.zh: 宝宝的出生证明你找到了吗？

choices.text: I've found it, it's right here in this folder.
choices.zh: 找到了，就在这个文件夹里。

choices.text: I've never once seen that document before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've found it, it's right here in this folder.

npcLine.en: This checklist is longer than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这份清单比我预想的要长。

choices.text: It is, let's go through it item by item.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们一项一项来吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this checklist looks pretty short.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's go through it item by item.

npcLine.en: We'll also need two pieces of ID each.
npcLine.zh: 我们每个人还需要两份身份证件。

choices.text: Got it, I'll pull those out now.
choices.zh: 明白了，我现在就把它们找出来。

choices.text: Got it, though we probably don't have any.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Got it, I'll pull those out now.

transition.en: They visit a shop for official passport photos.
transition.zh: 他们去了一家店拍摄官方护照照片。

npcLine.en: Can you keep a neutral expression for this photo?
npcLine.zh: 拍照时你能保持面无表情吗？

choices.text: I can, though it's harder than it sounds.
choices.zh: 我能，不过比听起来要难。

choices.text: I can't, smiling is impossible for me to avoid.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, though it's harder than it sounds.

npcLine.en: Getting the baby to hold still is harder than I imagined.
npcLine.zh: 让宝宝保持不动比我想象的要难。

choices.text: It really is, this might take a few tries.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这可能得试好几次。

choices.text: It really isn't, they're sitting perfectly still.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, this might take a few tries.

npcLine.en: Got it, this one meets all the requirements.
npcLine.zh: 拍到了，这张符合所有要求。

choices.text: Finally, I was starting to lose hope.
choices.zh: 终于啊，我都快没信心了。

choices.text: Finally, though we didn't even need a photo.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Finally, I was starting to lose hope.

transition.en: That evening, they fill out three separate application forms.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们填写了三份独立的申请表。

npcLine.en: Does this section ask for our home address?
npcLine.zh: 这个部分是问我们的家庭住址吗？

choices.text: Yes, it wants the full mailing address.
choices.zh: 是的，它需要完整的邮寄地址。

choices.text: No, addresses aren't required on this form.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it wants the full mailing address.

npcLine.en: This form is more detailed than the old one.
npcLine.zh: 这份表格比旧版更详细。

choices.text: It is, let's just take it slow and careful.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们就慢慢来，仔细填吧。

choices.text: It isn't, let's just rush through it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's just take it slow and careful.

npcLine.en: We'll need a guarantor to sign the baby's application.
npcLine.zh: 宝宝的申请需要一位保证人签字。

choices.text: Right, let's ask a family friend to help.
choices.zh: 对，我们请一位家庭朋友帮忙吧。

choices.text: Right, though guarantors seem unnecessary here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's ask a family friend to help.

transition.en: They arrive at the passport office for their appointment.
transition.zh: 他们到达护照办事处赴约。

scenes.title: The Passport Office
scenes.subtitle: 护照办事处 · 现场办理

npcLine.en: Do you have all three applications with you?
npcLine.zh: 三份申请材料你们都带齐了吗？

choices.text: Yes, everything is right here in this folder.
choices.zh: 带齐了，都在这个文件夹里。

choices.text: No, we forgot to bring anything at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, everything is right here in this folder.

npcLine.en: This line is moving faster than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这条队伍移动得比我预想的要快。

choices.text: It is, that's a relief, honestly.
choices.zh: 确实是，说实话这让人松了口气。

choices.text: It isn't, this line hasn't moved at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that's a relief, honestly.

npcLine.en: Please have a seat, we'll call your number shortly.
npcLine.zh: 请坐一下，我们很快会叫您的号码。

choices.text: Thank you, we don't mind waiting at all.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们完全不介意等待。

choices.text: Thank you, though waiting isn't something we do.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Thank you, we'll wait right over there.

transition.en: A clerk carefully reviews their applications and documents.
transition.zh: 一位工作人员仔细审核了他们的申请和文件。

scenes.title: The Clerk Review
scenes.subtitle: 护照办事处 · 窗口审核

npcLine.en: Have you signed the back of each photo?
npcLine.zh: 每张照片背面您都签字了吗？

choices.text: We've signed all of them, actually.
choices.zh: 其实我们都已经签好了。

choices.text: We've never signed anything on these photos.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've signed all of them, actually.

npcLine.en: Everything looks in order, which is more than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 一切都井井有条，比我预想的还要顺利。

choices.text: That's such a relief, thank you for reviewing it.
choices.zh: 这真让人松了口气，谢谢您的审核。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we thought something was missing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's great to hear, thank you for checking.

npcLine.en: Your new passports should arrive within three weeks.
npcLine.zh: 您的新护照大概三周内就能寄到。

choices.text: Perfect, that gives us plenty of time.
choices.zh: 太好了，这样时间很充裕。

choices.text: Perfect, though three weeks feels far too long.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Perfect, that gives us plenty of time.

transition.en: Each day, they check the mailbox hoping for the passports.
transition.zh: 每天他们都盼着信箱里能出现护照。

npcLine.en: Has anything come in the mail today?
npcLine.zh: 今天邮件里有什么来吗？

choices.text: Nothing's come yet, just some regular bills.
choices.zh: 还没什么来，就一些普通账单。

choices.text: Everything has already arrived by now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → Nothing's come yet, just some regular bills.

npcLine.en: I'm checking the tracking number again.
npcLine.zh: 我又在查快递追踪号了。

choices.text: You've checked that about ten times today.
choices.zh: 你今天已经查了大概十次了。

choices.text: You've never checked that once, I'm sure.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → You've checked that about ten times today.

npcLine.en: If they don't come this week, let's call and check.
npcLine.zh: 如果这周还没到，我们就打电话查一下吧。

choices.text: If that happens, let's call on Friday.
choices.zh: 如果真是那样，我们周五就打电话吧。

choices.text: If that happens, let's just forget about it.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that happens, let's call on Friday.

transition.en: A padded envelope finally arrives with three brand-new passports.
transition.zh: 一个厚厚的信封终于送到了，里面装着三本崭新的护照。

npcLine.en: They're here, all three of them!
npcLine.zh: 到了，三本都到了！

choices.text: Finally, I've been waiting for this all week.
choices.zh: 终于啊，我这一整周都在等这个。

choices.text: Finally, though we don't actually need them.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Finally, I've been waiting for this all week.

npcLine.en: The baby's photo turned out cuter than any of ours.
npcLine.zh: 宝宝的照片比我们俩的都可爱。

choices.text: It really did, that photo is adorable.
choices.zh: 确实如此，那张照片太可爱了。

choices.text: It really didn't, that photo looks blurry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, that photo is adorable.

npcLine.en: Now we can finally book that trip we talked about.
npcLine.zh: 现在我们终于可以订之前聊到的那趟旅行了。

choices.text: We can, let's start looking at flights tonight.
choices.zh: 确实可以，我们今晚就开始查机票吧。

choices.text: We can't, passports don't actually help with trips.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → We can, let's start looking at flights tonight.

transition.en: With passports in hand, they finally plan a family trip abroad.
transition.zh: 护照拿到手了，他们终于开始规划一次全家出国旅行。

npcLine.en: Where should our baby's first trip abroad be?
npcLine.zh: 宝宝的第一次出国旅行应该去哪儿？

choices.text: Somewhere close, maybe just across the border.
choices.zh: 近一点的地方，也许就跨个边境。

choices.text: Nowhere, first trips are always a bad idea.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Somewhere close, maybe just across the border.

npcLine.en: Traveling with a baby is more work than traveling alone.
npcLine.zh: 带着宝宝旅行比一个人旅行要费劲得多。

choices.text: It is, but it'll be worth it, definitely.
choices.zh: 确实是，但绝对值得。

choices.text: It isn't, babies never make anything harder.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but it'll be worth it, definitely.

npcLine.en: Let's make a checklist so we don't forget anything.
npcLine.zh: 我们列个清单，这样就不会漏掉什么了。

choices.text: Good idea, let's start writing it tonight.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们今晚就开始写吧。

choices.text: Let's just pack randomly and hope for the best.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's start writing it tonight.

transition.en: That night, he looks at his own passport and thinks back to where it all began.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他看着自己的护照，回想起这一切开始的地方。

npcLine.en: Do you remember the first time you used this passport?
npcLine.zh: 你还记得第一次用这本护照是什么时候吗？

choices.text: I remember it perfectly, it was that first trip here.
choices.zh: 我记得很清楚，是我第一次来这里的那趟旅行。

choices.text: I don't remember using a passport ever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I remember it perfectly, it was that first trip here.

npcLine.en: So much has changed since that very first stamp.
npcLine.zh: 从那第一个印章开始，已经发生了这么多变化。

choices.text: It really has, everything led to this moment.
choices.zh: 确实如此，一切都指向了这一刻。

choices.text: It really hasn't, nothing feels different at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → It really has, everything led to this moment.

npcLine.en: No matter where this next passport takes us, I'm ready for it.
npcLine.zh: 无论这本新护照会带我们去哪里，我都已经准备好了。

choices.text: No matter where it takes us, together, always.
choices.zh: 无论它带我们去哪里，我们都一起，永远如此。

choices.text: No matter where it takes us, I'd rather stay home.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter where it takes us, together, always.

transition.en: His mother calls to say his father took a fall at home.
transition.zh: 他母亲打来电话，说他父亲在家摔了一跤。

scenes.title: A Concerning Call
scenes.subtitle: 电话 · 令人担忧的消息

npcLine.en: Your father fell in the kitchen this morning.
npcLine.zh: 你父亲今天早上在厨房摔倒了。

choices.text: Is he okay? I'm coming over right now.
choices.zh: 他没事吧？我现在就过去。

choices.text: That's fine, falls happen sometimes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时表达关心的回应 → Is he okay? I'm coming over right now.

npcLine.en: He's okay, just a little shaken and bruised.
npcLine.zh: 他没事，就是有点被吓到，身上有点淤青。

choices.text: That's a relief, but we should still be careful.
choices.zh: 这让人松了口气，但我们还是要多加小心。

choices.text: That's fine, we don't need to worry at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's a relief, but we should still be careful.

npcLine.en: We should talk about getting some help around the house.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该谈谈请人帮忙照顾家里的事。

choices.text: You're right, let's look into our options.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我们研究一下有什么选择吧。

choices.text: You're wrong, they don't need any help.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → You're right, let's look into our options.

transition.en: They spend an evening researching home care services.
transition.zh: 他们花了一个晚上研究居家照护服务。

scenes.title: Researching Home Care
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 研究居家照护

npcLine.en: What kind of help do they actually need?
npcLine.zh: 他们实际上需要什么样的帮助？

choices.text: Someone to check in a few times a week.
choices.zh: 需要有人每周去看看几次。

choices.text: They need nothing at all, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答需求 → Someone to check in a few times a week.

npcLine.en: This agency has more experience than the others we found.
npcLine.zh: 这家机构比我们找到的其他几家更有经验。

choices.text: That's reassuring, let's contact them first.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，我们先联系他们吧。

choices.text: Experience doesn't matter, let's just pick randomly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's reassuring, let's contact them first.

npcLine.en: We'll need to talk to your parents about this too.
npcLine.zh: 我们也需要跟你父母谈谈这件事。

choices.text: Right, let's approach it gently with them.
