choices.zh: 对，跟他们谈的时候我们要委婉一点。

choices.text: Right, though their opinion doesn't matter here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's approach it gently with them.

transition.en: They sit down with his parents for an honest conversation.
transition.zh: 他们和他的父母坐下来进行了一次坦诚的谈话。

npcLine.en: We're not trying to take away your independence.
npcLine.zh: 我们不是想剥夺你们的独立自主。

choices.text: We know, we just want you both to be safe.
choices.zh: 我们知道，我们只是希望你们俩都安全。

choices.text: We're doing exactly that, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → We know, we just want you both to be safe.

npcLine.en: Do you feel comfortable with someone visiting a few times a week?
npcLine.zh: 每周有人来看看你们几次，你们能接受吗？

choices.text: I think that would actually be nice.
choices.zh: 我觉得那其实挺好的。

choices.text: No, strangers should never come here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I think that would actually be nice.

npcLine.en: Let's try it for a month and see how it feels.
npcLine.zh: 我们先试一个月，看看感觉怎么样。

choices.text: That sounds fair, let's give it a try.
choices.zh: 这听起来很公平，我们试试吧。

choices.text: Let's just decide forever right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → That sounds fair, let's give it a try.

transition.en: The agency sends a few potential caregivers to meet.
transition.zh: 机构安排了几位候选护理员来见面。

scenes.title: Interviewing Caregivers
scenes.subtitle: 父母家 · 护理员面试

npcLine.en: How many years of experience do you have?
npcLine.zh: 您有多少年的经验？

choices.text: I have about eight years, mostly with seniors.
choices.zh: 我大概有八年经验，主要是照顾老年人。

choices.text: Experience isn't something I have at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答经验 → I have about eight years, mostly with seniors.

npcLine.en: This candidate seems more patient than the last one.
npcLine.zh: 这位候选人看起来比上一位更有耐心。

choices.text: She does, I really like her approach.
choices.zh: 确实是，我很喜欢她的方式。

choices.text: She doesn't, they both seem identical to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → She does, I really like her approach.

npcLine.en: Would you be comfortable helping with light housework too?
npcLine.zh: 您愿意也帮忙做一些轻松的家务吗？

choices.text: Of course, that's part of the job for me.
choices.zh: 当然，对我来说这也是工作的一部分。

choices.text: No, housework is completely out of the question.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Of course, that's part of the job for me.

transition.en: They add grab bars and better lighting around the house.
transition.zh: 他们在房子里加装了扶手，改善了照明。

scenes.title: Installing Safety Features
scenes.subtitle: 父母家 · 安装安全设施

npcLine.en: Can you install this grab bar by the bathtub?
npcLine.zh: 你能在浴缸旁边装这个扶手吗？

choices.text: I can, give me a few minutes.
choices.zh: 可以，给我几分钟。

choices.text: I can't, I've never installed anything before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, give me a few minutes.

npcLine.en: This lighting is brighter than what they had before.
npcLine.zh: 这个照明比他们之前用的要亮。

choices.text: It is, that should help them see better at night.
choices.zh: 确实是，这应该能帮他们晚上看得更清楚。

choices.text: It isn't, this lighting looks exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that should help them see better at night.

npcLine.en: Let's also remove that loose rug by the stairs.
npcLine.zh: 我们也把楼梯旁那块松动的地毯拿走吧。

choices.text: Good call, that's exactly the kind of hazard we need to fix.
choices.zh: 好主意，这正是我们要解决的隐患。

choices.text: Let's leave it, rugs are never actually dangerous.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good call, that's exactly the kind of hazard we need to fix.

transition.en: The caregiver's first visit goes better than anyone expected.
transition.zh: 护理员第一次上门比大家预想的都顺利。

npcLine.en: How did today's visit go?
npcLine.zh: 今天的探访情况怎么样？

choices.text: It went really well, better than I hoped.
choices.zh: 非常顺利，比我期望的还要好。

choices.text: It didn't go at all, nobody showed up.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答结果 → It went really well, better than I hoped.

npcLine.en: Your dad seemed more relaxed than I expected too.
npcLine.zh: 你爸爸看起来也比我预想的要放松。

choices.text: He really was, they got along right away.
choices.zh: 确实是，他们一见面就相处得很好。

choices.text: He really wasn't, he seemed uncomfortable the whole time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → He really was, they got along right away.

npcLine.en: Maybe this will end up being easier than we feared.
npcLine.zh: 也许这最终会比我们担心的要容易得多。

choices.text: I hope so, that would be such a relief.
choices.zh: 希望如此，那真会让人松一口气。

choices.text: I doubt it, this will only get harder.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → I hope so, that would be such a relief.

transition.en: That night, he opens up to Emma about how the whole situation feels.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他向Emma坦露了对整件事的真实感受。

npcLine.en: Seeing my dad fall really scared me, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，看到我爸摔倒真的把我吓到了。

choices.text: That's completely understandable, I'd feel the same.
choices.zh: 这完全可以理解，我也会有同样的感受。

choices.text: That's strange, falls shouldn't scare anyone.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's completely understandable, I'd feel the same.

npcLine.en: It's strange watching your parents need help like this.
npcLine.zh: 看到父母需要这样的帮助，感觉很奇怪。

choices.text: It really is, the roles feel reversed somehow.
choices.zh: 确实是，感觉角色好像颠倒了过来。

choices.text: It really isn't, nothing about this feels strange.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, the roles feel reversed somehow.

npcLine.en: Even though this is hard, I'm glad we're facing it together.
npcLine.zh: 尽管这很难，但我很高兴我们能一起面对。

choices.text: Even though it's hard, I feel the same way.
choices.zh: 尽管很难，我也有同样的感受。

choices.text: Even though it's hard, I'd rather handle it alone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even though it's hard, I feel the same way.

transition.en: A month later, they check in on how the new routine is going.
transition.zh: 一个月后，他们了解新作息进行得如何。

npcLine.en: Has anything felt difficult about this arrangement?
npcLine.zh: 这个安排有什么让你们觉得困难的地方吗？

choices.text: Honestly, it's been easier than we expected.
choices.zh: 说实话，比我们预想的要容易。

choices.text: It's been a complete disaster from the start.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → Honestly, it's been easier than we expected.

npcLine.en: Your dad has been walking more confidently lately.
npcLine.zh: 你爸最近走路更有信心了。

choices.text: That's wonderful, all the changes really helped.
choices.zh: 太好了，所有这些改变真的有帮助。

choices.text: That's disappointing, nothing has improved at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → That's wonderful, all the changes really helped.

npcLine.en: This feels like something we did right for the whole family.
npcLine.zh: 这感觉像是我们为全家人做对了的一件事。

choices.text: It really does, and I'm proud of us for it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我为我们感到骄傲。

choices.text: It doesn't, we probably did this all wrong.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, and I'm proud of us for it.

transition.en: They start bringing their toddler along on visits to the grandparents.
transition.zh: 他们开始带着自己的孩子一起去看爷爷奶奶。

npcLine.en: Your dad's face lights up every time he sees the baby.
npcLine.zh: 每次看到宝宝，你爸的脸都会亮起来。

choices.text: It really does, this visit means everything to him.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这次探访对他意义重大。

choices.text: It doesn't, he barely notices the baby at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, this visit means everything to him.

npcLine.en: These visits seem to be helping him more than the exercises.
npcLine.zh: 这些探访对他的帮助似乎比那些锻炼还要大。

choices.text: I believe it, family is powerful medicine too.
choices.zh: 我相信这个，家人也是一种强大的良药。

choices.text: I doubt it, visits never really help anyone.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → I believe it, family is powerful medicine too.

npcLine.en: Let's keep bringing them every single week.
npcLine.zh: 我们每周都继续带他们来吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this matters more than almost anything.
choices.zh: 好的，这比几乎任何事都重要。

choices.text: Let's cut back, weekly visits sound excessive.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this matters more than almost anything.

transition.en: That evening, he reflects on how grateful he is for this extra time.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他感慨自己有多感激这段额外的时光。

scenes.title: Grateful for More Time
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 感激这段时光

npcLine.en: That scary phone call ended up leading to something good.
npcLine.zh: 那通吓人的电话最终却带来了一些好事。

choices.text: It really did, in a strange kind of way.
choices.zh: 确实如此，以一种奇特的方式。

choices.text: It really didn't, nothing good came from that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It really did, in a strange kind of way.

npcLine.en: How do you feel about everything that's changed this year?
npcLine.zh: 对今年发生的这一切变化，你有什么感受？

choices.text: Grateful, honestly, for every extra moment with them.
choices.zh: 说实话，很感激能和他们多待的每一刻。

choices.text: I don't feel anything about it at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答感受 → Grateful, honestly, for every extra moment with them.

npcLine.en: No matter how much time we have left, we won't waste a single day.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们还剩多少时间，我们都不会浪费一天。

choices.text: No matter how much time, we'll make it count.
choices.zh: 不管还有多少时间，我们都会好好珍惜。

choices.text: No matter how much time, we'll probably still waste it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how much time, we'll make it count.

transition.en: Between work, the baby, and his parents, grocery shopping keeps slipping.
transition.zh: 工作、宝宝和照顾父母之间，买菜这件事总是被耽搁。

scenes.title: Too Busy to Shop
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 忙得没空买菜

npcLine.en: We've run out of basically everything again.
npcLine.zh: 我们家里基本上又什么都没了。

choices.text: We really have, we need a better system.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们需要一个更好的办法。

choices.text: We really haven't, the fridge is completely full.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, we need a better system.

npcLine.en: Should we try one of those meal kit subscriptions?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要试试那种餐食套餐订阅服务？

choices.text: Yes, let's just try it for a month.
choices.zh: 好，我们先试一个月吧。

choices.text: No, subscriptions always feel like a scam.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's just try it for a month.

npcLine.en: We'll save so much time on planning meals.
npcLine.zh: 这样能省下很多计划饮食的时间。

choices.text: That's exactly what we need right now.
choices.zh: 这正是我们现在需要的。

choices.text: That's fine, planning meals never took much time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's exactly what we need right now.

transition.en: They browse different subscription plans online.
transition.zh: 他们在网上浏览不同的订阅套餐。

npcLine.en: How many meals should we get each week?
npcLine.zh: 我们每周应该订多少份餐食？

choices.text: Maybe three meals to start with.
choices.zh: 先试三份吧。

choices.text: We shouldn't get any meals at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → Maybe three meals to start with.

npcLine.en: This plan is cheaper than the one with more meals.
npcLine.zh: 这个套餐比含更多餐食的那个便宜。

choices.text: Let's start with the cheaper one, then.
choices.zh: 那我们就先从便宜的开始吧。

choices.text: Price doesn't matter, let's get the biggest plan.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's start with the cheaper one, then.

npcLine.en: You can cancel anytime with no penalty.
npcLine.zh: 您可以随时取消，没有任何罚金。

choices.text: That's reassuring, let's give it a shot.
choices.zh: 这让人放心，我们就试试吧。

choices.text: That's suspicious, there must be a hidden catch.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应能力/许可句 → That's reassuring, let's give it a shot.

transition.en: They select a delivery window that fits their schedule.
transition.zh: 他们选择了一个适合自己日程的配送时段。

scenes.title: Picking a Delivery Slot
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 选择配送时段

npcLine.en: Which day works best for a delivery?
npcLine.zh: 哪一天最适合安排配送？

choices.text: Tuesday afternoons work best for us.
choices.zh: 周二下午对我们来说最合适。

choices.text: No day works, we're always unavailable.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时间 → Tuesday afternoons work best for us.

npcLine.en: This time slot is earlier than we usually get home.
npcLine.zh: 这个时段比我们平常到家的时间要早。

choices.text: Let's pick a later slot instead, then.
choices.zh: 那我们选一个更晚的时段吧。

choices.text: That's fine, packages can just sit outside forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's pick a later slot instead, then.

npcLine.en: Please leave the box by the front door if we're out.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们不在家，请把箱子放在前门旁边。

choices.text: Sure, I'll add that note to the order.
choices.zh: 好的，我会在订单里加上这个说明。

choices.text: Sorry, we'd rather the box just disappear.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Sure, I'll add that note to the order.

transition.en: Their first delivery box shows up right on schedule.
transition.zh: 他们的第一箱配送准时送到了。

npcLine.en: This box is bigger than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这个箱子比我预想的要大。

choices.text: It is, everything looks so neatly packed too.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且里面装得整整齐齐的。

choices.text: It isn't, this box looks tiny to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, everything looks so neatly packed too.

npcLine.en: Each recipe comes with its own card and instructions.
npcLine.zh: 每份食谱都配有自己的卡片和说明。

choices.text: That's helpful, even I can probably follow this.
choices.zh: 这挺有帮助的，就算是我大概也能照着做。

choices.text: That's unnecessary, instructions never actually help.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's helpful, even I can probably follow this.

npcLine.en: Let's cook the first meal together tonight.
npcLine.zh: 我们今晚一起做第一顿饭吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'm actually excited to try it.
choices.zh: 好啊，我其实还挺期待试试的。

choices.text: Let's just order takeout instead tonight.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'm actually excited to try it.

transition.en: They follow the recipe card step by step in the kitchen.
transition.zh: 他们在厨房里按照食谱卡一步步做菜。

npcLine.en: Can you chop these vegetables while I start the sauce?
npcLine.zh: 我做酱的时候你能把这些蔬菜切一下吗？

choices.text: I can, hand me the cutting board.
choices.zh: 可以，把砧板给我。

choices.text: I can't, chopping vegetables scares me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, hand me the cutting board.

npcLine.en: This recipe is simpler than I thought it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这份食谱比我想的要简单。

choices.text: It really is, we might actually pull this off.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们说不定真能做成。

choices.text: It really isn't, this seems impossible to follow.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, we might actually pull this off.

npcLine.en: This actually smells better than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这闻起来其实比我预想的要香。

choices.text: It really does, maybe we're better cooks than we thought.
choices.zh: 确实如此，也许我们比自己想的更会做饭。

choices.text: It really doesn't, something's clearly gone wrong.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, maybe we're better cooks than we thought.

transition.en: After a few weeks, they tweak the subscription to fit better.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们调整了订阅方案，让它更符合需求。

npcLine.en: Should we switch to more kid-friendly meals?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要换成更适合小孩吃的餐食？

choices.text: Yes, let's pick options the baby can eat too.
choices.zh: 好，我们选一些宝宝也能吃的选项吧。

choices.text: No, the baby should just eat what we eat.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's pick options the baby can eat too.

npcLine.en: These new options seem more family-friendly than the old ones.
npcLine.zh: 这些新选项看起来比之前的更适合家庭。

choices.text: They do, let's switch to these for next week.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们下周就换成这些吧。

choices.text: They don't, let's just keep the old options.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They do, let's switch to these for next week.

npcLine.en: We can also skip a week if we're too busy.
npcLine.zh: 如果太忙我们也可以跳过某一周。

choices.text: That's good to know, that gives us flexibility.
choices.zh: 知道这个真好，这给了我们灵活性。

choices.text: That's odd, subscriptions should never be flexible.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/许可 → That's good to know, that gives us flexibility.

transition.en: One week, the delivery never shows up.
transition.zh: 有一周，配送一直没有送到。

npcLine.en: Did the box ever actually arrive today?
npcLine.zh: 今天的箱子到底有没有送到？

choices.text: No, it never showed up at all.
choices.zh: 没有，压根就没送来。

choices.text: Yes, it arrived hours ago as usual.

n1.hintOnWrong: 否定回答 → No, it never showed up at all.

npcLine.en: Let's contact customer service about this.
npcLine.zh: 我们联系一下客服吧。

choices.text: Good idea, I'll message them right now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我现在就给他们发消息。

choices.text: Let's just forget about it and skip dinner.

n2.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, I'll message them right now.

npcLine.en: They offered a full refund and a free box next time.
npcLine.zh: 他们提供了全额退款，还有下次一箱免费。

choices.text: That's fair, mistakes happen sometimes.
choices.zh: 这样很公平，有时候难免出错。

choices.text: That's not enough, we should cancel right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's fair, mistakes happen sometimes.

transition.en: Three months in, they reflect on whether it's still worth it.
transition.zh: 三个月过去了，他们思考这项服务是否还值得。

npcLine.en: Has this actually saved us time overall?
npcLine.zh: 这整体上真的帮我们省了时间吗？

choices.text: It's saved us more time than I expected.
choices.zh: 它省下的时间比我预想的要多。

choices.text: It's never once saved us any time at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → It's saved us more time than I expected.

npcLine.en: We've also tried more new recipes than we ever would have on our own.
npcLine.zh: 我们也尝试了比自己平时更多的新食谱。

choices.text: That's true, our meals have gotten more varied.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们的饮食变得更丰富了。

choices.text: That's false, we've cooked the exact same things.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's true, our meals have gotten more varied.

npcLine.en: I think we should keep this going for now.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得我们目前应该继续保持这个订阅。

choices.text: I agree, this has honestly been worth it.
choices.zh: 我同意，说实话这确实值得。

choices.text: I disagree, let's cancel it immediately.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I agree, this has honestly been worth it.

transition.en: They start sharing favorite recipe cards with friends.
transition.zh: 他们开始把喜欢的食谱卡分享给朋友们。

npcLine.en: Which recipe should we recommend to them first?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该先推荐哪份食谱给他们？

choices.text: Definitely the pasta one, it's our favorite.
choices.zh: 肯定是意面那份，那是我们的最爱。

choices.text: None of them, recipes shouldn't be shared.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Definitely the pasta one, it's our favorite.

npcLine.en: This recipe box is fuller than it was last month.
npcLine.zh: 这个食谱盒比上个月更满了。

choices.text: It is, we've collected quite a few favorites.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们已经收集了不少喜欢的食谱。

choices.text: It isn't, we've thrown most of them away.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we've collected quite a few favorites.

npcLine.en: Let's start a little recipe collection just for our family.
npcLine.zh: 我们为自己的家庭开始建一个小小的食谱合集吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, our kid might love it someday.
choices.zh: 好啊，我们的孩子将来说不定也会喜欢。

choices.text: Let's not bother, recipes never matter that much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, our kid might love it someday.

transition.en: Cooking together has quietly become one of their favorite parts of the week.
transition.zh: 一起做饭悄悄变成了他们一周中最喜欢的时刻之一。

npcLine.en: I actually look forward to cooking night now.
npcLine.zh: 现在我其实还挺期待做饭之夜的。

choices.text: Me too, it's become my favorite night of the week.
choices.zh: 我也是，这变成了我一周里最喜欢的一晚。

choices.text: Me too, though I'd rather skip it entirely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Me too, it's become my favorite night of the week.

npcLine.en: We've gotten better at this than I ever thought we would.
npcLine.zh: 我们做菜的水平比我曾经想象的要好得多。

choices.text: We really have, and I'm proud of how far we've come.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我为我们的进步感到骄傲。

choices.text: We really haven't, we're still terrible cooks.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really have, and I'm proud of how far we've come.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy life gets, let's keep this night sacred.
npcLine.zh: 不管生活多忙，我们都要保护好这个夜晚。

choices.text: No matter how busy, this stays ours, always.
choices.zh: 不管多忙，这都属于我们，永远如此。

choices.text: No matter how busy, this will probably be the first thing to go.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy, this stays ours, always.

transition.en: A group chat starts buzzing about a friend's upcoming fortieth birthday.
transition.zh: 一个群聊因为一位朋友即将到来的四十岁生日热闹了起来。

npcLine.en: Should we throw her a surprise party this year?
npcLine.zh: 我们今年要给她办个惊喜派对吗？

choices.text: Yes, she deserves something special this year.
choices.zh: 好啊，今年她值得拥有点特别的东西。

choices.text: No, surprises are always a terrible idea.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, she deserves something special this year.

npcLine.en: We'll need to keep this a complete secret.
npcLine.zh: 我们得把这件事完全保密。

choices.text: Agreed, not a single word to her.
choices.zh: 同意，一个字都不能跟她透露。

choices.text: Agreed, though we should probably tell her anyway.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Agreed, not a single word to her.

npcLine.en: Let's create a group chat without her in it.
npcLine.zh: 我们建一个不加她的群聊吧。

choices.text: Good idea, I'll set that up right now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我现在就建。

choices.text: Let's just plan everything in the group with her.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, I'll set that up right now.

transition.en: They search for a venue that can host without being obvious.
transition.zh: 他们寻找一个既能办派对又不会太张扬的场地。

npcLine.en: This venue is quieter than the one we used last time.
npcLine.zh: 这个场地比我们上次用的更安静。

choices.text: That's perfect, less noise means less suspicion.
choices.zh: 太好了，噪音越小引起怀疑的可能就越小。

choices.text: That's bad, we want a loud, obvious place.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's perfect, less noise means less suspicion.

npcLine.en: Can they hold thirty people comfortably?
npcLine.zh: 这里能舒适地容纳三十个人吗？

choices.text: They can, that fits our guest list perfectly.
choices.zh: 可以，这正好符合我们的宾客名单。

choices.text: They can't, this place barely fits five people.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → They can, that fits our guest list perfectly.

npcLine.en: We'll book it under a fake reason, just in case.
npcLine.zh: 为了保险起见，我们用一个假借口来预订场地。

choices.text: Smart move, let's say it's a work event.
choices.zh: 聪明的做法，我们就说是公司活动吧。

choices.text: Smart move, let's just tell her the truth.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Smart move, let's say it's a work event.

transition.en: They divide up tasks among a growing group of friends.
transition.zh: 他们在越来越多的朋友之间分配任务。

npcLine.en: Who's handling the cake and decorations?
npcLine.zh: 谁负责蛋糕和装饰？

choices.text: I'll take care of both of those.
choices.zh: 这两样我来负责。

choices.text: Nobody's handling anything at all, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答分工 → I'll take care of both of those.

npcLine.en: This planning has become more complicated than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个策划比我预想的要复杂多了。

choices.text: It has, but it's fun coordinating everyone.
choices.zh: 确实是，但协调大家其实挺有趣的。

choices.text: It hasn't, this has been incredibly simple.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It has, but it's fun coordinating everyone.

npcLine.en: Let's set a deadline for everyone to RSVP.
npcLine.zh: 我们给大家设一个回复出席与否的截止时间吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's say by the end of the week.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们就定在本周末之前吧。

choices.text: Let's not set any deadlines, that seems too strict.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's say by the end of the week.

transition.en: They invent a believable reason to get her to the venue.
transition.zh: 他们编了一个可信的理由，把她骗到场地去。

npcLine.en: What excuse should we use to bring her there?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该用什么借口把她带过去？

choices.text: Let's tell her we're just meeting for dinner.
choices.zh: 我们就说只是一起吃个饭吧。

choices.text: We shouldn't use any excuse at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Let's tell her we're just meeting for dinner.

npcLine.en: This lie is easier to keep up than I thought.
npcLine.zh: 这个谎言比我想的要好维持。

choices.text: It really is, she hasn't suspected a thing.
choices.zh: 确实如此，她一点都没起疑心。

choices.text: It really isn't, she already figured it out.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, she hasn't suspected a thing.

npcLine.en: Please stick to the story, no matter what she asks.
npcLine.zh: 不管她问什么，都请坚持这个说法。

choices.text: Of course, I won't slip up.
choices.zh: 当然，我不会说漏嘴的。

choices.text: Sorry, I already told her the truth.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, I won't slip up.

transition.en: While she's distracted, everyone rushes to decorate the venue.
transition.zh: 趁她被支开的时候，大家赶紧布置场地。

npcLine.en: We only have thirty minutes before she arrives.
npcLine.zh: 她到之前我们只有三十分钟。

choices.text: Then let's move fast and split up the tasks.
choices.zh: 那我们就快点动作，分头行动吧。

choices.text: Then let's slow down and take our time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Then let's move fast and split up the tasks.

npcLine.en: This banner looks better than the one from last year.
npcLine.zh: 这条横幅比去年那条更好看。

choices.text: It does, everyone did a great job on this.
choices.zh: 确实是，大家这次做得都很棒。

choices.text: It doesn't, last year's banner was much nicer.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, everyone did a great job on this.

npcLine.en: She just texted, she's five minutes away!
npcLine.zh: 她刚发消息说，还有五分钟就到了！

choices.text: Everyone hide, quick, turn off the lights!
choices.zh: 大家快躲起来，关灯！

choices.text: Everyone relax, we have plenty of time still.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → Everyone hide, quick, turn off the lights!

transition.en: The lights flip on the moment she walks through the door.
transition.zh: 她一走进门，灯光瞬间亮了起来。

npcLine.en: Surprise! We can't believe you didn't suspect anything!
npcLine.zh: 惊喜！真不敢相信你一点都没起疑心！

choices.text: I honestly can't believe this either!
choices.zh: 说实话我也不敢相信这一切！

choices.text: I can believe it, I knew all along.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/惊讶 → I honestly can't believe this either!

npcLine.en: Her face lit up brighter than any candle in the room.
npcLine.zh: 她脸上的笑容比屋里任何一支蜡烛都要明亮。

choices.text: It really did, this was worth every secret text.
choices.zh: 确实如此，之前所有偷偷发的短信都值得了。

choices.text: It really didn't, she looked completely unimpressed.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, this was worth every secret text.

npcLine.en: This is honestly the best surprise anyone has ever given me.
npcLine.zh: 这真的是有人给过我的最棒的惊喜了。

choices.text: We're so glad we could pull this off for you.
choices.zh: 我们很高兴能为你把这一切做成。

choices.text: We're glad, though it wasn't really that hard.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → We're so glad we could pull this off for you.

transition.en: Over drinks, they explain how they kept the secret for months.
transition.zh: 喝着饮料，他们解释这个秘密是怎么保守了好几个月的。

npcLine.en: How long have you been planning this?
npcLine.zh: 你们计划这件事多久了？

choices.text: We've actually been planning it for two months.
choices.zh: 我们其实已经计划了两个月了。

choices.text: We've never actually planned this at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've actually been planning it for two months.

npcLine.en: This secret was harder to keep than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个秘密比我预想的更难保守。

choices.text: It really was, I almost slipped up twice.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我差点漏嘴两次。

choices.text: It really wasn't, keeping secrets is always easy.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really was, I almost slipped up twice.

npcLine.en: You all really pulled off something amazing tonight.
npcLine.zh: 你们今晚真的做成了一件很了不起的事。

choices.text: We did, and honestly, it was worth it.
choices.zh: 确实做到了，说实话这一切都值得。

choices.text: We didn't, tonight was actually a disaster.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did, and honestly, it was worth it.

transition.en: Someone raises a glass to celebrate the friendship behind it all.
transition.zh: 有人举杯，庆祝这份友谊背后的一切。

npcLine.en: To friends who plan secret parties and never tell.
npcLine.zh: 敬那些筹划秘密派对却守口如瓶的朋友们。

choices.text: To friendship, and to keeping good secrets.
choices.zh: 敬友谊，也敬那些守得住的美好秘密。

choices.text: To nothing at all, this feels unnecessary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应祝酒 → To friendship, and to keeping good secrets.

npcLine.en: Nights like this remind me how lucky I am to have you all.
npcLine.zh: 像今晚这样的夜晚让我意识到自己有你们这些朋友有多幸运。

choices.text: We feel exactly the same way about you.
choices.zh: 我们对你也有一模一样的感受。

choices.text: We don't feel lucky at all, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We feel exactly the same way about you.

npcLine.en: Let's do this again for the next big birthday.
npcLine.zh: 下一个重要生日我们还这样办吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, though we'll need a better hiding spot.
choices.zh: 好啊，不过我们得找个更好的藏身之处。

choices.text: Let's not, one surprise party was enough forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, though we'll need a better hiding spot.

transition.en: Once the guests leave, they help clean up the venue.
transition.zh: 客人离开后，他们帮忙收拾场地。

npcLine.en: Can you sweep while I fold up these tables?
npcLine.zh: 我折桌子的时候你能扫一下地吗？

choices.text: I can, hand me the broom.
choices.zh: 可以，把扫帚给我。

choices.text: I can't, sweeping isn't something I know how to do.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, hand me the broom.

npcLine.en: Cleanup always feels faster with more people helping.
npcLine.zh: 人多帮忙收拾总是感觉更快。

choices.text: It does, many hands really do make light work.
choices.zh: 确实是，人多力量大果然没错。

choices.text: It doesn't, more people just gets in the way.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, many hands really do make light work.

npcLine.en: Tonight was such a wonderful reminder of what friendship means.
npcLine.zh: 今晚真的让人重新体会到友谊的意义。

choices.text: It really was, I'll remember tonight for a long time.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我会长久记得今晚。

choices.text: It really wasn't, tonight felt pretty forgettable.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really was, I'll remember tonight for a long time.

transition.en: Exhausted but happy, they drive home talking about the whole night.
transition.zh: 又累又高兴，他们开车回家，聊着整晚发生的一切。

npcLine.en: That went better than we could have ever planned.
npcLine.zh: 这次的效果比我们计划的还要好。

choices.text: It really did, everything just came together perfectly.
choices.zh: 确实如此，一切都恰到好处地凑到了一起。

choices.text: It really didn't, tonight went completely wrong.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, everything just came together perfectly.

npcLine.en: I love being part of something like this for someone we care about.
npcLine.zh: 我很喜欢为我们在乎的人参与这样的事情。

choices.text: Me too, moments like this make everything worth it.
choices.zh: 我也是，像这样的时刻让一切都变得值得。

choices.text: Me too, though it wasn't really worth the effort.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Me too, moments like this make everything worth it.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy we get, let's always make time for our friends.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们有多忙，都要一直为朋友抽出时间。

choices.text: No matter how busy, our friends deserve that.
choices.zh: 不管多忙，我们的朋友值得我们这样做。

choices.text: No matter how busy, friends can always wait.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy, our friends deserve that.

transition.en: After yet another sleepless night, they decide something needs to change.
transition.zh: 又一个不眠之夜后，他们决定必须做出改变。

scenes.title: Another Rough Night
scenes.subtitle: 卧室 · 又一个难熬的夜晚

npcLine.en: They woke up four times again last night.
npcLine.zh: 昨晚他们又醒了四次。

choices.text: That's it, we need a real plan now.
choices.zh: 够了，我们现在需要一个真正的计划。

choices.text: That's fine, four times is completely normal.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's it, we need a real plan now.

npcLine.en: We should really look into sleep training methods.
npcLine.zh: 我们真的应该研究一下睡眠训练方法了。

choices.text: Agreed, let's research this weekend.
choices.zh: 同意，我们这周末就去研究一下。

choices.text: Disagreed, sleep training sounds cruel to us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, let's research this weekend.

npcLine.en: Let's talk to the pediatrician about it first.
npcLine.zh: 我们先跟儿科医生聊聊这件事吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's book an appointment.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们预约一下吧。

choices.text: Let's just guess what to do on our own.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's book an appointment.

transition.en: The pediatrician explains a few gentle approaches to try.
transition.zh: 儿科医生讲解了几种可以尝试的温和方法。

scenes.title: Talking to the Pediatrician
scenes.subtitle: 诊所 · 咨询儿科医生

npcLine.en: Is your child eating and growing normally?
npcLine.zh: 您的孩子吃得和长得都正常吗？

choices.text: Yes, everything else seems perfectly fine.
choices.zh: 是的，其他方面都完全正常。

choices.text: No, nothing about our child seems normal.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, everything else seems perfectly fine.

npcLine.en: A consistent bedtime routine works better than most other methods.
npcLine.zh: 一个固定的睡前流程比大多数其他方法都更有效。

choices.text: That makes sense, let's build one at home.
choices.zh: 有道理，我们在家建立一个吧。

choices.text: Routines never actually make a difference.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, let's build one at home.

npcLine.en: Give it two weeks before deciding if it's working.
npcLine.zh: 给它两周时间，再判断是否有效。

choices.text: Okay, we'll be patient and stick with it.
choices.zh: 好的，我们会耐心坚持下去的。

choices.text: Sorry, two weeks feels far too long to wait.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, we'll be patient and stick with it.

transition.en: They design a calm, predictable routine for every night.
transition.zh: 他们设计了一套每晚都平静、可预测的流程。

scenes.title: Building a Bedtime Routine
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 建立睡前流程

npcLine.en: What order should we do bath, book, and bed?
npcLine.zh: 洗澡、读书、睡觉的顺序应该怎么安排？

choices.text: Let's do bath first, then a book, then bed.
choices.zh: 我们先洗澡，然后读书，最后睡觉吧。

choices.text: Order doesn't matter, let's do them randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Let's do bath first, then a book, then bed.

npcLine.en: This routine should feel calmer than our usual chaos.
npcLine.zh: 这个流程应该比我们平常的混乱要平静多了。

choices.text: It should, and calm helps everyone sleep better.
choices.zh: 应该是的，平静能帮大家睡得更好。

choices.text: It shouldn't, chaos actually helps babies sleep.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It should, and calm helps everyone sleep better.

npcLine.en: Let's keep the same routine every single night.
npcLine.zh: 我们每晚都坚持同一套流程吧。

choices.text: Good idea, consistency is probably the key.
choices.zh: 好主意，一致性大概才是关键。

choices.text: Let's change it up every night for fun.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, consistency is probably the key.

transition.en: The first night of the new routine brings some tears.
transition.zh: 新流程的第一晚伴随着一些哭闹。

scenes.title: The First Hard Night
scenes.subtitle: 卧室 · 艰难的第一晚

npcLine.en: This crying is harder to listen to than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这哭声比我预想的更让人揪心。

choices.text: It is, but let's trust the process for now.
choices.zh: 确实是，但我们现在先相信这个方法吧。

choices.text: It is, so let's give up right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but let's trust the process for now.

npcLine.en: Even though this is hard, we shouldn't rush in immediately.
npcLine.zh: 尽管这很难，我们也不应该立刻冲进去。

choices.text: Even though it's hard, let's give it a few minutes.
choices.zh: 尽管很难，我们还是先等几分钟吧。

choices.text: Even though it's hard, let's rush in right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even though it's hard, let's give it a few minutes.

npcLine.en: This is honestly harder on us than it is on them.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，这对我们来说比对他们更难受。

choices.text: That's probably true, we just need to stay strong.
choices.zh: 也许确实如此，我们只需要坚持住。

choices.text: That's false, this is only hard for them.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's probably true, we just need to stay strong.

transition.en: They check in every few minutes without picking the baby up.
transition.zh: 他们每隔几分钟就去看一下，但不把宝宝抱起来。

npcLine.en: Should we just pat their back and leave again?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要拍拍他们的背然后再离开？

choices.text: Yes, let's keep it short and calm.
choices.zh: 对，我们要简短又平静地做这件事。

choices.text: No, let's stay in the room all night.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's keep it short and calm.

npcLine.en: The crying seems quieter than it was ten minutes ago.
npcLine.zh: 哭声好像比十分钟前小了一些。

choices.text: It does, I think it's actually working.
choices.zh: 确实是，我觉得这方法真的有效果。

choices.text: It doesn't, this is getting worse and worse.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I think it's actually working.

npcLine.en: They've finally settled down on their own.
npcLine.zh: 他们终于自己平静下来了。

choices.text: They really have, I'm honestly a little proud.
choices.zh: 确实是，说实话我有点小骄傲。

choices.text: They really haven't, they're still crying loudly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → They really have, I'm honestly a little proud.

transition.en: By the third night, bedtime takes far less time.
transition.zh: 到了第三晚，入睡花的时间大大减少了。

npcLine.en: Tonight only took ten minutes to settle them.
npcLine.zh: 今晚只花了十分钟就让他们安定下来了。

choices.text: That's amazing, this is actually working now.
choices.zh: 太棒了，这方法现在真的起效果了。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we hoped for one minute.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's amazing, this is actually working now.

npcLine.en: We're both getting more sleep than we have in months.
npcLine.zh: 我们俩现在睡的比过去几个月都要多。

choices.text: We really are, I feel like a new person.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我感觉自己都焕然一新了。

choices.text: We really aren't, we're still just as exhausted.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really are, I feel like a new person.

npcLine.en: Let's not get too excited, some nights will still be hard.
npcLine.zh: 先别高兴得太早，有些晚上应该还是会很难熬。

choices.text: That's fair, let's just enjoy tonight for now.
choices.zh: 有道理，我们先享受今晚吧。

choices.text: Let's assume every night from now on is perfect.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → That's fair, let's just enjoy tonight for now.

transition.en: A cold sets the progress back by a few days.
transition.zh: 一场感冒让训练进度倒退了几天。

npcLine.en: They're waking up again because of this cold.
npcLine.zh: 因为这场感冒，他们又开始夜醒了。

choices.text: That makes sense, let's comfort them more right now.
choices.zh: 这可以理解，我们现在多安抚他们一些吧。

choices.text: That's strange, colds never affect sleep at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → That makes sense, let's comfort them more right now.

npcLine.en: This setback feels less scary than the first hard night did.
npcLine.zh: 这次倒退感觉比第一个艰难的夜晚要没那么吓人。

choices.text: It does, we know we can get back on track.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们知道自己能重新回到正轨。

choices.text: It doesn't, this feels even worse than before.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, we know we can get back on track.

npcLine.en: Once they're feeling better, we'll get right back to the routine.
npcLine.zh: 等他们感觉好些了，我们就重新回到流程上。

choices.text: Right, let's just focus on comfort for now.
choices.zh: 对，我们现在先专注于让他们舒服些吧。

choices.text: Right, though the routine doesn't matter anymore.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's just focus on comfort for now.

transition.en: Once the cold passes, they return to the routine successfully.
transition.zh: 感冒好了之后，他们成功回到了原来的流程。

npcLine.en: We're finally back to our normal bedtime routine.
npcLine.zh: 我们终于回到了正常的睡前流程。

choices.text: That's such a relief, I missed this routine.
choices.zh: 这真让人松了口气，我还挺想念这个流程的。

choices.text: That's disappointing, the chaos was more fun.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's such a relief, I missed this routine.

npcLine.en: This whole experience taught us more patience than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 整个过程教会了我们比预想的更多的耐心。

choices.text: It really did, and I'm grateful for that lesson.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很感激这个经历带来的教训。

choices.text: It really didn't, we've never once needed patience.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, and I'm grateful for that lesson.

npcLine.en: No matter what setbacks come, we know we can handle it now.
npcLine.zh: 不管未来遇到什么挫折，我们现在都知道自己能应付。

choices.text: No matter what comes, we've got this together.
choices.zh: 不管遇到什么，我们都能一起搞定。

choices.text: No matter what comes, we'll probably fall apart.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what comes, we've got this together.

transition.en: One morning, they realize the baby slept through the entire night.
transition.zh: 一天早上，他们意识到宝宝一整晚都没醒过。

npcLine.en: Did they really sleep through the whole night?
npcLine.zh: 他们真的一整晚都没醒吗？

choices.text: Yes, not a single wake-up, I checked.
choices.zh: 是的，一次都没醒，我检查过了。

choices.text: No, they woke up every single hour again.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, not a single wake-up, I checked.

npcLine.en: I feel more rested than I have in a year.
npcLine.zh: 我感觉比这一年来任何时候都休息得更好。

choices.text: Same here, this feels like a whole new life.
choices.zh: 我也是，这感觉像是全新的生活一样。

choices.text: Same here, though nothing has changed at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Same here, this feels like a whole new life.

npcLine.en: All those hard nights were absolutely worth it.
npcLine.zh: 所有那些难熬的夜晚都完全值得了。

choices.text: They really were, every single one of them.
choices.zh: 确实如此，每一个夜晚都值得。

choices.text: They really weren't, we shouldn't have bothered.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They really were, every single one of them.

transition.en: They pass along what they learned to another struggling friend.
transition.zh: 他们把学到的经验分享给了另一位正在挣扎的朋友。

npcLine.en: How did you two finally get through this?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩最后到底是怎么熬过来的？

choices.text: Consistency, patience, and a lot of coffee.
choices.zh: 一致性、耐心，还有大量的咖啡。

choices.text: We never actually got through it at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答方法 → Consistency, patience, and a lot of coffee.

npcLine.en: It's much easier when you know it'll eventually end.
npcLine.zh: 当你知道它最终会结束时，一切会容易很多。

choices.text: It is, and it really does end, I promise.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且它真的会结束的，我保证。

choices.text: It isn't, nothing about parenting ever gets easier.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, and it really does end, I promise.

npcLine.en: You'll get through this, no matter how hard it feels right now.
npcLine.zh: 不管现在感觉多难，你们都会熬过来的。

choices.text: No matter how hard, thank you for the encouragement.
choices.zh: 不管有多难，谢谢你的鼓励。

choices.text: No matter how hard, I don't believe that at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how hard, thank you for the encouragement.

transition.en: With work picking up, they start considering daycare options.
transition.zh: 随着工作越来越忙，他们开始考虑日托的选择。

npcLine.en: Do you think they're ready for daycare?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得他们准备好去日托了吗？

choices.text: I think so, they love being around other kids.
choices.zh: 我觉得可以，他们喜欢和其他小朋友在一起。

choices.text: No, daycare should never happen at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I think so, they love being around other kids.

npcLine.en: We should tour a few places before deciding.
npcLine.zh: 我们决定之前应该先参观几家。

choices.text: Agreed, let's book some tours this week.
choices.zh: 同意，我们这周就预约几家参观吧。

choices.text: Disagreed, let's just pick the closest one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, let's book some tours this week.

npcLine.en: We'll need to apply soon, spots fill up fast.
npcLine.zh: 我们得尽快申请，名额很快就会满。

choices.text: Right, let's start the applications today.
choices.zh: 对，我们今天就开始申请吧。

choices.text: Right, though we can probably wait months.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's start the applications today.

transition.en: They visit a daycare center to see it in person.
transition.zh: 他们参观了一家日托中心，实地看看情况。

scenes.title: Touring a Daycare
scenes.subtitle: 日托中心 · 实地参观

npcLine.en: How many children do you have per caregiver?
npcLine.zh: 你们每位护理员负责多少个孩子？

choices.text: We keep it to about four children per adult.
choices.zh: 我们保持每位成人负责大约四个孩子。

choices.text: We don't count that, it doesn't matter.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答信息 → We keep it to about four children per adult.

npcLine.en: This classroom feels brighter than the last place we saw.
npcLine.zh: 这间教室比我们看的上一家感觉更明亮。

choices.text: It does, and it feels really welcoming too.
choices.zh: 确实是，感觉也很温馨。

choices.text: It doesn't, this room looks pretty dim.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, and it feels really welcoming too.

npcLine.en: Let's ask about their daily schedule before we leave.
npcLine.zh: 走之前我们问问他们的日常安排吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's ask right now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们现在就问。

choices.text: Let's skip that question, it doesn't matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's ask right now.

transition.en: They fill out the enrollment paperwork that evening.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们填写了入托申请表。

npcLine.en: Does this form ask about allergies too?
npcLine.zh: 这份表格也问过敏情况吗？

choices.text: Yes, there's a whole section for that.
choices.zh: 是的，专门有一个部分问这个。

choices.text: No, allergies aren't mentioned anywhere.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, there's a whole section for that.

npcLine.en: This application is longer than the passport form was.
npcLine.zh: 这份申请表比之前的护照表格还要长。

choices.text: It is, let's just take it one page at a time.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们就一页一页来吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this form looks very short.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's just take it one page at a time.

npcLine.en: We'll also need proof of vaccinations.
npcLine.zh: 我们还需要提供疫苗接种证明。

choices.text: Got it, we have those records at home.
choices.zh: 明白了，我们家里有这些记录。

choices.text: Got it, though we've never had those records.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Got it, we have those records at home.

transition.en: The night before the first day, they pack a daycare bag.
transition.zh: 上学第一天前的晚上，他们打包了一个日托包。

npcLine.en: What should we pack for their first day?
npcLine.zh: 第一天我们应该给他们打包什么？

choices.text: An extra outfit, snacks, and their favorite toy.
choices.zh: 一套换洗衣服、点心，还有他们最喜欢的玩具。

choices.text: Nothing at all, they don't need anything.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答清单 → An extra outfit, snacks, and their favorite toy.

npcLine.en: Can you label everything with their name?
npcLine.zh: 你能把所有东西都写上他们的名字吗？

choices.text: I can, I'll do that right now.
choices.zh: 可以，我现在就去做。

choices.text: I can't, labeling things sounds too complicated.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, I'll do that right now.

npcLine.en: Let's lay their clothes out tonight too.
npcLine.zh: 我们今晚也把衣服准备好吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that'll save time in the morning.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样早上能省点时间。

choices.text: Let's just figure it out tomorrow morning.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that'll save time in the morning.

transition.en: The first drop-off morning is harder than they expected.
transition.zh: 第一次送去日托的早上比他们预想的要难熬。

scenes.title: The First Drop-Off
scenes.subtitle: 日托中心 · 首次送托

npcLine.en: This is harder than I imagined it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这比我想象的要难熬多了。

choices.text: It really is, but they'll be okay soon.
choices.zh: 确实如此，但他们很快就会好起来的。

choices.text: It isn't, this feels completely easy for me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, but they'll be okay soon.

npcLine.en: Most kids calm down within a few minutes of the parents leaving.
npcLine.zh: 大多数孩子在父母离开后几分钟内就会平静下来。

choices.text: That's reassuring, thank you for telling us.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，谢谢你告诉我们。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we hoped they'd cry all day.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, thank you for telling us.

npcLine.en: We'll call you if anything comes up.
npcLine.zh: 有什么情况我们会打电话给您。

choices.text: Thank you, we'll keep our phones nearby.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们会把手机放在身边。

choices.text: Thank you, though we'll turn our phones off.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Thank you, we'll keep our phones nearby.

transition.en: At work, he can't stop checking his phone for updates.
transition.zh: 在公司，他忍不住一直查看手机看有没有消息。

npcLine.en: I'm checking my phone every two minutes, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，我每两分钟就查一次手机。

choices.text: I'm doing the exact same thing right now.
choices.zh: 我现在也在做一模一样的事。

choices.text: I'm not checking my phone at all, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I'm doing the exact same thing right now.

npcLine.en: This morning is passing more slowly than any morning I remember.
npcLine.zh: 今天早上比我记忆中的任何一个早上都过得慢。

choices.text: It really is, let's just distract ourselves at work.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们工作时分散一下注意力吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this morning is flying by.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, let's just distract ourselves at work.

npcLine.en: No news is good news, I keep telling myself.
npcLine.zh: 没消息就是好消息，我一直这样告诉自己。

choices.text: That's true, let's try to trust that today.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们今天就试着相信这一点吧。

choices.text: That's not true, no news usually means bad news.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's true, let's try to trust that today.

transition.en: That afternoon, they arrive together to pick up their toddler.
transition.zh: 那天下午，他们一起去接自己的孩子。

npcLine.en: How was their first day, honestly?
npcLine.zh: 说实话，他们第一天过得怎么样？

choices.text: It went better than we could have hoped.
choices.zh: 比我们期望的还要好。

choices.text: It went nowhere, nothing happened at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答结果 → It went better than we could have hoped.

npcLine.en: They stopped crying more quickly than most new kids do.
npcLine.zh: 他们停止哭泣的速度比大多数新来的孩子都要快。

choices.text: That's such a relief, they're tougher than I thought.
choices.zh: 这真让人松了口气，他们比我想的更坚强。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we wanted more attention on them.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's such a relief, they're tougher than I thought.

npcLine.en: They even made a new friend today.
npcLine.zh: 他们今天还交了一个新朋友。

choices.text: That's wonderful, I love hearing that.
choices.zh: 太好了，听到这个真开心。

choices.text: That's odd, friends shouldn't matter this early.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's wonderful, I love hearing that.

transition.en: Within a couple of weeks, daycare becomes part of the daily rhythm.
transition.zh: 几周之内，日托就成了日常生活的一部分。

scenes.title: Settling into a Routine
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 融入日常节奏

npcLine.en: Mornings are running more smoothly than that first week.
npcLine.zh: 早晨现在比第一周顺利多了。

choices.text: They are, we've finally found our rhythm.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们终于找到了自己的节奏。

choices.text: They aren't, every morning still feels chaotic.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, we've finally found our rhythm.

npcLine.en: Who's handling drop-off and who's handling pickup this week?
npcLine.zh: 这周谁负责送、谁负责接？

choices.text: I'll do drop-off, you handle pickup.
choices.zh: 我负责送，你负责接。

choices.text: Neither of us is doing either this week.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答分工 → I'll do drop-off, you handle pickup.

npcLine.en: This whole arrangement is working out better than expected.
npcLine.zh: 整个安排的效果比预想的要好。

choices.text: It really is, I'm proud of how far we've come.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我为我们走过的路感到骄傲。

choices.text: It really isn't, this arrangement is falling apart.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I'm proud of how far we've come.

transition.en: At pickup one day, a teacher shares a small but proud moment.
transition.zh: 有一天接孩子时，一位老师分享了一个虽小却令人骄傲的瞬间。

scenes.title: A Proud Parent Moment
scenes.subtitle: 日托中心 · 骄傲的瞬间

npcLine.en: They shared their toy with another child today.
npcLine.zh: 他们今天把玩具分享给了另一个孩子。

choices.text: That's amazing, I'm so proud of them.
choices.zh: 太棒了，我为他们感到骄傲。

choices.text: That's odd, sharing seems unlike them.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's amazing, I'm so proud of them.

npcLine.en: They've grown so much more social than they were a month ago.
npcLine.zh: 他们比一个月前变得更加合群了。

choices.text: They really have, daycare has been so good for them.
choices.zh: 确实如此，日托对他们真的很有好处。

choices.text: They really haven't, they seem exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really have, daycare has been so good for them.

npcLine.en: Sending them here was one of our better decisions this year.
npcLine.zh: 把他们送到这儿来是我们今年做得比较好的决定之一。

choices.text: It really was, I have zero regrets about it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我对此完全没有后悔。

choices.text: It really wasn't, we should have kept them home.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really was, I have zero regrets about it.

transition.en: That night, they talk about everyone helping raise their child.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们聊起了所有帮忙抚养孩子的人。

scenes.title: Grateful for the Village
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 感激这份支持

npcLine.en: We've had so much help raising them this year.
npcLine.zh: 今年我们在养育他们的过程中得到了这么多帮助。

choices.text: We really have, and I'm grateful for every bit of it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，每一份帮助我都心怀感激。

choices.text: We really haven't, we've done this all alone.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, and I'm grateful for every bit of it.

npcLine.en: It really does take a village, doesn't it?
npcLine.zh: 养育一个孩子真的需要一整个村庄的支持，不是吗？

choices.text: It really does, and we've been lucky to find ours.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们很幸运找到了属于我们的支持网络。

choices.text: It doesn't, we could have done this completely alone.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, and we've been lucky to find ours.

npcLine.en: No matter how much help we get, this journey is still ours.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们得到多少帮助，这段旅程终究是属于我们的。

choices.text: No matter how much help, we're grateful for every step.
choices.zh: 不管得到多少帮助，我们都感激每一步。

choices.text: No matter how much help, this journey feels like a burden.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how much help, we're grateful for every step.

transition.en: A scare with a choking toy convinces them to get certified.
transition.zh: 一次玩具卡喉的惊吓让他们决定去考急救证。

npcLine.en: That choking scare really shook us both up.
npcLine.zh: 那次卡喉的惊吓真的把我们俩都吓坏了。

choices.text: It did, we should learn first aid properly.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们应该好好学一学急救知识。

choices.text: It didn't, that wasn't scary at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It did, we should learn first aid properly.

npcLine.en: There's an infant CPR class at the community center.
npcLine.zh: 社区中心有一节婴儿心肺复苏课程。

choices.text: Perfect, let's sign up for that right now.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们现在就报名吧。

choices.text: That's unnecessary, we already know everything.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Perfect, let's sign up for that right now.

npcLine.en: We'll both need to attend the whole session.
npcLine.zh: 我们俩都需要参加整节课。

choices.text: Right, let's clear our schedules for that day.
choices.zh: 对，我们把那天的日程都空出来吧。

choices.text: Right, though only one of us really needs to go.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's clear our schedules for that day.

transition.en: A calm, experienced instructor welcomes the class.
transition.zh: 一位沉着有经验的讲师迎接了这个班的学员。

npcLine.en: Have any of you taken a first aid class before?
npcLine.zh: 你们中有人以前上过急救课吗？

choices.text: We've never taken one, this is our first time.
choices.zh: 我们从没上过，这是我们第一次。

choices.text: We've taken this exact class ten times.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've never taken one, this is our first time.

npcLine.en: This training could actually save a life someday.
npcLine.zh: 这次培训未来某天可能真的能救人一命。

choices.text: That's exactly why we're here today.
choices.zh: 这正是我们今天来这里的原因。

choices.text: That's overdramatic, this training seems pointless.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's exactly why we're here today.

npcLine.en: Please practice on the dummies, not on each other.
npcLine.zh: 请在模拟人身上练习，不要互相练习。

choices.text: Understood, we'll stick to the dummies.
choices.zh: 明白了，我们会用模拟人练习的。

choices.text: Sorry, we already practiced on each other.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Understood, we'll stick to the dummies.

transition.en: They practice chest compressions on infant training dummies.
transition.zh: 他们在婴儿模拟人身上练习胸外按压。

scenes.title: Learning Chest Compressions
scenes.subtitle: 教室 · 学习胸外按压

npcLine.en: Can you use two fingers, not your whole hand?
npcLine.zh: 你能用两根手指按压，而不是整只手吗？

choices.text: I can, that makes more sense for a baby.
choices.zh: 可以，这对婴儿来说更合理。

choices.text: I can't, two fingers seems too weak.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, that makes more sense for a baby.

npcLine.en: Your rhythm is more consistent than it was a minute ago.
npcLine.zh: 你的节奏比一分钟前更稳定了。

choices.text: Thanks, I'm starting to feel the pattern now.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我现在开始找到感觉了。

choices.text: Thanks, though I feel completely lost still.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thanks, I'm starting to feel the pattern now.

npcLine.en: Count out loud, it helps keep the pace steady.
npcLine.zh: 大声数数，这样有助于保持稳定的节奏。

choices.text: Okay, I'll count each one out loud.
choices.zh: 好的，我会大声数每一下。

choices.text: Sorry, counting out loud feels silly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'll count each one out loud.

transition.en: The instructor walks through how to respond to choking.
transition.zh: 讲师讲解了遇到异物卡喉时应该如何应对。

scenes.title: The Choking Scenario
scenes.subtitle: 教室 · 异物窒息演练

npcLine.en: What's the first thing you should check for?
npcLine.zh: 你首先应该检查什么？

choices.text: Whether they can still cough or make sounds.
choices.zh: 看他们是否还能咳嗽或发出声音。

choices.text: Nothing, you should just panic immediately.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答步骤 → Whether they can still cough or make sounds.

npcLine.en: This back blow technique is different from what I imagined.
npcLine.zh: 这种拍背手法和我想象的不一样。

choices.text: It is, I'm glad we're learning it correctly.
choices.zh: 确实是，很高兴我们能学到正确的方法。

choices.text: It isn't, this is exactly what I expected.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I'm glad we're learning it correctly.

npcLine.en: Alternate between back blows and chest thrusts.
npcLine.zh: 交替进行拍背和胸部冲击。

choices.text: Got it, back and forth until it clears.
choices.zh: 明白了，交替进行直到异物排出。

choices.text: Sorry, that sounds too complicated to remember.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Got it, back and forth until it clears.

transition.en: They take turns practicing the full sequence on the dummies.
transition.zh: 他们轮流在模拟人身上练习完整的流程。

npcLine.en: Are you feeling more confident with each try?
npcLine.zh: 每练一次你有没有觉得更有自信了？

choices.text: I am, this is finally starting to click.
choices.zh: 有的，这终于开始有点感觉了。

choices.text: I'm not, I feel less confident each time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I am, this is finally starting to click.

npcLine.en: Your technique is smoother than it was earlier.
npcLine.zh: 你的手法比刚才更流畅了。

choices.text: Thank you, repetition really seems to help.
choices.zh: 谢谢，反复练习确实很有帮助。

choices.text: Thank you, though I feel exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thank you, repetition really seems to help.

npcLine.en: Let's run through the whole sequence one more time.
npcLine.zh: 我们再完整地走一遍整个流程吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, practice makes it stick.
choices.zh: 好的，多练习才能记牢。

choices.text: Let's skip it, we've practiced enough already.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, practice makes it stick.

transition.en: During the practical exam, nerves briefly take over.
transition.zh: 实操考核时，紧张情绪一度占了上风。

npcLine.en: I completely blanked for a second there.
npcLine.zh: 我刚才有那么一秒完全脑子一片空白。

choices.text: That's normal, just take a breath and restart.
choices.zh: 这很正常，深呼吸一下重新开始吧。

choices.text: That's a disaster, you should probably fail.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's normal, just take a breath and restart.

npcLine.en: Everyone gets nervous during exams like this.
npcLine.zh: 所有人在这种考试中都会紧张。

choices.text: That's reassuring, I feel a little better now.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，我现在感觉好一点了。

choices.text: That's odd, nerves shouldn't happen to anyone.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, I feel a little better now.

npcLine.en: Take your time, there's no rush at all.
npcLine.zh: 慢慢来，一点都不用赶。

choices.text: Thank you, that actually helps me relax.
choices.zh: 谢谢，这真的让我放松了一些。

choices.text: Thank you, though I'd rather rush through it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Thank you, that actually helps me relax.

transition.en: Both of them complete the practical exam successfully.
transition.zh: 他们俩都顺利通过了实操考核。

npcLine.en: You both passed with excellent technique.
npcLine.zh: 你们俩都以出色的手法通过了考核。

choices.text: I can't believe we actually did it.
choices.zh: 我真不敢相信我们真的做到了。

choices.text: I already knew we would pass easily.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → I can't believe we actually did it.

npcLine.en: You both look more relaxed than you did an hour ago.
npcLine.zh: 你们俩看起来都比一小时前放松多了。

choices.text: We really are, that was more stressful than expected.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这比预想的更让人紧张。

choices.text: We really aren't, that was completely stress-free.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really are, that was more stressful than expected.

npcLine.en: Your certificates will be mailed within two weeks.
npcLine.zh: 您的证书会在两周内寄出。

choices.text: Thank you, we'll watch for it in the mail.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我们会留意邮件的。

choices.text: Thank you, though certificates don't matter much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Thank you, we'll watch for it in the mail.

transition.en: That weekend, they update the first aid kit at home.
transition.zh: 那个周末，他们更新了家里的急救箱。

npcLine.en: Have we checked what's expired in this kit?
npcLine.zh: 我们检查过这个箱子里有什么东西过期了吗？

choices.text: We haven't checked in a while, actually.
choices.zh: 其实我们有一阵子没检查了。

choices.text: We've checked it every single day this year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We haven't checked in a while, actually.

npcLine.en: This new kit is more complete than the old one.
npcLine.zh: 这个新的急救箱比旧的更齐全。

choices.text: It is, let's keep it somewhere easy to reach.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们把它放在容易拿到的地方吧。

choices.text: It isn't, the old kit had everything we need.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's keep it somewhere easy to reach.

npcLine.en: Let's set a reminder to check it every six months.
npcLine.zh: 我们设个提醒，每六个月检查一次吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that'll keep us on top of it.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样我们就能一直保持更新。

choices.text: Let's not bother, we'll remember on our own.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that'll keep us on top of it.

transition.en: They walk through the basics with the new caregiver too.
transition.zh: 他们也向新来的护理员讲解了基础知识。

npcLine.en: Do you know what to do if they start choking?
npcLine.zh: 如果他们开始卡喉，你知道该怎么做吗？

choices.text: I do now, thanks to this training.
choices.zh: 现在知道了，多亏了这次培训。

choices.text: I don't, and I don't need to know either.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I do now, thanks to this training.

npcLine.en: This knowledge feels more important than I ever realized.
npcLine.zh: 这些知识比我曾经意识到的要重要得多。

choices.text: It really does, I'm glad we finally learned it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，很高兴我们终于学到了这些。

choices.text: It doesn't, this knowledge feels unnecessary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I'm glad we finally learned it.

npcLine.en: Everyone who cares for kids should know this stuff.
npcLine.zh: 每个照顾孩子的人都应该懂这些知识。

choices.text: I completely agree, it should be required for everyone.
choices.zh: 我完全同意，这应该成为所有人的必修课。

choices.text: I disagree, only doctors need to know this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I completely agree, it should be required for everyone.

transition.en: That night, they talk about hoping they'll never need what they learned.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们聊起希望自己永远用不上学到的这些知识。

scenes.title: Hoping Never to Need It
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 希望永远用不上

npcLine.en: I hope we never have to use any of this.
npcLine.zh: 我希望我们永远都用不上这些知识。

choices.text: Me too, but I'm glad we know it now.
choices.zh: 我也是，但很高兴我们现在懂了。

choices.text: Me too, so let's just forget everything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Me too, but I'm glad we know it now.

npcLine.en: Being prepared feels safer than hoping for the best.
npcLine.zh: 有所准备比一味期望顺利要安心得多。

choices.text: It really does, this brings a lot of peace of mind.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这带来了很多安心感。

choices.text: It doesn't, preparation is always a waste of time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, this brings a lot of peace of mind.

npcLine.en: No matter what happens, we're ready to protect this family.
npcLine.zh: 不管发生什么，我们都已经准备好保护这个家。

choices.text: No matter what happens, we've got each other's backs.
choices.zh: 不管发生什么，我们都会互相照应。

choices.text: No matter what happens, we're probably not ready.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what happens, we've got each other's backs.

transition.en: Taking out the trash, they notice how much food waste they throw away.
transition.zh: 倒垃圾时，他们注意到自己扔掉了多少食物垃圾。

npcLine.en: This bag is heavier than it should be for one week.
npcLine.zh: 这个袋子对一周的垃圾来说太重了。

choices.text: It is, we're throwing away too much food.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们扔掉的食物太多了。

choices.text: It isn't, this feels perfectly normal to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we're throwing away too much food.

npcLine.en: We should probably start composting our food scraps.
npcLine.zh: 我们大概应该开始把食物残渣堆肥。

choices.text: Good idea, we learned a lot about that at the garden.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们在花园那边学到了不少相关知识。

choices.text: Bad idea, composting sounds messy and difficult.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good idea, we learned a lot about that at the garden.

npcLine.en: Let's buy a small compost bin this weekend.
npcLine.zh: 我们这周末买一个小堆肥箱吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I've been wanting to try it.
choices.zh: 好啊，我一直想试试。

choices.text: Let's just keep throwing everything away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I've been wanting to try it.

transition.en: They browse compost bins at a hardware store.
transition.zh: 他们在五金店浏览堆肥箱。

scenes.title: Buying a Compost Bin
scenes.subtitle: 五金店 · 购买堆肥箱

npcLine.en: This countertop bin is smaller than the outdoor one.
npcLine.zh: 这个台面堆肥箱比室外那个要小。

choices.text: Let's get the small one for the kitchen first.
choices.zh: 我们先买这个小的放厨房吧。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's just grab any bin.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's get the small one for the kitchen first.

npcLine.en: Does this bin have a filter to control the smell?
npcLine.zh: 这个箱子有过滤器来控制气味吗？

choices.text: Yes, it comes with a charcoal filter.
choices.zh: 有的，它配了一个活性炭过滤器。

choices.text: No, smell has never been a concern for us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, it comes with a charcoal filter.

npcLine.en: We'll also need bags that are compostable themselves.
npcLine.zh: 我们还需要一些本身可堆肥的垃圾袋。

choices.text: Right, let's grab a box of those too.
choices.zh: 对，我们也拿一盒吧。

choices.text: Right, though regular bags should work fine.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Right, let's grab a box of those too.

transition.en: They research what can and can't go into the compost.
transition.zh: 他们研究了哪些东西能堆肥，哪些不能。

scenes.title: Learning What Can Be Composted
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 学习堆肥规则

npcLine.en: Can we put eggshells and coffee grounds in there?
npcLine.zh: 我们能把蛋壳和咖啡渣放进去吗？

choices.text: We can, those are both great for compost.
choices.zh: 可以，这两样都很适合堆肥。

choices.text: We can't, nothing organic belongs in there.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/许可 → We can, those are both great for compost.

npcLine.en: Meat and dairy are trickier to compost than vegetables.
npcLine.zh: 肉类和乳制品比蔬菜更难堆肥。

choices.text: That makes sense, let's avoid those for now.
choices.zh: 有道理，那我们现在先避开这些吧。

choices.text: That's odd, meat should compost the fastest.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, let's avoid those for now.

npcLine.en: Let's print out a simple list for the fridge.
npcLine.zh: 我们打印一份简单的清单贴在冰箱上吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that'll help us remember the rules.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样能帮我们记住规则。

choices.text: Let's just guess every time instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that'll help us remember the rules.

transition.en: They also set up a clearer system for recycling.
transition.zh: 他们还建立了一个更清晰的回收系统。

npcLine.en: Does this plastic actually get recycled here?
npcLine.zh: 这种塑料在这儿真的会被回收吗？

choices.text: Yes, but only if we rinse it out first.
choices.zh: 会的，但前提是我们要先冲洗干净。

choices.text: No, all plastic just gets thrown away anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, but only if we rinse it out first.

npcLine.en: This new bin system is more organized than before.
npcLine.zh: 这套新的分类箱系统比之前更有条理了。

choices.text: It is, I think we'll actually stick with it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我觉得我们这次真的能坚持下去。

choices.text: It isn't, the old system was much better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I think we'll actually stick with it.

npcLine.en: Let's label each bin clearly so nothing gets mixed up.
npcLine.zh: 我们把每个箱子都标清楚，这样就不会弄混了。

choices.text: Good call, I'll make the labels tonight.
choices.zh: 好主意，我今晚就来做标签。

choices.text: Let's not bother, we'll remember somehow.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good call, I'll make the labels tonight.

transition.en: A few weeks in, the new habits start to feel natural.
transition.zh: 几周之后，这些新习惯开始变得自然起来。

npcLine.en: Have you noticed our regular trash has gotten lighter?
npcLine.zh: 你有没有注意到我们的普通垃圾变轻了？

choices.text: I've noticed, it's honestly a huge difference.
choices.zh: 注意到了，说实话这差别真的很大。

choices.text: I've never once noticed anything different at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've noticed, it's honestly a huge difference.

npcLine.en: Sorting everything is faster now than it was the first week.
npcLine.zh: 现在分类比第一周要快多了。

choices.text: It is, we've finally gotten the hang of it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们终于摸到门道了。

choices.text: It isn't, sorting still takes forever every time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we've finally gotten the hang of it.

npcLine.en: This is starting to feel like second nature.
npcLine.zh: 这开始变得像本能一样自然了。

choices.text: It really is, I don't even think about it now.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我现在都不用刻意去想了。

choices.text: It really isn't, this still feels like a chore.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, I don't even think about it now.

transition.en: One evening, an unpleasant smell reveals a mistake in the compost bin.
transition.zh: 一天晚上，一股难闻的气味暴露出堆肥箱出了问题。

npcLine.en: Something in here smells worse than usual.
npcLine.zh: 这里面有什么东西闻起来比平常更难闻。

choices.text: It does, let's check what we put in yesterday.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们检查一下昨天放了什么进去吧。

choices.text: It doesn't, everything smells completely normal.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's check what we put in yesterday.

npcLine.en: I think we accidentally put some meat scraps in there.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得我们不小心把一些肉类残渣放进去了。

choices.text: That explains it, let's fix that mistake now.
choices.zh: 这就说得通了，我们现在把这个错误改过来吧。

choices.text: That's fine, meat should be totally okay in there.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That explains it, let's fix that mistake now.

npcLine.en: Let's double-check the list before adding anything from now on.
npcLine.zh: 从现在起，添加任何东西之前都先检查一下清单。

choices.text: Good idea, mistakes happen, we'll be more careful.
choices.zh: 好主意，难免出错，我们以后会更小心。

choices.text: Let's just give up on composting entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, mistakes happen, we'll be more careful.

transition.en: Months later, the compost is finally ready to use in the garden.
transition.zh: 几个月后，堆肥终于可以用在花园里了。

scenes.title: Using the Finished Compost
scenes.subtitle: 花园 · 使用成熟堆肥

npcLine.en: This compost looks richer than anything we bought before.
npcLine.zh: 这堆肥看起来比我们之前买的任何肥料都更肥沃。

choices.text: It really does, I can't believe we made this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，真不敢相信这是我们自己做的。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this looks like plain dirt.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I can't believe we made this.

npcLine.en: All those scraps actually turned into something useful.
npcLine.zh: 所有那些残渣真的变成了有用的东西。

choices.text: They really did, that feels pretty amazing.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这感觉真的很了不起。

choices.text: They didn't, this whole thing was pointless.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → They really did, that feels pretty amazing.

npcLine.en: Let's spread this on our garden plot this weekend.
npcLine.zh: 我们这周末把它铺到花园地块上吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, our vegetables will love it.
choices.zh: 好啊，我们的蔬菜肯定会喜欢的。

choices.text: Let's just throw it away instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, our vegetables will love it.

transition.en: Inspired, they look for more ways to cut down on waste.
transition.zh: 受到启发，他们寻找更多减少浪费的方法。

scenes.title: Cutting Down on Plastic
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 减少塑料使用

npcLine.en: Should we switch to reusable grocery bags?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要换成可重复使用的购物袋？

choices.text: Yes, let's keep a few in the car always.
choices.zh: 好，我们车里一直放几个吧。

choices.text: No, plastic bags are honestly just as good.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's keep a few in the car always.

npcLine.en: These glass containers are more durable than plastic ones.
npcLine.zh: 这些玻璃容器比塑料容器更耐用。

choices.text: They are, and they don't stain like plastic does.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而且它们也不像塑料那样会染色。

choices.text: They aren't, plastic containers last forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, and they don't stain like plastic does.

npcLine.en: Small changes like this really do add up.
npcLine.zh: 像这样的小改变真的会积少成多。

choices.text: They really do, and it's satisfying to see.
choices.zh: 确实如此，看着这一切也挺让人满足的。

choices.text: They don't, small changes never matter at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They really do, and it's satisfying to see.

transition.en: They start teaching their toddler to sort scraps too.
transition.zh: 他们开始教自己的孩子学着分类残渣。

npcLine.en: Can you put the banana peel in the green bin?
npcLine.zh: 你能把香蕉皮放进绿色箱子吗？

choices.text: They can, and they actually love helping with this.
choices.zh: 他们能做到，而且他们其实很喜欢帮忙做这件事。

choices.text: They can't, they're far too young to help at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → They can, and they actually love helping with this.

npcLine.en: They're getting better at this than I expected already.
npcLine.zh: 他们做这件事的水平已经比我预想的要好了。

choices.text: They really are, kids pick things up so fast.
choices.zh: 确实是，小孩子学东西真的很快。

choices.text: They really aren't, they still get confused every time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, kids pick things up so fast.

npcLine.en: It's nice knowing they're growing up caring about this too.
npcLine.zh: 看到他们从小也开始关心这些事，感觉真好。

choices.text: It really is, this feels like a lesson worth teaching.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这是一个值得教给他们的道理。

choices.text: It doesn't matter, kids won't remember this stuff.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, this feels like a lesson worth teaching.

transition.en: That evening, they reflect on how much has quietly changed.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们感慨这些悄然发生的变化。

npcLine.en: We've cut our trash down more than I ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 我们减少的垃圾量比我曾经预想的要多得多。

choices.text: We really have, and it started with one small change.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而这一切都始于一个小小的改变。

choices.text: We really haven't, nothing about our habits changed.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, and it started with one small change.

npcLine.en: One family probably can't fix everything, but it still matters.
npcLine.zh: 一个家庭大概无法解决所有问题，但这依然重要。

choices.text: It really does, small actions still add up.
choices.zh: 确实重要，小小的行动依然会积累起来。

choices.text: It doesn't, one family's effort is meaningless.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, small actions still add up.

npcLine.en: No matter how small the change, we're glad we made it.
npcLine.zh: 不管这个改变有多小，我们都很高兴自己做出了它。

choices.text: No matter how small, it's a change worth keeping.
choices.zh: 不管多小，这都是一个值得坚持下去的改变。

choices.text: No matter how small, it probably wasn't worth it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how small, it's a change worth keeping.

transition.en: They decide it's time to enroll their toddler in swim lessons.
transition.zh: 他们决定是时候给孩子报名游泳课了。

npcLine.en: Do you think they're old enough for this?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得他们年纪够大能学这个了吗？

choices.text: Yes, this age is actually a great time to start.
choices.zh: 是的，这个年纪其实正是开始学的好时机。

choices.text: No, swimming should wait until high school.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, this age is actually a great time to start.

npcLine.en: Water safety is something we should teach them early.
npcLine.zh: 水中安全是我们应该早点教给他们的东西。

choices.text: Agreed, this feels important, not just fun.
choices.zh: 同意，这不只是有趣，更是重要的事。

choices.text: Disagreed, safety can wait for now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, this feels important, not just fun.

npcLine.en: Let's sign up for the parent-and-child class.
npcLine.zh: 我们报名亲子班吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that way we're in the water too.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样我们也能一起在水里。

choices.text: Let's skip that, we'd rather just watch.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that way we're in the water too.

transition.en: They pack a bag with everything needed for the pool.
transition.zh: 他们打包了一个装满游泳所需物品的包。

npcLine.en: What do we actually need to bring?
npcLine.zh: 我们实际上需要带什么？

choices.text: Swimsuits, towels, and a swim diaper.
choices.zh: 泳衣、毛巾，还有一个游泳专用尿布。

choices.text: Nothing at all, the pool provides everything.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答清单 → Swimsuits, towels, and a swim diaper.

npcLine.en: This swim diaper fits tighter than the regular one.
npcLine.zh: 这个游泳尿布比普通的更紧一些。

choices.text: That's the point, it needs to hold in water.
choices.zh: 这正是它的作用，得能防水。

choices.text: That's bad, let's just use a regular diaper.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's the point, it needs to hold in water.

npcLine.en: Let's also grab some floaties, just in case.
npcLine.zh: 我们也拿几个浮圈，以防万一吧。

choices.text: Good idea, extra safety never hurts.
choices.zh: 好主意，多一份安全保障总没坏处。

choices.text: Let's not bother, floaties seem unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, extra safety never hurts.

transition.en: A friendly instructor greets them at the edge of the pool.
transition.zh: 一位友善的教练在泳池边迎接他们。

npcLine.en: Has your child ever been in a pool before?
npcLine.zh: 您的孩子以前进过泳池吗？

choices.text: They've been in a bathtub, but never a pool.
choices.zh: 他们在浴缸里待过，但从没进过泳池。

choices.text: They've been swimming competitively for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → They've been in a bathtub, but never a pool.

npcLine.en: This water is warmer than most public pools.
npcLine.zh: 这里的水比大多数公共泳池要暖和。

choices.text: That's good, warmer water helps kids relax.
choices.zh: 这很好，水温高一点能帮孩子放松。

choices.text: That's bad, cold water is much better for kids.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's good, warmer water helps kids relax.

npcLine.en: Please hold them close for the first few minutes.
npcLine.zh: 前几分钟请把他们抱紧一些。

choices.text: Of course, I won't let go at first.
choices.zh: 当然，一开始我不会松手的。

choices.text: Sorry, I'd rather let them float alone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, I won't let go at first.

transition.en: They slowly step into the shallow end together.
transition.zh: 他们慢慢一起走进浅水区。

npcLine.en: Are they crying, or are those happy sounds?
npcLine.zh: 他们是在哭吗，还是开心的声音？

choices.text: Those are happy sounds, they seem excited.
choices.zh: 是开心的声音，他们看起来很兴奋。

choices.text: They're definitely crying, let's leave right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Those are happy sounds, they seem excited.

npcLine.en: They're kicking more confidently than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 他们踢水的样子比我预想的要自信多了。

choices.text: They really are, they seem like a natural.
choices.zh: 确实如此，他们看起来还挺有天赋的。

choices.text: They really aren't, they seem terrified of water.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, they seem like a natural.

npcLine.en: Let's blow bubbles together to make it fun.
npcLine.zh: 我们一起吹泡泡，让这变得更好玩吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, they'll probably love it.
choices.zh: 好啊，他们大概会很喜欢。

choices.text: Let's just stay still and not move at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, they'll probably love it.

transition.en: The instructor guides them through their first floating attempt.
transition.zh: 教练指导他们第一次尝试漂浮。

npcLine.en: Can you support their back while they lean into the water?
npcLine.zh: 他们往水里靠的时候，你能托住他们的背吗？

choices.text: I can, I've got a firm grip on them.
choices.zh: 可以，我抓得很稳。

choices.text: I can't, my hands are too shaky right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, I've got a firm grip on them.

npcLine.en: They're floating longer than they did a minute ago.
npcLine.zh: 他们漂浮的时间比一分钟前要长了。

choices.text: They really are, this is such great progress.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这真是很大的进步。

choices.text: They really aren't, they're barely floating at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, this is such great progress.

npcLine.en: You're doing great, keep that grip nice and steady.
npcLine.zh: 你做得很好，继续保持稳稳的托举。

choices.text: Thank you, I'll hold steady just like this.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我就这样稳稳地托着。

choices.text: Thank you, though my arms are getting tired.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Thank you, I'll hold steady just like this.

transition.en: The instructor reminds everyone of the basic pool rules.
transition.zh: 教练提醒大家泳池的基本规则。

npcLine.en: Never leave your child alone near the water.
npcLine.zh: 永远不要让孩子独自靠近水边。

choices.text: Understood, we'll always stay within arm's reach.
choices.zh: 明白了，我们会一直保持在能伸手够到的距离。

choices.text: Understood, though we'll probably step away sometimes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Understood, we'll always stay within arm's reach.

npcLine.en: These rules exist for a reason more important than convenience.
npcLine.zh: 这些规则的存在，理由比图方便更重要。

choices.text: That's true, safety always matters more.
choices.zh: 确实如此，安全永远更重要。

choices.text: That's odd, rules like this feel unnecessary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's true, safety always matters more.

npcLine.en: We'll follow every rule, no exceptions.
npcLine.zh: 我们会遵守每一条规则，绝无例外。

choices.text: That's exactly the right attitude to have.
choices.zh: 这正是应该有的正确态度。

choices.text: That's too strict, rules are meant to be bent.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's exactly the right attitude to have.

transition.en: A splash of water in the face brings on a few tears.
transition.zh: 一次水花溅到脸上，引来了一些眼泪。

npcLine.en: Are they okay? That splash startled them.
npcLine.zh: 他们没事吧？那次水花把他们吓到了。

choices.text: They're okay, just a little surprised.
choices.zh: 他们没事，只是有点被吓到了。

choices.text: They're not okay, we should quit swimming forever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → They're okay, just a little surprised.

npcLine.en: This happens more often than you'd think at their age.
npcLine.zh: 在他们这个年纪，这种情况比你想的要常见得多。

choices.text: That's reassuring, we won't overreact then.
choices.zh: 这让人放心，那我们就不会反应过度了。

choices.text: That's alarming, let's stop the lesson right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's reassuring, we won't overreact then.

npcLine.en: Let's take a short break and try again in a minute.
npcLine.zh: 我们先休息一下，一分钟后再试。

choices.text: Good idea, let's give them a moment to recover.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们给他们一点时间缓一缓。

choices.text: Let's push through without stopping at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's give them a moment to recover.

transition.en: After a short break, they get back into the pool.
transition.zh: 短暂休息后，他们又回到了泳池里。

npcLine.en: Are you ready to try again?
npcLine.zh: 你准备好再试一次了吗？

choices.text: We are, they seem calm now.
choices.zh: 准备好了，他们现在看起来很平静。

choices.text: We're not, let's just go home instead.
