n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → We are, they seem calm now.

npcLine.en: They're smiling more than I expected after that scare.
npcLine.zh: 经历了那次惊吓后，他们的笑容比我预想的要多。

choices.text: They really are, kids bounce back so fast.
choices.zh: 确实如此，孩子恢复得真快。

choices.text: They really aren't, they still look terrified.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, kids bounce back so fast.

npcLine.en: This resilience is honestly impressive to watch.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，看到这种韧性真的让人印象深刻。

choices.text: It really is, kids are tougher than we think.
choices.zh: 确实如此，孩子比我们想的要坚强。

choices.text: It isn't, resilience doesn't matter for babies.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, kids are tougher than we think.

transition.en: As the lesson wraps up, the instructor shares encouraging feedback.
transition.zh: 课程接近尾声，教练给出了鼓励性的反馈。

npcLine.en: They did better today than most kids do on their first try.
npcLine.zh: 他们今天的表现比大多数孩子第一次尝试要好。

choices.text: That's wonderful to hear, we're really proud.
choices.zh: 听到这个真好，我们真的很骄傲。

choices.text: That's surprising, we thought they did terribly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's wonderful to hear, we're really proud.

npcLine.en: Same time next week works for us all.
npcLine.zh: 下周同一时间对我们都合适。

choices.text: Perfect, we'll see you then.
choices.zh: 太好了，那我们下次见。

choices.text: Perfect, though we'd rather skip next week.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Perfect, we'll see you then.

npcLine.en: Thank you for being so patient with them today.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你今天对他们这么有耐心。

choices.text: Of course, it's honestly a joy watching them learn.
choices.zh: 不客气，看着他们学习真的是一种乐趣。

choices.text: Of course, though patience wasn't really needed.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, it's honestly a joy watching them learn.

transition.en: Wet hair and towels in tow, they drive home together.
transition.zh: 带着湿漉漉的头发和毛巾，他们一起开车回家。

scenes.title: Driving Home Soaked
scenes.subtitle: 车上 · 湿漉漉地回家

npcLine.en: That went so much better than I imagined it would.
npcLine.zh: 结果比我想象的要好得多。

choices.text: It really did, I'm honestly relieved.
choices.zh: 确实如此，说实话我松了一口气。

choices.text: It really didn't, today felt like a disaster.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, I'm honestly relieved.

npcLine.en: I love watching them try something brand new.
npcLine.zh: 我很喜欢看着他们尝试全新的事物。

choices.text: Me too, moments like this are what I live for.
choices.zh: 我也是，像这样的时刻正是我所珍视的。

choices.text: Me too, though new things always feel stressful.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Me too, moments like this are what I live for.

npcLine.en: No matter how many tears there are, moments like today make it worth it.
npcLine.zh: 不管有多少眼泪，像今天这样的时刻都让一切值得。

choices.text: No matter how many tears, this is worth every one.
choices.zh: 不管有多少眼泪，这一切都值得。

choices.text: No matter how many tears, we should just quit now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many tears, this is worth every one.

transition.en: They visit the local library to get a card for their child.
transition.zh: 他们去当地图书馆给孩子办一张借书证。

npcLine.en: Do children need their own library card here?
npcLine.zh: 在这儿小朋友需要办自己的借书证吗？

choices.text: Yes, even babies can have their own card.
choices.zh: 需要的，就算是婴儿也能有自己的卡。

choices.text: No, children aren't allowed inside libraries.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, even babies can have their own card.

npcLine.en: This children's section is bigger than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个儿童区比我预想的要大。

choices.text: It is, and it looks so colorful too.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且看起来也很多彩。

choices.text: It isn't, this section looks tiny to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, and it looks so colorful too.

npcLine.en: Let's fill out the application at the front desk.
npcLine.zh: 我们去前台填写申请表吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's head over there now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们现在就过去。

choices.text: Let's skip that, we don't need a card.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's head over there now.

transition.en: A librarian helps them set up a new library card.
transition.zh: 一位图书管理员帮他们办理了新的借书证。

scenes.title: Getting the Library Card
scenes.subtitle: 图书馆 · 办理借书证

npcLine.en: Do you have proof of your home address?
npcLine.zh: 您有家庭住址的证明吗？

choices.text: Yes, here's a bill with our address on it.
choices.zh: 有的，这是一张有我们地址的账单。

choices.text: No, addresses have never mattered to us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, here's a bill with our address on it.

npcLine.en: This card lets you borrow more books than the basic one.
npcLine.zh: 这张卡能借的书比基础卡要多。

choices.text: That's great, let's get that one then.
choices.zh: 太好了，那我们就办这种吧。

choices.text: That doesn't matter, we'll never borrow much.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's great, let's get that one then.

npcLine.en: You'll get an email reminder before books are due.
npcLine.zh: 书快到期时您会收到一封提醒邮件。

choices.text: Perfect, that'll help us avoid late fees.
choices.zh: 太好了，这样能帮我们避免滞纳金。

choices.text: Perfect, though we never check our email.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Perfect, that'll help us avoid late fees.

transition.en: They browse the picture book shelves together.
transition.zh: 他们一起浏览绘本书架。

npcLine.en: Which book should we pick first?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该先选哪本书？

choices.text: The one with the bright animal pictures.
choices.zh: 那本有鲜艳动物图片的吧。

choices.text: None of them, books are boring anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → The one with the bright animal pictures.

npcLine.en: This story is simpler than the one we read last week.
npcLine.zh: 这个故事比我们上周读的那个更简单。

choices.text: It is, that might be easier for them to follow.
choices.zh: 确实是，这样他们可能更容易理解。

choices.text: It isn't, that story was actually much simpler.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that might be easier for them to follow.

npcLine.en: Let's grab five books for this week.
npcLine.zh: 我们这周借五本书吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, variety keeps things interesting.
choices.zh: 好，多样化能让读书更有趣。

choices.text: Let's just grab one and call it a day.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, variety keeps things interesting.

transition.en: A poster on the wall mentions a weekly story time.
transition.zh: 墙上一张海报提到了每周的故事会。

scenes.title: Discovering Story Time
scenes.subtitle: 图书馆 · 发现故事会

npcLine.en: Have you ever heard of story time here?
npcLine.zh: 你听说过这里的故事会吗？

choices.text: I've never heard of it, but let's check it out.
choices.zh: 我没听说过，不过我们去看看吧。

choices.text: I've been going every week for years already.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never heard of it, but let's check it out.

npcLine.en: This program looks more fun than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个活动看起来比我预想的更好玩。

choices.text: It does, songs and stories sound perfect for them.
choices.zh: 确实是，儿歌和故事对他们来说正合适。

choices.text: It doesn't, this looks pretty boring, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, songs and stories sound perfect for them.

npcLine.en: Let's come back for it this Saturday.
npcLine.zh: 我们这周六再来参加吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'll mark it on the calendar.
choices.zh: 好啊，我把它标在日历上。

choices.text: Let's skip it, one visit was probably enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'll mark it on the calendar.

transition.en: They join a circle of families for their first story time.
transition.zh: 他们加入了一圈家庭，参加了第一次故事会。

scenes.title: The First Story Time
scenes.subtitle: 图书馆 · 首次故事会

npcLine.en: This circle is bigger than I imagined it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这个圈子比我想象的要大。

choices.text: It is, so many families come to this.
choices.zh: 确实是，好多家庭都来参加这个活动。

choices.text: It isn't, we're pretty much the only ones here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, so many families come to this.

npcLine.en: Are they clapping along with the song?
npcLine.zh: 他们在跟着歌曲拍手吗？

choices.text: They are, look at that little smile.
choices.zh: 是的，看看那个小小的笑容。

choices.text: They aren't, they seem completely uninterested.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → They are, look at that little smile.

npcLine.en: Let's join in on the next song too.
npcLine.zh: 我们也一起唱下一首歌吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this is honestly kind of fun.
choices.zh: 好啊，说实话这真的挺好玩的。

choices.text: Let's just watch quietly from the back instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this is honestly kind of fun.

transition.en: After story time, they chat with another set of parents.
transition.zh: 故事会结束后，他们和另一对父母聊了起来。

scenes.title: Making a New Friend
scenes.subtitle: 图书馆 · 认识新朋友

npcLine.en: How old is your little one?
npcLine.zh: 你们家宝宝多大了？

choices.text: They just turned one a few months ago.
choices.zh: 他们几个月前刚满一岁。

choices.text: Age isn't something we keep track of.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答信息 → They just turned one a few months ago.

npcLine.en: They seem more social here than at home, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，他们在这儿比在家更合群。

choices.text: Same with ours, kids love being around others.
choices.zh: 我们家也一样，孩子喜欢和其他人在一起。

choices.text: That's odd, home should always feel more comfortable.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Same with ours, kids love being around others.

npcLine.en: We should set up a playdate sometime.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该找时间安排一次一起玩的约会。

choices.text: We'd love that, let's exchange numbers.
choices.zh: 我们很乐意，我们交换一下电话号码吧。

choices.text: That's unnecessary, they don't need friends yet.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We'd love that, let's exchange numbers.

transition.en: A week later, they return their first batch of borrowed books.
transition.zh: 一周后，他们归还了第一批借的书。

npcLine.en: Have we read every single one of these books?
npcLine.zh: 这些书我们都读过了吗？

choices.text: We've read all of them, some more than once.
choices.zh: 都读过了，有些还读了不止一次。

choices.text: We've never opened a single one of them.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've read all of them, some more than once.

npcLine.en: This one was requested more often than the others.
npcLine.zh: 这一本被要求读的次数比其他几本都多。

choices.text: It was, let's check that one out again.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们再借一次这本吧。

choices.text: It wasn't, we barely opened this one at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It was, let's check that one out again.

npcLine.en: Let's pick five new ones before we leave.
npcLine.zh: 走之前我们再选五本新的吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's browse the shelves again.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们再逛逛书架吧。

choices.text: Let's just leave without checking anything else out.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's browse the shelves again.

transition.en: One book quickly becomes an obsession at bedtime.
transition.zh: 有一本书很快就成了睡前的心头好。

npcLine.en: Can you believe they want this same book every single night?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信他们每晚都想读这同一本书吗？

choices.text: I can, I remember loving one book that much too.
choices.zh: 我能理解，我记得我小时候也这么爱过一本书。

choices.text: I can't, that seems completely unreasonable.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/共情 → I can, I remember loving one book that much too.

npcLine.en: I've read this page more times than I can count.
npcLine.zh: 这一页我读的次数已经数不清了。

choices.text: Same here, I've practically memorized it.
choices.zh: 我也是，我基本上都背下来了。

choices.text: Same here, though I've only read it once.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Same here, I've practically memorized it.

npcLine.en: Even though we've read this a hundred times, I still enjoy it.
npcLine.zh: 尽管这本书我们已经读了上百遍，我依然乐在其中。

choices.text: Even though it's repetitive, I feel the same way.
choices.zh: 尽管有点重复，我也有同样的感受。

choices.text: Even though it's repetitive, I've completely lost patience.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even though it's repetitive, I feel the same way.

transition.en: They discover a library book has gone missing at the worst time.
transition.zh: 他们发现一本图书馆的书在最不巧的时候不见了。

npcLine.en: Have you seen that blue book anywhere?
npcLine.zh: 你看到那本蓝色的书了吗？

choices.text: I haven't seen it since last week, actually.
choices.zh: 其实我从上周开始就没见过它了。

choices.text: I've had it in my hands this whole time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I haven't seen it since last week, actually.

npcLine.en: This search is taking longer than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这次找书花的时间比我预想的要长。

choices.text: It is, let's check under the couch cushions.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们查查沙发垫子底下吧。

choices.text: It isn't, let's just give up looking already.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's check under the couch cushions.

npcLine.en: If we can't find it, we'll just pay the replacement fee.
npcLine.zh: 如果实在找不到，我们就付赔偿费吧。

choices.text: If it comes to that, we'll handle it responsibly.
choices.zh: 如果真到那一步，我们会负责任地处理。

choices.text: If it comes to that, let's just avoid the library forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If it comes to that, we'll handle it responsibly.

transition.en: Months later, they notice how much their child now loves books.
transition.zh: 几个月后，他们注意到自己的孩子已经变得多么喜爱读书。

npcLine.en: They've started bringing books to us on their own now.
npcLine.zh: 他们现在已经开始自己主动把书拿给我们了。

choices.text: They really have, that melts my heart every time.
choices.zh: 确实是，这每次都让我心都化了。

choices.text: They really haven't, they've never touched a book.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → They really have, that melts my heart every time.

npcLine.en: This little habit means more to me than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个小小的习惯对我来说比我预想的意义更大。

choices.text: It really does, this feels like such a gift.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这感觉像是一份珍贵的礼物。

choices.text: It doesn't, reading habits never really matter.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, this feels like such a gift.

npcLine.en: No matter what they grow up to love, I hope books stay part of it.
npcLine.zh: 不管他们长大后喜欢什么，我希望书籍都能一直是其中的一部分。

choices.text: No matter what, I hope that too, always.
choices.zh: 不管怎样，我也一直这样希望着。

choices.text: No matter what, books probably won't matter later.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what, I hope that too, always.

transition.en: It's been a while since anyone in the family saw a dentist.
transition.zh: 家里已经有一阵子没人去看牙医了。

npcLine.en: When was the last time any of us saw a dentist?
npcLine.zh: 我们上次看牙医是什么时候？

choices.text: Honestly, it's probably been over a year.
choices.zh: 说实话，大概已经一年多了。

choices.text: We just went yesterday, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时间 → Honestly, it's probably been over a year.

npcLine.en: It's also time for their first dental checkup.
npcLine.zh: 也该带他们做第一次牙科检查了。

choices.text: You're right, let's find a family-friendly dentist.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我们找一位适合家庭的牙医吧。

choices.text: You're wrong, that seems way too early.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → You're right, let's find a family-friendly dentist.

npcLine.en: Let's book all three of us for the same morning.
npcLine.zh: 我们三个人都约在同一个早上吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that saves us a whole extra trip.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样能省下一趟额外的行程。

choices.text: Let's book three completely different days instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that saves us a whole extra trip.

transition.en: They try to prepare their toddler for the unfamiliar visit.
transition.zh: 他们试着让孩子提前熟悉这次陌生的看诊。

npcLine.en: Should we read them a book about visiting the dentist?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要给他们读一本关于看牙医的书？

choices.text: Yes, that should make it feel less scary.
choices.zh: 好，这样应该能让他们没那么害怕。

choices.text: No, let's just surprise them at the office.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that should make it feel less scary.

npcLine.en: This book explains it more simply than I could.
npcLine.zh: 这本书解释得比我能说的还要简单明了。

choices.text: It does, kids' books are surprisingly good at this.
choices.zh: 确实是，儿童书在这方面出乎意料地擅长。

choices.text: It doesn't, this book is way too confusing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, kids' books are surprisingly good at this.

npcLine.en: Let's practice opening wide like the dentist will ask.
npcLine.zh: 我们练习一下像牙医要求的那样张大嘴巴吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it might make them more comfortable.
choices.zh: 好啊，这样可能会让他们更自在一些。

choices.text: Let's skip that, practicing seems unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it might make them more comfortable.

transition.en: They check in at a bright, welcoming dental office.
transition.zh: 他们在一间明亮温馨的牙科诊所办理登记。

scenes.title: Checking In at the Clinic
scenes.subtitle: 牙科诊所 · 办理登记

npcLine.en: Have any of you had dental work done before?
npcLine.zh: 你们之前有做过牙科治疗吗？

choices.text: We've had a few cavities filled over the years.
choices.zh: 这些年我们补过几颗蛀牙。

choices.text: We've never once been to a dentist before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We've had a few cavities filled over the years.

npcLine.en: This waiting room feels more playful than most clinics.
npcLine.zh: 这个候诊室感觉比大多数诊所都更有趣味。

choices.text: It does, all these fish tanks are a nice touch.
choices.zh: 确实是，这些鱼缸真是个不错的巧思。

choices.text: It doesn't, this room feels pretty plain.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, all these fish tanks are a nice touch.

npcLine.en: Please fill out this medical history form while you wait.
npcLine.zh: 请在等待期间填写这份病史表。

choices.text: Of course, we'll get started right away.
choices.zh: 好的，我们马上开始填写。

choices.text: Sorry, forms aren't something we like filling out.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, we'll get started right away.

transition.en: The dentist gently examines the toddler's teeth first.
transition.zh: 牙医先温和地检查了孩子的牙齿。

npcLine.en: Can you open wide for me, just like we practiced?
npcLine.zh: 你能像我们练习的那样，给我张大嘴巴吗？

choices.text: They can, and I think they're actually excited.
choices.zh: 他们能做到，而且我觉得他们其实还挺兴奋的。

choices.text: They can't, they're refusing to open at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → They can, and I think they're actually excited.

npcLine.en: Their teeth look healthier than most kids their age.
npcLine.zh: 他们的牙齿比大多数同龄孩子都要健康。

choices.text: That's such a relief, all that brushing paid off.
choices.zh: 这真让人松了口气，之前的刷牙习惯没白费。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we expected worse news.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's such a relief, all that brushing paid off.

npcLine.en: You did such a great job holding still.
npcLine.zh: 你保持不动做得真好。

choices.text: They really did, I'm so proud of them.
choices.zh: 确实做得很好，我为他们感到骄傲。

choices.text: They really didn't, they moved the whole time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They really did, I'm so proud of them.

transition.en: Next, both parents take turns getting a cleaning and checkup.
transition.zh: 接下来，两位家长轮流洗牙检查。

npcLine.en: Do you floss regularly at home?
npcLine.zh: 您在家规律用牙线吗？

choices.text: Honestly, not as often as I probably should.
choices.zh: 说实话，可能没有我应该做到的那么频繁。

choices.text: Yes, I floss after literally every single meal.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答（带诚实说明） → Honestly, not as often as I probably should.

npcLine.en: This cleaning feels more thorough than my last one.
npcLine.zh: 这次洗牙感觉比我上次的更彻底。

choices.text: It does, my teeth already feel so smooth.
choices.zh: 确实是，我的牙齿已经感觉很光滑了。

choices.text: It doesn't, this feels exactly the same as always.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, my teeth already feel so smooth.

npcLine.en: I found one small cavity that needs filling.
npcLine.zh: 我发现了一颗需要补的小蛀牙。

choices.text: That's manageable, let's schedule the filling soon.
choices.zh: 这问题不大，我们尽快安排补牙吧。

choices.text: That's terrible, let's just ignore it forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's manageable, let's schedule the filling soon.

transition.en: They book a follow-up appointment for the small cavity.
transition.zh: 他们预约了一次复诊来处理那颗小蛀牙。

scenes.title: Scheduling the Filling
scenes.subtitle: 牙科诊所 · 预约补牙

npcLine.en: How long does a filling usually take?
npcLine.zh: 补牙通常需要多长时间？

choices.text: Usually about thirty minutes, more or less.
choices.zh: 通常大概三十分钟左右。

choices.text: Fillings take absolutely no time at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时长 → Usually about thirty minutes, more or less.

npcLine.en: Will you need anesthesia for something this small?
npcLine.zh: 这么小的问题您需要打麻药吗？

choices.text: I'll probably need a little bit, just to be safe.
choices.zh: 为了保险起见，我大概需要一点点。

choices.text: I'll definitely skip that, pain doesn't bother me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → I'll probably need a little bit, just to be safe.

npcLine.en: We have an opening next Thursday morning.
npcLine.zh: 我们下周四早上有一个空档。

choices.text: That works perfectly, let's book that slot.
choices.zh: 那正合适，我们就订这个时间吧。

choices.text: That's impossible, we're never free on Thursdays.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That works perfectly, let's book that slot.

transition.en: The hygienist gives them tips for better brushing habits at home.
transition.zh: 洁牙师给了他们一些在家更好刷牙的建议。

scenes.title: Improving Oral Hygiene
scenes.subtitle: 诊室 · 改善口腔卫生

npcLine.en: Are you brushing for the full two minutes each time?
npcLine.zh: 您每次刷牙有刷满两分钟吗？

choices.text: Honestly, probably not, I usually rush a bit.
choices.zh: 说实话，可能没有，我通常刷得有点快。

choices.text: Yes, I time it perfectly every single day.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答（诚实说明） → Honestly, probably not, I usually rush a bit.

npcLine.en: A timer or a song can help more than you'd think.
npcLine.zh: 一个计时器或一首歌能带来比你想象的更大帮助。

choices.text: That's a great tip, we'll try that at home.
choices.zh: 这是个好建议，我们在家试试。

choices.text: That sounds silly, timing brushing seems unnecessary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's a great tip, we'll try that at home.

npcLine.en: Let's set a two-minute song for brushing time at home.
npcLine.zh: 我们在家设定一首两分钟的歌当刷牙时间吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it might even make brushing fun.
choices.zh: 好啊，这甚至可能让刷牙变得有趣起来。

choices.text: Let's not bother, two minutes is easy to guess.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it might even make brushing fun.

transition.en: After the appointment, they pick a small treat for being brave.
transition.zh: 看诊结束后，他们为孩子的勇敢挑选了一份小奖励。

scenes.title: A Treat for Being Brave
scenes.subtitle: 诊所门口 · 勇敢的奖励

npcLine.en: You can pick a sticker from this box.
npcLine.zh: 你可以从这个盒子里选一张贴纸。

choices.text: They can pick one, they've earned it.
choices.zh: 他们能选一张，这是他们应得的。

choices.text: They can't, stickers seem unnecessary for this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/许可 → They can pick one, they've earned it.

npcLine.en: They handled that better than I ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 他们处理得比我预想的要好得多。

choices.text: They really did, they were incredibly brave.
choices.zh: 确实如此，他们真的非常勇敢。

choices.text: They really didn't, that was a total disaster.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really did, they were incredibly brave.

npcLine.en: This experience should make future visits much easier.
npcLine.zh: 这次经历应该会让未来的看诊轻松很多。

choices.text: That would be wonderful, I really hope so.
choices.zh: 那真是太好了，我真心希望如此。

choices.text: That won't happen, dentist visits never get easier.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That would be wonderful, I really hope so.

transition.en: The following week, one parent goes in for the small filling.
transition.zh: 第二周，一位家长去补了那颗小蛀牙。

npcLine.en: This is going to feel a little strange for a moment.
npcLine.zh: 这会让您有一小段时间感觉有点奇怪。

choices.text: Okay, I'll try to just relax through it.
choices.zh: 好的，我尽量放松地度过这段时间。

choices.text: Okay, though strange feelings really scare me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → Okay, I'll try to just relax through it.

npcLine.en: That was actually easier than I remembered it being.
npcLine.zh: 这其实比我记忆中的要容易多了。

choices.text: It was, I built it up more than I needed to.
choices.zh: 确实是，我之前把它想得比实际严重多了。

choices.text: It wasn't, that was worse than I imagined.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It was, I built it up more than I needed to.

npcLine.en: You're all set, no more numbness in about an hour.
npcLine.zh: 都弄好了，大概一小时后麻木感就会消失。

choices.text: Perfect, thank you for taking such good care of me.
choices.zh: 太好了，谢谢您把我照顾得这么好。

choices.text: Perfect, though I'd rather stay numb all day.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Perfect, thank you for taking such good care of me.

transition.en: That night, brushing time becomes a little more fun at home.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，家里的刷牙时间变得有趣了一些。

scenes.title: A Healthier Habit
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 更健康的习惯

npcLine.en: This little song makes brushing go by faster.
npcLine.zh: 这首小歌让刷牙的时间过得更快了。

choices.text: It really does, and it's become a fun routine.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这也变成了一个有趣的习惯。

choices.text: It doesn't, brushing still feels just as slow.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, and it's become a fun routine.

npcLine.en: We've all gotten better at this since the appointment.
npcLine.zh: 自从那次看诊后，我们大家都做得更好了。

choices.text: We really have, small reminders really do help.
choices.zh: 确实如此，小小的提醒真的很有帮助。

choices.text: We really haven't, nothing has changed at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, small reminders really do help.

npcLine.en: No matter how small the habit, taking care of ourselves matters.
npcLine.zh: 不管这个习惯有多小，照顾好自己都很重要。

choices.text: No matter how small, every healthy habit counts.
choices.zh: 不管多小，每一个健康的习惯都算数。

choices.text: No matter how small, habits like this don't matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how small, every healthy habit counts.

transition.en: A neighbor mentions she's moving and can't take her cat.
transition.zh: 一位邻居提到她要搬家，没法带走她的猫。

npcLine.en: I'm moving overseas, and I can't bring my cat.
npcLine.zh: 我要搬到国外去，没办法带上我的猫。

choices.text: I can't imagine how hard that must be.
choices.zh: 我无法想象那该有多难。

choices.text: I can imagine that being pretty easy, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/共情 → I can't imagine how hard that must be.

npcLine.en: Would you two ever consider taking her in?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩会考虑收养她吗？

choices.text: We'd need to talk it over, but maybe.
choices.zh: 我们需要商量一下，但也许可以。

choices.text: Absolutely not, we already have enough pets.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We'd need to talk it over, but maybe.

npcLine.en: She's such a gentle, calm cat, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，她是一只非常温和安静的猫。

choices.text: That's reassuring, especially with a toddler around.
choices.zh: 这挺让人放心的，尤其是家里有个学步的孩子。

choices.text: That's concerning, gentle cats sound suspicious.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, especially with a toddler around.

transition.en: That night, they discuss whether to take in the cat.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们讨论要不要收养这只猫。

npcLine.en: Do you think our dog would get along with a cat?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得我们家的狗会和猫相处得来吗？

choices.text: I think so, he's pretty calm with new animals.
choices.zh: 我觉得可以，他对新动物一向挺淡定的。

choices.text: No, he's never met an animal he liked.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I think so, he's pretty calm with new animals.

npcLine.en: Two pets will be more work than one.
npcLine.zh: 养两只宠物比养一只要更费心。

choices.text: It will, but I think we can handle it.
choices.zh: 确实会，但我觉得我们能应付得来。

choices.text: It won't, two pets are always easier than one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It will, but I think we can handle it.

npcLine.en: Let's say yes, she deserves a good home.
npcLine.zh: 我们答应吧，她值得拥有一个好归宿。

choices.text: Let's do it, we'll figure out the details.
choices.zh: 好，我们就这么做，细节再想办法。

choices.text: Let's say no, this feels like too much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do it, we'll figure out the details.

transition.en: They shop for everything a cat might need.
transition.zh: 他们采购了猫咪可能需要的一切用品。

scenes.title: Shopping for Cat Supplies
scenes.subtitle: 宠物店 · 采购猫咪用品

npcLine.en: What does a cat actually need that a dog doesn't?
npcLine.zh: 猫真正需要而狗不需要的东西有什么？

choices.text: A litter box and a scratching post, mainly.
choices.zh: 主要是猫砂盆和抓板。

choices.text: Cats and dogs need exactly the same things.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答清单 → A litter box and a scratching post, mainly.

npcLine.en: This litter box is bigger than the one she has now.
npcLine.zh: 这个猫砂盆比她现在用的要大。

choices.text: That's fine, more space should be more comfortable.
choices.zh: 没关系，空间更大应该会更舒服。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's get the tiniest one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's fine, more space should be more comfortable.

npcLine.en: Let's grab a scratching post before we forget.
npcLine.zh: 我们趁还没忘记，赶紧拿个抓板吧。

choices.text: Good call, that'll protect our furniture too.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样也能保护我们的家具。

choices.text: Let's skip that, furniture doesn't matter much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good call, that'll protect our furniture too.

transition.en: The neighbor drops off the cat, along with her favorite toys.
transition.zh: 邻居送来了猫咪，还带了她最喜欢的玩具。

npcLine.en: She seems more nervous than I expected in a new place.
npcLine.zh: 在新地方，她看起来比我预想的更紧张。

choices.text: That's normal, let's give her some quiet space.
choices.zh: 这很正常，我们给她留点安静的空间吧。

choices.text: That's odd, cats should feel comfortable instantly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's normal, let's give her some quiet space.

npcLine.en: Should we keep the dog in another room for now?
npcLine.zh: 我们现在要不要把狗关在另一个房间？

choices.text: Yes, let's introduce them slowly, over a few days.
choices.zh: 好，我们花几天慢慢介绍他们认识吧。

choices.text: No, let's just let them meet right away.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's introduce them slowly, over a few days.

npcLine.en: Let's set up a cozy corner just for her.
npcLine.zh: 我们给她布置一个温馨的小角落吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, somewhere she can hide if needed.
choices.zh: 好啊，找个她需要时能躲起来的地方。

choices.text: Let's not bother, she can just sleep anywhere.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, somewhere she can hide if needed.

transition.en: After a few days, they let the two animals meet through a cracked door.
transition.zh: 几天后，他们让两只动物隔着一道门缝初次见面。

npcLine.en: Is he being gentle, or is he too excited?
npcLine.zh: 他是在温柔相待，还是太兴奋了？

choices.text: He's being gentle, actually, tail wagging slowly.
choices.zh: 他其实很温柔，尾巴慢慢摇着。

choices.text: He's being way too rough, let's separate them.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → He's being gentle, actually, tail wagging slowly.

npcLine.en: She's calmer about this than I thought she'd be.
npcLine.zh: 她对这件事的镇定程度比我预想的要高。

choices.text: She really is, this is going better than expected.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这比预想的顺利多了。

choices.text: She really isn't, she looks terrified right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → She really is, this is going better than expected.

npcLine.en: Let's keep these short introductions going every day.
npcLine.zh: 我们每天都继续这样短暂的见面吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, slow and steady seems to be working.
choices.zh: 好啊，慢慢来的方式看起来很有效。

choices.text: Let's just let them live together immediately.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, slow and steady seems to be working.

transition.en: One introduction goes sideways with a hiss and a bark.
transition.zh: 有一次见面出了岔子，一声嘶叫伴着一声犬吠。

npcLine.en: That escalated more quickly than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这次升级的速度比我预想的要快。

choices.text: It did, let's give them both some space now.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们现在给他们俩都留点空间吧。

choices.text: It didn't, that was actually pretty calm.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It did, let's give them both some space now.

npcLine.en: Setbacks like this are more common than people admit.
npcLine.zh: 像这样的小挫折比大家承认的要常见得多。

choices.text: That's reassuring, we won't panic about it then.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，那我们就不会为此惊慌了。

choices.text: That's alarming, let's give up on this entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's reassuring, we won't panic about it then.

npcLine.en: Let's slow things down and start over tomorrow.
npcLine.zh: 我们放慢速度，明天重新开始吧。

choices.text: Good idea, patience matters more than speed here.
choices.zh: 好主意，在这件事上耐心比速度更重要。

choices.text: Let's push forward faster instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, patience matters more than speed here.

transition.en: A week later, the two animals nap in the same room.
transition.zh: 一周后，两只动物在同一个房间里打盹了。

npcLine.en: Can you believe they're actually in the same room?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信他们居然待在同一个房间了吗？

choices.text: I honestly can't believe it, this is huge progress.
choices.zh: 我真不敢相信，这是很大的进步。

choices.text: I can believe it, this was always going to happen.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/惊讶 → I honestly can't believe it, this is huge progress.

npcLine.en: They're getting more comfortable around each other every day.
npcLine.zh: 他们每天都对彼此更自在一些。

choices.text: They really are, patience is finally paying off.
choices.zh: 确实如此，耐心终于有了回报。

choices.text: They really aren't, nothing has changed at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, patience is finally paying off.

npcLine.en: This slow approach was clearly the right call.
npcLine.zh: 这种循序渐进的方式显然是正确的做法。

choices.text: It really was, I'm glad we didn't rush it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，很高兴我们没有操之过急。

choices.text: It really wasn't, we should have rushed it more.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really was, I'm glad we didn't rush it.

transition.en: Their toddler carefully reaches out to pet the cat for the first time.
transition.zh: 他们的孩子第一次小心翼翼地伸手摸猫。

scenes.title: The Toddler Meets the Cat
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 孩子初见猫咪

npcLine.en: Can you pet her gently, just like this?
npcLine.zh: 你能像这样轻轻地摸她吗？

choices.text: They can, look how careful they're being.
choices.zh: 他们能做到，看他们多小心。

choices.text: They can't, they're being far too rough.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → They can, look how careful they're being.

npcLine.en: She's letting the toddler pet her more than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 她让孩子摸她的时间比我预想的要长。

choices.text: She really is, she's more patient than I thought.
choices.zh: 确实如此，她比我想的更有耐心。

choices.text: She really isn't, she's already run away twice.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → She really is, she's more patient than I thought.

npcLine.en: This moment feels more precious than I could have imagined.
npcLine.zh: 这一刻感觉比我能想象的还要珍贵。

choices.text: It really does, I want to remember this forever.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我想永远记住这一刻。

choices.text: It doesn't, this moment feels pretty ordinary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I want to remember this forever.

transition.en: Weeks later, the dog and cat nap curled up together.
transition.zh: 几周后，狗和猫蜷在一起打起了盹。

npcLine.en: Look at them, they're actually curled up together!
npcLine.zh: 快看他们，他们居然蜷在一起了！

choices.text: I'm getting my phone, I have to capture this.
choices.zh: 我去拿手机，我必须拍下这一幕。

choices.text: I'm not surprised, animals never get along.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I'm getting my phone, I have to capture this.

npcLine.en: These two have become closer than we ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 他们俩变得比我们预想的还要亲密。

choices.text: They really have, and it's honestly adorable.
choices.zh: 确实如此，说实话真的太可爱了。

choices.text: They really haven't, they still avoid each other.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really have, and it's honestly adorable.

npcLine.en: This house feels more like a real home with both of them here.
npcLine.zh: 有了他们俩，这个家感觉更像一个真正的家了。

choices.text: It really does, this family feels complete now.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这个家庭现在感觉完整了。

choices.text: It doesn't, nothing feels different at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, this family feels complete now.

transition.en: They send a photo update to their former neighbor overseas.
transition.zh: 他们给远在海外的前邻居发去了一张近照。

npcLine.en: She's happier here than I ever could have made her.
npcLine.zh: 她在这儿比我曾经能给她的还要幸福。

choices.text: That means so much, thank you for trusting us.
choices.zh: 这句话对我们意义重大，谢谢你信任我们。

choices.text: That's a strange thing to say, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That means so much, thank you for trusting us.

npcLine.en: Thank you both for giving her such a wonderful life.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你们俩给了她如此美好的生活。

choices.text: Of course, she's brought us so much joy too.
choices.zh: 不客气，她也给我们带来了很多快乐。

choices.text: Of course, though she hasn't really added much.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, she's brought us so much joy too.

npcLine.en: No matter how far away you are, she'll always be part of your story too.
npcLine.zh: 不管你在多远的地方，她也永远是你人生故事的一部分。

choices.text: No matter how far, we'll send updates often.
choices.zh: 不管多远，我们都会经常给你发近况。

choices.text: No matter how far, we'll probably forget about it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how far, we'll send updates often.

transition.en: They look for a fun date night idea that isn't dinner and a movie.
transition.zh: 他们想找一个不同于晚餐加电影的有趣约会点子。

scenes.title: Booking a Date Night
scenes.subtitle: 手机 · 寻找约会灵感

npcLine.en: This pottery studio offers a beginner class on Fridays.
npcLine.zh: 这家陶艺工作室周五有初学者课程。

choices.text: That sounds different, let's actually try it.
choices.zh: 这听起来挺特别的，我们真去试试吧。

choices.text: That sounds boring, let's just order dinner again.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That sounds different, let's actually try it.

npcLine.en: Have you ever tried working with clay before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前尝试过用陶土创作吗？

choices.text: I've never tried it, but I'm curious.
choices.zh: 我从没试过，但挺好奇的。

choices.text: I've done this every weekend for years.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never tried it, but I'm curious.

npcLine.en: Let's book two spots for this Friday.
npcLine.zh: 我们订两个位子，就这周五吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'll book it right now.
choices.zh: 好啊，我现在就去订。

choices.text: Let's wait a few more months first.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'll book it right now.

transition.en: They arrive at a cozy studio filled with finished pottery.
transition.zh: 他们抵达一间摆满成品陶艺的温馨工作室。

scenes.title: Arriving at the Studio
scenes.subtitle: 陶艺工作室 · 抵达现场

npcLine.en: This place is more relaxed than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这地方比我预想的要放松许多。

choices.text: It is, I already feel calmer just being here.
choices.zh: 确实是，光是在这儿我就感觉平静了不少。

choices.text: It isn't, this place feels stressful already.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I already feel calmer just being here.

npcLine.en: Look at all these finished pieces on the shelves.
npcLine.zh: 看看架子上这些完成的作品。

choices.text: These are gorgeous, I hope ours look half this good.
choices.zh: 这些太美了，希望我们做的能有它们一半好看。

choices.text: These look boring, honestly, not impressive at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → These are gorgeous, I hope ours look half this good.

npcLine.en: Let's grab an apron before we start.
npcLine.zh: 我们开始前先拿件围裙吧。

choices.text: Good idea, clay sounds like it gets messy.
choices.zh: 好主意，陶土听起来会弄得很脏。

choices.text: Let's skip that, we won't get dirty at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, clay sounds like it gets messy.

transition.en: A warm instructor shows them to the pottery wheels.
transition.zh: 一位亲切的讲师带他们来到陶轮前。

scenes.title: Meeting the Instructor
scenes.subtitle: 陶艺工作室 · 认识讲师

npcLine.en: Have either of you used a pottery wheel before?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩有人用过陶轮吗？

choices.text: Neither of us has, we're both complete beginners.
choices.zh: 我们俩都没有，都是彻底的新手。

choices.text: Both of us have used it since childhood.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → Neither of us has, we're both complete beginners.

npcLine.en: This wheel spins faster than you might expect at first.
npcLine.zh: 这个陶轮转起来可能比你一开始想的要快。

choices.text: Good to know, we'll start slow and careful.
choices.zh: 很高兴知道这个，我们会慢慢来、小心一点。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just spin it wildly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Good to know, we'll start slow and careful.

npcLine.en: Please keep your hands wet while you shape the clay.
npcLine.zh: 塑形的时候请保持双手湿润。

choices.text: Got it, we'll keep the water nearby.
choices.zh: 明白了，我们会把水放在旁边。

choices.text: Sorry, we'd rather keep our hands dry.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Got it, we'll keep the water nearby.

transition.en: Their first attempt at the wheel collapses into a lump.
transition.zh: 他们第一次在陶轮上的尝试塌成了一团。

scenes.title: The First Attempt
scenes.subtitle: 陶艺工作室 · 首次尝试

npcLine.en: Mine just collapsed into a shapeless blob.
npcLine.zh: 我做的直接塌成了一团没有形状的泥。

choices.text: Mine did too, this is harder than it looks.
choices.zh: 我做的也是，这比看起来要难多了。

choices.text: Mine turned out perfect on the very first try.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → Mine did too, this is harder than it looks.

npcLine.en: This is more frustrating than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这比我预想的要更让人沮丧。

choices.text: It is, but let's laugh about it and try again.
choices.zh: 确实是，但我们就笑笑，再试一次吧。

choices.text: It is, so let's just give up right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but let's laugh about it and try again.

npcLine.en: Everyone's first attempt looks like this, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，每个人的第一次尝试都是这样的。

choices.text: That's reassuring, we don't feel so bad now.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，我们现在没那么沮丧了。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we hoped we'd be naturals.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, we don't feel so bad now.

transition.en: By the third attempt, something finally starts taking shape.
transition.zh: 到了第三次尝试，终于有点成形的样子了。

scenes.title: Finding a Rhythm
scenes.subtitle: 陶艺工作室 · 找到节奏

npcLine.en: This is actually starting to look like a bowl!
npcLine.zh: 这个现在真的开始有碗的样子了！

choices.text: It's really coming together, I'm impressed with us.
choices.zh: 确实开始成形了，我真为我们感到骄傲。

choices.text: It's not really looking like anything at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → It's really coming together, I'm impressed with us.

npcLine.en: Your hands are steadier now than they were ten minutes ago.
npcLine.zh: 你的手现在比十分钟前要稳多了。

choices.text: They are, I think I finally found the rhythm.
choices.zh: 确实是，我觉得我终于找到节奏了。

choices.text: They aren't, I'm shakier than when we started.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, I think I finally found the rhythm.

npcLine.en: Let's slow down and center the clay carefully.
npcLine.zh: 我们放慢速度，仔细把陶土居中吧。

choices.text: Good idea, patience seems to be the whole trick.
choices.zh: 好主意，耐心似乎就是全部的诀窍。

choices.text: Let's just rush through this part instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, patience seems to be the whole trick.

transition.en: With guidance, they each finish shaping a small bowl.
transition.zh: 在指导下，他们各自做完了一个小碗的塑形。

scenes.title: Shaping the Final Piece
scenes.subtitle: 陶艺工作室 · 完成塑形

npcLine.en: Can you believe we actually made these ourselves?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信这些真的是我们自己做的吗？

choices.text: I honestly can't, I'm so proud of this bowl.
choices.zh: 说实话我不敢相信，我为这个碗感到骄傲。

choices.text: I can believe it, this looks totally ordinary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/惊讶 → I honestly can't, I'm so proud of this bowl.

npcLine.en: Yours turned out smoother than mine, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，你做的比我的要光滑多了。

choices.text: Maybe, but yours has more character to it.
choices.zh: 也许吧，但你的更有特色。

choices.text: That's true, yours is clearly worse than mine.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Maybe, but yours has more character to it.

npcLine.en: Now we choose a glaze color for the final firing.
npcLine.zh: 现在我们要为最后的烧窑选一种釉色。

choices.text: Let's pick colors that go well together.
choices.zh: 我们选两种搭配起来好看的颜色吧。

choices.text: Color doesn't matter, let's grab any random one.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Let's pick colors that go well together.

transition.en: They browse a wall of glaze samples to pick their colors.
transition.zh: 他们浏览了一整面墙的釉色样品来挑选颜色。

scenes.title: Choosing the Glaze
scenes.subtitle: 陶艺工作室 · 挑选釉色

npcLine.en: This blue is deeper than the one you picked last time.
npcLine.zh: 这种蓝色比你上次选的要深一些。

choices.text: It is, and I actually like it even more.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且我其实更喜欢这个。

choices.text: It isn't, these two colors look identical.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, and I actually like it even more.

npcLine.en: Which glaze should we put on the inside of the bowl?
npcLine.zh: 我们碗内侧应该上哪种釉？

choices.text: Let's use a lighter shade for the inside.
choices.zh: 内侧用浅一点的颜色吧。

choices.text: The inside doesn't need any glaze at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Let's use a lighter shade for the inside.

npcLine.en: This will take about two weeks to fire and cool.
npcLine.zh: 烧制加冷却大概需要两周时间。

choices.text: That's fine, good things are worth waiting for.
choices.zh: 没关系，好东西值得等待。

choices.text: That's too long, we need it done today.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → That's fine, good things are worth waiting for.

transition.en: They wonder aloud what the finished pieces will look like.
transition.zh: 他们大声猜测着成品会是什么样子。

npcLine.en: I wonder if the color will look different after firing.
npcLine.zh: 我在想烧制后颜色会不会看起来不一样。

choices.text: Probably, glazes always change in the kiln.
choices.zh: 大概会，釉色在窑里总是会有变化。

choices.text: Definitely not, colors never change at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Probably, glazes always change in the kiln.

npcLine.en: This wait feels longer than it actually is.
npcLine.zh: 这次等待感觉比实际时间要长。

choices.text: It does, good things always feel far away.
choices.zh: 确实是，好事总是感觉很遥远。

choices.text: It doesn't, two weeks feel like nothing at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, good things always feel far away.

npcLine.en: Let's plan a small celebration when we pick them up.
npcLine.zh: 我们取件的时候小庆祝一下吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, maybe dinner out that night.
choices.zh: 好啊，也许那晚出去吃顿饭。

choices.text: Let's not bother, picking them up is nothing special.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, maybe dinner out that night.

transition.en: Two weeks later, they return to collect their finished bowls.
transition.zh: 两周后，他们回来领取烧好的碗。

npcLine.en: These came out even better than I imagined.
npcLine.zh: 这些成品比我想象的还要好。

choices.text: They really did, I can't stop staring at them.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我怎么看都看不够。

choices.text: They really didn't, these look completely ruined.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really did, I can't stop staring at them.

npcLine.en: The glaze turned out more vibrant than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 釉色的效果比我预想的要鲜艳。

choices.text: It really did, the color is stunning in the light.
choices.zh: 确实如此，在光线下颜色美极了。

choices.text: It really didn't, the color looks pretty dull.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, the color is stunning in the light.

npcLine.en: Let's use these bowls for breakfast tomorrow.
npcLine.zh: 我们明天早餐就用这两个碗吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I've been waiting to use mine.
choices.zh: 好啊，我一直等着用我这个呢。

choices.text: Let's just put them on a shelf forever instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I've been waiting to use mine.

transition.en: Every morning after, the bowls quietly remind them of that night.
transition.zh: 从那以后每天早上，这两个碗都默默提醒着他们那个夜晚。

npcLine.en: This bowl has become more meaningful than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个碗变得比我预想的更有意义。

choices.text: It really has, it holds a whole memory now.
choices.zh: 确实如此，它现在承载了一整段回忆。

choices.text: It hasn't, it's honestly just a plain old bowl.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really has, it holds a whole memory now.

npcLine.en: We should try a new hobby together more often.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该更经常地一起尝试新爱好。

choices.text: Agreed, nights like this bring us closer.
choices.zh: 同意，像这样的夜晚能让我们更亲近。

choices.text: Disagreed, our usual routine works just fine.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, nights like this bring us closer.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy life gets, let's keep making time for us.
npcLine.zh: 不管生活多忙，我们都要继续为彼此留出时间。

choices.text: No matter how busy, this is one thing worth protecting.
choices.zh: 不管多忙，这是一件值得守护的事。

choices.text: No matter how busy, date nights will probably stop.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy, we'll always make time for this.

transition.en: A flyer for a charity 5K catches their attention at the community center.
transition.zh: 社区中心一张慈善五公里跑的传单引起了他们的注意。

scenes.title: Seeing the Flyer
scenes.subtitle: 社区中心 · 看到传单

npcLine.en: This run raises money for the local children's hospital.
npcLine.zh: 这场跑步为当地儿童医院筹款。

choices.text: That's a great cause, let's sign up together.
choices.zh: 这是个很棒的公益事业，我们一起报名吧。

choices.text: That's fine, but running sounds too difficult.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's a great cause, let's sign up together.

npcLine.en: Have either of us ever run five kilometers before?
npcLine.zh: 我们俩有人跑过五公里吗？

choices.text: Neither of us has, but there's a first time.
choices.zh: 我们俩都没有，但凡事总有第一次。

choices.text: Both of us have run marathons before.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → Neither of us has, but there's a first time.

npcLine.en: Let's give ourselves eight weeks to train.
npcLine.zh: 我们给自己八周时间来训练吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that sounds like enough time.
choices.zh: 好主意，这个时间听起来够用。

choices.text: Let's just show up without training at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that sounds like enough time.

transition.en: They fill out the online registration together.
transition.zh: 他们一起填写了网上报名表。

npcLine.en: Do you want to run together or at your own pace?
npcLine.zh: 你想和我一起跑还是按自己的节奏跑？

choices.text: I'd love to run together, at least at first.
choices.zh: 至少一开始，我很想和你一起跑。

choices.text: I'd rather never see you during the race.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答（补充意愿） → I'd love to run together, at least at first.

npcLine.en: This registration fee is lower than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个报名费比我预想的要低。

choices.text: That's great, more money can go to the cause.
choices.zh: 太好了，这样能有更多钱用于公益事业。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we wanted to pay more.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's great, more money can go to the cause.

npcLine.en: We'll get a free T-shirt just for signing up.
npcLine.zh: 报名就能免费获得一件T恤。

choices.text: Nice, let's pick our sizes right now.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们现在就选尺码吧。

choices.text: Nice, though we don't want free shirts.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Nice, let's pick our sizes right now.

transition.en: Their first training run leaves them both out of breath quickly.
transition.zh: 第一次训练跑步很快就让他们俩都气喘吁吁。

npcLine.en: We're already more tired than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 我们现在已经比我预想的要累了。

choices.text: We are, let's walk for a minute and catch our breath.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们走一分钟，喘口气吧。

choices.text: We are, so let's just quit right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We are, let's walk for a minute and catch our breath.

npcLine.en: This first run was harder than I imagined it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这第一次训练比我想象的要难得多。

choices.text: It was, but we'll only get stronger from here.
choices.zh: 确实是，但从这之后我们只会越来越强。

choices.text: It was, so let's just give up on this idea.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It was, but we'll only get stronger from here.

npcLine.en: Everyone starts somewhere, this is normal.
npcLine.zh: 每个人都是从某个起点开始的，这很正常。

choices.text: That's a relief, we're not the only ones struggling.
choices.zh: 这真让人松了口气，挣扎的不止我们俩。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we hoped to be experts already.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, I feel a little better now.

transition.en: They map out a simple training schedule for the weeks ahead.
transition.zh: 他们规划了未来几周的简单训练计划。

scenes.title: Building a Training Schedule
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 制定训练计划

npcLine.en: How many days a week should we train?
npcLine.zh: 我们每周应该训练几天？

choices.text: Maybe three days, with rest in between.
choices.zh: 也许三天，中间要休息。

choices.text: We shouldn't train on any days at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答频率 → Maybe three days, with rest in between.

npcLine.en: This plan increases our distance more gradually than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个计划增加距离的方式比我预想的要循序渐进。

choices.text: That's good, gradual seems safer than rushing.
choices.zh: 这样很好，循序渐进听起来比急于求成更安全。

choices.text: That's bad, let's just increase the distance fast.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's good, gradual seems safer than rushing.

npcLine.en: Let's mark our runs on the calendar together.
npcLine.zh: 我们把训练日一起标在日历上吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that'll keep us accountable.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样能让我们互相监督。

choices.text: Let's not plan it, we'll just wing it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that'll keep us accountable.

transition.en: Rain threatens to interrupt their scheduled run.
transition.zh: 一场雨险些打断了他们计划好的训练。

npcLine.en: Should we skip today's run because of the rain?
npcLine.zh: 我们要因为下雨跳过今天的训练吗？

choices.text: No, let's just wear jackets and go anyway.
choices.zh: 不要，我们穿上外套照样去跑吧。

choices.text: Yes, let's skip every rainy day from now on.

n1.hintOnWrong: 否定回答 → No, let's just wear jackets and go anyway.

npcLine.en: Running in the rain feels more refreshing than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 在雨中跑步比我预想的更让人神清气爽。

choices.text: It does, this is oddly enjoyable, honestly.
choices.zh: 确实是，说实话这莫名地挺享受的。

choices.text: It doesn't, this is completely miserable.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, this is oddly enjoyable, honestly.

npcLine.en: We're more committed to this than I thought we'd be.
npcLine.zh: 我们对这件事的坚持程度比我预想的要高。

choices.text: We really are, and it feels good to show up.
choices.zh: 确实如此，能坚持出现感觉真好。

choices.text: We really aren't, we've skipped most of our runs.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really are, and it feels good to show up.

transition.en: A tough week leaves both of them wanting to quit.
transition.zh: 艰难的一周让他们俩都产生了放弃的念头。

npcLine.en: I don't think I can finish this run today.
npcLine.zh: 我觉得我今天跑不完这段路了。

choices.text: You can, let's just slow down together.
choices.zh: 你可以的，我们一起放慢速度吧。

choices.text: You can't, so let's stop training entirely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力鼓励 → You can, let's just slow down together.

npcLine.en: This week has been harder than any week before it.
npcLine.zh: 这周比之前任何一周都要难。

choices.text: It has, but hard weeks don't erase our progress.
choices.zh: 确实是，但艰难的一周并不会抹去我们的进步。

choices.text: It has, so let's just give up altogether.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It has, but hard weeks don't erase our progress.

npcLine.en: Even on hard days, showing up still counts.
npcLine.zh: 即使是艰难的日子，坚持出现依然算数。

choices.text: Even on hard days, we're still doing this.
choices.zh: 即使在艰难的日子里，我们也依然在坚持。

choices.text: Even on hard days, showing up doesn't matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even on hard days, we're still doing this.

transition.en: One morning, the whole distance finally feels effortless.
transition.zh: 一天早上，整段距离终于感觉毫不费力了。

npcLine.en: We just finished the full distance without stopping!
npcLine.zh: 我们刚全程跑完，中途一次都没停！

choices.text: We actually did it, I'm honestly shocked.
choices.zh: 我们真的做到了，说实话我很震惊。

choices.text: We didn't, that felt like a total failure.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We actually did it, I'm honestly shocked.

npcLine.en: That felt so much easier than the first week.
npcLine.zh: 这次感觉比第一周轻松多了。

choices.text: It really did, we've come such a long way.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们真的进步了很多。

choices.text: It really didn't, this felt just as hard as before.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, we've come such a long way.

npcLine.en: All those hard training days were worth it.
npcLine.zh: 所有那些艰难的训练日都值得了。

choices.text: They really were, and I'd do it all again.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我愿意再来一遍。

choices.text: They really weren't, we shouldn't have bothered.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They really were, every single one of them.

transition.en: Race day arrives with nerves, excitement, and a big crowd.
transition.zh: 比赛日带着紧张、兴奋和一大群人一起到来。

scenes.title: Race Day Morning
scenes.subtitle: 赛道起点 · 比赛日清晨

npcLine.en: This crowd is bigger than I expected for a local race.
npcLine.zh: 对一场本地赛事来说，这人群比我预想的要大。

choices.text: It is, this energy is honestly contagious.
choices.zh: 确实是，这种气氛真的很有感染力。

choices.text: It isn't, barely anyone showed up today.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, this energy is honestly contagious.

npcLine.en: Are you feeling ready for this?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得自己准备好了吗？

choices.text: I am, nervous, but ready.
choices.zh: 准备好了，虽然紧张，但也准备好了。

choices.text: I'm not, let's just go home instead.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I am, nervous, but ready.

npcLine.en: Let's just enjoy this, no matter our time.
npcLine.zh: 不管成绩如何，我们就享受这个过程吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, finishing together is what matters.
choices.zh: 好啊，一起完成才是最重要的。

choices.text: Let's obsess over beating everyone else instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, finishing together is what matters.

transition.en: With the finish line in sight, they push through the last stretch.
transition.zh: 终点线就在眼前，他们咬牙冲过最后一段路。

npcLine.en: We can see the finish line up ahead!
npcLine.zh: 我们能看到前面的终点线了！

choices.text: We can, let's push through to the end.
choices.zh: 确实能看到，我们咬牙坚持到最后吧。

choices.text: We can't, the finish line is nowhere in sight.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → We can, let's push through to the end.

npcLine.en: My legs feel heavier than they did an hour ago.
npcLine.zh: 我的腿比一小时前要沉重多了。

choices.text: Mine too, but we're almost there, keep going.
choices.zh: 我也是，但我们快到了，继续加油。

choices.text: Mine feel lighter than they've ever felt.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Mine too, but we're almost there, keep going.

npcLine.en: Let's cross the finish line holding hands.
npcLine.zh: 我们牵着手冲过终点线吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, together, just like everything else.
choices.zh: 好啊，我们一起，就像其他一切一样。

choices.text: Let's race each other to the finish instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, together, just like everything else.

transition.en: They cross the finish line together, exhausted and elated.
transition.zh: 他们一起冲过终点线，又累又兴奋。

npcLine.en: We actually did it, we finished the whole race!
npcLine.zh: 我们真的做到了，我们跑完了全程！

choices.text: I can't believe we finished, I'm so proud of us.
choices.zh: 我真不敢相信我们完成了，我为我们感到骄傲。

choices.text: I already knew this would happen anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → I can't believe we finished, I'm so proud of us.

npcLine.en: This medal means more to me than I expected it to.
npcLine.zh: 这枚奖牌对我的意义比我预想的要大。

choices.text: It really does, this represents so much hard work.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这代表了这么多的努力。

choices.text: It doesn't, this medal means nothing to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, this represents so much hard work.

npcLine.en: No matter how sore we are tomorrow, this was worth it.
npcLine.zh: 不管明天我们有多酸痛，这一切都值得。

choices.text: No matter how sore, I'd do this again in a heartbeat.
choices.zh: 不管有多酸痛，我会毫不犹豫地再来一次。

choices.text: No matter how sore, I'll never run again.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how sore, I'd do this again in a heartbeat.

transition.en: Riding the high from the 5K, they look for a new challenge.
transition.zh: 沉浸在跑完五公里的兴奋中，他们想找个新挑战。

npcLine.en: Have you ever wanted to try rock climbing?
npcLine.zh: 你有没有想过尝试攀岩？

choices.text: I've actually always wanted to try it.
choices.zh: 其实我一直都想试试。

choices.text: I've never once thought about climbing anything.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've actually always wanted to try it.

npcLine.en: There's an indoor climbing gym near the studio.
npcLine.zh: 陶艺工作室附近有一家室内攀岩馆。

choices.text: Perfect, let's check it out this weekend.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们这周末去看看吧。

choices.text: That's odd, climbing sounds too dangerous.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Perfect, let's check it out this weekend.

npcLine.en: Let's sign up for a beginner intro session.
npcLine.zh: 我们报名一节初学者体验课吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's book that right now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们现在就去订。

choices.text: Let's just show up without booking anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's book that right now.

transition.en: Staff at the gym fit them with climbing shoes and harnesses.
transition.zh: 攀岩馆的工作人员帮他们试穿攀岩鞋和安全带。

npcLine.en: These shoes should fit snugger than your regular sneakers.
npcLine.zh: 这双鞋应该比你平常穿的运动鞋要更贴脚。

choices.text: That makes sense, tighter should give better grip.
choices.zh: 有道理，更紧一点应该能提供更好的抓地力。

choices.text: That's odd, loose shoes should work just fine.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, tighter should give better grip.

npcLine.en: Can you double-check that your harness is buckled correctly?
npcLine.zh: 你能再检查一下安全带扣得对不对吗？

choices.text: I can, let me look at it again.
choices.zh: 可以，我再看一下。

choices.text: I can't, checking buckles seems unnecessary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me look at it again.

npcLine.en: Please always have a partner check your gear before climbing.
npcLine.zh: 攀爬前请务必让搭档检查一下你的装备。

choices.text: Got it, we'll always check each other first.
choices.zh: 明白了，我们会一直先互相检查。

choices.text: Sorry, checking each other seems unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Got it, we'll always check each other first.

transition.en: An instructor walks them through basic safety and technique.
transition.zh: 教练带他们了解基本的安全知识和技巧。

scenes.title: Learning the Basics
scenes.subtitle: 攀岩馆 · 学习基础知识

npcLine.en: How do these colored holds work exactly?
npcLine.zh: 这些彩色的岩点具体是怎么运作的？

choices.text: Each color marks a different route and difficulty.
choices.zh: 每种颜色代表一条不同的路线和难度。

choices.text: Colors don't mean anything on this wall.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答方法 → Each color marks a different route and difficulty.

npcLine.en: This route is easier than the one next to it.
npcLine.zh: 这条路线比旁边那条要简单。

choices.text: Let's start with the easier one first.
choices.zh: 我们先从简单的这条开始吧。

choices.text: Let's skip the easy ones entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's start with the easier one first.

npcLine.en: Keep your weight over your feet, not your arms.
npcLine.zh: 重心要放在脚上，不是手臂上。

choices.text: Okay, I'll focus on my legs more.
choices.zh: 好的，我会更专注于用腿发力。

choices.text: Sorry, using my arms feels more natural.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'll focus on my legs more.

transition.en: One partner takes the wall while the other holds the rope.
transition.zh: 一人先上墙攀爬，另一人负责保护绳。

npcLine.en: Are you feeling steady up there?
npcLine.zh: 你在上面感觉稳吗？

choices.text: I am, this actually feels manageable.
choices.zh: 挺稳的，这其实感觉还挺可控的。

choices.text: I'm not, get me down immediately.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I am, this actually feels manageable.

npcLine.en: You're climbing more confidently than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 你爬得比我预想的要自信多了。

choices.text: Thanks, I think adrenaline is helping me.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我觉得肾上腺素在帮我发挥。

choices.text: Thanks, though I feel completely terrified.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thanks, I think adrenaline is helping me.

npcLine.en: I've got you, take your time finding the next hold.
npcLine.zh: 我保护着你呢，慢慢找下一个岩点。

choices.text: Thank you, that actually helps me relax up here.
choices.zh: 谢谢，这真的让我在上面放松了一些。

choices.text: Thank you, though I'd rather rush this part.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Thank you, that actually helps me relax up here.

transition.en: After a slow, careful climb, one of them reaches the top.
transition.zh: 经过缓慢而小心的攀爬，其中一人到达了顶端。

npcLine.en: I actually made it all the way to the top!
npcLine.zh: 我居然爬到了最顶端！

choices.text: You did it, I'm so proud of you!
choices.zh: 你做到了，我为你感到骄傲！

choices.text: You didn't, you're only halfway up.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → You did it, I'm so proud of you!

npcLine.en: The view from up here is better than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 上面的视野比我预想的要好。

choices.text: It is, you can see the whole gym from there.
choices.zh: 确实是，在那儿能看到整个攀岩馆。

choices.text: It isn't, there's honestly nothing to look at.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, you can see the whole gym from there.

npcLine.en: Can you lean back and let the rope lower you down?
npcLine.zh: 你能往后靠，让绳子把你放下来吗？

choices.text: I can, here goes, trusting the rope.
choices.zh: 可以，来吧，我相信这根绳子。

choices.text: I can't, I'd rather just climb back down.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, here goes, trusting the rope.

transition.en: They also try bouldering on a shorter wall without ropes.
transition.zh: 他们还在一面无需保护绳的矮墙上尝试了抱石。

npcLine.en: This wall is shorter, but the moves look trickier.
npcLine.zh: 这面墙更矮，但动作看起来更棘手。

choices.text: That makes sense, shorter walls focus more on skill.
choices.zh: 有道理，矮墙更注重技巧本身。

choices.text: That's odd, shorter should always mean easier.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, shorter walls focus more on skill.

npcLine.en: There are crash pads below, so falling is safe.
npcLine.zh: 下面有防摔垫，所以掉下来也是安全的。

choices.text: Good to know, that makes this less scary.
choices.zh: 很高兴知道这个，这样感觉没那么可怕了。

choices.text: That's fine, falling never worries me at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good to know, that makes this less scary.

npcLine.en: Let's each try this route a few times.
npcLine.zh: 我们各自多试几次这条路线吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, practice should help a lot here.
choices.zh: 好啊，在这方面多练应该会很有帮助。

choices.text: Let's just try once and move on.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, practice should help a lot here.

transition.en: A few failed attempts turn into fits of laughter.
transition.zh: 几次失败的尝试变成了一阵阵大笑。

scenes.title: Falling and Laughing
scenes.subtitle: 攀岩馆 · 跌落与欢笑

npcLine.en: I just fell off that same spot for the third time!
npcLine.zh: 我又在同一个地方摔下来了，这已经是第三次了！

choices.text: That was hilarious, honestly, let's try once more.
choices.zh: 说实话那真的太搞笑了，我们再试一次吧。

choices.text: That was terrible, let's just give up now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That was hilarious, honestly, let's try once more.

npcLine.en: This is somehow more fun than I expected failing to be.
npcLine.zh: 不知怎么，失败居然比我预想的还要有趣。

choices.text: It really is, we're laughing more than climbing.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们笑的时间比爬的时间还多。

choices.text: It isn't, failing feels frustrating every time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, we're laughing more than climbing.

npcLine.en: Even when we fail, this is still a great time.
npcLine.zh: 即使我们失败了，这也依然是一段美好的时光。

choices.text: Even when we fail, I'm having a blast.
choices.zh: 即使失败了，我也玩得很开心。

choices.text: Even when we fail, I want to leave now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even when we fail, I'm having a blast.

transition.en: By the end of the session, both are pleasantly exhausted.
transition.zh: 课程结束时，两人都累得心满意足。

scenes.title: Sore but Happy
scenes.subtitle: 攀岩馆 · 疲惫又满足

npcLine.en: My forearms are more sore than they've ever been.
npcLine.zh: 我的前臂比以往任何时候都要酸痛。

choices.text: Mine too, but this was completely worth it.
choices.zh: 我也是，但这完全值得。

choices.text: Mine feel perfectly fine, actually.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Mine too, but this was completely worth it.

npcLine.en: This turned out more fun than I ever imagined.
npcLine.zh: 这次的效果比我想象的要有趣得多。

choices.text: It really did, we should make this a regular thing.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们应该把这变成常规活动。

choices.text: It really didn't, this was a waste of time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, we should make this a regular thing.

npcLine.en: Let's come back next weekend and try harder routes.
npcLine.zh: 我们下周末再来，试试更难的路线吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'm actually looking forward to it.
choices.zh: 好啊，我其实还挺期待的。

choices.text: Let's not, once was more than enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'm actually looking forward to it.

transition.en: Weeks later, climbing has become a regular part of their routine.
transition.zh: 几周后，攀岩已经成了他们日常生活的固定部分。

scenes.title: A New Shared Hobby
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 新的共同爱好

npcLine.en: We've gotten stronger than I ever expected this fast.
npcLine.zh: 我们变强的速度比我预想的要快得多。

choices.text: We really have, all that practice paid off.
choices.zh: 确实如此，所有的练习都有了回报。

choices.text: We really haven't, we've barely improved at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really have, all that practice paid off.

npcLine.en: This hobby has honestly brought us closer together.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，这项爱好真的让我们更亲近了。

choices.text: It really has, I love having a shared challenge.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很喜欢有一个共同的挑战。

choices.text: It hasn't, we barely spend time together climbing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really has, I love having a shared challenge.

npcLine.en: No matter what new challenge comes next, let's face it together.
npcLine.zh: 不管接下来有什么新挑战，我们都要一起面对。

choices.text: No matter what, together, always.
choices.zh: 无论如何，我们都在一起，永远如此。

choices.text: No matter what, we'll probably face it apart.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what, together, always.

transition.en: On a family day, they bring their toddler to a kids' climbing area.
transition.zh: 在一个家庭日，他们带孩子去了儿童攀爬区。

scenes.title: Teaching the Toddler to Climb
scenes.subtitle: 攀岩馆 · 教孩子攀爬

npcLine.en: Can you reach that low hold right there?
npcLine.zh: 你能够到那个低处的岩点吗？

choices.text: They can, look how proud they look already.
choices.zh: 他们能做到，看他们已经多骄傲了。

choices.text: They can't, they're far too small for this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → They can, look how proud they look already.

npcLine.en: They're more fearless up there than I ever was.
npcLine.zh: 他们在上面比我曾经要无畏得多。

choices.text: They really are, it's amazing to watch.
choices.zh: 确实如此，看着真是太棒了。

choices.text: They really aren't, they seem terrified up there.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, it's amazing to watch.

npcLine.en: This might just become a whole family hobby someday.
npcLine.zh: 这或许有一天会变成我们全家的共同爱好。

choices.text: I'd love that, honestly, more than anything.
choices.zh: 说实话，我非常希望如此。

choices.text: I doubt it, this is only for us adults.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I'd love that, honestly, more than anything.

transition.en: A group of old friends plans a night out at an escape room.
transition.zh: 一群老朋友计划去密室逃脱玩一晚上。

npcLine.en: Has anyone here done an escape room before?
npcLine.zh: 这里有人玩过密室逃脱吗？

choices.text: I've done one, years ago with coworkers.
choices.zh: 我几年前和同事玩过一次。

choices.text: I've never once heard of escape rooms before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've done one, years ago with coworkers.

npcLine.en: This one has a mystery theme with a sixty-minute limit.
npcLine.zh: 这一间是悬疑主题，限时六十分钟。

choices.text: That sounds thrilling, let's book six spots.
choices.zh: 听起来很刺激，我们订六个位子吧。

choices.text: That sounds boring, let's skip that theme.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That sounds thrilling, let's book six spots.

npcLine.en: Let's grab dinner beforehand too.
npcLine.zh: 我们提前一起去吃个晚饭吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it'll make the whole night special.
choices.zh: 好啊，这样能让整个晚上更特别。

choices.text: Let's skip dinner and just show up hungry.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it'll make the whole night special.

transition.en: The group arrives at a dimly lit escape room lobby.
transition.zh: 大家抵达了灯光昏暗的密室逃脱大堂。

scenes.title: Arriving at the Venue
scenes.subtitle: 密室逃脱馆 · 抵达现场

npcLine.en: This place feels spookier than I expected already.
npcLine.zh: 这地方比我预想的还要更阴森一些。

choices.text: It does, I love the atmosphere already.
choices.zh: 确实是，我已经很喜欢这种氛围了。

choices.text: It doesn't, this feels perfectly ordinary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I love the atmosphere already.

npcLine.en: You'll have sixty minutes once the door locks.
npcLine.zh: 门锁上之后，你们有六十分钟时间。

choices.text: Got it, we'll try to use every minute wisely.
choices.zh: 明白了，我们会尽量善用每一分钟。

choices.text: Got it, though sixty minutes should be plenty extra.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Got it, we'll try to use every minute wisely.

npcLine.en: Let's split into pairs to search different corners.
npcLine.zh: 我们分成两人一组，分头搜索不同的角落吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's cover more ground that way.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样能覆盖更多区域。

choices.text: Let's just all stand in one corner together.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's cover more ground that way.

transition.en: A hidden clue appears behind a bookshelf almost immediately.
transition.zh: 一条隐藏线索几乎立刻就出现在了书架后面。

npcLine.en: Can you read what's written on this piece of paper?
npcLine.zh: 你能读出这张纸上写的是什么吗？

choices.text: I can, it's a series of numbers.
choices.zh: 可以，是一串数字。

choices.text: I can't, the writing is completely invisible.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's a series of numbers.

npcLine.en: This clue is trickier than I expected right off the bat.
npcLine.zh: 这条线索一开始就比我预想的更棘手。

choices.text: It is, let's look at it from another angle.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们换个角度看看吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this seems way too obvious.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's look at it from another angle.

npcLine.en: Let's write down every number we find.
npcLine.zh: 我们找到的每一个数字都记下来吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's keep track on this notepad.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们用这个记事本记下来。

choices.text: Let's just try to remember everything by heart.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's keep track on this notepad.

transition.en: A locked drawer with a number pad blocks their next move.
transition.zh: 一个带密码锁的抽屉挡住了他们的下一步。

npcLine.en: What number should we try on this lock?
npcLine.zh: 我们应该在这把锁上试哪个数字？

choices.text: Let's try the numbers we found earlier.
choices.zh: 我们试试刚才找到的那些数字吧。

choices.text: Numbers don't matter, let's just guess randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Let's try the numbers we found earlier.

npcLine.en: That combination is wrong, but we're closer than before.
npcLine.zh: 这个组合是错的，但我们比之前更接近了。

choices.text: Let's rearrange the numbers and try again.
choices.zh: 我们把数字重新排列一下再试试吧。

choices.text: Let's just give up on this drawer entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's rearrange the numbers and try again.

npcLine.en: It clicked, we actually got it open!
npcLine.zh: 咔哒一声，我们真的把它打开了！

choices.text: We did it, that felt incredibly satisfying.
choices.zh: 我们做到了，感觉太有成就感了。

choices.text: We didn't, that lock is still completely stuck.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did it, that felt incredibly satisfying.

transition.en: With the clock ticking, everyone works faster together.
transition.zh: 随着时间流逝，大家一起加快了速度。

scenes.title: Teamwork Under Pressure
scenes.subtitle: 密室 · 高压下的团队合作

npcLine.en: We're working better together than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 我们合作得比我预想的要好。

choices.text: We really are, everyone's contributing something.
choices.zh: 确实如此，每个人都在贡献力量。

choices.text: We really aren't, everyone's working alone here.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really are, everyone's contributing something.

npcLine.en: This is more stressful with the timer counting down.
npcLine.zh: 看着计时器倒数，感觉压力更大了。

choices.text: It is, but the pressure is honestly kind of fun.
choices.zh: 确实是，但说实话这种压力挺有意思的。

choices.text: It isn't, the timer doesn't bother me at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but the pressure is honestly kind of fun.

npcLine.en: Let's check in with the other group for updates.
npcLine.zh: 我们跟另一组核对一下进展吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's shout over and compare notes.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们喊过去比对一下线索吧。

choices.text: Let's just ignore the other group entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's shout over and compare notes.

transition.en: One puzzle stumps the whole group for several long minutes.
transition.zh: 有一道谜题让全组人卡了好几分钟。

npcLine.en: I've been staring at this for five minutes with no idea.
npcLine.zh: 我盯着这个看了五分钟，完全没头绪。

choices.text: I've been just as stuck, let's think out loud together.
choices.zh: 我也一样卡住了，我们一起大声说出想法吧。

choices.text: I've never had trouble with anything like this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've been just as stuck, let's think out loud together.

npcLine.en: If we combine these two clues, it might make sense.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们把这两条线索结合起来，也许就说得通了。

choices.text: If that works, you're a genius, honestly.
choices.zh: 如果真的行，你真是天才，说真的。

choices.text: If that works, I'll never believe it.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that works, you're a genius, honestly.

npcLine.en: That's it, we finally cracked it!
npcLine.zh: 就是这样，我们终于解开了！

choices.text: We did it, everyone cheer for a second!
choices.zh: 我们做到了，大家一起欢呼一下吧！

choices.text: That's wrong, we're still completely stuck.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We did it, everyone cheer for a second!

transition.en: With ten minutes left, the pressure ramps up.
transition.zh: 还剩十分钟，压力骤然升高。

npcLine.en: We only have ten minutes left on the clock!
npcLine.zh: 我们只剩十分钟了！

choices.text: Then let's stay calm and focus on the last lock.
choices.zh: 那我们保持冷静，专注解开最后一把锁吧。

choices.text: Then let's just panic and run around randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Then let's stay calm and focus on the last lock.

npcLine.en: We're moving faster now than we were an hour ago.
npcLine.zh: 我们现在的速度比一小时前要快多了。

choices.text: We are, the pressure is bringing out our best.
choices.zh: 确实是，压力让我们发挥出了最好的水平。

choices.text: We aren't, we're actually slowing down now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We are, the pressure is bringing out our best.

npcLine.en: Can you hear that? The lock just clicked open!
npcLine.zh: 你听到了吗？锁刚咔哒一声开了！

choices.text: I can hear it, let's go, go, go!
choices.zh: 我听到了，快走快走快走！

choices.text: I can't hear anything, let's just wait here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can hear it, let's go, go, go!

transition.en: The door swings open with seconds to spare.
transition.zh: 门在最后几秒钟内打开了。

npcLine.en: We actually made it out with time to spare!
npcLine.zh: 我们真的赶在时间结束前逃出来了！

choices.text: We really did, I can't believe we pulled it off.
choices.zh: 确实做到了，真不敢相信我们成功了。

choices.text: We didn't, we ran out of time completely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We really did, I can't believe we pulled it off.

npcLine.en: This felt more rewarding than I expected an escape room to be.
npcLine.zh: 这次的成就感比我预想的密室逃脱要强得多。

choices.text: It really did, teamwork made it so much better.
choices.zh: 确实如此，团队合作让一切都变得更棒了。

choices.text: It really didn't, this felt pretty forgettable.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, teamwork made it so much better.

npcLine.en: Let's take a group photo before we leave.
npcLine.zh: 走之前我们拍张合照吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this moment deserves a photo.
choices.zh: 好啊，这一刻值得拍照留念。

choices.text: Let's skip it, photos never matter much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this moment deserves a photo.

transition.en: The group heads to a nearby bar to recap the whole experience.
transition.zh: 大家去了附近一家酒吧，回顾整段经历。

npcLine.en: Which clue confused you the most tonight?
npcLine.zh: 今晚哪条线索让你最困惑？

choices.text: Honestly, that locked drawer nearly broke me.
choices.zh: 说实话，那个上锁的抽屉差点把我逼疯了。

choices.text: Nothing confused me at all tonight, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答经历 → Honestly, that locked drawer nearly broke me.

npcLine.en: We worked together better tonight than any group I've been in.
npcLine.zh: 今晚我们的配合比我参加过的任何一组都要好。

choices.text: That means a lot, we make a great team.
choices.zh: 这话意义重大，我们真是个很棒的团队。

choices.text: That's odd, tonight felt pretty disorganized to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That means a lot, we make a great team.

npcLine.en: We should try a harder room next time.
npcLine.zh: 我们下次应该挑战一个更难的密室。

choices.text: Absolutely, let's find the hardest one in the city.
choices.zh: 当然，我们找这座城市里最难的那间吧。

choices.text: Absolutely not, this one was already too hard.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Absolutely, let's find the hardest one in the city.

transition.en: Driving home, they reflect on a fun, memorable night with friends.
transition.zh: 开车回家的路上，他们回味着和朋友们度过的有趣又难忘的一晚。

npcLine.en: Tonight was more fun than I've had in a long time.
npcLine.zh: 今晚是我很长时间以来玩得最开心的一次。

choices.text: It really was, nights like this remind me why we do this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，像这样的夜晚让我想起我们为什么要这样做。

choices.text: It really wasn't, tonight felt pretty ordinary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really was, nights like this remind me why we do this.

npcLine.en: We should make time for friends like this more often.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该更经常抽出时间和朋友们这样聚聚。

choices.text: Agreed, life gets busy, but this matters too.
choices.zh: 同意，生活很忙，但这件事也很重要。

choices.text: Disagreed, our current schedule is already perfect.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, life gets busy, but this matters too.

npcLine.en: No matter how busy things get, let's keep making memories like this.
npcLine.zh: 不管生活多忙，我们都要继续创造这样的回忆。

choices.text: No matter how busy, this is always worth it.
choices.zh: 不管多忙，这永远都值得。

choices.text: No matter how busy, we'll probably stop doing this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how busy, this is always worth it.

transition.en: They stumble upon a farmers market while out for a walk.
transition.zh: 散步时他们偶然发现了一个农夫市集。

npcLine.en: Did you know this market was here every Saturday?
npcLine.zh: 你知道这个市集每周六都在这儿吗？

choices.text: I had no idea, this is a happy surprise.
choices.zh: 我完全不知道，这真是个惊喜。

choices.text: Yes, I've known about it for years already.

n1.hintOnWrong: 否定回答（补充信息） → I had no idea, this is a happy surprise.

npcLine.en: This produce looks fresher than what we get at the store.
npcLine.zh: 这些农产品看起来比我们平常在超市买的要新鲜。

choices.text: It does, let's start shopping here on weekends.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们周末就来这儿买菜吧。

choices.text: It doesn't, the store produce always looks better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's start shopping here on weekends.

npcLine.en: Let's walk through and see what everyone's selling.
npcLine.zh: 我们逛一圈，看看大家都在卖什么吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's take our time exploring.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们慢慢逛吧。

choices.text: Let's just buy from the first stall we see.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's take our time exploring.

transition.en: A friendly farmer offers them a sample of ripe strawberries.
transition.zh: 一位友善的农户给他们递上了成熟草莓的试吃。

scenes.title: Meeting a Local Farmer
scenes.subtitle: 摊位 · 认识本地农户

npcLine.en: Would you like to try a sample before buying?
npcLine.zh: 购买前要不要先试吃一下？

choices.text: Yes, please, that would be lovely.
choices.zh: 好的，麻烦您了，那太好了。

choices.text: No, samples always taste terrible anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Yes, please, that would be lovely.

npcLine.en: These are sweeter than any strawberries I've ever had.
npcLine.zh: 这些草莓比我吃过的任何草莓都要甜。

choices.text: They really are, we'll take two baskets.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们要两篮。

choices.text: They're not sweet at all, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, we'll take two baskets.

npcLine.en: I grow everything myself on a small farm nearby.
npcLine.zh: 这些都是我在附近一个小农场自己种的。

choices.text: That's wonderful, we love supporting local farmers.
choices.zh: 太棒了，我们很乐意支持本地农户。

choices.text: That's odd, we assumed everything came from far away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's wonderful, we love supporting local farmers.

transition.en: They pull out their reusable bags to fill with produce.
transition.zh: 他们拿出自带的环保袋来装农产品。

scenes.title: Shopping with Reusable Bags
scenes.subtitle: 市集 · 用环保袋购物

npcLine.en: Did you remember to bring the reusable bags?
npcLine.zh: 你记得带环保袋了吗？

choices.text: Yes, they're right here in my backpack.
choices.zh: 带了，就在我的背包里。
