choices.text: No, we've never once used reusable bags.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, they're right here in my backpack.

npcLine.en: This bag holds more than the plastic ones we used to use.
npcLine.zh: 这个袋子比我们以前用的塑料袋能装更多东西。

choices.text: It does, and it's sturdier too.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且也更结实。

choices.text: It doesn't, plastic bags always held more.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, and it's sturdier too.

npcLine.en: Let's grab tomatoes, peppers, and some greens.
npcLine.zh: 我们买点西红柿、辣椒和一些绿叶菜吧。

choices.text: Good list, let's find those stalls now.
choices.zh: 好清单，我们现在就去找那些摊位吧。

choices.text: Let's just buy random things instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good list, let's find those stalls now.

transition.en: A vendor introduces them to a vegetable they've never seen.
transition.zh: 一位摊主给他们介绍了一种从未见过的蔬菜。

npcLine.en: Have either of you ever cooked with kohlrabi before?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩有人用大头菜做过菜吗？

choices.text: Neither of us has, but we're curious to try.
choices.zh: 我们俩都没有，但很想尝试一下。

choices.text: Both of us have cooked it for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → Neither of us has, but we're curious to try.

npcLine.en: This vegetable is milder than you might expect.
npcLine.zh: 这种蔬菜的味道比你想的要清淡。

choices.text: Good to know, we'll grab a couple then.
choices.zh: 很高兴知道这个，那我们就买几个吧。

choices.text: Taste doesn't matter, let's skip it entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Good to know, we'll grab a couple then.

npcLine.en: Let's look up a recipe for it when we get home.
npcLine.zh: 我们到家后查一下它的做法吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this could become a new favorite.
choices.zh: 好啊，这说不定会成为我们的新宠。

choices.text: Let's just throw it in the fridge and forget it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'm actually excited to try it.

transition.en: A stall selling local honey catches their attention.
transition.zh: 一个卖本地蜂蜜的摊位吸引了他们的注意。

npcLine.en: This honey comes from bees just outside the city.
npcLine.zh: 这些蜂蜜来自城市郊外的蜜蜂。

choices.text: That's fascinating, we'd love to support that.
choices.zh: 这真有意思，我们很乐意支持这个。

choices.text: That's boring, honey is honey everywhere.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's fascinating, we'd love to support that.

npcLine.en: This jar is bigger than the one we bought last time.
npcLine.zh: 这罐比我们上次买的要大。

choices.text: Let's get the bigger jar, it'll last longer.
choices.zh: 我们买大罐的吧，能用更久。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's just grab any one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's get the bigger jar, it'll last longer.

npcLine.en: Can I try a taste before deciding?
npcLine.zh: 我能先尝一下再决定吗？

choices.text: Of course, here's a little spoon for you.
choices.zh: 当然可以，这是给您的小勺子。

choices.text: No, tasting isn't allowed at this stall.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/许可 → Of course, here's a little spoon for you.

transition.en: Their toddler wanders over to a small flower stand.
transition.zh: 他们的孩子走到了一个小花摊前。

npcLine.en: Which flower do you want to bring home?
npcLine.zh: 你想带哪朵花回家？

choices.text: They're pointing at the biggest sunflower.
choices.zh: 他们正指着那朵最大的向日葵。

choices.text: They don't want any flowers at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → They're pointing at the biggest sunflower.

npcLine.en: This sunflower is taller than they are!
npcLine.zh: 这朵向日葵比他们还要高！

choices.text: It really is, that's such a funny sight.
choices.zh: 确实是，这画面真有趣。

choices.text: It really isn't, this flower is quite short.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, that's such a funny sight.

npcLine.en: Let's put this in a vase when we get home.
npcLine.zh: 我们回家后把它插到花瓶里吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it'll brighten up the kitchen.
choices.zh: 好啊，这样厨房会更明亮。

choices.text: Let's just leave it in the car instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it'll brighten up the kitchen.

transition.en: The smell of fresh bread pulls them toward a bakery stand.
transition.zh: 新鲜面包的香气把他们吸引到了一个烘焙摊位。

npcLine.en: This bread was baked earlier than most, just this morning.
npcLine.zh: 这面包比大多数烤得更早，今天早上刚出炉的。

choices.text: That's exciting, let's grab a loaf while it's fresh.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们趁新鲜买一条吧。

choices.text: That doesn't matter, freshness never really matters.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's exciting, let's grab a loaf while it's fresh.

npcLine.en: Do you have anything without gluten?
npcLine.zh: 您有无麸质的面包吗？

choices.text: Yes, we have a gluten-free option over here.
choices.zh: 有的，这边有一款无麸质的可以选。

choices.text: No, everything here contains gluten, sorry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, we have a gluten-free option over here.

npcLine.en: This will be gone by lunchtime, it always sells out fast.
npcLine.zh: 这个到午饭时间就会卖完了，一直卖得很快。

choices.text: Let's grab two loaves then, just to be safe.
choices.zh: 那我们买两条吧，保险起见。

choices.text: That's fine, we'll come back tomorrow instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来时 → Let's grab two loaves then, just to be safe.

transition.en: By their third visit, the vendors already recognize them.
transition.zh: 第三次来的时候，摊主们已经认识他们了。

npcLine.en: Back again this week, I see!
npcLine.zh: 这周又来啦，我看到了！

choices.text: We're becoming regulars, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我们已经算是常客了。

choices.text: We're never coming back after this.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → We're becoming regulars, honestly.

npcLine.en: This little one has grown taller since we last saw them.
npcLine.zh: 这个小家伙比我们上次见到时长高了。

choices.text: They really have, it happens so fast.
choices.zh: 确实是，长得真快。

choices.text: They really haven't, they look exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really have, it happens so fast.

npcLine.en: It's nice to be recognized somewhere like this.
npcLine.zh: 在这样的地方被认出来感觉真好。

choices.text: It really is, this feels like a real community.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这感觉像是一个真正的社区。

choices.text: It doesn't matter, being recognized feels awkward.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, this feels like a real community.

transition.en: Back home, they cook dinner using everything they bought.
transition.zh: 回到家后，他们用买来的所有食材做了晚餐。

scenes.title: Cooking with the Haul
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 用战利品做饭

npcLine.en: Everything in this meal came from the market today.
npcLine.zh: 今天这顿饭的所有食材都来自市集。

choices.text: That's amazing, this feels extra special somehow.
choices.zh: 太棒了，不知怎么这感觉格外特别。

choices.text: That's odd, none of this tastes any different.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That's amazing, this feels extra special somehow.

npcLine.en: This meal tastes fresher than anything from a grocery store.
npcLine.zh: 这顿饭吃起来比任何超市买的都要新鲜。

choices.text: It really does, you can taste the difference.
choices.zh: 确实如此，能尝出来这种差别。

choices.text: It doesn't, everything tastes exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, you can taste the difference.

npcLine.en: Let's make this a Saturday tradition for our family.
npcLine.zh: 我们把这变成我们家的周六传统吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I already love this routine.
choices.zh: 好啊，我已经很喜欢这个日常了。

choices.text: Let's not, once was already enough for us.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I already love this routine.

transition.en: Weeks later, the market has become the highlight of their weekend.
transition.zh: 几周后，市集已经成了他们周末的重头戏。

scenes.title: A New Saturday Ritual
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 新的周六仪式

npcLine.en: Saturdays have become more meaningful than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 周六变得比我预想的更有意义。

choices.text: They really have, and I look forward to them now.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我现在很期待周六。

choices.text: They haven't, Saturdays feel exactly the same.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really have, and I look forward to them now.

npcLine.en: We've built such a nice little routine as a family.
npcLine.zh: 我们全家建立了一个非常好的小小惯例。

choices.text: We really have, and I hope it lasts for years.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我希望这能持续很多年。

choices.text: We really haven't, our weekends still feel messy.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We really have, and I hope it lasts for years.

npcLine.en: No matter how life changes, let's keep our Saturday mornings like this.
npcLine.zh: 不管生活怎么变化，我们都要保持这样的周六早晨。

choices.text: No matter what, this ritual is worth keeping.
choices.zh: 不管怎样，这个仪式都值得坚持下去。

choices.text: No matter what, we'll probably drop this eventually.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what, this ritual is worth keeping.

transition.en: A flyer about hosting an exchange student catches their eye.
transition.zh: 一张关于接待交换生的传单引起了他们的注意。

npcLine.en: Have you ever thought about hosting a student?
npcLine.zh: 你有没有想过接待一位学生？

choices.text: I've actually thought about it before, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我以前其实想过这件事。

choices.text: I've never once considered anything like that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've actually thought about it before, honestly.

npcLine.en: This program places students for a whole semester.
npcLine.zh: 这个项目会安排学生待一整个学期。

choices.text: That's a real commitment, but a good one.
choices.zh: 这确实是个不小的承诺，但也是件好事。

choices.text: That's way too long, let's forget about this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's a real commitment, but a good one.

npcLine.en: Let's fill out the interest form and see what happens.
npcLine.zh: 我们填一下意向表，看看结果如何吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, there's no harm in asking.
choices.zh: 好啊，问问也无妨。

choices.text: Let's not, this seems too complicated to try.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, there's no harm in asking.

transition.en: A program coordinator visits to interview the family.
transition.zh: 一位项目协调员上门对这个家庭进行面谈。

npcLine.en: Why do you want to host a student?
npcLine.zh: 你们为什么想接待一位学生？

choices.text: We want our child to grow up seeing different cultures.
choices.zh: 我们希望孩子能从小接触不同的文化。

choices.text: We don't actually want to host anyone, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答理由 → We want our child to grow up seeing different cultures.

npcLine.en: Do you have a spare bedroom available?
npcLine.zh: 你们有多余的卧室可以用吗？

choices.text: Yes, we have a small guest room ready.
choices.zh: 有的，我们有一间准备好的小客房。

choices.text: No, we don't have any extra space at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, we have a small guest room ready.

npcLine.en: We'll match you with a student in the next few weeks.
npcLine.zh: 我们会在接下来几周内给你们匹配一位学生。

choices.text: Wonderful, we'll start getting the room ready.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们开始准备房间吧。

choices.text: Wonderful, though we'd rather wait indefinitely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → Wonderful, we'll start getting the room ready.

transition.en: They set up the guest room for their future student.
transition.zh: 他们为未来的学生布置了客房。

npcLine.en: Should we add a small desk for studying?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要加一张学习用的小书桌？

choices.text: Yes, let's make sure they have space to work.
choices.zh: 好，我们确保他们有学习的空间。

choices.text: No, students never actually need to study.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's make sure they have space to work.

npcLine.en: This room feels warmer now than it did empty.
npcLine.zh: 这间屋子现在比空着的时候感觉更温馨了。

choices.text: It does, I hope they feel welcome here.
choices.zh: 确实是，希望他们在这儿感觉受欢迎。

choices.text: It doesn't, this room still feels cold to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I hope they feel welcome here.

npcLine.en: Let's leave a small welcome note on the pillow.
npcLine.zh: 我们在枕头上留一张小小的欢迎卡吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it's a nice personal touch.
choices.zh: 好啊，这是个不错的贴心细节。

choices.text: Let's skip that, notes seem unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it's a nice personal touch.

transition.en: A nervous but excited student arrives from overseas.
transition.zh: 一位既紧张又兴奋的学生从海外抵达了。

npcLine.en: You must be exhausted after such a long flight.
npcLine.zh: 经过这么长的飞行，你一定很累了。

choices.text: I am, but I'm also really excited to be here.
choices.zh: 确实很累，但我也非常兴奋能来到这里。

choices.text: I'm not tired at all, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I am, but I'm also really excited to be here.

npcLine.en: Do you have any questions before we head home?
npcLine.zh: 回家之前你有什么问题吗？

choices.text: Just one, how far is your house from here?
choices.zh: 就一个，你们家离这儿有多远？

choices.text: No, I already know absolutely everything.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答（补充问题） → Just one, how far is your house from here?

npcLine.en: Welcome, we're really happy to have you with us.
npcLine.zh: 欢迎你，我们很高兴你能和我们在一起。

choices.text: Thank you so much for having me.
choices.zh: 非常感谢你们愿意接待我。

choices.text: Thank you, though I'd rather stay in a hotel.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Thank you so much for having me.

transition.en: They gently walk through a few basic house rules.
transition.zh: 他们温和地讲解了几条基本的家规。

npcLine.en: Please let us know if you'll be home late.
npcLine.zh: 如果你会晚回家，请提前告诉我们一声。

choices.text: Of course, I'll always send a message.
choices.zh: 当然，我会一直发消息告知的。

choices.text: Sorry, sending messages seems too complicated.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, I'll always send a message.

npcLine.en: Feel free to treat the kitchen like it's your own.
npcLine.zh: 厨房你随便用，就当是自己家的一样。

choices.text: Thank you, that makes me feel really welcome.
choices.zh: 谢谢，这让我感觉非常受欢迎。

choices.text: Thank you, though I'd rather never cook here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Thank you, that makes me feel really welcome.

npcLine.en: If anything ever feels wrong, please just tell us.
npcLine.zh: 如果有任何事让你觉得不对劲，请一定告诉我们。

choices.text: If that happens, I promise I'll speak up.
choices.zh: 如果真发生了，我保证会说出来。

choices.text: If that happens, I'll just keep it to myself.

n3.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that happens, I promise I'll speak up.

transition.en: The student offers to cook a dish from their home country.
transition.zh: 学生主动提出要做一道家乡菜。

npcLine.en: Would you like to try one of my favorite dishes?
npcLine.zh: 你们想尝尝我最喜欢的一道菜吗？

choices.text: We'd love that, we're excited to try it.
choices.zh: 我们很乐意，很期待尝一尝。

choices.text: We'd rather not, new food seems risky.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We'd love that, we're excited to try it.

npcLine.en: This dish is spicier than anything we usually cook.
npcLine.zh: 这道菜比我们平时做的任何菜都要辣。

choices.text: That's exciting, we love trying new flavors.
choices.zh: 太棒了，我们喜欢尝试新的口味。

choices.text: That's concerning, spicy food scares us.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's exciting, we love trying new flavors.

npcLine.en: This is honestly better than any restaurant version I've had.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，这比我吃过的任何餐厅版本都要好吃。

choices.text: That means so much, thank you for sharing this.
choices.zh: 这句话意义重大，谢谢你分享这道菜。

choices.text: That's odd, restaurant food is always better.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That means so much, thank you for sharing this.

transition.en: One quiet evening, the student seems a little homesick.
transition.zh: 一个安静的夜晚，学生看起来有点想家。

npcLine.en: Are you feeling okay tonight?
npcLine.zh: 你今晚还好吗？

choices.text: I'm okay, just missing my family a little.
choices.zh: 我还好，就是有点想家人了。

choices.text: I'm not okay, I want to leave right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I'm okay, just missing my family a little.

npcLine.en: Missing home is more normal than you might think.
npcLine.zh: 想家其实比你想的要更普遍。

choices.text: That's reassuring, thank you for understanding.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，谢谢你的理解。

choices.text: That's odd, I thought I was the only one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's reassuring, thank you for understanding.

npcLine.en: Let's call your family together, if that would help.
npcLine.zh: 如果有帮助的话，我们一起给你家人打个电话吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, that would mean so much to me.
choices.zh: 好啊，这对我意义重大。

choices.text: Let's not, I'd rather not talk to them right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, that would mean so much to me.

transition.en: Weeks later, the student feels like part of the family.
transition.zh: 几周后，学生已经感觉像家里的一员了。

npcLine.en: I've started calling this place home, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，我已经开始把这里当成家了。

choices.text: That means everything to us, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，这句话对我们意义非凡。

choices.text: That's strange, this isn't your real home.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时回应 → That means everything to us, honestly.

npcLine.en: Our little one has become more attached to you than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 我们家小家伙对你的依恋比我预想的要深。

choices.text: That's so sweet, I've grown attached too.
choices.zh: 这真是太温馨了，我也变得很依恋他们。

choices.text: That's odd, kids never really bond with guests.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's so sweet, I've grown attached too.

npcLine.en: This house feels more complete with you in it.
npcLine.zh: 有了你，这个家感觉更完整了。

choices.text: That's such a kind thing to say, thank you.
choices.zh: 你这样说真是太贴心了，谢谢你。

choices.text: That's not true, nothing has changed here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's such a kind thing to say, thank you.

transition.en: At the end of the semester, it's time to say goodbye.
transition.zh: 学期结束了，到了道别的时候。

npcLine.en: This goodbye is harder than I ever thought it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这次道别比我曾经想象的要难得多。

choices.text: It really is, we've grown so close to you.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们和你已经变得非常亲近。

choices.text: It really isn't, goodbyes have never mattered to us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, we've grown so close to you.

npcLine.en: Thank you for treating me like your own family.
npcLine.zh: 谢谢你们把我当成自己的家人。

choices.text: Of course, you'll always be part of ours.
choices.zh: 当然了，你永远是我们家的一员。

choices.text: Of course, though you were never really family.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应 → Of course, you'll always be part of ours.

npcLine.en: We'll stay in touch no matter how far apart we are.
npcLine.zh: 不管相隔多远，我们都会保持联系。

choices.text: No matter the distance, we'll always be family.
choices.zh: 不管距离多远，我们永远都是一家人。

choices.text: No matter the distance, we'll probably lose touch.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter the distance, we'll always be family.

transition.en: That night, they reflect on how the experience changed them all.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们感慨这段经历如何改变了全家人。

scenes.title: A Changed Family
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 改变了的一家人

npcLine.en: We've learned more from this than I ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 我们从这段经历中学到的比我预想的要多得多。

choices.text: We really have, this changed how we see the world.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这改变了我们看待世界的方式。

choices.text: We really haven't, nothing much changed for us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really have, this changed how we see the world.

npcLine.en: Our child will grow up remembering this whole experience.
npcLine.zh: 我们的孩子长大后会一直记得这整段经历。

choices.text: They will, and I hope it shapes who they become.
choices.zh: 他们会的，我希望这能塑造他们成为的样子。

choices.text: They won't, they're too young to remember any of it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应未来计划 → They will, and I hope it shapes who they become.

npcLine.en: No matter where life takes any of us, this connection will remain.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们各自的人生走向哪里，这份牵绊都会留存下去。

choices.text: No matter where life takes us, we're grateful for this.
choices.zh: 不管人生走向哪里，我们都感激这段经历。

choices.text: No matter where life takes us, this will be forgotten.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter where life takes us, we're grateful for this.

transition.en: A neighbor mentions a hobby called geocaching that uses GPS.
transition.zh: 一位邻居提到一种用GPS的爱好，叫地理藏宝。

npcLine.en: Have you ever heard of geocaching before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前听说过地理藏宝吗？

choices.text: I've never heard of it, but it sounds fun.
choices.zh: 我从没听过，不过听起来挺有意思的。

choices.text: I've done this every single day for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never heard of it, but it sounds fun.

npcLine.en: People hide small containers, and you find them using coordinates.
npcLine.zh: 大家会藏小容器，你用坐标去寻找它们。

choices.text: That sounds like a real-life treasure hunt.
choices.zh: 这听起来像是现实版的寻宝游戏。

choices.text: That sounds pointless, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That sounds like a real-life treasure hunt.

npcLine.en: Let's download the app and try one this weekend.
npcLine.zh: 我们下载这个应用，这周末试一次吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'm actually curious now.
choices.zh: 好啊，我现在其实挺好奇的。

choices.text: Let's not, this seems too complicated to try.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'm actually curious now.

transition.en: They browse the app for a beginner-friendly cache nearby.
transition.zh: 他们在应用上寻找一个附近适合初学者的藏宝点。

scenes.title: Picking the First Cache
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 挑选第一个藏宝点

npcLine.en: This one is closer than the others on the list.
npcLine.zh: 这个比清单上其他的要近。

choices.text: Let's start with that one, it's convenient.
choices.zh: 我们从这个开始吧，比较方便。

choices.text: Distance doesn't matter, let's pick the farthest one.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's start with that one, it's convenient.

npcLine.en: This difficulty level looks easier than the others.
npcLine.zh: 这个难度看起来比其他的要简单。

choices.text: Perfect, let's start easy for our first try.
choices.zh: 太好了，我们第一次先从简单的开始吧。

choices.text: Let's skip the easy ones, we want a challenge.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Perfect, let's start easy for our first try.

npcLine.en: Let's pack a small trinket to leave behind, too.
npcLine.zh: 我们也带上一个小玩意儿留在那儿吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that's part of the fun, apparently.
choices.zh: 好主意，据说这也是乐趣的一部分。

choices.text: Let's not bother, we'll just take without giving.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that's part of the fun, apparently.

transition.en: They walk through a park, phone in hand, following the GPS arrow.
transition.zh: 他们穿过公园，手拿手机跟着GPS箭头走。

npcLine.en: The arrow says we're getting closer!
npcLine.zh: 箭头显示我们越来越近了！

choices.text: We're almost there, let's keep going!
choices.zh: 我们快到了，继续走吧！

choices.text: We're getting farther away, let's turn back.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → We're almost there, let's keep going!

npcLine.en: This park is bigger than I remembered it being.
npcLine.zh: 这个公园比我记忆中的要大。

choices.text: It is, there's more to explore than I thought.
choices.zh: 确实是，能探索的地方比我想的要多。

choices.text: It isn't, this park feels tiny to me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, there's more to explore than I thought.

npcLine.en: Can you check the hint if we get stuck?
npcLine.zh: 如果我们卡住了，你能查一下提示吗？

choices.text: I can, let's use it only if we're desperate.
choices.zh: 可以，只有真没办法了才用它吧。

choices.text: I can't, hints seem like cheating to me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let's use it only if we're desperate.

transition.en: The GPS points them to a suspicious cluster of rocks near a tree.
transition.zh: GPS指向了一棵树旁边一堆可疑的石头。

npcLine.en: This spot looks more promising than anywhere else.
npcLine.zh: 这个地方比其他任何地方都更有希望。

choices.text: It does, let's search this area carefully.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们仔细搜索这片区域吧。

choices.text: It doesn't, let's just wander off randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's search this area carefully.

npcLine.en: These caches are often hidden more cleverly than you'd expect.
npcLine.zh: 这些藏宝点隐藏的方式通常比你想的要巧妙。

choices.text: That makes sense, let's check under things too.
choices.zh: 有道理，我们也检查一下东西下面吧。

choices.text: That's odd, hiding spots should always be obvious.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, let's check under things too.

npcLine.en: Wait, this rock feels lighter than a real rock should.
npcLine.zh: 等等，这块石头感觉比真石头要轻。

choices.text: That's it, this must be a fake rock container.
choices.zh: 就是这个，这肯定是个假石头容器。

choices.text: That's normal, all rocks feel exactly the same.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's it, this must be a fake rock container.

transition.en: Inside, they find a small logbook and a handful of tiny trinkets.
transition.zh: 打开容器，他们发现了一本小日志和一把小玩意儿。

npcLine.en: We actually found it, I can't believe this!
npcLine.zh: 我们真的找到了，我简直不敢相信！

choices.text: We did it, this feels incredible!
choices.zh: 我们做到了，这感觉太棒了！

choices.text: We didn't, this container is completely empty.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did it, this feels incredible!

npcLine.en: Should we sign the logbook before we leave?
npcLine.zh: 我们走之前要不要在日志上签名？

choices.text: Yes, let's write today's date and our names.
choices.zh: 好的，我们写上今天的日期和名字吧。

choices.text: No, signing seems unnecessary for this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's write today's date and our names.

npcLine.en: Let's leave our small trinket and take one to trade.
npcLine.zh: 我们留下自己带的小玩意儿，换一个带走吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, trading is part of the tradition.
choices.zh: 好啊，交换是这个活动传统的一部分。

choices.text: Let's just take everything and leave nothing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, trading is part of the tradition.

transition.en: Their toddler squeals with delight at finding the hidden box.
transition.zh: 他们的孩子发现藏宝盒后兴奋得尖叫起来。

npcLine.en: They're more excited about this than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 他们对这个的兴奋程度比我预想的要高。

choices.text: They really are, treasure hunts are magical at this age.
choices.zh: 确实如此，寻宝游戏在这个年纪真的很神奇。

choices.text: They really aren't, they seem completely bored.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, treasure hunts are magical at this age.

npcLine.en: Can you pick out a trinket to keep for yourself?
npcLine.zh: 你能挑一个小玩意儿留给自己吗？

choices.text: They can, watch how carefully they're choosing.
choices.zh: 他们能做到，看他们选得多认真。

choices.text: They can't, they're too young to choose anything.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → They can, watch how carefully they're choosing.

npcLine.en: This might become their new favorite family activity.
npcLine.zh: 这可能会成为他们新的最爱的家庭活动。

choices.text: I hope so, this feels like a keeper.
choices.zh: 我希望如此，这个活动感觉值得保留。

choices.text: I doubt it, this will get boring fast.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I hope so, this feels like a keeper.

transition.en: Their second cache of the day proves much harder to find.
transition.zh: 当天的第二个藏宝点找起来困难多了。

scenes.title: A Trickier Hunt
scenes.subtitle: 公园 · 更棘手的搜寻

npcLine.en: This one is definitely harder than the last cache.
npcLine.zh: 这一个肯定比上一个藏宝点要难。

choices.text: It is, but that makes it more satisfying.
choices.zh: 确实如此，但这样找到会更有成就感。

choices.text: It is, so let's just give up right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but that makes it more satisfying.

npcLine.en: If we reread the hint, we might find a clue we missed.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们重新读一遍提示，也许能发现漏掉的线索。

choices.text: If that helps, let's read it together carefully.
choices.zh: 如果有帮助，我们一起仔细读一遍吧。

choices.text: If that helps, let's just skip reading it entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that helps, let's read it together carefully.

npcLine.en: There it is, hidden inside a hollow branch!
npcLine.zh: 找到了，藏在一根中空的树枝里！

choices.text: That was clever, I never would have guessed.
choices.zh: 这想法太巧妙了，我绝对猜不到。

choices.text: That was obvious, anyone could have found it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That was clever, I never would have guessed.

transition.en: Back home, they log their finds on the app for other players.
transition.zh: 回家后，他们在应用上记录了自己的发现，供其他玩家参考。

npcLine.en: Should we leave a note about how we found each cache?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要留言说明是怎么找到每个藏宝点的？

choices.text: Yes, that might help the next person who searches.
choices.zh: 好，这可能对下一位来寻找的人有帮助。

choices.text: No, other players never actually read those notes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that might help the next person who searches.

npcLine.en: We found two caches today, more than I expected for our first try.
npcLine.zh: 我们今天找到了两个藏宝点，比我预想的第一次成果要多。

choices.text: That's a great start, I'm really proud of us.
choices.zh: 这是个很好的开始，我为我们感到骄傲。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we expected to find at least ten.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's a great start, I'm really proud of us.

npcLine.en: Let's mark our favorite spots to visit again.
npcLine.zh: 我们把喜欢的地点标记出来，下次再来吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's save this park for sure.
choices.zh: 好主意，这个公园我们一定要保存起来。

choices.text: Let's just forget where we went entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's save this park for sure.

transition.en: Over the following weeks, geocaching leads them to hidden corners of the city.
transition.zh: 接下来的几周里，地理藏宝带他们发现了城市里许多隐秘的角落。

scenes.title: A New Way to Explore
scenes.subtitle: 城市各处 · 全新的探索方式

npcLine.en: We've discovered more hidden spots than we ever knew existed.
npcLine.zh: 我们发现的隐秘地点比我们曾经知道的要多得多。

choices.text: We really have, this city feels new again.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这座城市感觉焕然一新了。

choices.text: We really haven't, we've found absolutely nothing.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really have, this city feels new again.

npcLine.en: This hobby has honestly become better than I ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，这个爱好变得比我曾经预想的要好得多。

choices.text: It really has, I look forward to it every week.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我每周都很期待。

choices.text: It hasn't, this feels boring most of the time.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really has, I look forward to it every week.

npcLine.en: No matter how many caches we find, the search itself is the real fun.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们找到多少藏宝点，寻找的过程本身才是真正的乐趣所在。

choices.text: No matter how many, the adventure matters most.
choices.zh: 不管有多少，这段冒险本身才最重要。

choices.text: No matter how many, only the number really counts.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many, the adventure matters most.

transition.en: Inspired, they decide to hide their own cache for others to find.
transition.zh: 受到启发，他们决定自己藏一个宝，让其他人来寻找。

scenes.title: Hiding Their Own Cache
scenes.subtitle: 公园 · 藏下属于自己的宝藏

npcLine.en: Where should we hide our first cache?
npcLine.zh: 我们的第一个藏宝点应该藏在哪儿？

choices.text: Somewhere near the bench by the old oak tree.
choices.zh: 就藏在老橡树旁边的长椅附近吧。

choices.text: It doesn't matter, let's hide it in our house.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Somewhere near the bench by the old oak tree.

npcLine.en: This container should be sturdier than a simple box.
npcLine.zh: 这个容器应该比一个简单的盒子更结实。

choices.text: You're right, let's use a waterproof one instead.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我们改用一个防水的吧。

choices.text: Durability doesn't matter, any old box will do.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → You're right, let's use a waterproof one instead.

npcLine.en: Let's give it a fun, mysterious name.
npcLine.zh: 我们给它起个有趣又神秘的名字吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this part is honestly the funnest.
choices.zh: 好啊，说实话这部分最好玩了。

choices.text: Let's just call it something boring and plain.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this part is honestly the funnest.

transition.en: A steady drip from the kitchen faucet keeps them up at night.
transition.zh: 厨房水龙头持续的滴水声让他们晚上睡不着。

scenes.title: The Dripping Faucet
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 滴水的水龙头

npcLine.en: That dripping sound is driving me crazy.
npcLine.zh: 那个滴水声快把我逼疯了。

choices.text: Same here, we need to fix this soon.
choices.zh: 我也是，我们得尽快修一下这个。

choices.text: That's fine, the sound doesn't bother me at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Same here, we need to fix this soon.

npcLine.en: Should we call a plumber, or should we try it ourselves?
npcLine.zh: 我们要请水管工，还是自己试试？

choices.text: Let's try it ourselves first, how hard can it be?
choices.zh: 我们先自己试试吧，能有多难呢？

choices.text: Let's just call someone without even trying.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答（补充建议） → Let's try it ourselves first, how hard can it be?

npcLine.en: Let's watch a video and see what tools we need.
npcLine.zh: 我们看个视频，看看需要哪些工具吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's search for one right now.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们现在就搜一下。

choices.text: Let's just guess and hope for the best.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's search for one right now.

transition.en: They dig through a toolbox looking for the right tools.
transition.zh: 他们翻找工具箱，寻找合适的工具。

npcLine.en: What tools do we actually need for this?
npcLine.zh: 我们实际上需要哪些工具？

choices.text: A wrench, a screwdriver, and a new washer.
choices.zh: 一把扳手、一把螺丝刀，还有一个新垫圈。

choices.text: We don't need any tools at all for this.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答清单 → A wrench, a screwdriver, and a new washer.

npcLine.en: This wrench looks bigger than what the video used.
npcLine.zh: 这把扳手看起来比视频里用的要大。

choices.text: Let's check if a smaller one fits better.
choices.zh: 我们看看有没有更小的更合适吧。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's use this one anyway.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's check if a smaller one fits better.

npcLine.en: Let's grab a bucket too, just in case.
npcLine.zh: 我们也拿个桶吧，以防万一。

choices.text: Good thinking, let's place it right under the sink.
choices.zh: 想得周到，我们就放在水槽正下方吧。

choices.text: Let's not bother, a bucket seems unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good thinking, let's place it right under the sink.

transition.en: Before touching anything, they locate the shutoff valve.
transition.zh: 在动手之前，他们先找到了总阀门。

scenes.title: Shutting Off the Water
scenes.subtitle: 水槽下方 · 关闭总阀

npcLine.en: Can you find the shutoff valve under here?
npcLine.zh: 你能在下面找到总阀门吗？

choices.text: I can, it's right behind these pipes.
choices.zh: 可以，就在这些水管后面。

choices.text: I can't, valves don't exist under sinks.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's right behind these pipes.

npcLine.en: Turn it clockwise until it stops moving.
npcLine.zh: 顺时针转动，直到转不动为止。

choices.text: Okay, I'm turning it slowly right now.
choices.zh: 好的，我现在正在慢慢转动。

choices.text: Sorry, I'd rather turn it the other way.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'm turning it slowly right now.

npcLine.en: Let's test the faucet to make sure the water's off.
npcLine.zh: 我们试一下水龙头，确保水已经关了。

choices.text: Good idea, let's turn the handle and check.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们转一下把手检查一下吧。

choices.text: Let's skip that step and just start working.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's turn the handle and check.

transition.en: They carefully disassemble the faucet handle to reach the washer.
transition.zh: 他们小心地拆开水龙头把手，以便够到垫圈。

npcLine.en: This screw is looser than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这颗螺丝比我预想的要松。

choices.text: That's convenient, this should come off easily.
choices.zh: 这挺方便的，应该很容易就能拆下来。

choices.text: That's concerning, let's tighten it more first.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's convenient, this should come off easily.

npcLine.en: Can you hold this piece steady while I unscrew it?
npcLine.zh: 我拧螺丝的时候你能把这块固定住吗？

choices.text: I can, I've got a good grip on it.
choices.zh: 可以，我抓得很稳。

choices.text: I can't, holding things steady isn't my strength.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, I've got a good grip on it.

npcLine.en: There it is, the worn-out washer causing the leak.
npcLine.zh: 找到了，就是这个磨损的垫圈导致漏水。

choices.text: So that's the problem, let's swap it out.
choices.zh: 原来问题在这儿，我们换掉它吧。

choices.text: That's odd, that washer looks perfectly fine.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → So that's the problem, let's swap it out.

transition.en: They swap the old washer for a new one from the hardware store.
transition.zh: 他们把旧垫圈换成了从五金店买来的新垫圈。

npcLine.en: This new washer looks identical to the old one.
npcLine.zh: 这个新垫圈看起来和旧的一模一样。

choices.text: Good, that means we bought the right size.
choices.zh: 很好，这说明我们买对了尺寸。

choices.text: That's odd, we should have bought a different size.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good, that means we bought the right size.

npcLine.en: Can you fit this piece in without forcing it?
npcLine.zh: 你能把这块装进去，不需要用力硬塞吗？

choices.text: I can, it's sliding in smoothly.
choices.zh: 可以，它顺利滑进去了。

choices.text: I can't, I'll just hammer it in instead.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's sliding in smoothly.

npcLine.en: Let's put everything back together in reverse order.
npcLine.zh: 我们按相反顺序把所有东西装回去吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's go step by step.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们一步一步来。

choices.text: Let's just guess the order randomly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's go step by step.

transition.en: With everything reassembled, they turn the water back on.
transition.zh: 一切重新装好后，他们重新打开了水。

scenes.title: The Moment of Truth
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 见真章的时刻

npcLine.en: Are you ready to turn the water back on?
npcLine.zh: 你准备好重新打开水了吗？

choices.text: I am, here goes nothing.
choices.zh: 准备好了，豁出去了。

choices.text: I'm not, let's leave the water off forever.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I am, here goes nothing.

npcLine.en: This faucet is quieter now than it was this morning.
npcLine.zh: 这水龙头现在比今早要安静多了。

choices.text: It really is, I don't hear any dripping at all.
choices.zh: 确实是，我一点滴水声都听不到了。

choices.text: It really isn't, it's dripping louder than before.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I don't hear any dripping at all.

npcLine.en: We actually fixed it ourselves, I can't believe it!
npcLine.zh: 我们真的自己修好了，我简直不敢相信！

choices.text: We did it, I'm honestly really proud of us.
choices.zh: 我们做到了，说实话我为我们感到骄傲。

choices.text: We didn't, this faucet is still dripping badly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did it, I'm honestly really proud of us.

transition.en: They watch the pipes closely for the next few minutes.
transition.zh: 接下来的几分钟他们仔细观察着水管。

npcLine.en: Do you see any water pooling underneath?
npcLine.zh: 你看到下面有积水吗？

choices.text: No, everything looks completely dry down here.
choices.zh: 没有，这下面看起来完全干燥。

choices.text: Yes, there's a huge puddle forming already.

n1.hintOnWrong: 否定回答 → No, everything looks completely dry down here.

npcLine.en: This connection is tighter than it was before we started.
npcLine.zh: 这个接口比我们开始修之前要更紧固了。

choices.text: It is, we did a solid job on this part.
choices.zh: 确实是，这部分我们做得很扎实。

choices.text: It isn't, this connection feels loose still.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we did a solid job on this part.

npcLine.en: Let's check back on it tomorrow, just to be sure.
npcLine.zh: 为保险起见，我们明天再检查一次吧。

choices.text: Good idea, one more check won't hurt.
choices.zh: 好主意，再检查一次也无妨。

choices.text: Let's not bother, we're already confident enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, better safe than sorry.

transition.en: That night, the kitchen stays wonderfully silent.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，厨房安静得美妙极了。

npcLine.en: It's so quiet in here now, no more dripping.
npcLine.zh: 现在这儿真安静，再也没有滴水声了。

choices.text: It really is, I forgot how peaceful this could be.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我都忘了这里可以这么安静了。

choices.text: It isn't, I can still hear it dripping somewhere.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, I forgot how peaceful this could be.

npcLine.en: We saved more money than I expected by doing this ourselves.
npcLine.zh: 我们自己动手省下的钱比我预想的要多。

choices.text: We really did, that's a nice bonus.
choices.zh: 确实是，这真是个不错的额外收获。

choices.text: We really didn't, this cost us more overall.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really did, that's a nice bonus.

npcLine.en: No matter what breaks next, I feel like we can handle it now.
npcLine.zh: 不管下次坏的是什么，我现在感觉我们能应付了。

choices.text: No matter what, we've got this together.
choices.zh: 不管是什么，我们都能一起搞定。

choices.text: No matter what, we'll probably call someone else.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what, we've got this together.

transition.en: The small victory sparks confidence to tackle more small repairs.
transition.zh: 这次小胜利激发了他们处理更多小修理的信心。

npcLine.en: What other small repairs should we try next?
npcLine.zh: 我们接下来还应该尝试哪些小修理？

choices.text: Maybe that squeaky door hinge in the hallway.
choices.zh: 也许试试走廊那扇吱呀作响的门吧。

choices.text: We shouldn't try anything else, ever again.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Maybe that squeaky door hinge in the hallway.

npcLine.en: We're more capable than we ever gave ourselves credit for.
npcLine.zh: 我们比自己曾经想象的要能干得多。

choices.text: We really are, this whole thing was empowering.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这整件事让人感到很有力量。

choices.text: We really aren't, that was just a lucky fix.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really are, this whole thing was empowering.

npcLine.en: Let's keep a running list of little projects for the house.
npcLine.zh: 我们列一份持续更新的家庭小项目清单吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I actually find this satisfying.
choices.zh: 好啊，我其实觉得这挺有成就感的。

choices.text: Let's not, one fix was more than enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I actually find this satisfying.

transition.en: Their toddler watches with fascination as they organize the toolbox.
transition.zh: 他们的孩子着迷地看着他们整理工具箱。

scenes.title: Teaching the Toddler Tools
scenes.subtitle: 车库 · 教孩子认识工具

npcLine.en: Can you point to the screwdriver for me?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我指出螺丝刀在哪儿吗？

choices.text: They can, look how proud they look pointing it out.
choices.zh: 他们能做到，看他们指出来的时候多骄傲。

choices.text: They can't, tools are way too advanced for them.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → They can, look how proud they look pointing it out.

npcLine.en: They're more interested in this than any toy lately.
npcLine.zh: 他们最近对这个的兴趣比对任何玩具都要大。

choices.text: They really are, maybe they'll be handy someday too.
choices.zh: 确实如此，也许他们以后也会很会动手。

choices.text: They really aren't, they'd rather watch television.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, maybe they'll be handy someday too.

npcLine.en: It's nice knowing they're growing up seeing us solve problems together.
npcLine.zh: 看到他们从小就看着我们一起解决问题，感觉真好。

choices.text: It really is, that feels like an important lesson.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这感觉是个重要的道理。

choices.text: It doesn't matter, they won't remember any of this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, that feels like an important lesson.

transition.en: A local studio advertises a paint-and-sip night for beginners.
transition.zh: 一家本地工作室宣传了一场适合初学者的绘画配饮品之夜。

npcLine.en: No experience needed, they say anyone can do it.
npcLine.zh: 他们说不需要经验，任何人都能参加。

choices.text: That's reassuring, I can't paint at all.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，我完全不会画画。

choices.text: That's unlikely, art always requires talent.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, I can't paint at all.

npcLine.en: Have you ever painted anything since school?
npcLine.zh: 你从上学以后画过什么吗？

choices.text: I've never once picked up a paintbrush since then.
choices.zh: 从那以后我一次都没拿过画笔。

choices.text: I've painted something every single week since.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never once picked up a paintbrush since then.

npcLine.en: Let's book two spots for Friday night.
npcLine.zh: 我们订两个位子，周五晚上去吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it sounds like a fun change.
choices.zh: 好啊，这听起来会是个有趣的转换。

choices.text: Let's just watch a movie instead like usual.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'm actually curious now.

transition.en: They find seats in front of blank canvases and small paint palettes.
transition.zh: 他们在空白画布和小调色盘前找到了座位。

npcLine.en: This canvas looks bigger than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这幅画布比我预想的要大。

choices.text: It does, that's a lot of space to fill.
choices.zh: 确实是，要填满的空间不少。

choices.text: It doesn't, this canvas looks tiny to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, that's a lot of space to fill.

npcLine.en: What would you like to drink while you paint?
npcLine.zh: 画画的时候你想喝点什么？

choices.text: I'll just have a glass of sparkling water, thanks.
choices.zh: 我就来一杯气泡水吧，谢谢。

choices.text: I don't want anything to drink at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答 → I'll just have a glass of sparkling water, thanks.

npcLine.en: Let's grab our aprons before we get started.
npcLine.zh: 我们开始前先拿上围裙吧。

choices.text: Good idea, I don't want paint on my shirt.
choices.zh: 好主意，我可不想把颜料弄到衣服上。

choices.text: Let's skip that, we'll be perfectly careful.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, I don't want paint on my shirt.

transition.en: A cheerful instructor demonstrates each step for everyone to follow.
transition.zh: 一位开朗的讲师示范每一步，供大家跟着做。

scenes.title: Following the Instructor
scenes.subtitle: 绘画工作室 · 跟着讲师学

npcLine.en: First, mix these two colors to create the background.
npcLine.zh: 首先，把这两种颜色混合，画出背景色。

choices.text: Okay, I'll try to blend them evenly.
choices.zh: 好的，我会尽量把它们混合均匀。

choices.text: Sorry, mixing colors sounds too complicated.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'll try to blend them evenly.

npcLine.en: My color came out darker than the instructor's sample.
npcLine.zh: 我调出的颜色比讲师的样本要深。

choices.text: That's fine, mine looks pretty good like this too.
choices.zh: 没关系，我这样也挺好看的。

choices.text: That's terrible, let's just stop right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's fine, mine looks pretty good like this too.

npcLine.en: Don't worry about perfection, just have fun with it.
npcLine.zh: 别在意完不完美，享受这个过程就好。

choices.text: Good advice, I'll try to relax a little.
choices.zh: 好建议，我会尽量放松一点。

choices.text: Sorry, I can only focus on perfection.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Good advice, I'll try to relax a little.

transition.en: Halfway through, they pause to compare their paintings.
transition.zh: 画到一半时，他们停下来比较各自的画。

scenes.title: Comparing Progress
scenes.subtitle: 绘画工作室 · 比较进度

npcLine.en: Yours actually looks better than mine, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，你画的其实比我的好看。

choices.text: No way, yours has way more personality.
choices.zh: 才不是呢，你的更有个性多了。

choices.text: That's true, mine is honestly pretty ugly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → No way, yours has way more personality.

npcLine.en: This is more relaxing than I ever thought painting could be.
npcLine.zh: 这比我曾经想象的画画要放松得多。

choices.text: It really is, I forgot how nice this feels.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我都忘了这种感觉有多好了。

choices.text: It really isn't, this feels stressful, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I forgot how nice this feels.

npcLine.en: Let's take a picture of our canvases side by side.
npcLine.zh: 我们把两幅画拍一张并排的照片吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this is a fun memory to keep.
choices.zh: 好啊，这是值得保留的有趣回忆。

choices.text: Let's not, unfinished paintings look silly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this is a fun memory to keep.

transition.en: They move on to adding small details with thinner brushes.
transition.zh: 他们用更细的画笔开始添加细节。

scenes.title: Adding the Details
scenes.subtitle: 绘画工作室 · 添加细节

npcLine.en: This brush is thinner than the one we used before.
npcLine.zh: 这支画笔比我们之前用的要细。

choices.text: It is, that should help with the small details.
choices.zh: 确实是，这应该能帮上处理细节的忙。

choices.text: It isn't, this brush looks exactly the same.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that should help with the small details.

npcLine.en: Can you show me how to make these tiny highlights?
npcLine.zh: 你能教我怎么画这些小小的高光吗？

choices.text: I can, just watch my brush carefully.
choices.zh: 可以，你仔细看我的画笔就行。

choices.text: I can't, I have no idea how to do that either.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, just watch my brush carefully.

npcLine.en: This little touch really brought the whole piece together.
npcLine.zh: 这个小小的细节真的让整幅画都完整起来了。

choices.text: It really did, small details matter more than I thought.
choices.zh: 确实如此，小细节的作用比我想的要大。

choices.text: It didn't, that detail changed absolutely nothing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It really did, small details matter more than I thought.

transition.en: With brushes down, everyone holds up their finished paintings.
transition.zh: 放下画笔后，大家举起了各自完成的画作。

scenes.title: The Final Reveal
scenes.subtitle: 绘画工作室 · 成品揭晓

npcLine.en: I can't believe we actually finished these!
npcLine.zh: 我真不敢相信我们真的画完了！

choices.text: I honestly can't either, I'm impressed with us.
choices.zh: 说实话我也不敢相信，我为我们感到骄傲。

choices.text: I can believe it, these look completely unfinished.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/惊讶 → I honestly can't either, I'm impressed with us.

npcLine.en: Yours turned out even better than the sample painting.
npcLine.zh: 你画的效果比示范画还要好。

choices.text: That's so kind, thank you, though yours is great too.
choices.zh: 你真是太客气了，谢谢你，不过你的也很棒。

choices.text: That's not true, the sample was clearly better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's so kind, thank you, though yours is great too.

npcLine.en: Let's hang these somewhere in the house together.
npcLine.zh: 我们把这两幅画一起挂在家里某处吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, maybe side by side in the hallway.
choices.zh: 好啊，也许可以在走廊里并排挂着。

choices.text: Let's just leave them in the closet forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, maybe side by side in the hallway.

transition.en: They carefully carry their wet canvases out to the car.
transition.zh: 他们小心翼翼地把还没干的画布抱到车上。

npcLine.en: Can you hold the door while I carry both canvases?
npcLine.zh: 我拿两幅画的时候你能帮我扶一下门吗？

choices.text: I can, let me get that for you.
choices.zh: 可以，我来帮你扶门。

choices.text: I can't, my hands are completely full too.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me get that for you.

npcLine.en: These will look better once they're fully dry.
npcLine.zh: 等完全干了之后会更好看。

choices.text: I bet they will, I can already picture it.
choices.zh: 我相信会的，我都能想象出来了。

choices.text: I doubt it, these will only look worse.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → I bet they will, I can already picture it.

npcLine.en: Let's lay them flat in the trunk to be safe.
npcLine.zh: 为了安全起见，我们把它们平放在后备箱里吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's protect our hard work.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们保护好这份劳动成果吧。

choices.text: Let's just toss them in carelessly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's protect our hard work.

transition.en: Once dry, they debate where in the house to hang their art.
transition.zh: 干了之后，他们讨论该把画挂在家里哪个位置。

scenes.title: Finding the Right Spot
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 寻找合适的位置

npcLine.en: This wall gets more light than the one in the hallway.
npcLine.zh: 这面墙比走廊那面采光更好。

choices.text: It does, let's hang them here instead.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们改挂在这儿吧。

choices.text: Light doesn't matter, let's just pick randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's hang them here instead.

npcLine.en: Can you hold it up while I check if it's level?
npcLine.zh: 我检查是否水平的时候你能扶着吗？

choices.text: I can, just tell me which way to adjust.
choices.zh: 可以，告诉我该往哪边调就行。

choices.text: I can't, my arms are already too tired.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, just tell me which way to adjust.

npcLine.en: There, it looks perfect right where it is now.
npcLine.zh: 好了，现在这个位置看起来正合适。

choices.text: It really does, I love how it turned out.
choices.zh: 确实是，我很喜欢这个效果。

choices.text: It doesn't, let's take it down completely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, I love how it turned out.

transition.en: That evening, they admire their new artwork from the couch.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们坐在沙发上欣赏自己的新画作。

npcLine.en: I actually really like looking at this every day.
npcLine.zh: 我其实每天看着这幅画都很喜欢。

choices.text: Same here, it makes this room feel more like ours.
choices.zh: 我也是，这让这个房间更有我们的味道了。

choices.text: Same here, though I already want a new one.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Same here, it makes this room feel more like ours.

npcLine.en: We should try painting again sometime soon.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该找时间再画一次。

choices.text: Agreed, this turned out to be so much fun.
choices.zh: 同意，这真的很有意思。

choices.text: Disagreed, once was more than enough for me.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Agreed, this turned out to be so much fun.

npcLine.en: No matter how it turns out, making something together always feels good.
npcLine.zh: 不管结果如何，一起创作总是让人感觉很好。

choices.text: No matter how it turns out, I agree completely.
choices.zh: 不管结果如何，我完全同意。

choices.text: No matter how it turns out, results are all that matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how it turns out, I agree completely.

transition.en: A month later, they return to the studio to try a new style.
transition.zh: 一个月后，他们回到工作室尝试一种新的画风。

scenes.title: A Second Attempt
scenes.subtitle: 绘画工作室 · 再次尝试

npcLine.en: This time feels more comfortable than the first.
npcLine.zh: 这次感觉比第一次更自在了。

choices.text: It does, we already know what to expect.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们已经知道会是什么样了。

choices.text: It doesn't, this feels harder than before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, we already know what to expect.

npcLine.en: We've gotten better at this than I ever expected we would.
npcLine.zh: 我们的水平比我曾经预想的要好得多。

choices.text: We really have, practice must be paying off.
choices.zh: 确实如此，练习一定有了回报。

choices.text: We really haven't, we've barely improved at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really have, practice must be paying off.

npcLine.en: This might just become our regular date night thing.
npcLine.zh: 这或许会成为我们固定的约会活动。

choices.text: I'd love that, more than most other date nights.
choices.zh: 我很愿意，比大多数其他约会都更喜欢这个。

choices.text: I doubt it, this feels like a one-time thing.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → I'd love that, more than most other date nights.

transition.en: Friends invite them on a day trip to a nearby ski hill.
transition.zh: 朋友们邀请他们去附近的雪场玩一天。

scenes.title: Planning a Ski Trip
scenes.subtitle: 群聊 · 计划滑雪之旅

npcLine.en: Have either of us ever skied before?
npcLine.zh: 我们俩有人滑过雪吗？

choices.text: Neither of us has, this will be our first time.
choices.zh: 我们俩都没有，这将是我们第一次。

choices.text: Both of us have skied since childhood.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → Neither of us has, this will be our first time.

npcLine.en: Do you think our toddler is old enough for the bunny hill?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得我们家孩子的年纪够上初级雪道了吗？

choices.text: I think so, plenty of kids start this young.
choices.zh: 我觉得可以，很多孩子这个年纪就开始了。

choices.text: No, skiing is only for teenagers and adults.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I think so, plenty of kids start this young.

npcLine.en: Let's take a beginner lesson before hitting the slopes.
npcLine.zh: 我们上雪道之前先上一节初学者课程吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's not skip that step.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们不要跳过这一步。

choices.text: Let's just wing it without any lessons.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's not skip that step.

transition.en: They visit the rental shop for skis, boots, and helmets.
transition.zh: 他们去租赁店租雪板、雪靴和头盔。

npcLine.en: What size boots do you usually wear?
npcLine.zh: 您平常穿多大码的靴子？

choices.text: I usually wear a size nine, I think.
choices.zh: 我一般穿九码，我觉得。

choices.text: I never wear boots, ever, at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答尺码 → I usually wear a size nine, I think.

npcLine.en: These skis are shorter than the ones you rented last time.
npcLine.zh: 这些雪板比您上次租的要短。

choices.text: That makes sense, shorter should be easier for beginners.
choices.zh: 有道理，短一点对初学者来说应该更容易。

choices.text: Length doesn't matter, let's just grab any pair.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, shorter should be easier for beginners.

npcLine.en: Please make sure the helmet fits snugly.
npcLine.zh: 请确保头盔戴得贴合。

choices.text: Got it, I'll adjust the strap now.
choices.zh: 明白了，我现在就调整一下带子。

choices.text: Sorry, helmets seem unnecessary for beginners.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Got it, I'll adjust the strap now.

transition.en: Their first challenge is simply standing up on skis.
transition.zh: 他们的第一个挑战就是简单地站稳在雪板上。

scenes.title: Learning to Stand
scenes.subtitle: 初级雪道 · 学习站立

npcLine.en: This is harder than I ever imagined it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这比我曾经想象的要难得多。

choices.text: It really is, standing alone feels impossible.
choices.zh: 确实如此，光是站着都感觉不可能。

choices.text: It really isn't, this feels completely natural.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, standing alone feels impossible.

npcLine.en: Can you keep your knees bent while standing?
npcLine.zh: 站着的时候你能保持膝盖弯曲吗？

choices.text: I can, though my legs are already shaking.
choices.zh: 可以，不过我的腿已经在抖了。

choices.text: I can't, my legs refuse to bend at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, though my legs are already shaking.

npcLine.en: Everyone falls a lot on their first day, this is normal.
npcLine.zh: 每个人第一天都会摔很多次，这很正常。

choices.text: That's reassuring, we feel a little better now.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，我们现在感觉好一点了。

choices.text: That's disappointing, we hoped to be naturals already.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, we feel a little better now.

transition.en: A sudden wobble sends one of them tumbling into the snow.
transition.zh: 一个突然的摇晃让其中一人摔进了雪里。

scenes.title: The First Fall
scenes.subtitle: 初级雪道 · 首次摔倒

npcLine.en: Are you okay? That looked like a soft landing at least.
npcLine.zh: 你还好吗？至少看起来摔得挺软的。

choices.text: I'm okay, snow is surprisingly forgiving.
choices.zh: 我没事，雪比想象中要软得多。

choices.text: I'm not okay, call an ambulance right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I'm okay, snow is surprisingly forgiving.

npcLine.en: Getting back up is trickier than falling down.
npcLine.zh: 重新站起来比摔倒本身要棘手。

choices.text: It really is, I have no idea how to do this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我完全不知道该怎么做。

choices.text: It isn't, standing back up is completely simple.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I have no idea how to do this.

npcLine.en: Let's laugh about this instead of getting frustrated.
npcLine.zh: 我们笑一笑就好，别为此感到沮丧了。

choices.text: Let's do that, this is honestly kind of funny.
choices.zh: 好啊，说实话这挺搞笑的。

choices.text: Let's just quit and go home right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this is honestly kind of funny.

transition.en: Meanwhile, their toddler takes a lesson at the kids' area.
transition.zh: 与此同时，他们的孩子在儿童区上了一节课。

scenes.title: The Toddler's Ski Lesson
scenes.subtitle: 儿童雪场 · 孩子的滑雪课

npcLine.en: Your child is picking this up faster than most adults do.
npcLine.zh: 您的孩子学得比大多数成年人还要快。

choices.text: That's amazing, kids really do learn quickly.
choices.zh: 太厉害了，孩子学东西确实快。

choices.text: That's odd, adults always learn faster than kids.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's amazing, kids really do learn quickly.

npcLine.en: They're braver on this hill than I expected them to be.
npcLine.zh: 他们在这个雪坡上比我预想的要勇敢。

choices.text: They really are, I'm learning from them, honestly.
choices.zh: 确实如此，说实话，我都在向他们学习。

choices.text: They really aren't, they seem terrified up there.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, I'm learning from them, honestly.

npcLine.en: Let's watch them finish this run before we head back.
npcLine.zh: 我们回去之前先看他们把这一趟滑完吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this is too cute to miss.
choices.zh: 好啊，这画面太可爱了不能错过。

choices.text: Let's just leave now without watching.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this is too cute to miss.

transition.en: One of them finally glides a few meters without falling.
transition.zh: 其中一人终于顺畅地滑了几米，没有摔倒。

scenes.title: The First Real Slide
scenes.subtitle: 初级雪道 · 第一次真正滑行

npcLine.en: I actually just glided without falling over!
npcLine.zh: 我刚刚真的滑起来了，没有摔倒！

choices.text: You did it, that was actually really smooth!
choices.zh: 你做到了，那滑得真的很顺！

choices.text: You didn't, you fell down immediately.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → You did it, that was actually really smooth!

npcLine.en: That felt more natural than I expected it to feel.
npcLine.zh: 那种感觉比我预想的要自然。

choices.text: It really did, maybe we're getting the hang of this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，也许我们开始上手了。

choices.text: It really didn't, that felt completely wrong.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, maybe we're getting the hang of this.

npcLine.en: Let's try that same slope one more time.
npcLine.zh: 我们再试一次同样的坡道吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I want to feel that again.
choices.zh: 好啊，我还想再感受一次那种感觉。

choices.text: Let's move to a much steeper slope instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I want to feel that again.

transition.en: Feeling braver, they try the chairlift for a slightly longer run.
transition.zh: 变得更大胆后，他们尝试坐缆车去一条稍长的雪道。

scenes.title: Riding the Chairlift
scenes.subtitle: 缆车 · 乘坐滑雪缆车

npcLine.en: This chairlift is higher off the ground than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个缆车离地面比我预想的要高。

choices.text: It is, but the view up here is worth it.
choices.zh: 确实是，但这上面的景色很值得。

choices.text: It isn't, this chairlift feels perfectly low.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but the view up here is worth it.

npcLine.en: Can you lower the safety bar for us?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我们把安全杆放下来吗？

choices.text: I can, one second, let me reach it.
choices.zh: 可以，等我一下，我来够一下。

choices.text: I can't, safety bars seem unnecessary honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, one second, let me reach it.

npcLine.en: Getting off might be trickier than getting on.
npcLine.zh: 下车可能比上车更棘手。

choices.text: Let's stay calm and just slide off gently.
choices.zh: 我们保持冷静，轻轻滑下去就好。

choices.text: Let's just jump off as fast as possible.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's stay calm and just slide off gently.

transition.en: The longer run down proves wobbly but exhilarating.
transition.zh: 这条更长的下坡路线走得摇摇晃晃但令人兴奋。

npcLine.en: My legs are shaking more than they ever have before!
npcLine.zh: 我的腿比以往任何时候都抖得厉害！

choices.text: Mine too, but we're actually doing this!
choices.zh: 我也是，但我们真的在做这件事！

choices.text: Mine feel completely steady, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Mine too, but we're actually doing this!

npcLine.en: This run is definitely scarier than the bunny hill.
npcLine.zh: 这条道肯定比初级道更吓人。

choices.text: It is, but the thrill is honestly kind of fun.
choices.zh: 确实是，但说实话这种刺激感挺有意思的。

choices.text: It is, so let's just stop here and walk down.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but the thrill is honestly kind of fun.

npcLine.en: We actually made it all the way down!
npcLine.zh: 我们真的一路滑到底了！

choices.text: We did it, I'm honestly shaking with excitement.
choices.zh: 我们做到了，说实话我都因为兴奋在发抖。

choices.text: We didn't, we're still stuck halfway up.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did it, I'm honestly shaking with excitement.

transition.en: They retreat to the lodge to warm up by the fireplace.
transition.zh: 他们回到小木屋，在壁炉旁取暖。

scenes.title: Warming Up by the Fire
scenes.subtitle: 雪场小木屋 · 壁炉旁取暖

npcLine.en: This hot chocolate tastes better than any I've had before.
npcLine.zh: 这杯热可可比我以前喝过的任何一杯都要好喝。

choices.text: It really does, maybe it's the cold weather.
choices.zh: 确实如此，也许是因为天气冷的缘故。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this tastes exactly the same.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, maybe it's the cold weather.

npcLine.en: My whole body feels more sore than it has in years.
npcLine.zh: 我全身比这些年来任何时候都要酸痛。

choices.text: Mine too, but it's the good kind of sore.
choices.zh: 我也是，但这是一种舒服的酸痛。

choices.text: Mine feels perfectly fine, actually.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Mine too, but it's the good kind of sore.

npcLine.en: This turned out to be more fun than I ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 这次的乐趣比我曾经预想的要多得多。

choices.text: It really did, let's make this a yearly trip.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们把这变成每年一次的旅行吧。

choices.text: It really didn't, this was a waste of a day.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, let's make this a yearly trip.

transition.en: On the drive home, they're already dreaming about their next ski day.
transition.zh: 回家的路上，他们已经在憧憬下一次滑雪日了。

npcLine.en: We've come further than I ever thought we would today.
npcLine.zh: 今天我们进步的程度超出了我曾经的想象。

choices.text: We really have, and it's only our first day.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而这才只是我们的第一天。

choices.text: We really haven't, we barely improved at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really have, and it's only our first day.

npcLine.en: Our child might end up skiing better than both of us.
npcLine.zh: 我们家孩子可能最终会滑得比我们俩都好。

choices.text: That's true, and I'd be honestly delighted about that.
choices.zh: 确实如此，说实话我会很乐意看到这一点。

choices.text: That's impossible, kids never surpass their parents.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's true, and I'd be honestly delighted about that.

npcLine.en: No matter how sore we are tomorrow, today was worth every fall.
npcLine.zh: 不管明天有多酸痛，今天的每一次摔倒都值得。

choices.text: No matter how sore, I'd do this again tomorrow.
choices.zh: 不管有多酸痛，我明天还愿意再来一次。

choices.text: No matter how sore, I'll never ski again.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how sore, I'd do this again tomorrow.

transition.en: Friends suggest axe throwing as their next group outing.
transition.zh: 朋友们提议把飞斧作为下一次聚会活动。

npcLine.en: Has anyone here actually thrown an axe before?
npcLine.zh: 这里有人真的投过飞斧吗？

choices.text: I've never thrown one, but I'm curious.
choices.zh: 我从没投过，不过挺好奇的。

choices.text: I've thrown axes competitively for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never thrown one, but I'm curious.

npcLine.en: This place gives a full safety briefing before you start.
npcLine.zh: 这家店在开始前会给一次完整的安全讲解。

choices.text: That's reassuring, safety first, always.
choices.zh: 这让人安心，安全永远第一。

choices.text: That's boring, let's skip the safety part.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's reassuring, safety first, always.

npcLine.en: Let's book a lane for six people this Saturday.
npcLine.zh: 我们订一个能容纳六人的场地，就这周六吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this could be a lot of fun.
choices.zh: 好啊，这可能会很好玩。

choices.text: Let's wait a few more months to decide.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'll book it right now.

transition.en: A staff member walks the group through the safety rules.
transition.zh: 一位工作人员向大家讲解了安全规则。

npcLine.en: Please never step past this line when someone is throwing.
npcLine.zh: 有人在投掷时，请千万不要越过这条线。

choices.text: Understood, I'll always stay well behind it.
choices.zh: 明白了，我会一直待在线后面的。

choices.text: Sorry, that line seems unnecessary to follow.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Understood, I'll always stay well behind it.

npcLine.en: This axe is heavier than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这把斧头比我预想的要重。

choices.text: It is, I'll need both hands for this.
choices.zh: 确实是，我这次要用两只手了。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's just throw it fast.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I'll need both hands for this.

npcLine.en: Always wait for a clear signal before retrieving your axe.
npcLine.zh: 取回你的斧头前一定要等待明确的信号。

choices.text: Got it, I'll wait for the all-clear.
choices.zh: 明白了，我会等待安全信号的。

choices.text: Sorry, I'd rather just grab it whenever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Got it, I'll wait for the all-clear.

transition.en: The first attempt sails wide, missing the target entirely.
transition.zh: 第一次投掷偏得很远，完全没打中靶。

npcLine.en: That went completely wide of the target!
npcLine.zh: 那一斧完全偏离靶子了！

choices.text: It did, my aim needs a lot of work.
choices.zh: 确实是，我的瞄准需要好好练一练。

choices.text: It didn't, that landed right in the center.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It did, my aim needs a lot of work.

npcLine.en: This is harder than it looks in the videos.
npcLine.zh: 这比视频里看起来要难得多。

choices.text: It really is, let's just keep practicing.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们继续多练几次吧。

choices.text: It really isn't, this feels completely simple.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, let's just keep practicing.

npcLine.en: Keep your eyes on the target, not on the axe.
npcLine.zh: 眼睛要盯着靶子，不要盯着斧头。

choices.text: Okay, I'll focus on the target this time.
choices.zh: 好的，这次我会盯着靶子。

choices.text: Sorry, I'd rather just close my eyes entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'll focus on the target this time.

transition.en: After a few tries, the throws start landing closer to the board.
transition.zh: 试了几次后，投掷开始更靠近靶板了。

npcLine.en: That one actually stuck in the wood!
npcLine.zh: 那一斧真的钉进木头里了！

choices.text: It did, that felt really satisfying.
choices.zh: 确实是，那种感觉真的很有成就感。

choices.text: It didn't, that bounced off completely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It did, that felt really satisfying.

npcLine.en: Your form is looking more consistent than it was earlier.
npcLine.zh: 你的动作比刚才要稳定多了。

choices.text: Thanks, I think I finally found a rhythm.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我觉得我终于找到节奏了。

choices.text: Thanks, though nothing has changed at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thanks, I think I finally found a rhythm.

npcLine.en: Let's each take five more throws before we score.
npcLine.zh: 计分之前我们每人再投五次吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, more practice can only help.
choices.zh: 好啊，多练习总没坏处。

choices.text: Let's just start scoring right away instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, more practice can only help.

transition.en: A surprise throw lands dead center for the first time.
transition.zh: 一次意外的投掷第一次正中靶心。

npcLine.en: I actually hit the bullseye, I can't believe it!
npcLine.zh: 我居然正中靶心了，简直不敢相信！

choices.text: You did it, that was an amazing throw!
choices.zh: 你做到了，那一投太厉害了！

choices.text: You didn't, that hit the very edge.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → You did it, that was an amazing throw!

npcLine.en: That felt more like luck than actual skill, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，那感觉更像是运气，不是真本事。

choices.text: Maybe, but I'll take it either way!
choices.zh: 也许吧，但不管怎样我都收下这次成功！

choices.text: That's true, skill has nothing to do with it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Maybe, but I'll take it either way!

npcLine.en: Let's see if you can do that again.
npcLine.zh: 我们看看你能不能再做到一次。

choices.text: Let's find out, no pressure at all.
choices.zh: 试试看吧，完全没压力。

choices.text: Let's not risk it, I'll quit while I'm ahead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's find out, no pressure at all.

transition.en: The group turns their session into a lighthearted tournament.
transition.zh: 大家把这次活动变成了一场轻松的小比赛。

scenes.title: Friendly Competition
scenes.subtitle: 飞斧馆 · 友好的比赛

npcLine.en: Should we keep score for the rest of the session?
npcLine.zh: 剩下的时间我们要记分吗？

choices.text: Yes, let's make this a friendly little contest.
choices.zh: 好啊，我们把这变成一场友好的小比赛吧。

choices.text: No, scores would just ruin all the fun.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's make this a friendly little contest.

npcLine.en: You're doing better than everyone else right now.
npcLine.zh: 你现在的表现比其他所有人都要好。

choices.text: That's just beginner's luck, honestly.
choices.zh: 这只是新手运气罢了，说实话。

choices.text: That's expected, I'm clearly the best here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's just beginner's luck, honestly.

npcLine.en: This is more fun than I expected friendly competition to be.
npcLine.zh: 这次友好比赛比我预想的要有趣得多。

choices.text: It really is, this whole night has been a blast.
choices.zh: 确实如此，整晚都玩得很开心。

choices.text: It really isn't, competition always feels tense.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, this whole night has been a blast.

transition.en: The final round comes down to two close competitors.
transition.zh: 最后一轮比赛落在了两位势均力敌的选手之间。

npcLine.en: This score is closer than any round we've had tonight.
npcLine.zh: 这个比分比今晚任何一轮都要接近。

choices.text: It is, every throw counts now.
choices.zh: 确实是，现在每一投都很重要。

choices.text: It isn't, this round isn't close at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, every throw counts now.

npcLine.en: No matter who wins, this was still an amazing night.
npcLine.zh: 不管谁赢，今晚都还是很棒的一晚。

choices.text: No matter who wins, I agree completely.
choices.zh: 不管谁赢，我完全同意。

choices.text: No matter who wins, winning is all that matters.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter who wins, I agree completely.

npcLine.en: That's it, we finally have our winner!
npcLine.zh: 结束了，我们终于有优胜者了！

choices.text: Congratulations, that was well deserved.
choices.zh: 恭喜，这是你应得的。

choices.text: That's disappointing, the result feels unfair.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Congratulations, that was well deserved.

transition.en: Over food afterward, everyone shares their favorite moment of the night.
transition.zh: 赛后大家一起吃东西，分享今晚各自最喜欢的瞬间。

npcLine.en: What was your favorite moment from tonight?
npcLine.zh: 今晚你最喜欢的瞬间是什么？

choices.text: Definitely that surprise bullseye earlier.
choices.zh: 肯定是之前那次意外的靶心。

choices.text: Nothing tonight was memorable, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答经历 → Definitely that surprise bullseye earlier.

npcLine.en: We laughed more tonight than we have in months.
npcLine.zh: 今晚我们笑的次数比过去几个月都多。

choices.text: We really did, this group makes everything fun.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这个团体让一切都变得有趣。

choices.text: We really didn't, tonight felt pretty quiet.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really did, this group makes everything fun.

npcLine.en: Let's plan another activity like this again soon.
npcLine.zh: 我们尽快再计划一次这样的活动吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, maybe archery next time.
choices.zh: 好啊，下次也许可以玩射箭。

choices.text: Let's not, once was more than enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, maybe archery next time.

transition.en: Driving home, they feel pleasantly worn out from the whole evening.
transition.zh: 开车回家的路上，他们感到一种整晚下来令人愉悦的疲惫。

npcLine.en: Tonight was more fun than I ever expected axe throwing to be.
npcLine.zh: 今晚比我曾经想象的飞斧活动要有趣得多。

choices.text: It really was, we should try this again soon.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们应该尽快再试一次。

choices.text: It really wasn't, tonight felt pretty forgettable.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really was, we should try this again soon.

npcLine.en: I love how our group always finds something fun to try.
npcLine.zh: 我很喜欢我们这群人总能找到有趣的事情尝试。

choices.text: Me too, that's honestly what I love most about them.
choices.zh: 我也是，说实话这正是我最喜欢他们的一点。

choices.text: Me too, though most activities are pretty boring.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Me too, that's honestly what I love most about them.

npcLine.en: No matter what we try next, let's keep making these memories.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们下次尝试什么，都要继续创造这样的回忆。

choices.text: No matter what, these nights are always worth it.
choices.zh: 不管是什么，这样的夜晚永远都值得。

choices.text: No matter what, we'll probably stop doing this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what, these nights are always worth it.

transition.en: A chalkboard sign outside a pub advertises weekly trivia night.
transition.zh: 酒吧外一块黑板宣传每周的知识问答之夜。

npcLine.en: Have you ever done trivia night before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前参加过知识问答之夜吗？

choices.text: I've never done it, but I love random facts.
choices.zh: 我从没参加过，不过我很喜欢各种冷知识。

choices.text: I've done this every single week for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never done it, but I love random facts.

npcLine.en: Teams can have up to six players.
npcLine.zh: 每队最多可以有六名玩家。

choices.text: That's plenty, let's invite a couple more friends.
choices.zh: 这人数够用了，我们再邀请几个朋友吧。

choices.text: That's too many, let's just go by ourselves.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/规则 → That's plenty, let's invite a couple more friends.

npcLine.en: Let's come back next Thursday and give it a try.
npcLine.zh: 我们下周四回来试试看吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'm actually excited already.
choices.zh: 好啊，我已经很期待了。

choices.text: Let's forget about it, trivia sounds too stressful.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'm actually excited already.

transition.en: They gather a small group of friends and pick a team name.
transition.zh: 他们召集了一小群朋友，起了一个队名。

npcLine.en: What should we name our team?
npcLine.zh: 我们队应该叫什么名字？

choices.text: Something punny, like Quiz Pro Quo.
choices.zh: 起个带点谐音梗的名字，比如“问答有理”。

choices.text: It doesn't need a name, honestly.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答建议 → Something punny, like Quiz Pro Quo.

npcLine.en: This name is funnier than the one we used last time.
npcLine.zh: 这个名字比我们上次用的要更好笑。

choices.text: It is, let's go with this one for sure.
choices.zh: 确实是，那我们就用这个吧。

choices.text: It isn't, let's just keep the old boring name.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's go with this one for sure.

npcLine.en: Let's split up who's good at which categories.
npcLine.zh: 我们分一下谁擅长哪个类别吧。

choices.text: Good idea, I'm strong in movies and music.
choices.zh: 好主意，我在电影和音乐方面比较强。

choices.text: Let's not plan anything, we'll just wing it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, I'm strong in movies and music.

transition.en: The host reads out the first round of questions.
transition.zh: 主持人念出了第一轮的题目。

npcLine.en: This category is history, does anyone know a lot about that?
npcLine.zh: 这个类别是历史，有人对这个很了解吗？

choices.text: Yes, actually, history happens to be my thing.
choices.zh: 有的，其实历史正好是我擅长的。

choices.text: No, none of us know anything about history.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, actually, history happens to be my thing.

npcLine.en: This question is trickier than I expected round one to be.
npcLine.zh: 这道题比我预想的第一轮要棘手。

choices.text: It is, let's think about it together.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们一起想想吧。

choices.text: It isn't, this question feels far too easy.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's think about it together.

npcLine.en: Let's write our answer down before time runs out.
npcLine.zh: 我们赶在时间结束前写下答案吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, quick, we're almost out of time.
choices.zh: 好，快点，我们快没时间了。

choices.text: Let's just leave the answer blank instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, quick, we're almost out of time.

transition.en: A wild guess on a science question surprisingly lands correct.
transition.zh: 一次关于科学题的乱猜居然出乎意料地答对了。

npcLine.en: That was a total guess, and we actually got it right!
npcLine.zh: 那完全是瞎猜的，我们居然还答对了！

choices.text: We did it, I can't believe that worked!
choices.zh: 我们做到了，真不敢相信居然对了！

choices.text: We didn't, that answer was actually wrong.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did it, I can't believe that worked!

npcLine.en: We're doing better than I ever expected for our first time.
npcLine.zh: 对于我们第一次来说，表现比我预想的要好。

choices.text: We really are, maybe we're naturals at this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，也许我们对这个还挺有天赋的。

choices.text: We really aren't, we're doing terribly, honestly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really are, maybe we're naturals at this.

npcLine.en: Let's not get overconfident, there's still a lot of trivia left.
npcLine.zh: 我们别太自满，后面还有很多题呢。

choices.text: Good point, let's stay focused for the rest.
choices.zh: 说得有道理，接下来我们要保持专注。

choices.text: Let's just relax completely for the rest of the night.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good point, let's stay focused for the rest.

transition.en: Short song clips play during the music category round.
transition.zh: 音乐类别环节播放了几段简短的歌曲片段。

npcLine.en: Do you recognize this song from the intro?
npcLine.zh: 从这段前奏你能认出这首歌吗？

choices.text: I do, this song is from the nineties.
choices.zh: 认得出来，这是九十年代的歌。

choices.text: I don't, this song sounds completely unfamiliar.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I do, this song is from the nineties.

npcLine.en: This round is more fun than the history round was.
npcLine.zh: 这一轮比历史环节要更有趣。

choices.text: It is, music trivia is my favorite kind.
choices.zh: 确实是，音乐类问答是我最喜欢的类型。

choices.text: It isn't, this round feels much more boring.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, music trivia is my favorite kind.

npcLine.en: We got every single question right in this round!
npcLine.zh: 这一轮的每一道题我们都答对了！

choices.text: We did, this is honestly our best round yet.
choices.zh: 确实做到了，说实话这是我们目前最好的一轮。

choices.text: We didn't, we missed almost every question.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did, this is honestly our best round yet.

transition.en: Two teams end up tied, leading to a nerve-wracking tiebreaker.
transition.zh: 两支队伍打平了，进入了令人紧张的加时赛。

npcLine.en: This tiebreaker feels more intense than the whole game combined.
npcLine.zh: 这次加时赛比整场比赛加起来还要紧张。

choices.text: It does, my heart is honestly racing right now.
choices.zh: 确实是，说实话我的心跳现在都加快了。

choices.text: It doesn't, this feels completely relaxed to me.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, my heart is honestly racing right now.

npcLine.en: If we're closest without going over, we win.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们的答案在不超过的情况下最接近，我们就赢了。

choices.text: If that's the rule, let's guess carefully.
choices.zh: 如果规则是这样，我们就仔细猜吧。

choices.text: If that's the rule, let's just guess a huge number.

n2.hintOnWrong: if 条件句 → If that's the rule, let's guess carefully.

npcLine.en: We're closer than the other team, we actually won!
npcLine.zh: 我们比另一队更接近，我们真的赢了！

choices.text: We are, I honestly can't believe it!
choices.zh: 确实是，我真不敢相信！

choices.text: We aren't, the other team clearly beat us.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We are, I honestly can't believe it!

transition.en: The host announces their team as the winner of the night.
transition.zh: 主持人宣布他们的队伍是今晚的优胜者。

npcLine.en: Congratulations, your team wins a gift card tonight!
npcLine.zh: 恭喜，你们队今晚赢得了一张礼品卡！

choices.text: That's amazing, we can't believe our luck!
choices.zh: 太棒了，我们简直不敢相信自己的运气！

choices.text: That's disappointing, we expected something better.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's amazing, we can't believe our luck!

npcLine.en: This win feels sweeter than I expected our first time to feel.
npcLine.zh: 对于我们的第一次来说，这次获胜比我预想的更让人满足。

choices.text: It really does, beginner's luck can be amazing.
choices.zh: 确实如此，新手运有时候真的很厉害。

choices.text: It doesn't, winning never really feels satisfying.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, beginner's luck can be amazing.

npcLine.en: Let's celebrate with a round of drinks for everyone.
npcLine.zh: 我们给大家点一轮饮料庆祝一下吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, we've definitely earned it.
choices.zh: 好啊，我们绝对是应得的。

choices.text: Let's just save the gift card and go home.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, we've definitely earned it.

transition.en: Buzzing from the win, they talk about making it a regular thing.
transition.zh: 沉浸在胜利的喜悦中，他们聊起要不要把这变成固定活动。

scenes.title: A New Weekly Plan
scenes.subtitle: 酒吧 · 定下每周计划

npcLine.en: Should we make this a regular Thursday thing?
npcLine.zh: 我们要把这变成固定的周四活动吗？

choices.text: Yes, let's mark it on the calendar right now.
choices.zh: 好，我们现在就标在日历上吧。

choices.text: No, once was already more than enough.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's mark it on the calendar right now.

npcLine.en: This has honestly become more fun than I expected weekly outings to be.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，这比我预想的每周活动要有趣得多。

choices.text: It really has, I already look forward to next week.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我已经开始期待下周了。

choices.text: It hasn't, this feels like a chore already.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really has, I already look forward to next week.

npcLine.en: No matter how we do next time, tonight was a great start.
npcLine.zh: 不管下次我们表现如何，今晚都是个很好的开始。

choices.text: No matter what, tonight was honestly perfect.
choices.zh: 不管怎样，今晚说实话真的很完美。

choices.text: No matter what, we probably won't come back.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter what, tonight was honestly perfect.

transition.en: In the following weeks, they start jokingly quizzing each other at home.
transition.zh: 接下来几周，他们开始在家里开玩笑地互相考问。

scenes.title: Studying for Fun
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 为了好玩而学习

npcLine.en: Did you know the human body has more bones as a baby than as an adult?
npcLine.zh: 你知道人体作为婴儿时的骨头比成年后要多吗？

choices.text: I didn't know that, that's a fun fact.
choices.zh: 我不知道，这真是个有趣的冷知识。

choices.text: I already knew that, everyone knows that.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → I didn't know that, that's a fun fact.
