npcLine.en: We've been learning more random facts than I ever expected we would.
npcLine.zh: 我们学到的冷知识比我曾经预想的要多得多。

choices.text: We really have, this hobby is oddly educational.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这个爱好意外地挺有教育意义的。

choices.text: We really haven't, we've forgotten everything already.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really have, this hobby is oddly educational.

npcLine.en: Let's keep quizzing each other before next Thursday.
npcLine.zh: 下周四之前我们继续互相考一考吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, practice can only help us win again.
choices.zh: 好啊，多练习总能帮我们再赢一次。

choices.text: Let's not, we already know everything we need.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, practice can only help us win again.

transition.en: A rival team starts to recognize them each week at the pub.
transition.zh: 一支对手队伍开始每周在酒吧认出他们了。

npcLine.en: You two again, you're getting harder to beat each week.
npcLine.zh: 又是你们俩，你们一周比一周更难被打败了。

choices.text: We're trying, honestly, and it's been fun.
choices.zh: 说实话，我们也在努力，而且过程很有趣。

choices.text: We're not trying at all, we're just lucky.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We're trying, honestly, and it's been fun.

npcLine.en: This rivalry has made trivia night even more exciting than before.
npcLine.zh: 这份竞争让知识问答之夜比以前更精彩了。

choices.text: It really has, I love having someone to compete with.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很喜欢有对手一起较量。

choices.text: It hasn't, competition just makes everything worse.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really has, I love having someone to compete with.

npcLine.en: No matter who wins next week, this has become one of my favorite nights.
npcLine.zh: 不管下周谁赢，这已经成了我最喜欢的夜晚之一。

choices.text: No matter who wins, I feel exactly the same way.
choices.zh: 不管谁赢，我也有完全一样的感受。

choices.text: No matter who wins, only winning really matters.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter who wins, I feel exactly the same way.

transition.en: A cooking school advertises a hands-on pasta-making class.
transition.zh: 一家烹饪学校宣传了一堂动手做意面的课程。

npcLine.en: Have you ever made pasta completely from scratch?
npcLine.zh: 你有完全从头做过意面吗？

choices.text: I've never once made it from scratch.
choices.zh: 我从没从头做过。

choices.text: I've made it from scratch every week for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never once made it from scratch.

npcLine.en: This class covers dough, sauce, and plating.
npcLine.zh: 这堂课涵盖面团、酱汁和摆盘。

choices.text: That sounds thorough, let's sign up together.
choices.zh: 这听起来很全面，我们一起报名吧。

choices.text: That sounds unnecessary, let's just eat instant noodles.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That sounds thorough, let's sign up together.

npcLine.en: Let's book the Saturday morning session.
npcLine.zh: 我们订周六上午的场次吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, mornings work well for us.
choices.zh: 好啊，早上对我们来说合适。

choices.text: Let's just pick a random weekday evening instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, mornings work well for us.

transition.en: A passionate Italian chef welcomes the class into the kitchen.
transition.zh: 一位充满热情的意大利厨师把大家迎进了厨房。

scenes.title: Meeting the Chef
scenes.subtitle: 厨房教室 · 认识主厨

npcLine.en: Good pasta starts with just flour, eggs, and patience.
npcLine.zh: 好的意面只需要面粉、鸡蛋和耐心。

choices.text: That sounds simple, but I bet it takes practice.
choices.zh: 听起来挺简单，但我猜需要多加练习。

choices.text: That sounds fake, real pasta needs fancy machines.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That sounds simple, but I bet it takes practice.

npcLine.en: This flour feels finer than what we usually buy.
npcLine.zh: 这种面粉比我们平常买的要更细腻。

choices.text: It does, that should make a smoother dough.
choices.zh: 确实是，这样应该能做出更顺滑的面团。

choices.text: Texture doesn't matter, any flour works the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, that should make a smoother dough.

npcLine.en: Please wash your hands before we start kneading.
npcLine.zh: 开始揉面前请先洗手。

choices.text: Of course, we'll go wash up right now.
choices.zh: 当然，我们现在就去洗手。

choices.text: Sorry, washing hands seems unnecessary for cooking.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Of course, we'll go wash up right now.

transition.en: They take turns kneading a sticky ball of dough on the counter.
transition.zh: 他们轮流在台面上揉一团黏糊糊的面团。

npcLine.en: This dough is stickier than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这面团比我预想的要黏得多。

choices.text: It is, let's add a little more flour.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们再加点面粉吧。

choices.text: Stickiness doesn't matter, let's just leave it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's add a little more flour.

npcLine.en: Can you feel it getting smoother as you knead?
npcLine.zh: 你能感觉到揉着揉着它变得更顺滑了吗？

choices.text: I can, this is honestly kind of satisfying.
choices.zh: 能感觉到，说实话这挺有成就感的。

choices.text: I can't, this still feels exactly the same.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, this is honestly kind of satisfying.

npcLine.en: Let this rest for thirty minutes before rolling it out.
npcLine.zh: 擀面之前先让它醒发三十分钟。

choices.text: Okay, we'll set a timer for that.
choices.zh: 好的，我们设个计时器。

choices.text: Sorry, we'd rather skip resting it entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, we'll set a timer for that.

transition.en: They feed the rested dough through a hand-cranked pasta roller.
transition.zh: 他们把醒好的面团送进一台手摇压面机。

npcLine.en: This sheet is thinner than the last one we made.
npcLine.zh: 这张面皮比我们上一张做的要薄。

choices.text: It is, we're getting better with each try.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们每次都做得更好了。

choices.text: It isn't, this sheet looks exactly the same.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we're getting better with each try.

npcLine.en: Can you turn the crank while I feed the dough in?
npcLine.zh: 我送面团的时候你能摇一下手柄吗？

choices.text: I can, just tell me when to slow down.
choices.zh: 可以，告诉我什么时候该放慢就行。

choices.text: I can't, my arm is already too tired.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, just tell me when to slow down.

npcLine.en: Let's cut this into long, thin noodles now.
npcLine.zh: 我们现在把它切成又长又细的面条吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I've been waiting for this part.
choices.zh: 好啊，我一直在等这一步。

choices.text: Let's leave it as one giant sheet instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I've been waiting for this part.

transition.en: While the pasta rests, they start a simple tomato sauce.
transition.zh: 趁面条静置的时候，他们开始做一款简单的番茄酱汁。

npcLine.en: This sauce needs less garlic than you might think.
npcLine.zh: 这个酱汁需要的大蒜比你想的要少。

choices.text: Good to know, let's add it a little at a time.
choices.zh: 很高兴知道这个，我们一点一点加吧。

choices.text: More garlic is always better, let's dump it all in.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Good to know, let's add it a little at a time.

npcLine.en: Taste it now and tell me what it needs.
npcLine.zh: 现在尝一下，告诉我还需要加点什么。

choices.text: Okay, I think it needs a little more salt.
choices.zh: 好的，我觉得需要再多加点盐。

choices.text: Sorry, tasting food while cooking feels wrong.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I think it needs a little more salt.

npcLine.en: This smells better than any sauce we've made at home.
npcLine.zh: 这闻起来比我们在家做的任何酱汁都要香。

choices.text: It really does, I want to remember this recipe.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我要记住这个食谱。

choices.text: It really doesn't, our sauce at home is always better.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I want to remember this recipe.

transition.en: The fresh noodles hit boiling water for just a couple of minutes.
transition.zh: 新鲜面条只需要在沸水中煮几分钟。

npcLine.en: Fresh pasta cooks much faster than dried pasta does.
npcLine.zh: 新鲜意面煮的速度比干意面要快得多。

choices.text: That's good to know, let's watch it closely.
choices.zh: 很高兴知道这个，我们仔细看着点吧。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just walk away.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's good to know, let's watch it closely.

npcLine.en: It's ready when it floats to the top.
npcLine.zh: 当它浮到水面上就熟了。

choices.text: There it goes, let's pull it out now.
choices.zh: 浮起来了，我们现在就捞出来吧。

choices.text: That's fine, let's just leave it boiling forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → There it goes, let's pull it out now.

npcLine.en: Save some pasta water before draining it.
npcLine.zh: 沥水前留一些煮面水。

choices.text: Got it, I'll scoop some out right now.
choices.zh: 明白了，我现在就舀一点出来。

choices.text: Sorry, pasta water seems completely useless.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Got it, I'll scoop some out right now.

transition.en: The chef demonstrates how to twirl noodles into a neat plated pile.
transition.zh: 主厨示范了如何把面条卷成整齐的一堆摆盘。

npcLine.en: This twirling technique looks harder than it actually is.
npcLine.zh: 这个卷面技巧看起来比实际做起来要难。

choices.text: Let's give it a try and see for ourselves.
choices.zh: 我们试试看吧，自己感受一下。

choices.text: Let's just pile it on messily instead.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Let's give it a try and see for ourselves.

npcLine.en: Yours looks more elegant than mine, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，你摆的看起来比我的更精致。

choices.text: No way, yours has its own kind of charm.
choices.zh: 才不是呢，你的也有自己的一种魅力。

choices.text: That's true, mine looks like a total mess.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → No way, yours has its own kind of charm.

npcLine.en: Add a little fresh basil right on top.
npcLine.zh: 在最上面加一点新鲜罗勒叶。

choices.text: Perfect, that'll add a nice pop of color.
choices.zh: 太好了，这样能增添一抹亮色。

choices.text: Sorry, basil seems unnecessary for this dish.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Perfect, that'll add a nice pop of color.

transition.en: The whole class sits down together to taste what they made.
transition.zh: 全班一起坐下品尝自己做的成果。

scenes.title: Tasting Their Creation
scenes.subtitle: 厨房教室 · 品尝成果

npcLine.en: This tastes better than any pasta I've ever ordered at a restaurant.
npcLine.zh: 这味道比我在餐厅点过的任何意面都要好。

choices.text: It really does, this beats any restaurant, honestly.
choices.zh: 确实如此，说实话这比任何餐厅都好吃。

choices.text: It really doesn't, restaurant pasta always wins.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I can't believe we made this.

npcLine.en: The texture is chewier than store-bought pasta too.
npcLine.zh: 口感也比买来的意面更有嚼劲。

choices.text: It is, and honestly that's exactly how I like it.
choices.zh: 确实是，说实话我就喜欢这种口感。

choices.text: It isn't, this tastes exactly like the boxed stuff.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, and honestly that's exactly how I like it.

npcLine.en: We actually made a full meal from scratch, together.
npcLine.zh: 我们真的一起从头做出了一顿完整的饭。

choices.text: We did, and I'm honestly really proud of us.
choices.zh: 确实是，说实话我为我们感到骄傲。

choices.text: We didn't, most of this was actually pre-made.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → We did, and I'm honestly really proud of us.

transition.en: They leave with a printed recipe card and a bag of flour.
transition.zh: 他们带着一张打印的食谱卡和一袋面粉离开了。

scenes.title: Taking the Recipe Home
scenes.subtitle: 厨房教室 · 带食谱回家

npcLine.en: Should we try making this again at home next weekend?
npcLine.zh: 我们下周末要不要在家再做一次？

choices.text: Yes, let's definitely give it a try.
choices.zh: 好，我们一定要试一试。

choices.text: No, once was already more than enough.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's definitely give it a try.

npcLine.en: Doing it at home will probably be trickier without help.
npcLine.zh: 在家没人帮忙做，大概会更棘手一些。

choices.text: Probably, but we'll figure it out together.
choices.zh: 大概会，但我们会一起想办法解决的。

choices.text: Probably, so let's just never try it again.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Probably, but we'll figure it out together.

npcLine.en: Let's invite friends over when we make it.
npcLine.zh: 我们做的时候把朋友们请过来吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, homemade pasta night sounds fun.
choices.zh: 好啊，自制意面之夜听起来很有意思。

choices.text: Let's just keep it to ourselves this time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, homemade pasta night sounds fun.

transition.en: Homemade pasta night quietly becomes a monthly favorite.
transition.zh: 自制意面之夜悄悄成了每月最爱的活动。

scenes.title: A New Favorite Tradition
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 新的最爱传统

npcLine.en: We've made this three times now, and it's gotten easier each time.
npcLine.zh: 我们已经做了三次了，一次比一次容易。

choices.text: We really have, practice is honestly paying off.
choices.zh: 确实如此，说实话练习真的有了回报。

choices.text: We really haven't, it feels harder each time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really have, practice is honestly paying off.

npcLine.en: This has become one of our favorite things to do together.
npcLine.zh: 这已经成了我们最喜欢一起做的事情之一。

choices.text: It really has, I love that we found this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，很高兴我们发现了这件事。

choices.text: It really hasn't, this still feels like a chore.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → It really has, I love that we found this.

npcLine.en: No matter how many times we make it, this still feels special.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们做了多少次，这依然感觉很特别。

choices.text: No matter how many times, I hope it always does.
choices.zh: 不管多少次，我希望它永远都是如此。

choices.text: No matter how many times, it's getting boring now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many times, I hope it always does.

transition.en: A local photographer offers a beginner walk-and-shoot workshop.
transition.zh: 一位本地摄影师开设了一堂适合初学者的摄影漫步课。

scenes.title: Signing Up for Photo Walk
scenes.subtitle: 手机 · 报名摄影漫步课

npcLine.en: Have you ever used a camera besides your phone?
npcLine.zh: 除了手机你用过相机吗？

choices.text: I've never once used a real camera before.
choices.zh: 我以前从没用过真正的相机。

choices.text: I've used one professionally for many years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never once used a real camera before.

npcLine.en: This workshop lends out cameras for the day.
npcLine.zh: 这堂课当天会提供相机借用。

choices.text: That's convenient, we don't need to buy anything.
choices.zh: 这挺方便的，我们不用买任何东西。

choices.text: That's unnecessary, phone cameras are always better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's convenient, we don't need to buy anything.

npcLine.en: Let's sign up for the Sunday morning session.
npcLine.zh: 我们报周日上午的场次吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, morning light sounds beautiful.
choices.zh: 好啊，早晨的光线听起来很美。

choices.text: Let's just skip mornings and sleep in instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, morning light sounds beautiful.

transition.en: They collect borrowed cameras and get a quick orientation.
transition.zh: 他们领取了借用的相机，并接受了简短的入门讲解。

npcLine.en: This camera is heavier than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这台相机比我预想的要重。

choices.text: It is, I'll need to hold it with both hands.
choices.zh: 确实是，我得用两只手拿着了。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's just hold it loosely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I'll need to hold it with both hands.

npcLine.en: Can you find the shutter button on top?
npcLine.zh: 你能在顶部找到快门按钮吗？

choices.text: I can, right here where my finger naturally rests.
choices.zh: 可以，就在我手指自然放的地方。

choices.text: I can't, this camera has no buttons at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, right here where my finger naturally rests.

npcLine.en: Please keep the camera strap around your neck at all times.
npcLine.zh: 请一直把相机带挂在脖子上。

choices.text: Got it, I'll keep it on the whole time.
choices.zh: 明白了，我会一直挂着的。

choices.text: Sorry, straps seem uncomfortable and unnecessary.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Got it, I'll keep it on the whole time.

transition.en: The instructor explains a few basic camera settings.
transition.zh: 讲师讲解了几个基本的相机设置。

scenes.title: Learning the Basics
scenes.subtitle: 公园 · 学习基础知识

npcLine.en: A wider aperture lets in more light than a narrow one.
npcLine.zh: 更大的光圈比更小的光圈能进更多光。

choices.text: That makes sense, useful for darker scenes.
choices.zh: 有道理，在光线暗的场景下很有用。

choices.text: That's odd, aperture never affects light at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, useful for darker scenes.

npcLine.en: A faster shutter speed freezes motion more than a slow one.
npcLine.zh: 更快的快门速度比慢速快门更能定格动态画面。

choices.text: That's helpful, good for photographing our toddler.
choices.zh: 这很有帮助，很适合给我们孩子拍照。

choices.text: Shutter speed doesn't matter for that at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's helpful, good for photographing our toddler.

npcLine.en: Let's practice adjusting these settings before we start walking.
npcLine.zh: 开始走之前我们先练习一下调整这些设置吧。

choices.text: Good idea, let's get comfortable with the dials.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们先熟悉一下这些旋钮。

choices.text: Let's skip that and just figure it out later.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, let's get comfortable with the dials.

transition.en: They pause at a fountain to compose their first real photo.
transition.zh: 他们在一座喷泉旁停下，构图拍下第一张真正的照片。

scenes.title: Framing the First Shot
scenes.subtitle: 公园 · 构图第一张照片

npcLine.en: Try placing the fountain slightly off-center.
npcLine.zh: 试着把喷泉放在稍微偏离中心的位置。

choices.text: Okay, I'll shift it a little to the left.
choices.zh: 好的，我会把它往左边挪一点。

choices.text: Sorry, centering everything feels more natural.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'll shift it a little to the left.

npcLine.en: This angle looks better than the one from straight ahead.
npcLine.zh: 这个角度比正面拍要好看。

choices.text: It does, angles really do change everything.
choices.zh: 确实是，角度真的能改变一切。

choices.text: It doesn't, angles never actually matter much.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, angles really do change everything.

npcLine.en: Let's take a few shots and compare them after.
npcLine.zh: 我们多拍几张，之后再比较一下吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, we can pick the best one later.
choices.zh: 好啊，之后可以选出最好的那张。

choices.text: Let's just take one photo and move on.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, we can pick the best one later.

transition.en: The instructor points out how golden the morning light looks.
transition.zh: 讲师指出早晨的光线显得多么金黄。

npcLine.en: This morning light is softer than midday sun.
npcLine.zh: 这清晨的光线比正午的阳光更柔和。

choices.text: It is, that's why photographers love this time.
choices.zh: 确实是，这也是摄影师喜欢这个时段的原因。

choices.text: Light doesn't matter, let's shoot at noon instead.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that's why photographers love this time.

npcLine.en: Can you position yourself so the light hits your subject?
npcLine.zh: 你能站个位置，让光线照到拍摄对象上吗？

choices.text: I can, let me move a little to the right.
choices.zh: 可以，我往右边挪一点。

choices.text: I can't, positioning myself sounds too complicated.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me move a little to the right.

npcLine.en: This shot came out better than I expected it would.
npcLine.zh: 这张照片拍出来比我预想的要好。

choices.text: It really did, look at how the light glows.
choices.zh: 确实如此，看看这光线多么柔美地发亮。

choices.text: It really didn't, this photo looks completely blurry.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, look at how the light glows.

transition.en: The instructor encourages the group to try candid street photography.
transition.zh: 讲师鼓励大家尝试抓拍街头人物。

npcLine.en: Should we ask people before taking their picture?
npcLine.zh: 拍照之前我们要不要先问一下对方？

choices.text: Yes, let's always ask first out of respect.
choices.zh: 好，出于尊重我们总要先问一下。

choices.text: No, let's just snap photos of anyone we see.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's always ask first out of respect.

npcLine.en: This is more nerve-wracking than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这比我预想的要更让人紧张。

choices.text: It is, but people are usually nicer than we think.
choices.zh: 确实是，但人们通常比我们想的要友善。

choices.text: It is, so let's just avoid this entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but people are usually nicer than we think.

npcLine.en: That baker let us photograph him working, that was lucky.
npcLine.zh: 那位面包师让我们拍他工作的样子，运气不错。

choices.text: That was lucky, and honestly a great shot too.
choices.zh: 确实幸运，说实话也是张很棒的照片。

choices.text: That was unlucky, we should have avoided him.

n3.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → That was lucky, and honestly a great shot too.

transition.en: They struggle to capture a moving bicycle without blur.
transition.zh: 他们努力想拍出一辆移动的自行车却不糊掉。

scenes.title: A Tricky Shot
scenes.subtitle: 街上 · 棘手的一张照片

npcLine.en: This shot is trickier than the still photos we took earlier.
npcLine.zh: 这张照片比我们之前拍的静态照片要棘手。

choices.text: It is, moving subjects are a lot harder to capture.
choices.zh: 确实是，移动的对象拍起来难多了。

choices.text: It isn't, this feels exactly as easy as before.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, moving subjects are a lot harder to capture.

npcLine.en: If you use a faster shutter speed, it might freeze better.
npcLine.zh: 如果你用更快的快门速度，可能会定格得更好。

choices.text: If that helps, let's try adjusting it now.
choices.zh: 如果有帮助，我们现在就调整一下试试。

npcLine.en: That's it, sharp and perfectly timed!
npcLine.zh: 就是这样，清晰又时机完美！

choices.text: We actually got it, I'm really proud of that shot.

transition.en: Back at the studio, they scroll through everything they captured.

npcLine.en: We took more photos than I ever thought we would today.

choices.text: We really did, it's hard to pick a favorite.
choices.zh: 确实如此，很难挑出最喜欢的一张。

choices.text: We really didn't, we barely took any photos.

npcLine.en: This one turned out sharper than I remembered taking it.

choices.text: It really did, this might be my favorite one.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这可能是我最喜欢的一张。

choices.text: It didn't, this photo looks completely blurry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, this might be my favorite one.

npcLine.en: Let's print our favorites to hang up at home.
npcLine.zh: 我们把最喜欢的几张洗出来挂在家里吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, that's a lovely idea.
choices.zh: 好啊，这个主意真不错。

choices.text: Let's just leave them on our phones forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, that's a lovely idea.

transition.en: Walking home, they notice details they'd never seen before.
transition.zh: 走回家的路上，他们注意到了以前从未察觉的细节。

scenes.title: A New Lens on the City
scenes.subtitle: 街上 · 用新眼光看城市

npcLine.en: I'm noticing so many details I never saw before.
npcLine.zh: 我注意到了这么多以前从没发现的细节。

choices.text: Same here, this city looks different today.
choices.zh: 我也是，今天这座城市看起来不一样了。

choices.text: I'm not noticing anything different at all.

choices.text: It really did, in the best possible way.
choices.zh: 确实如此，而且是最好的那种改变。

choices.text: It really didn't, nothing feels any different.

n2.hintOnWrong: 过去时回应 → It really did, in the best possible way.

transition.en: That evening, they use their new skills to frame a family photo.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们用新学到的技巧拍了一张全家福。

npcLine.zh: 我们用窗户的自然光，别用闪光灯吧。

choices.text: Good idea, natural light looks so much softer.
choices.zh: 好主意，自然光看起来柔和多了。

choices.text: Let's just use the flash, it's simpler.

n1.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, natural light looks so much softer.

npcLine.en: This photo turned out warmer than any we've taken before.
npcLine.zh: 这张照片拍出来的色调比我们以前拍的都要温暖。

choices.text: It really did, I want to frame this one.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我想把这张裱起来。

choices.text: It really didn't, this photo looks completely cold.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, I want to frame this one.

npcLine.en: No matter how many photos we take, this one might be my favorite.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们拍多少张照片，这张可能都会是我最喜欢的。

choices.text: No matter how many, I feel exactly the same way.
choices.zh: 不管拍多少张，我也有完全一样的感受。

choices.text: No matter how many, none of them really matter.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many, I feel exactly the same way.

transition.en: A karate studio nearby offers a free trial class for families.
transition.zh: 附近一家空手道馆提供免费的亲子体验课。

choices.text: I think so, kids' classes are usually pretty gentle.
choices.zh: 我觉得可以，儿童课程通常都挺温和的。

choices.text: No, martial arts are only for adults.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → I think so, kids' classes are usually pretty gentle.

npcLine.en: This studio teaches discipline as much as physical skills.

choices.text: That's appealing, structure could be good for them.
choices.zh: 这挺吸引人的，结构感对他们可能有好处。

choices.text: That's boring, kids just need to run around.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's appealing, structure could be good for them.

npcLine.en: Let's all try the family trial class together.
npcLine.zh: 我们一起试试这堂亲子体验课吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this could be fun for all of us.
choices.zh: 好啊，这对我们大家来说都会很有意思。

choices.text: Let's not, only kids should join classes like this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this could be fun for all of us.

transition.en: They change into borrowed uniforms, feeling a bit silly.
transition.zh: 他们换上借来的道服，感觉有点滑稽。

npcLine.en: This uniform feels stiffer than regular clothes.
npcLine.zh: 这套道服比平常的衣服要硬挺一些。

choices.text: It does, but it looks pretty official.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过看起来挺正式的。

choices.text: Stiffness doesn't matter, let's just wear our own clothes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, but it looks pretty official.

npcLine.en: Can you help me tie this belt correctly?
npcLine.zh: 你能帮我把这条腰带系对吗？

choices.text: I can, let me show you the knot.
choices.zh: 可以，我来教你这个结。

choices.text: I can't, belts are impossible to figure out.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me show you the knot.

npcLine.en: We all look more official than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 我们都比我预想的看起来更专业了。

choices.text: We really do, we look like a real family team.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们看起来像真正的一家人小团队。

choices.text: We really don't, we all look ridiculous.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We really do, we look like a real family team.

transition.en: The instructor teaches proper bowing before class begins.
transition.zh: 上课前教练教了正确的鞠躬礼仪。

npcLine.en: Please bow whenever you enter or leave the mat.
npcLine.zh: 进出垫子时请一定要鞠躬。

choices.text: Understood, we'll remember to bow every time.
choices.zh: 明白了，我们会每次都记得鞠躬的。

choices.text: Sorry, bowing seems too formal for us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Understood, we'll remember to bow every time.

npcLine.en: This ceremony feels more meaningful than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个仪式比我预想的更有意义。

choices.text: It does, respect really is at the heart of this.
choices.zh: 确实是，尊重确实是这一切的核心。

choices.text: It doesn't, this feels completely unnecessary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, respect really is at the heart of this.

choices.text: That's adorable, they're taking this so seriously.
choices.zh: 太可爱了，他们对这个真的很认真。

choices.text: That's odd, they should just skip this part.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's adorable, they're taking this so seriously.

transition.en: Everyone practices standing in a low, balanced fighting stance.
transition.zh: 大家都在练习一个低而平衡的格斗站姿。

npcLine.en: This stance is harder to hold than it looks.
npcLine.zh: 这个站姿比看起来要难保持。

choices.text: It is, my legs are already shaking a little.
choices.zh: 确实是，我的腿已经开始有点抖了。

choices.text: It isn't, this feels completely effortless.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, my legs are already shaking a little.

npcLine.en: Keep your knees bent and your weight balanced.
npcLine.zh: 膝盖保持弯曲，重心保持平衡。

choices.text: Okay, I'll try to stay low like this.
choices.zh: 好的，我会尽量保持这么低。

choices.text: Sorry, I'd rather just stand up straight.

n2.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应请求 → Okay, I'll try to stay low like this.

npcLine.en: You're holding this better than you did a minute ago.
npcLine.zh: 你现在保持得比一分钟前要好了。

choices.text: Thanks, I think I'm finding my balance.
choices.zh: 谢谢，我觉得我开始找到平衡感了。

choices.text: Thanks, though I feel exactly the same as before.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thanks, I think I'm finding my balance.

transition.en: They line up to practice basic punches into the air.
transition.zh: 他们排成一列，练习朝空中出拳的基本动作。

npcLine.en: Snap your punch back faster than you throw it out.
npcLine.zh: 收拳的速度要比出拳的速度更快。

choices.text: Got it, that actually feels more natural.
choices.zh: 明白了，这样其实感觉更自然。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just punch slowly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Got it, that actually feels more natural.

npcLine.en: Your form is looking sharper than it was a few minutes ago.
npcLine.zh: 你的动作比几分钟前要利落多了。

choices.text: Thanks, I'm honestly starting to enjoy this.
choices.zh: 谢谢，说实话我开始喜欢上这个了。

choices.text: Thanks, though nothing has really changed.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thanks, I'm honestly starting to enjoy this.

choices.zh: 好啊，这有助于我们保持节奏。

choices.text: Let's just punch silently instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it helps us stay in rhythm.

npcLine.zh: 那块板碎得比我预想的要容易。

choices.text: It did, though I bet it still takes real skill.

choices.text: It didn't, that board was completely unbreakable.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It did, though I bet it still takes real skill.

choices.text: That makes sense, focus over force, I like that.

choices.text: That's odd, strength should always matter most.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That makes sense, focus over force, I like that.

scenes.subtitle: 道馆 · 孩子的第一次踢腿

choices.text: Mine too, but that was honestly a great workout.

choices.text: It really did, we should keep coming back.

choices.text: It really didn't, once was more than enough.

choices.text: Let's do that, this could be our new family thing.

choices.text: We really haven't, nothing about us has changed.

npcLine.zh: 自从我们一起训练以来，我们的孩子更崇拜我们了。

choices.text: That's true, and I love that we're learning together.

choices.text: That's not true, they don't notice this at all.

choices.text: No matter how far, that memory will always be special.

npcLine.en: Has our toddler ever seen a real shark before?
npcLine.zh: 我们家孩子见过真正的鲨鱼吗？

choices.text: They've never seen one, only in picture books.
choices.zh: 他们从没见过，只在绘本里看过。

choices.text: They've seen sharks every single week this year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → They've never seen one, only in picture books.

choices.text: That sounds exciting, they'll love touching things.

choices.text: That sounds unsanitary, let's avoid that area.

transition.zh: 他们走过一条玻璃隧道，四周环绕着游动的鲨鱼。

npcLine.en: These sharks are closer than I ever expected to get.
npcLine.zh: 这些鲨鱼离得比我曾经预想的要近得多。

choices.text: They are, this glass is doing a lot of work.

choices.text: They aren't, this glass feels far too thin.

choices.text: I see it, this is honestly incredible.

choices.text: I don't see anything up there at all.

choices.text: They really aren't, they look completely bored.

npcLine.zh: 你能只用两根手指轻轻摸它吗？

choices.text: It does, I thought they'd feel much smoother.

choices.text: They really don't, they just float around aimlessly.

choices.text: It isn't, this tank looks completely dark.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this is oddly relaxing.

transition.en: A keeper announces it's almost time for penguin feeding.
transition.zh: 一位饲养员宣布快到企鹅喂食的时间了。

npcLine.en: These penguins are noisier than I expected them to be.
npcLine.zh: 这些企鹅比我预想的要更吵闹。

choices.text: They are, but it's honestly kind of charming.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过说实话还挺有魅力的。

choices.text: They aren't, they're completely silent right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, but it's honestly kind of charming.

npcLine.en: This one is waddling faster than the others toward the fish.
npcLine.zh: 这只朝着鱼摇摇摆摆走得比其他企鹅要快。

choices.text: It is, that one is clearly the hungriest.
choices.zh: 确实是，那只显然是最饿的。

choices.text: It isn't, all of them are moving at the same speed.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that one is clearly the hungriest.

npcLine.en: Our toddler is laughing harder than I've ever heard them laugh.
npcLine.zh: 我们家孩子笑得比我听过的任何时候都要大声。

choices.text: They really are, this is the best part of the day.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这是今天最棒的部分。

choices.text: They really aren't, they seem completely uninterested.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, this is the best part of the day.

transition.en: By early afternoon, their toddler is fading fast.
transition.zh: 到了下午早些时候，他们家孩子明显开始撑不住了。

scenes.title: A Tired Toddler
scenes.subtitle: 水族馆 · 疲惫的孩子

npcLine.en: They're getting sleepier than I expected this early.
npcLine.zh: 才这么早他们就比我预想的要困了。

choices.text: They are, all this excitement wore them out.
choices.zh: 确实是，今天这些兴奋的活动把他们累坏了。

choices.text: They aren't, they're wide awake and full of energy.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, all this excitement wore them out.

npcLine.en: Should we take a break in the café for a while?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要在咖啡厅休息一会儿？

choices.text: Yes, let's rest and get them a snack.
choices.zh: 好，我们休息一下，给他们买点零食吧。

choices.text: No, let's keep pushing through the whole aquarium.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's rest and get them a snack.

npcLine.en: Let's save the rest of the aquarium for another visit.
npcLine.zh: 剩下的部分我们留到下次再来看吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, there's no need to rush today.
choices.zh: 好啊，今天不用赶时间。

choices.text: Let's push through no matter how tired they are.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, there's no need to rush today.

transition.en: On the way out, they stop by the gift shop for a souvenir.
transition.zh: 出门前，他们顺路去了礼品店买纪念品。

npcLine.en: Which stuffed animal do you want to bring home?
npcLine.zh: 你想带哪个毛绒玩具回家？

choices.text: They're pointing at the little shark, of course.
choices.zh: 他们当然是指着那只小鲨鱼啦。

choices.text: They don't want any toy at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → They're pointing at the little shark, of course.

npcLine.en: This shark toy is softer than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这只鲨鱼玩具比我预想的要软。

choices.text: It is, perfect for cuddling at bedtime.
choices.zh: 确实是，睡前抱着正合适。

choices.text: Softness doesn't matter, let's grab something else.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, perfect for cuddling at bedtime.

npcLine.en: This will be a nice reminder of today.
npcLine.zh: 这会是今天的一个不错的纪念。

choices.text: It will, I hope they keep it forever.
choices.zh: 会的，我希望他们能一直留着。

choices.text: It won't, toys like this get lost immediately.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It will, I hope they keep it forever.

transition.en: Their toddler drifts off within minutes of leaving the parking lot.
transition.zh: 离开停车场没几分钟，孩子就睡着了。

scenes.title: Driving Home Sleepy
scenes.subtitle: 车上 · 昏昏欲睡地回家

npcLine.en: They fell asleep faster than I've ever seen them fall asleep.
npcLine.zh: 他们睡着的速度比我见过的任何时候都要快。

choices.text: That's a good sign, today really wore them out.
choices.zh: 这是个好迹象，今天确实把他们累坏了。

choices.text: That's odd, they usually fight sleep for hours.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's a good sign, today really wore them out.

npcLine.en: Today turned out more magical than I ever expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 今天比我曾经想象的要更加神奇。

choices.text: It really did, watching them discover it all was priceless.
choices.zh: 确实如此，看着他们发现这一切真是无价的。

choices.text: It really didn't, today felt pretty ordinary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, watching them discover it all was priceless.

npcLine.en: No matter how many times we come back, this will always feel special.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们再来多少次，这里都永远会感觉特别。

choices.text: No matter how many times, this place will feel special.
choices.zh: 不管多少次，这里都会让人觉得特别。

choices.text: No matter how many times, it'll get boring eventually.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many times, this place will feel special.

transition.en: That evening, their toddler draws a wobbly picture of a shark.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，孩子画了一幅歪歪扭扭的鲨鱼画。

npcLine.en: Can you believe they remembered every detail like that?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信他们把每个细节都记得这么清楚吗？

choices.text: I honestly can't, kids remember more than we think.
choices.zh: 我真不敢相信，孩子记住的比我们想的要多。

choices.text: I can believe it, this drawing shows nothing at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/惊讶 → I honestly can't, kids remember more than we think.

npcLine.en: This drawing means more to me than any photo we took today.
npcLine.zh: 这幅画对我的意义比我们今天拍的任何照片都要大。

choices.text: It really does, I want to keep this one forever.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我想把这幅永远留着。

choices.text: It doesn't, photos are always more valuable.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I want to keep this one forever.

npcLine.en: Let's put this on the fridge where we'll see it every day.
npcLine.zh: 我们把它贴在冰箱上，这样每天都能看到。

choices.text: Let's do that, this deserves a place of honor.
choices.zh: 好啊，这值得一个特别的位置。

choices.text: Let's just put it in a drawer somewhere.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this deserves a place of honor.

transition.en: A telescope arrives in a large cardboard box on the porch.
transition.zh: 一台望远镜装在一个大纸箱里送到了门廊上。

npcLine.en: Have you ever set up a telescope before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前架设过望远镜吗？

choices.text: I've never set one up, but I've read the manual.
choices.zh: 我从没架设过，不过我读过说明书了。

choices.text: I've set up dozens of telescopes every week.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never set one up, but I've read the manual.

npcLine.en: This lens is heavier than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这个镜片比我预想的要重。

choices.text: It is, let's be careful carrying it outside.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们搬出去的时候要小心点。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's just toss it around.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's be careful carrying it outside.

npcLine.en: Let's set it up in the backyard tonight.
npcLine.zh: 我们今晚就在后院把它架起来吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, the sky looks clear tonight.
choices.zh: 好啊，今晚天空看起来很清朗。

choices.text: Let's just leave it in the box for now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, the sky looks clear tonight.

transition.en: In the backyard, they try to locate the North Star.
transition.zh: 在后院，他们试着找到北极星。

npcLine.en: Can you spot the Big Dipper from here?
npcLine.zh: 你能从这里认出北斗七星吗？

choices.text: I can, it's right above those trees.
choices.zh: 我能看到，就在那些树的正上方。

choices.text: I can't see any stars from this house.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's right above those trees.

npcLine.en: This star looks brighter than all the others tonight.
npcLine.zh: 这颗星今晚看起来比其他所有的都要亮。

choices.text: It does, that must be the North Star.
choices.zh: 确实是，那一定是北极星。

choices.text: Brightness doesn't matter, let's ignore it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, that must be the North Star.

npcLine.en: Sailors used to navigate by this star alone.
npcLine.zh: 水手们过去仅靠这颗星来导航。

choices.text: That's amazing, imagine trusting just one star.
choices.zh: 太神奇了，想象一下只靠一颗星就能信任导航。

choices.text: That's boring, one star can't guide anyone.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's amazing, imagine trusting just one star.

transition.en: Through the lens, the moon's craters suddenly come into focus.
transition.zh: 透过镜头，月球上的环形山突然变得清晰起来。

npcLine.en: These craters look more detailed than I ever imagined.
npcLine.zh: 这些环形山看起来比我曾经想象的要更加清晰。

choices.text: They really do, I can see every little shadow.
choices.zh: 确实如此，每一处小阴影我都能看到。

choices.text: They really don't, this just looks like a blur.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really do, I can see every little shadow.

npcLine.en: Is our toddler tall enough to look through the eyepiece?
npcLine.zh: 我们家孩子够高能看到目镜里吗？

choices.text: Almost, let's lift them up for a peek.
choices.zh: 差不多了，我们把他们抱起来看一眼吧。

choices.text: Not at all, let's just skip it entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定倾向回答 → Almost, let's lift them up for a peek.

npcLine.en: Look, look, I can see the moon so close!
npcLine.zh: 快看快看，我能看到月亮离得好近！

choices.text: Isn't it amazing how close it looks?
choices.zh: 是不是很神奇它看起来这么近？

choices.text: It's not that close, don't get excited.

n3.hintOnWrong: 呼应孩子的兴奋 → Isn't it amazing how close it looks?

transition.en: Using an app, they try to identify constellations overhead.
transition.zh: 他们用一个应用尝试识别头顶的星座。

npcLine.en: Which constellation is that bright cluster over there?
npcLine.zh: 那边那一片亮亮的星群是哪个星座？

choices.text: The app says that's Orion, the hunter.
choices.zh: 应用说那是猎户座，猎人星座。

choices.text: It doesn't have a name at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答 → The app says that's Orion, the hunter.

npcLine.en: This constellation is easier to spot than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个星座比我预想的要更容易找到。

choices.text: It is, those three stars in a line really stand out.
choices.zh: 确实是，那三颗排成一线的星特别显眼。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just move on.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, those three stars in a line really stand out.

npcLine.en: Ancient people told stories about these star patterns.
npcLine.zh: 古人围绕这些星群图案讲述了很多故事。

choices.text: They did, I'd love to learn a few of them.
choices.zh: 确实是，我很想学几个这样的故事。

choices.text: They didn't, ancient people never looked up.

n3.hintOnWrong: 一般过去时回应 → They did, I'd love to learn a few of them.

transition.en: A sudden streak of light flashes across the sky.
transition.zh: 一道突然的光线划过天空。

npcLine.en: Did you see that, it moved faster than lightning!
npcLine.zh: 你看到了吗，它划过得比闪电还快！

choices.text: I saw it, make a wish quickly!
choices.zh: 我看到了，快许个愿吧！

choices.text: I didn't see anything unusual at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 一般过去时回应 → I saw it, make a wish quickly!

npcLine.en: What did you wish for just now?
npcLine.zh: 你刚才许了什么愿？

choices.text: I wished for more nights like this one.
choices.zh: 我许愿希望能有更多像今晚这样的夜晚。

choices.text: I didn't wish for anything at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答过去时 → I wished for more nights like this one.

npcLine.en: If we stay longer, we might see another one.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们多待一会儿，也许还能再看到一颗。

choices.text: If we stay, I'd love to see another too.
choices.zh: 如果我们多待，我也很想再看到一颗。

choices.text: If we stay, nothing else will happen.

n3.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If we stay, I'd love to see another too.

transition.en: That week, they learn a meteor shower peaks this weekend.
transition.zh: 那周他们得知这个周末会有一场流星雨的高峰。

scenes.title: Checking the Meteor Shower Schedule
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 查看流星雨时间表

npcLine.en: The meteor shower will peak around midnight on Saturday.
npcLine.zh: 这场流星雨会在周六午夜前后达到高峰。

choices.text: We'll definitely stay up to watch that.
choices.zh: 我们一定要熬夜看这个。

choices.text: We'll definitely sleep straight through it.

n1.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We'll definitely stay up to watch that.

npcLine.en: Should we let our toddler stay up that late?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要让孩子那么晚还不睡？

choices.text: Just this once, it's a rare event.
choices.zh: 就这一次吧，这是件难得的事。

choices.text: Never, bedtime rules can't ever bend.

n2.hintOnWrong: 折中回答 → Just this once, it's a rare event.

npcLine.en: Let's bring blankets and lie in the grass together.
npcLine.zh: 我们带上毯子，一起躺在草地上吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it sounds perfectly cozy.
choices.zh: 好啊，听起来会很惬意。

choices.text: Let's just watch it through the window instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it sounds perfectly cozy.

transition.en: Lying on blankets, they count streaks of light overhead.
transition.zh: 躺在毯子上，他们数着头顶划过的道道光痕。

npcLine.en: How many have we counted so far tonight?
npcLine.zh: 我们今晚到目前为止数到多少颗了？

choices.text: We've counted twelve, and it's still early.
choices.zh: 我们数到十二颗了，而且还早呢。

choices.text: We haven't counted a single one tonight.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → We've counted twelve, and it's still early.

npcLine.en: This is more meteors than I've ever seen in one night.
npcLine.zh: 这是我一夜之间见过最多的流星了。

choices.text: It really is, tonight was worth every minute.
choices.zh: 确实如此，今晚每一分钟都值得。

choices.text: It really isn't, tonight has been disappointing.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, tonight was worth every minute.

npcLine.en: No matter how tired we are tomorrow, this was worth it.
npcLine.zh: 不管明天有多累，今晚都是值得的。

choices.text: No matter how tired, I'd do this again.
choices.zh: 不管多累，我都愿意再来一次。

choices.text: No matter how tired, we shouldn't have come.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how tired, I'd do this again.

transition.en: Well past midnight, they carry their sleepy toddler back indoors.
transition.zh: 过了午夜很久，他们把昏昏欲睡的孩子抱回了屋里。

scenes.title: A Sleepy Drive Inside
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 昏睡着抱回屋

npcLine.en: They fell asleep faster than I expected out there.
npcLine.zh: 他们在外面睡着的速度比我预想的要快。

choices.text: They did, the fresh air must have helped.
choices.zh: 确实是，新鲜空气一定帮了忙。

choices.text: They didn't, they stayed awake the entire time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They did, the fresh air must have helped.

npcLine.en: Someday they'll remember this as their first meteor shower.
npcLine.zh: 将来他们会记得这是自己第一次看流星雨。

choices.text: They will, and I hope they cherish it.
choices.zh: 会的，希望他们能珍惜这份记忆。

choices.text: They won't, toddlers forget everything instantly.

n2.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → They will, and I hope they cherish it.

npcLine.en: Let's plan to do this again for the next shower.
npcLine.zh: 我们再计划一次，等下次流星雨再来吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'll set a reminder for the date.
choices.zh: 好啊，我会为那个日期设个提醒。

choices.text: Let's forget about it until it happens again.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'll set a reminder for the date.

transition.en: The next day, they hang a glow-in-the-dark star chart in the nursery.
transition.zh: 第二天，他们在婴儿房挂了一张夜光星图。

scenes.title: A Star Chart on the Wall
scenes.subtitle: 婴儿房 · 墙上的星图

npcLine.en: This chart will glow once the lights go off.
npcLine.zh: 灯关掉之后这张图就会发光。

choices.text: It will, they'll love falling asleep under stars.
choices.zh: 会的，他们会喜欢在星空下入睡的。

choices.text: It won't, this material doesn't actually glow.

n1.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, they'll love falling asleep under stars.

npcLine.en: Can you find Orion on this little chart too?
npcLine.zh: 你能在这张小图上也找到猎户座吗？

choices.text: I can, right there next to the moon.
choices.zh: 我能找到，就在月亮旁边。

choices.text: I can't find any shapes on this chart.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, right there next to the moon.

npcLine.en: This will be their whole universe every night now.
npcLine.zh: 从现在起这会是他们每晚的整片宇宙。

choices.text: It will, and what a lovely one to have.
choices.zh: 会的，能拥有这样一片天空真美好。

choices.text: It won't, they'll ignore it completely.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, and what a lovely one to have.

transition.en: They start researching a dark-sky park for their next trip.
transition.zh: 他们开始研究一个暗夜公园，作为下次出游的目的地。

scenes.title: Planning the Next Stargazing Trip
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 计划下次观星之旅

npcLine.en: This park is farther from city lights than anywhere nearby.
npcLine.zh: 这个公园比附近任何地方都离城市灯光更远。

choices.text: That's perfect, the sky should be incredibly clear.
choices.zh: 太完美了，那里的天空应该会非常清澈。

choices.text: Distance doesn't matter, let's just stay home instead.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's perfect, the sky should be incredibly clear.

npcLine.en: Should we camp overnight or just drive there for the evening?
npcLine.zh: 我们要露营过夜，还是傍晚开车过去就行？

choices.text: Let's camp, it'll make the whole trip better.
choices.zh: 我们露营吧，这会让整趟旅程更棒。

choices.text: Neither one, let's cancel the whole trip.

n2.hintOnWrong: 选择性回答 → Let's camp, it'll make the whole trip better.

npcLine.en: No matter where we go, watching the sky together is what matters.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们去哪里，一起看星空才是最重要的。

choices.text: No matter where, I'll always want that with you.
choices.zh: 不管去哪里，我都会一直想和你一起做这件事。

choices.text: No matter where, the location is all that counts.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter where, I'll always want that with you.

transition.en: They sign up for a weekend beekeeping class at a local farm.
transition.zh: 他们报名参加了当地农场的周末养蜂课。

npcLine.en: Have you ever been stung by a bee before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前被蜜蜂蜇过吗？

choices.text: I've been stung once, but it wasn't too bad.
choices.zh: 我被蜇过一次，不过还不算太糟。

choices.text: I've been stung every single day this year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've been stung once, but it wasn't too bad.

npcLine.en: This protective suit looks bulkier than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这套防护服看起来比我预想的要更笨重。

choices.text: It does, but I feel safer wearing it.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过穿着它我感觉更安全。

choices.text: Comfort doesn't matter, let's skip wearing it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, but I feel safer wearing it.

npcLine.en: Let's stay calm and move slowly around the hives.
npcLine.zh: 我们在蜂箱周围要保持冷静、动作放慢。

choices.text: Good idea, sudden movements might startle them.
choices.zh: 好主意，突然的动作可能会惊到它们。

choices.text: Let's just run past them as fast as possible.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, sudden movements might startle them.

transition.en: The instructor helps them spot the queen bee inside the hive.
transition.zh: 老师帮他们在蜂箱里找到了蜂后。

npcLine.en: Can you spot the queen among all these bees?
npcLine.zh: 你能在这么多蜜蜂里找到蜂后吗？

choices.text: I can, she's the one with the longer body.
choices.zh: 我能找到，就是那只身体比较长的。

choices.text: I can't tell any of these bees apart.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, she's the one with the longer body.

npcLine.en: The queen lays more eggs than any other bee in the hive.
npcLine.zh: 蜂后产的卵比蜂箱里任何其他蜜蜂都要多。

choices.text: She does, thousands a day sometimes.
choices.zh: 确实如此，有时一天能产上千颗。

choices.text: Egg-laying doesn't matter, let's ignore that.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → She does, thousands a day sometimes.

npcLine.en: Worker bees take care of her their whole lives.
npcLine.zh: 工蜂们一生都在照顾她。

choices.text: That's fascinating, the whole hive works around her.
choices.zh: 太有意思了，整个蜂群都是围绕她运转的。

choices.text: That's boring, worker bees do nothing important.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → That's fascinating, the whole hive works around her.

transition.en: At home, they assemble their very first wooden beehive.
transition.zh: 在家里，他们组装了自己第一个木制蜂箱。

scenes.title: Building Their Own Hive
scenes.subtitle: 后院 · 搭建自家蜂箱

npcLine.en: Where should we place the hive in the yard?
npcLine.zh: 我们该把蜂箱放在院子的哪里？

choices.text: Somewhere sunny but away from the walking path.
choices.zh: 找个阳光充足但远离走道的地方。

choices.text: It doesn't matter where at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答地点 → Somewhere sunny but away from the walking path.

npcLine.en: This box is trickier to assemble than the instructions suggested.
npcLine.zh: 这个箱子组装起来比说明书说的要更棘手。

choices.text: It is, let's read the steps again slowly.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们再慢慢读一遍步骤吧。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just guess randomly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's read the steps again slowly.

npcLine.en: Once it's finished, we'll order our first bee colony.
npcLine.zh: 等做完之后，我们就订购第一批蜂群。

choices.text: We will, I'm actually getting excited now.
choices.zh: 会的，我现在真的开始期待了。

choices.text: We won't, let's just leave the box empty.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, I'm actually getting excited now.

transition.en: A small wooden package of buzzing bees arrives by mail.
transition.zh: 一个装着嗡嗡作响的蜜蜂的小木箱通过邮寄到货了。

npcLine.en: This package is buzzing louder than I imagined it would.
npcLine.zh: 这个箱子嗡嗡响得比我想象的要大声。

choices.text: It is, there must be thousands inside.
choices.zh: 确实是，里面一定有成千上万只。

choices.text: Volume doesn't matter, let's just toss it aside.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, there must be thousands inside.

npcLine.en: Should we release them into the hive right away?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要马上把它们放进蜂箱？

choices.text: Yes, but let's move slowly and calmly.
choices.zh: 好，不过我们动作要慢一点、保持冷静。

choices.text: No, let's just leave them in the box forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, but let's move slowly and calmly.

npcLine.en: Welcome home, little bees, we'll take good care of you.
npcLine.zh: 欢迎回家，小蜜蜂们，我们会好好照顾你们的。

choices.text: We really will, this is the start of something new.
choices.zh: 我们真的会，这是新事物的开始。

choices.text: We won't, this whole idea seems pointless now.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We really will, this is the start of something new.

transition.en: Every evening, they watch bees fly in and out of the hive.
transition.zh: 每天傍晚，他们都会看着蜜蜂进出蜂箱。

scenes.title: Watching the Bees Work
scenes.subtitle: 后院 · 观察蜜蜂工作

npcLine.en: These bees are busier in the morning than in the evening.
npcLine.zh: 这些蜜蜂早上比傍晚要忙碌得多。

choices.text: They are, that's when the flowers are freshest.
choices.zh: 确实是，那时候花朵最新鲜。

choices.text: Timing doesn't matter, they're always the same.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, that's when the flowers are freshest.

npcLine.en: Look, that one's legs are covered in yellow pollen!
npcLine.zh: 看，那只的腿上沾满了黄色花粉！

choices.text: I see it, she's carrying a full load home.
choices.zh: 我看到了，她带着满满一包花粉回家呢。

choices.text: I don't see any pollen on any bee.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I see it, she's carrying a full load home.

npcLine.en: This hive is turning nectar into honey right now.
npcLine.zh: 这个蜂箱现在正在把花蜜酿成蜂蜜。

choices.text: It is, imagine how much work that takes.
choices.zh: 是的，想想这需要多少工夫。

choices.text: It isn't, this hive is completely empty.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → It is, imagine how much work that takes.

transition.en: Their curious toddler asks endless questions about the hive.
transition.zh: 好奇的孩子对蜂箱问个不停。

scenes.title: A Toddler Questions the Bees
scenes.subtitle: 后院 · 孩子问蜂箱的问题

npcLine.en: Why do the bees keep going in and out?
npcLine.zh: 为什么蜜蜂一直进进出出？

choices.text: They're bringing flower nectar back to the hive.
choices.zh: 它们在把花蜜带回蜂箱。

choices.text: They just enjoy flying around for no reason.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → They're bringing flower nectar back to the hive.

npcLine.en: Do bees ever get tired from all that flying?
npcLine.zh: 蜜蜂飞这么多会不会累？

choices.text: They probably do, but they rarely stop working.
choices.zh: 它们大概会累，不过它们很少停下工作。

choices.text: They never get tired, bees don't feel anything.

n2.hintOnWrong: 折中回答 → They probably do, but they rarely stop working.

npcLine.en: Can we see the honey they made yet?
npcLine.zh: 我们现在能看到它们酿的蜂蜜了吗？

choices.text: Not yet, we'll have to wait a few more weeks.
choices.zh: 还不行，我们还得再等几周。

choices.text: We can see it right now, it's already full.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表可能性/否定 → Not yet, we'll have to wait a few more weeks.

transition.en: Weeks later, they open the hive to inspect the honeycomb frames.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们打开蜂箱检查蜂巢框架。

scenes.title: Checking the Frames
scenes.subtitle: 后院 · 检查蜂巢框架

npcLine.en: This frame is heavier than the one we checked last time.
npcLine.zh: 这个框架比我们上次检查的那个要重。

choices.text: It is, that means it's full of honey.
choices.zh: 确实是，说明里面装满了蜂蜜。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's put it right back.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that means it's full of honey.

npcLine.en: Look at all these tiny golden hexagon cells.
npcLine.zh: 快看这些细小的金色六边形蜂房。

choices.text: They're so perfectly shaped, it's amazing.
choices.zh: 它们的形状太完美了，真让人惊叹。

choices.text: They're just random shapes, nothing special.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → They're so perfectly shaped, it's amazing.

npcLine.en: If this frame is full, we can harvest it next week.
npcLine.zh: 如果这个框架满了，我们下周就能采蜜了。

choices.text: If it's full, I can't wait to taste it.
choices.zh: 如果满了，我等不及要尝尝了。

choices.text: If it's full, we should just throw it away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If it's full, I can't wait to taste it.

transition.en: The whole family gathers to extract honey for the first time.
transition.zh: 全家人聚在一起第一次采蜜。

npcLine.en: This honey tastes sweeter than anything I've bought at a store.
npcLine.zh: 这蜂蜜比我在商店买的任何蜂蜜都要甜。

choices.text: It really does, I'm so proud of our little hive.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我为我们的小蜂箱感到骄傲。

choices.text: It really doesn't, store honey tastes better.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I'm so proud of our little hive.

npcLine.en: How many jars did we fill from just one hive?
npcLine.zh: 光是一个蜂箱我们就装满了多少罐？

choices.text: We filled six jars, more than I expected.
choices.zh: 我们装满了六罐，比我预想的要多。

choices.text: We didn't fill any jars at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → We filled six jars, more than I expected.

npcLine.en: Let's give a jar to each of our neighbors.
npcLine.zh: 我们给每位邻居送一罐吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, they'll be so surprised.
choices.zh: 好啊，他们一定会很惊喜的。

choices.text: Let's keep every single jar just for ourselves.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, they'll be so surprised.

transition.en: They knock on doors, handing out small jars of golden honey.
transition.zh: 他们挨家挨户敲门，分送一小罐一小罐的金色蜂蜜。

scenes.title: Sharing Honey with Neighbors
scenes.subtitle: 街坊 · 分享自家蜂蜜

npcLine.en: You made this yourselves, from your own backyard bees?
npcLine.zh: 这是你们自己做的，用自家后院的蜜蜂？

choices.text: We did, it's been such a fun project.
choices.zh: 是的，这是个特别有趣的项目。

choices.text: We didn't, we just bought this at a store.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → We did, it's been such a fun project.

npcLine.en: This is more thoughtful than any gift I've received all year.
npcLine.zh: 这比我今年收到的任何礼物都更用心。

choices.text: That means a lot, we're glad you like it.
choices.zh: 这话对我们意义很大，很高兴你喜欢。

choices.text: Thoughtfulness doesn't matter, it's just honey.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That means a lot, we're glad you like it.

npcLine.en: No matter how small the jar, this feels really special.
npcLine.zh: 不管罐子有多小，这份心意都特别珍贵。

choices.text: No matter how small, we made it with love.
choices.zh: 不管多小，都是我们用心做的。

choices.text: No matter how small, it isn't worth much.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how small, we made it with love.

transition.en: As autumn arrives, they prepare the hive for the coming winter.
transition.zh: 秋天到来时，他们开始为即将到来的冬天准备蜂箱。

scenes.title: Preparing the Hive for Winter
scenes.subtitle: 后院 · 为过冬做准备

npcLine.en: We should leave enough honey for the bees to survive winter.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该给蜜蜂留够蜂蜜好让它们过冬。

choices.text: You're right, we shouldn't take it all for ourselves.
choices.zh: 你说得对，我们不应该全都留给自己。

choices.text: That's silly, bees don't need honey to survive.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → You're right, we shouldn't take it all for ourselves.

npcLine.en: This hive will be quieter than it was all summer.
npcLine.zh: 这个蜂箱会比整个夏天都要安静。

choices.text: It will, but they're still working inside.
choices.zh: 会的，不过它们里面还在忙活。

choices.text: It won't, winter changes nothing at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It will, but they're still working inside.

npcLine.en: By next spring, we'll have a whole new season of honey.
npcLine.zh: 到明年春天，我们又会有一整季新蜂蜜了。

choices.text: We will, and I already can't wait for it.
choices.zh: 会的，我已经等不及了。

choices.text: We won't, this hobby is probably over now.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, and I already can't wait for it.

transition.en: A candle-making kit arrives, filled with wax, wicks, and oils.
transition.zh: 一套蜡烛制作套装送到了，里面装着蜡、烛芯和香精油。

scenes.title: The Candle-Making Kit
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 蜡烛制作套装

npcLine.en: Have you ever melted wax before tonight?
npcLine.zh: 你以前有融过蜡吗？

choices.text: I've never melted wax, this is a first for me.
choices.zh: 我从没融过蜡，这对我来说是第一次。

choices.text: I've melted wax hundreds of times every week.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never melted wax, this is a first for me.

npcLine.en: This soy wax feels softer than the beeswax we saw.
npcLine.zh: 这种大豆蜡摸起来比我们看过的蜂蜡要软。

choices.text: It does, it should melt more evenly too.
choices.zh: 确实是，它应该也会熔化得更均匀。

choices.text: Texture doesn't matter, let's just melt it all together.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, it should melt more evenly too.

npcLine.en: Let's read the instructions before we start heating anything.
npcLine.zh: 我们开始加热之前先读一下说明书吧。

choices.text: Good call, safety first with hot wax.
choices.zh: 很有道理，热蜡这件事安全第一。

choices.text: Let's just heat it and figure it out later.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good call, safety first with hot wax.

transition.en: They set up a double boiler and watch the wax slowly liquefy.
transition.zh: 他们架起了一个双层锅，看着蜡慢慢融化成液体。

npcLine.en: This is melting slower than I expected it to.
npcLine.zh: 这融化的速度比我预想的要慢。

choices.text: It is, but low heat keeps it from burning.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过小火能防止它烧焦。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just crank up the heat.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but low heat keeps it from burning.

npcLine.en: Can you check the temperature with this little thermometer?
npcLine.zh: 你能用这个小温度计量一下温度吗？

choices.text: I can, it's almost at the right temperature.
choices.zh: 我可以量，已经快到合适的温度了。

choices.text: I can't read a thermometer at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's almost at the right temperature.

npcLine.en: Once it's fully melted, we'll add the fragrance oil.
npcLine.zh: 等它完全融化，我们就加香精油。

choices.text: We will, I already picked the lavender scent.
choices.zh: 会的，我已经选了薰衣草香味。

choices.text: We won't, let's skip the fragrance entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, I already picked the lavender scent.

transition.en: Little bottles of fragrance oil line the counter, each labeled differently.
transition.zh: 一排排小瓶香精油摆在台面上，各自贴着不同的标签。

npcLine.en: Which scent do you want for our first candle?
npcLine.zh: 我们的第一支蜡烛你想要什么香味？

choices.text: I'd love something warm, like vanilla and cinnamon.
choices.zh: 我想要暖调的香味，像香草和肉桂那样的。

choices.text: I don't want any scent added at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → I'd love something warm, like vanilla and cinnamon.

npcLine.en: This scent is stronger than the sample we smelled earlier.
npcLine.zh: 这个香味比我们之前闻的样品要浓。

choices.text: It is, let's use a little less this time.
choices.zh: 确实是，这次我们少放一点吧。

choices.text: Strength doesn't matter, let's just pour it all in.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's use a little less this time.

npcLine.en: This whole kitchen smells amazing right now.
npcLine.zh: 现在整个厨房闻起来都好香。

choices.text: It does, I could stay in here all night.
choices.zh: 确实是，我能在这里待一整晚。

choices.text: It doesn't, this kitchen smells terrible.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It does, I could stay in here all night.

transition.en: They carefully center a cotton wick inside each small glass jar.
transition.zh: 他们仔细地把棉质烛芯居中放进每个小玻璃罐里。

npcLine.en: Is this wick centered enough in the jar?
npcLine.zh: 这根烛芯在罐子里居中够了吗？

choices.text: Almost, let's nudge it just a bit left.
choices.zh: 差不多了，我们再往左推一点点吧。

choices.text: It doesn't matter where the wick sits.

n1.hintOnWrong: 折中回答 → Almost, let's nudge it just a bit left.

npcLine.en: This wick clip is trickier to use than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个烛芯夹比我预想的要更难用。

choices.text: It is, but I think I've got it now.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过我觉得我现在弄好了。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just skip this step.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but I think I've got it now.

npcLine.en: If the wick isn't straight, the candle won't burn evenly.
npcLine.zh: 如果烛芯不直，蜡烛就不会烧得均匀。

choices.text: If it's crooked, let's fix it before pouring.
choices.zh: 如果歪了，我们倒蜡之前就把它弄直。

choices.text: If it's crooked, that shouldn't matter at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If it's crooked, let's fix it before pouring.

transition.en: Slowly, they pour the warm scented wax into the little jars.
transition.zh: 他们慢慢地把温热的香蜡倒进小罐子里。

npcLine.en: Can you pour it slower so it doesn't splash?
npcLine.zh: 你能倒得慢一点，别让它溅出来吗？

choices.text: I can, steady hands, here we go.
choices.zh: 我可以，稳住手，来吧。

choices.text: I can't pour anything slowly at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, steady hands, here we go.

npcLine.en: This jar is filling up faster than the last one.
npcLine.zh: 这个罐子灌得比上一个要快。

choices.text: It is, I'm pouring a bit more steadily now.
choices.zh: 确实是，我现在倒得更稳一些了。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just dump the rest in.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I'm pouring a bit more steadily now.

npcLine.en: Now we'll let these cool for a few hours.
npcLine.zh: 现在我们要让这些静置冷却几个小时。

choices.text: We will, patience is the hardest part.
choices.zh: 会的，耐心等待是最难的部分。

choices.text: We won't, let's use them right away.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, patience is the hardest part.

transition.en: The candles sit undisturbed on the counter overnight.
transition.zh: 蜡烛整晚都静静地放在台面上，没人去动。

scenes.title: Waiting for the Candles to Set
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 等待蜡烛凝固

npcLine.en: Should we peek at them before we go to bed?
npcLine.zh: 我们睡觉前要不要瞄一眼？

choices.text: Just a quick peek, then we'll leave them alone.
choices.zh: 就瞄一眼，然后我们就不动它们了。

choices.text: No, we should stir them every hour tonight.

n1.hintOnWrong: 折中回答 → Just a quick peek, then we'll leave them alone.

npcLine.en: These are cooling slower than I thought they would.
npcLine.zh: 这些冷却的速度比我预想的要慢。

choices.text: That's fine, good things take a little time.
choices.zh: 没关系，好东西总需要一点时间。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's throw them in the freezer.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's fine, good things take a little time.

npcLine.en: By morning, these will be completely solid.
npcLine.zh: 到早上，这些就会完全凝固了。

choices.text: They will, I can't wait to see them finished.
choices.zh: 会的，我等不及要看到成品了。

choices.text: They won't, wax never actually hardens fully.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → They will, I can't wait to see them finished.

transition.en: The next morning, three finished candles sit smooth and solid.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，三支成品蜡烛光滑而坚实地摆在那里。

npcLine.en: These turned out better than I ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 这些做出来比我曾经预想的要好。

choices.text: They really did, look how smooth the tops are.
choices.zh: 确实如此，看看顶面多光滑。

choices.text: They really didn't, these look messy and uneven.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really did, look how smooth the tops are.

npcLine.en: Should we trim the wicks before lighting one?
npcLine.zh: 点燃之前我们要不要先修剪一下烛芯？

choices.text: Yes, a shorter wick burns more evenly.
choices.zh: 要，短一点的烛芯燃烧得更均匀。

choices.text: No, let's light it exactly as it is.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, a shorter wick burns more evenly.

npcLine.en: Let's light this one tonight and see how it burns.
npcLine.zh: 我们今晚点这一支，看看它燃烧得怎么样。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'm excited to finally see it.
choices.zh: 好啊，我很期待终于能看到效果。

choices.text: Let's just leave them unlit on the shelf forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'm excited to finally see it.

transition.en: That evening, the homemade candle flickers softly on the table.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，自制的蜡烛在桌上轻轻摇曳着微光。

scenes.title: A Cozy Evening Glow
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 温馨的夜晚光影

npcLine.en: This flame is steadier than I expected for a first try.
npcLine.zh: 以第一次尝试来说，这火苗比我预想的要稳定。

choices.text: It is, the wick size must have been just right.
choices.zh: 确实是，烛芯的粗细一定刚刚好。

choices.text: Steadiness doesn't matter, let's blow it out already.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, the wick size must have been just right.

npcLine.en: The whole room smells warmer than usual tonight.
npcLine.zh: 今晚整个房间闻起来比平时更暖。

choices.text: It does, I could get used to this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我可能会习惯这样的感觉。

choices.text: Smell doesn't matter, let's open the windows now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I could get used to this.

npcLine.en: There's something special about making our own light.
npcLine.zh: 自己动手制造光源这件事有种特别的意义。

choices.text: There really is, this feels earned somehow.
choices.zh: 确实是，这感觉像是我们赢得的东西。

choices.text: There isn't, it's just a candle after all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → There really is, this feels earned somehow.

transition.en: They decide to make a bigger batch as holiday gifts.
transition.zh: 他们决定多做一批，当作节日礼物。

scenes.title: Making Candles as Gifts
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 制作礼物蜡烛

npcLine.en: How many candles should we make for everyone?
npcLine.zh: 我们要给大家做多少支蜡烛？

choices.text: Maybe a dozen, one for each family we know.
choices.zh: 大概十二支吧，认识的每个家庭一支。

choices.text: We shouldn't make any candles for anyone.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → Maybe a dozen, one for each family we know.

npcLine.en: This batch is going faster now that we know the steps.
npcLine.zh: 现在我们熟悉步骤了，这批做得更快了。

choices.text: It is, practice really does make a difference.
choices.zh: 确实是，多练习真的很有用。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's slow everything down.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, practice really does make a difference.

npcLine.en: Let's tie a little ribbon around each jar.
npcLine.zh: 我们给每个罐子系一根小丝带吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it'll make them feel more personal.
choices.zh: 好啊，这会让它们显得更用心。

choices.text: Let's skip decorating and just hand them out plain.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it'll make them feel more personal.

transition.en: They hand a finished candle to a delighted neighbor.
transition.zh: 他们把一支成品蜡烛递给了一位惊喜的邻居。

scenes.title: Giving the First Gift
scenes.subtitle: 邻居家 · 送出第一份礼物

npcLine.en: Did you two really make this candle by hand?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩真的是手工做的这支蜡烛吗？

choices.text: We did, right in our own kitchen.
choices.zh: 是的，就在我们自己的厨房做的。

choices.text: We didn't, we bought this at a store.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → We did, right in our own kitchen.

npcLine.en: This is more personal than any candle I've ever received.
npcLine.zh: 这比我收到过的任何蜡烛都更有心意。

choices.text: That means so much, we're glad you love it.
choices.zh: 这话对我们意义太大了，很高兴你喜欢。

choices.text: Personal touches don't matter, it's just wax.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That means so much, we're glad you love it.

npcLine.en: No matter how simple, homemade gifts feel the warmest.
npcLine.zh: 不管多简单，手作礼物总让人感觉最温暖。

choices.text: No matter how simple, we made it just for you.
choices.zh: 不管多简单，我们就是专门为你做的。

choices.text: No matter how simple, store-bought is always better.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how simple, we made it just for you.

transition.en: They pick up a beginner birdhouse kit at the hardware store.
transition.zh: 他们在五金店买了一套初学者鸟屋套装。

npcLine.en: Have you ever built anything out of wood before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前用木头做过什么东西吗？

choices.text: I've never built anything, but I'm willing to try.
choices.zh: 我从没做过，不过我愿意试一试。

choices.text: I've built houses out of wood every week.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never built anything, but I'm willing to try.

npcLine.en: This kit looks simpler than the ones I saw online.
npcLine.zh: 这套套装比我在网上看到的要更简单。

choices.text: It does, perfect for a first attempt.
choices.zh: 确实是，很适合第一次尝试。

choices.text: Simplicity doesn't matter, let's buy the hardest one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, perfect for a first attempt.

npcLine.en: Let's grab safety glasses before we start cutting.
npcLine.zh: 开始切割之前我们先拿好护目镜吧。

choices.text: Good idea, safety first with sharp tools.
choices.zh: 好主意，用锋利工具安全第一。

choices.text: Let's just skip the glasses, we'll be fine.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, safety first with sharp tools.

transition.en: In the garage, they sand rough wooden boards until smooth.
transition.zh: 在车库里，他们打磨粗糙的木板，直到变得光滑。

npcLine.en: This board feels rougher than the others in the kit.
npcLine.zh: 这块木板比套装里其他的要粗糙。

choices.text: It does, let's give it a few extra passes.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们多打磨几遍吧。

choices.text: Texture doesn't matter, let's move on already.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's give it a few extra passes.

npcLine.en: Can you feel any splinters left on this edge?
npcLine.zh: 你能摸到这条边上还有木刺吗？

choices.text: I can feel a few, let's sand it once more.
choices.zh: 我摸到了一些，我们再打磨一次吧。

choices.text: I can't feel anything, this edge is perfect.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can feel a few, let's sand it once more.

npcLine.en: This is getting smoother with every pass we make.
npcLine.zh: 每打磨一遍它就变得更光滑一些。

choices.text: It is, this feels satisfying to do.
choices.zh: 确实是，做这件事让人很有成就感。

choices.text: It isn't, this board looks exactly the same.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → It is, this feels satisfying to do.

transition.en: They measure each board carefully before making any cuts.
transition.zh: 动手切割之前，他们仔细测量了每块木板。

npcLine.en: Can you double check this measurement before I cut?
npcLine.zh: 我切之前你能再检查一遍这个尺寸吗？

choices.text: I can, let me measure it one more time.
choices.zh: 我能，我再量一遍。

choices.text: I can't measure anything with this ruler.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me measure it one more time.

npcLine.en: This measurement is trickier than I thought it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这个尺寸比我想的要更棘手。

choices.text: It is, angles always make things harder.
choices.zh: 确实是，涉及角度总会更难一些。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just guess the size.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, angles always make things harder.

npcLine.en: Remember, measure twice and cut only once.
npcLine.zh: 记住，量两次，切一次。

choices.text: Good rule, mistakes are hard to fix in wood.
choices.zh: 这规则不错，木头上的失误很难修正。

choices.text: That rule is silly, let's just cut it now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Good rule, mistakes are hard to fix in wood.

transition.en: They line up the boards and start hammering small nails.
transition.zh: 他们把木板对齐，开始敲进小钉子。

npcLine.en: This hammer is heavier than the one at home.
npcLine.zh: 这把锤子比家里那把要重。

choices.text: It is, but it drives nails in faster.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过敲钉子更快一些。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's use it randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but it drives nails in faster.

npcLine.en: Should we hold the nail steady while you hammer?
npcLine.zh: 你敲的时候我们要不要扶稳钉子？

choices.text: Yes, please, that keeps it from bending.
choices.zh: 好的，请扶稳，这样它就不会弯。

choices.text: No, let's just hammer it in blindly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, please, that keeps it from bending.

npcLine.en: That nail is going in straighter than the last one.
npcLine.zh: 这颗钉子敲得比上一颗要直。

choices.text: It is, I think I'm finally getting the hang of it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我想我终于摸到窍门了。

choices.text: Straightness doesn't matter, let's move on quickly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I think I'm finally getting the hang of it.

transition.en: Their curious toddler watches from a safe distance, fascinated.
transition.zh: 好奇的孩子在安全距离外看得入了迷。

scenes.title: A Toddler Watches Closely
scenes.subtitle: 车库 · 孩子在一旁看

npcLine.en: Can I hold the hammer just once, please?
npcLine.zh: 我能拿一次锤子吗，拜托？

choices.text: Not yet, but you can watch closely.
choices.zh: 现在还不行，不过你可以仔细看。

choices.text: Sure, here's a real hammer for you.

n1.hintOnWrong: 拒绝但补偿 → Not yet, but you can watch closely.

npcLine.en: Why do we need so many little nails?
npcLine.zh: 为什么我们需要这么多小钉子？

choices.text: Each one holds the boards together tightly.
choices.zh: 每一颗都能把木板牢牢固定住。

choices.text: We don't actually need any nails at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → Each one holds the boards together tightly.

npcLine.en: Once we finish, you can paint the birdhouse yourself.
npcLine.zh: 等我们做完，你就可以自己给鸟屋上色了。

choices.text: They will love that, they've been waiting patiently.
choices.zh: 他们会很喜欢的，一直耐心等着呢。

choices.text: They won't care about painting anything at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → They will love that, they've been waiting patiently.

transition.en: The tricky part comes next: attaching the slanted roof pieces.
transition.zh: 接下来是最棘手的部分：安装倾斜的屋顶部件。

npcLine.en: This roof piece is trickier to attach than the walls were.
npcLine.zh: 这块屋顶部件比墙面更难安装。

choices.text: It is, the angle keeps throwing me off.
choices.zh: 确实是，这个角度老是让我搞错。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just force it on.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, the angle keeps throwing me off.

npcLine.en: If we glue it first, the nails will hold better.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们先用胶水粘，钉子会固定得更牢。

choices.text: If that works, let's do glue every time.
choices.zh: 如果有效，我们以后每次都先上胶吧。

choices.text: If that works, let's forget the nails entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If that works, let's do glue every time.

npcLine.en: This roof is looking sturdier than I expected already.
npcLine.zh: 这个屋顶看起来已经比我预想的要更牢固了。

choices.text: It is, I'm actually proud of how it looks.
choices.zh: 确实是，我对它的样子挺自豪的。

choices.text: Sturdiness doesn't matter, let's just glue it faster.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I'm actually proud of how it looks.

transition.en: Their toddler dips a small brush into bright blue paint.
transition.zh: 孩子把一支小刷子蘸进了明亮的蓝色颜料里。

npcLine.en: Which color do you want to paint the roof?
npcLine.zh: 你想把屋顶漆成什么颜色？

choices.text: They're pointing at the bright red, of course.
choices.zh: 他们当然是指着那种亮红色啦。

choices.text: They don't want any color at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → They're pointing at the bright red, of course.

npcLine.en: They're painting more carefully than I expected them to.
npcLine.zh: 他们涂色比我预想的要更细心。

choices.text: They are, look how focused they seem.
choices.zh: 确实是，看他们多专注啊。

choices.text: Care doesn't matter, let's just take over for them.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, look how focused they seem.

npcLine.en: This is going to be a very colorful birdhouse.
npcLine.zh: 这会是一个非常五颜六色的鸟屋。

choices.text: It will, and the birds probably won't mind at all.
choices.zh: 会的，鸟儿大概也不会介意的。

choices.text: It won't, we should stop them right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, and the birds probably won't mind at all.

transition.en: They walk around the yard, searching for the perfect tree branch.
transition.zh: 他们在院子里走来走去，寻找最合适的树枝。

scenes.title: Finding the Right Spot
scenes.subtitle: 后院 · 寻找合适的位置

npcLine.en: This branch looks sturdier than the one near the fence.
npcLine.zh: 这根树枝看起来比篱笆边那根要更结实。

choices.text: It does, and it's high enough for safety too.
choices.zh: 确实是，而且高度也够安全了。

choices.text: Sturdiness doesn't matter, let's just pick any branch.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, and it's high enough for safety too.

npcLine.en: Should we hang it facing away from the wind?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要挂得背对着风向？

choices.text: Yes, that'll keep the birds warmer inside.
choices.zh: 要，这样鸟儿在里面会更暖和。

choices.text: No, direction doesn't matter to birds at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that'll keep the birds warmer inside.

npcLine.en: Let's hang it here and see who moves in first.
npcLine.zh: 我们把它挂在这儿，看看谁先住进来吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I'm excited to find out.
choices.zh: 好啊，我很期待看到结果。

choices.text: Let's just leave it in the garage instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I'm excited to find out.

transition.en: Together, they hang the finished birdhouse on a sturdy branch.
transition.zh: 他们一起把做好的鸟屋挂在了一根结实的树枝上。

npcLine.en: This looks better hanging outside than it did in the garage.
npcLine.zh: 挂在外面比在车库里看起来更好看。

choices.text: It does, the colors really pop against the leaves.
choices.zh: 确实是，颜色在树叶映衬下特别鲜艳。

choices.text: Looks don't matter, let's just take it down now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, the colors really pop against the leaves.

npcLine.en: How long do you think it'll take for a bird to notice?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得鸟儿要多久才会注意到它？

choices.text: Maybe a few days, birds are curious creatures.
choices.zh: 也许几天吧，鸟儿是很好奇的生物。

choices.text: Never, birds don't notice anything new.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时间 → Maybe a few days, birds are curious creatures.

npcLine.en: No matter how long it takes, we made this together.
npcLine.zh: 不管要花多久，这都是我们一起做的。

choices.text: No matter how long, I'll always remember today.
choices.zh: 不管要多久，我都会一直记得今天。

choices.text: No matter how long, this was a waste of time.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how long, I'll always remember today.

transition.en: A week later, a small bird finally perches on the birdhouse.
transition.zh: 一周后，一只小鸟终于停在了鸟屋上。

npcLine.en: Look, a bird is checking out our birdhouse right now!
npcLine.zh: 快看，有只鸟正在查看我们的鸟屋！

choices.text: I see it, I can't believe it actually worked.
choices.zh: 我看到了，真不敢相信它真的成功了。

choices.text: I don't see any bird anywhere near it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I see it, I can't believe it actually worked.

npcLine.en: This moment feels better than I ever imagined it would.
npcLine.zh: 这一刻比我曾经想象的要更美好。

choices.text: It really does, all that work was worth it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，之前所有的努力都值得了。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this feels pretty ordinary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, all that work was worth it.

npcLine.en: Someday we'll build a bigger one for the whole yard.
npcLine.zh: 将来我们会给整个院子做一个更大的。

choices.text: We will, this hobby might just be starting.
choices.zh: 会的，这个爱好也许才刚刚开始。

choices.text: We won't, one birdhouse is more than enough.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, this hobby might just be starting.

transition.en: A cheese-making kit arrives with cultures, rennet, and cheesecloth.
transition.zh: 一套奶酪制作套装送到了，里面有菌种、凝乳酶和奶酪布。

scenes.title: The Cheese-Making Kit
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 奶酪制作套装

npcLine.en: Have you ever made cheese from scratch before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前从零开始做过奶酪吗？

choices.text: I've never made cheese, only bought it from stores.
choices.zh: 我从没做过奶酪，只在店里买过。

choices.text: I've made cheese every single day this year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never made cheese, only bought it from stores.

npcLine.en: This recipe looks trickier than the yogurt one we tried.
npcLine.zh: 这个食谱看起来比我们试过的酸奶食谱更棘手。

choices.text: It does, but let's give it a shot anyway.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过我们还是试试吧。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's skip this recipe entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, but let's give it a shot anyway.

npcLine.en: Let's warm the milk slowly on low heat first.
npcLine.zh: 我们先小火慢慢把牛奶加热吧。

choices.text: Good idea, patience matters with cheese.
choices.zh: 好主意，做奶酪需要耐心。

choices.text: Let's just blast it on high heat instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, patience matters with cheese.

transition.en: They sprinkle a packet of starter culture into the warm milk.
transition.zh: 他们把一包发酵菌种撒进了温热的牛奶里。

npcLine.en: Can you stir this gently without breaking the surface too much?
npcLine.zh: 你能轻轻搅拌，别把表面搅得太乱吗？

choices.text: I can, slow circles should do it.
choices.zh: 我能做到，慢慢画圈就行。

choices.text: I can't stir anything gently at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, slow circles should do it.

npcLine.en: This milk needs to rest longer than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这牛奶需要静置的时间比我预想的要长。

choices.text: It does, an hour should be about right.
choices.zh: 确实是，大概一小时就差不多了。

choices.text: Time doesn't matter, let's rush this step.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, an hour should be about right.

npcLine.en: Once the culture works, we'll add the rennet next.
npcLine.zh: 菌种起作用之后，我们接下来就加凝乳酶。

choices.text: We will, this is the exciting part.
choices.zh: 会的，这是最令人期待的部分。

choices.text: We won't, let's skip the rennet completely.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, this is the exciting part.

transition.en: Slowly, the milk begins separating into soft curds and clear whey.
transition.zh: 牛奶慢慢开始分离成软软的凝乳和清澈的乳清。

scenes.title: Watching the Curds Form
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 观察凝乳形成
