npcLine.en: This is separating faster than I thought it would.
npcLine.zh: 这个分离得比我想的要快。

choices.text: It is, the rennet must be working well.
choices.zh: 确实是，凝乳酶一定在起作用。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just stir it more.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, the rennet must be working well.

npcLine.en: Look, this part is turning into soft little clumps.
npcLine.zh: 看，这部分正在变成软软的小凝块。

choices.text: I see it, those must be the curds forming.
choices.zh: 我看到了，那一定是正在形成的凝乳。

choices.text: I don't see any change happening at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I see it, those must be the curds forming.

npcLine.en: The whey looks clearer than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这乳清比我预想的要更清澈。

choices.text: It does, that's a good sign apparently.
choices.zh: 确实是，据说这是个好迹象。

choices.text: Clarity doesn't matter, let's throw it all away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, that's a good sign apparently.

transition.en: They pour the mixture through cheesecloth stretched over a bowl.
transition.zh: 他们把混合物倒进撑在碗上的奶酪布里过滤。

scenes.title: Straining with Cheesecloth
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 用奶酪布过滤

npcLine.en: Can you hold the cloth steady while I pour?
npcLine.zh: 我倒的时候你能把布扶稳吗？

choices.text: I can, go ahead and pour slowly.
choices.zh: 我能扶稳，你慢慢倒吧。

choices.text: I can't hold anything steady right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, go ahead and pour slowly.

npcLine.en: This cloth is straining out more whey than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这块布滤出的乳清比我预想的要多。

choices.text: It is, look how much liquid is left behind.
choices.zh: 确实是，看留下了多少液体。

choices.text: Amount doesn't matter, let's just squeeze it dry.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, look how much liquid is left behind.

npcLine.en: Let's hang this over the sink for an hour.
npcLine.zh: 我们把它挂在水槽上方晾一个小时吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, gravity will do the rest.
choices.zh: 好啊，剩下的交给重力就行。

choices.text: Let's just squeeze it hard right now instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, gravity will do the rest.

transition.en: Once drained, they mix in salt, herbs, and cracked pepper.
transition.zh: 沥干之后，他们拌入了盐、香草和碎黑胡椒。

npcLine.en: How much salt do you think we should add?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得我们该加多少盐？

choices.text: Just a pinch, we can always add more.
choices.zh: 一小撮就行，后面还可以再加。

choices.text: We shouldn't add any salt at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → Just a pinch, we can always add more.

npcLine.en: This tastes creamier than I imagined homemade cheese would.
npcLine.zh: 这尝起来比我想象的自制奶酪要更绵密。

choices.text: It really does, I'm genuinely impressed with it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我真的对它很满意。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this tastes pretty bland.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I'm genuinely impressed with it.

npcLine.en: Let's try adding some fresh chives too.
npcLine.zh: 我们也加点新鲜香葱试试吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, it'll add a nice bite.
choices.zh: 好啊，这会增添一点清爽的口感。

choices.text: Let's leave it completely plain instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, it'll add a nice bite.

transition.en: Their toddler cautiously tries a tiny spoonful of the fresh cheese.
transition.zh: 孩子小心翼翼地尝了一小勺新鲜奶酪。

npcLine.en: Do you like it, is it good?
npcLine.zh: 你喜欢吗，好吃吗？

choices.text: They're nodding, that's a very good sign.
choices.zh: 他们在点头，这是个很好的信号。

choices.text: They hated it and spit it out immediately.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定倾向回答 → They're nodding, that's a very good sign.

npcLine.en: They're asking for a second spoonful already!
npcLine.zh: 他们已经又要了一勺了！

choices.text: That's the best review we could ask for.
choices.zh: 这是我们能得到的最好评价了。

choices.text: That means they didn't like it at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → That's the best review we could ask for.

npcLine.en: This turned out better than any cheese we've bought.
npcLine.zh: 这做出来比我们买过的任何奶酪都要好。

choices.text: It really did, I'm so proud of us.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我为我们感到骄傲。

choices.text: It really didn't, store cheese tastes better.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, I'm so proud of us.

transition.en: Encouraged, they attempt a firmer cheese that needs to age.
transition.zh: 备受鼓舞，他们尝试做一种需要熟成的更硬的奶酪。

scenes.title: Trying a Harder Cheese
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 尝试更硬的奶酪

npcLine.en: This cheese needs pressing longer than the soft one did.
npcLine.zh: 这种奶酪需要压制的时间比软奶酪更长。

choices.text: It does, let's set a timer for tomorrow.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们设个明天的提醒吧。

choices.text: Time doesn't matter, let's unwrap it right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's set a timer for tomorrow.

npcLine.en: If we press it firmly, the texture will hold better.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们压得紧实一些，质地会保持得更好。

choices.text: If that's true, let's add more weight on top.
choices.zh: 如果是这样，我们再加点重物压上去吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's just leave it loose.

n2.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If that's true, let's add more weight on top.

npcLine.en: This will need to age in the fridge for weeks.
npcLine.zh: 这个需要在冰箱里熟成好几周。

choices.text: It will, good things really do take time.
choices.zh: 会的，好东西确实需要时间。

choices.text: It won't, we should eat it right away instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, good things really do take time.

transition.en: Weeks later, they peek inside the fridge to check on their cheese.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们打开冰箱查看熟成中的奶酪。

scenes.title: Checking on the Aging Cheese
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 查看熟成中的奶酪

npcLine.en: This rind looks firmer than it did last week.
npcLine.zh: 这层外皮比上周要更结实了。

choices.text: It does, the aging process is really working.
choices.zh: 确实是，熟成过程真的在起作用。

choices.text: Firmness doesn't matter, let's just eat it now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, the aging process is really working.

npcLine.en: Have we ever waited this long for food before?
npcLine.zh: 我们以前有为食物等这么久吗？

choices.text: We haven't, this patience feels new to us.
choices.zh: 还没有过，这种耐心对我们来说挺新鲜的。

choices.text: We've waited for hours for every single meal.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We haven't, this patience feels new to us.

npcLine.en: Just one more week, and then we can finally taste it.
npcLine.zh: 再等一周，我们就终于能尝到了。

choices.text: I can hardly wait for that day to come.
choices.zh: 我几乎等不及那一天到来了。

choices.text: I can't wait any longer, let's eat it today.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力/耐心 → I can hardly wait for that day to come.

transition.en: The wait is finally over, and they slice into the aged wheel.
transition.zh: 等待终于结束了，他们切开了熟成的奶酪轮。

npcLine.en: This flavor is sharper than I ever expected homemade cheese to be.
npcLine.zh: 这个味道比我曾经预想的自制奶酪要更浓郁。

choices.text: It really is, aging made a huge difference.
choices.zh: 确实如此，熟成带来了巨大的变化。

choices.text: It really isn't, this tastes exactly like milk.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, aging made a huge difference.

npcLine.en: Can you believe we made this ourselves, start to finish?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信这是我们从头到尾自己做的吗？

choices.text: I honestly can't, this feels like an achievement.
choices.zh: 我真的不敢相信，这感觉像是一项成就。

choices.text: I can believe it, this tastes completely ordinary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表惊讶 → I honestly can't, this feels like an achievement.

npcLine.en: Let's invite friends over to try our next batch.
npcLine.zh: 我们邀请朋友来尝尝下一批吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, they'll never believe we made it.
choices.zh: 好啊，他们绝对不会相信是我们做的。

choices.text: Let's keep this a secret from everyone forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, they'll never believe we made it.

transition.en: Inspired, they start planning to try a smoked cheese next.
transition.zh: 受到鼓舞，他们开始计划接下来尝试一种烟熏奶酪。

npcLine.en: What kind of cheese should we try making next?
npcLine.zh: 我们接下来该尝试做哪种奶酪？

choices.text: Maybe something smoked, that sounds interesting.
choices.zh: 也许试试烟熏口味的，听起来很有意思。

choices.text: We shouldn't make any cheese ever again.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → Maybe something smoked, that sounds interesting.

npcLine.en: This hobby has become more rewarding than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个爱好比我预想的要更有成就感。

choices.text: It has, I look forward to it every week now.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我现在每周都期待它。

choices.text: Reward doesn't matter, let's just stop entirely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It has, I look forward to it every week now.

npcLine.en: No matter how long it takes, this is worth doing together.
npcLine.zh: 不管要花多久，这件事都值得我们一起做。

choices.text: No matter how long, I'll always want to learn with you.
choices.zh: 不管要多久，我都愿意和你一起学。

choices.text: No matter how long, this hobby isn't worth the effort.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how long, I'll always want to learn with you.

transition.en: A jar containing a strange rubbery disc arrives in the mail.
transition.zh: 一个装着一片奇怪橡胶状圆盘的罐子邮寄到了。

npcLine.en: Have you ever seen anything quite like this before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前有见过这种东西吗？

choices.text: I've never seen anything like it, honestly.
choices.zh: 说实话，我从没见过这种东西。

choices.text: I've seen this exact thing every single week.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never seen anything like it, honestly.

npcLine.en: This looks stranger than any ingredient we've ever used.
npcLine.zh: 这个看起来比我们用过的任何食材都要奇怪。

choices.text: It does, but apparently it makes great tea.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过据说它能酿出很棒的茶。

choices.text: Appearance doesn't matter, let's throw it away now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, but apparently it makes great tea.

npcLine.en: Let's read the instructions carefully before we start.
npcLine.zh: 开始之前我们先仔细读一下说明书吧。

choices.text: Good idea, fermentation seems easy to get wrong.
choices.zh: 好主意，发酵这件事似乎很容易出错。

choices.text: Let's just wing it without reading anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, fermentation seems easy to get wrong.

transition.en: They brew a large pot of sweet black tea to feed the culture.
transition.zh: 他们煮了一大壶加糖的红茶来喂养这个菌种。

npcLine.en: This tea needs to cool down completely before we use it.
npcLine.zh: 这茶需要完全放凉之后我们才能用。

choices.text: Right, warm tea could hurt the culture.
choices.zh: 对，温热的茶可能会伤害菌种。

choices.text: That's wrong, hot tea works even better.

n1.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Right, warm tea could hurt the culture.

npcLine.en: Should we add more sugar than the recipe suggests?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要比食谱建议的多加点糖？

choices.text: No, let's follow the recipe exactly this time.
choices.zh: 不，这次我们就完全按食谱来吧。

choices.text: Yes, let's double the sugar just to be safe.

n2.hintOnWrong: 否定回答 → No, let's follow the recipe exactly this time.

npcLine.en: This kitchen smells sweeter than it usually does.
npcLine.zh: 厨房现在闻起来比平时要甜。

choices.text: It does, the whole house smells like tea.
choices.zh: 确实是，整间屋子都是茶香。

choices.text: Smell doesn't matter, let's open all the windows.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, the whole house smells like tea.

transition.en: They pour the cooled tea into a large glass jar with the SCOBY.
transition.zh: 他们把放凉的茶倒进装着红茶菌的大玻璃罐里。

scenes.title: Starting the First Ferment
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 开始一次发酵

npcLine.en: Can you cover this with a cloth instead of a lid?
npcLine.zh: 你能用布盖住而不是用盖子吗？

choices.text: I can, it still needs to breathe apparently.
choices.zh: 我能做到，据说它还是需要透气的。

choices.text: I can't find any cloth in this kitchen.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it still needs to breathe apparently.

npcLine.en: This needs to sit in a warmer spot than the pantry.
npcLine.zh: 这个需要放在比储藏室更暖和的地方。

choices.text: It does, let's put it on top of the fridge.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们把它放在冰箱顶上吧。

choices.text: Temperature doesn't matter, let's just leave it anywhere.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's put it on top of the fridge.

npcLine.en: In about a week, this will taste tangy and fizzy.
npcLine.zh: 大约一周后，这会变得酸酸的、还带点气泡。

choices.text: It will, I'm curious to see how it changes.
choices.zh: 会的，我很好奇它会怎么变化。

choices.text: It won't, this will taste exactly the same.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, I'm curious to see how it changes.

transition.en: Every couple of days, they peek at the fermenting jar on the counter.
transition.zh: 他们每隔几天就会瞄一眼台面上正在发酵的罐子。

scenes.title: Checking the Progress
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 检查发酵进度

npcLine.en: This is bubbling more than it was yesterday.
npcLine.zh: 这个比昨天冒的泡要多。

choices.text: It is, that means it's fermenting well.
choices.zh: 确实是，说明发酵得很顺利。

choices.text: Bubbling doesn't matter, let's just pour it out.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that means it's fermenting well.

npcLine.en: Can you smell how vinegary it's becoming?
npcLine.zh: 你能闻到它变得越来越有醋味了吗？

choices.text: I can, it smells tangier every single day.
choices.zh: 我能闻到，一天比一天更酸了。

choices.text: I can't smell anything different at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it smells tangier every single day.

npcLine.en: Should we taste a little bit today to check?
npcLine.zh: 我们今天要不要尝一小口试试？

choices.text: Sure, a small taste test can't hurt.
choices.zh: 可以，少量试喝应该没问题。

choices.text: No, let's never taste it until it's finished.

n3.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Sure, a small taste test can't hurt.

transition.en: They pour the brewed kombucha into bottles with fresh fruit.
transition.zh: 他们把酿好的康普茶倒进瓶子里，加入新鲜水果。

npcLine.en: Which fruit do you want to add to this bottle?
npcLine.zh: 你想在这瓶里加哪种水果？

choices.text: Let's try strawberries in this one first.
choices.zh: 我们先在这瓶里试试草莓吧。

choices.text: I don't want to add any fruit at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → Let's try strawberries in this one first.

npcLine.en: This second ferment creates more fizz than the first one did.
npcLine.zh: 这次二次发酵产生的气泡比第一次要多。

choices.text: It does, the fruit sugar really helps with that.
choices.zh: 确实是，水果里的糖分对此很有帮助。

choices.text: Fizz doesn't matter, let's skip this whole step.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, the fruit sugar really helps with that.

npcLine.en: Let's seal these bottles tightly for a few more days.
npcLine.zh: 我们把这些瓶子密封好，再放几天。

choices.text: Let's do that, patience makes it fizzier.
choices.zh: 好啊，耐心等待会让气泡更足。

choices.text: Let's just open them and drink it flat.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, patience makes it fizzier.

transition.en: One bottle fizzes over dramatically when they open it too fast.
transition.zh: 有一瓶因为打开得太快而剧烈冒泡溢了出来。

scenes.title: A Bottle Overflows
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 一瓶溢了出来

npcLine.en: Whoa, that fizzed up faster than I expected!
npcLine.zh: 哇，这冒泡的速度比我预想的要快！

choices.text: It did, let's open the next one slower.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们打开下一瓶时慢一点吧。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's shake the next one too.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It did, let's open the next one slower.

npcLine.en: If we chill it first, it might overflow less.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们先把它冰一下，可能就不会溢出那么多了。

choices.text: If that helps, let's chill the rest overnight.
choices.zh: 如果有用，我们把剩下的整晚冰一下吧。

choices.text: If that helps, let's warm them up instead.

n2.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If that helps, let's chill the rest overnight.

npcLine.en: At least we learned something for the next batch.
npcLine.zh: 至少我们为下一批学到了经验。

choices.text: True, every mistake teaches us something new.
choices.zh: 没错，每个失误都会教会我们一些新东西。

choices.text: Not true, this was a complete waste of tea.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → True, every mistake teaches us something new.

transition.en: Chilled and finally ready, they pour the first glasses to taste.
transition.zh: 冰好之后终于可以喝了，他们倒出了第一杯来品尝。

npcLine.en: This tastes way more sour than store-bought kombucha.
npcLine.zh: 这个尝起来比店里买的康普茶要酸得多。

choices.text: It does, but I actually really like it.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过我其实挺喜欢的。

choices.text: Sourness doesn't matter, let's pour it all out.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, but I actually really like it.

npcLine.en: Can you taste the strawberry coming through at all?
npcLine.zh: 你能尝出草莓味吗？

choices.text: I can, it's a nice subtle sweetness.
choices.zh: 能尝到，是一种淡淡的甜味，挺好的。

choices.text: I can't taste anything besides plain tea.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's a nice subtle sweetness.

npcLine.en: We actually made something that tastes this good.
npcLine.zh: 我们真的做出了这么好喝的东西。

choices.text: We did, I'm honestly impressed with us.
choices.zh: 确实是，我对我们真的挺佩服的。

choices.text: We didn't, this whole batch was a failure.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We did, I'm honestly impressed with us.

transition.en: Curious, their toddler asks for a tiny sip of the fizzy drink.
transition.zh: 好奇的孩子想尝一小口这种带气泡的饮料。

npcLine.en: Can I try just a little tiny sip, please?
npcLine.zh: 我能尝一小口吗，拜托？

choices.text: Just a tiny sip, it's quite sour though.
choices.zh: 就一小口哦，不过挺酸的。

choices.text: Sure, drink the entire glass right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 允许但限定量 → Just a tiny sip, it's quite sour though.

npcLine.en: Their face just scrunched up from the sourness!
npcLine.zh: 他们的脸因为酸味都皱起来了！

choices.text: It did, that reaction was priceless honestly.
choices.zh: 确实是，那个表情真是太逗了。

choices.text: It didn't, they seemed completely unaffected.

n2.hintOnWrong: 一般过去时回应 → It did, that reaction was priceless honestly.

npcLine.en: Maybe we'll make a less sour batch for them next time.
npcLine.zh: 也许下次我们给他们做一批酸味淡一点的。

choices.text: We will, maybe with a sweeter fruit.
choices.zh: 会的，也许加点更甜的水果。

choices.text: We won't, kids don't need to try this drink.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, maybe with a sweeter fruit.

transition.en: They notice a thin new layer forming on top of the culture.
transition.zh: 他们注意到菌种表面又长出了一层薄薄的新膜。

scenes.title: Growing a New SCOBY
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 长出新的红茶菌

npcLine.en: Is this new layer thicker than the one from last month?
npcLine.zh: 这层新膜比上个月那层要厚吗？

choices.text: It is, this batch grew a really healthy one.
choices.zh: 是的，这批长出了很健康的一层。

choices.text: It isn't, nothing grew here at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → It is, this batch grew a really healthy one.

npcLine.en: We could give this extra one to a friend now.
npcLine.zh: 我们现在可以把这个多出来的分给朋友了。

choices.text: We could, they'd probably love brewing their own.
choices.zh: 可以，他们大概会喜欢自己酿一份的。

choices.text: We couldn't, this only works alone at home.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We could, they'd probably love brewing their own.

npcLine.en: Let's pass this hobby along to someone else now.
npcLine.zh: 我们现在把这个爱好传给别人吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, sharing makes it more fun.
choices.zh: 好啊，分享让这件事更有乐趣。

choices.text: Let's keep every SCOBY only for ourselves forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, sharing makes it more fun.

transition.en: They hand a small jar with the extra SCOBY to a curious friend.
transition.zh: 他们把装着多余红茶菌的小罐子递给了一位好奇的朋友。

scenes.title: Sharing with a Friend
scenes.subtitle: 朋友家 · 分享红茶菌

npcLine.en: Did you two really brew this whole thing yourselves?
npcLine.zh: 你们俩真的是自己酿的这整套东西吗？

choices.text: We did, right on our kitchen counter.
choices.zh: 是的，就在我们家厨房台面上做的。

choices.text: We didn't, we bought this from a shop.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → We did, right on our kitchen counter.

npcLine.en: This is more interesting than any gift I've gotten recently.
npcLine.zh: 这比我最近收到的任何礼物都更有意思。

choices.text: That's kind of you, we hope you enjoy brewing.
choices.zh: 你真客气，希望你享受酿造的过程。

choices.text: Interest doesn't matter, just throw it away.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's kind of you, we hope you enjoy brewing.

npcLine.en: No matter how odd it looks, this hobby brought us joy.
npcLine.zh: 不管它看起来多奇怪，这个爱好给我们带来了快乐。

choices.text: No matter how odd, I hope it does the same for you.
choices.zh: 不管多奇怪，我希望它也能给你带来同样的快乐。

choices.text: No matter how odd, this hobby was pointless.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how odd, I hope it does the same for you.

transition.en: They lay out lye, oils, and silicone molds on the table.
transition.zh: 他们把碱液、油和硅胶模具摆在桌上。

npcLine.en: Have you ever handled lye before this project?
npcLine.zh: 这次之前你处理过碱液吗？

choices.text: I've never handled it, so let's be extra careful.
choices.zh: 我从没处理过，所以我们要格外小心。

choices.text: I've handled lye every single day for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never handled it, so let's be extra careful.

npcLine.en: This lye is more dangerous than any ingredient we've used.
npcLine.zh: 这个碱液比我们用过的任何原料都要危险。

choices.text: It is, let's wear gloves and goggles.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们戴上手套和护目镜吧。

choices.text: Danger doesn't matter, let's just mix it barehanded.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's wear gloves and goggles.

npcLine.en: Let's work in a well-ventilated space just in case.
npcLine.zh: 我们在通风良好的地方操作吧，以防万一。

choices.text: Good call, let's open a window too.
choices.zh: 很有道理，我们也开扇窗吧。

choices.text: Let's just work in the closed bathroom instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good call, let's open a window too.

transition.en: Wearing gloves, they carefully stir lye into cold water.
transition.zh: 戴着手套，他们小心地把碱液搅拌进冷水里。

npcLine.en: Can you always add lye to water, never the other way around?
npcLine.zh: 是不是一定要把碱液加进水里，绝不能反过来？

choices.text: That's right, the order really matters here.
choices.zh: 没错，这里的顺序真的很重要。

choices.text: Order doesn't matter, do it however you like.

n1.hintOnWrong: 确认安全规则 → That's right, the order really matters here.

npcLine.en: This mixture is heating up faster than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个混合液升温比我预想的要快。

choices.text: It is, that's a normal chemical reaction apparently.
choices.zh: 确实是，据说这是正常的化学反应。

choices.text: Heat doesn't matter, let's touch it to check.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that's a normal chemical reaction apparently.

npcLine.en: Let's set this aside to cool for a while.
npcLine.zh: 我们把这个放一边晾一会儿吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, patience keeps us safe here.
choices.zh: 好啊，耐心等待能让我们更安全。

choices.text: Let's just pour it into the oils right away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, patience keeps us safe here.

transition.en: They warm coconut oil, olive oil, and shea butter together.
transition.zh: 他们一起加热了椰子油、橄榄油和乳木果油。

npcLine.en: This shea butter is melting slower than the coconut oil.
npcLine.zh: 这乳木果油融化得比椰子油要慢。

choices.text: It is, let's stir it a little more.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们再多搅拌一下吧。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's crank up the heat.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's stir it a little more.

npcLine.en: Can you check if both temperatures match now?
npcLine.zh: 你能确认两边的温度现在是否一致吗？

choices.text: I can, they're almost exactly the same now.
choices.zh: 我能确认，现在几乎完全一致了。

choices.text: I can't check temperatures with this thermometer.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, they're almost exactly the same now.

npcLine.en: Once both are the same temperature, we'll combine them.
npcLine.zh: 两边温度一致后，我们就把它们混合起来。

choices.text: We will, timing really matters for this step.
choices.zh: 会的，这一步的时机把握真的很重要。

choices.text: We won't, let's just mix them whenever.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, timing really matters for this step.

transition.en: They blend the mixture until it thickens to a pudding-like consistency.
transition.zh: 他们搅拌混合物，直到它变得像布丁一样浓稠。

scenes.title: Reaching Trace
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 达到皂化痕迹

npcLine.en: This is thickening faster than the tutorial said it would.
npcLine.zh: 这变浓稠的速度比教程说的要快。

choices.text: It is, let's stop blending pretty soon.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们应该差不多要停止搅拌了。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's blend for another hour.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's stop blending pretty soon.

npcLine.en: Is this what they call reaching trace?
npcLine.zh: 这就是他们说的达到皂化痕迹吗？

choices.text: It is, the drizzle leaves a mark now.
choices.zh: 是的，现在滴下去会留下痕迹了。

choices.text: It isn't, this still looks completely liquid.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → It is, the drizzle leaves a mark now.

npcLine.en: Now we'll add the essential oils for scent.
npcLine.zh: 现在我们要加入精油来调香了。

choices.text: We will, I picked lavender and mint.
choices.zh: 会的，我选了薰衣草和薄荷。

choices.text: We won't, let's leave the soap unscented.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, I picked lavender and mint.

transition.en: They pour the thick soap batter into cheerful silicone molds.
transition.zh: 他们把浓稠的皂液倒进色彩明快的硅胶模具里。

npcLine.en: Can you pour this evenly across all six molds?
npcLine.zh: 你能把这个均匀地分到六个模具里吗？

choices.text: I can, let me go slowly and steady.
choices.zh: 我能做到，我慢慢地稳稳地倒。

choices.text: I can't pour anything evenly at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me go slowly and steady.

npcLine.en: This mold is filling up faster than the others.
npcLine.zh: 这个模具比其他的灌得快。

choices.text: It is, let's pour a bit less into it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们往这个里少倒一点吧。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just keep pouring.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's pour a bit less into it.

npcLine.en: Let's tap the molds gently to release any air bubbles.
npcLine.zh: 我们轻轻敲一下模具，把气泡排出来吧。

choices.text: Good idea, that should smooth out the tops.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样能让表面更平整。

choices.text: Let's just leave the bubbles trapped inside.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, that should smooth out the tops.

transition.en: They cover the molds and let chemistry work overnight.
transition.zh: 他们盖上模具，让化学反应过夜进行。

npcLine.en: Should we peek at these before we go to bed?
npcLine.zh: 我们睡觉前要不要瞄一眼？

choices.text: Just once, then let's leave them alone.
choices.zh: 就看一次，之后我们就不动它们了。

choices.text: No, let's stir them every single hour tonight.

n1.hintOnWrong: 折中回答 → Just once, then let's leave them alone.

npcLine.en: This process is happening slower than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个过程发生得比我预想的要慢。

choices.text: It is, but good soap takes real time.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过好皂需要真正的时间。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's throw them in the oven.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but good soap takes real time.

npcLine.en: By morning, these will be firm enough to unmold.
npcLine.zh: 到早上，这些就会变得足够硬，可以脱模了。

choices.text: They will, I can't wait to see the shapes.
choices.zh: 会的，我等不及要看它们的形状了。

choices.text: They won't, these will stay liquid forever.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → They will, I can't wait to see the shapes.

transition.en: The next morning, they carefully pop the bars out of the molds.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，他们小心地把皂块从模具里脱出来。

npcLine.en: This came out cleaner than I expected it to.
npcLine.zh: 这个脱模比我预想的要更干净利落。

choices.text: It did, the silicone molds really helped.
choices.zh: 确实如此，硅胶模具真的帮了大忙。

choices.text: It didn't, this bar looks completely ruined.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It did, the silicone molds really helped.

npcLine.en: Look, you can still see swirls of the mint color.
npcLine.zh: 看，还能看到薄荷色的漩涡纹路。

choices.text: I see it, that turned out beautifully.
choices.zh: 我看到了，效果做得真好看。

choices.text: I don't see any pattern at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力回应 → I see it, that turned out beautifully.

npcLine.en: This smells lovelier than I imagined homemade soap would.
npcLine.zh: 这闻起来比我想象的自制皂要更宜人。

choices.text: It really does, the lavender is just right.
choices.zh: 确实如此，薰衣草的比例正好。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this smells quite unpleasant.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, the lavender is just right.

transition.en: They line the bars up on a rack to cure for several weeks.
transition.zh: 他们把皂块排在架子上，让它们熟成好几周。

npcLine.en: Have we ever waited this long for a bar of soap?
npcLine.zh: 我们以前有为一块肥皂等这么久吗？

choices.text: We haven't, and it's teaching us to slow down.
choices.zh: 还没有过，这也让我们学会了放慢脚步。

choices.text: We've waited weeks for soap dozens of times.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We haven't, and it's teaching us to slow down.

npcLine.en: If we let it cure fully, it'll last longer in the shower.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们让它充分熟成，用起来会更耐用。

choices.text: If that's true, I'm glad we're being patient.
choices.zh: 如果确实如此，我很高兴我们有耐心等待。

choices.text: If that's true, let's just use it right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If that's true, I'm glad we're being patient.

npcLine.en: In four weeks, this will be ready to use.
npcLine.zh: 四周后，这个就能用了。

choices.text: It will, and I already know it'll be worth it.
choices.zh: 会的，我已经知道这会是值得的。

choices.text: It won't, soap doesn't actually need to cure.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, and I already know it'll be worth it.

transition.en: Weeks later, they finally use a cured bar for the first time.
transition.zh: 几周后，他们终于第一次用上了熟成好的皂块。

npcLine.en: This lathers more richly than any soap we've bought.
npcLine.zh: 这个起泡比我们买过的任何肥皂都要丰富。

choices.text: It really does, I'm genuinely surprised by that.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这真的让我很惊喜。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this barely lathers at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, I'm genuinely surprised by that.

npcLine.en: Can you believe we made this from scratch, start to finish?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信这是我们从头到尾自己做的吗？

choices.text: I honestly can't, this feels like a real achievement.
choices.zh: 我真的不敢相信，这感觉像是一项真正的成就。

choices.text: I can believe it, this feels totally ordinary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表惊讶 → I honestly can't, this feels like a real achievement.

npcLine.en: Let's make a batch of gift bars for the holidays.
npcLine.zh: 我们做一批节日礼物皂吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, everyone will love a handmade gift.
choices.zh: 好啊，大家都会喜欢手工礼物的。

choices.text: Let's keep every bar just for ourselves instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, everyone will love a handmade gift.

transition.en: They wrap the finished bars in kraft paper and twine.
transition.zh: 他们用牛皮纸和麻绳把成品皂块包了起来。

npcLine.en: This wrapping looks nicer than I expected for a first attempt.
npcLine.zh: 以第一次尝试来说，这个包装比我预想的要好看。

choices.text: It does, the twine really ties it together.
choices.zh: 确实是，这麻绳把整体感觉衬托出来了。

choices.text: Looks don't matter, let's just toss it in a bag.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, the twine really ties it together.

npcLine.en: No matter how simple, handmade soap makes a thoughtful gift.
npcLine.zh: 不管多简单，手工皂都是一份用心的礼物。

choices.text: No matter how simple, we made it with care.
choices.zh: 不管多简单，都是我们用心做的。

choices.text: No matter how simple, store-bought is always better.

n2.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how simple, we made it with care.

npcLine.en: This hobby turned out to be more rewarding than we imagined.
npcLine.zh: 这个爱好带来的成就感比我们想象的要多。

choices.text: It did, I'm so glad we tried something new.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很高兴我们尝试了新事物。

choices.text: It didn't, this hobby was disappointing overall.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It did, I'm so glad we tried something new.

transition.en: They arrive at a small forge for a beginner blacksmithing class.
transition.zh: 他们来到一个小锻造坊，参加入门锻造课。

scenes.title: The Blacksmith Workshop
scenes.subtitle: 锻造坊 · 入门锻造课

npcLine.en: Have you ever stood this close to a forge before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前有站得离锻造炉这么近过吗？

choices.text: I've never stood this close, the heat is intense.
choices.zh: 我从没这么近过，这热度真强烈。

choices.text: I've stood this close every single week for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never stood this close, the heat is intense.

npcLine.en: This forge is hotter than any oven we've ever used.
npcLine.zh: 这锻造炉比我们用过的任何烤箱都要热。

choices.text: It is, let's keep a safe distance from it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们要跟它保持安全距离。

choices.text: Heat doesn't matter, let's just touch it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's keep a safe distance from it.

npcLine.en: Let's put on these thick leather aprons first.
npcLine.zh: 我们先穿上这些厚厚的皮围裙吧。

choices.text: Good idea, safety first around fire.
choices.zh: 好主意，靠近火要把安全放在第一位。

choices.text: Let's skip the aprons, they look uncomfortable.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, safety first around fire.

transition.en: The instructor places a steel bar into the glowing coals.
transition.zh: 老师把一根钢条放进了发红的炭火里。

npcLine.en: This steel is glowing brighter than I expected it would.
npcLine.zh: 这根钢条发的红光比我预想的要亮。

choices.text: It is, that means it's almost ready to shape.
choices.zh: 确实是，说明它差不多可以塑形了。

choices.text: Brightness doesn't matter, let's grab it right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that means it's almost ready to shape.

npcLine.en: Can you tell when the color turns orange-yellow?
npcLine.zh: 你能看出它什么时候变成橙黄色吗？

choices.text: I can, that's the color we're waiting for.
choices.zh: 我能看出来，那就是我们要等的颜色。

choices.text: I can't see any color change at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, that's the color we're waiting for.

npcLine.en: Once it's hot enough, we'll pull it out fast.
npcLine.zh: 等它够热了，我们就要快速把它拿出来。

choices.text: We will, speed really matters at this point.
choices.zh: 会的，这一步速度真的很重要。

choices.text: We won't, let's just leave it in there longer.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, speed really matters at this point.

transition.en: They take turns swinging a hammer against the glowing metal.
transition.zh: 他们轮流挥锤敲打发红的金属。

scenes.title: Hammering on the Anvil
scenes.subtitle: 锻造坊 · 铁砧上锤打

npcLine.en: This hammer is heavier than any tool I've held before.
npcLine.zh: 这把锤子比我拿过的任何工具都要重。

choices.text: It is, my arm is already feeling it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我的胳膊已经有感觉了。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's swing it wildly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, my arm is already feeling it.

npcLine.en: Can you hit the same spot again, right there?
npcLine.zh: 你能再打一次同一个位置吗，就是那里？

choices.text: I can, watch my aim this time.
choices.zh: 我能做到，这次看我瞄准。

choices.text: I can't hit anything accurately at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, watch my aim this time.

npcLine.en: This metal is flattening faster than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这块金属变扁的速度比我预想的要快。

choices.text: It is, each hit is making real progress.
choices.zh: 确实是，每一锤都有实实在在的进展。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just stop hammering.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, each hit is making real progress.

transition.en: The metal cools quickly, so they return it to the coals often.
transition.zh: 金属冷却得很快，所以他们经常把它放回炭火里。

npcLine.en: This is cooling faster than I thought metal would.
npcLine.zh: 这个冷却得比我以为金属会冷却的速度要快。

choices.text: It is, we'll need to heat it several times.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们需要多次重新加热。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just keep hammering it cold.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we'll need to heat it several times.

npcLine.en: How many times do we need to repeat this process?
npcLine.zh: 我们需要重复这个过程多少次？

choices.text: Probably five or six more times, the instructor said.
choices.zh: 老师说大概还要五六次。

choices.text: We don't need to repeat it at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → Probably five or six more times, the instructor said.

npcLine.en: This shape is starting to look more like a blade now.
npcLine.zh: 这个形状现在开始更像一把刀刃了。

choices.text: It is, I can finally see what it'll become.
choices.zh: 确实是，我终于能看出它会变成什么样了。

choices.text: Shape doesn't matter, let's just melt it down.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I can finally see what it'll become.

transition.en: Carefully, they hammer a thin edge along one side of the blade.
transition.zh: 他们小心地沿着刀身一侧锤出了薄薄的刃口。

npcLine.en: This edge needs to be thinner than the spine of the blade.
npcLine.zh: 这个刃口需要比刀背更薄。

choices.text: It does, let's angle the hammer carefully.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们要小心调整锤子的角度。

choices.text: Thickness doesn't matter, let's just hit it randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's angle the hammer carefully.

npcLine.en: Should we check the shape against this template?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要对照这个模板检查一下形状？

choices.text: Yes, let's compare it every few hits.
choices.zh: 要，我们每敲几下就比对一次吧。

choices.text: No, let's just guess the shape freely.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, let's compare it every few hits.

npcLine.en: This is starting to look like a real knife now.
npcLine.zh: 这个现在开始看起来像一把真正的刀了。

choices.text: It really is, I'm impressed with our progress.
choices.zh: 确实是，我对我们的进展感到很佩服。

choices.text: It really isn't, this just looks like a lump.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really is, I'm impressed with our progress.

transition.en: With tongs, the instructor plunges the hot blade into a bucket of oil.
transition.zh: 老师用钳子把热刀刃浸入了一桶油里。

npcLine.en: That hissed louder than anything I've heard all day.
npcLine.zh: 那声嘶嘶声比我今天听到的任何声音都要大。

choices.text: It did, that sudden cooling must be intense.
choices.zh: 确实是，那种骤冷一定很剧烈。

choices.text: Volume doesn't matter, let's ignore that sound.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It did, that sudden cooling must be intense.

npcLine.en: Why do we need to cool it down so quickly?
npcLine.zh: 为什么我们需要这么快地把它冷却下来？

choices.text: It hardens the steel so it holds an edge.
choices.zh: 这能让钢材变硬，让刀刃更持久。

choices.text: Cooling speed doesn't affect the metal at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → It hardens the steel so it holds an edge.

npcLine.en: This blade is harder now than it was an hour ago.
npcLine.zh: 这把刀现在比一小时前要硬得多。

choices.text: It is, quenching really changed everything.
choices.zh: 确实是，淬火确实改变了一切。

choices.text: Hardness doesn't matter, let's bend it for fun.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, quenching really changed everything.

transition.en: They use a grinder to smooth the rough surface of the blade.
transition.zh: 他们用磨床把刀身粗糙的表面打磨光滑。

npcLine.en: Can you hold this steady while I grind the edge?
npcLine.zh: 我磨刃口的时候你能扶稳吗？

choices.text: I can, take your time and go slow.
choices.zh: 我能扶稳，你慢慢来。

choices.text: I can't hold anything steady right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, take your time and go slow.

npcLine.en: This surface is smoother now than it was this morning.
npcLine.zh: 这个表面现在比今天早上要光滑多了。

choices.text: It is, all that grinding really paid off.
choices.zh: 确实是，那些打磨确实值得。

choices.text: Smoothness doesn't matter, let's stop grinding now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, all that grinding really paid off.

npcLine.en: This will shine even more once we polish it fully.
npcLine.zh: 等我们完全抛光后，这会更闪亮。

choices.text: It will, I can already see the shine forming.
choices.zh: 会的，我已经能看到光泽在形成了。

choices.text: It won't, this metal will always look dull.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, I can already see the shine forming.

transition.en: They wrap and secure a wooden handle onto the finished blade.
transition.zh: 他们把一个木质刀柄包裹并固定在成品刀身上。

npcLine.en: This wood feels warmer in the hand than metal would.
npcLine.zh: 这块木头握在手里比金属要更温暖。

choices.text: It does, that'll make it more comfortable to hold.
choices.zh: 确实是，这会让握持更舒服。

choices.text: Warmth doesn't matter, let's use metal instead.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, that'll make it more comfortable to hold.

npcLine.en: Should we sand the handle before we attach it?
npcLine.zh: 我们装上之前要不要先打磨一下刀柄？

choices.text: Yes, a smooth handle grips better.
choices.zh: 要，光滑的刀柄握起来更好。

choices.text: No, let's attach it exactly as it is.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, a smooth handle grips better.

npcLine.en: This finally looks like a finished knife, not just a project.
npcLine.zh: 这终于看起来像一把完成的刀了，不再只是个半成品。

choices.text: It really does, our first project actually worked.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们的第一个项目真的成功了。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this still looks unfinished.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really does, our first project actually worked.

transition.en: They hold up the completed knife, glinting under the workshop lights.
transition.zh: 他们举起了做好的刀，在车间灯光下闪闪发亮。

npcLine.en: This turned out better than I ever expected on our first try.
npcLine.zh: 以第一次尝试来说，这做出来比我曾经预想的要好。

choices.text: It really did, I'm proud of what we made.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我为我们做出的东西感到自豪。

choices.text: It really didn't, this looks pretty rough.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, I'm proud of what we made.

npcLine.en: Can you believe we shaped this from a plain steel bar?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信这是我们从一根普通钢条打出来的吗？

choices.text: I honestly can't, this feels like real craftsmanship.
choices.zh: 我真的不敢相信，这感觉像真正的手艺。

choices.text: I can believe it, this looks totally ordinary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表惊讶 → I honestly can't, this feels like real craftsmanship.

npcLine.en: Let's frame the receipt just to remember this day.
npcLine.zh: 我们把这张凭证裱起来，纪念今天吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this deserves a special memory.
choices.zh: 好啊，这值得一份特别的纪念。

choices.text: Let's just throw the receipt away right now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this deserves a special memory.

transition.en: On the drive home, the new knife rests carefully in its sheath.
transition.zh: 回家的路上，新刀小心地放在刀鞘里。

npcLine.en: Today felt more satisfying than most weekends we've had.
npcLine.zh: 今天比我们大多数周末都要更有成就感。

choices.text: It really did, making something with our hands mattered.
choices.zh: 确实如此，亲手做点东西真的很有意义。

choices.text: It really didn't, today felt pretty ordinary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, making something with our hands mattered.

npcLine.en: Someday we'll tell people we forged our own knife.
npcLine.zh: 将来我们会告诉别人我们自己锻造过一把刀。

choices.text: We will, and no one will quite believe it.
choices.zh: 会的，没人会完全相信的。

choices.text: We won't, this isn't worth mentioning to anyone.

n2.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, and no one will quite believe it.

npcLine.en: No matter how many hobbies we try, this one felt different.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们尝试了多少爱好，这次感觉不一样。

choices.text: No matter how many, this one will stay special.
choices.zh: 不管有多少个，这次都会一直特别。

choices.text: No matter how many, they all feel the same.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many, this one will stay special.

transition.en: They arrive at a family orchard on a crisp autumn morning.
transition.zh: 在一个清爽的秋日早晨，他们来到了一家果园。

npcLine.en: Have you ever picked apples straight from a tree?
npcLine.zh: 你以前有直接从树上摘过苹果吗？

choices.text: I've never picked any, only bought them at stores.
choices.zh: 我从没摘过，只在店里买过。

choices.text: I've picked apples every single day this year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never picked any, only bought them at stores.

npcLine.en: These rows look longer than any orchard I've seen in photos.
npcLine.zh: 这些行列比我在照片里见过的任何果园都要长。

choices.text: They do, we could be here all afternoon.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们可能要在这待一整个下午了。

choices.text: Length doesn't matter, let's just pick five apples.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They do, we could be here all afternoon.

npcLine.en: Let's grab some baskets before we start picking.
npcLine.zh: 开始摘之前我们先拿几个果篮吧。

choices.text: Good idea, we'll need somewhere to put them.
choices.zh: 好主意，我们总得有地方放苹果。

choices.text: Let's just carry them all in our arms.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, we'll need somewhere to put them.

transition.en: Their toddler reaches up eagerly toward a low, red apple.
transition.zh: 孩子伸手急切地够向一颗低处的红苹果。

npcLine.en: Can you reach that one on the lower branch?
npcLine.zh: 你能够到低处树枝上那颗吗？

choices.text: They can, just barely on their tiptoes.
choices.zh: 他们能够到，踮着脚刚刚好够到。

choices.text: They can't reach anything from the ground.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → They can, just barely on their tiptoes.

npcLine.en: This apple feels heavier than it looks.
npcLine.zh: 这颗苹果摸起来比看上去要重。

choices.text: It does, it must be really ripe.
choices.zh: 确实是，它一定很熟了。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's just toss it in.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, it must be really ripe.

npcLine.en: Look how quickly this basket is filling up!
npcLine.zh: 看这个果篮装得多快！

choices.text: I see it, we're a pretty good team.
choices.zh: 我看到了，我们配合得挺不错的。

choices.text: I don't see any apples in that basket.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I see it, we're a pretty good team.

transition.en: Signs along the rows label different apple varieties by name.
transition.zh: 行列旁的标牌标注着不同苹果品种的名称。

scenes.title: Comparing Apple Varieties
scenes.subtitle: 果园 · 比较苹果品种

npcLine.en: Which variety do you think tastes the sweetest?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得哪个品种尝起来最甜？

choices.text: Probably this one, it smells amazing already.
choices.zh: 大概是这种吧，闻起来就已经很香了。

choices.text: None of them have any taste at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → Probably this one, it smells amazing already.

npcLine.en: This variety is crunchier than the ones we usually buy.
npcLine.zh: 这个品种比我们平时买的要更脆。

choices.text: It is, I could get used to this kind.
choices.zh: 确实是，我可能会喜欢上这个品种。

choices.text: Crunch doesn't matter, let's just grab any apple.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I could get used to this kind.

npcLine.en: Let's pick a mix so we can compare them all.
npcLine.zh: 我们挑几种混合一下，这样可以都比较一下。

choices.text: Let's do that, variety makes it more fun.
choices.zh: 好啊，多样化会更有趣一些。

choices.text: Let's just pick one kind and stick with it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, variety makes it more fun.

transition.en: At the barn, a farmhand weighs their heavy baskets on a scale.
transition.zh: 在谷仓里，一位农场工人用秤称了他们沉甸甸的果篮。

npcLine.en: How many pounds do you think we picked today?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得我们今天摘了多少磅？

choices.text: Maybe thirty pounds, we filled two full baskets.
choices.zh: 大概三十磅吧，我们装满了两整篮。

choices.text: We didn't pick any apples at all today.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答数量 → Maybe thirty pounds, we filled two full baskets.

npcLine.en: This basket weighs more than I expected it to.
npcLine.zh: 这个果篮比我预想的要重。

choices.text: It does, we really got carried away picking.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们摘得太投入了。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's dump some apples out.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, we really got carried away picking.

npcLine.en: We'll never eat all of these before they go bad.
npcLine.zh: 这么多苹果我们根本吃不完，会坏掉的。

choices.text: We won't, but we could press some into cider.
choices.zh: 确实吃不完，不过我们可以压一些苹果汁。

choices.text: We will finish all of them by tonight easily.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We won't, but we could press some into cider.

transition.en: They try the orchard's old wooden cider press for the first time.
transition.zh: 他们第一次尝试使用果园里那台老式木制榨汁机。

npcLine.en: This crank is harder to turn than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这个摇柄比我预想的要更难转动。

choices.text: It is, let's take turns cranking it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们轮流来转吧。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just give up.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's take turns cranking it.

npcLine.en: Can you smell how sweet this juice already is?
npcLine.zh: 你能闻到这果汁已经有多甜了吗？

choices.text: I can, it smells incredible right now.
choices.zh: 我能闻到，现在闻起来棒极了。

choices.text: I can't smell anything from the press.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it smells incredible right now.

npcLine.en: This is producing more juice than I thought apples could hold.
npcLine.zh: 这榨出的汁比我以为苹果能装的要多。

choices.text: It is, apples are mostly water it seems.
choices.zh: 确实是，看来苹果大部分是水分。

choices.text: Amount doesn't matter, let's stop cranking now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, apples are mostly water it seems.

transition.en: They pour the freshly pressed juice into small paper cups.
transition.zh: 他们把刚压好的果汁倒进了小纸杯里。

scenes.title: Tasting Fresh Cider
scenes.subtitle: 谷仓 · 品尝鲜榨苹果汁

npcLine.en: This tastes fresher than any juice from a bottle.
npcLine.zh: 这尝起来比瓶装果汁要新鲜得多。

choices.text: It really does, nothing compares to this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，没什么能比得上这个。

choices.text: It really doesn't, bottled juice tastes better.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, nothing compares to this.

npcLine.en: Their whole face is lighting up from that first sip!
npcLine.zh: 他们喝了第一口整张脸都亮了起来！

choices.text: I can see that, they clearly love it.
choices.zh: 我看得出来，他们显然很喜欢。

choices.text: I don't see any change on their face.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I can see that, they clearly love it.

npcLine.en: We should bottle some to bring home with us.
npcLine.zh: 我们应该装一些瓶带回家。

choices.text: Definitely, let's fill a jug before we leave.
choices.zh: 当然，我们走之前装满一壶吧。

choices.text: Definitely not, let's leave every drop here.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Definitely, let's fill a jug before we leave.

transition.en: They climb onto a wagon for a bumpy hayride around the farm.
transition.zh: 他们爬上了一辆干草车，绕着农场颠簸兜风。

npcLine.en: This ride is bumpier than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这趟车程比我预想的要更颠簸。

choices.text: It is, hold on tight to the rail.
choices.zh: 确实是，扶紧栏杆吧。

choices.text: Bumpiness doesn't matter, let's stand up now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, hold on tight to the rail.

npcLine.en: Are you having fun back there on the hay?
npcLine.zh: 你们在后面坐干草上玩得开心吗？

choices.text: They are, they haven't stopped smiling.
choices.zh: 很开心，他们一直笑个不停。

choices.text: They aren't, they want to get off right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → They are, they haven't stopped smiling.

npcLine.en: This view of the orchard is prettier from up here.
npcLine.zh: 从这里看果园的风景更美。

choices.text: It is, the whole valley looks golden.
choices.zh: 确实是，整个山谷看起来一片金黄。

choices.text: Beauty doesn't matter, let's just look at our phones.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, the whole valley looks golden.

transition.en: Near the exit, a patch of pumpkins catches their toddler's eye.
transition.zh: 出口附近，一片南瓜地吸引了孩子的目光。

npcLine.en: Which pumpkin do you want to bring home with us?
npcLine.zh: 你想带哪个南瓜回家？

choices.text: They're pointing at the biggest one, of course.
choices.zh: 他们当然是指着最大的那个啦。

choices.text: They don't want any pumpkin at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → They're pointing at the biggest one, of course.

npcLine.en: This one is rounder than the others in the patch.
npcLine.zh: 这个比南瓜地里其他的要更圆。

choices.text: It is, it'll look great on our porch.
choices.zh: 确实是，放在我们门廊上会很好看。

choices.text: Shape doesn't matter, let's just grab any one.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, it'll look great on our porch.

npcLine.en: This has been such a full, happy day for us.
npcLine.zh: 对我们来说，今天真是充实又快乐的一天。

choices.text: It really has, I don't want it to end.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我真不想这天就这样结束。

choices.text: It really hasn't, today felt pretty dull.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really has, I don't want it to end.

transition.en: They pack apples, cider jugs, and the pumpkin into the trunk.
transition.zh: 他们把苹果、苹果汁壶和南瓜都装进了后备箱。

npcLine.en: This trunk is fuller than it's ever been before.
npcLine.zh: 这个后备箱比以前任何时候都要装得满。

choices.text: It is, we really went all in today.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们今天真是尽兴了。

choices.text: Fullness doesn't matter, let's buy even more apples.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we really went all in today.

npcLine.en: What should we make first with all these apples?
npcLine.zh: 用这么多苹果我们该先做什么？

choices.text: Let's start with a big apple pie tonight.
choices.zh: 我们今晚先做一个大苹果派吧。

choices.text: We shouldn't make anything with these apples.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → Let's start with a big apple pie tonight.

npcLine.en: No matter how many apples we brought, it'll never feel like too many.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们带了多少苹果，都不会觉得太多。

choices.text: No matter how many, we'll find a use for them.
choices.zh: 不管有多少，我们都能想到用处。

choices.text: No matter how many, half of these will spoil.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many, we'll find a use for them.

transition.en: That evening, the kitchen fills with the smell of cinnamon and baked apples.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，厨房里弥漫着肉桂和烤苹果的香气。

scenes.title: Baking the First Apple Pie
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 烤第一个苹果派

npcLine.en: This kitchen smells better than it has in weeks.
npcLine.zh: 这厨房闻起来比过去几周都要香。

choices.text: It does, I could smell this forever.
choices.zh: 确实是，我可以永远闻着这个味道。

choices.text: Smell doesn't matter, let's open the windows.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I could smell this forever.

npcLine.en: This pie came out better than any we've ever made.
npcLine.zh: 这个派做出来比我们做过的任何一个都要好。

choices.text: It really did, fresh apples made all the difference.
choices.zh: 确实如此，新鲜的苹果带来了全然不同的效果。

choices.text: It really didn't, this pie tastes pretty bland.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, fresh apples made all the difference.

npcLine.en: Let's make this an autumn tradition every single year.
npcLine.zh: 我们把这个定成每年秋天的传统吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, today was too good not to repeat.
choices.zh: 好啊，今天太美好了，值得每年重复。

choices.text: Let's never do this trip again after today.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, today was too good not to repeat.

transition.en: They load rods, tackle boxes, and a cooler into the car.
transition.zh: 他们把鱼竿、渔具箱和冰箱都装上了车。

scenes.title: Packing for the Fishing Trip
scenes.subtitle: 家里 · 准备钓鱼装备

npcLine.en: Have you ever gone fishing before this trip?
npcLine.zh: 这次之前你钓过鱼吗？

choices.text: I've never gone fishing, but I've always wanted to try.
choices.zh: 我从没钓过鱼，不过我一直想试试。

choices.text: I've gone fishing every single day this year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never gone fishing, but I've always wanted to try.

npcLine.en: This tackle box looks heavier than the cooler.
npcLine.zh: 这个渔具箱看起来比冰箱要重。

choices.text: It does, let's carry it with both hands.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们用双手抬吧。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's just drag it along.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's carry it with both hands.

npcLine.en: Let's leave early before the lake gets crowded.
npcLine.zh: 我们早点出发，趁湖边人还不多。

choices.text: Good idea, we'll get the best spot that way.
choices.zh: 好主意，这样我们能占到最好的位置。

choices.text: Let's just leave whenever we feel like it.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, we'll get the best spot that way.

transition.en: By the lake, they attach hooks, weights, and bobbers to the lines.
transition.zh: 在湖边，他们把鱼钩、铅坠和浮标绑到了鱼线上。

npcLine.en: Can you tie this knot tighter than that one?
npcLine.zh: 你能把这个结打得比那个更紧吗？

choices.text: I can, let me try it again slowly.
choices.zh: 我能做到，让我再慢慢试一次。

choices.text: I can't tie any kind of knot at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me try it again slowly.

npcLine.en: This bobber is smaller than the one in the picture.
npcLine.zh: 这个浮标比图片里那个要小。

choices.text: It is, but it should still float just fine.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过它应该还是能正常浮起来。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's throw it away.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but it should still float just fine.

npcLine.en: Once the hook is on, we'll add the bait next.
npcLine.zh: 鱼钩装好后，我们接下来就装鱼饵。

choices.text: We will, I hope the worms don't wiggle too much.
choices.zh: 会的，希望蚯蚓别扭动得太厉害。

choices.text: We won't, let's skip the bait entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, I hope the worms don't wiggle too much.

transition.en: Their toddler watches, half curious and half squeamish, as they bait a hook.
transition.zh: 孩子看着他们装鱼饵，又好奇又有点害怕。

npcLine.en: Is this worm wigglier than the last one we used?
npcLine.zh: 这条蚯蚓比我们上次用的那条扭得更厉害吗？

choices.text: It is, this one clearly wants to escape.
choices.zh: 是的，这条明显想逃跑。

choices.text: It isn't, this worm isn't moving at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → It is, this one clearly wants to escape.

npcLine.en: Why do we have to use real worms as bait?
npcLine.zh: 为什么我们非得用真的蚯蚓当鱼饵？

choices.text: Fish are drawn to their smell and movement.
choices.zh: 鱼会被它们的气味和动作吸引。

choices.text: Fish don't care what kind of bait we use.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → Fish are drawn to their smell and movement.

npcLine.en: Can I hold the worm just once, please?
npcLine.zh: 我能拿一下这条蚯蚓吗，拜托？

choices.text: Sure, hold it gently in your palm.
choices.zh: 可以，轻轻捧在手心里就行。

choices.text: No, worms are never allowed near you.

n3.hintOnWrong: 允许并指导 → Sure, hold it gently in your palm.

transition.en: With a gentle swing, they cast their fishing lines into the water.
transition.zh: 他们轻轻一甩，把鱼线抛进了水里。

npcLine.en: Can you cast it farther than I just did?
npcLine.zh: 你能比我刚才抛得更远吗？

choices.text: I can try, watch this next cast.
choices.zh: 我可以试试，看我这次抛。

choices.text: I can't cast a line at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can try, watch this next cast.

npcLine.en: That cast went farther than mine, nicely done!
npcLine.zh: 这次抛得比我远，抛得好！

choices.text: Thanks, beginner's luck must be on my side.
choices.zh: 谢谢，大概是新手运吧。

choices.text: Distance doesn't matter, let's just reel it in.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Thanks, beginner's luck must be on my side.

npcLine.en: Now we just wait and watch the bobber.
npcLine.zh: 现在我们只需要等待，看着浮标就行。

choices.text: Patience is really the whole game here.
choices.zh: 耐心真的是这整件事的关键。

choices.text: Patience doesn't matter, let's yank the line now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Patience is really the whole game here.

transition.en: The family sits quietly on the bank, watching ripples on the lake.
transition.zh: 一家人静静地坐在岸边，看着湖面上的涟漪。

npcLine.en: This is quieter here than anywhere we've been all week.
npcLine.zh: 这里比我们这周去过的任何地方都要安静。

choices.text: It is, I could get used to this peace.
choices.zh: 确实是，我可能会喜欢上这份宁静。

choices.text: Quiet doesn't matter, let's start talking loudly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I could get used to this peace.

npcLine.en: How long do fish usually take to bite?
npcLine.zh: 鱼通常要多久才会咬钩？

choices.text: Sometimes minutes, sometimes hours, apparently.
choices.zh: 有时几分钟，有时几小时，据说是这样。

choices.text: Fish never actually bite the hook at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答时间 → Sometimes minutes, sometimes hours, apparently.

npcLine.en: Even if we catch nothing, this still feels worth it.
npcLine.zh: 就算什么都钓不到，这也还是值得的。

choices.text: Even if we don't, I'm glad we came.
choices.zh: 就算钓不到，我也很高兴我们来了。

choices.text: Even if we don't, this trip is a failure.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → Even if we don't, I'm glad we came.

transition.en: Suddenly, one bobber jerks and sinks beneath the surface.
transition.zh: 突然，一个浮标猛地一动，沉到了水面以下。

npcLine.en: Did you see that, the bobber just went under!
npcLine.zh: 你看到了吗，浮标刚刚沉下去了！

choices.text: I saw it, grab the rod quickly!
choices.zh: 我看到了，快抓住鱼竿！

choices.text: I didn't see anything move at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 一般过去时回应 → I saw it, grab the rod quickly!

npcLine.en: This tug feels stronger than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这拉力比我预想的要更强。

choices.text: It does, this might be a big one!
choices.zh: 确实是，这可能是条大鱼！

choices.text: Strength doesn't matter, let's just drop the rod.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, this might be a big one!

npcLine.en: Reel it in slowly, don't let the line go slack!
npcLine.zh: 慢慢收线，别让鱼线松掉！

choices.text: Got it, I'm reeling as steadily as I can.
choices.zh: 明白了，我在尽量平稳地收线。

choices.text: No thanks, I'll just yank it out fast.

n3.hintOnWrong: 礼貌回应指示 → Got it, I'm reeling as steadily as I can.

transition.en: With a final splash, a shining fish breaks the surface.
transition.zh: 水花一溅，一条闪亮的鱼跃出了水面。

npcLine.en: This fish is bigger than any I imagined catching!
npcLine.zh: 这条鱼比我想象中能钓到的任何一条都要大！

choices.text: It really is, I can't believe we caught it.
choices.zh: 确实如此，真不敢相信我们钓到了。

choices.text: It really isn't, this fish looks tiny.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I can't believe we caught it.

npcLine.en: Can you hold it still while I get the hook out?
npcLine.zh: 我摘钩的时候你能扶住它别动吗？

choices.text: I can, go ahead and remove it carefully.
choices.zh: 我能扶住，你小心地把钩摘出来吧。

choices.text: I can't hold anything slippery like this.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, go ahead and remove it carefully.

npcLine.en: Their eyes are wider than I've ever seen them!
npcLine.zh: 他们的眼睛睁得比我以前见过的任何时候都大！

choices.text: They really are, this is pure excitement for them.
choices.zh: 确实如此，这对他们来说是纯粹的兴奋。

choices.text: They really aren't, they seem completely unbothered.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They really are, this is pure excitement for them.

transition.en: They discuss whether to keep the fish or release it back.
transition.zh: 他们商量着是该留下这条鱼还是把它放回水里。

scenes.title: Deciding What to Do with It
scenes.subtitle: 湖边 · 决定去留

npcLine.en: Should we keep this one or let it go?
npcLine.zh: 我们要留下这条还是放它走？

choices.text: Let's release it, catch and release feels right.
choices.zh: 我们放了它吧，钓放理念感觉更合适。

choices.text: Let's just leave it on the ground to dry.

n1.hintOnWrong: 折中回答 → Let's release it, catch and release feels right.

npcLine.en: If we let it go, it can grow even bigger.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们放了它，它还能长得更大。

choices.text: If that's true, let's give it another chance.
choices.zh: 如果确实如此，我们再给它一次机会吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's keep it anyway.

n2.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If that's true, let's give it another chance.

npcLine.en: Watch it swim away, that was pretty amazing.
npcLine.zh: 看它游走了，这真是太棒了。

choices.text: It really was, I'll remember this moment.
choices.zh: 确实很棒，我会记住这一刻的。

choices.text: It really wasn't, that was pretty forgettable.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really was, I'll remember this moment.

transition.en: They spread a blanket and share sandwiches by the shore.
transition.zh: 他们铺开了毯子，在岸边分享三明治。

npcLine.en: This sandwich tastes better out here than at home.
npcLine.zh: 这个三明治在这吃比在家吃更好吃。

choices.text: It does, fresh air makes everything taste better.
choices.zh: 确实是，新鲜空气让一切都更美味。

choices.text: Taste doesn't matter, let's just eat inside next time.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, fresh air makes everything taste better.

npcLine.en: Today has been more relaxing than any weekend lately.
npcLine.zh: 今天比最近任何一个周末都要放松。

choices.text: It has, we needed a day like this.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们需要这样的一天。

choices.text: Relaxation doesn't matter, let's plan something hectic instead.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It has, we needed a day like this.

npcLine.en: Let's come back to this same spot again soon.
npcLine.zh: 我们要再回到这个地方来。

choices.text: Let's do that, this place feels like ours now.
choices.zh: 好啊，这地方现在感觉像是我们自己的了。

choices.text: Let's never come back to this lake again.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this place feels like ours now.

transition.en: Sunburned and sleepy, they drive home as the sky turns orange.
transition.zh: 晒黑了、有点困，他们在天空转橙的时候开车回家。

npcLine.en: This sunset looks more beautiful than usual tonight.
npcLine.zh: 今晚这日落比平时看起来更美。

choices.text: It does, maybe today just made everything brighter.
choices.zh: 确实是，也许是今天让一切都变得更明亮了。

choices.text: Beauty doesn't matter, let's just close our eyes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, maybe today just made everything brighter.

npcLine.en: They fell asleep faster than I've ever seen them fall asleep.
npcLine.zh: 他们睡着的速度比我见过的任何时候都要快。

choices.text: That's a good sign, today really tired them out.
choices.zh: 这是个好迹象，今天确实把他们累坏了。

choices.text: That's odd, they usually fight sleep for hours.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → That's a good sign, today really tired them out.

npcLine.en: No matter how many hobbies we try, simple days like this stay the best.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们尝试多少爱好，像这样简单的日子始终是最好的。

choices.text: No matter how many, I'll always love days like this.
choices.zh: 不管有多少个，我都会一直喜欢这样的日子。

choices.text: No matter how many, this day was pretty forgettable.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many, I'll always love days like this.

transition.en: Shelves of colorful board games line every wall of the cozy café.
transition.zh: 一排排色彩缤纷的桌游摆满了这家温馨咖啡馆的每面墙。

scenes.title: Entering the Board Game Café
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 走进咖啡馆

npcLine.en: Have you ever seen this many games in one place?
npcLine.zh: 你以前有在一个地方见过这么多游戏吗？

choices.text: I've never seen this many, it's overwhelming.
choices.zh: 我从没见过这么多，简直让人应接不暇。

choices.text: I've seen this many games every single day.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never seen this many, it's overwhelming.

npcLine.en: This selection looks bigger than any store we've visited.
npcLine.zh: 这个选择范围比我们去过的任何店都要大。

choices.text: It does, we might be here for hours.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们可能要在这待好几个小时了。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's just grab the first box.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, we might be here for hours.

npcLine.en: Let's ask the staff for a beginner recommendation.
npcLine.zh: 我们问问店员推荐个适合新手的游戏吧。

choices.text: Good idea, they'll know what's easiest.
choices.zh: 好主意，他们会知道哪个最简单。

choices.text: Let's just grab the hardest game on the shelf.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, they'll know what's easiest.

transition.en: A friendly staff member suggests a light strategy game for families.
transition.zh: 一位友善的店员推荐了一款适合家庭的轻策略游戏。

scenes.title: Choosing a Game
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 挑选游戏

npcLine.en: Which game sounds more fun to you, this one or that one?
npcLine.zh: 这个和那个，你觉得哪个听起来更有趣？

choices.text: This one, the artwork looks really charming.
choices.zh: 这个吧，画风看起来特别有魅力。

choices.text: Neither one sounds interesting at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → This one, the artwork looks really charming.

npcLine.en: This box is heavier than I expected for a card game.
npcLine.zh: 以一款卡牌游戏来说，这盒子比我预想的要重。

choices.text: It is, there must be a lot of pieces.
choices.zh: 确实是，里面一定有很多配件。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's just pick randomly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, there must be a lot of pieces.

npcLine.en: Let's read the rules together before we start.
npcLine.zh: 开始之前我们一起读一下规则吧。

choices.text: Good idea, no one likes learning mid-game.
choices.zh: 好主意，没人喜欢一边玩一边现学规则。

choices.text: Let's just start playing without reading anything.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, no one likes learning mid-game.

transition.en: They spread out cards, tokens, and a small rulebook on the table.
transition.zh: 他们把卡牌、代币和一本小规则书摊在了桌上。

scenes.title: Learning the Rules
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 学习规则

npcLine.en: These rules are trickier to understand than I expected.
npcLine.zh: 这些规则比我预想的要更难理解。

choices.text: They are, let's go through them slowly.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们慢慢读一遍吧。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just guess how to play.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, let's go through them slowly.

npcLine.en: Can you explain how the scoring works again?
npcLine.zh: 你能再解释一下计分是怎么运作的吗？

choices.text: I can, let me walk through it step by step.
choices.zh: 我能解释，让我一步一步讲一遍。

choices.text: I can't explain anything about this game.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me walk through it step by step.

npcLine.en: Once we understand this, the rest will be easy.
npcLine.zh: 一旦我们理解了这个，剩下的就简单了。

choices.text: It will, I think we're almost there.
choices.zh: 会的，我觉得我们快弄懂了。

choices.text: It won't, this game will only get harder.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, I think we're almost there.

transition.en: The game finally begins as they roll colorful dice across the table.
transition.zh: 他们把彩色骰子掷向桌面，游戏终于开始了。

scenes.title: Rolling the Dice
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 掷骰子

npcLine.en: This roll is luckier than any I've had all night.
npcLine.zh: 这次掷骰比我今晚掷过的任何一次都要幸运。

choices.text: It is, that's exactly the number I needed.
choices.zh: 确实是，正好是我需要的那个数字。

choices.text: Luck doesn't matter, let's just skip this turn.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, that's exactly the number I needed.

npcLine.en: Can you move your piece four spaces forward?
npcLine.zh: 你能把你的棋子往前移四格吗？

choices.text: I can, let me count them carefully.
choices.zh: 我能移，让我仔细数一下。

choices.text: I can't move any pieces on this board.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me count them carefully.

npcLine.en: Their toddler is getting more excited with every roll.
npcLine.zh: 每掷一次骰子，孩子就更兴奋一分。

choices.text: They are, dice are apparently the best part.
choices.zh: 确实是，骰子显然是最有趣的部分。

choices.text: Excitement doesn't matter, let's take the dice away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, dice are apparently the best part.

transition.en: Midway through, a tricky choice forces careful strategic thinking.
transition.zh: 游戏进行到一半，一个棘手的选择需要仔细思考策略。

scenes.title: A Strategic Decision
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 策略抉择

npcLine.en: This decision matters more than any move so far.
npcLine.zh: 这个决定比目前为止任何一步都要重要。

choices.text: It does, let's think this through carefully.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们要仔细考虑一下。

choices.text: Importance doesn't matter, let's just pick randomly.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, let's think this through carefully.

npcLine.en: If we take this path, we could win faster.
npcLine.zh: 如果我们走这条路，可能会赢得更快。

choices.text: If that's true, let's take the risk.
choices.zh: 如果确实如此，我们就冒这个险吧。

choices.text: If that's true, let's play it safe instead.

n2.hintOnWrong: 条件句回应 → If that's true, let's take the risk.

npcLine.en: This game is more strategic than I gave it credit for.
npcLine.zh: 这游戏比我最初想的要更有策略性。

choices.text: It is, I'm impressed with how deep it goes.
choices.zh: 确实是，我对它的深度挺佩服的。

choices.text: Strategy doesn't matter, this is basically luck.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I'm impressed with how deep it goes.

transition.en: Their curious toddler insists on rolling the dice for everyone.
transition.zh: 好奇的孩子坚持要替大家掷骰子。

scenes.title: The Toddler Wants to Play
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 孩子也想玩

npcLine.en: Can I roll the dice for you this time, please?
npcLine.zh: 这次我能替你掷骰子吗，拜托？

choices.text: You can, go ahead and give it a good shake.
choices.zh: 可以，你摇一下再掷吧。

choices.text: No, dice are never allowed near you.

n1.hintOnWrong: 允许并鼓励 → You can, go ahead and give it a good shake.

npcLine.en: Look, they rolled a higher number than I did!
npcLine.zh: 看，他们掷出的数字比我的还要高！

choices.text: They did, they might just be a lucky charm.
choices.zh: 确实是，他们可能就是幸运符。

choices.text: Numbers don't matter, let's ignore that roll.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They did, they might just be a lucky charm.

npcLine.en: Let's make them the official dice roller from now on.
npcLine.zh: 从现在起我们就让他们当官方掷骰手吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, they clearly love the job.
choices.zh: 好啊，他们显然很喜欢这份工作。

choices.text: Let's take that responsibility away from them.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, they clearly love the job.

transition.en: As the game nears its end, the scores turn out surprisingly close.
transition.zh: 游戏接近尾声，分数意外地十分接近。

scenes.title: A Close Finish
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 接近的结局

npcLine.en: This score is closer than any game we've played tonight.
npcLine.zh: 这个比分比我们今晚玩的任何一局都要接近。

choices.text: It is, this could really go either way.
choices.zh: 确实是，这局真的谁赢都有可能。

choices.text: Score doesn't matter, let's just stop playing now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, this could really go either way.

npcLine.en: Who do you think is going to win this round?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得这一局谁会赢？

choices.text: Honestly, I have no idea, it's that close.
choices.zh: 说实话，我完全猜不出来，就是这么接近。

choices.text: No one is going to win this game.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答 → Honestly, I have no idea, it's that close.

npcLine.en: This last turn will decide the whole game.
npcLine.zh: 最后这一轮会决定整局游戏。

choices.text: It will, no pressure at all, right?
choices.zh: 确实会，一点压力都没有，对吧？

choices.text: It won't, the result was already decided.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, no pressure at all, right?

transition.en: Everyone leans in as the final scores are tallied on paper.
transition.zh: 大家都凑上前，看着最后的分数被记在纸上。

scenes.title: The Final Round
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 最后一轮

npcLine.en: Did you count that correctly, can you check again?
npcLine.zh: 你数对了吗，能再检查一遍吗？

choices.text: I can, let me recount just to be sure.
choices.zh: 我能再检查，让我重新数一遍确保没错。

choices.text: I can't count anything on this table.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, let me recount just to be sure.

npcLine.en: We won by only two points, that's incredible!
npcLine.zh: 我们只赢了两分，太不可思议了！

choices.text: We did, that was such a close game.
choices.zh: 确实是，这局真的太接近了。

choices.text: We didn't win anything at all tonight.

n2.hintOnWrong: 一般过去时回应 → We did, that was such a close game.

npcLine.en: This was more fun than any game night we've had.
npcLine.zh: 这比我们之前任何一次游戏之夜都更好玩。

choices.text: It really was, let's make this a regular thing.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我们把这变成常规活动吧。

choices.text: It really wasn't, I found tonight pretty boring.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really was, let's make this a regular thing.

transition.en: Before leaving, they browse the shelves for a game to try next.
transition.zh: 离开前，他们浏览了货架，寻找下次想玩的游戏。

scenes.title: Browsing for Next Time
scenes.subtitle: 桌游咖啡馆 · 为下次挑选

npcLine.en: Which game should we try on our next visit?
npcLine.zh: 我们下次来该试试哪个游戏？

choices.text: Maybe this cooperative one, working together sounds fun.
choices.zh: 也许试试这个合作类的，一起合作听起来挺有趣。

choices.text: We shouldn't try any new games ever again.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → Maybe this cooperative one, working together sounds fun.

npcLine.en: This box looks more complex than the one we just played.
npcLine.zh: 这盒子看起来比我们刚玩的那个更复杂。

choices.text: It does, but we'll grow into it eventually.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过我们最终会慢慢适应的。

choices.text: Complexity doesn't matter, let's avoid it forever.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, but we'll grow into it eventually.

npcLine.en: Let's make family game night a weekly tradition now.
npcLine.zh: 我们把家庭游戏之夜变成每周的传统吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, tonight was too good to be rare.
choices.zh: 好啊，今晚太棒了，不该只是偶尔一次。

choices.text: Let's never do this again after tonight.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, tonight was too good to be rare.

transition.en: In the car, their toddler chatters about winning the dice roll.
transition.zh: 在车上，孩子叽叽喳喳地说着自己掷骰子赢的事。

npcLine.en: They're talking faster than they have all week!
npcLine.zh: 他们说话的速度比这周任何时候都要快！

choices.text: They are, tonight really got them excited.
choices.zh: 确实是，今晚真的让他们很兴奋。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's tell them to be quiet.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They are, tonight really got them excited.

npcLine.en: Someday they'll remember this as their first board game.
npcLine.zh: 将来他们会记得这是自己第一次玩桌游。

choices.text: They will, and I hope they always love games.
choices.zh: 会的，希望他们能一直喜欢游戏。

choices.text: They won't, toddlers forget everything instantly.

n2.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → They will, and I hope they always love games.

npcLine.en: No matter how many game nights we have, tonight will stay special.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们有多少个游戏之夜，今晚都会一直特别。

choices.text: No matter how many, I'll always remember tonight.
choices.zh: 不管有多少个，我都会一直记得今晚。

choices.text: No matter how many, tonight wasn't anything special.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many, I'll always remember tonight.

transition.en: At a riverside rental shop, they pick out kayaks and paddles.
transition.zh: 在河边的一家租赁店，他们挑选了皮划艇和桨。

scenes.title: Renting the Kayaks
scenes.subtitle: 河边租赁店 · 租皮划艇

npcLine.en: Have you ever paddled a kayak before today?
npcLine.zh: 今天之前你划过皮划艇吗？

choices.text: I've never paddled one, but I'm eager to learn.
choices.zh: 我从没划过，不过我很想学。

choices.text: I've paddled kayaks every single day this year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never paddled one, but I'm eager to learn.

npcLine.en: This paddle feels lighter than I expected it to be.
npcLine.zh: 这支桨比我预想的要更轻。

choices.text: It does, that should make paddling easier.
choices.zh: 确实是，这样划起来应该会更轻松。

choices.text: Weight doesn't matter, let's grab any paddle.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, that should make paddling easier.

npcLine.en: Let's put on our life jackets before we launch.
npcLine.zh: 下水之前我们先穿上救生衣吧。

choices.text: Good idea, safety comes first on the water.
choices.zh: 好主意，在水上安全永远第一。

choices.text: Let's just skip the jackets, we'll be fine.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, safety comes first on the water.

transition.en: An instructor shows them how to hold the paddle correctly.
transition.zh: 一位教练示范了如何正确握桨。

npcLine.en: Can you hold the paddle with both hands like this?
npcLine.zh: 你能像这样用双手握住桨吗？

choices.text: I can, this grip feels pretty natural.
choices.zh: 我能做到，这个握法感觉挺自然的。

choices.text: I can't hold anything with two hands.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, this grip feels pretty natural.

npcLine.en: This stroke is trickier to master than it looks.
npcLine.zh: 这个划桨动作比看起来更难掌握。

choices.text: It is, but I'm slowly getting the rhythm.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过我慢慢找到节奏了。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just splash randomly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but I'm slowly getting the rhythm.

npcLine.en: Once you get the rhythm, steering gets much easier.
npcLine.zh: 一旦你找到节奏，操控就会容易得多。

choices.text: It will, I can already feel it improving.
choices.zh: 会的，我已经能感觉到在进步了。

choices.text: It won't, steering will always feel impossible.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, I can already feel it improving.

transition.en: They push off from the bank and glide onto calm water.
transition.zh: 他们从岸边推离，滑入了平静的水面。

npcLine.en: This water is calmer than I expected for a river.
npcLine.zh: 作为一条河，这水面比我预想的要平静。

choices.text: It is, perfect conditions for our first try.
choices.zh: 确实是，是我们第一次尝试的绝佳条件。

choices.text: Calmness doesn't matter, let's paddle as fast as possible.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, perfect conditions for our first try.

npcLine.en: Can you feel how the current pulls us gently downstream?
npcLine.zh: 你能感觉到水流轻轻地把我们往下游推吗？

choices.text: I can feel it, it's actually kind of relaxing.
choices.zh: 我能感觉到，其实挺让人放松的。

choices.text: I can't feel any movement at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can feel it, it's actually kind of relaxing.

npcLine.en: This feels more peaceful than I imagined it would be.
npcLine.zh: 这比我想象的要更平静宜人。

choices.text: It does, I could paddle like this for hours.
choices.zh: 确实是，我可以这样划上好几个小时。

choices.text: Peace doesn't matter, let's race each other now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I could paddle like this for hours.

transition.en: Their toddler sits bundled in a small seat between the paddlers.
transition.zh: 孩子裹得严严实实地坐在两位划桨人中间的小座位上。

scenes.title: The Toddler in a Tandem Kayak
scenes.subtitle: 河上 · 双人艇上的孩子

npcLine.en: Are you comfortable back there in your little seat?
npcLine.zh: 你坐在那个小座位上舒服吗？

choices.text: They are, they seem completely at ease.
choices.zh: 很舒服，他们看起来完全放松。

choices.text: They aren't, they want to get out right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → They are, they seem completely at ease.

npcLine.en: Look, they're pointing at a duck swimming right beside us!
npcLine.zh: 看，他们在指着游在我们旁边的一只鸭子！

choices.text: I see it, wildlife is everywhere out here.
choices.zh: 我看到了，这附近到处都是野生动物。

choices.text: I don't see any animals nearby at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I see it, wildlife is everywhere out here.

npcLine.en: This might be their favorite part of the whole trip.
npcLine.zh: 这可能是整趟旅程里他们最喜欢的部分。

choices.text: It might be, look at that huge smile.
choices.zh: 很有可能，看那灿烂的笑容。

choices.text: It can't be, they look completely bored.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It might be, look at that huge smile.

transition.en: They practice steering the kayak around a gentle bend in the river.
transition.zh: 他们练习在河流一个平缓的弯道处操控皮划艇转弯。

npcLine.en: This turn is smoother than the last one we tried.
npcLine.zh: 这次转弯比我们上次试的要更顺畅。

choices.text: It is, we're getting better with practice.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们越练越好了。

choices.text: Smoothness doesn't matter, let's stop paddling entirely.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, we're getting better with practice.

npcLine.en: Should we paddle harder on the left to turn right?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要左边多用力划来向右转？

choices.text: Yes, that's exactly how steering works apparently.
choices.zh: 对，据说操控就是这个原理。

choices.text: No, direction doesn't matter at all here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, that's exactly how steering works apparently.

npcLine.en: This is starting to feel more natural now.
npcLine.zh: 这现在开始感觉更自然了。

choices.text: It is, I think we've got the hang of it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我觉得我们摸到窍门了。

choices.text: Naturalness doesn't matter, let's just drift aimlessly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, I think we've got the hang of it.

transition.en: A playful splash from a paddle sends cool water over everyone.
transition.zh: 一次调皮的划桨溅起的水花把大家都弄湿了。

npcLine.en: That splash was colder than I expected it to be!
npcLine.zh: 那水花比我预想的要更凉！

choices.text: It was, but it actually feels refreshing.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过感觉挺清爽的。

choices.text: Temperature doesn't matter, let's splash back harder.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It was, but it actually feels refreshing.

npcLine.en: Their laughter was louder than the sound of the river!
npcLine.zh: 他们的笑声比河水的声音还要响亮！

choices.text: It was, that sound made the whole trip better.
choices.zh: 确实是，那笑声让整趟旅程更美好了。

choices.text: Volume doesn't matter, let's tell them to quiet down.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It was, that sound made the whole trip better.

npcLine.en: Let's be a little more careful with the paddle from now on.
npcLine.zh: 从现在起我们用桨的时候小心点吧。

choices.text: Good idea, wet clothes aren't ideal out here.
choices.zh: 好主意，穿着湿衣服在这可不太理想。

choices.text: Let's splash even more, it's actually fun.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, wet clothes aren't ideal out here.

transition.en: A heron stands motionless in the shallows as they paddle past.
transition.zh: 一只苍鹭静静地站在浅水处，他们划桨经过。

scenes.title: Spotting Wildlife
scenes.subtitle: 河上 · 观察野生动物

npcLine.en: Can you see that heron standing so still over there?
npcLine.zh: 你能看到那边站得一动不动的苍鹭吗？

choices.text: I can, it hasn't moved an inch.
choices.zh: 我能看到，它一动都没动。

choices.text: I can't see any birds anywhere near us.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it hasn't moved an inch.

npcLine.en: This bird is more patient than any hunter I've seen.
npcLine.zh: 这只鸟比我见过的任何猎手都要有耐心。

choices.text: It is, it's waiting for the perfect moment.
choices.zh: 确实是，它在等待完美的时机。

choices.text: Patience doesn't matter, let's paddle right at it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, it's waiting for the perfect moment.

npcLine.en: Let's paddle quietly so we don't scare it off.
npcLine.zh: 我们轻轻划桨，别把它吓跑了。

choices.text: Let's do that, I want to watch it a bit longer.
choices.zh: 好啊，我想再多看它一会儿。

choices.text: Let's shout and see if it flies away.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I want to watch it a bit longer.

transition.en: They pull the kayaks onto a small sandbar to rest and snack.
transition.zh: 他们把皮划艇拖上一片小沙洲，休息、吃点东西。

npcLine.en: This sand feels warmer than the water we've been sitting in.
