npcLine.zh: 这沙子比我们坐着的水要更暖和。

choices.text: It does, this is a perfect little break spot.
choices.zh: 确实是，这是个休息的绝佳小地方。

choices.text: Warmth doesn't matter, let's get back in the water now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, this is a perfect little break spot.

npcLine.en: My arms are more tired than I expected after that stretch.
npcLine.zh: 划了那一段之后，我的胳膊比我预想的要更累。

choices.text: Mine too, but it's a good kind of tired.
choices.zh: 我也是，不过是那种好的累。

choices.text: Tiredness doesn't matter, let's paddle twice as far.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Mine too, but it's a good kind of tired.

npcLine.en: This snack tastes better after all that paddling.
npcLine.zh: 划了这么久之后，这零食吃起来更香了。

choices.text: It does, everything tastes better after exercise.
choices.zh: 确实是，运动之后什么都更好吃。

choices.text: Taste doesn't matter, let's skip the snack entirely.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, everything tastes better after exercise.

transition.en: Refreshed, they turn the kayaks around and paddle back upstream.
transition.zh: 休息够了，他们调转皮划艇，往上游划回去。

npcLine.en: This is harder than paddling with the current was.
npcLine.zh: 这比顺着水流划要更费力。

choices.text: It is, let's paddle steadily and pace ourselves.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们要稳稳地划，控制节奏。

choices.text: Difficulty doesn't matter, let's just sprint the whole way.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, let's paddle steadily and pace ourselves.

npcLine.en: We're closer to the dock now than we were an hour ago.
npcLine.zh: 我们现在离码头比一小时前要近多了。

choices.text: We are, we're almost back now.
choices.zh: 确实是，我们快到了。

choices.text: Distance doesn't matter, let's just stop paddling here.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → We are, we're almost back now.

npcLine.en: We actually paddled this whole river today, all of us.
npcLine.zh: 我们今天真的一起划完了整条河。

choices.text: We did, I'm proud of our whole family.
choices.zh: 确实是，我为我们全家感到骄傲。

choices.text: We didn't, we barely moved at all today.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → We did, I'm proud of our whole family.

transition.en: Tired and sun-kissed, they haul the kayaks back onto the dock.
transition.zh: 疲惫又晒得微红，他们把皮划艇拖回了码头。

npcLine.en: Today turned out more adventurous than I ever expected.
npcLine.zh: 今天比我曾经预想的要更有冒险精神。

choices.text: It really did, I'm so glad we tried this.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我很高兴我们尝试了这个。

choices.text: It really didn't, today felt pretty ordinary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really did, I'm so glad we tried this.

npcLine.en: Someday we'll paddle an even longer stretch of river.
npcLine.zh: 将来我们会划更长一段河。

choices.text: We will, today was just the beginning.
choices.zh: 会的，今天只是个开始。

choices.text: We won't, this was probably a one-time thing.

n2.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → We will, today was just the beginning.

npcLine.en: No matter how tired we are, this was completely worth it.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们有多累，今天完全值得。

choices.text: No matter how tired, I'd do this again tomorrow.
choices.zh: 不管多累，我明天都愿意再来一次。

choices.text: No matter how tired, we shouldn't have come at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how tired, I'd do this again tomorrow.

transition.en: They walk into a domed building humming with quiet anticipation.
transition.zh: 他们走进一座圆顶建筑，四周弥漫着安静的期待感。

scenes.title: Arriving at the Planetarium
scenes.subtitle: 天文馆 · 抵达天文馆

npcLine.en: Have you ever been inside a planetarium before?
npcLine.zh: 你以前进过天文馆吗？

choices.text: I've never been inside one, I'm quite curious.
choices.zh: 我从没进去过，挺好奇的。

choices.text: I've been inside one every single week this year.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never been inside one, I'm quite curious.

npcLine.en: This dome looks bigger than any ceiling we've stood under.
npcLine.zh: 这个穹顶比我们站过的任何天花板都要大。

choices.text: It does, I wonder what it'll show us.
choices.zh: 确实是，我很好奇它会给我们展示什么。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's just look at the floor.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I wonder what it'll show us.

npcLine.en: Let's find seats near the middle of the theater.
npcLine.zh: 我们找靠近影厅中间的座位吧。

choices.text: Good idea, the view should be best from there.
choices.zh: 好主意，那里的视野应该最好。

choices.text: Let's sit right against the back wall instead.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, the view should be best from there.

transition.en: The lights dim, and stars slowly bloom across the curved screen.
transition.zh: 灯光渐暗，星星在弯曲的银幕上慢慢绽放。

npcLine.en: This looks more real than any picture I've seen of space.
npcLine.zh: 这看起来比我见过的任何太空照片都更真实。

choices.text: It does, I feel like I'm actually up there.
choices.zh: 确实是，我感觉自己好像真的身在其中。

choices.text: Realism doesn't matter, let's just close our eyes.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I feel like I'm actually up there.

npcLine.en: Can you see how the projector fills the whole ceiling?
npcLine.zh: 你能看到投影仪是怎么铺满整个穹顶的吗？

choices.text: I can, it's honestly a bit dizzying.
choices.zh: 我能看到，说实话有点让人晕。

choices.text: I can't see anything on the ceiling at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's honestly a bit dizzying.

npcLine.en: This whole room is turning into outer space right now.
npcLine.zh: 整个房间现在正在变成外太空。

choices.text: It is, I've never seen anything like it.
choices.zh: 确实是，我从没见过这样的场景。

choices.text: It isn't, this still looks like a normal room.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → It is, I've never seen anything like it.

transition.en: A narrator guides them past glowing planets one by one.
transition.zh: 一位讲解员带他们逐一飞过发光的行星。

scenes.title: Touring the Solar System
scenes.subtitle: 天文馆 · 太阳系巡游

npcLine.en: Which planet do you think looks the most beautiful?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得哪颗行星看起来最美？

choices.text: Saturn, those rings are absolutely stunning.
choices.zh: 土星吧，那些光环真是美极了。

choices.text: None of them look interesting at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → Saturn, those rings are absolutely stunning.

npcLine.en: This planet is bigger than every other one combined.
npcLine.zh: 这颗行星比其他所有行星加起来都要大。

choices.text: It is, Jupiter really is enormous.
choices.zh: 确实是，木星真的太庞大了。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's skip past it quickly.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, Jupiter really is enormous.

npcLine.en: Our whole planet looks smaller than I ever imagined from here.
npcLine.zh: 从这里看，我们整个星球比我曾经想象的要小得多。

choices.text: It does, it puts everything into perspective.
choices.zh: 确实是，这让人重新看待一切。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, Earth is still the biggest.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, it puts everything into perspective.

transition.en: Their toddler stretches tiny hands up toward the glowing dome.
transition.zh: 孩子伸出小手，朝着发光的穹顶够去。

scenes.title: A Toddler Reaches for Stars
scenes.subtitle: 天文馆 · 孩子伸手够星星

npcLine.en: Can I touch the stars, they look so close?
npcLine.zh: 我能摸到星星吗，它们看起来好近？

choices.text: Not quite, but you can pretend to touch them.
choices.zh: 还不太行，不过你可以假装摸摸看。

choices.text: Sure, reach right through the screen and grab one.

n1.hintOnWrong: 拒绝但引导 → Not quite, but you can pretend to touch them.

npcLine.en: This is the most amazed I've ever seen them look.
npcLine.zh: 这是我见过他们看起来最惊叹的一次。

choices.text: It really is, this trip is worth it just for that.
choices.zh: 确实如此，光凭这一点这趟就值了。

choices.text: Amazement doesn't matter, let's just leave already.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, this trip is worth it just for that.

npcLine.en: This might be the moment they fall in love with space.
npcLine.zh: 这可能就是他们爱上太空的那一刻。

choices.text: It might be, wouldn't that be wonderful?
choices.zh: 很有可能，那不是太美好了吗？

choices.text: It can't be, kids forget things instantly.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It might be, wouldn't that be wonderful?

transition.en: Swirling clouds of purple and orange light fill the entire dome.
transition.zh: 紫色和橙色的光云在整个穹顶中盘旋交织。

npcLine.en: This nebula is more colorful than anything I've ever seen.
npcLine.zh: 这片星云比我见过的任何东西都要绚丽。

choices.text: It really is, I could watch this forever.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我可以一直看着它。

choices.text: Color doesn't matter, let's fast forward past it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really is, I could watch this forever.

npcLine.en: Do you know that stars are actually born inside these clouds?
npcLine.zh: 你知道恒星其实是在这些云团里诞生的吗？

choices.text: I didn't, that's a genuinely fascinating fact.
choices.zh: 我不知道，这真是个非常有意思的知识。

choices.text: I did, everyone already knows that fact.

n2.hintOnWrong: 否定但表兴趣 → I didn't, that's a genuinely fascinating fact.

npcLine.en: This whole universe suddenly feels bigger than I ever realized.
npcLine.zh: 整个宇宙突然感觉比我曾经意识到的要大得多。

choices.text: It does, it's humbling in the best way.
choices.zh: 确实是，这让人以最好的方式感到谦卑。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's think about something else.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, it's humbling in the best way.

transition.en: The lights slowly rise, and the theater returns to a plain ceiling.
transition.zh: 灯光渐渐亮起，影厅恢复成了一个普通的天花板。

scenes.title: After the Show
scenes.subtitle: 天文馆 · 电影结束后

npcLine.en: This ceiling looks plainer now than it did during the show.
npcLine.zh: 这个天花板现在看起来比放映时要朴素多了。

choices.text: It does, hard to believe it's the same room.
choices.zh: 确实是，很难相信是同一个房间。

choices.text: Appearance doesn't matter, let's just leave right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, hard to believe it's the same room.

npcLine.en: What was your favorite part of the whole show?
npcLine.zh: 整场影片里你最喜欢哪部分？

choices.text: Definitely the nebula, those colors were incredible.
choices.zh: 绝对是星云，那些颜色太震撼了。

choices.text: I didn't have any favorite part at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → Definitely the nebula, those colors were incredible.

npcLine.en: Let's visit the gift shop before we head home.
npcLine.zh: 回家之前我们去礼品店看看吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, I want a little souvenir.
choices.zh: 好啊，我想买个小纪念品。

choices.text: Let's skip the shop and just leave.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, I want a little souvenir.

transition.en: A glowing model of the solar system catches their eye in the shop.
transition.zh: 店里一个会发光的太阳系模型吸引了他们的目光。

scenes.title: The Gift Shop Globe
scenes.subtitle: 礼品店 · 太阳系模型

npcLine.en: This model is more detailed than the poster we saw earlier.
npcLine.zh: 这个模型比我们之前看到的海报要更精细。

choices.text: It is, you can even see the little rings.
choices.zh: 确实是，甚至能看到那些小光环。

choices.text: Detail doesn't matter, let's just grab a magnet.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, you can even see the little rings.

npcLine.en: Should we get this for their room at home?
npcLine.zh: 我们要不要给他们的房间买这个？

choices.text: Yes, they'll love falling asleep under it.
choices.zh: 要，他们会喜欢在它下面入睡的。

choices.text: No, let's leave it here on the shelf.

n2.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → Yes, they'll love falling asleep under it.

npcLine.en: This will remind them of today every single night.
npcLine.zh: 这会让他们每晚都想起今天。

choices.text: It will, what a lovely thing to have.
choices.zh: 会的，能拥有这样的东西真美好。

choices.text: It won't, they'll forget about today by tomorrow.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, what a lovely thing to have.

transition.en: On the drive home, real stars appear scattered across the night sky.
transition.zh: 回家的路上，真正的星星散布在夜空中。

scenes.title: Driving Home Under Real Stars
scenes.subtitle: 车上 · 在真实星空下回家

npcLine.en: These real stars look dimmer than the ones inside the dome.
npcLine.zh: 这些真实的星星看起来比穹顶里那些要暗淡一些。

choices.text: They do, but they're actually really out there.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过它们是真的存在于那里。

choices.text: Brightness doesn't matter, the show was fake anyway.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → They do, but they're actually really out there.

npcLine.en: Can you point out any constellations we learned about tonight?
npcLine.zh: 你能指出今晚我们学到的任何星座吗？

choices.text: I can, that group over there is Orion.
choices.zh: 我能指出来，那边那一群就是猎户座。

choices.text: I can't recognize any shapes up there.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, that group over there is Orion.

npcLine.en: No matter how many times we look up, the sky never gets old.
npcLine.zh: 不管我们抬头看多少次，天空都不会让人厌倦。

choices.text: No matter how many times, I'll always look up.
choices.zh: 不管多少次，我都会一直抬头看的。

choices.text: No matter how many times, it eventually gets boring.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how many times, I'll always look up.

transition.en: That night, they hang the new solar system model above the crib.
transition.zh: 那天晚上，他们把新的太阳系模型挂在了婴儿床上方。

scenes.title: Hanging the Glowing Globe
scenes.subtitle: 婴儿房 · 挂起发光模型

npcLine.en: This looks even better in the dark than it did in the shop.
npcLine.zh: 这个在暗处看起来比在店里还要好看。

choices.text: It does, the glow is so soft and calming.
choices.zh: 确实是，光晕柔和又让人平静。

choices.text: Looks don't matter, let's leave the lights on.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, the glow is so soft and calming.

npcLine.en: This will be the last thing they see before sleep now.
npcLine.zh: 从现在起这会是他们入睡前看到的最后一样东西。

choices.text: It will, and what a peaceful thing to see.
choices.zh: 会的，能看到这样平静的东西真好。

choices.text: It won't, they never look up before sleeping.

n2.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, and what a peaceful thing to see.

npcLine.en: This was such a full, wonder-filled day for our family.
npcLine.zh: 对我们全家来说，今天真是充实又充满惊奇的一天。

choices.text: It really was, I'll remember today for a long time.
choices.zh: 确实如此，我会记得今天很久很久。

choices.text: It really wasn't, today felt pretty forgettable.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It really was, I'll remember today for a long time.

transition.en: Before bed, the couple sits together thinking about the vastness of it all.
transition.zh: 睡前，夫妻俩坐在一起，思索着这一切的浩瀚。

npcLine.en: Today made me feel smaller than I've ever felt before.
npcLine.zh: 今天让我感觉自己比以往任何时候都要渺小。

choices.text: Me too, but in a good, humbling way.
choices.zh: 我也是，不过是那种很好的、让人谦卑的方式。

choices.text: Size doesn't matter, let's not think about it.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → Me too, but in a good, humbling way.

npcLine.en: Have we ever talked about the universe like this before?
npcLine.zh: 我们以前有像这样谈论过宇宙吗？

choices.text: We haven't, tonight feels like a first for us.
choices.zh: 还没有过，今晚对我们来说感觉是第一次。

choices.text: We've talked about this every single night for years.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → We haven't, tonight feels like a first for us.

npcLine.en: No matter how vast the universe is, this little family feels like everything.
npcLine.zh: 不管宇宙有多浩瀚，这个小家对我来说就是一切。

choices.text: No matter how vast, you and our child are my whole world.
choices.zh: 不管有多浩瀚，你和我们的孩子就是我的整个世界。

choices.text: No matter how vast, our little family barely matters.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how vast, you and our child are my whole world.

transition.en: Steam rises from a small wooden building deep in the maple woods.
transition.zh: 枫树林深处一座小木屋里正冒着蒸汽。

scenes.title: Arriving at the Sugar Shack
scenes.subtitle: 枫糖农场 · 抵达糖屋

npcLine.en: Have you ever seen how maple syrup is actually made?
npcLine.zh: 你以前有见过枫糖浆到底是怎么做出来的吗？

choices.text: I've never seen it, only bought bottles at stores.
choices.zh: 我从没见过，只在店里买过瓶装的。

choices.text: I've seen this process every single week for years.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 → I've never seen it, only bought bottles at stores.

npcLine.en: This building looks older than any barn we've visited.
npcLine.zh: 这座建筑比我们参观过的任何谷仓都要老。

choices.text: It does, it must have quite a history.
choices.zh: 确实是，它一定有不少历史了。

choices.text: Age doesn't matter, let's just walk right past it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, it must have quite a history.

npcLine.en: Let's follow the smell of sweetness inside.
npcLine.zh: 我们跟着甜香味走进去吧。

choices.text: Good idea, my nose is already leading me there.
choices.zh: 好主意，我的鼻子已经在带路了。

choices.text: Let's ignore the smell and go the other way.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Good idea, my nose is already leading me there.

transition.en: A guide shows them how a small spile taps into a maple trunk.
transition.zh: 向导给他们演示了一根小引流管是怎么插进枫树树干的。

scenes.title: Tapping a Maple Tree
scenes.subtitle: 枫树林 · 给枫树钻孔取汁

npcLine.en: Can you see the sap slowly dripping into the bucket?
npcLine.zh: 你能看到树液正慢慢滴进桶里吗？

choices.text: I can, drop by drop, it's mesmerizing.
choices.zh: 我能看到，一滴一滴的，看得让人着迷。

choices.text: I can't see any liquid moving at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, drop by drop, it's mesmerizing.

npcLine.en: This sap looks thinner than I expected maple syrup to be.
npcLine.zh: 这树液比我预想的枫糖浆要稀得多。

choices.text: It does, it's basically just sweet water right now.
choices.zh: 确实是，现在基本上就是甜水。

choices.text: Thickness doesn't matter, let's drink it right now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, it's basically just sweet water right now.

npcLine.en: Once we boil it down, it'll become real syrup.
npcLine.zh: 等我们把它熬煮浓缩，就会变成真正的糖浆。

choices.text: It will, I'm curious how long that takes.
choices.zh: 会的，我很好奇要花多久。

choices.text: It won't, this will always taste like water.

n3.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → It will, I'm curious how long that takes.

transition.en: Steam billows from a long, shallow pan bubbling over a wood fire.
transition.zh: 一口在柴火上咕嘟冒泡的长浅锅腾起阵阵蒸汽。

npcLine.en: This room is hotter than any kitchen we've cooked in.
npcLine.zh: 这间屋子比我们做过饭的任何厨房都要热。

choices.text: It is, all that boiling really warms things up.
choices.zh: 确实是，一直熬煮真的会让屋子变暖。

choices.text: Heat doesn't matter, let's stand right over the pan.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, all that boiling really warms things up.

npcLine.en: Why do we need to boil the sap for so many hours?
npcLine.zh: 为什么我们需要把树液熬煮这么多个小时？

choices.text: It takes forty gallons of sap to make one of syrup.
choices.zh: 要四十加仑树液才能熬出一加仑糖浆。

choices.text: Boiling time doesn't actually change anything at all.

n2.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答原因 → It takes forty gallons of sap to make one of syrup.

npcLine.en: This liquid is turning darker with every passing minute.
npcLine.zh: 这液体每过一分钟就变得更深一些。

choices.text: It is, that color change is fascinating to watch.
choices.zh: 确实是，看着颜色变化真是很有意思。

choices.text: It isn't, this liquid looks exactly the same.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → It is, that color change is fascinating to watch.

transition.en: The farmer dips a thermometer into the bubbling amber liquid.
transition.zh: 农场主把温度计浸入了冒泡的琥珀色液体里。

npcLine.en: Is this syrup ready yet, or does it need more time?
npcLine.zh: 这糖浆好了吗，还是还需要点时间？

choices.text: Almost there, just a few more degrees to go.
choices.zh: 快好了，还差几度就到了。

choices.text: It doesn't need any more time at all.

n1.hintOnWrong: 折中回答 → Almost there, just a few more degrees to go.

npcLine.en: This syrup is thicker now than it was an hour ago.
npcLine.zh: 这糖浆现在比一小时前要浓稠多了。

choices.text: It is, you can really see the change.
choices.zh: 确实是，能明显看出变化。

choices.text: Thickness doesn't matter, let's just bottle it now.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, you can really see the change.

npcLine.en: Can you smell how sweet the whole room has become?
npcLine.zh: 你能闻到整个房间现在变得多甜吗？

choices.text: I can, it's almost overwhelming at this point.
choices.zh: 我能闻到，这时候几乎有点浓得受不了。

choices.text: I can't smell anything different at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, it's almost overwhelming at this point.

transition.en: They dip small wooden spoons into the freshly finished syrup.
transition.zh: 他们用小木勺蘸了蘸刚熬好的糖浆。

scenes.title: Tasting Fresh Syrup
scenes.subtitle: 糖屋内 · 品尝新鲜糖浆

npcLine.en: This tastes richer than any bottle we've ever bought.
npcLine.zh: 这尝起来比我们买过的任何瓶装糖浆都要浓郁。

choices.text: It really does, nothing compares to this freshness.
choices.zh: 确实如此，没什么能比得上这份新鲜。

choices.text: It really doesn't, bottled syrup tastes better.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, nothing compares to this freshness.

npcLine.en: Their whole face is lighting up from that first taste!
npcLine.zh: 他们尝了第一口整张脸都亮了起来！

choices.text: I can see that, syrup this fresh wins every time.
choices.zh: 我看得出来，这么新鲜的糖浆总能赢得人心。

choices.text: I don't see any change on their face.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时回应 → I can see that, syrup this fresh wins every time.

npcLine.en: We should definitely buy a bottle to bring home.
npcLine.zh: 我们绝对应该买一瓶带回家。

choices.text: Definitely, let's grab the biggest one they have.
choices.zh: 当然，我们买他们家最大的那瓶吧。

choices.text: Definitely not, let's leave without buying any.

n3.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → Definitely, let's grab the biggest one they have.

transition.en: They pour hot syrup onto fresh snow, watching it turn into chewy taffy.
transition.zh: 他们把热糖浆倒在新雪上，看着它变成有嚼劲的太妃糖。

npcLine.en: This is hardening faster than I expected it to.
npcLine.zh: 这变硬的速度比我预想的要快。

choices.text: It is, the cold snow works incredibly fast.
choices.zh: 确实是，冷雪的效果快得惊人。

choices.text: Speed doesn't matter, let's just wait an hour.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, the cold snow works incredibly fast.

npcLine.en: Can you twirl it around this little wooden stick?
npcLine.zh: 你能把它绕在这根小木棍上吗？

choices.text: I can, this is oddly satisfying to do.
choices.zh: 我能做到，这样做莫名地让人满足。

choices.text: I can't twirl anything around a stick.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表能力 → I can, this is oddly satisfying to do.

npcLine.en: This is chewier than any candy I've had before.
npcLine.zh: 这比我以前吃过的任何糖果都更有嚼劲。

choices.text: It is, my jaw is getting a real workout.
choices.zh: 确实是，我的下巴都在认真运动了。

choices.text: Chewiness doesn't matter, let's swallow it whole.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, my jaw is getting a real workout.

transition.en: Their sticky-fingered toddler grins with syrup all over their cheeks.
transition.zh: 孩子满脸沾着糖浆，手指也黏糊糊的，笑得很开心。

scenes.title: A Toddler Covered in Syrup
scenes.subtitle: 户外 · 满脸糖浆的孩子

npcLine.en: Are they stickier than any time I've seen them before?
npcLine.zh: 他们现在是不是比我以前见过的任何时候都要黏？

choices.text: They definitely are, syrup is everywhere on them.
choices.zh: 绝对是，他们身上到处都是糖浆。

choices.text: They aren't sticky at all right now.

n1.hintOnWrong: 肯定回答 → They definitely are, syrup is everywhere on them.

npcLine.en: This might be the messiest they've ever been.
npcLine.zh: 这可能是他们有史以来最狼狈的一次。

choices.text: It might be, but they look so happy about it.
choices.zh: 很有可能，不过他们看起来很开心。

choices.text: It can't be, they always stay perfectly clean.

n2.hintOnWrong: 陈述句回应 → It might be, but they look so happy about it.

npcLine.en: Let's take a quick photo before we clean them up.
npcLine.zh: 我们先拍张照，再帮他们清理干净吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this moment is too good to miss.
choices.zh: 好啊，这一刻太珍贵了不能错过。

choices.text: Let's skip the photo and clean them up now.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this moment is too good to miss.

transition.en: At the little farm store, glass bottles of syrup line the shelves.
transition.zh: 在小小的农场商店里，一瓶瓶玻璃装的糖浆摆满了货架。

scenes.title: Buying a Bottle to Take Home
scenes.subtitle: 农场商店 · 买瓶糖浆带回家

npcLine.en: Which grade of syrup should we bring home with us?
npcLine.zh: 我们该带哪个等级的糖浆回家？

choices.text: Let's get the darker one, it has more flavor.
choices.zh: 我们买颜色深一点的吧，风味更浓。

choices.text: We shouldn't buy any syrup at all today.

n1.hintOnWrong: wh-问题回答选择 → Let's get the darker one, it has more flavor.

npcLine.en: This bottle is pricier than I expected for its size.
npcLine.zh: 以这个大小来说，这瓶比我预想的要贵。

choices.text: It is, but real maple syrup is worth it.
choices.zh: 确实是，不过纯枫糖浆值这个价。

choices.text: Price doesn't matter, let's just buy ten bottles.

n2.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It is, but real maple syrup is worth it.

npcLine.en: This will taste better on pancakes than anything from a store.
npcLine.zh: 这个抹在薄煎饼上会比任何店里买的都好吃。

choices.text: It will, I can't wait for breakfast tomorrow.
choices.zh: 会的，我已经等不及明天的早餐了。

choices.text: It won't, store syrup will always taste the same.

n3.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It will, I can't wait for breakfast tomorrow.

transition.en: The car smells sweet the whole ride home from their sticky hands.
transition.zh: 回家的路上，车里因为他们黏糊糊的小手一路都弥漫着甜味。

scenes.title: Driving Home Sticky and Happy
scenes.subtitle: 车上 · 黏糊糊又开心地回家

npcLine.en: This car smells sweeter than it ever has before.
npcLine.zh: 这车比以前任何时候都要闻起来更甜。

choices.text: It does, I don't think I mind it at all.
choices.zh: 确实是，我一点都不介意。

choices.text: Smell doesn't matter, let's open every window.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It does, I don't think I mind it at all.

npcLine.en: Someday they'll remember this as their first sugar shack visit.
npcLine.zh: 将来他们会记得这是自己第一次去糖屋参观。

choices.text: They will, and I hope they always love maple season.
choices.zh: 会的，希望他们能一直喜欢枫糖季。

choices.text: They won't, toddlers forget everything instantly.

n2.hintOnWrong: will 表将来 → They will, and I hope they always love maple season.

npcLine.en: No matter how sticky today got, this was completely worth it.
npcLine.zh: 不管今天有多黏糊糊，这都是完全值得的。

choices.text: No matter how sticky, I'd do this again next year.
choices.zh: 不管多黏，明年我都愿意再来一次。

choices.text: No matter how sticky, we shouldn't have come at all.

n3.hintOnWrong: 让步句 → No matter how sticky, I'd do this again next year.

transition.en: The next morning, they drizzle their fresh syrup over warm pancakes.
transition.zh: 第二天早上，他们把新鲜糖浆淋在了热腾腾的薄煎饼上。

scenes.title: Breakfast with Fresh Syrup
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 用新鲜糖浆吃早餐

npcLine.en: This breakfast tastes better than any we've had in months.
npcLine.zh: 这顿早餐比我们几个月来吃过的任何一顿都好吃。

choices.text: It really does, that farm trip was worth every minute.
choices.zh: 确实如此，那趟农场之旅每一分钟都值得。

choices.text: It really doesn't, this tastes pretty ordinary.

n1.hintOnWrong: 回应比较句 → It really does, that farm trip was worth every minute.

npcLine.en: Can you believe we watched this syrup get made ourselves?
npcLine.zh: 你能相信这糖浆是我们亲眼看着做出来的吗？

choices.text: I honestly can't, it makes breakfast feel special.
choices.zh: 我真的不敢相信，这让早餐都变得特别了。

choices.text: I can believe it, this feels totally ordinary.

n2.hintOnWrong: 用 can 表惊讶 → I honestly can't, it makes breakfast feel special.

npcLine.en: Let's make maple season a family tradition every single year.
npcLine.zh: 我们把枫糖季定成每年的家庭传统吧。

choices.text: Let's do that, this deserves to happen every spring.
choices.zh: 好啊，每年春天都该有这个安排。

choices.text: Let's never visit a sugar shack again after this.

n3.hintOnWrong: 接受建议 → Let's do that, this deserves to happen every spring.

transition.en: One quiet evening, the phone rings. It's a voice they haven't heard in a while.
transition.zh: 一个安静的夜晚，电话响了。是一个好久没听到的声音。

npcLine.en: It's Mrs. Ho. I hope I'm not calling too late, dear.
npcLine.zh: 我是Ho太太。希望没打扰你太晚，亲爱的。

choices.text: Not at all, it's so good to hear your voice.
choices.zh: 一点也不晚，能听到您的声音真好。

choices.text: Not at all, it's so good to hearing your voice.

n1.hintOnWrong: so good to + 动词原形 → Not at all, it's so good to hear your voice.

npcLine.en: Uncle Lok found something in the old house that he says you both need to see.
npcLine.zh: Lok叔叔在老房子里发现了一样东西，他说你们俩都得来看看。

choices.text: Something Lily wrote? Now you have my full attention.
choices.zh: 是Lily写的东西？现在您完全抓住我的注意力了。

choices.text: Something Lily writes? Now you have my full attention.

n2.hintOnWrong: Lily 是过去的人，要用过去式 wrote → Something Lily wrote? Now you have my full attention.

npcLine.en: Come Saturday, and bring little Lily. He insists the whole family should be there.
npcLine.zh: 周六来吧，把小Lily也带上。他坚持要全家都到场。

choices.text: We'll be there, and we wouldn't miss it for anything.
choices.zh: 我们一定到，说什么也不会错过。

choices.text: We'll be there, and we wouldn't miss it for nothing.

n3.hintOnWrong: wouldn't miss it for anything 是固定说法，不能双重否定 → We'll be there, and we wouldn't miss it for anything.

transition.en: Saturday afternoon. The old house on the corner has a fresh coat of paint and a small crowd inside.
transition.zh: 周六下午。街角的老房子刷了新漆，屋里已经聚了一小群人。

scenes.title: Back at Lily's House
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · 重回 Lily's House

npcLine.en: Look who's here! She's grown so much since the last time we saw her.
npcLine.zh: 看看是谁来了！上次见到她之后她长大了好多。

choices.text: She has grown fast, and she already loves this place.
choices.zh: 她长得是快，而且她已经喜欢上这个地方了。

choices.text: She has grow fast, and she already loves this place.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 has + 过去分词 grown → She has grown fast, and she already loves this place.

npcLine.en: Mom has been talking about this evening all week, honestly.
npcLine.zh: 说实话，我妈这一整周都在念叨今晚。

choices.text: So have we, David. This house pulls everyone back.
choices.zh: 我们也是，David。这栋房子会把每个人都拉回来。

choices.text: So have we, David. This house pull everyone back.

n2.hintOnWrong: 第三人称单数 this house 后动词加 s → So have we, David. This house pulls everyone back.

npcLine.en: Emma's grandmother used to stand right where you're standing now.
npcLine.zh: Emma的祖母以前就常站在你现在站的这个位置。

choices.text: Then I'm standing in the right place tonight.
choices.zh: 那我今晚站对地方了。

choices.text: Then I'm stand in the right place tonight.

n3.hintOnWrong: 现在进行时 am + 动词-ing → Then I'm standing in the right place tonight.

transition.en: Uncle Lok, slower now but smiling, carries a small wooden box to the table.
transition.zh: Lok叔叔走得慢了，但笑着把一个小木盒端到桌上。

scenes.title: Uncle Lok's Box
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · 地板下的木盒

npcLine.en: When the floor was repaired last month, the workers found this under the boards.
npcLine.zh: 上个月修地板的时候，工人在木板底下发现了这个。

choices.text: Under the boards? It must have been hidden there for decades.
choices.zh: 在木板底下？那它肯定在那儿藏了几十年了。

choices.text: Under the boards? It must has been hidden there for decades.

n1.hintOnWrong: 情态动词后面用 have 不用 has → Under the boards? It must have been hidden there for decades.

npcLine.en: There's one more letter from Lily, and it isn't addressed to anyone we know.
npcLine.zh: 里面还有一封Lily的信，收信人不是我们认识的任何人。

choices.text: Who did she write it to, then?
choices.zh: 那她是写给谁的？

choices.text: Who she wrote it to, then?

n2.hintOnWrong: 特殊疑问句要有助动词 did → Who did she write it to, then?

npcLine.en: The envelope says: to whoever is living in this house in ten years.
npcLine.zh: 信封上写着：致十年后住在这栋房子里的人。

choices.text: Whoever is living here... that's us, and that's little Lily.
choices.zh: 十年后住在这里的人……就是我们，还有小Lily。

choices.text: Whoever living here... that's us, and that's little Lily.

n3.hintOnWrong: whoever 引导的从句要有动词 is → Whoever is living here... that's us, and that's little Lily.

transition.en: Emma unfolds the yellowed pages and reads aloud, her voice steady until the last line.
transition.zh: Emma展开泛黄的信纸大声读了起来，声音一直很稳，直到最后一行。

scenes.title: The Last Letter
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · 最后一封信

npcLine.en: She wrote that if this house was still standing, someone had kept the promise.
npcLine.zh: 她写道，如果这栋房子还立着，就说明有人守住了承诺。

choices.text: She admitted that she wasn't sure anyone would stay.
choices.zh: 她承认自己当时并不确定会有人留下来。

choices.text: She admitted that she isn't sure anyone would stay.

n1.hintOnWrong: 间接引语时态要后移：admitted that she wasn't → She admitted that she wasn't sure anyone would stay.

npcLine.en: Then she wrote: 'If you are reading this, the letters worked. Please write the next one.'
npcLine.zh: 然后她写道：'如果你正在读这封信，说明这些信起作用了。请写下一封。'

choices.text: If she hadn't written that, we might never have thought of it.
choices.zh: 如果她没写这句，我们可能永远想不到。

choices.text: If she hadn't wrote that, we might never have thought of it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 第三条件句 if + hadn't + 过去分词 written → If she hadn't written that, we might never have thought of it.

npcLine.en: The last line just says: 'Love travels slower than mail, but it always arrives.'
npcLine.zh: 最后一行只写着：'爱比信走得慢，但它总会到。'

choices.text: That's the truest thing I've heard in this house.
choices.zh: 这是我在这栋房子里听过最真的一句话。

choices.text: That's the most true thing I've heard in this house.

n3.hintOnWrong: 单音节形容词最高级加 -est：the truest → That's the truest thing I've heard in this house.

transition.en: The front door opens again. Sam walks in with a group from the east-end classroom.
transition.zh: 前门又开了。Sam带着东区教室的一群学生走了进来。

scenes.title: Sam and the Students
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · Sam 和他的学生

npcLine.en: Sorry we're late, the streetcar took forever. Everyone insisted on coming.
npcLine.zh: 抱歉来晚了，电车慢得要命。大家都坚持要来。

choices.text: You brought the whole class? Lily would have loved this.
choices.zh: 你把全班都带来了？Lily要是看到一定很高兴。

choices.text: You brought the whole class? Lily would loved this.

n1.hintOnWrong: would have + 过去分词 → You brought the whole class? Lily would have loved this.

npcLine.en: Remember when I told you I was scared to stand in front of a room?
npcLine.zh: 还记得我跟你说过我害怕站在一屋子人面前吗？

choices.text: I remember, and now you run a whole school of your own.
choices.zh: 我记得，而现在你自己办了一整所学校。

choices.text: I remember, and now you runs a whole school of your own.

n2.hintOnWrong: 主语 you 后动词用原形 run → I remember, and now you run a whole school of your own.

npcLine.en: None of this would exist if you hadn't come back for that promise.
npcLine.zh: 如果你当年没有为了那个约定回来，这一切都不会存在。

choices.text: Maybe not, though the letters were already here before me.
choices.zh: 也许吧，不过这些信在我来之前就已经在这儿了。

choices.text: Maybe not, though the letters was already here before me.

n3.hintOnWrong: 复数主语 the letters 配 were → Maybe not, though the letters were already here before me.

transition.en: Mr. Grant, the librarian who found the first clipping, taps his glass.
transition.zh: 当年找到第一张剪报的图书管理员Mr. Grant敲了敲杯子。

scenes.title: A Toast to Lily
scenes.subtitle: 老房子 · 为 Lily 举杯

npcLine.en: I've spent forty years among letters, and none of them were as stubborn as Lily's.
npcLine.zh: 我跟信件打了四十年交道，没有一封像Lily的信这么固执。

choices.text: Stubborn is the kindest word for it, Mr. Grant.
choices.zh: '固执'已经是最客气的说法了，Mr. Grant。

choices.text: Stubborn is the most kind word for it, Mr. Grant.

n1.hintOnWrong: kind 的最高级是 kindest，不用 most → Stubborn is the kindest word for it, Mr. Grant.

npcLine.en: To the woman who wrote to strangers, and to the strangers who became family.
npcLine.zh: 敬那位给陌生人写信的女士，也敬那些变成了家人的陌生人。

choices.text: To Lily, who never met us but somehow knew us anyway.
choices.zh: 敬Lily，她从没见过我们，却不知怎么就懂我们。

choices.text: To Lily, which never met us but somehow knew us anyway.

n2.hintOnWrong: 指人用 who 不用 which → To Lily, who never met us but somehow knew us anyway.

npcLine.en: Although she never saw this room full, I think she always expected it.
npcLine.zh: 虽然她从没见过这间屋子坐满人，我想她一直都料到了。

choices.text: Although she never saw it, she wrote as if she had.
choices.zh: 虽然她从没见过，可她写得就像见过一样。

choices.text: Although she never see it, she wrote as if she had.

n3.hintOnWrong: never 后面用过去式 saw → Although she never saw it, she wrote as if she had.

transition.en: Later, in the quiet kitchen, Emma sets a blank sheet of paper on the table.
transition.zh: 晚些时候，安静的厨房里，Emma把一张空白信纸放到桌上。

npcLine.en: I wish Grandma could see how far her ten letters traveled.
npcLine.zh: 真希望外婆能看到她那十封信走了多远。

choices.text: I wish she could too, but tonight she's in every word.
choices.zh: 我也希望她能看到，不过今晚每一个字里都有她。

choices.text: I wish she can too, but tonight she's in every word.

n1.hintOnWrong: I wish 后面用过去式表虚拟：could → I wish she could too, but tonight she's in every word.

npcLine.en: What if we wrote one for our Lily, to open when she turns eleven?
npcLine.zh: 要不我们也给我们的Lily写一封，等她十一岁的时候打开？

choices.text: Ten years from now? That's a decade she'll have to wait.
choices.zh: 十年后？那她得等上整整十年。

choices.text: Ten years from now? That's a decade she'll has to wait.

n2.hintOnWrong: will 后面接动词原形 have → Ten years from now? That's a decade she'll have to wait.

npcLine.en: If she reads it at eleven, she'll be exactly the age I was when I wrote to you.
npcLine.zh: 如果她十一岁读到它，正好是我当年给你写信的年纪。

choices.text: Then the promise comes full circle, doesn't it?
choices.zh: 那这个约定就绕了一整圈回到原点了，是不是？

choices.text: Then the promise comes full circle, isn't it?

n3.hintOnWrong: 反义疑问句要跟主句动词 comes 对应，用 doesn't it → Then the promise comes full circle, doesn't it?

transition.en: Two pens, one page. They take turns writing.
transition.zh: 两支笔，一张纸。两人轮流写。

scenes.title: Writing to Lily
scenes.subtitle: 厨房 · 写给小 Lily 的信

npcLine.en: You start. Tell her what this house had already been before she was born.
npcLine.zh: 你先写。告诉她在她出生之前，这栋房子已经是什么了。

choices.text: By the time you arrived, this house had already saved two families.
choices.zh: 在你来到这个世界之前，这栋房子已经救过两个家庭。

choices.text: By the time you arrived, this house has already saved two families.

n1.hintOnWrong: 过去完成时 had already + 过去分词 → By the time you arrived, this house had already saved two families.

npcLine.en: Now tell her the truth about her father, the one who almost didn't come back.
npcLine.zh: 现在跟她说说她爸爸的实话，那个差点没有回来的人。

choices.text: I nearly stayed away, but a promise kept pulling me home.
choices.zh: 我差点就没回来，但一个约定一直把我往家里拉。

choices.text: I nearly stay away, but a promise kept pulling me home.

n2.hintOnWrong: 讲过去的事用过去式 stayed → I nearly stayed away, but a promise kept pulling me home.

npcLine.en: Should we tell her that the letters were her great-grandmother's idea?
npcLine.zh: 要不要告诉她，写信这件事是她曾外婆的主意？

choices.text: Yes, tell her the letters were written by someone who loved strangers.
choices.zh: 要，告诉她这些信是一个爱着陌生人的人写的。

choices.text: Yes, tell her the letters were wrote by someone who loved strangers.

n3.hintOnWrong: 被动语态 were + 过去分词 written → Yes, tell her the letters were written by someone who loved strangers.

transition.en: Mrs. Ho brings an empty envelope from the same box, as if she had known all along.
transition.zh: Ho太太从同一个木盒里拿出一个空信封，仿佛她早就知道会有这一刻。

npcLine.en: This house has kept letters safe for forty years. It can keep one more.
npcLine.zh: 这栋房子把信安安稳稳地守了四十年。再多守一封也没问题。

choices.text: Then it goes back to the place where the others waited.
choices.zh: 那就把它放回其他信等过的那个地方。

choices.text: Then it goes back to the place which the others waited.

n1.hintOnWrong: 表示地点的定语从句用 where → Then it goes back to the place where the others waited.

npcLine.en: Write the date on the front, so she knows how long it traveled.
npcLine.zh: 在信封正面写上日期，这样她就知道这封信走了多久。

choices.text: I've written today's date and the year she should open it.
choices.zh: 我写好了今天的日期，还有她该打开它的那一年。

choices.text: I've wrote today's date and the year she should open it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 have + 过去分词 written → I've written today's date and the year she should open it.

npcLine.en: David says he'll check on it every spring, just in case.
npcLine.zh: David说他每年春天都会来看一眼，以防万一。

choices.text: He said he'd check every spring? That's Ho family loyalty.
choices.zh: 他说他每年春天都来看？这就是Ho家的忠诚。

choices.text: He said him would check every spring? That's Ho family loyalty.

n3.hintOnWrong: 间接引语从句里的主语用 he 不用 him → He said he'd check every spring? That's Ho family loyalty.

transition.en: Midnight. The guests have gone. Emma and you sit on the porch with Lily asleep between you.
transition.zh: 午夜。客人都走了。你和Emma坐在门廊上，Lily在你们中间睡着了。

npcLine.en: Ten years ago tonight, I didn't know if you'd come. Now look at us.
npcLine.zh: 十年前的今晚，我不知道你会不会来。现在看看我们。

choices.text: You waited, I came, and everything since has been the reward.
choices.zh: 你等了，我来了，之后的一切都是回报。

choices.text: You waited, I came, and everything since has be the reward.

n1.hintOnWrong: 现在完成时 has + 过去分词 been → You waited, I came, and everything since has been the reward.

npcLine.en: Do you think she'll understand the letter when she opens it?
npcLine.zh: 你觉得她打开信的时候能看懂吗？

choices.text: If she doesn't, she'll have ten more years to grow into it.
choices.zh: 如果看不懂，她还有十年可以慢慢长大去懂它。

choices.text: If she don't, she'll have ten more years to grow into it.

n2.hintOnWrong: 第三人称单数 she 配 doesn't → If she doesn't, she'll have ten more years to grow into it.

npcLine.en: So this isn't the end of the story, is it?
npcLine.zh: 所以这不是故事的结局，对吧？

choices.text: No. It's just where our decade hands the pen to hers.
choices.zh: 不是。这只是我们的十年把笔递给她的十年的地方。

choices.text: No. It's just where our decade hand the pen to hers.

n3.hintOnWrong: 第三人称单数 our decade 后动词加 s → No. It's just where our decade hands the pen to hers.
